        supNormOn (gradient u) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / 2)) +
          holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient u) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / 2)) ≤
            C_d * oscOn u (Metric.ball 0 1)

noncomputable def projSpace {d : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).symm (fun i => z (Fin.castSucc i))

noncomputable def projTime {d : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  z (Fin.last d)

noncomputable def mkSpaceTime {d : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.snoc (fun i => x i) t)

noncomputable def liftFunc {d : ℕ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  u (projSpace z) + projTime z

def IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic (d : ℕ) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Bornology.IsBounded (u '' Metric.ball 0 1) ∧
  IsInfinityHarmonicOn u (Metric.ball 0 1) ∧
  u 0 = 0 ∧
  oscOn u (Metric.ball 0 1) ≤ 1

def IsCylinderGood {d : ℕ} (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r lam : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), P ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      let N_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P‖⁻¹) • P
      |inner ℝ h N_P| ≤ r →
      ‖h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * r →
      |U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P h| ≤ lam * r

def HasUniformCylinderPowerDecay (d : ℕ) (B γ s₀ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < B ∧ 0 < γ ∧ γ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < s₀ ∧ s₀ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
  ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
    IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u →
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ s₀ * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) →
        ∀ lam : ℝ, B * (r / (3 / 4 - ‖z‖)) ^ γ < lam → lam < 1 →
          IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u) z r lam

noncomputable def limitingOperator {d : ℕ} (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ϕ z)) 1
  fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z ξ ξ

def InLimitingClassA (d : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Continuous v ∧
  (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
    ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z = v z → (∀ y ∈ V, v y ≤ ϕ y) →
      0 ≤ limitingOperator ϕ z) ∧
  (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
    ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z = v z → (∀ y ∈ V, ϕ y ≤ v y) →
      limitingOperator ϕ z ≤ 0) ∧
  (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ), 0 < R →
    ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
      ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ℓ : ℝ),
        |ℓ| ≤ R → ‖h - ℓ • p‖ ≤ R →
        |v (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) -
          inner ℝ p h - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ| ≤ C₀ * R)

def IsAffineSpaceTime (d : ℕ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (c : ℝ),
    ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), v z = inner ℝ P z + c

def IsCylinderFitAt {d : ℕ} (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r lam : ℝ)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : Prop :=

def HasUniformNormalizedLiftBounds (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
    IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u →
    let U := liftFunc u
    IsInfinityHarmonicOn U (Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8), |U z| ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8),
      ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8),
        |U z₁ - U z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) →
        ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam < 1 →
          ∀ P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
            IsCylinderFitAt U z r lam P →
            ‖P‖ ≤ L + Real.sqrt lam ∧ |projTime P - 1| ≤ Real.sqrt lam)

def HasUniformQualitativeFlatness (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ s₀ : ℝ, 0 < s₀ ∧ s₀ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
      ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
        IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u →
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
          ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ s₀ * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) →

def HasSelectedBlowupScales (d : ℕ)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : ℕ,
    IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d (u_seq i) ∧
    z_seq i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
    0 < r_seq i ∧
    r_seq i ≤ (1 / (i + 8 : ℝ)) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) ∧
    0 < lam_seq i ∧
    lam_seq i < 1 / 128 ∧
    ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (lam_seq i) ∧
    IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (32 * lam_seq i)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto lam_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  (∀ M : ℝ, 2 ≤ M →
    ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖z - z_seq i‖ ≤ M * r_seq i →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ M * r_seq i →
          z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
          r ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) ∧
          IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) z r (32 * lam_seq i))

noncomputable def anisotropicRescale {d : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r c lam : ℝ)
    (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let x := projSpace w
  let t := projTime w
  (U (z + r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) t)) - U z - r * c * t) / (r * c * lam)

def IsAnisotropicBlowupLimit (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  v 0 = 0 ∧
  ∃ (k : ℕ → ℕ) (P_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (O_seq : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))),
    StrictMono k ∧
    (∀ i : ℕ,
      let j := k i
      IsCylinderFitAt (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (z_seq j) (r_seq j) (32 * lam_seq j) (P_seq i) ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖P_seq i‖ ∧ ‖P_seq i‖ ≤ L + 1 ∧
      O_seq i (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = (‖P_seq i‖⁻¹) • P_seq i) ∧
    (∀ K ε : ℝ, 0 < K → 0 < ε →
      ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
        let j := k i
        ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖w‖ ≤ K →
          |anisotropicRescale (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (z_seq j) (r_seq j) ‖P_seq i‖ (lam_seq j) (O_seq i) w - v w| ≤ ε)

    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : ℕ,
    IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d (u_seq i) ∧
    z_seq i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
    0 < r_seq i ∧
    r_seq i ≤ (1 / (i + 8 : ℝ)) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) ∧
    0 < lam_seq i ∧
    lam_seq i < 1 / 128 ∧
    ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (lam_seq i) ∧
    IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (32 * lam_seq i)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto lam_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  (∀ M : ℝ, 2 ≤ M →
    ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖z - z_seq i‖ ≤ M * r_seq i →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ M * r_seq i →
          z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
          r ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) ∧
          IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) z r (32 * lam_seq i))

noncomputable def anisotropicRescale {d : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r c lam : ℝ)
    (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let x := projSpace w
  let t := projTime w
  (U (z + r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) t)) - U z - r * c * t) / (r * c * lam)

def IsAnisotropicBlowupLimit (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  v 0 = 0 ∧
  ∃ (k : ℕ → ℕ) (P_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (O_seq : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))),
    StrictMono k ∧
    (∀ i : ℕ,
      let j := k i
      IsCylinderFitAt (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (z_seq j) (r_seq j) (32 * lam_seq j) (P_seq i) ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖P_seq i‖ ∧ ‖P_seq i‖ ≤ L + 1 ∧
      O_seq i (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = (‖P_seq i‖⁻¹) • P_seq i) ∧
    (∀ K ε : ℝ, 0 < K → 0 < ε →
      ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
        let j := k i
        ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖w‖ ≤ K →
          |anisotropicRescale (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (z_seq j) (r_seq j) ‖P_seq i‖ (lam_seq j) (O_seq i) w - v w| ≤ ε)

by
  by_contra h_nonaff
  have hC₁ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max C₀ 1 := le_max_right C₀ 1
  have hC₁_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max C₀ 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨κ, H_star, v_star, hκ_pos, hv_star_class, hv_star_cent, hv_star_jensen,
    hv_star_gap, hv_star_slope, hW_slope⟩ :=
    extremal_barycentric_contact d hd C₀ hC₀ v hv h_nonaff
  obtain ⟨K, x_end, H_end, k, x_seq, p_seq, a_seq, hK_pos, hslope_end, hk_mono, h_contacts⟩ :=
    stopped_walk_contact_localization d hd (max C₀ 1) hC₁ κ H_star hκ_pos v_star
      hv_star_class hv_star_cent hv_star_jensen hv_star_gap ⟨hv_star_slope, hW_slope⟩
  obtain ⟨v_inf, b, B, hv_inf_class, hv_inf_slopes, hv_inf_gap⟩ :=
    constant_slope_limit_of_localized_contacts d hd (max C₀ 1) hC₁ κ hκ_pos v_star
      hv_star_class hv_star_jensen K x_end H_end k x_seq p_seq a_seq
      hK_pos hslope_end hk_mono h_contacts
  have hv_inf_aff : IsAffineSpaceTime d v_inf :=
    affine_of_constant_envelope_slopes d hd (max C₀ 1) hC₁_nonneg v_inf
      hv_inf_class b 0 B hv_inf_slopes
  let z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
  obtain ⟨P, c, hP⟩ := hv_inf_aff
  have h_mem : v_inf z₀ ∈
      { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace z₀) ∧
        val = (∑ i, θ i * v_inf (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) } := by
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => projSpace z₀, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
    have hz : mkSpaceTime (projSpace z₀) (projTime z₀) = z₀ := by
      ext j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
      · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime]
      · intro i
        simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace]
    simp [hz]
  have h_ub : ∀ val ∈
      { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace z₀) ∧
        val = (∑ i, θ i * v_inf (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) }, val ≤ v_inf z₀ := by
    rintro val ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
    have hz_sum : ∑ i, θ i • mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀) = z₀ := by
      apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).injective
      ext j
      rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
      · simp only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mkSpaceTime,
          ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Fin.snoc_last]
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hθ_sum, one_mul]
        rfl
      · intro m
        simp only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mkSpaceTime,
          ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        have h_m := congr_fun (congr_arg (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ) hy_mean) m
        rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply] at h_m
        simpa [projSpace] using h_m
    have hv_sum : (∑ i, θ i * v_inf (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) = v_inf z₀ := by
      simp_rw [hP]
      calc ∑ i, θ i * (inner ℝ P (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀)) + c)
        _ = (∑ i, inner ℝ P (θ i • mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) + (∑ i, θ i) * c := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            congr 1 with i
            rw [real_inner_smul_right]
            ring
        _ = inner ℝ P (∑ i, θ i • mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀)) + 1 * c := by
            rw [← inner_sum, hθ_sum]
        _ = inner ℝ P z₀ + c := by rw [hz_sum, one_mul]
    rw [hv_sum]
    have h_pen : 0 ≤ (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) := by
      apply div_nonneg
      · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro i _
        exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
      · norm_num
    linarith
  have h_eq : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v_inf z₀ = v_inf z₀ :=
    le_antisymm (csSup_le ⟨v_inf z₀, h_mem⟩ h_ub) (le_csSup ⟨v_inf z₀, h_ub⟩ h_mem)

  linarith

liouville_limiting_class.definitions:
def IsFitAt (d : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ)
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ℓ : ℝ),
    |ℓ| ≤ R → ‖h - ℓ • p‖ ≤ R →
    |v (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) -
      inner ℝ p h - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ| ≤ C₀ * R

def IsCenteredAt (d : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) = 0 ∧ IsFitAt d C₀ v x₀ t₀ 1 0 0

noncomputable def quadEnvelopePlus (d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  sSup ((fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
    f (mkSpaceTime y (projTime z + ℓ)) - ‖y - projSpace z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ)

noncomputable def quadEnvelopeMinus (d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  sInf ((fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
    f (mkSpaceTime y (projTime z - ℓ)) + ‖y - projSpace z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ)

noncomputable def slopePlus (d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ f z - f z) / ℓ

noncomputable def slopeMinus (d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (f z - quadEnvelopeMinus d ℓ f z) / ℓ

def HasCommonSlopeLimit (d : ℕ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => slopePlus d ℓ f z) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => slopeMinus d ℓ f z) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H)

def HasHorizontalJensenBound (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
    (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) →
    let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
    let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)
    (∑ i, θ i * f (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - f (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ κ * r

noncomputable def barycentricEnvelope (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  sSup { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
    (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace z) ∧
    val = (∑ i, θ i * f (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z))) -
      (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s) }

noncomputable def shiftedBarycentricEnvelope (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  barycentricEnvelope d (projTime z) f z - κ ^ 2 * projTime z / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: extremal_barycentric_contact
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₀ : ℝ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀)
    (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv₀ : InLimitingClassA d C₀ v₀)
    (h_nonaff : ¬ IsAffineSpaceTime d v₀) :
    ∃ (κ H_star : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      0 < κ ∧
      InLimitingClassA d (max C₀ 1) v ∧
      IsCenteredAt d (max C₀ 1) v 0 1 ∧
      HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v ∧
      barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2 ∧
      HasCommonSlopeLimit d v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) H_star ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => slopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H_star)

subgoal_signatures.name: stopped_walk_contact_localization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
    (κ H_star : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_class : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (hv_gap : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2)
    (hv_slope : HasCommonSlopeLimit d v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) H_star ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => slopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H_star)) :
    ∃ (K : ℝ) (x_end : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (H_end : ℝ)
      (k : ℕ → ℕ) (x_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
      (p_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a_seq : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 < K ∧
      HasCommonSlopeLimit d v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) H_end ∧
      StrictMono k ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ,
        let r_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k j)
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime (x_seq j) r_j) =
          v (mkSpaceTime (x_seq j) r_j) ∧
        IsFitAt d C₁ v (x_seq j) r_j r_j (p_seq j) (a_seq j) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_fderiv_scale : ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (c b : ℝ)
      (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f x →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => c * f y + b) x = c • fderiv ℝ f x := by
    intro f c b x hf
    rw [fderiv_add_const]
    exact fderiv_const_smul hf c
  have h_grad_scale : ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (c b : ℝ)
      (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f x →
      gradient (fun y => c * f y + b) x = c • gradient f x := by
    intro f c b x hf
    unfold gradient
    rw [h_fderiv_scale f c b x hf, LinearIsometryEquiv.map_smul]
  have h_lap_scale : ∀ (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
      (V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (c b : ℝ),
      IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
      infinityLaplacian (fun y => c * ϕ y + b) z = c ^ 3 * infinityLaplacian ϕ z := by
    intro ϕ V z c b hV_open hz hϕ_diff
    have h_diff_on : ∀ y ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ y := fun y hy =>
      (hϕ_diff.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h_ev : fderiv ℝ (fun y => c * ϕ y + b) =ᶠ[nhds z] (c • fderiv ℝ ϕ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hz)
        (fun y hy => h_fderiv_scale ϕ c b y (h_diff_on y hy))
    have h_fderiv2_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z :=
      ((hϕ_diff.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz)).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt_one
    have h_fderiv2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => c * ϕ y + b)) z = c • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z := by
      rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_smul h_fderiv2_diff c
    unfold infinityLaplacian
    rw [h_fderiv2, h_grad_scale ϕ c b z (h_diff_on z hz)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  let B1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) := Metric.ball 0 1
  let B12 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) := Metric.ball 0 (1 / 2)
  have h0_mem : (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) ∈ B1 := Metric.mem_ball_self zero_lt_one
  have h_sub : B12 ⊆ B1 := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by norm_num)
  rcases le_or_gt (oscOn u B1) 0 with hM_le | hM_pos
  · have h0_le : u 0 ≤ sSup (u '' B1) := le_csSup hbdd.bddAbove ⟨0, h0_mem, rfl⟩
    have h0_ge : sInf (u '' B1) ≤ u 0 := csInf_le hbdd.bddBelow ⟨0, h0_mem, rfl⟩
    have hM_def : oscOn u B1 = sSup (u '' B1) - sInf (u '' B1) := rfl
    have hM_zero : oscOn u B1 = 0 := by linarith
    have hu_const : ∀ x ∈ B12, u x = u 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hx_le : u x ≤ sSup (u '' B1) := le_csSup hbdd.bddAbove ⟨x, h_sub hx, rfl⟩
      have hx_ge : sInf (u '' B1) ≤ u x := csInf_le hbdd.bddBelow ⟨x, h_sub hx, rfl⟩
      linarith
    have h_grad_zero : ∀ x ∈ B12, gradient u x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h_ev : u =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun _ => u 0) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx) hu_const
      unfold gradient
      rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.map_zero]
    have h_sup_mem : ∀ a ∈ (fun x => ‖gradient u x‖) '' B12, a ≤ 0 := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      dsimp
      rw [h_grad_zero x hx, norm_zero]
    have h_hold_mem : ∀ q ∈ { q : ℝ | ∃ x ∈ B12, ∃ y ∈ B12, x ≠ y ∧
        q = ‖gradient u x - gradient u y‖ / ‖x - y‖ ^ α_d }, q ≤ 0 := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, _, rfl⟩
      rw [h_grad_zero x hx, h_grad_zero y hy, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_div]
    refine ⟨⟨contDiffOn_const.congr hu_const, hbdd.subset (Set.image_mono h_sub),
      ⟨0, h_sup_mem⟩, ⟨0, h_hold_mem⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    have h_sup_le : supNormOn (gradient u) B12 ≤ 0 := Real.sSup_nonpos h_sup_mem
    have h_hold_le : holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient u) B12 ≤ 0 := Real.sSup_nonpos h_hold_mem
    change supNormOn (gradient u) B12 + holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient u) B12 ≤ C_d * oscOn u B1
    rw [hM_zero, mul_zero]
    linarith
  · let M : ℝ := oscOn u B1
    let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x => M⁻¹ * (u x - u 0)
    have hM_ne : M ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hM_pos
    have hMinv_pos : 0 < M⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hM_pos
    have hMinv_nonneg : 0 ≤ M⁻¹ := le_of_lt hMinv_pos
    have hw_lower : ∀ y ∈ w '' B1, M⁻¹ * (sInf (u '' B1) - u 0) ≤ y := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sub_le_sub_right (csInf_le hbdd.bddBelow ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩) (u 0)) hMinv_nonneg
    have hw_upper : ∀ y ∈ w '' B1, y ≤ M⁻¹ * (sSup (u '' B1) - u 0) := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sub_le_sub_right (le_csSup hbdd.bddAbove ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩) (u 0)) hMinv_nonneg
    have hw_bdd : Bornology.IsBounded (w '' B1) :=
      (IsOrderBornology.isBounded_iff_bddBelow_bddAbove (w '' B1)).mpr
        ⟨⟨M⁻¹ * (sInf (u '' B1) - u 0), hw_lower⟩, ⟨M⁻¹ * (sSup (u '' B1) - u 0), hw_upper⟩⟩
    have hw_ne : (w '' B1).Nonempty := ⟨w 0, 0, h0_mem, rfl⟩
    have hw_sup : sSup (w '' B1) ≤ M⁻¹ * (sSup (u '' B1) - u 0) := csSup_le hw_ne hw_upper
    have hw_inf : M⁻¹ * (sInf (u '' B1) - u 0) ≤ sInf (w '' B1) := le_csInf hw_ne hw_lower
    have hw_osc : oscOn w B1 ≤ 1 := by
      unfold oscOn
      have h_diff : M⁻¹ * (sSup (u '' B1) - u 0) - M⁻¹ * (sInf (u '' B1) - u 0) = 1 := by
        calc M⁻¹ * (sSup (u '' B1) - u 0) - M⁻¹ * (sInf (u '' B1) - u 0)
            = M⁻¹ * (sSup (u '' B1) - sInf (u '' B1)) := by ring
          _ = M⁻¹ * M := rfl
          _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hM_ne
      linarith
    rcases hhar with ⟨hu_cont, hu_sub, hu_sup⟩
    have hw_cont : ContinuousOn w B1 := by
      change ContinuousOn (fun x => M⁻¹ • (u x - u 0)) B1
      exact (hu_cont.sub continuousOn_const).const_smul M⁻¹
    have hw_har : IsInfinityHarmonicOn w B1 := by
      refine ⟨hw_cont, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz ϕ V hV_open hzV hV_sub hϕ_diff hϕ_z hϕ_ge
        let ϕ' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun y => M * ϕ y + u 0
        have hϕ'_diff : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ' V := by
          change ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => M • ϕ y + u 0) V
          exact (hϕ_diff.const_smul M).add contDiffOn_const
        have hϕ'_z : ϕ' z = u z := by
          dsimp [ϕ']
          rw [hϕ_z]
          dsimp [w]
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hM_ne, one_mul, sub_add_cancel]
        have hϕ'_ge : ∀ y ∈ V, u y ≤ ϕ' y := by
          intro y hy
          have h_le := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hϕ_ge y hy) (le_of_lt hM_pos)
          dsimp [w] at h_le
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hM_ne, one_mul] at h_le
          dsimp [ϕ']
          linarith
        have h_lap := hu_sub z hz ϕ' V hV_open hzV hV_sub hϕ'_diff hϕ'_z hϕ'_ge
        rw [h_lap_scale ϕ V z M (u 0) hV_open hzV hϕ_diff] at h_lap
        exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_lap (pow_pos hM_pos 3)
      · intro z hz ϕ V hV_open hzV hV_sub hϕ_diff hϕ_z hϕ_le
        let ϕ' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun y => M * ϕ y + u 0
        have hϕ'_diff : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ' V := by
          change ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => M • ϕ y + u 0) V
          exact (hϕ_diff.const_smul M).add contDiffOn_const
        have hϕ'_z : ϕ' z = u z := by
          dsimp [ϕ']
          rw [hϕ_z]
          dsimp [w]
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hM_ne, one_mul, sub_add_cancel]
        have hϕ'_le : ∀ y ∈ V, ϕ' y ≤ u y := by
          intro y hy
          have h_le := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hϕ_le y hy) (le_of_lt hM_pos)
          dsimp [w] at h_le
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hM_ne, one_mul] at h_le
          dsimp [ϕ']
          linarith
        have h_lap := hu_sup z hz ϕ' V hV_open hzV hV_sub hϕ'_diff hϕ'_z hϕ'_le
        rw [h_lap_scale ϕ V z M (u 0) hV_open hzV hϕ_diff] at h_lap
        exact nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right h_lap (pow_pos hM_pos 3)
    have hw_norm : IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d w :=
      ⟨hw_bdd, hw_har, by simp [w], hw_osc⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨hw_diff, _, hw_grad_bdd, hw_hold_bdd⟩, hw_est⟩ := h_norm w hw_norm
    have hu_eq : u = fun y => M * w y + u 0 := by
      ext y
      dsimp [w]
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hM_ne, one_mul, sub_add_cancel]
    have hu_diff : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u B12 := by
      rw [hu_eq]
      change ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => M • w y + u 0) B12
      exact (hw_diff.const_smul M).add contDiffOn_const
    have hu_bdd12 : Bornology.IsBounded (u '' B12) :=
      hbdd.subset (Set.image_mono h_sub)
    have hu_grad : ∀ x ∈ B12, gradient u x = M • gradient w x := by
      intro x hx
      have hw_diff_x : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x :=
        (hw_diff.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt_one
      rw [hu_eq]
      exact h_grad_scale w M (u 0) x hw_diff_x
    have h_sup_w_nonneg : 0 ≤ supNormOn (gradient w) B12 :=
      Real.sSup_nonneg (by rintro _ ⟨x, _, rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _)
    have h_hold_w_nonneg : 0 ≤ holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient w) B12 :=
      Real.sSup_nonneg (by rintro _ ⟨x, _, y, _, _, rfl⟩; exact div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
    have h_sup_u_mem : ∀ a ∈ (fun x => ‖gradient u x‖) '' B12, a ≤ M * supNormOn (gradient w) B12 := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      dsimp
      rw [hu_grad x hx, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hM_pos]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_csSup hw_grad_bdd ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩) (le_of_lt hM_pos)
    have h_hold_u_mem : ∀ q ∈ { q : ℝ | ∃ x ∈ B12, ∃ y ∈ B12, x ≠ y ∧
        q = ‖gradient u x - gradient u y‖ / ‖x - y‖ ^ α_d },
        q ≤ M * holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient w) B12 := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, rfl⟩
      rw [hu_grad x hx, hu_grad y hy, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hM_pos, mul_div_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_csSup hw_hold_bdd ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, rfl⟩) (le_of_lt hM_pos)
    refine ⟨⟨hu_diff, hu_bdd12, ⟨M * supNormOn (gradient w) B12, h_sup_u_mem⟩,
      ⟨M * holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient w) B12, h_hold_u_mem⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    have h_sup_u_le : supNormOn (gradient u) B12 ≤ M * supNormOn (gradient w) B12 :=
      Real.sSup_le h_sup_u_mem (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hM_pos) h_sup_w_nonneg)
    have h_hold_u_le : holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient u) B12 ≤ M * holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient w) B12 :=
      Real.sSup_le h_hold_u_mem (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hM_pos) h_hold_w_nonneg)
    have h_mul_est : M * (supNormOn (gradient w) B12 + holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient w) B12) ≤ M * C_d :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_est (le_of_lt hM_pos)
    change supNormOn (gradient u) B12 + holderSeminormOn α_d (gradient u) B12 ≤ C_d * M
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (B γ s₀ : ℝ)
    (h_decay : HasUniformCylinderPowerDecay d B γ s₀) :
    ∃ (A₀ r₀ : ℝ),
      0 < A₀ ∧ 0 < r₀ ∧ r₀ ≤ 1 ∧
      A₀ * r₀ ^ γ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      Real.sqrt A₀ * r₀ ^ (1 + γ / 2) ≤ 1 / 4 ∧
      ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
        IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u →
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1, |u x| ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (1 / 2),
          ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ r₀ →
            ∃ p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
              ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
                ‖h‖ ≤ Real.sqrt A₀ * r ^ (1 + γ / 2) →
                |u (y + h) - u y - inner ℝ p h| ≤ A₀ * r ^ (1 + γ))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_projSpace_mk : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), projSpace (mkSpaceTime x 0) = x := by
    intro x
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime_mk : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), projTime (mkSpaceTime x 0) = 0 := by
    intro x
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_lift_mk : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      liftFunc u (mkSpaceTime x 0) = u x := by
    intro u x
    simp [liftFunc, h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk]
  have h_mk_add : ∀ x h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      mkSpaceTime x 0 + mkSpaceTime h 0 = mkSpaceTime (x + h) 0 := by
    intro x h
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp [mkSpaceTime]
  have h_norm_mk : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖mkSpaceTime x 0‖ = ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    congr 1
    have h_last : ‖(mkSpaceTime x 0) (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
    have h_cast : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖(mkSpaceTime x 0) (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖x i‖ ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
    linarith
  have h_inner_mk : ∀ (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      inner ℝ P (mkSpaceTime h 0) = inner ℝ (projSpace P) h := by
    intro P h
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have h_last : inner ℝ (P (Fin.last d)) ((mkSpaceTime h 0) (Fin.last d)) = 0 := by
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
    have h_cast : ∑ i : Fin d, inner ℝ (P (Fin.castSucc i)) ((mkSpaceTime h 0) (Fin.castSucc i)) =
        ∑ i : Fin d, inner ℝ ((projSpace P) i) (h i) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hB_pos, hγ_pos, hγ_le, hs₀_pos, hs₀_le, h_cyl_all⟩ := h_decay
  let A₀ : ℝ := 2 * B * (4 : ℝ) ^ γ
  have hA₀_pos : 0 < A₀ := by positivity
  let r₀ : ℝ := min (s₀ / 4) (((2 * A₀)⁻¹) ^ (γ⁻¹))
  have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := by
    refine lt_min (by positivity) ?_
    positivity
  have hr₀_le_s₀ : r₀ ≤ s₀ / 4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hr₀_le_quarter : r₀ ≤ 1 / 4 := by linarith
  have hr₀_le_one : r₀ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hAr₀_le : A₀ * r₀ ^ γ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hr₀_le_inv : r₀ ≤ ((2 * A₀)⁻¹) ^ (γ⁻¹) := min_le_right _ _
    have hrpow : r₀ ^ γ ≤ (((2 * A₀)⁻¹) ^ (γ⁻¹)) ^ γ :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hr₀_pos) hr₀_le_inv (le_of_lt hγ_pos)
    have h_inv_rpow : (((2 * A₀)⁻¹) ^ (γ⁻¹)) ^ γ = (2 * A₀)⁻¹ :=
      Real.rpow_inv_rpow (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hγ_pos)
    rw [h_inv_rpow] at hrpow
    calc A₀ * r₀ ^ γ ≤ A₀ * (2 * A₀)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow (le_of_lt hA₀_pos)
      _ = 1 / 2 := by
          have hA₀_ne : A₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA₀_pos
          field_simp [hA₀_ne]
  have h_rho_eq : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      Real.sqrt A₀ * r ^ (1 + γ / 2) = Real.sqrt (A₀ * r ^ γ) * r := by
    intro r hr_pos
    have h1 : r ^ (1 + γ / 2) = r * Real.sqrt (r ^ γ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add hr_pos 1 (γ / 2), Real.rpow_one]
      have h_half : γ / 2 = γ * (1 / 2) := by ring
      rw [h_half, Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hr_pos) γ (1 / 2), ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (r ^ γ)]
    rw [h1, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.sqrt A₀) r, mul_assoc,
      ← Real.sqrt_mul (le_of_lt hA₀_pos) (r ^ γ), mul_comm r]
  have hρ₀_le : Real.sqrt A₀ * r₀ ^ (1 + γ / 2) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    rw [h_rho_eq r₀ hr₀_pos]
    have h_sqrt_le : Real.sqrt (A₀ * r₀ ^ γ) ≤ 1 := by
      calc Real.sqrt (A₀ * r₀ ^ γ) ≤ Real.sqrt 1 :=
            Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
        _ = 1 := Real.sqrt_one
    calc Real.sqrt (A₀ * r₀ ^ γ) * r₀ ≤ 1 * (1 / 4) :=
          mul_le_mul h_sqrt_le hr₀_le_quarter (le_of_lt hr₀_pos) zero_le_one
      _ = 1 / 4 := by ring
  refine ⟨A₀, r₀, hA₀_pos, hr₀_pos, hr₀_le_one, hAr₀_le, hρ₀_le, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨hbdd, _, hu0, hosc⟩ := hu
    intro x hx
    have h0_mem : (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1 :=
      Metric.mem_ball_self zero_lt_one
    have hu0_mem : u 0 ∈ u '' Metric.ball 0 1 := Set.mem_image_of_mem u h0_mem
    have hux_mem : u x ∈ u '' Metric.ball 0 1 := Set.mem_image_of_mem u hx
    have h_ux_le : u x ≤ sSup (u '' Metric.ball 0 1) := le_csSup hbdd.bddAbove hux_mem
    have h_le_ux : sInf (u '' Metric.ball 0 1) ≤ u x := csInf_le hbdd.bddBelow hux_mem
    have h_u0_le : u 0 ≤ sSup (u '' Metric.ball 0 1) := le_csSup hbdd.bddAbove hu0_mem
    have h_le_u0 : sInf (u '' Metric.ball 0 1) ≤ u 0 := csInf_le hbdd.bddBelow hu0_mem
    change sSup (u '' Metric.ball 0 1) - sInf (u '' Metric.ball 0 1) ≤ 1 at hosc
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  · intro y hy r hr_pos hr_le
    let z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime y 0
    let lam : ℝ := A₀ * r ^ γ
    have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by positivity
    have hy_norm : ‖y‖ < 1 / 2 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hy
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = ‖y‖ := h_norm_mk y
    have hz_mem : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hz_norm]
      linarith
    have h_dist_bd : 1 / 4 < 3 / 4 - ‖z‖ := by linarith
    have hr_adm : r ≤ s₀ * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) := by
      have : r ≤ s₀ / 4 := le_trans hr_le hr₀_le_s₀
      nlinarith
    have hlam_gt : B * (r / (3 / 4 - ‖z‖)) ^ γ < lam := by
      have h_div_le : r / (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) ≤ 4 * r := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        nlinarith
      have h_rpow_le : (r / (3 / 4 - ‖z‖)) ^ γ ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ γ * r ^ γ := by
        calc (r / (3 / 4 - ‖z‖)) ^ γ ≤ (4 * r) ^ γ :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h_div_le (le_of_lt hγ_pos)
          _ = (4 : ℝ) ^ γ * r ^ γ :=
              Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (le_of_lt hr_pos)
      have h_B_le : B * (r / (3 / 4 - ‖z‖)) ^ γ ≤ (1 / 2) * lam := by
        calc B * (r / (3 / 4 - ‖z‖)) ^ γ ≤ B * ((4 : ℝ) ^ γ * r ^ γ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le (le_of_lt hB_pos)
          _ = (1 / 2) * lam := by
              dsimp [lam, A₀]
              ring
      linarith
    have hlam_le_half : lam ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have hrpow_le : r ^ γ ≤ r₀ ^ γ :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hr_pos) hr_le (le_of_lt hγ_pos)
      calc lam = A₀ * r ^ γ := rfl
        _ ≤ A₀ * r₀ ^ γ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (le_of_lt hA₀_pos)
        _ ≤ 1 / 2 := hAr₀_le
    have hlam_lt : lam < 1 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨P, hP_ne, hP_fit⟩ := h_cyl_all u hu z hz_mem r hr_pos hr_adm lam hlam_gt hlam_lt
    refine ⟨projSpace P, ?_⟩
    intro h hh
    let h_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime h 0
    let N_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P‖⁻¹) • P
    have h_norm_P_ne : ‖P‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hP_ne
    have h_norm_NP : ‖N_P‖ = 1 := by
      dsimp [N_P]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg P)),
        inv_mul_cancel₀ h_norm_P_ne]
    have hh_hat_norm : ‖h_hat‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * r := by
      dsimp [h_hat, lam]
      rw [h_norm_mk h, ← h_rho_eq r hr_pos]
      exact hh
    have h_sqrt_lam_le_one : Real.sqrt lam ≤ 1 := by
      calc Real.sqrt lam ≤ Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_of_lt hlam_lt)
        _ = 1 := Real.sqrt_one
    have h_axial : |inner ℝ h_hat N_P| ≤ r := by
      calc |inner ℝ h_hat N_P| ≤ ‖h_hat‖ * ‖N_P‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm h_hat N_P
        _ = ‖h_hat‖ := by rw [h_norm_NP, mul_one]
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * r := hh_hat_norm
        _ ≤ 1 * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sqrt_lam_le_one (le_of_lt hr_pos)
        _ = r := one_mul r
    have h_trans : ‖h_hat - (inner ℝ h_hat N_P) • N_P‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * r := by
      let c : ℝ := inner ℝ h_hat N_P
      have h_sq : ‖h_hat - c • N_P‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_expand : ‖h_hat - c • N_P‖ ^ 2 = ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 - c ^ 2 := by
          rw [norm_sub_sq_real, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            mul_pow, sq_abs, h_norm_NP]
          change ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (c * c) + c ^ 2 * 1 ^ 2 = ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 - c ^ 2
          ring
        have hc_sq : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 := sq_nonneg c
        linarith
      have h_norm_le : ‖h_hat - c • N_P‖ ≤ ‖h_hat‖ := by
        have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq
        rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h_sqrt
      exact le_trans h_norm_le hh_hat_norm
    have h_fit_inst := hP_fit h_hat h_axial h_trans
    have hz_add : z + h_hat = mkSpaceTime (y + h) 0 := h_mk_add y h
    have hU_zh : liftFunc u (z + h_hat) = u (y + h) := by
      rw [hz_add, h_lift_mk u (y + h)]
    have hU_z : liftFunc u z = u y := h_lift_mk u y
    have h_inner_Ph : inner ℝ P h_hat = inner ℝ (projSpace P) h := h_inner_mk P h
    have h_lam_r : lam * r = A₀ * r ^ (1 + γ) := by
      dsimp [lam]
      rw [Real.rpow_add hr_pos 1 γ, Real.rpow_one]
      ring
    rw [hU_zh, hU_z, h_inner_Ph, h_lam_r] at h_fit_inst
    exact h_fit_inst

          |u (y + h) - u y - inner ℝ p h| ≤ A₀ * (r₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ (1 + γ) := by
      intro j
      have hrj_pos : 0 < r₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
      have hrj_le : r₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ r₀ :=
        mul_le_of_le_one_right (le_of_lt hr₀_pos) (pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
      exact hu_fit y hy (r₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) hrj_pos hrj_le
    let p : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun j => Classical.choose (hp_ex j)
    have hp : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        ‖h‖ ≤ Real.sqrt A₀ * (r₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ (1 + γ / 2) →
        |u (y + h) - u y - inner ℝ (p j) h| ≤ A₀ * (r₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ (1 + γ) :=
      fun j => Classical.choose_spec (hp_ex j)
    obtain ⟨hp0, hstep⟩ := h_s1 u hu_bdd y hy p hp
    obtain ⟨gy, hgy_norm, htail⟩ := h_s2 p hp0 hstep
    refine ⟨gy, hgy_norm, ?_⟩
    intro h hh
    exact h_s3 C₂ hC₂_nonneg u y p gy hp htail h hh
  classical
  let g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun y => if hy : y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (1 / 2) then
      Classical.choose (h_pointwise y hy) else 0
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    dsimp [g]
    rw [dif_pos hy]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (h_pointwise y hy)).1
  · intro y hy h hh
    dsimp [g]
    rw [dif_pos hy]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (h_pointwise y hy)).2 h hh

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx y hy
  set v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := g x - g y
  set ℓ : ℝ := ‖x - y‖
  set C₄_small : ℝ := C₃ * (2 + 2 ^ (1 + α_d))
  set C₄_large : ℝ := 2 * L₀ * (ρ₀ / 2) ^ (-α_d)
  have hC₄_small_nonneg : 0 ≤ C₄_small := by positivity
  have hC₄_large_nonneg : 0 ≤ C₄_large := by positivity
  have hℓ_nonneg : 0 ≤ ℓ := norm_nonneg (x - y)
  have hℓ_rpow_nonneg : 0 ≤ ℓ ^ α_d := by positivity
  by_cases h_eq : g x = g y
  · have hv_zero : ‖g x - g y‖ = 0 := by rw [h_eq, sub_self, norm_zero]
    rw [hv_zero]
    positivity
  · have hv_ne : v ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq
    have hv_pos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv_ne
    have hxy_ne : x ≠ y := by
      intro hxy
      exact h_eq (congrArg g hxy)
    have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxy_ne)
    rcases le_or_gt ℓ (ρ₀ / 2) with h_le | h_gt
    · 
      set w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (ℓ / ‖v‖) • v
      have hw_norm : ‖w‖ = ℓ := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ ℓ / ‖v‖),
          div_mul_cancel₀ ℓ (ne_of_gt hv_pos)]
      have hvw_inner : inner ℝ v w = ℓ * ‖v‖ := by
        rw [inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm,
          ← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ ℓ (ne_of_gt hv_pos)]
      have hw_le_ρ₀ : ‖w‖ ≤ ρ₀ := by linarith
      have hR₀ := hg_taylor y hy w hw_le_ρ₀
      rw [hw_norm] at hR₀
      have hyx_norm : ‖y - x‖ = ℓ := norm_sub_rev y x
      have hyx_le_ρ₀ : ‖y - x‖ ≤ ρ₀ := by linarith
      have hR₁ := hg_taylor x hx (y - x) hyx_le_ρ₀
      have hxy_add : x + (y - x) = y := add_sub_cancel x y
      rw [hxy_add, hyx_norm] at hR₁
      have hh₂_norm : ‖(y - x) + w‖ ≤ 2 * ℓ := by
        calc ‖(y - x) + w‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_add_le (y - x) w
          _ = ℓ + ℓ := by rw [hyx_norm, hw_norm]
          _ = 2 * ℓ := by ring
      have hh₂_le_ρ₀ : ‖(y - x) + w‖ ≤ ρ₀ := by linarith
      have hR₂_raw := hg_taylor x hx ((y - x) + w) hh₂_le_ρ₀
      have hx_add₂ : x + ((y - x) + w) = y + w := by abel
      rw [hx_add₂] at hR₂_raw
      have hh₂_rpow : ‖(y - x) + w‖ ^ (1 + α_d) ≤ 2 ^ (1 + α_d) * ℓ ^ (1 + α_d) := by
        calc ‖(y - x) + w‖ ^ (1 + α_d) ≤ (2 * ℓ) ^ (1 + α_d) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) hh₂_norm (by linarith)
          _ = 2 ^ (1 + α_d) * ℓ ^ (1 + α_d) :=
              Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (le_of_lt hℓ_pos)
      have hR₂ : |u (y + w) - u x - inner ℝ (g x) ((y - x) + w)| ≤
          C₃ * (2 ^ (1 + α_d) * ℓ ^ (1 + α_d)) :=
        le_trans hR₂_raw (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh₂_rpow hC₃_nonneg)
      set R₀ : ℝ := u (y + w) - u y - inner ℝ (g y) w
      set R₁ : ℝ := u y - u x - inner ℝ (g x) (y - x)
      set R₂ : ℝ := u (y + w) - u x - inner ℝ (g x) ((y - x) + w)
      have h_pol : ℓ * ‖v‖ = R₀ + R₁ - R₂ := by
        have h_in1 : inner ℝ v w = inner ℝ (g x) w - inner ℝ (g y) w := inner_sub_left (g x) (g y) w
        have h_in2 : inner ℝ (g x) ((y - x) + w) = inner ℝ (g x) (y - x) + inner ℝ (g x) w :=
          inner_add_right (g x) (y - x) w
        dsimp only [R₀, R₁, R₂]
        linarith
      have h_abs_pol : ℓ * ‖v‖ ≤ |R₀| + |R₁| + |R₂| := by
        calc ℓ * ‖v‖ = |ℓ * ‖v‖| := (abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)).symm
          _ = |R₀ + R₁ - R₂| := by rw [h_pol]
          _ = |(R₀ + R₁) + (-R₂)| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |R₀ + R₁| + |-R₂| := abs_add_le (R₀ + R₁) (-R₂)
          _ = |R₀ + R₁| + |R₂| := by rw [abs_neg]
          _ ≤ |R₀| + |R₁| + |R₂| := by linarith [abs_add_le R₀ R₁]
      have h_rpow_split : ℓ ^ (1 + α_d) = ℓ * ℓ ^ α_d := by
        rw [Real.rpow_add hℓ_pos 1 α_d, Real.rpow_one]
      have h_mul_bound : ℓ * ‖v‖ ≤ ℓ * (C₄_small * ℓ ^ α_d) := by
        calc ℓ * ‖v‖ ≤ |R₀| + |R₁| + |R₂| := h_abs_pol
          _ ≤ C₃ * ℓ ^ (1 + α_d) + C₃ * ℓ ^ (1 + α_d) + C₃ * (2 ^ (1 + α_d) * ℓ ^ (1 + α_d)) := by
            linarith [hR₀, hR₁, hR₂]
          _ = C₄_small * ℓ ^ (1 + α_d) := by dsimp only [C₄_small]; ring
          _ = C₄_small * (ℓ * ℓ ^ α_d) := by rw [h_rpow_split]
          _ = ℓ * (C₄_small * ℓ ^ α_d) := by ring
      have hv_bound : ‖v‖ ≤ C₄_small * ℓ ^ α_d := le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_mul_bound hℓ_pos
      have h_extra : 0 ≤ C₄_large * ℓ ^ α_d := by positivity
      change ‖v‖ ≤ (C₄_small + C₄_large) * ℓ ^ α_d
      linarith
    · 
      have h_g_sub : ‖v‖ ≤ 2 * L₀ := by
        calc ‖v‖ = ‖g x - g y‖ := rfl
          _ ≤ ‖g x‖ + ‖g y‖ := norm_sub_le (g x) (g y)
          _ ≤ L₀ + L₀ := add_le_add (hg_bdd x hx) (hg_bdd y hy)
          _ = 2 * L₀ := by ring
      have hρ2_pos : 0 < ρ₀ / 2 := by linarith
      have h_rpow_le : (ρ₀ / 2) ^ α_d ≤ ℓ ^ α_d :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hρ2_pos) (le_of_lt h_gt) (le_of_lt hα_pos)
      have hρ2_rpow_pos : 0 < (ρ₀ / 2) ^ α_d := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ2_pos α_d
      have h_one_le : 1 ≤ (ρ₀ / 2) ^ (-α_d) * ℓ ^ α_d := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = ((ρ₀ / 2) ^ α_d)⁻¹ * (ρ₀ / 2) ^ α_d :=
              (inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hρ2_rpow_pos)).symm
          _ = (ρ₀ / 2) ^ (-α_d) * (ρ₀ / 2) ^ α_d := by
              rw [Real.rpow_neg (le_of_lt hρ2_pos) α_d]
          _ ≤ (ρ₀ / 2) ^ (-α_d) * ℓ ^ α_d :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le (by positivity)
      have h_2L₀_le : 2 * L₀ ≤ C₄_large * ℓ ^ α_d := by
        calc 2 * L₀ = (2 * L₀) * 1 := (mul_one (2 * L₀)).symm
          _ ≤ (2 * L₀) * ((ρ₀ / 2) ^ (-α_d) * ℓ ^ α_d) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_one_le (by positivity)
          _ = C₄_large * ℓ ^ α_d := by dsimp only [C₄_large]; ring
      have h_extra : 0 ≤ C₄_small * ℓ ^ α_d := by positivity
      change ‖v‖ ≤ (C₄_small + C₄_large) * ℓ ^ α_d
      linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  let E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) := Metric.ball 0 (1 / 2)
  have h_grad : ∀ y ∈ E, HasGradientAt u (g y) y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hasGradientAt_iff_isLittleO, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro c hc
    rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
    have hC3_pos : 0 < C₃ + 1 := by linarith
    have hc_div_pos : 0 < c / (C₃ + 1) := div_pos hc hC3_pos
    let δ : ℝ := min ρ₀ ((c / (C₃ + 1)) ^ (1 / α_d))
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hρ₀_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc_div_pos (1 / α_d))
    refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, ?_⟩
    intro x' hx'
    let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x' - y
    have hh_lt : ‖h‖ < δ := by simpa [h, dist_eq_norm] using hx'
    have hh_le_ρ₀ : ‖h‖ ≤ ρ₀ := le_trans (le_of_lt hh_lt) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hh_le_c : ‖h‖ ≤ (c / (C₃ + 1)) ^ (1 / α_d) :=
      le_trans (le_of_lt hh_lt) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hyh : y + h = x' := add_sub_cancel y x'
    have h_tay := hg_taylor y hy h hh_le_ρ₀
    rw [hyh] at h_tay
    have h_rpow_split : ‖h‖ ^ (1 + α_d) = ‖h‖ * ‖h‖ ^ α_d :=
      Real.rpow_one_add' (norm_nonneg h) (by linarith)
    have h_rpow_le : ‖h‖ ^ α_d ≤ c / (C₃ + 1) := by
      calc ‖h‖ ^ α_d ≤ ((c / (C₃ + 1)) ^ (1 / α_d)) ^ α_d :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg h) hh_le_c (le_of_lt hα_pos)
        _ = (c / (C₃ + 1)) ^ ((1 / α_d) * α_d) :=
            (Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hc_div_pos) (1 / α_d) α_d).symm
        _ = (c / (C₃ + 1)) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hα_pos)]
        _ = c / (C₃ + 1) := Real.rpow_one (c / (C₃ + 1))
    have hC3_mul_le : C₃ * ‖h‖ ^ α_d ≤ c := by
      calc C₃ * ‖h‖ ^ α_d ≤ C₃ * (c / (C₃ + 1)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le hC₃_nonneg
        _ ≤ (C₃ + 1) * (c / (C₃ + 1)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hc_div_pos)
        _ = c := mul_div_cancel₀ c (ne_of_gt hC3_pos)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc |u x' - u y - inner ℝ (g y) (x' - y)| = |u x' - u y - inner ℝ (g y) h| := rfl
      _ ≤ C₃ * ‖h‖ ^ (1 + α_d) := h_tay
      _ = (C₃ * ‖h‖ ^ α_d) * ‖h‖ := by rw [h_rpow_split]; ring
      _ ≤ c * ‖h‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC3_mul_le (norm_nonneg h)
      _ = c * ‖x' - y‖ := rfl
  have h_grad_eq : ∀ y ∈ E, gradient u y = g y :=
    fun y hy => (h_grad y hy).gradient
  have h_fderiv : ∀ y ∈ E,
      HasFDerivAt u (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (g y)) y :=
    fun y hy => (h_grad y hy).hasFDerivAt
  have hg_cont : ContinuousOn g E := by
    rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
    intro b hb ε hε
    have hC4_pos : 0 < C₄ + 1 := by linarith
    have hε_div_pos : 0 < ε / (C₄ + 1) := div_pos hε hC4_pos
    let δ : ℝ := (ε / (C₄ + 1)) ^ (1 / α_d)
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_div_pos (1 / α_d)
    refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, ?_⟩
    intro a ha hab
    have hab_le : ‖a - b‖ ≤ δ := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact le_of_lt hab
    have h_rpow_le : ‖a - b‖ ^ α_d ≤ ε / (C₄ + 1) := by
      calc ‖a - b‖ ^ α_d ≤ δ ^ α_d :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg (a - b)) hab_le (le_of_lt hα_pos)
        _ = (ε / (C₄ + 1)) ^ ((1 / α_d) * α_d) :=
            (Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hε_div_pos) (1 / α_d) α_d).symm
        _ = (ε / (C₄ + 1)) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hα_pos)]
        _ = ε / (C₄ + 1) := Real.rpow_one (ε / (C₄ + 1))
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    calc ‖g a - g b‖ ≤ C₄ * ‖a - b‖ ^ α_d := hg_holder a ha b hb
      _ ≤ C₄ * (ε / (C₄ + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le hC₄_nonneg
      _ < (C₄ + 1) * (ε / (C₄ + 1)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) hε_div_pos
      _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hC4_pos)
  have hu_c1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u E := by
    have hu_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ u E :=
      fun y hy => (h_fderiv y hy).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    let L := InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    have hL_cont : ContinuousOn (fun y => L (g y)) E :=
      L.continuous.comp_continuousOn hg_cont
    have hfderiv_cont : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderivWithin ℝ u E y) E := by
      refine hL_cont.congr ?_
      intro y hy
      dsimp only
      exact (h_fderiv y hy).hasFDerivWithinAt.fderivWithin
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.uniqueDiffWithinAt hy)
    have hfderiv_c0 : ContDiffOn ℝ (0 : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => fderivWithin ℝ u E y) E :=
      contDiffOn_zero.mpr hfderiv_cont
    exact contDiffOn_succ_of_fderivWithin (n := 0) hu_diff (fun h => nomatch h) hfderiv_c0
  have hu_bdd_E : Bornology.IsBounded (u '' E) := by
    refine (Metric.isBounded_Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1).subset ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hx1 : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hx
    exact abs_le.mp (hu_bdd x hx1)
  have h_sup_mem : ∀ a ∈ (fun x => ‖gradient u x‖) '' E, a ≤ L₀ := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [h_grad_eq x hx]

noncomputable def driftFunctional (d : ℕ) (κ ε : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (quadEnvelopePlus d ε (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) z -
    quadEnvelopeMinus d ε v z) / (2 * ε)

def IsOptimizingStepTriple (d : ℕ) (κ ε : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : Prop :=
  let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
  W (mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Q_zero) (t + ε)) - (ε / 2) * ‖Q_zero‖ ^ 2 =
    quadEnvelopePlus d ε W (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
  W (mkSpaceTime (x + (2 * ε) • Q_plus) (t + 2 * ε)) - ε * ‖Q_plus‖ ^ 2 =
    quadEnvelopePlus d (2 * ε) W (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
  v (mkSpaceTime (x - (2 * ε) • Q_minus) (t - 2 * ε)) + ε * ‖Q_minus‖ ^ 2 =
    quadEnvelopeMinus d (2 * ε) v (mkSpaceTime x t)

def HasPrelimitWalkContacts (d : ℕ) (C₁ κ : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (R K L₀ D₀ : ℝ) (M_blk N_seq : ℕ → ℕ) (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x_term : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (x_mk p_mk : ℕ → ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (a_mk : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ R ∧ 0 < K ∧ 0 < D₀ ∧ StrictMono N_seq ∧
  (∀ h : ℕ, h ≤ M_blk h) ∧
  ∀ m : ℕ,
    let τ_m : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (N_seq m)
    0 < ε_seq m ∧ ε_seq m ≤ τ_m / 4 ∧
    ‖x_term m‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
    L₀ ≤ driftFunctional d κ (ε_seq m) v (mkSpaceTime (x_term m) τ_m) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N_seq m →
      let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
      ‖x_mk m j‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
      IsFitAt d C₁ v (x_mk m j) δ_j δ_j (p_mk m j) (a_mk m j) ∧
      L₀ - D₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤
        driftFunctional d κ (ε_seq m) v (mkSpaceTime (x_mk m j) δ_j)) ∧
    (∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m →
      ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ j ≤ N_seq m ∧
        ‖x_term m - x_mk m j - (τ_m - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) • p_mk m j‖ ≤
          K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j)

noncomputable def fittedFrameTransform (d : ℕ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)

    (p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₀ : ℝ)

signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 1 ≤ L ∧ HasUniformNormalizedLiftBounds d L

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hd
  have norm_sq_eq_projSpace_add_projTime :
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        ‖z‖ ^ 2 = ‖projSpace z‖ ^ 2 + (projTime z) ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [projSpace, projTime, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have projSpace_mkSpaceTime :
      ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have projTime_mkSpaceTime :
      ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
  have mkSpaceTime_projSpace_projTime :
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z) = z := by
    intro z
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro j
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have projSpace_add :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projSpace (z₁ + z₂) = projSpace z₁ + projSpace z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_add :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projTime (z₁ + z₂) = projTime z₁ + projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    simp [projTime]
  have projSpace_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        projSpace (c • z) = c • projSpace z := by
    intro c z
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        projTime (c • z) = c * projTime z := by
    intro c z
    simp [projTime]
  have mkSpaceTime_add :
      ∀ (x₁ x₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₁ t₂ : ℝ),
        mkSpaceTime (x₁ + x₂) (t₁ + t₂) = mkSpaceTime x₁ t₁ + mkSpaceTime x₂ t₂ := by
    intro x₁ x₂ t₁ t₂
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro j
      simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have mkSpaceTime_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
        mkSpaceTime (c • x) (c * t) = c • mkSpaceTime x t := by
    intro c x t
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro j
      simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        inner ℝ z₁ z₂ = inner ℝ (projSpace z₁) (projSpace z₂) + projTime z₁ * projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [projSpace, projTime, mul_comm]
  let projSpaceCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := projSpace
        map_add' := projSpace_add
        map_smul' := projSpace_smul }
  let projTimeCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := projTime
        map_add' := projTime_add
        map_smul' := projTime_smul }
  let sliceCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →
      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :=
    fun q => LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := fun h => mkSpaceTime h (inner ℝ q h)
        map_add' := fun h₁ h₂ => by rw [inner_add_right, mkSpaceTime_add]
        map_smul' := fun c h => by rw [inner_smul_right, RingHom.id_apply, mkSpaceTime_smul] }
  have sliceCLM_apply :
      ∀ (q h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), sliceCLM q h = mkSpaceTime h (inner ℝ q h) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv :
      ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
        {f : E → ℝ} {W : Set E}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : E}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f W → ∀ (ξ : E),
        deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => f (z₀ + t • ξ))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ ξ := by
    intro E _ _ f W hW z₀ hz₀ hf ξ
    have h_pre : IsOpen ((fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W) :=
      hW.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W := by simp [hz₀]
    have h_ev : (fun t : ℝ => deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (z₀ + s • ξ)) t) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        (fun t : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + t • ξ)) ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [h_pre.mem_nhds h0_mem] with t ht
      have hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z₀ + t • ξ) :=
        ((hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds ht)).differentiableAt (by norm_num))
      have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ξ t := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
      exact (hf_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h_line).deriv
    rw [h_ev.deriv_eq]
    have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f z₀ := hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)
    have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ := hcd.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hf2_diff : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀) (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) := by
      simpa using (hcd1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have h_line0 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • ξ) ξ 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
    have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + t • ξ))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ) 0 :=
      hf2_diff.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line0
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ξ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_comp).deriv
  have second_deriv_nonneg_of_isLocalMin :
      ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ}, IsLocalMin f 0 → ContinuousAt f 0 → deriv f 0 = 0 →
        0 ≤ deriv (deriv f) 0 := by
    intro f h_min h_cont h_d1
    by_contra h_lt
    have h_neg : deriv (deriv f) 0 < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h_lt
    have h_max : IsLocalMax f 0 := isLocalMax_of_deriv_deriv_neg h_neg h_d1 h_cont
    have h_ev : f =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun _ => f 0 := by
      filter_upwards [h_min, h_max] with t h1 h2
      exact le_antisymm h2 h1
    have h_d2 : deriv (deriv f) 0 = 0 := by
      have hd1 : deriv f =ᶠ[nhds 0] deriv (fun _ : ℝ => f 0) := h_ev.deriv
      rw [hd1.deriv_eq]
      simp
    linarith
  have second_deriv_nonpos_of_isLocalMax :
      ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ}, IsLocalMax f 0 → ContinuousAt f 0 → deriv f 0 = 0 →
        deriv (deriv f) 0 ≤ 0 := by
    intro f h_max h_cont h_d1
    by_contra h_gt
    have h_pos : 0 < deriv (deriv f) 0 := lt_of_not_ge h_gt
    have h_min : IsLocalMin f 0 := isLocalMin_of_deriv_deriv_pos h_pos h_d1 h_cont
    have h_ev : f =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun _ => f 0 := by
      filter_upwards [h_min, h_max] with t h1 h2
      exact le_antisymm h2 h1
    have h_d2 : deriv (deriv f) 0 = 0 := by
      have hd1 : deriv f =ᶠ[nhds 0] deriv (fun _ : ℝ => f 0) := h_ev.deriv
      rw [hd1.deriv_eq]
      simp
    linarith
  have vert_line_hasDerivAt_and_deriv2 :
      ∀ {ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ} {V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))},
        IsOpen V → ∀ {z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))}, z₀ ∈ V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
        let e_b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
        let g_vert : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ϕ (z₀ + t • e_b) - t
        ContinuousAt g_vert 0 ∧
        HasDerivAt g_vert (projTime (gradient ϕ z₀) - 1) 0 ∧
        deriv (deriv g_vert) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ e_b e_b := by
    intro ϕ V hV z₀ hz₀ hϕ_C2 e_b g_vert
    have h_pre : IsOpen ((fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • e_b) ⁻¹' V) :=
      hV.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • e_b) ⁻¹' V := by simp [hz₀]
    have h_diff_at : ∀ t ∈ (fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • e_b) ⁻¹' V,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ (z₀ + t • e_b) := fun t ht =>
      (hϕ_C2.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds ht)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)

        have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ := by
          dsimp [Φ]
          fun_prop
        have h_diff_cont : ContinuousOn (fun Z => U Z - Φ Z) K :=
          (h_har.1.mono hK_sub).sub hΦ_cont.continuousOn
        obtain ⟨Z₀, hZ_mem_K, hZ_max⟩ :=
          hK_compact.exists_isMaxOn ⟨z₂, hz₂_mem_K⟩ h_diff_cont
        have hZ_pos : 0 < U Z₀ - Φ Z₀ := by
          have h_ge : U z₂ - Φ z₂ ≤ U Z₀ - Φ Z₀ := hZ_max hz₂_mem_K
          linarith
        have hZ_ne : Z₀ - z₁ ≠ 0 := by
          intro h_eq
          have hZ_eq : Z₀ = z₁ := sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq
          subst hZ_eq
          dsimp [Φ] at hZ_pos
          simp at hZ_pos
        set ρ : ℝ := ‖Z₀ - z₁‖
        have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hZ_ne
        have hρ_le : ρ ≤ 1 / 32 := by
          simpa [K, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, ρ] using hZ_mem_K
        have hρ_lt : ρ < 1 / 32 := by
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hρ_le with hlt | heq
          · exact hlt
          · exfalso
            have hZ_15 : Z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16) :=
              hK_sub hZ_mem_K
            have hU₁ := h_bdd31 z₁ hz₁_15
            have hU₀ := h_bdd31 Z₀ hZ_15
            rw [abs_le] at hU₁ hU₀
            have hΦ_val : Φ Z₀ = U z₁ + 127 / 32 := by

              change U z₁ + 128 * ρ - 32 * ρ ^ 2 = U z₁ + 127 / 32
              rw [heq]
              ring
            linarith
        set V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := Metric.ball z₁ (1 / 32) \ {z₁}
        have hV_open : IsOpen V := Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
        have hZ_mem_V : Z₀ ∈ V := by
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, ρ] using hρ_lt
          · simp [sub_ne_zero.mp hZ_ne]
        have hV_sub_K : V ⊆ K :=
          Set.sdiff_subset.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
        have hV_sub_15 : V ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16) := hV_sub_K.trans hK_sub
        set ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
          fun Z => Φ Z + (U Z₀ - Φ Z₀)
        have hϕ_C2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V := by
          intro Z hZ
          have h_ne : Z - z₁ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hZ.2
          have h_norm_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => ‖x - z₁‖) Z :=

          have hΦ_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 Φ Z := by
            dsimp [Φ]
            exact ((contDiffAt_const.add (contDiffAt_const.mul h_norm_cd)).sub
              (contDiffAt_const.mul (h_norm_cd.pow 2)))
          exact (hΦ_cd.add contDiffAt_const).contDiffWithinAt
        have hϕ_eq : ϕ Z₀ = U Z₀ := by dsimp [ϕ]; ring
        have hϕ_ge : ∀ Z ∈ V, U Z ≤ ϕ Z := by
          intro Z hZ
          have h_le_max : U Z - Φ Z ≤ U Z₀ - Φ Z₀ := hZ_max (hV_sub_K hZ)
          dsimp [ϕ]
          linarith
        have h_visc : 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ϕ Z₀ :=
          h_har.2.1 Z₀ (hV_sub_15 hZ_mem_V) ϕ V hV_open hZ_mem_V hV_sub_15 hϕ_C2 hϕ_eq hϕ_ge
        set s : ℝ := 128 - 64 * ρ
        have hs_pos : 0 < s := by dsimp [s]; linarith
        set e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (ρ⁻¹) • (Z₀ - z₁)
        have he_norm : ‖e‖ = 1 := by
          dsimp [e]
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_pos.le),
            inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne']
        set ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := s • e
        have h_grad : gradient ϕ Z₀ = ξ := by
          apply HasGradientAt.gradient
          rw [hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
          have h_f1 := hasFDerivAt_norm_sub hZ_ne
          have h_f2 : HasFDerivAt (fun x => ‖x - z₁‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ (Z₀ - z₁)) Z₀ := by
            simpa using (hasFDerivAt_id Z₀ |>.sub_const z₁).norm_sq
          have h_fΦ := (((hasFDerivAt_const (U z₁) Z₀).add (h_f1.const_mul 128)).sub
            (h_f2.const_mul 32)).add (hasFDerivAt_const (U Z₀ - Φ Z₀) Z₀)
          convert h_fΦ using 1
          ext v
          simp only [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, add_apply,
            sub_apply, smul_apply, zero_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, ξ, e, s,
            inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real]
          have h_ρ : ρ * ρ⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne'

        have h_lap_eq : infinityLaplacian ϕ Z₀ =
            deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => ϕ (Z₀ + t • ξ))) 0 := by
          unfold infinityLaplacian
          rw [h_grad, deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hV_open hZ_mem_V hϕ_C2 ξ]
        set q : ℝ → ℝ :=
          fun t => U z₁ + 128 * (ρ + t * s) - 32 * (ρ + t * s) ^ 2 + (U Z₀ - Φ Z₀)
        have h_ev_q : (fun t : ℝ => ϕ (Z₀ + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] q := by
          have h_open_t : IsOpen { t : ℝ | 0 < ρ + t * s } :=
            isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))
          have h0_t : (0 : ℝ) ∈ { t : ℝ | 0 < ρ + t * s } := by simp [hρ_pos]
          filter_upwards [h_open_t.mem_nhds h0_t] with t ht
          have h_vec : Z₀ + t • ξ - z₁ = (ρ + t * s) • e := by
            ext i
            simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ξ, e]
            have h_ρ : ρ * ρ⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne'
            linear_combination -(Z₀ i - z₁ i) * h_ρ
          have h_norm_t : ‖Z₀ + t • ξ - z₁‖ = ρ + t * s := by
            rw [h_vec, norm_smul, he_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht)]
          dsimp [ϕ, Φ, q]
          rw [h_norm_t]
        have h_d2_eq : deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => ϕ (Z₀ + t • ξ))) 0 = deriv (deriv q) 0 := by
          have h_d1 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => ϕ (Z₀ + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] deriv q :=
            h_ev_q.deriv
          exact h_d1.deriv_eq
        have h_q_d1 : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv q t = 128 * s - 64 * s * (ρ + t * s) := by
          intro t
          have hd : HasDerivAt q (128 * s - 64 * s * (ρ + t * s)) t := by
            dsimp [q]
            have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ρ + x * s) s t := by
              simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const s |>.const_add ρ
            have h_sq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (ρ + x * s) ^ 2) (2 * (ρ + t * s) * s) t := by
              convert h_lin.pow 2 using 1
              ring
            convert (((hasDerivAt_const t (U z₁)).add (h_lin.const_mul 128)).sub
              (h_sq.const_mul 32)).add (hasDerivAt_const t (U Z₀ - Φ Z₀)) using 1
            ring
          exact hd.deriv
        have h_q_d2 : deriv (deriv q) 0 = -64 * s ^ 2 := by
          have h_fun : deriv q = fun t : ℝ => 128 * s - 64 * s * (ρ + t * s) := by
            ext t; exact h_q_d1 t
          rw [h_fun]
          have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 128 * s - 64 * s * (ρ + t * s)) (-64 * s ^ 2) 0 := by
            have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ρ + x * s) s 0 := by
              simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).mul_const s |>.const_add ρ
            convert (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (128 * s)).sub (h_lin.const_mul (64 * s)) using 1
            ring
          exact hd2.deriv
        rw [h_lap_eq, h_d2_eq, h_q_d2] at h_visc
        nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hs_pos]
      · have hU₁ := h_bdd31 z₁ hz₁_15
        have hU₂ := h_bdd31 z₂ hz₂_15
        rw [abs_le] at hU₁ hU₂
        linarith
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
    rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
    refine ⟨h_one_sided z₂ hz₂ z₁ hz₁, ?_⟩
    have h2 := h_one_sided z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
    rwa [norm_sub_rev] at h2
  refine ⟨h_har, h_bdd2, h_lip, fun z hz r hr_pos hr_le lam hlam_pos hlam_lt P hfit => ?_⟩
  rcases hfit with ⟨hP_ne, hfit_ineq⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hz
  have hP_pos : 0 < ‖P‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hP_ne
  set N_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P‖⁻¹) • P
  have hNP_norm : ‖N_P‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hP_pos.le), inv_mul_cancel₀ hP_pos.ne']
  have h_sqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt lam := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam_pos
  have h_sqrt_lt : Real.sqrt lam < 1 := by
    simpa using Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt hlam_pos.le hlam_lt
  set s : ℝ := Real.sqrt lam * r
  have hs_pos : 0 < s := mul_pos h_sqrt_pos hr_pos
  have hs_le_r : s ≤ r := by nlinarith
  have h_in_ball : ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖h‖ ≤ s →
      |liftFunc u (z + h) - liftFunc u z - inner ℝ P h| ≤ lam * r ∧
      z + h ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8) := by
    intro h hh
    have h_inner_le : |inner ℝ h N_P| ≤ r := by
      calc |inner ℝ h N_P| ≤ ‖h‖ * ‖N_P‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm h N_P
        _ = ‖h‖ := by rw [hNP_norm, mul_one]
        _ ≤ s := hh
        _ ≤ r := hs_le_r
    have h_orth_le : ‖h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P‖ ≤ s := by
      have h_sq : ‖h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_sub_sq_real, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, hNP_norm, mul_one,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (inner ℝ h N_P)]
      have h_sq2 : ‖h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P‖ ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 :=
        h_sq.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg h) hh 2)
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P), hs_pos]
    refine ⟨hfit_ineq h h_inner_le h_orth_le, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have h_tri : ‖z + h‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖h‖ := norm_add_le z h
    linarith
  have hz_ball78 : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith
  have h_lam_eq : lam * r = Real.sqrt lam * s := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [← mul_assoc, Real.mul_self_sqrt hlam_pos.le]
  constructor
  · set h₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := s • N_P
    have hh₁_norm : ‖h₁‖ = s := by
      rw [norm_smul, hNP_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_pos.le]
    obtain ⟨h_fit₁, h_mem₁⟩ := h_in_ball h₁ hh₁_norm.le
    have h_lip₁ : |liftFunc u (z + h₁) - liftFunc u z| ≤ 128 * s := by
      have := h_lip (z + h₁) h_mem₁ z hz_ball78
      simpa [hh₁_norm] using this
    have h_inner₁ : inner ℝ P h₁ = s * ‖P‖ := by
      dsimp [h₁, N_P]
      rw [inner_smul_right, inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm]
      have h_inv : ‖P‖⁻¹ * ‖P‖ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hP_pos.ne'
      linear_combination s * ‖P‖ * h_inv
    rw [h_inner₁, h_lam_eq] at h_fit₁
    rw [abs_le] at h_fit₁ h_lip₁
    nlinarith
  · set e_b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
    have heb_norm : ‖e_b‖ = 1 := by
      have h_sq := norm_sq_eq_projSpace_add_projTime e_b
      rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime, norm_zero] at h_sq
      have h_sq1 : ‖e_b‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg e_b]
    set h₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := s • e_b
    have hh₂_norm : ‖h₂‖ = s := by
      rw [norm_smul, heb_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_pos.le]
    obtain ⟨h_fit₂, _⟩ := h_in_ball h₂ hh₂_norm.le
    have h_diff₂ : liftFunc u (z + h₂) - liftFunc u z = s := by
      dsimp [liftFunc, h₂]
      rw [projSpace_add, projSpace_smul, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, smul_zero, add_zero,
        projTime_add, projTime_smul, projTime_mkSpaceTime, mul_one]
      ring
    have h_inner₂ : inner ℝ P h₂ = s * projTime P := by
      dsimp [h₂, e_b]
      rw [inner_smul_right, inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime,
        projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime, inner_zero_right, zero_add, mul_one]
    rw [h_diff₂, h_inner₂, h_lam_eq] at h_fit₂
    have h_abs_eq : |s - s * projTime P| = s * |projTime P - 1| := by
      calc |s - s * projTime P| = |s * (1 - projTime P)| := by ring_nf
        _ = |s| * |1 - projTime P| := abs_mul s (1 - projTime P)
        _ = s * |projTime P - 1| := by rw [abs_of_pos hs_pos, abs_sub_comm]
    rw [h_abs_eq] at h_fit₂
    nlinarith

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε hε_pos
  by_contra h_not_flat
  have h_ex : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
      (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r lam : ℝ),
      IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u ∧
      z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
      (0 < r ∧ r ≤ (1 / (8 * (i + 1 : ℝ))) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖)) ∧
      (ε ≤ lam ∧ lam < 1 ∧ ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u) z r lam) := by
    intro i
    have hs_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (8 * (i + 1 : ℝ)) := by positivity
    have hs_le : 1 / (8 * (i + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      have hi : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (i + 1 : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le i)
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
    by_contra h_all
    apply h_not_flat
    refine ⟨1 / (8 * (i + 1 : ℝ)), hs_pos, hs_le, ?_⟩
    intro u hu z hz r hr_pos hr_le lam hlam_ge hlam_lt
    by_contra h_bad
    exact h_all ⟨u, z, r, lam, hu, hz, ⟨hr_pos, hr_le⟩, ⟨hlam_ge, hlam_lt, h_bad⟩⟩
  choose u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq h_seq using h_ex
  have hu_seq : ∀ i : ℕ, IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d (u_seq i) := fun i => (h_seq i).1
  have hz_seq : ∀ i : ℕ, z_seq i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) :=
    fun i => (h_seq i).2.1
  have hr_seq : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < r_seq i ∧ r_seq i ≤ (1 / (8 * (i + 1 : ℝ))) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) :=
    fun i => (h_seq i).2.2.1
  have hlam_seq : ∀ i : ℕ, ε ≤ lam_seq i ∧ lam_seq i < 1 ∧
      ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (lam_seq i) :=
    fun i => (h_seq i).2.2.2
  obtain ⟨U₀, z_star, k₁, R_seq, hU₀_har, hU₀_lip, hz_star, hk₁, hR_props,
    hR_tendsto, hr_ratio, hz_ratio, h_approx⟩ :=
    subseq_limit_and_slow_scales d hd L hL_ge hL u_seq z_seq r_seq hu_seq hz_seq hr_seq
  have hR_bounds : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < R_seq i ∧ R_seq i ≤ 1 / 16 :=
    fun i => ⟨(hR_props i).1, (hR_props i).2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨k₂, P_star, hk₂, h_lin⟩ :=
    fixed_center_affine_blowup d hd L hL_ge U₀ z_star R_seq hU₀_har hU₀_lip hz_star hR_bounds hR_tendsto
  let k : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => k₁ (k₂ i)
  let F_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
    fun i => isotropicBlowup (liftFunc (u_seq (k i))) z_star (R_seq (k₂ i))
  have hF_har : ∀ i : ℕ, IsInfinityHarmonicOn (F_seq i) (Metric.ball 0 1) :=
    fun i => (hR_props (k₂ i)).2.2.1
  have hF_lip : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |F_seq i X₁ - F_seq i X₂| ≤ L * ‖X₁ - X₂‖ :=
    fun i => (hR_props (k₂ i)).2.2.2
  have hF_conv : HasUniformLinearLimitOnBall F_seq 1 P_star := by
    intro δ hδ_pos
    obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ := h_approx (δ / 2) (half_pos hδ_pos)
    obtain ⟨i₂, hi₂⟩ := h_lin (δ / 2) (half_pos hδ_pos)
    refine ⟨max i₁ i₂, fun i hi X hX => ?_⟩
    have hi₁_le : i₁ ≤ k₂ i := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left i₁ i₂) hi) (hk₂.id_le i)
    have hi₂_le : i₂ ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_right i₁ i₂) hi
    have h1 := hi₁ (k₂ i) hi₁_le X hX
    have h2 := hi₂ i hi₂_le X hX
    have h_tri := abs_sub_le (F_seq i X) (isotropicBlowup U₀ z_star (R_seq (k₂ i)) X) (inner ℝ P_star X)
    linarith
  have h_mid : HasUniformMidpointFlatnessOnQuarterBall F_seq :=
    three_point_midpoint_flatness d hd L hL_ge F_seq P_star hF_har hF_lip hF_conv
  have hr_sub : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < r_seq (k i) ∧ r_seq (k i) ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq (k i)‖) := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨(hr_seq (k i)).1, ?_⟩
    have h_pos_dist : 0 ≤ 3 / 4 - ‖z_seq (k i)‖ := by
      have hz_lt : ‖z_seq (k i)‖ < 3 / 4 := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz_seq (k i)
      linarith
    have h_coeff : 1 / (8 * (k i + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      have hk_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k i + 1 : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (k i))
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
    exact le_trans (hr_seq (k i)).2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coeff h_pos_dist)
  have hR_sub_pos : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < R_seq (k₂ i) := fun i => (hR_props (k₂ i)).1
  have hr_ratio_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => r_seq (k i) / R_seq (k₂ i)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hr_ratio.comp hk₂.tendsto_atTop
  have hz_ratio_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ‖z_seq (k i) - z_star‖ / R_seq (k₂ i)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hz_ratio.comp hk₂.tendsto_atTop
  obtain ⟨i, hi_good⟩ :=
    small_scale_linear_blowup_of_midpoint_flatness d hd L hL_ge hL
      (fun i => u_seq (k i)) (fun i => z_seq (k i)) (fun i => r_seq (k i)) (fun i => R_seq (k₂ i)) z_star
      (fun i => hu_seq (k i)) (fun i => hz_seq (k i)) hr_sub hR_sub_pos
      hr_ratio_sub hz_ratio_sub h_mid ε hε_pos
  exact (hlam_seq (k i)).2.2 (hi_good (lam_seq (k i)) (hlam_seq (k i)).1 (hlam_seq (k i)).2.1)

uniform_qualitative_flatness_of_lift.definitions:
noncomputable def isotropicBlowup {d : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (R : ℝ)
    (X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (U (z + R • X) - U z) / R

def HasUniformLinearLimitOnBall {d : ℕ}
    (F_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : Prop :=

by
  have hS_ne : ∀ s : ℝ, (insert (0 : ℝ) (badParamSet d s)).Nonempty :=
    fun s => Set.insert_nonempty 0 (badParamSet d s)
  have hS_bdd : ∀ s : ℝ, BddAbove (insert (0 : ℝ) (badParamSet d s)) := by
    intro s
    refine ⟨1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · norm_num
    · exact le_of_lt hx.2.1
  have hb_nonneg : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ familyBadness d s := by
    intro s
    exact le_csSup (hS_bdd s) (Set.mem_insert 0 (badParamSet d s))
  have hb_le_one : ∀ s : ℝ, familyBadness d s ≤ 1 := by
    intro s
    refine csSup_le (hS_ne s) (fun x hx => ?_)
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · norm_num
    · exact le_of_lt hx.2.1
  have hb_good : ∀ (s : ℝ) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ),
      IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ s * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) →
          ∀ lam : ℝ, familyBadness d s < lam → lam < 1 →
            IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u) z r lam := by
    intro s u hu z hz r hr_pos hr_le lam hlam_gt hlam_lt
    by_contra h_not_good
    have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := lt_of_le_of_lt (hb_nonneg s) hlam_gt
    have hlam_mem : lam ∈ insert (0 : ℝ) (badParamSet d s) :=
      Set.mem_insert_of_mem 0 ⟨hlam_pos, hlam_lt, u, z, r, hu, hz, hr_pos, hr_le, h_not_good⟩
    have hlam_le : lam ≤ familyBadness d s := le_csSup (hS_bdd s) hlam_mem
    linarith
  have hb_extract : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < familyBadness d s →
      ∃ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r lam : ℝ),
        IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u ∧
        z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
        0 < r ∧ r ≤ s * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) ∧
        0 < lam ∧ lam < 1 ∧
        familyBadness d s / 2 < lam ∧ lam ≤ familyBadness d s ∧
        ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u) z r lam := by
    intro s hbs_pos
    have h_half_lt : familyBadness d s / 2 < familyBadness d s := by linarith
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam_mem, hlam_gt⟩ := (lt_csSup_iff (hS_bdd s) (hS_ne s)).mp h_half_lt
    have hlam_le : lam ≤ familyBadness d s := le_csSup (hS_bdd s) hlam_mem
    rcases hlam_mem with rfl | ⟨hlam_pos, hlam_lt, u, z, r, hu, hz, hr_pos, hr_le, h_not_good⟩
    · linarith
    · exact ⟨u, z, r, lam, hu, hz, hr_pos, hr_le, hlam_pos, hlam_lt, hlam_gt, hlam_le, h_not_good⟩
  have hb_flat : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ s₀ : ℝ, 0 < s₀ ∧ s₀ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ s₀ → familyBadness d s ≤ ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀_pos, hs₀_le, h_good_s₀⟩ := h_flat ε hε
    refine ⟨s₀, hs₀_pos, hs₀_le, fun s hs => ?_⟩
    refine csSup_le (hS_ne s) (fun lam hlam => ?_)
    rcases hlam with rfl | ⟨hlam_pos, hlam_lt, u, z, r, hu, hz, hr_pos, hr_le, h_not_good⟩
    · exact le_of_lt hε
    · by_contra h_gt

  have hb_unbdd : ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ → γ ≤ 1 → ∀ B : ℝ, 0 < B →

    refine ⟨B, γ, 1 / 8, hB_pos, hγ_pos, hγ_le, by norm_num, le_rfl, ?_⟩

    obtain ⟨h, hh_pos, hh_le, hh_gt⟩ := hb_unbdd γ hγ_pos hγ_le (2 / δ ^ γ) hB_pos

    let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => familyBadness d s / s ^ γ

      refine ⟨1 / h ^ γ, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨s, ⟨hs_ge, _⟩, rfl⟩
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le hh_pos hs_ge
      have hs_rpow_pos : 0 < s ^ γ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs_pos γ
      have hs_rpow_ge : h ^ γ ≤ s ^ γ :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hh_pos) hs_ge (le_of_lt hγ_pos)
      calc familyBadness d s / s ^ γ ≤ 1 / s ^ γ :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hb_le_one s) (le_of_lt hs_rpow_pos)

    have hqh_mem : q h ∈ E := ⟨h, ⟨le_rfl, hh_le⟩, rfl⟩

    have hK_pos : 0 < sSup E := lt_trans hB_pos hK_gt
    have hK_half_lt : sSup E / 2 < sSup E := by linarith

    have hs_star_rpow_pos : 0 < s_star ^ γ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs_star_pos γ
    have h_two_div : 2 / δ ^ γ = 2 * (1 / δ ^ γ) := by ring
    have hq_star_gt : 1 / δ ^ γ < q s_star := by linarith
    have hs_star_lt_δ : s_star < δ := by
      by_contra h_ge
      push_neg at h_ge
      have hδ_le_s_star : δ ^ γ ≤ s_star ^ γ :=

        calc familyBadness d s_star / s_star ^ γ ≤ 1 / s_star ^ γ :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hb_le_one s_star) (le_of_lt hs_star_rpow_pos)
          _ ≤ 1 / δ ^ γ := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hδ_rpow_pos hδ_le_s_star
