    have hqs_mem : q s ∈ E := ⟨s, ⟨le_trans hs_star_ge hs_ge, hs_le⟩, rfl⟩
    have hqs_le : q s ≤ sSup E := le_csSup hE_bdd hqs_mem
    have hqs_le2 : familyBadness d s / s ^ γ ≤ 2 * (familyBadness d s_star / s_star ^ γ) := by
      change q s ≤ 2 * q s_star
      linarith
    have hbs_le : familyBadness d s ≤ 2 * (familyBadness d s_star / s_star ^ γ) * s ^ γ :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hs_rpow_pos).mp hqs_le2
    calc familyBadness d s ≤ 2 * (familyBadness d s_star / s_star ^ γ) * s ^ γ := hbs_le
      _ = 2 * familyBadness d s_star * (s ^ γ / s_star ^ γ) := by ring
      _ = 2 * familyBadness d s_star * (s / s_star) ^ γ := by
          rw [Real.div_rpow (le_of_lt hs_pos) (le_of_lt hs_star_pos) γ]
  have h_ex : ∀ i : ℕ,
      ∃ (s_i : ℝ) (u_i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
        (z_i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r_i lam_i : ℝ),
        0 < s_i ∧ s_i ≤ 1 / (i + 8 : ℝ) ∧
        (∀ s : ℝ, s_i ≤ s → s ≤ 1 / 8 →
          familyBadness d s ≤ 2 * familyBadness d s_i * (s / s_i) ^ (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ))) ∧
        IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u_i ∧
        z_i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
        0 < r_i ∧ r_i ≤ s_i * (3 / 4 - ‖z_i‖) ∧
        0 < lam_i ∧ lam_i ≤ 1 / (256 * (i + 1 : ℝ)) ∧
        familyBadness d s_i < 2 * lam_i ∧
        ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u_i) z_i r_i lam_i := by
    intro i
    have hi2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (i + 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hi8_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (i + 8 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hγ_pos : 0 < 1 / (i + 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hγ_le : 1 / (i + 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hi2_pos]
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg i
      linarith
    have hε_pos : 0 < 1 / (256 * (i + 1 : ℝ)) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀_pos, hs₀_le, hs₀_flat⟩ := hb_flat (1 / (256 * (i + 1 : ℝ))) hε_pos
    let δ := min s₀ (1 / (i + 8 : ℝ))
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hs₀_pos (by positivity)
    have hδ_le : δ ≤ 1 / 8 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hs₀_le
    obtain ⟨s_i, hs_i_pos, hs_i_lt_δ, hbs_i_pos, hs_i_doub⟩ :=
      h_doubling (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ)) δ hγ_pos hγ_le hδ_pos hδ_le
    have hs_i_le_s₀ : s_i ≤ s₀ := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hs_i_lt_δ (min_le_left _ _))
    have hs_i_le_i8 : s_i ≤ 1 / (i + 8 : ℝ) :=
      le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hs_i_lt_δ (min_le_right _ _))
    have hbs_i_le_ε : familyBadness d s_i ≤ 1 / (256 * (i + 1 : ℝ)) :=
      hs₀_flat s_i hs_i_le_s₀
    obtain ⟨u_i, z_i, r_i, lam_i, hu_i, hz_i, hr_i_pos, hr_i_le, hlam_i_pos, _,
      hlam_i_gt, hlam_i_le, h_not_good⟩ := hb_extract s_i hbs_i_pos
    refine ⟨s_i, u_i, z_i, r_i, lam_i, hs_i_pos, hs_i_le_i8, hs_i_doub,
      hu_i, hz_i, hr_i_pos, hr_i_le, hlam_i_pos, le_trans hlam_i_le hbs_i_le_ε,
      by linarith, h_not_good⟩
  choose s_seq u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq h_spec using h_ex
  refine ⟨u_seq, z_seq, r_seq, lam_seq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨hs_pos, hs_le, _, hu, hz, hr_pos, hr_le, hlam_pos, hlam_le, h_lt_2lam, h_not_good⟩ :=
      h_spec i
    have hz_norm : ‖z_seq i‖ < 3 / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz
    have hD_pos : 0 < 3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖ := by linarith
    have hr_le_i8 : r_seq i ≤ (1 / (i + 8 : ℝ)) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) := by
      calc r_seq i ≤ s_seq i * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) := hr_le
        _ ≤ (1 / (i + 8 : ℝ)) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_le (le_of_lt hD_pos)
    have hi_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg i
    have h256_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 256 * (i + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hlam_le_256 : lam_seq i ≤ 1 / 256 := by
      have h1 : 1 / (256 * (i + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 256 := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h256_pos (by norm_num)]
        linarith
      exact le_trans hlam_le h1
    have hlam_lt_128 : lam_seq i < 1 / 128 := by linarith
    have h32_gt : familyBadness d (s_seq i) < 32 * lam_seq i := by linarith
    have h32_lt : 32 * lam_seq i < 1 := by linarith
    have h_good_32 : IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (32 * lam_seq i) :=
      hb_good (s_seq i) (u_seq i) hu (z_seq i) hz (r_seq i) hr_pos hr_le (32 * lam_seq i)
        h32_gt h32_lt
    exact ⟨hu, hz, hr_pos, hr_le_i8, hlam_pos, hlam_lt_128, h_not_good, h_good_32⟩
  · rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (ε⁻¹)
    refine ⟨N, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hlam_pos, hlam_le, _, _⟩ := h_spec i
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hlam_pos]
    have hiN : (N : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hi
    have hi1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (i + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have h256_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 256 * (i + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have h_inv_lt : 1 / (256 * (i + 1 : ℝ)) < ε := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h256_pos]
      have hε_inv : 1 ≤ ε * (N : ℝ) := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN (le_of_lt hε)
        rwa [mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hε)] at this
      nlinarith
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hlam_le h_inv_lt
  · intro M hM
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := exists_nat_ge (16 * M)
    refine ⟨i₀, fun i hi z hz_dist r hr_pos hr_le => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hs_pos, hs_le, hs_doub, hu, hz_i, hr_i_pos, hr_i_le, hlam_pos, hlam_le,
      h_lt_2lam, _⟩ := h_spec i
    have hi_ge : 16 * M ≤ (i : ℝ) := le_trans hi₀ (Nat.cast_le.mpr hi)
    have hi8_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (i + 8 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have h2M_pos : 0 < 2 * M := by linarith
    have hs_2M_le : 2 * M * s_seq i ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      have h1 : 2 * M * s_seq i ≤ 2 * M * (1 / (i + 8 : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs_le (by linarith)
      have h2 : 2 * M * (1 / (i + 8 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
        rw [mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hi8_pos (by norm_num)]
        linarith
      exact le_trans h1 h2
    have hs_le_2M : s_seq i ≤ 2 * M * s_seq i := by nlinarith
    have hMs_le_half : M * s_seq i ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have hz_i_norm : ‖z_seq i‖ < 3 / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz_i
    have hD_i_pos : 0 < 3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖ := by linarith
    have hMr_i_le : M * r_seq i ≤ (M * s_seq i) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) := by
      calc M * r_seq i ≤ M * (s_seq i * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_i_le (by linarith)
        _ = (M * s_seq i) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) := by ring
    have hz_sub_le : ‖z - z_seq i‖ ≤ (1 / 2) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) := by
      calc ‖z - z_seq i‖ ≤ M * r_seq i := hz_dist
        _ ≤ (M * s_seq i) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) := hMr_i_le
        _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMs_le_half (le_of_lt hD_i_pos)
    have h_tri : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z_seq i‖ + ‖z - z_seq i‖ := by
      calc ‖z‖ = ‖z_seq i + (z - z_seq i)‖ := by abel_nf
        _ ≤ ‖z_seq i‖ + ‖z - z_seq i‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    have hD_z_ge : (1 / 2) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) ≤ 3 / 4 - ‖z‖ := by linarith
    have hz_ball : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    have hr_le_2M : r ≤ (2 * M * s_seq i) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) := by
      calc r ≤ M * r_seq i := hr_le
        _ ≤ (M * s_seq i) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) := hMr_i_le
        _ = (2 * M * s_seq i) * ((1 / 2) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (2 * M * s_seq i) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD_z_ge (by positivity)
    have hr_le_8 : r ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) := by
      calc r ≤ (2 * M * s_seq i) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) := hr_le_2M
        _ ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_2M_le (by linarith)
    have hrpow_le_2 : (2 * M) ^ (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ)) ≤ 2 := by
      have h_lt_pow : i + 2 < 2 ^ (i + 2) := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
      have h_le_pow_real : ((i + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ (i + 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_of_lt h_lt_pow)
      push_cast at h_le_pow_real
      have h2M_le_pow : 2 * M ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (i + 2 : ℕ) := by linarith
      have hi2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (i + 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h_exp_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 / (i + 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      calc (2 * M) ^ (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ))
          ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (i + 2 : ℕ)) ^ (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ)) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h2M_le_pow h_exp_nonneg
        _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((i + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ)) := by
            rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (((i + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ))) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
            push_cast
            rw [mul_one_div_cancel (ne_of_gt hi2_pos)]
        _ = 2 := Real.rpow_one 2
    have hb_2M_le : familyBadness d (2 * M * s_seq i) ≤
        2 * familyBadness d (s_seq i) * (2 * M) ^ (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ)) := by
      have h_doub := hs_doub (2 * M * s_seq i) hs_le_2M hs_2M_le
      have h_div : (2 * M * s_seq i) / s_seq i = 2 * M :=
        mul_div_cancel_right₀ (2 * M) (ne_of_gt hs_pos)
      rwa [h_div] at h_doub
    have hbs_i_nonneg : 0 ≤ familyBadness d (s_seq i) := hb_nonneg (s_seq i)
    have hb_2M_lt_32 : familyBadness d (2 * M * s_seq i) < 32 * lam_seq i := by
      have h1 : 2 * familyBadness d (s_seq i) * (2 * M) ^ (1 / (i + 2 : ℝ)) ≤
          2 * familyBadness d (s_seq i) * 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le_2 (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h256_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 256 * (i + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hlam_le_256 : lam_seq i ≤ 1 / 256 := by
      have h1 : 1 / (256 * (i + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 256 := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h256_pos (by norm_num)]
        have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg i
        linarith
      exact le_trans hlam_le h1
    have h32_lt_1 : 32 * lam_seq i < 1 := by linarith
    have h_good_z : IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) z r (32 * lam_seq i) :=
      hb_good (2 * M * s_seq i) (u_seq i) hu z hz_ball r hr_pos hr_le_2M
        (32 * lam_seq i) hb_2M_lt_32 h32_lt_1
    exact ⟨hz_ball, hr_le_8, h_good_z⟩

scale_selection_of_no_power_decay.definitions:
def badParamSet (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  { lam : ℝ | 0 < lam ∧ lam < 1 ∧
    ∃ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r : ℝ),
      IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u ∧
      z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
      0 < r ∧ r ≤ s * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) ∧
      ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u) z r lam }

noncomputable def familyBadness (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (insert 0 (badParamSet d s))

proof.tactics:
by
  let e_b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
  have heb_eq : e_b = EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last d) (1 : ℝ) := by
    ext j
    rw [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [e_b, mkSpaceTime]
    · intro k
      simp [e_b, mkSpaceTime, Fin.castSucc_ne_last]
  have heb_norm : ‖e_b‖ = 1 := by
    rw [heb_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one]
  let P_base : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    fun i => Classical.choose (h_scales.1 i).2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  let O_base : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :=
    fun i => (ℝ ∙ (e_b - (‖P_base i‖⁻¹) • P_base i))ᗮ.reflection
  have h_base : IsBaseSlopeAndFrameSeq d L u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq P_base O_base := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨hu_i, hz_i, hr_pos, hr_le, hlam_pos, hlam_lt, _, hgood32⟩ := h_scales.1 i
    have hP_fit : IsCylinderFitAt (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (32 * lam_seq i) (P_base i) :=
      Classical.choose_spec hgood32
    have hz_lt : ‖z_seq i‖ < 3 / 4 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz_i
    have hr_le8 : r_seq i ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) := by
      have hi_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ i := Nat.cast_nonneg i
      have h_inv : 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 8) ≤ 1 / 8 :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      exact hr_le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv (by linarith))
    have h32_pos : 0 < 32 * lam_seq i := by linarith
    have h32_lt1 : 32 * lam_seq i < 1 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hP_norm_le, hP_time⟩ :=
      (hL (u_seq i) hu_i).2.2.2 (z_seq i) hz_i (r_seq i) hr_pos hr_le8
        (32 * lam_seq i) h32_pos h32_lt1 (P_base i) hP_fit
    have hsqrt_le : Real.sqrt (32 * lam_seq i) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have h14 : 32 * lam_seq i ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by linarith
      exact (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h14).trans (by norm_num)
    have hP_upper : ‖P_base i‖ ≤ L + 1 := by linarith
    have hP_time_ge : 1 / 2 ≤ projTime (P_base i) := by
      have h1 := (abs_le.mp hP_time).1
      linarith
    have hP_coord_le : |projTime (P_base i)| ≤ ‖P_base i‖ := by
      simpa [projTime, Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le (P_base i) (Fin.last d)
    have hP_lower : 1 / 2 ≤ ‖P_base i‖ := by
      linarith [le_abs_self (projTime (P_base i))]
    have h_unit_norm : ‖(‖P_base i‖⁻¹) • P_base i‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by linarith)]
    have hO_eb : O_base i (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = (‖P_base i‖⁻¹) • P_base i :=
      Submodule.reflection_sub (heb_norm.trans h_unit_norm.symm)
    exact ⟨hP_fit, hP_lower, hP_upper, hO_eb⟩
  have h_comp : HasCylinderFitComparisonBounds d L :=
    cylinder_fit_comparison d hd L hL_ge
  let v_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
    fun i => anisotropicRescale (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) ‖P_base i‖ (lam_seq i) (O_base i)
  have h_boxes : HasUniformRescaledShearedBoxFits d lam_seq v_seq :=
    rescaled_sheared_box_fits_of_selected_scales d hd L hL_ge hL h_comp u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq h_scales P_base O_base h_base
  have hv_zero : ∀ i : ℕ, v_seq i 0 = 0 := by
    intro i
    have h_mk0 : mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt (lam_seq i) • projSpace (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))
        (projTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) = 0 := by
      ext j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
      · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime]
      · intro k
        simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace]
    have h_pt0 : projTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) = 0 := rfl
    dsimp [v_seq, anisotropicRescale]
    rw [h_mk0, h_pt0, map_zero, smul_zero, add_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, sub_self, zero_div]
  obtain ⟨v, k, hv0, hv_cont, hk_mono, hv_unif, hv_fits⟩ :=
    subseq_limit_and_fits_of_rescaled_sheared_box_fits d hd lam_seq
      (fun i => (h_scales.1 i).2.2.2.2.1) h_scales.2.1 v_seq hv_zero h_boxes
  have hv_limit : IsAnisotropicBlowupLimit d L u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq v :=
    ⟨hv0, k, (fun i => P_base (k i)), (fun i => O_base (k i)), hk_mono, (fun i => h_base (k i)), hv_unif⟩
  obtain ⟨hv_sub, hv_super⟩ :=
    viscosity_limit_of_anisotropic_blowup d hd L hL_ge hL u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq h_scales v hv_cont hv_limit
  exact ⟨v, ⟨hv_cont, hv_sub, hv_super, hv_fits⟩, hv_limit⟩

anisotropic_blowup_subseq_in_class_A.definitions:
def IsBaseSlopeAndFrameSeq (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (P_base : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (O_base : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : ℕ,
    IsCylinderFitAt (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (32 * lam_seq i) (P_base i) ∧
    1 / 2 ≤ ‖P_base i‖ ∧ ‖P_base i‖ ≤ L + 1 ∧
    O_base i (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = (‖P_base i‖⁻¹) • P_base i

def HasCylinderFitComparisonBounds (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C_comp : ℝ, 0 < C_comp ∧
    ∀ (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
      (z z' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (H H' θ : ℝ)
      (P P' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      0 < θ → θ < 1 / 2 →
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖P‖ → ‖P‖ ≤ L + 1 →
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖P'‖ → ‖P'‖ ≤ L + 1 →

      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hsqrt_pos)]
    have h_rhs : ‖(s * N_i⁻¹ * Real.sqrt lam_j) • p + projSpace η‖ ≤
        |s * N_i⁻¹ * Real.sqrt lam_j| * ‖p‖ + ‖projSpace η‖ := by
      have := norm_add_le ((s * N_i⁻¹ * Real.sqrt lam_j) • p) (projSpace η)
      rwa [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h_coeff : |s * N_i⁻¹ * Real.sqrt lam_j| ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt lam_j := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hN_pos), abs_of_pos hsqrt_pos]
      have hN_inv_le : N_i⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
        rw [inv_le_comm₀ hN_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
        linarith
      have h_sN : |s| * N_i⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg s, inv_pos.mpr hN_pos]
      nlinarith
    have h_eta_space : ‖projSpace η‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam_j :=
      le_trans (h_norm_projSpace_le η) hη_norm
    have h_comb : Real.sqrt lam_j * ‖x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam_j * (2 * ‖p‖ + 1) := by
      rw [← h_lhs, h_ux]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg p]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_comb hsqrt_pos
  have ht_abs : |t| ≤ 2 := by
    have h_ut : t = (s * N_i⁻¹) * (1 + lam_j * q) + projTime η := by
      change projTime u = _
      rw [hu_decomp, h_projTime_add, h_projTime_smul]
      dsimp [Q_i]
      rw [h_projTime_mk]
    have h_q_le_N : |1 + lam_j * q| ≤ N_i := by
      have h1 := h_abs_projTime_le Q_i
      rwa [h_projTime_mk] at h1
    have h_term1 : |(s * N_i⁻¹) * (1 + lam_j * q)| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hN_pos)]
      have h_prod : N_i⁻¹ * |1 + lam_j * q| ≤ 1 := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_q_le_N (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hN_pos))
        rwa [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hN_pos)] at this
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg s, abs_nonneg (1 + lam_j * q), inv_pos.mpr hN_pos]
    have h_sqrt_le_one : Real.sqrt lam_j ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    have h_term2 : |projTime η| ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans (h_abs_projTime_le η) (le_trans hη_norm h_sqrt_le_one)
    have h_tri := abs_add_le ((s * N_i⁻¹) * (1 + lam_j * q)) (projTime η)
    rw [h_ut]
    linarith
  have hw_norm : ‖w‖ ≤ K := by
    have h1 := h_norm_mk_le x t
    change ‖w‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + |t| at h1
    dsimp [K]
    linarith
  have h_P_inner_h : inner ℝ P_tilde h = r_j * c_i * t + r_j * c_i * lam_j * v w := by
    rw [← h_r_Oi_u]
    dsimp [P_tilde]
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, O_i.inner_map_map]
    rw [← h_mk_u]
    dsimp [Q_i]
    rw [h_inner_split, h_projSpace_mk, h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk, h_projTime_mk]
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, ← mul_assoc (Real.sqrt lam_j),
      Real.mul_self_sqrt (le_of_lt hlam_pos)]
    rw [hv_split w, h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk]
    ring
  have h_rescale_eq :
      U_j (z_j + h) - U_j z_j - inner ℝ P_tilde h =
        r_j * c_i * lam_j * (anisotropicRescale U_j z_j r_j c_i lam_j O_i w - v w) := by
    have h_unfold : anisotropicRescale U_j z_j r_j c_i lam_j O_i w =
        (U_j (z_j + h) - U_j z_j - r_j * c_i * t) / (r_j * c_i * lam_j) := by
      dsimp [anisotropicRescale, w]
      rw [h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk, h_mk_u, h_r_Oi_u]
    rw [h_unfold, h_P_inner_h]
    have h_denom_ne : r_j * c_i * lam_j ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [h_denom_ne]
    ring
  have h_conv_w : |anisotropicRescale U_j z_j r_j c_i lam_j O_i w - v w| ≤ 1 / (L + 1) :=
    hi₂ i (le_max_right i₁ i₂) w hw_norm
  have h_pos_prod : 0 < r_j * c_i * lam_j := by positivity
  rw [h_rescale_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_pos_prod]
  have h_step1 : r_j * c_i * lam_j * |anisotropicRescale U_j z_j r_j c_i lam_j O_i w - v w| ≤
      r_j * (L + 1) * lam_j * (1 / (L + 1)) := by
    have h_c_lam : r_j * c_i * lam_j ≤ r_j * (L + 1) * lam_j := by nlinarith
    exact mul_le_mul h_c_lam h_conv_w (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have h_step2 : r_j * (L + 1) * lam_j * (1 / (L + 1)) = lam_j * r_j := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hL1_pos]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2

signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_two_scale : ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R →
      ∀ (p p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a a' : ℝ),
        IsFitAt d C₁ v 0 0 R p a →
        IsFitAt d C₁ v 0 0 (2 * R) p' a' →
        ‖p' - p‖ ≤ 3 * C₁ ∧ |a' - a| ≤ 3 * C₁ * (1 + 3 * C₁) + (9 / 2) * C₁ ^ 2 := by
    intro R hR p p' a a' hfit1 hfit2
    have hp_diff : ‖p' - p‖ ≤ 3 * C₁ := by
      by_cases hp : ‖p' - p‖ = 0
      · linarith
      · have hp_pos : 0 < ‖p' - p‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hp)
        let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (R / ‖p' - p‖) • (p' - p)
        have hh_norm : ‖h‖ = R := by
          dsimp [h]
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hR hp_pos), div_mul_cancel₀ R hp]
        have h1 := hfit1 h 0 (by simp [le_of_lt hR]) (by simp [hh_norm])
        have h2 := hfit2 h 0 (by simp; linarith) (by simp [hh_norm]; linarith)
        simp only [zero_add, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h1 h2
        have h_inner : inner ℝ p' h - inner ℝ p h = R * ‖p' - p‖ := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left]
          dsimp [h]
          rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
          have h_ring : R / ‖p' - p‖ * ‖p' - p‖ ^ 2 = R / ‖p' - p‖ * ‖p' - p‖ * ‖p' - p‖ := by ring
          rw [h_ring, div_mul_cancel₀ R hp]
        have h1_le := (abs_le.mp h1).2
        have h2_le := (abs_le.mp h2).1
        nlinarith
    refine ⟨hp_diff, ?_⟩
    let ℓ : ℝ := R / (1 + 3 * C₁)
    have h_denom : 0 < 1 + 3 * C₁ := by linarith
    have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ := div_pos hR h_denom
    have hℓ_eq : (1 + 3 * C₁) * ℓ = R := mul_div_cancel₀ R (ne_of_gt h_denom)
    have hCℓ_nonneg : 0 ≤ C₁ * ℓ := mul_nonneg hC₁ (le_of_lt hℓ_pos)
    have hℓ_le_R : |ℓ| ≤ R := by
      rw [abs_of_pos hℓ_pos]
      linarith
    have hℓ_le_2R : |ℓ| ≤ 2 * R := by linarith
    have hh1 : ‖ℓ • p - ℓ • p‖ ≤ R := by
      simp [le_of_lt hR]
    have hh2 : ‖ℓ • p - ℓ • p'‖ ≤ 2 * R := by
      rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos, norm_sub_rev]
      nlinarith
    have h1 := hfit1 (ℓ • p) ℓ hℓ_le_R hh1
    have h2 := hfit2 (ℓ • p) ℓ hℓ_le_2R hh2
    simp only [zero_add] at h1 h2
    have h_ip1 : inner ℝ p (ℓ • p) = ℓ * ‖p‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    have h_ip2 : inner ℝ p' (ℓ • p) = ℓ * inner ℝ p' p := by
      rw [real_inner_smul_right]
    have h_sq : ‖p' - p‖ ^ 2 = ‖p'‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ p' p + ‖p‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_sub_sq_real p' p
    have h_p_sq_le : ‖p' - p‖ ^ 2 ≤ 9 * C₁ ^ 2 := by
      have : 0 ≤ ‖p' - p‖ := norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have h_alg : (inner ℝ p (ℓ • p) + (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ) -
        (inner ℝ p' (ℓ • p) + (a' - ‖p'‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ) =
        ℓ * (a - a' + ‖p' - p‖ ^ 2 / 2) := by
      rw [h_ip1, h_ip2, h_sq]
      ring
    have h1a := (abs_le.mp h1).1
    have h1b := (abs_le.mp h1).2
    have h2a := (abs_le.mp h2).1
    have h2b := (abs_le.mp h2).2
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  have h_exists : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
      IsFitAt d C₁ v 0 0 ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) p a :=
    fun k => hv.2.2.2 0 0 ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) (by positivity)
  choose p a hfit using h_exists
  let C₂ : ℝ := 3 * C₁ * (1 + 3 * C₁) + (9 / 2) * C₁ ^ 2
  have hC₂_nonneg : 0 ≤ C₂ := by positivity
  have h_step : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖p (k + 1) - p k‖ ≤ 3 * C₁ ∧ |a (k + 1) - a k| ≤ C₂ := by
    intro k
    have hfit_succ : IsFitAt d C₁ v 0 0 (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ k) (p (k + 1)) (a (k + 1)) := by
      simpa [pow_succ'] using hfit (k + 1)
    exact h_two_scale ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) (by positivity) (p k) (p (k + 1)) (a k) (a (k + 1))
      (hfit k) hfit_succ
  have hp_lin : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖p k‖ ≤ ‖p 0‖ + 3 * C₁ * (k : ℝ) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      have h_tri : ‖p (k + 1)‖ ≤ ‖p k‖ + ‖p (k + 1) - p k‖ := by
        calc ‖p (k + 1)‖ = ‖p k + (p (k + 1) - p k)‖ := by rw [add_sub_cancel]
          _ ≤ ‖p k‖ + ‖p (k + 1) - p k‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      have h_diff := (h_step k).1
      push_cast
      linarith
  have ha_lin : ∀ k : ℕ, |a k| ≤ |a 0| + C₂ * (k : ℝ) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      have h_tri : |a (k + 1)| ≤ |a k| + |a (k + 1) - a k| := by
        calc |a (k + 1)| = |a k + (a (k + 1) - a k)| := by rw [add_sub_cancel]
          _ ≤ |a k| + |a (k + 1) - a k| := abs_add_le _ _
      have h_diff := (h_step k).2
      push_cast
      linarith
  let B₁ : ℝ := max (‖p 0‖ + 3 * C₁ + 1) (|a 0| + C₂ + 1)
  have hB₁_ge_one : 1 ≤ B₁ := by
    have : 1 ≤ ‖p 0‖ + 3 * C₁ + 1 := by
      have : 0 ≤ ‖p 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
      linarith
    exact le_trans this (le_max_left _ _)
  have h_pow54 : ∀ k : ℕ, (k : ℝ) + 4 ≤ 4 * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ k ih =>
      push_cast
      rw [pow_succ']
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      linarith
  have h_pow85 : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 + (3 / 5 : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ≤ (8 / 5 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ k ih =>
      push_cast
      rw [pow_succ']
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      linarith
  have h_pow2 : ∀ k : ℕ, (k : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ k ih =>
      push_cast
      rw [pow_succ']
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      linarith
  let B₀ : ℝ := 4 * B₁
  have hB₀_ge : 4 ≤ B₀ := by dsimp [B₀]; linarith
  have hp_exp : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖p k‖ ≤ B₀ * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k
    have hk_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
    have hB₁_left : ‖p 0‖ + 3 * C₁ + 1 ≤ B₁ := le_max_left _ _
    have h1 := hp_lin k
    have h2 := h_pow54 k
    have h_p0 : 0 ≤ ‖p 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
    dsimp [B₀]
    nlinarith
  have ha_exp : ∀ k : ℕ, |a k| ≤ B₀ * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k
    have hk_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
    have hB₁_right : |a 0| + C₂ + 1 ≤ B₁ := le_max_right _ _
    have h1 := ha_lin k
    have h2 := h_pow54 k
    have h_a0 : 0 ≤ |a 0| := abs_nonneg _
    dsimp [B₀]
    nlinarith
  let T : ℝ := max |t₁| |t₂| + 1
  have hT_ge_one : 1 ≤ T := by
    have : 0 ≤ max |t₁| |t₂| := le_trans (abs_nonneg t₁) (le_max_left _ _)
    dsimp [T]; linarith
  let K_req : ℝ := (5 / 4) * max (T * B₀) ((4 / ε) * ((3 / 2) * B₀ + 1 + 2 * C₁))
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := exists_nat_ge ((5 / 3) * K_req)
  have hK_dom : ∀ m : ℕ, K_req * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
    intro m
    have h_k0_le : K_req ≤ (8 / 5 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := by
      have h_b := h_pow85 k₀
      linarith
    have h_km_le : (8 / 5 : ℝ) ^ k₀ ≤ (8 / 5 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.le_add_right k₀ m)
    have h_prod : (8 / 5 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
      rw [← mul_pow]
      norm_num
    have h_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have h_shell_bound : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → ‖y‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) →
      |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ |v (mkSpaceTime 0 0)| + (ε / 4) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m)) ^ 2 := by
    intro m y s hs1 hs2 hy
    let k : ℕ := k₀ + m + 1
    have hs_abs : |s| ≤ T := by
      have h_t1 : -max |t₁| |t₂| ≤ t₁ := by
        have : -|t₁| ≤ t₁ := neg_abs_le t₁
        have : |t₁| ≤ max |t₁| |t₂| := le_max_left _ _
        linarith
      have h_t2 : t₂ ≤ max |t₁| |t₂| := le_trans (le_abs_self t₂) (le_max_right _ _)
      rw [abs_le]
      dsimp [T]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have h_pow54_k : (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k = (5 / 4) * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
      dsimp [k]
      rw [pow_succ']
    have h_pow2_k : (2 : ℝ) ^ k = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
      dsimp [k]
      rw [pow_succ']
    have h_54_ge_one : 1 ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hK_left : (5 / 4) * (T * B₀) ≤ K_req := by
      dsimp [K_req]
      have : T * B₀ ≤ max (T * B₀) ((4 / ε) * ((3 / 2) * B₀ + 1 + 2 * C₁)) := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
    have hK_right : (5 / 4) * ((3 / 2) * B₀ + 1 + 2 * C₁) ≤ (ε / 4) * K_req := by
      have h_max : (4 / ε) * ((3 / 2) * B₀ + 1 + 2 * C₁) ≤
          max (T * B₀) ((4 / ε) * ((3 / 2) * B₀ + 1 + 2 * C₁)) := le_max_right _ _
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_max (show 0 ≤ (5 / 4) * (ε / 4) by positivity)
      have h_eq : (5 / 4) * (ε / 4) * ((4 / ε) * ((3 / 2) * B₀ + 1 + 2 * C₁)) =
          (5 / 4) * ((3 / 2) * B₀ + 1 + 2 * C₁) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
      have h_eq2 : (5 / 4) * (ε / 4) * max (T * B₀) ((4 / ε) * ((3 / 2) * B₀ + 1 + 2 * C₁)) =
          (ε / 4) * K_req := by
        dsimp [K_req]
        ring
      linarith
    have h_dom_m := hK_dom m
    have h_pk_bound : ‖p k‖ ≤ B₀ * ((5 / 4) * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m)) := by
      simpa [h_pow54_k] using hp_exp k
    have h_ak_bound : |a k| ≤ B₀ * ((5 / 4) * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m)) := by
      simpa [h_pow54_k] using ha_exp k
    have h_T_pk : T * ‖p k‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by nlinarith
    have h_T_ak : T * |a k| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by nlinarith
    have h_T_K : T ≤ K_req := by nlinarith
    have h_T_le : T ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by nlinarith
    have h_coeff : (3 / 2) * ‖p k‖ + 1 + 2 * C₁ ≤ (ε / 4) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
      have h_pk_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖p k‖ := norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have hs_le_2k : |s| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hy_sp : ‖y - s • p k‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      have h_tri : ‖y - s • p k‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖s • p k‖ := norm_sub_le y (s • p k)
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h_tri
      have : |s| * ‖p k‖ ≤ T * ‖p k‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_abs (norm_nonneg _)
      linarith
    have h_fit_ys := hfit k y s hs_le_2k hy_sp
    simp only [zero_add] at h_fit_ys
    rw [h_pow2_k, sub_mul] at h_fit_ys
    have h_cs : |inner ℝ (p k) y| ≤ ‖p k‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
      calc |inner ℝ (p k) y| ≤ ‖p k‖ * ‖y‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm (p k) y
        _ ≤ ‖p k‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy (norm_nonneg _)
    have h_as : |a k * s| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      have : |a k| * |s| ≤ |a k| * T :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs_abs (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
    have h_ps : ‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2 * |s| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖p k‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
      have h1 : ‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2 * |s| ≤ ‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2 * T :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs_abs (by positivity)
      have h2 : (1 / 2) * ‖p k‖ * (T * ‖p k‖) ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖p k‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_T_pk (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h_ps_abs : |‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2 * s| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖p k‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ ‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2 by positivity)]
      exact h_ps
    have h_v_diff : |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| - |v (mkSpaceTime 0 0)| ≤
        |v (mkSpaceTime y s) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 0)| := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub _ _

    push_neg at h_gt
    let D : ℝ := S r₀ - B
    have hD : 0 < D := sub_pos.mpr h_gt
    let M : ℝ := max C 0
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right C 0
    have hC_le_M : C ≤ M := le_max_left C 0
    let r : ℝ := r₀ + (M + 1) / D
    have h_div_pos : 0 < (M + 1) / D := div_pos (by linarith) hD
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
    have hr₀_le : r₀ ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
    have hS_le : S r₀ ≤ S r := hS_mono r₀ r hr₀ hr₀_le
    have hD_le : D ≤ S r - B := by dsimp [D]; linarith
    have hrD_le : r * D ≤ r * (S r - B) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD_le (le_of_lt hr_pos)
    have hr_lin : r * (S r - B) ≤ C := hS_lin r hr_pos
    have hrD_eq : r * D = r₀ * D + (M + 1) := by
      dsimp [r]
      rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ (M + 1) (ne_of_gt hD)]
    have hr₀D_pos : 0 < r₀ * D := mul_pos hr₀ hD
    linarith
  have h_comp_gt : ∀ (x' y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t' r : ℝ),
      t₀ < t' → 0 < r →
      v (mkSpaceTime y' (t' + r)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' t') ≤ B * r + ‖y' - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r) := by
    intro x' y' t' r ht' hr
    let δ : ℝ := t' - t₀
    have hδ : 0 < δ := sub_pos.mpr ht'
    have h_lin : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
        s * (slopePlus d s v (mkSpaceTime x' t') - B) ≤
          v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - v (mkSpaceTime x' t') + B * δ + ‖x' - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * δ) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨y_plus, hy_plus⟩ := (h_attain x' t' s hs).1
      have hτ : 0 < δ + s := add_pos hδ hs
      have ht₀τ : t₀ + (δ + s) = t' + s := by dsimp [δ]; ring
      have h_b := (h_comp b y_plus t₀ (δ + s) hτ).1
      have h_sb := (h_slopes (δ + s) hτ).1
      rw [ht₀τ, h_sb] at h_b
      have h_q := h_quad_diff_le b x' y_plus δ s hδ hs
      linarith
    have h_sp_le : slopePlus d r v (mkSpaceTime x' t') ≤ B := by
      apply h_slope_le (fun s => slopePlus d s v (mkSpaceTime x' t'))
        (v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - v (mkSpaceTime x' t') + B * δ + ‖x' - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * δ))
      · intro r₁ r₂ hr₁ hr₁₂
        exact (h_mono x' t' r₁ r₂ hr₁ hr₁₂).1
      · exact h_lin
      · exact hr
    have h_r_sp : r * slopePlus d r v (mkSpaceTime x' t') ≤ r * B :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sp_le (le_of_lt hr)
    have h_c := (h_comp x' y' t' r hr).1
    linarith
  have h_comp_lt : ∀ (x' y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t' r : ℝ),
      t' + r < t₀ → 0 < r →
      v (mkSpaceTime y' (t' + r)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' t') ≤ B * r + ‖y' - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r) := by
    intro x' y' t' r ht' hr
    let s₀ : ℝ := t' + r
    let δ : ℝ := t₀ - s₀
    have hδ : 0 < δ := sub_pos.mpr ht'
    have h_lin : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
        s * (slopeMinus d s v (mkSpaceTime y' s₀) - B) ≤
          v (mkSpaceTime y' s₀) - v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) + B * δ + ‖y' - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * δ) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨y_minus, hy_minus⟩ := (h_attain y' s₀ s hs).2
      have hτ : 0 < δ + s := add_pos hδ hs
      have ht₀τ : t₀ - (δ + s) = s₀ - s := by dsimp [δ]; ring
      have h_b := (h_comp b y_minus t₀ (δ + s) hτ).2
      have h_sb := (h_slopes (δ + s) hτ).2
      rw [ht₀τ, h_sb] at h_b
      have h_q := h_quad_diff_le b y' y_minus δ s hδ hs
      linarith
    have h_sm_le : slopeMinus d r v (mkSpaceTime y' s₀) ≤ B := by
      apply h_slope_le (fun s => slopeMinus d s v (mkSpaceTime y' s₀))
        (v (mkSpaceTime y' s₀) - v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) + B * δ + ‖y' - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * δ))
      · intro r₁ r₂ hr₁ hr₁₂
        exact (h_mono y' s₀ r₁ r₂ hr₁ hr₁₂).2
      · exact h_lin
      · exact hr
    have h_r_sm : r * slopeMinus d r v (mkSpaceTime y' s₀) ≤ r * B :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sm_le (le_of_lt hr)
    have h_c := (h_comp y' x' s₀ r hr).2
    have hs₀_sub : s₀ - r = t' := by dsimp [s₀]; ring
    rw [hs₀_sub, norm_sub_rev x' y'] at h_c
    linarith
  have h_cont_mk : ∀ x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => mkSpaceTime x' τ) := by
    intro x'
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    apply Continuous.comp (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _)
    rw [continuous_pi_iff]
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
      exact continuous_id
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact continuous_const
  have h_le_of_gt : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a C : ℝ),
      Continuous f → (∀ τ : ℝ, a < τ → f τ ≤ C) → f a ≤ C := by
    intro f a C hf h_gt_bound
    by_contra h_gt
    push_neg at h_gt
    let ε : ℝ := f a - C
    have hε : 0 < ε := sub_pos.mpr h_gt
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hf.continuousAt ε hε
    let τ : ℝ := a + δ / 2
    have haτ : a < τ := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
    have hfτ_le : f τ ≤ C := h_gt_bound τ haτ
    have h_dist_τ : dist τ a < δ := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have h_sub : τ - a = δ / 2 := by dsimp [τ]; ring
      rw [h_sub, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have h_dist_f : dist (f τ) (f a) < ε := hδ h_dist_τ
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h_dist_f
    have h_abs := (abs_lt.mp h_dist_f).1
    dsimp [ε] at h_abs
    linarith
  have h_le_of_lt : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a C : ℝ),
      Continuous f → (∀ τ : ℝ, τ < a → f τ ≤ C) → f a ≤ C := by
    intro f a C hf h_lt_bound
    by_contra h_gt
    push_neg at h_gt
    let ε : ℝ := f a - C
    have hε : 0 < ε := sub_pos.mpr h_gt
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hf.continuousAt ε hε
    let τ : ℝ := a - δ / 2
    have hτa : τ < a := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
    have hfτ_le : f τ ≤ C := h_lt_bound τ hτa
    have h_dist_τ : dist τ a < δ := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have h_sub : τ - a = -(δ / 2) := by dsimp [τ]; ring
      rw [h_sub, abs_of_neg (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have h_dist_f : dist (f τ) (f a) < ε := hδ h_dist_τ
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h_dist_f
    have h_abs := (abs_lt.mp h_dist_f).1
    dsimp [ε] at h_abs
    linarith
  have h_comp_ge : ∀ (x' y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t' r : ℝ),
      t₀ ≤ t' → 0 < r →
      v (mkSpaceTime y' (t' + r)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' t') ≤ B * r + ‖y' - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r) := by
    intro x' y' t' r ht' hr
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => v (mkSpaceTime y' (τ + r)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' τ)) :=
      Continuous.sub (hv_cont.comp ((h_cont_mk y').comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)))
        (hv_cont.comp (h_cont_mk x'))
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ht' with h_gt | rfl
    · exact h_comp_gt x' y' t' r h_gt hr
    · exact h_le_of_gt (fun τ : ℝ => v (mkSpaceTime y' (τ + r)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' τ))
        t₀ (B * r + ‖y' - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r)) hf_cont (fun τ hτ => h_comp_gt x' y' τ r hτ hr)
  have h_comp_le : ∀ (x' y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t' r : ℝ),
      t' + r ≤ t₀ → 0 < r →
      v (mkSpaceTime y' (t' + r)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' t') ≤ B * r + ‖y' - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r) := by
    intro x' y' t' r ht' hr
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => v (mkSpaceTime y' (τ + r)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' τ)) :=
      Continuous.sub (hv_cont.comp ((h_cont_mk y').comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)))
        (hv_cont.comp (h_cont_mk x'))
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ht' with h_lt | h_eq
    · exact h_comp_lt x' y' t' r h_lt hr
    · have ht'_eq : t' = t₀ - r := by linarith
      rw [ht'_eq]
      exact h_le_of_lt (fun τ : ℝ => v (mkSpaceTime y' (τ + r)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' τ))
        (t₀ - r) (B * r + ‖y' - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r)) hf_cont
        (fun τ hτ => h_comp_lt x' y' τ r (by linarith) hr)
  rcases le_or_gt t₀ t with ht_ge | ht_lt
  · exact h_comp_ge x y t ℓ ht_ge hℓ
  · rcases le_or_gt (t + ℓ) t₀ with h_le | h_gt
    · exact h_comp_le x y t ℓ h_le hℓ
    · let ℓ₁ : ℝ := t₀ - t
      let ℓ₂ : ℝ := t + ℓ - t₀
      have hℓ₁ : 0 < ℓ₁ := sub_pos.mpr ht_lt
      have hℓ₂ : 0 < ℓ₂ := sub_pos.mpr h_gt
      let z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x + (ℓ₁ / ℓ) • (y - x)
      have ht₁ : t + ℓ₁ = t₀ := by dsimp [ℓ₁]; ring
      have ht₂ : t₀ + ℓ₂ = t + ℓ := by dsimp [ℓ₂]; ring
      have h1 := h_comp_le x z t ℓ₁ (by linarith) hℓ₁
      have h2 := h_comp_ge z y t₀ ℓ₂ (le_refl t₀) hℓ₂
      rw [ht₁] at h1
      rw [ht₂] at h2
      have hzx : z - x = (ℓ₁ / ℓ) • (y - x) := by
        dsimp [z]
        exact add_sub_cancel_left x ((ℓ₁ / ℓ) • (y - x))
      have hyz : y - z = (ℓ₂ / ℓ) • (y - x) := by
        have h_sub : y - z = (1 : ℝ) • (y - x) - (ℓ₁ / ℓ) • (y - x) := by
          dsimp [z]
          rw [one_smul]
          abel
        rw [h_sub, ← sub_smul]
        congr 1
        have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ
        field_simp
        dsimp [ℓ₁, ℓ₂]
        ring
      have h_q_sum : ‖z - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ₁) + ‖y - z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ₂) = ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) := by
        rw [hzx, hyz, h_norm_smul_sq (ℓ₁ / ℓ) (y - x), h_norm_smul_sq (ℓ₂ / ℓ) (y - x)]
        have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ
        have hℓ₁_ne : ℓ₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ₁
        have hℓ₂_ne : ℓ₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ₂
        field_simp
        dsimp [ℓ₁, ℓ₂]
        ring
      have h_B_sum : B * ℓ₁ + B * ℓ₂ = B * ℓ := by
        dsimp [ℓ₁, ℓ₂]
        ring
      linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ B : ℝ)
    (h_global : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ B * ℓ + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ))
    (h_attain_b : ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t₀ + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - ‖y_plus - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          B * ℓ) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t₀ - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          B * ℓ)) :
    IsAffineSpaceTime d v

signature.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ B : ℝ)
    (h_global : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ B * ℓ + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ))
    (h_attain_b : ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t₀ + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - ‖y_plus - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          B * ℓ) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t₀ - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          B * ℓ)) :
    IsAffineSpaceTime d v

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_norm_smul_sq : ∀ (s : ℝ) (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ‖s • q‖ ^ 2 = s ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro s q
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  have h_norm_sub_smul_sq : ∀ (u q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ℓ : ℝ),
      ‖u - ℓ • q‖ ^ 2 =
        (1 + ℓ) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * ‖q‖ ^ 2 - ℓ * ‖u + q‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro u q ℓ
    have h1 : ‖u + q‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ u q + ‖q‖ ^ 2 := norm_add_sq_real u q
    have h2 : ‖u - ℓ • q‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ u (ℓ • q) + ‖ℓ • q‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_sub_sq_real u (ℓ • q)
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, h_norm_smul_sq] at h2
    rw [h2, h1]
    ring
  have h_mkSpaceTime_proj : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z) = z := by
    intro z
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime]
    · intro i
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace]
  have h_inner_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a_t : ℝ)
      (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      inner ℝ (mkSpaceTime q a_t) z = inner ℝ q (projSpace z) + a_t * projTime z := by
    intro q a_t z
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have h_sum : (∑ i : Fin d, inner ℝ (mkSpaceTime q a_t (Fin.castSucc i)) (z (Fin.castSucc i))) =
        ∑ i : Fin d, inner ℝ (q i) (projSpace z i) := by
      congr 1 with i
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace]
    have h_last : inner ℝ (mkSpaceTime q a_t (Fin.last d)) (z (Fin.last d)) = a_t * projTime z := by
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime, mul_comm]
    rw [h_sum, h_last]
  obtain ⟨y₁_minus, hy₁_minus⟩ := (h_attain_b 1 zero_lt_one).2
  let q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := b - y₁_minus
  have hq_norm : ‖y₁_minus - b‖ ^ 2 = ‖q‖ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [norm_sub_rev]
  have hy₁_eq : v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - v (mkSpaceTime y₁_minus (t₀ - 1)) = B + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    linarith [hy₁_minus, hq_norm]
  have h_ray_plus : ∀ (ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime (b + ℓ • q) (t₀ + ℓ)) =
        v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) + (B + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    obtain ⟨y_plus, hy_plus⟩ := (h_attain_b ℓ hℓ).1
    let u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := y_plus - b
    have hu_q : y_plus - y₁_minus = u + q := by
      dsimp [u, q]
      abel
    have h_step_pos : 0 < 1 + ℓ := by linarith
    have h_glob := h_global y₁_minus y_plus (t₀ - 1) (1 + ℓ) h_step_pos
    have h_time : (t₀ - 1) + (1 + ℓ) = t₀ + ℓ := by ring
    rw [h_time, hu_q] at h_glob
    have hu_norm : ‖y_plus - b‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := rfl
    rw [hu_norm] at hy_plus
    have h_ineq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ ‖u + q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 + ℓ)) := by
      linarith [hy₁_eq, hy_plus, h_glob]
    have h_alg : (1 + ℓ) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * ‖q‖ ^ 2 - ℓ * ‖u + q‖ ^ 2 =
        2 * ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * (‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 - ‖u + q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 + ℓ))) := by
      have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ
      have h1ℓ_ne : 1 + ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_step_pos
      field_simp
    have h_nonpos : ‖u - ℓ • q‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
      rw [h_norm_sub_smul_sq u q ℓ, h_alg]
      have h_pos_fac : 0 ≤ 2 * ℓ * (1 + ℓ) := by positivity
      have h_diff_nonpos :
          ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 - ‖u + q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 + ℓ)) ≤ 0 := by
        linarith [h_ineq]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h_pos_fac h_diff_nonpos
    have h_sq_zero : ‖u - ℓ • q‖ ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm h_nonpos (sq_nonneg _)
    have hu_eq : u = ℓ • q := by
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h_sq_zero))
    have hy_plus_eq : y_plus = b + ℓ • q := by
      dsimp [u] at hu_eq
      calc y_plus = b + (y_plus - b) := by abel
        _ = b + ℓ • q := by rw [hu_eq]
    rw [hu_eq, h_norm_smul_sq, hy_plus_eq] at hy_plus
    have h_div_simp : ℓ ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) = ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 * ℓ := by
      have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ
      field_simp
    linarith [hy_plus, h_div_simp]
  have h_ray_plus_one : v (mkSpaceTime (b + q) (t₀ + 1)) - v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) =
      B + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have h1 := h_ray_plus 1 zero_lt_one
    rw [one_smul] at h1
    linarith
  have h_ray_minus : ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      v (mkSpaceTime (b - r • q) (t₀ - r)) =
        v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - (B + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2) * r := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨y_minus, hy_minus⟩ := (h_attain_b r hr).2
    let u_m : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := b - y_minus
    have hu_m_q : (b + q) - y_minus = u_m + q := by
      dsimp [u_m]
      abel
    have h_step_pos : 0 < 1 + r := by linarith
    have h_glob := h_global y_minus (b + q) (t₀ - r) (1 + r) h_step_pos
    have h_time : (t₀ - r) + (1 + r) = t₀ + 1 := by ring
    rw [h_time, hu_m_q] at h_glob
    have hu_m_norm : ‖y_minus - b‖ ^ 2 = ‖u_m‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [u_m]
      rw [norm_sub_rev]
    rw [hu_m_norm] at hy_minus
    have h_ineq : ‖u_m‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r) + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ ‖u_m + q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 + r)) := by
      linarith [h_ray_plus_one, hy_minus, h_glob]
    have h_alg : (1 + r) * ‖u_m‖ ^ 2 + r * (1 + r) * ‖q‖ ^ 2 - r * ‖u_m + q‖ ^ 2 =
        2 * r * (1 + r) * (‖u_m‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r) + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 - ‖u_m + q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 + r))) := by
      have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
      have h1r_ne : 1 + r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_step_pos
      field_simp
    have h_nonpos : ‖u_m - r • q‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
      rw [h_norm_sub_smul_sq u_m q r, h_alg]
      have h_pos_fac : 0 ≤ 2 * r * (1 + r) := by positivity
      have h_diff_nonpos :
          ‖u_m‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r) + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 - ‖u_m + q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 + r)) ≤ 0 := by
        linarith [h_ineq]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h_pos_fac h_diff_nonpos
    have h_sq_zero : ‖u_m - r • q‖ ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm h_nonpos (sq_nonneg _)

      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h_sq_zero))

      dsimp [u_m] at hu_m_eq

        _ = b - r • q := by rw [hu_m_eq]

    have h_div_simp : r ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * r) = ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 * r := by
      have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
      field_simp
    linarith [hy_minus, h_div_simp]
  have h_eval : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) =
        v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) + inner ℝ q (x - b) + (B - ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (t - t₀) := by
    intro x t

          v (mkSpaceTime b t₀) - (B + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2) * r +

          A + (‖w‖ ^ 2 / 2) / τ := by
        dsimp [A, r]
        field_simp

      have h_time_lb : t + τ = t₀ + ℓ := by dsimp [ℓ, δ]; ring

        dsimp [A, ℓ]

      dsimp [τ₀]
      field_simp
      ring

  let P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime q a_t

three_point_midpoint_flatness.definitions:
noncomputable def concaveSepPenalty (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  r - (1 / 8 : ℝ) * (r * Real.sqrt r)

noncomputable def threePointCutoff {d : ℕ} (L δ : ℝ)
    (c₀ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let C : ℝ := 2 * L
  let B_out : ℝ := (5 / 4 : ℝ) * (C + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * C ^ 2 + 1)
  δ / 2 + 16 * B_out * ‖c - c₀‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def threePointPenaltyPsi {d : ℕ} (L δ : ℝ)
    (P_star c₀ x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)
  let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z - c
  let r : ℝ := ‖x - y‖
  inner ℝ P_star (x + y - (2 : ℝ) • z) +
    threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c * concaveSepPenalty r +
    ‖h‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2

noncomputable def threePointQuadForm {d : ℕ}
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  -α * (inner ℝ e (x - y)) ^ 2 +
    β * ‖(x - y) - (inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e‖ ^ 2 +
    γ * ‖z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)‖ ^ 2 +
    K * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 + ‖z‖ ^ 2)

def HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest {d : ℕ}
    (u_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
    ∀ (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
      (X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      (∀ v w, inner ℝ (X v) w = inner ℝ v (X w)) →
      (∃ δ_test > 0, ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ_test,

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def concaveSepPenalty (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  r - (1 / 8 : ℝ) * (r * Real.sqrt r)

noncomputable def threePointCutoff {d : ℕ} (L δ : ℝ)
    (c₀ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let C : ℝ := 2 * L
  let B_out : ℝ := (5 / 4 : ℝ) * (C + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * C ^ 2 + 1)
  δ / 2 + 16 * B_out * ‖c - c₀‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def threePointPenaltyPsi {d : ℕ} (L δ : ℝ)
    (P_star c₀ x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)
  let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z - c
  let r : ℝ := ‖x - y‖
  inner ℝ P_star (x + y - (2 : ℝ) • z) +
    threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c * concaveSepPenalty r +
    ‖h‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2

noncomputable def threePointQuadForm {d : ℕ}
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  -α * (inner ℝ e (x - y)) ^ 2 +
    β * ‖(x - y) - (inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e‖ ^ 2 +
    γ * ‖z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)‖ ^ 2 +
    K * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 + ‖z‖ ^ 2)

def HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest {d : ℕ}
    (u_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
    ∀ (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
      (X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      (∀ v w, inner ℝ (X v) w = inner ℝ v (X w)) →
      (∃ δ_test > 0, ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ_test,
        u_hat ξ ≤ u_hat ξ₀ + inner ℝ q (ξ - ξ₀) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (ξ - ξ₀)) (ξ - ξ₀)) →
      0 ≤ inner ℝ (X (P + q)) (P + q)

by
  let η : ℝ := ε / (14 * (d + 1 : ℝ))
  have hd_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (d + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := by positivity
  have hη : 0 ≤ η := le_of_lt hη_pos
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by linarith
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := h_mid η hη_pos
  have hr_ev : ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, r_seq i / R_seq i < 1 / 16 :=
    (tendsto_order.mp hr_ratio).2 (1 / 16) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hr_ev
  have hz_ev : ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, ‖z_seq i - z_star‖ / R_seq i < 1 / 8 :=
    (tendsto_order.mp hz_ratio).2 (1 / 8) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨i₂, hi₂⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hz_ev
  let i : ℕ := max i₀ (max i₁ i₂)
  have hi₀_le : i₀ ≤ i := le_max_left i₀ (max i₁ i₂)
  have hi₁_le : i₁ ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_left i₁ i₂) (le_max_right i₀ (max i₁ i₂))
  have hi₂_le : i₂ ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_right i₁ i₂) (le_max_right i₀ (max i₁ i₂))
  let U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := liftFunc (u_seq i)
  let z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z_seq i
  let r : ℝ := r_seq i
  let R : ℝ := R_seq i
  let W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := isotropicBlowup U z r
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := (hr_seq i).1
  have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr_pos
  have hR_pos_i : 0 < R := hR_pos i
  have hR_ne : R ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR_pos_i
  have hW0 : W 0 = 0 := by simp [W, isotropicBlowup]
  have hW_last : W (EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last d) 1) = 1 := by
    let e_last : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last d) 1
    have h_space : projSpace (z + r • e_last) = projSpace z := by
      ext m
      dsimp [projSpace]
      have h_ne : Fin.castSucc m ≠ Fin.last d := Fin.castSucc_ne_last m
      have hs : e_last (Fin.castSucc m) = 0 := by
        simp [e_last, h_ne]
      change (z + r • e_last).ofLp (Fin.castSucc m) = z.ofLp (Fin.castSucc m)
      rw [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs, mul_zero, add_zero]
    have h_time : projTime (z + r • e_last) = projTime z + r := by
      dsimp [projTime]
      have hs : e_last (Fin.last d) = 1 := by
        simp [e_last]
      change (z + r • e_last).ofLp (Fin.last d) = z.ofLp (Fin.last d) + r
      rw [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs, mul_one]
    dsimp [W, isotropicBlowup, U, liftFunc]
    change (u_seq i (projSpace (z + r • e_last)) + projTime (z + r • e_last) -
      (u_seq i (projSpace z) + projTime z)) / r = 1
    rw [h_space, h_time]
    field_simp [hr_ne]
    ring
  have hz_ball : ∀ H ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2,
      z + r • H ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8) := by
    intro H hH
    have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < 3 / 4 := by simpa [z, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz_seq i
    have hr_le : r ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) := (hr_seq i).2
    have hH_norm : ‖H‖ ≤ 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hH
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have h_tri := norm_add_le z (r • H)
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos] at h_tri
    nlinarith
  have hW_lip : ∀ H₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2,
      ∀ H₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2,
        |W H₁ - W H₂| ≤ L * ‖H₁ - H₂‖ := by
    intro H₁ hH₁ H₂ hH₂
    have hU_lip := (hL (u_seq i) (hu_seq i)).2.2.1 (z + r • H₁) (hz_ball H₁ hH₁) (z + r • H₂) (hz_ball H₂ hH₂)
    have h_diff_norm : ‖(z + r • H₁) - (z + r • H₂)‖ = r * ‖H₁ - H₂‖ := by
      have : (z + r • H₁) - (z + r • H₂) = r • (H₁ - H₂) := by rw [smul_sub]; abel
      rw [this, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
    rw [h_diff_norm] at hU_lip
    have hW_diff : W H₁ - W H₂ = (U (z + r • H₁) - U (z + r • H₂)) / r := by
      dsimp [W, isotropicBlowup]
      ring
    rw [hW_diff, abs_div, abs_of_pos hr_pos, div_le_iff₀ hr_pos]
    linarith
  have hX_ball : ∀ H ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2,
      R⁻¹ • (z - z_star + r • H) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (1 / 4) := by
    intro H hH
    have hH_norm : ‖H‖ ≤ 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hH
    have hrR : r / R < 1 / 16 := hi₁ i hi₁_le
    have hzR : ‖z - z_star‖ / R < 1 / 8 := hi₂ i hi₂_le
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hR_pos_i] at hrR hzR
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hR_pos_i,
      inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hR_pos_i]
    have h_tri := norm_add_le (z - z_star) (r • H)
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos] at h_tri
    nlinarith
  have hW_mid : ∀ H ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2,
      ∀ K ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2,
        |W H + W K - 2 * W ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (H + K))| ≤ η * ‖H - K‖ := by
    intro H hH K hK
    let X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := R⁻¹ • (z - z_star + r • H)
    let Y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := R⁻¹ • (z - z_star + r • K)
    have hX : X ∈ Metric.ball 0 (1 / 4) := hX_ball H hH
    have hY : Y ∈ Metric.ball 0 (1 / 4) := hX_ball K hK
    have h_mid_XY := hi₀ i hi₀_le X hX Y hY
    have h_pt : ∀ V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        z_star + R • (R⁻¹ • (z - z_star + r • V)) = z + r • V := by
      intro V
      rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hR_ne, one_smul]
      abel
    have h_pt_X : z_star + R • X = z + r • H := h_pt H
    have h_pt_Y : z_star + R • Y = z + r • K := h_pt K
    have h_mid_eq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + Y) = R⁻¹ • (z - z_star + r • ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (H + K))) := by
      dsimp [X, Y]
      ext m
      simp [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have h_pt_M : z_star + R • ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + Y)) = z + r • ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (H + K)) := by
      rw [h_mid_eq]
      exact h_pt ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (H + K))

      have : X - Y = (r / R) • (H - K) := by
        dsimp [X, Y]
        ext m
        simp [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [this, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hr_pos hR_pos_i)]
    have h_sec : W H + W K - 2 * W ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (H + K)) =

          2 * isotropicBlowup U z_star R ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + Y))) := by
      dsimp [W, isotropicBlowup]
      rw [h_pt_X, h_pt_Y, h_pt_M]

    have h_cancel : (R / r) * (η * (r / R * ‖H - K‖)) = η * ‖H - K‖ := by
      field_simp [hr_ne, hR_ne]

  have h_ray : ∀ H ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2,

      intro c hc
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, he_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one]
      exact hc
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => W ((2 * t) • e)
    have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by simp [g, hW0]
    have ht_mem : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 → (2 * t) • e ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2 := by
      intro t ht
      apply hc_mem
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      linarith
    have hg_bdd : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 → |g t| ≤ 2 * L := by
      intro t ht

      have hlip := hW_lip ((2 * t) • e) (ht_mem t ht) 0 h0_mem
      rw [hW0, sub_zero, sub_zero, norm_smul, he_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,

      intro s u hs hu

      have h_eq1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((2 * s) • e + (2 * u) • e) = (2 * ((s + u) / 2)) • e := by

          rw [← sub_smul]

        rw [this, norm_smul, he_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
          abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]

    let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => g t - t * g 1
    have hh0 : h 0 = 0 := by simp [h, hg0]
    have hh1 : h 1 = 0 := by simp [h]
    have hh_mid : ∀ s u : ℝ, |s| ≤ 1 → |u| ≤ 1 → |h s + h u - 2 * h ((s + u) / 2)| ≤ 2 * η * |s - u| := by
      intro s u hs hu
      have h_id : h s + h u - 2 * h ((s + u) / 2) = g s + g u - 2 * g ((s + u) / 2) := by
        dsimp [h]
        ring
      rw [h_id]
      exact hg_mid s u hs hu
    have hh_ind : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → |h t| ≤ 2 * η + 4 * L * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro t ht0 ht1
        have hgt : |g t| ≤ 2 * L := hg_bdd t (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, ht1⟩)
        have hg1 : |g 1| ≤ 2 * L := hg_bdd 1 (by norm_num)
        have h_tri : |h t| ≤ |g t| + |t * g 1| := by
          simpa [h, sub_eq_add_neg] using abs_add_le (g t) (-(t * g 1))
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht0] at h_tri
        simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
        nlinarith
      | succ m ihm =>
        intro t ht0 ht1
        rcases le_total t (1 / 2) with h_le | h_ge
        · have h2t0 : 0 ≤ 2 * t := by linarith
          have h2t1 : 2 * t ≤ 1 := by linarith
          have h_step := hh_mid 0 (2 * t) (by norm_num) (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, h2t1⟩)
          have h_arg : (0 + 2 * t) / 2 = t := by ring
          rw [hh0, zero_add, h_arg, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg h2t0] at h_step
          have h_ih := ihm (2 * t) h2t0 h2t1
          rw [abs_le] at h_step h_ih ⊢
          constructor <;> { rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith }
        · have h2t0 : 0 ≤ 2 * t - 1 := by linarith
          have h2t1 : 2 * t - 1 ≤ 1 := by linarith
          have h_step := hh_mid (2 * t - 1) 1 (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, h2t1⟩) (by norm_num)
          have h_arg : (2 * t - 1 + 1) / 2 = t := by ring
          have h_sub : |2 * t - 1 - 1| = 2 * (1 - t) := by
            have : 2 * t - 1 - 1 = -(2 * (1 - t)) := by ring
            rw [this, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
          rw [hh1, add_zero, h_arg, h_sub] at h_step
          have h_ih := ihm (2 * t - 1) h2t0 h2t1
          rw [abs_le] at h_step h_ih ⊢
          constructor <;> { rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith }
    have hh_nonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → |h t| ≤ 2 * η := by
      intro t ht0 ht1
      have h_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => 2 * η + 4 * L * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) Filter.atTop (nhds (2 * η + 4 * L * 0)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.add ((tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).const_mul (4 * L))
      rw [mul_zero, add_zero] at h_tend
      exact ge_of_tendsto h_tend (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun m => hh_ind m t ht0 ht1))
    have hh_all : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 → |h t| ≤ 6 * η := by
      intro t ht
      rcases le_total 0 t with ht0 | ht0
      · have ht1 : t ≤ 1 := (abs_le.mp ht).2
        have := hh_nonneg t ht0 ht1
        linarith
      · have hmt0 : 0 ≤ -t := by linarith
        have hmt1 : -t ≤ 1 := by linarith [(abs_le.mp ht).1]
        have h_pos := hh_nonneg (-t) hmt0 hmt1
        have h_sym := hg_mid t (-t) ht (by rw [abs_neg]; exact ht)
        have h_avg : (t + -t) / 2 = 0 := by ring
        have h_diff : |t - -t| = -2 * t := by
          have : t - -t = -(-2 * t) := by ring
          rw [this, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
        rw [h_avg, hg0, mul_zero, sub_zero, h_diff] at h_sym
        have h_id : h t = (g t + g (-t)) - h (-t) := by dsimp [h]; ring
        rw [h_id]
        rw [abs_le] at h_pos h_sym ⊢
        constructor <;> nlinarith
    have hg1_half : |g 1 - 2 * W e| ≤ 2 * η := by
      have h_m := hg_mid 1 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      have h_avg : (1 + 0) / 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by ring
      have h_ge : g (1 / 2) = W e := by
        dsimp [g]
        have : (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ)) = 1 := by ring
        rw [this, one_smul]
      rw [hg0, add_zero, h_avg, h_ge, sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one] at h_m
      exact h_m
    have hHj : |H j| ≤ 2 := by
      have hH_norm : ‖H‖ ≤ 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hH
      have h_le : ‖H j‖ ≤ ‖H‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le H j
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using le_trans h_le hH_norm
    let t : ℝ := H j / 2
    have ht_abs : |t| ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [t]
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      linarith
    have hht := hh_all t ht_abs
    have h_eval : g t = W ((H j) • e) := by
      dsimp [g, t]
      have : 2 * (H j / 2) = H j := by ring
      rw [this]
    have h_id : W ((H j) • e) - (H j) * W e = h t + t * (g 1 - 2 * W e) := by
      rw [← h_eval]
      dsimp [h, t]
      ring
    have h_prod : |t * (g 1 - 2 * W e)| ≤ 2 * η := by
      rw [abs_mul]

    have h_tri := abs_add_le (h t) (t * (g 1 - 2 * W e))
    rw [← h_id] at h_tri
    linarith
  have h_sum_approx : ∀ H ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2,
      |W H - ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), W ((H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤ 6 * (d + 1 : ℝ) * η := by
    intro H hH
    have h_add : ∀ X Y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        X ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 2 → Y ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 2 → X + Y ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 2 →
        |W (X + Y) - W X - W Y| ≤ 6 * η := by
      intro X Y hX hY hXY
      have h0 : (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 2 := by simp
      have h1 := hW_mid (X + Y) hXY 0 h0
      rw [hW0, add_zero, add_zero, sub_zero] at h1
      have hXY_norm : ‖X + Y‖ ≤ 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hXY
      have hX_norm : ‖X‖ ≤ 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hX
      have hY_norm : ‖Y‖ ≤ 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hY
      have h2 := hW_mid X hX Y hY
      have h_diff_norm : ‖X - Y‖ ≤ 4 := by
        have := norm_sub_le X Y
        linarith
      have h1' : |W (X + Y) - 2 * W ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + Y))| ≤ 2 * η := by nlinarith
      have h2' : |W X + W Y - 2 * W ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + Y))| ≤ 4 * η := by nlinarith
      rw [abs_le] at h1' h2' ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hH_norm : ‖H‖ ≤ 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hH
    let S : Finset (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
      fun s => ∑ j ∈ s, (H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1
    have hS_apply : ∀ (s : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) (k : Fin (d + 1)),
        (S s) k = if k ∈ s then H k else 0 := by
      intro s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
        intro k
        simp [S]
      | @insert a t ha iht =>
        intro k
        have h_ins : S (insert a t) = (H a) • EuclideanSpace.single a 1 + S t :=
          Finset.sum_insert ha
        rw [h_ins, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, iht k]
        have h_single : (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)) k = if k = a then 1 else 0 := by
          simp [PiLp.single_apply, eq_comm]
        rw [h_single]
        by_cases hka : k = a
        · subst hka
          simp [ha]
        · simp [hka]
    have hS_mem : ∀ s : Finset (Fin (d + 1)), S s ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2 := by
      intro s
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have h_le : ‖S s‖ ≤ ‖H‖ := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq (S s), EuclideanSpace.norm_eq H]
        apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro k _
        have hk := hS_apply s k
        change (S s).ofLp k = _ at hk
        rw [hk]
        split_ifs <;> simp [sq_nonneg]
      exact le_trans h_le hH_norm
    have h_single_mem : ∀ a : Fin (d + 1),
        (H a) • EuclideanSpace.single a 1 ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2 := by
      intro a
      have h_eq : (H a) • EuclideanSpace.single a 1 = S {a} := (Finset.sum_singleton _ _).symm
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hS_mem {a}
    have hS_ind : ∀ s : Finset (Fin (d + 1)),
        |W (S s) - ∑ j ∈ s, W ((H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤ 6 * (s.card : ℝ) * η := by
      intro s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
        simp [S, hW0]
      | @insert a t ha iht =>
        have h_ins : S (insert a t) = (H a) • EuclideanSpace.single a 1 + S t :=
          Finset.sum_insert ha
        have h_sum : (∑ j ∈ insert a t, W ((H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) =
            W ((H a) • EuclideanSpace.single a 1) + ∑ j ∈ t, W ((H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1) :=
          Finset.sum_insert ha
        have h_step := h_add ((H a) • EuclideanSpace.single a 1) (S t)
          (h_single_mem a) (hS_mem t) (by rw [← h_ins]; exact hS_mem (insert a t))
        rw [h_ins, h_sum, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

      ext k
      have hk := hS_apply Finset.univ k

    rw [hS_univ, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h_fin
    exact h_fin

      |W H - ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), (H j) * W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤ ε := by
    intro H hH
    have h1 := h_sum_approx H hH
    have h2 : |(∑ j : Fin (d + 1), W ((H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) -
        ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), (H j) * W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤ (d + 1 : ℝ) * (8 * η) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      calc |∑ j : Fin (d + 1), (W ((H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1) - (H j) * W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))|
        _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), |W ((H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1) - (H j) * W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (d + 1), 8 * η :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => h_ray H hH j)
        _ = (d + 1 : ℝ) * (8 * η) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h_tri := abs_sub_le (W H) (∑ j : Fin (d + 1), W ((H j) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
      (∑ j : Fin (d + 1), (H j) * W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
    have h_eta_eq : 14 * (d + 1 : ℝ) * η = ε := by
      dsimp [η]
      have : 14 * (d + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [this]
    linarith
  refine ⟨i, fun lam hlam_ge hlam_lt => ?_⟩
  let P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1
  have hP_inner : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      inner ℝ P v = ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), (v j) * W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := by
    intro v
    dsimp [P]
    rw [sum_inner]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have hP_ne : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro hP0
    have h1 : inner ℝ P (EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last d) 1) = 1 := by
      rw [hP_inner]
      have h_sum : (∑ j : Fin (d + 1), ((EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last d) (1 : ℝ)) j) * W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) =
          W (EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last d) 1) := by
        have h_congr : ∀ j : Fin (d + 1),
            ((EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last d) (1 : ℝ)) j) * W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) =
              if j = Fin.last d then W (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) else 0 := by
          intro j
          have hs : (EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last d) (1 : ℝ)) j = if j = Fin.last d then 1 else 0 := by
            simp [PiLp.single_apply]
          rw [hs]
          split_ifs <;> ring
        simp_rw [h_congr]
        simp
      rw [h_sum]
      exact hW_last
    rw [hP0, inner_zero_left] at h1
    norm_num at h1
  refine ⟨P, hP_ne, ?_⟩
  intro h N_P h_par h_perp
  have hNP_norm : ‖N_P‖ = 1 := by
    dsimp [N_P]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hP_ne)]
  have h_norm : ‖h‖ ≤ 2 * r := by
    have h_decomp : h = (h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P) + (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P := by abel
    have h_tri : ‖h‖ ≤ ‖h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P‖ + ‖(inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P‖ := by
      simpa [← h_decomp] using norm_add_le (h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P) ((inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P)
    rw [norm_smul, hNP_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h_tri
    have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt lam ≤ 1 := Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr (le_of_lt hlam_lt)
    nlinarith
  let H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := r⁻¹ • h
  have hH_mem : H ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 2 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
    exact (inv_mul_le_iff₀ hr_pos).mpr (by linarith)
  have h_fit := hW_lin H hH_mem
  rw [← hP_inner H] at h_fit
  have h_zh : z + r • H = z + h := by
    dsimp [H]
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne, one_smul]
  have h_id : U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P h = r * (W H - inner ℝ P H) := by
    dsimp [W, isotropicBlowup]
    rw [h_zh]
    have h_in : inner ℝ P H = r⁻¹ * inner ℝ P h := by
      dsimp [H]
      rw [real_inner_smul_right]
    rw [h_in]
    field_simp [hr_ne]
  rw [h_id, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
  nlinarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₀ : ℝ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀)
    (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv₀ : InLimitingClassA d C₀ v₀)
    (h_nonaff : ¬ IsAffineSpaceTime d v₀) :
    ∃ (κ : ℝ) (v_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      0 < κ ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ,
        InLimitingClassA d (max C₀ 1) (v_seq j) ∧
        IsCenteredAt d (max C₀ 1) (v_seq j) 0 1 ∧
        HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ (v_seq j) ∧
        κ ^ 2 / 2 - κ / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤
          barycentricEnvelope d 1 (v_seq j) (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - (v_seq j) (mkSpaceTime 0 1)

      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          M ≤ ‖y‖ → |w (mkSpaceTime y 1)| ≤ ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ), 0 < R →
    ∃ (B_fit : ℝ), 0 ≤ B_fit ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
          ‖p‖ ≤ B_fit ∧ |a| ≤ B_fit ∧ IsFitAt d C₁ w x t R p a) ∧
  (∀ (K : ℝ), 0 < K →
    (∃ (U : ℝ), 0 ≤ U ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ K → |projTime z| ≤ K → |w z| ≤ U) ∧
    (∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
          InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
          ∀ (z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
            ‖projSpace z₁‖ ≤ K → |projTime z₁| ≤ K →
            ‖projSpace z₂‖ ≤ K → |projTime z₂| ≤ K →
            ‖z₁ - z₂‖ ≤ δ → |w z₁ - w z₂| ≤ ε))

    have h_lin_3 : ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖p k‖ + 1 + 2 * C₁) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n =

    have hw_le_lin : |w (mkSpaceTime x t)| ≤ ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖p k‖ + 1 + 2 * C₁) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith [h_fit_abs.1, h_fit_abs.2, h_cs_abs.1, h_cs_abs.2,
        h_ak_abs.1, h_ak_abs.2, h_pk_abs.1, h_pk_abs.2, h_lin_1, h_lin_2, h_lin_3]
    have h_rhs : ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖p k‖ + 1 + 2 * C₁) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (ε / 4) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coef_bound (le_of_lt h2n_pos)

    intro m
    induction' m with m ih

      have hx_sq : ((2 : ℝ) ^ k₀) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hx_ge 2
      nlinarith
    · intro hx_succ
      rcases le_total ‖x‖ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m)) with hx_le | hx_gt
      · exact ih hx_le
      · have hn_ge : k₀ ≤ k₀ + (m + 1) := Nat.le_add_right k₀ (m + 1)
        have hw_1 := h_single_scale (k₀ + (m + 1)) hn_ge hx_succ
        have h_pow_eq : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + (m + 1))) ^ 2 = 4 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m)) ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Nat.add_assoc, pow_succ' 2 (k₀ + m)]
          ring
        have hx_sq : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m)) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hx_gt 2
        nlinarith
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_ge ‖x‖
  have hm_pow : ‖x‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) := by
    have h1 : (m : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := h_ind_2 m
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + m) :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.le_add_left m k₀)
    linarith
  exact h_shell m hm_pow

by
  intro d hd C₁ hC₁ κ hκ h_growth v hv_class hv_jensen x₀ p₀ x_end r a₀ K hr h_env h_fit h_loc
  dsimp only
  set w := fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀
  set b₀ := r⁻¹ • (x_end - x₀ + r • p₀)
  obtain ⟨hw_cont, hw_cent, hw_fits⟩ :=
    fitted_frame_fits_and_centering d C₁ v hv_class.1 hv_class.2.2.2 x₀ p₀ r a₀ hr h_fit
  obtain ⟨hw_sub, hw_super⟩ :=
    fitted_frame_viscosity_covariance d C₁ v hv_class x₀ p₀ r a₀ hr
  have hw_class : InLimitingClassA d C₁ w := ⟨hw_cont, hw_sub, hw_super, hw_fits⟩

    fitted_frame_barycentric_covariance d κ hκ v hv_jensen x₀ p₀ r a₀ hr h_env
  have hb₀ : ‖b₀‖ ≤ K := by
    have hr_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ r⁻¹ := le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hr)
    calc ‖b₀‖
      _ = ‖r⁻¹ • (x_end - x₀ + r • p₀)‖ := rfl
      _ = ‖r⁻¹‖ * ‖x_end - x₀ + r • p₀‖ := norm_smul r⁻¹ (x_end - x₀ + r • p₀)
      _ = r⁻¹ * ‖x_end - x₀ + r • p₀‖ := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr_inv_nonneg]
      _ ≤ r⁻¹ * (K * r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_loc hr_inv_nonneg
      _ = K * (r⁻¹ * r) := by ring
      _ = K := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr), mul_one]
  have hw_slopes : ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ →
      slopePlus d ℓ w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) =

      slopeMinus d ℓ w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) =
        slopeMinus d (r * ℓ) v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - a₀ :=
    fitted_frame_slope_covariance d hd C₁ hC₁ h_growth v x₀ p₀ x_end r a₀ hr hw_class hw_cent

def HasUniformBoxAndFitBounds (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M →
    ∃ (U_M : ℝ), 0 ≤ U_M ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ M → |projTime z| ≤ M → |w z| ≤ U_M) ∧
  (∀ (M R : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → 0 < R →
    ∃ (B_MR : ℝ), 0 ≤ B_MR ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ)
          (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
          ‖x‖ ≤ M → |t| ≤ M → IsFitAt d C₁ w x t R p a →
          ‖p‖ ≤ B_MR ∧ |a| ≤ B_MR)

def HasUniformBoxEquicontinuity (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : ℝ), 0 < M → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    ∃ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (z z' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ M → |projTime z| ≤ M →
          ‖projSpace z' - projSpace z‖ ≤ δ → |projTime z' - projTime z| ≤ δ →
          |w z' - w z| ≤ ε

      quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ f (mkSpaceTime x 0) =
        sSup ((fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
          1 * f (mkSpaceTime y ℓ) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ) := by
    intro f x
    unfold quadEnvelopePlus
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace, zero_add]
    simp only [one_mul]
  have h_env_minus_eq : ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      quadEnvelopeMinus d ℓ f (mkSpaceTime x 0) =
        - sSup ((fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
          (-1) * f (mkSpaceTime y (-ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ) := by
    intro f x
    unfold quadEnvelopeMinus
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace, zero_sub, Real.sInf_def]
    congr 2
    ext v
    simp only [Set.mem_neg, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
      linarith
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
      linarith
  have h_plus_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m => quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ (w_seq m) (mkSpaceTime (b_seq m) 0))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ v_inf (mkSpaceTime b 0))) := by
    simp_rw [h_env_plus_eq]
    exact h_sup_tendsto 1 ℓ (by norm_num) (by rw [abs_of_pos hℓ])
  have h_minus_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m => quadEnvelopeMinus d ℓ (w_seq m) (mkSpaceTime (b_seq m) 0))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (quadEnvelopeMinus d ℓ v_inf (mkSpaceTime b 0))) := by
    simp_rw [h_env_minus_eq]
    exact (h_sup_tendsto (-1) (-ℓ) (by norm_num) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hℓ])).neg
  constructor
  · unfold slopePlus
    exact (h_plus_tendsto.sub h_eval_zero).div_const ℓ
  · unfold slopeMinus
    exact (h_eval_zero.sub h_minus_tendsto).div_const ℓ

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ), 3 ≤ d → ∀ (C₁ : ℝ), 1 ≤ C₁ → ∀ (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
      HasUniformSubquadraticGrowth d C₁ →
      ∀ (w_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
        (v_inf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        (∀ m : ℕ,
          InLimitingClassA d C₁ (w_seq m) ∧
          IsCenteredAt d C₁ (w_seq m) 0 1 ∧
          HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ (w_seq m) ∧
          barycentricEnvelope d 1 (w_seq m) (mkSpaceTime 0 1) -
            w_seq m (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2) →
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ v_inf →
        IsCenteredAt d C₁ v_inf 0 1 →
        ConvergesLocUnif d w_seq v_inf →
        barycentricEnvelope d 1 v_inf (mkSpaceTime 0 1) -
          v_inf (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2
