proof.tactics:
by
  intro d hd C₁ hC₁ κ hκ_pos h_growth w_seq v hw_seq hv_class hv_cent h_conv
  have hv_cont : Continuous v := hv_class.1
  have h_subquad_all : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ (M : ℝ), 0 < M ∧
        ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
          InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
          ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
            M ≤ ‖y‖ → |w (mkSpaceTime y 1)| ≤ ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM⟩ := h_growth 1 zero_le_one ε hε
    refine ⟨M, hM_pos, fun w hw_cl hw_ce y hy => ?_⟩
    exact hM w hw_cl hw_ce y 1 (by norm_num) hy
  have hv_subquad : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ (M : ℝ), 0 < M ∧
        ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          M ≤ ‖y‖ → |v (mkSpaceTime y 1)| ≤ ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM⟩ := h_subquad_all ε hε
    exact ⟨M, hM_pos, hM v hv_class hv_cent⟩
  have hv_tendsto : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun m => w_seq m z) Filter.atTop (nhds (v z)) := by
    intro z
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    let R : ℝ := max (‖projSpace z‖ + 1) (|projTime z| + 1)
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := by
      have : 0 < ‖projSpace z‖ + 1 := by positivity
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (le_max_left _ _)
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_conv R hR_pos (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨N₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have hz_s : ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ R :=
      le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_left (‖projSpace z‖ + 1) (|projTime z| + 1))
    have hz_t : |projTime z| ≤ R :=
      le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_right (‖projSpace z‖ + 1) (|projTime z| + 1))
    have h_le := hN₀ m hm z hz_s hz_t
    linarith
  have hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v := by
    intro t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
    let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)
    have h_sum_tend : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m => (∑ i, θ i * w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - w_seq m (mkSpaceTime x t))
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds ((∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t))) :=
      (tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
        (hv_tendsto (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)).const_mul (θ i))).sub (hv_tendsto (mkSpaceTime x t))
    refine le_of_tendsto h_sum_tend (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨0, fun m _ => ?_⟩)
    exact (hw_seq m).2.2.1 t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
  have hb_dual_ex : ∃ (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) =
        quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have h_mk_cont : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => mkSpaceTime y 1) := by
      unfold mkSpaceTime
      refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp (continuous_pi (fun j => ?_))
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
      · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]; exact continuous_const
      · intro i; simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        exact (continuous_apply i).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous
    obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM⟩ := hv_subquad (1 / 4) (by norm_num)
    have h_main : ∀ (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B →
        ∃ (R : ℝ), 0 < R ∧
          ∀ (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ‖b‖ ≤ B →
            (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
              v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0)) ∧
            (∃ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
              ‖y‖ ≤ R ∧
              v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0)) ∧
            (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
              v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) →
              ‖y‖ ≤ R) := by
      intro B hB
      let R : ℝ := max M (max (8 * B) (8 * |v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)| + 8))
      have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le hM_pos (le_max_left _ _)
      have hR_ge_M : M ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
      have hR_ge_8B : 8 * B ≤ R := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      have hR_ge_v0 : 8 * |v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)| + 8 ≤ R :=
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      refine ⟨R, hR_pos, ?_⟩
      intro b hb
      have h_proj_s : projSpace (mkSpaceTime b 0) = b := by
        ext i; simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
      have h_proj_t : projTime (mkSpaceTime b 0) = 0 := by
        simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
      let g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun y => v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2
      have hg_cont : Continuous g :=
        (hv_cont.comp h_mk_cont).sub (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm.pow 2).div_const 2)
      have h_strict : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), R < ‖y‖ → g y < g 0 := by
        intro y hy
        have hy_M : M ≤ ‖y‖ := le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hR_ge_M hy)
        have hv_y : v (mkSpaceTime y 1) ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
          le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hM y hy_M)
        have hy_pos : 0 < ‖y‖ := lt_trans hR_pos hy
        have hb_le : ‖b‖ ≤ (1 / 8) * ‖y‖ := by linarith
        have h_inner : inner ℝ y b ≤ (1 / 8) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
          calc inner ℝ y b
            _ ≤ ‖y‖ * ‖b‖ := real_inner_le_norm y b
            _ ≤ ‖y‖ * ((1 / 8) * ‖y‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb_le (le_of_lt hy_pos)
            _ = (1 / 8) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by ring
        have hy_ge_one : 1 ≤ ‖y‖ := by
          have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)| := abs_nonneg _
          linarith
        have hy_sq_gt : 8 * |v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)| + 8 < ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
          calc 8 * |v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)| + 8
            _ < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hR_ge_v0 hy
            _ = 1 * ‖y‖ := by ring
            _ ≤ ‖y‖ * ‖y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy_ge_one (le_of_lt hy_pos)
            _ = ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by ring
        have hv0_ge : -|v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)| ≤ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := neg_abs_le _
        have h_norm_sub : ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ y b + ‖b‖ ^ 2 :=
          norm_sub_sq_real y b
        have h_norm_zero : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) - b‖ ^ 2 = ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [zero_sub, norm_neg]
        dsimp [g]
        rw [h_norm_sub, h_norm_zero]
        linarith
      have hK_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) R) :=
        isCompact_closedBall 0 R
      have h0_mem : (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 R := by
        simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, le_of_lt hR_pos]
      obtain ⟨y_star, hy_star_mem, hy_star_max⟩ :=
        hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn ⟨0, h0_mem⟩ hg_cont.continuousOn
      have hy_star_norm : ‖y_star‖ ≤ R := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hy_star_mem
      have hg0_le : g 0 ≤ g y_star := hy_star_max h0_mem
      have hg_ub : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), g y ≤ g y_star := by
        intro y
        by_cases hy : ‖y‖ ≤ R
        · exact hy_star_max (by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hy)
        · exact le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (h_strict y (lt_of_not_ge hy)) hg0_le)
      have h_env_eq_sSup : quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) = sSup (g '' Set.univ) := by
        unfold quadEnvelopePlus
        congr 1
        ext val
        simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_univ, true_and, h_proj_t, h_proj_s, zero_add, mul_one, g]
      have h_bdd : BddAbove (g '' Set.univ) := by
        refine ⟨g y_star, ?_⟩
        rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
        exact hg_ub y
      have h_le_env : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
          g y ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
        intro y
        rw [h_env_eq_sSup]
        exact le_csSup h_bdd ⟨y, Set.mem_univ y, rfl⟩
      have hy_star_eq : g y_star = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
        rw [h_env_eq_sSup]
        refine le_antisymm (le_csSup h_bdd ⟨y_star, Set.mem_univ y_star, rfl⟩) ?_
        refine csSup_le ⟨g y_star, ⟨y_star, Set.mem_univ y_star, rfl⟩⟩ ?_
        rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
        exact hg_ub y
      refine ⟨h_le_env, ⟨y_star, hy_star_norm, hy_star_eq⟩, ?_⟩
      intro y hy_eq
      by_contra hy_gt
      have h1 : g y < g 0 := h_strict y (lt_of_not_ge hy_gt)
      have h2 : g 0 ≤ g y := by
        calc g 0 ≤ g y_star := hg0_le
          _ = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := hy_star_eq
          _ = g y := hy_eq.symm
      linarith
    have h_le : ∀ (b y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
      intro b y
      obtain ⟨R, _, hR⟩ := h_main ‖b‖ (norm_nonneg b)
      exact (hR b le_rfl).1 y
    have h_conf : ∀ (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B →
        ∃ (R : ℝ), 0 < R ∧
          ∀ (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ‖b‖ ≤ B →
            (∃ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
              ‖y‖ ≤ R ∧
              v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0)) ∧
            (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
              v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) →
              ‖y‖ ≤ R) := by
      intro B hB
      obtain ⟨R, hR_pos, hR⟩ := h_main B hB
      exact ⟨R, hR_pos, fun b hb => ⟨(hR b hb).2.1, (hR b hb).2.2⟩⟩
    let Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
      fun b => quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2
    have h_sq_id : ∀ (b y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 =
          v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y‖ ^ 2 / 2 + inner ℝ b y := by
      intro b y
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_comm]
      ring
    have hΦ_ge : ∀ (b y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y‖ ^ 2 / 2 + inner ℝ b y ≤ Φ b := by
      intro b y
      have h1 := h_le b y
      have h2 := h_sq_id b y
      dsimp [Φ]
      linarith
    have hΦ_lip : ∀ (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B →
        ∃ (R : ℝ), 0 < R ∧
          ∀ (b₁ b₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ‖b₁‖ ≤ B → ‖b₂‖ ≤ B →
            |Φ b₁ - Φ b₂| ≤ R * ‖b₁ - b₂‖ := by
      intro B hB
      obtain ⟨R, hR_pos, hR⟩ := h_conf B hB
      have h_one_side : ∀ (b₁ b₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ‖b₁‖ ≤ B →
          Φ b₁ - Φ b₂ ≤ R * ‖b₁ - b₂‖ := by
        intro b₁ b₂ hb₁
        obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁_norm, hy₁_eq⟩ := (hR b₁ hb₁).1
        have h1 : Φ b₁ = v (mkSpaceTime y₁ 1) - ‖y₁‖ ^ 2 / 2 + inner ℝ b₁ y₁ := by
          dsimp [Φ]
          rw [← hy₁_eq, h_sq_id b₁ y₁]
        have h2 : v (mkSpaceTime y₁ 1) - ‖y₁‖ ^ 2 / 2 + inner ℝ b₂ y₁ ≤ Φ b₂ := hΦ_ge b₂ y₁
        have h_diff : Φ b₁ - Φ b₂ ≤ inner ℝ (b₁ - b₂) y₁ := by
          rw [inner_sub_left]
          linarith
        calc Φ b₁ - Φ b₂
          _ ≤ inner ℝ (b₁ - b₂) y₁ := h_diff
          _ ≤ ‖b₁ - b₂‖ * ‖y₁‖ := real_inner_le_norm (b₁ - b₂) y₁
          _ ≤ ‖b₁ - b₂‖ * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₁_norm (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = R * ‖b₁ - b₂‖ := mul_comm _ _
      refine ⟨R, hR_pos, ?_⟩
      intro b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₂
      rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
      refine ⟨h_one_side b₁ b₂ hb₁, ?_⟩
      simpa [norm_sub_rev] using h_one_side b₂ b₁ hb₂
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ := by
      rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
      intro b₀ ε hε
      obtain ⟨R, hR_pos, hR⟩ := hΦ_lip (‖b₀‖ + 1) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨min 1 (ε / (R + 1)), lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hε (by positivity)), ?_⟩
      intro b₁ hb₁
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at hb₁
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have hb₁_lt_one : ‖b₁ - b₀‖ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hb₁ (min_le_left _ _)
      have hb₁_lt_div : ‖b₁ - b₀‖ < ε / (R + 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le hb₁ (min_le_right _ _)
      have hb₀_norm : ‖b₀‖ ≤ ‖b₀‖ + 1 := by linarith
      have hb₁_norm : ‖b₁‖ ≤ ‖b₀‖ + 1 := by
        have : ‖b₁‖ ≤ ‖b₀‖ + ‖b₁ - b₀‖ := norm_le_insert' b₁ b₀
        linarith
      have h_le_R : |Φ b₁ - Φ b₀| ≤ R * ‖b₁ - b₀‖ := hR b₁ b₀ hb₁_norm hb₀_norm
      have h_R_lt : R * ‖b₁ - b₀‖ < (R + 1) * (ε / (R + 1)) := by
        calc R * ‖b₁ - b₀‖
          _ ≤ (R + 1) * ‖b₁ - b₀‖ := by
              nlinarith [norm_nonneg (b₁ - b₀)]
          _ < (R + 1) * (ε / (R + 1)) :=
              mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hb₁_lt_div (by positivity)
      have h_cancel : (R + 1) * (ε / (R + 1)) = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hB1_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1) :=
      isCompact_closedBall 0 1
    have hB1_ne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1).Nonempty :=
      ⟨0, by simp [Metric.mem_closedBall]⟩
    obtain ⟨y_min, hy_min_mem, hy_min⟩ :=
      hB1_comp.exists_isMinOn hB1_ne (hv_cont.comp h_mk_cont).continuousOn
    let m₁ : ℝ := v (mkSpaceTime y_min 1)
    have h_coercive : ∀ b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), 1 ≤ ‖b‖ → m₁ - 1 / 2 + ‖b‖ ≤ Φ b := by
      intro b hb
      have hb_pos : 0 < ‖b‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hb
      have hb_ne : ‖b‖ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb_pos
      let y_b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (‖b‖⁻¹) • b
      have hy_b_norm : ‖y_b‖ = 1 := by
        dsimp [y_b]
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hb_pos)), inv_mul_cancel₀ hb_ne]
      have hy_b_mem : y_b ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1 := by
        simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, hy_b_norm]
      have hv_ge : m₁ ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y_b 1) := hy_min hy_b_mem
      have h_inner_b : inner ℝ b y_b = ‖b‖ := by
        dsimp [y_b]
        rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
        calc ‖b‖⁻¹ * ‖b‖ ^ 2 = (‖b‖⁻¹ * ‖b‖) * ‖b‖ := by ring
          _ = 1 * ‖b‖ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hb_ne]
          _ = ‖b‖ := one_mul _
      have h_step := hΦ_ge b y_b
      rw [hy_b_norm, h_inner_b] at h_step
      linarith
    let B₀ : ℝ := max 1 (Φ 0 - m₁ + 1)
    have hB₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ B₀ := le_max_left _ _
    have hB₀_ge_val : Φ 0 - m₁ + 1 ≤ B₀ := le_max_right _ _
    have hB₀_pos : 0 < B₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB₀_ge_one
    obtain ⟨b, hb_mem, hb_min_ball⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) B₀).exists_isMinOn
        ⟨0, by simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, le_of_lt hB₀_pos]⟩ hΦ_cont.continuousOn
    have hb_le_zero : Φ b ≤ Φ 0 :=
      hb_min_ball (by simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, le_of_lt hB₀_pos])
    have hb_global : ∀ b' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Φ b ≤ Φ b' := by
      intro b'

    let D : Set ((Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) × (Fin (d + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) :=

              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_le b (y' i)) (le_of_lt (hθ'_pos i))
          _ = (∑ i, θ' i) * quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          _ = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
              rw [hθ'_sum, one_mul]
      dsimp [val_star]
      linarith
    have h_bary_eq : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = val_star := by
      change sSup S_bary = val_star
      exact le_antisymm (csSup_le ⟨val_star, h_mem⟩ h_ub) (le_csSup ⟨val_star, h_ub⟩ h_mem)
    exact ⟨b, h_bary_eq⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb_dual⟩ := hb_dual_ex
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_cont_mk : ∀ (t : ℝ),
      Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => mkSpaceTime y t) := by
    intro t
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp ?_
    rw [continuous_pi_iff]
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
      exact continuous_const
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (continuous_apply i).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous
  let z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
  have hz₀_space : projSpace z₀ = 0 := h_projSpace 0 1
  have hz₀_time : projTime z₀ = 1 := h_projTime 0 1
  have h_bary_mem : ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      f z₀ ∈ { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace z₀) ∧
        val = (∑ i, θ i * f (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) } := by
    intro f
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => 0, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, by simp [hz₀_space], ?_⟩
    simp [hz₀_space, hz₀_time, z₀]
  have h_ub : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v z₀ - v z₀ ≤ κ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have h_le : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v z₀ ≤ v z₀ + κ ^ 2 / 2 := by
      apply csSup_le ⟨v z₀, h_bary_mem v⟩
      rintro val ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
      let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
      have hx_eq : x = projSpace z₀ := hy_mean
      have hx_zero : x = 0 := hy_mean.trans hz₀_space
      let S_var : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2
      let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt S_var
      have hS_nonneg : 0 ≤ S_var := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro i _
        exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
      have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = S_var := Real.sq_sqrt hS_nonneg
      have h_jen := hv_jensen (projTime z₀) N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
      change (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) -
        v (mkSpaceTime x (projTime z₀)) ≤ κ * r at h_jen
      have h_mk_x : mkSpaceTime x (projTime z₀) = z₀ := by
        rw [hx_zero, hz₀_time]
      rw [h_mk_x] at h_jen
      have h_var_eq : (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) = r ^ 2 := by
        rw [← hx_eq, hr_sq]
      rw [h_var_eq]
      have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (r - κ)
      linarith
    linarith
  let zb : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime b 0
  have hzb_space : projSpace zb = b := h_projSpace b 0
  have hzb_time : projTime zb = 0 := h_projTime b 0
  obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM⟩ := h_subquad_all (1 / 4) (by norm_num)
  let R_star : ℝ := max (max M (8 * ‖b‖)) 1
  have hR_ge_M : M ≤ R_star := le_trans (le_max_left M (8 * ‖b‖)) (le_max_left _ 1)
  have hR_ge_b : 8 * ‖b‖ ≤ R_star := le_trans (le_max_right M (8 * ‖b‖)) (le_max_left _ 1)
  have hR_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ R_star := le_max_right _ 1
  have hR_pos : 0 < R_star := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hR_ge_one
  have h_tail : ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      R_star ≤ ‖y‖ → |w (mkSpaceTime y 1)| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 →
      w (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ - ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    intro w y hy_R hw_growth
    have hw_le : w (mkSpaceTime y 1) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
      le_trans (le_abs_self _) hw_growth
    have h_norm_sub : ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ y b + ‖b‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_sub_sq_real y b
    have h_inner : inner ℝ y b ≤ ‖y‖ * ‖b‖ :=
      le_trans (le_abs_self _) (abs_real_inner_le_norm y b)
    have hy_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
    have h_yb : 8 * (‖y‖ * ‖b‖) ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h8b : 8 * ‖b‖ ≤ ‖y‖ := le_trans hR_ge_b hy_R
      nlinarith
    have hy_sq : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg ‖y‖
    linarith
  let g_v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun y =>
    v (mkSpaceTime y (projTime zb + 1)) - ‖y - projSpace zb‖ ^ 2 / (2 * 1)
  have hg_v_eq : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      g_v y = v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    intro y
    dsimp [g_v]
    rw [hzb_time, zero_add, hzb_space]
    ring
  have hg_v_cont : Continuous g_v := by
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ ?_
    · exact hv_class.1.comp (h_cont_mk (projTime zb + 1))
    · exact ((continuous_norm.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).pow 2).div_const (2 * 1)
  have h_bdd_v : BddAbove (g_v '' Set.univ) := by
    obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀⟩ :=
      (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) R_star).bddAbove_image
        hg_v_cont.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max U₀ (- ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2), ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
    rcases le_or_gt ‖y‖ R_star with hy_le | hy_gt
    · have hy_mem : y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) R_star := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hy_le
      exact le_trans (hU₀ ⟨y, hy_mem, rfl⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hy_R : R_star ≤ ‖y‖ := le_of_lt hy_gt
      have hy_M : M ≤ ‖y‖ := le_trans hR_ge_M hy_R
      have h_est := h_tail v y hy_R (hM v hv_class hv_cent y hy_M)
      rw [← hg_v_eq y] at h_est
      exact le_trans h_est (le_max_right _ _)
  have hv_le_quad : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb := by
    intro y
    rw [← hg_v_eq y]
    exact le_csSup h_bdd_v ⟨y, Set.mem_univ y, rfl⟩
  have h_quad_lb : - ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb := by
    simpa [hv_cent.1, neg_div] using hv_le_quad 0
  have h_lb_dual : κ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    have hε2 : 0 < ε / 2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_conv R_star hR_pos (ε / 2) hε2
    let m : ℕ := N₀
    have hm_N₀ : N₀ ≤ m := le_rfl
    have hw_pt : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        w_seq m (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2 := by
      intro y
      rcases le_or_gt ‖y‖ R_star with hy_le | hy_gt
      · have h_diff := hN₀ m hm_N₀ (mkSpaceTime y 1)
          (by simpa [h_projSpace] using hy_le)
          (by rw [h_projTime, abs_of_pos zero_lt_one]; exact hR_ge_one)
        have hw_le_v : w_seq m (mkSpaceTime y 1) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y 1) + ε / 2 := by
          linarith [(abs_sub_le_iff.mp h_diff).1]
        have hv_y := hv_le_quad y
        linarith
      · have hy_R : R_star ≤ ‖y‖ := le_of_lt hy_gt
        have hy_M : M ≤ ‖y‖ := le_trans hR_ge_M hy_R
        have h_est := h_tail (w_seq m) y hy_R
          (hM (w_seq m) (hw_seq m).1 (hw_seq m).2.1 y hy_M)
        linarith
    have hw_bary_le : barycentricEnvelope d 1 (w_seq m) z₀ ≤
        quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 + ε / 2 := by
      apply csSup_le ⟨w_seq m z₀, h_bary_mem (w_seq m)⟩
      rintro val ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
      have hy_zero : ∑ i, θ i • y i = 0 := hy_mean.trans hz₀_space
      have h_var_shift : (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2) =
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_sub_sq : ∀ i : Fin N,
            θ i * ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 =
              θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (θ i • y i) b + θ i * ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
          intro i
          rw [hz₀_space, sub_zero, norm_sub_sq_real (y i) b, real_inner_smul_left]
          ring
        simp_rw [h_sub_sq, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
          ← sum_inner, hy_zero, inner_zero_left, mul_zero, sub_zero, ← Finset.sum_mul,
          hθ_sum, one_mul]
      have h_sum_pt : (∑ i, θ i * (w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)) ≤
          quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2 := by
        calc ∑ i, θ i * (w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)
          _ ≤ ∑ i, θ i * (quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2) := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro i _
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hw_pt (y i)) (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i))
          _ = (∑ i, θ i) * (quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2) := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          _ = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2 := by
              rw [hθ_sum, one_mul]
      have h_lhs_id : (∑ i, θ i * (w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)) =
          (∑ i, θ i * w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2) / 2 := by
        rw [hz₀_time, Finset.sum_div]
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        congr 1 with i
        ring
      linarith
    have hw_gap := (hw_seq m).2.2.2
    have hw_zero : w_seq m z₀ = 0 := (hw_seq m).2.1.1
    linarith
  have hv_zero : v z₀ = 0 := hv_cent.1
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_class : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v) :
    ∃ (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < t →
        IsOptimizingStepTriple d κ ε v x t (Q_plus x t ε) (Q_minus x t ε) (Q_zero x t ε) ∧
        (driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Q_plus x t ε) (t + ε)) +
          driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (x - ε • Q_minus x t ε) (t - ε))) / 2 -
          driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≥
            (1 / (16 * (1 + Real.log 2))) *
              (‖Q_plus x t ε - Q_zero x t ε‖ ^ 2 + ‖Q_minus x t ε - Q_zero x t ε‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ (R T : ℝ), 2 ≤ R → 2 ≤ T →
        ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧
          ∀ (ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
            0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → ‖x‖ ≤ R → ε < t → t ≤ T →
            ‖ε • Q_plus x t ε‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖ε • Q_minus x t ε‖ ≤ 1)

signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_class : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v) :
    ∃ (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < t →
        IsOptimizingStepTriple d κ ε v x t (Q_plus x t ε) (Q_minus x t ε) (Q_zero x t ε) ∧
        (driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Q_plus x t ε) (t + ε)) +
          driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (x - ε • Q_minus x t ε) (t - ε))) / 2 -
          driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≥
            (1 / (16 * (1 + Real.log 2))) *
              (‖Q_plus x t ε - Q_zero x t ε‖ ^ 2 + ‖Q_minus x t ε - Q_zero x t ε‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ (R T : ℝ), 2 ≤ R → 2 ≤ T →
        ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧
          ∀ (ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
            0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → ‖x‖ ≤ R → ε < t → t ≤ T →
            ‖ε • Q_plus x t ε‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖ε • Q_minus x t ε‖ ≤ 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  have _hv0 : v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = 0 := hv_cent.1
  have hC₁_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C₁ := by linarith
  have h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ η : ℝ), 0 < η →
      ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + η * ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
    subquadratic_growth_of_inLimitingClassA d C₁ hC₁_nonneg v hv_class
  obtain ⟨h_comp, Q_plus, Q_minus, Q_zero, hQ_opt, hQ_step⟩ :=
    existence_of_optimizing_step_triple_and_small_steps d κ hκ v hv_class.1 hv_jensen h_growth
  refine ⟨Q_plus, Q_minus, Q_zero, ?_, hQ_step⟩
  intro x t ε hε ht
  have h_opt := hQ_opt x t ε hε ht
  refine ⟨h_opt, ?_⟩
  let W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
  let Qp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := Q_plus x t ε
  let Qm : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := Q_minus x t ε
  let Q0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := Q_zero x t ε
  let z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime x t
  let z_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Qp) (t + ε)
  let z_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime (x - ε • Qm) (t - ε)
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by linarith
  have ht_plus_pos : 0 < t + ε := by linarith
  have ht_minus_pos : 0 < t - ε := by linarith
  have h2ε_pos : 0 < 2 * ε := by linarith
  have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have h1log2_pos : 0 < 1 + Real.log 2 := by linarith
  let c₀ : ℝ := ε / (2 * (1 + Real.log 2))
  have hc₀_pos : 0 < c₀ := div_pos hε (by linarith)
  let b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := c₀ • (Q0 - Qp)
  let d_shift : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := c₀ • (Q0 - Qm)
  have hQ0_eq : W (mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Q0) (t + ε)) - (ε / 2) * ‖Q0‖ ^ 2 =
      quadEnvelopePlus d ε W z := h_opt.1
  have hQp_eq : W (mkSpaceTime (x + (2 * ε) • Qp) (t + 2 * ε)) - ε * ‖Qp‖ ^ 2 =
      quadEnvelopePlus d (2 * ε) W z := h_opt.2.1
  have hQm_eq : v (mkSpaceTime (x - (2 * ε) • Qm) (t - 2 * ε)) + ε * ‖Qm‖ ^ 2 =
      quadEnvelopeMinus d (2 * ε) v z := h_opt.2.2
  
  have h_comp1_raw := (h_comp (x + ε • Qp) (x + (2 * ε) • Qp) (t + ε) ε ht_plus_pos hε).1
  have h_time1 : (t + ε) + ε = t + 2 * ε := by ring
  have h_diff1 : (x + (2 * ε) • Qp) - (x + ε • Qp) = ε • Qp := by
    rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← sub_smul]
    ring_nf
  have h_norm1 : ‖(x + (2 * ε) • Qp) - (x + ε • Qp)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) = (ε / 2) * ‖Qp‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_diff1, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε, mul_pow]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
  have h_ineq1 : quadEnvelopePlus d (2 * ε) W z + (ε / 2) * ‖Qp‖ ^ 2 ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d ε W z_plus := by
    rw [h_time1, h_norm1] at h_comp1_raw
    linarith [hQp_eq, h_comp1_raw]
  
  have h_comp2_raw := (h_comp (x - ε • Qm) (x + d_shift) (t - ε) ε ht_minus_pos hε).1
  have h_time2 : (t - ε) + ε = t := by ring
  have h_diff2 : (x + d_shift) - (x - ε • Qm) = d_shift + ε • Qm := by abel
  have h_norm2 : ‖(x + d_shift) - (x - ε • Qm)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) =
      ‖d_shift‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) + inner ℝ Qm d_shift + (ε / 2) * ‖Qm‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_diff2, norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul ε Qm, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε, mul_pow,
      real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm d_shift Qm]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
  have h_ineq2 : W (mkSpaceTime (x + d_shift) t) - inner ℝ Qm d_shift -
      ‖d_shift‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) - (ε / 2) * ‖Qm‖ ^ 2 ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d ε W z_minus := by
    rw [h_time2, h_norm2] at h_comp2_raw
    linarith [h_comp2_raw]
  
  have h_comp3_raw := (h_comp (x + ε • Qp) x (t + ε) ε ht_plus_pos hε).2
  have h_time3 : (t + ε) - ε = t := by ring
  have h_diff3 : x - (x + ε • Qp) = -(ε • Qp) := by abel
  have h_norm3 : ‖x - (x + ε • Qp)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) = (ε / 2) * ‖Qp‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_diff3, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε, mul_pow]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
  have h_ineq3 : quadEnvelopeMinus d ε v z_plus ≤ v z + (ε / 2) * ‖Qp‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_time3, h_norm3] at h_comp3_raw
    exact h_comp3_raw
  
  have h_comp4_raw := (h_comp (x - ε • Qm) (x - (2 * ε) • Qm) (t - ε) ε ht_minus_pos hε).2
  have h_time4 : (t - ε) - ε = t - 2 * ε := by ring
  have h_diff4 : (x - (2 * ε) • Qm) - (x - ε • Qm) = -(ε • Qm) := by
    rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_left, ← sub_smul]
    have h_sc : ε - 2 * ε = -ε := by ring
    rw [h_sc, neg_smul]
  have h_norm4 : ‖(x - (2 * ε) • Qm) - (x - ε • Qm)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) = (ε / 2) * ‖Qm‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_diff4, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε, mul_pow]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
  have h_ineq4 : quadEnvelopeMinus d ε v z_minus ≤
      quadEnvelopeMinus d (2 * ε) v z - (ε / 2) * ‖Qm‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_time4, h_norm4] at h_comp4_raw
    linarith [hQm_eq, h_comp4_raw]
  
  have hQp_eq' : W (mkSpaceTime (x + (2 * ε) • Qp) (t + 2 * ε)) - (2 * ε / 2) * ‖Qp‖ ^ 2 =
      quadEnvelopePlus d (2 * ε) W z := by
    have h_two : (2 * ε / 2) * ‖Qp‖ ^ 2 = ε * ‖Qp‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h_two]

stopped_walk_prelimit_localization.definitions:
noncomputable def psiPotential (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * s ^ 2 * (Real.log s) ^ 2 - 6 * s ^ 2 * Real.log s + 8 * s ^ 2

def HasPsiPotentialBounds : Prop :=
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ psiPotential s) ∧
  (∀ s T : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ T → psiPotential s ≤ psiPotential T) ∧
  (∀ s ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → 4 * ε ≤ s →
    ε ^ 2 * ((Real.log s) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) ≤
      (psiPotential (s + ε) + psiPotential (s - ε)) / 2 - psiPotential s)

noncomputable def uniformExp (h : ℕ) (f : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, f ω) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h

noncomputable def uniformProb (h : ℕ) (P : (Fin h → Bool) → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact uniformExp h (fun ω => if P ω then 1 else 0)

def flipBit (h n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) (i : Fin h) : Bool :=
  if i.1 = n then !ω i else ω i

def walkStepBit (h : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) (n : ℕ) : Bool :=
  if hn : n < h then ω ⟨n, hn⟩ else true

noncomputable def isWalkActive (d : ℕ) (δ R : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact decide (δ < z.2 ∧ z.2 < 16 ∧ ‖z.1‖ < R)

noncomputable def stoppedWalk (d : ℕ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (ε δ R : ℝ) (h : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ
  | 0 => (0, 1)
  | n + 1 =>
    let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ R h ω n
    if isWalkActive d δ R z then
      if walkStepBit h ω n then
        (z.1 + ε • Q_plus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 + ε)
      else
        (z.1 - ε • Q_minus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 - ε)
    else z

def isGoodReachedWalk (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R L₀ D₀ : ℝ) (ε_walk : ℕ → ℝ) (h_walk : ℕ → ℕ)
    (N : ℕ) (ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) : Prop :=
  let ε := ε_walk N
  let h := h_walk N
  let δ_N := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N
  let z_term := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω h
  z_term.2 = δ_N ∧
  ‖z_term.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
  L₀ ≤ driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime z_term.1 δ_N) ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N →
    let δ_j := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
    let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h
    z_mk.2 = δ_j ∧
    ‖z_mk.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
    L₀ - D₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime z_mk.1 δ_j)

def HasPredictableTravelBound (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : ℕ) (ε' S_max M_vel C_vel B₀ : ℝ)
    (y : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (s : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ)
    (act : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → Bool)
    (q_plus q_minus q_zero : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
    0 < ε' → 2 ≤ S_max → 0 ≤ M_vel → 0 ≤ C_vel → 0 ≤ B₀ →
    (∀ ω, y 0 ω = 0 ∧ s 0 ω = 1) →
    (∀ k n, k ≤ n → n < h → ∀ ω,
      y k (flipBit h n ω) = y k ω ∧
      s k (flipBit h n ω) = s k ω ∧
      act k (flipBit h n ω) = act k ω ∧
      q_zero k (flipBit h n ω) = q_zero k ω) →
    (∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      (act n ω = true →
        y (n + 1) ω = (if walkStepBit h ω n then y n ω + ε' • q_plus n ω else y n ω - ε' • q_minus n ω) ∧
        s (n + 1) ω = (if walkStepBit h ω n then s n ω + ε' else s n ω - ε') ∧
        4 * ε' ≤ s n ω ∧
        ‖q_zero n ω‖ ≤ M_vel + C_vel * |Real.log (s n ω)|) ∧
      (act n ω = false → y (n + 1) ω = y n ω ∧ s (n + 1) ω = s n ω)) →
    (∀ ω, 0 < s h ω ∧ s h ω ≤ S_max) →
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (‖q_plus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 + ‖q_minus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2) else 0) ≤ B₀ →
    uniformExp h (fun ω => s h ω) = 1 ∧
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 else 0) ≤ 2 * psiPotential S_max ∧
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ‖y h ω‖) ≤
      Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * (2 * (M_vel + C_vel) + Real.sqrt (2 * B₀))

def HasOriginalWalkBounds (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R L₀ D₀ B₀ : ℝ) (m_walk h_walk : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  let ε_walk : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m_walk N)
  16 ≤ R ∧ 0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < B₀ ∧

noncomputable def psiPotential (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * s ^ 2 * (Real.log s) ^ 2 - 6 * s ^ 2 * Real.log s + 8 * s ^ 2

def HasPsiPotentialBounds : Prop :=
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ psiPotential s) ∧
  (∀ s T : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ T → psiPotential s ≤ psiPotential T) ∧
  (∀ s ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → 4 * ε ≤ s →
    ε ^ 2 * ((Real.log s) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) ≤
      (psiPotential (s + ε) + psiPotential (s - ε)) / 2 - psiPotential s)

noncomputable def uniformExp (h : ℕ) (f : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, f ω) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h

noncomputable def uniformProb (h : ℕ) (P : (Fin h → Bool) → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact uniformExp h (fun ω => if P ω then 1 else 0)

def flipBit (h n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) (i : Fin h) : Bool :=
  if i.1 = n then !ω i else ω i

def walkStepBit (h : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) (n : ℕ) : Bool :=
  if hn : n < h then ω ⟨n, hn⟩ else true

noncomputable def isWalkActive (d : ℕ) (δ R : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact decide (δ < z.2 ∧ z.2 < 16 ∧ ‖z.1‖ < R)

noncomputable def stoppedWalk (d : ℕ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (ε δ R : ℝ) (h : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ
  | 0 => (0, 1)
  | n + 1 =>
    let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ R h ω n
    if isWalkActive d δ R z then
      if walkStepBit h ω n then
        (z.1 + ε • Q_plus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 + ε)
      else
        (z.1 - ε • Q_minus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 - ε)
    else z

def isGoodReachedWalk (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R L₀ D₀ : ℝ) (ε_walk : ℕ → ℝ) (h_walk : ℕ → ℕ)
    (N : ℕ) (ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) : Prop :=
  let ε := ε_walk N
  let h := h_walk N
  let δ_N := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N
  let z_term := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω h
  z_term.2 = δ_N ∧
  ‖z_term.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
  L₀ ≤ driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime z_term.1 δ_N) ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N →
    let δ_j := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
    let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h
    z_mk.2 = δ_j ∧
    ‖z_mk.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
    L₀ - D₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime z_mk.1 δ_j)

def HasPredictableTravelBound (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : ℕ) (ε' S_max M_vel C_vel B₀ : ℝ)
    (y : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (s : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ)
    (act : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → Bool)
    (q_plus q_minus q_zero : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
    0 < ε' → 2 ≤ S_max → 0 ≤ M_vel → 0 ≤ C_vel → 0 ≤ B₀ →
    (∀ ω, y 0 ω = 0 ∧ s 0 ω = 1) →
    (∀ k n, k ≤ n → n < h → ∀ ω,
      y k (flipBit h n ω) = y k ω ∧
      s k (flipBit h n ω) = s k ω ∧
      act k (flipBit h n ω) = act k ω ∧
      q_zero k (flipBit h n ω) = q_zero k ω) →
    (∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      (act n ω = true →
        y (n + 1) ω = (if walkStepBit h ω n then y n ω + ε' • q_plus n ω else y n ω - ε' • q_minus n ω) ∧
        s (n + 1) ω = (if walkStepBit h ω n then s n ω + ε' else s n ω - ε') ∧
        4 * ε' ≤ s n ω ∧
        ‖q_zero n ω‖ ≤ M_vel + C_vel * |Real.log (s n ω)|) ∧
      (act n ω = false → y (n + 1) ω = y n ω ∧ s (n + 1) ω = s n ω)) →
    (∀ ω, 0 < s h ω ∧ s h ω ≤ S_max) →
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (‖q_plus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 + ‖q_minus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2) else 0) ≤ B₀ →
    uniformExp h (fun ω => s h ω) = 1 ∧
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 else 0) ≤ 2 * psiPotential S_max ∧
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ‖y h ω‖) ≤
      Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * (2 * (M_vel + C_vel) + Real.sqrt (2 * B₀))

def HasOriginalWalkBounds (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R L₀ D₀ B₀ : ℝ) (m_walk h_walk : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  let ε_walk : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m_walk N)
  16 ≤ R ∧ 0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < B₀ ∧
  ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
    N + 2 ≤ m_walk N ∧
    0 < ε_walk N ∧ ε_walk N ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) / 4 ∧
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      ‖x‖ ≤ R → ε_walk N < t → t ≤ 16 →
      ‖(ε_walk N) • Q_plus x t (ε_walk N)‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      ‖(ε_walk N) • Q_minus x t (ε_walk N)‖ ≤ 1) ∧
    uniformProb (h_walk N)
      (isGoodReachedWalk d κ v Q_plus Q_minus R L₀ D₀ ε_walk h_walk N) ≥ 5 / 8 ∧
    uniformExp (h_walk N) (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (h_walk N),
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus (ε_walk N) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R (h_walk N) ω n
      if isWalkActive d ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R z then
        (‖Q_plus z.1 z.2 (ε_walk N) - Q_zero z.1 z.2 (ε_walk N)‖ ^ 2 +
         ‖Q_minus z.1 z.2 (ε_walk N) - Q_zero z.1 z.2 (ε_walk N)‖ ^ 2)
      else 0) ≤ B₀

  · 
    have h_two_fit : ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        |inner ℝ h n| ≤ H → ‖h - (inner ℝ h n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H →
        |inner ℝ h n'| ≤ H' → ‖h - (inner ℝ h n') • n'‖ ≤ θ * H' →
        |inner ℝ (P - P') h| ≤ 3 * θ ^ 2 * H := by
      intro h hn_ax hn_tr hn'_ax hn'_tr
      have hb1 : |U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P h| ≤ θ ^ 2 * H := by
        apply hfit.2 h hn_ax
        rwa [hsqrt_θ]
      have hb2 : |U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P' h| ≤ θ ^ 2 * H' := by
        apply hfit'.2 h hn'_ax
        rwa [hsqrt_θ]
      have h_id : inner ℝ (P - P') h =
          (U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P' h) - (U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P h) := by
        rw [inner_sub_left]; ring
      have h_abs : |inner ℝ (P - P') h| ≤
          |U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P' h| + |U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P h| := by
        rw [h_id]
        simpa using abs_sub (U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P' h) (U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P h)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg θ]
    have h_ball : ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖h‖ ≤ θ * H →
        |inner ℝ (P - P') h| ≤ (3 * θ) * (θ * H) := by
      intro h hh
      have hn_ax : |inner ℝ h n| ≤ H := by
        have := h_inner_u n hn_norm h
        nlinarith
      have hn_tr : ‖h - (inner ℝ h n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H :=
        (h_proj_le_norm n hn_norm h).trans hh
      have hn'_ax : |inner ℝ h n'| ≤ H' := by
        have := h_inner_u n' hn'_norm h
        nlinarith
      have hn'_tr : ‖h - (inner ℝ h n') • n'‖ ≤ θ * H' := by
        have := (h_proj_le_norm n' hn'_norm h).trans hh
        nlinarith
      have := h_two_fit h hn_ax hn_tr hn'_ax hn'_tr
      linarith
    have hPP'_le3 : ‖P - P'‖ ≤ 3 * θ :=
      h_ball_to_norm (θ * H) (3 * θ) (mul_pos hθ_pos hH_pos) (by linarith) h_ball
    have hPP'_le12 : ‖P - P'‖ ≤ 12 * θ := by linarith
    have hnn'_le12 : ‖n - n'‖ ≤ 12 * θ := by linarith
    let c : ℝ := H / 24
    have hc_pos : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; linarith
    let h₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := c • n'
    have hh₂_norm : ‖h₂‖ = c := by
      dsimp [h₂]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc_pos, hn'_norm, mul_one]
    have hh₂_in_n' : inner ℝ h₂ n' = c := by
      dsimp [h₂]
      rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm, hn'_norm, mul_one, mul_one]
    have hh₂_n'_ax : |inner ℝ h₂ n'| ≤ H' := by
      rw [hh₂_in_n', abs_of_pos hc_pos]
      dsimp [c]; linarith
    have hh₂_n'_tr : ‖h₂ - (inner ℝ h₂ n') • n'‖ ≤ θ * H' := by
      rw [hh₂_in_n']
      dsimp [h₂]
      rw [sub_self, norm_zero]
      nlinarith
    have hh₂_n_ax : |inner ℝ h₂ n| ≤ H := by
      have := h_inner_u n hn_norm h₂
      rw [hh₂_norm] at this
      dsimp [c] at this; linarith
    have hh₂_n_tr : ‖h₂ - (inner ℝ h₂ n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H := by
      have h_p := h_proj_u n hn_norm h₂ c
      have h_sub : h₂ - c • n = c • (n' - n) := by dsimp [h₂]; rw [smul_sub]
      have h_nm : ‖h₂ - c • n‖ = c * ‖n - n'‖ := by
        rw [h_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc_pos, norm_sub_rev]
      dsimp [c] at h_p h_nm ⊢
      nlinarith
    have h_eval2 := h_two_fit h₂ hh₂_n_ax hh₂_n_tr hh₂_n'_ax hh₂_n'_tr
    have h_in2 : |inner ℝ (P - P') h₂| = c * |inner ℝ (P - P') n'| := by
      dsimp [h₂]
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc_pos]
    have h_ax_bound : |inner ℝ (P - P') n'| ≤ 288 * θ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_in2] at h_eval2
      dsimp [c] at h_eval2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg θ]
    exact h_finish hPP'_le12 h_ax_bound
  · 
    let dz : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z' - z
    have hdz_fit : |U z' - U z - inner ℝ P dz| ≤ θ ^ 2 * H := by
      have h_z_add : z + dz = z' := add_sub_cancel z z'
      have hb := hfit.2 dz (by linarith) (by rw [hsqrt_θ]; nlinarith)
      rwa [h_z_add] at hb
    have h_three_fit : ∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        |inner ℝ (dz + k) n| ≤ H → ‖(dz + k) - (inner ℝ (dz + k) n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H →
        |inner ℝ k n'| ≤ H → ‖k - (inner ℝ k n') • n'‖ ≤ θ * H →
        |inner ℝ (P - P') k| ≤ 3 * θ ^ 2 * H := by
      intro k hn_ax hn_tr hn'_ax hn'_tr
      have hb1 : |U (z + (dz + k)) - U z - inner ℝ P (dz + k)| ≤ θ ^ 2 * H := by
        apply hfit.2 (dz + k) hn_ax
        rwa [hsqrt_θ]
      have hb2 : |U (z' + k) - U z' - inner ℝ P' k| ≤ θ ^ 2 * H := by
        apply hfit'.2 k hn'_ax
        rwa [hsqrt_θ]
      have h_zk : z + (dz + k) = z' + k := by
        dsimp [dz]; abel
      rw [h_zk] at hb1
      have h_id : inner ℝ (P - P') k =
          (U (z' + k) - U z' - inner ℝ P' k) -
          (U (z' + k) - U z - inner ℝ P (dz + k)) +
          (U z' - U z - inner ℝ P dz) := by
        rw [inner_sub_left, inner_add_right]
        ring
      have h_abs1 : |(U (z' + k) - U z' - inner ℝ P' k) - (U (z' + k) - U z - inner ℝ P (dz + k))| ≤
          |U (z' + k) - U z' - inner ℝ P' k| + |U (z' + k) - U z - inner ℝ P (dz + k)| := by
        simpa using abs_sub (U (z' + k) - U z' - inner ℝ P' k) (U (z' + k) - U z - inner ℝ P (dz + k))
      have h_abs2 : |inner ℝ (P - P') k| ≤
          |(U (z' + k) - U z' - inner ℝ P' k) - (U (z' + k) - U z - inner ℝ P (dz + k))| +
          |U z' - U z - inner ℝ P dz| := by
        rw [h_id]
        exact abs_add_le _ _
      linarith
    have h_tr_add : ∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        ‖(dz + k) - (inner ℝ (dz + k) n) • n‖ ≤
        ‖dz - (inner ℝ dz n) • n‖ + ‖k - (inner ℝ k n) • n‖ := by
      intro k
      have h_eq : (dz + k) - (inner ℝ (dz + k) n) • n =
          (dz - (inner ℝ dz n) • n) + (k - (inner ℝ k n) • n) := by
        rw [inner_add_left, add_smul]
        abel
      rw [h_eq]
      exact norm_add_le _ _
    have h_ball : ∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖k‖ ≤ θ * H / 4 →
        |inner ℝ (P - P') k| ≤ (12 * θ) * (θ * H / 4) := by
      intro k hk
      have hk_n_ax : |inner ℝ k n| ≤ θ * H / 4 := (h_inner_u n hn_norm k).trans hk
      have hn_ax : |inner ℝ (dz + k) n| ≤ H := by
        have h_add : |inner ℝ (dz + k) n| ≤ |inner ℝ dz n| + |inner ℝ k n| := by
          rw [inner_add_left]; exact abs_add_le _ _
        nlinarith
      have hn_tr : ‖(dz + k) - (inner ℝ (dz + k) n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H := by
        have h1 := h_tr_add k
        have h2 := (h_proj_le_norm n hn_norm k).trans hk
        nlinarith
      have hn'_ax : |inner ℝ k n'| ≤ H := by
        have := (h_inner_u n' hn'_norm k).trans hk
        nlinarith
      have hn'_tr : ‖k - (inner ℝ k n') • n'‖ ≤ θ * H := by
        have := (h_proj_le_norm n' hn'_norm k).trans hk
        nlinarith
      have := h_three_fit k hn_ax hn_tr hn'_ax hn'_tr
      linarith
    have hPP'_le12 : ‖P - P'‖ ≤ 12 * θ :=
      h_ball_to_norm (θ * H / 4) (12 * θ) (by nlinarith) (by linarith) h_ball
    have hnn'_le48 : ‖n - n'‖ ≤ 48 * θ := by linarith
    let c' : ℝ := H / 96
    have hc'_pos : 0 < c' := by dsimp [c']; linarith
    let k₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := c' • n'
    have hk₂_norm : ‖k₂‖ = c' := by
      dsimp [k₂]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc'_pos, hn'_norm, mul_one]
    have hk₂_in_n' : inner ℝ k₂ n' = c' := by
      dsimp [k₂]
      rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm, hn'_norm, mul_one, mul_one]
    have hk₂_n'_ax : |inner ℝ k₂ n'| ≤ H := by
      rw [hk₂_in_n', abs_of_pos hc'_pos]
      dsimp [c']; linarith
    have hk₂_n'_tr : ‖k₂ - (inner ℝ k₂ n') • n'‖ ≤ θ * H := by
      rw [hk₂_in_n']
      dsimp [k₂]
      rw [sub_self, norm_zero]
      nlinarith
    have hk₂_n_ax : |inner ℝ (dz + k₂) n| ≤ H := by
      have h_add : |inner ℝ (dz + k₂) n| ≤ |inner ℝ dz n| + |inner ℝ k₂ n| := by
        rw [inner_add_left]; exact abs_add_le _ _
      have hk₂_ax : |inner ℝ k₂ n| ≤ c' := by
        have := h_inner_u n hn_norm k₂
        rwa [hk₂_norm] at this
      dsimp [c'] at hk₂_ax
      linarith
    have hk₂_n_tr : ‖(dz + k₂) - (inner ℝ (dz + k₂) n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H := by
      have h1 := h_tr_add k₂
      have h_p := h_proj_u n hn_norm k₂ c'
      have h_sub : k₂ - c' • n = c' • (n' - n) := by dsimp [k₂]; rw [smul_sub]
      have h_nm : ‖k₂ - c' • n‖ = c' * ‖n - n'‖ := by
        rw [h_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc'_pos, norm_sub_rev]
      dsimp [c'] at h_p h_nm ⊢
      nlinarith
    have h_eval2 := h_three_fit k₂ hk₂_n_ax hk₂_n_tr hk₂_n'_ax hk₂_n'_tr
    have h_in2 : |inner ℝ (P - P') k₂| = c' * |inner ℝ (P - P') n'| := by
      dsimp [k₂]
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc'_pos]
    have h_ax_bound : |inner ℝ (P - P') n'| ≤ 288 * θ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_in2] at h_eval2
      dsimp [c'] at h_eval2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg θ]
    exact h_finish hPP'_le12 h_ax_bound

(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (hL : HasUniformNormalizedLiftBounds d L)
    (h_comp : HasCylinderFitComparisonBounds d L)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))

    (P_base : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (O_base : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))
    (h_base : IsBaseSlopeAndFrameSeq d L u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq P_base O_base) :
    HasUniformRescaledShearedBoxFits d lam_seq

(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (hL : HasUniformNormalizedLiftBounds d L)
    (h_comp : HasCylinderFitComparisonBounds d L)

    (P_base : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (O_base : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))
    (h_base : IsBaseSlopeAndFrameSeq d L u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq P_base O_base) :

proof.tactics:
by
  intro K S hK_pos hS_pos
  obtain ⟨C_comp, hC_pos, hC_body⟩ := h_comp
  have hC_comp : IsCylinderComparisonConstant d L C_comp := ⟨hC_pos, hC_body⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 1 (4 * K * (2 + 3 * C_comp)))
  have hn_gt1 : (1 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hn_gt
  have hn_gtK : 4 * K * (2 + 3 * C_comp) < (n : ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hn_gt
  let m : ℕ := 2 * n
  let R : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ m
  have hn_pow_nat : n < 2 ^ n := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hn_pow : (n : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by exact_mod_cast hn_pow_nat.le
  have hR_eq : R = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [R, m]
    rw [mul_comm, pow_mul]
  have hn_sq_le_R : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ R := by
    rw [hR_eq]
    nlinarith
  have hm_cast : (m : ℝ) = 2 * (n : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [m]
    push_cast
    ring
  let B₁ : ℝ := ((m : ℝ) + 1) * C_comp
  have hB₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ B₁ := by positivity
  have hR_ge1 : 1 ≤ R := by nlinarith
  have hR_K : 8 * K ≤ R := by nlinarith
  have hR_B₁ : 4 * K * (1 + B₁) ≤ R := by
    have h_factor : 1 + B₁ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (2 + 3 * C_comp) := by
      dsimp [B₁]
      rw [hm_cast]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hn_gt1.le) hC_pos.le]
    have h1 : 4 * K * (1 + B₁) ≤ 4 * K * ((n : ℝ) * (2 + 3 * C_comp)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_factor (by linarith)
    have h2 : 4 * K * ((n : ℝ) * (2 + 3 * C_comp)) = (n : ℝ) * (4 * K * (2 + 3 * C_comp)) := by
      ring
    nlinarith
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
  obtain ⟨k, hk_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (R / S) (S / R))
  have hk_RS : R / S < (k : ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hk_gt
  have hk_SR : S / R < (k : ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hk_gt
  have hk_pow_nat : k < 2 ^ k := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hk_pow : (k : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by exact_mod_cast hk_pow_nat.le
  have hR_le_kS : R ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * S :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hS_pos).mp (hk_RS.le.trans hk_pow)
  have hS_le_kR : S ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * R :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hR_pos).mp (hk_SR.le.trans hk_pow)
  let M : ℝ := 2 + 2 * K + R + S
  have hM : 2 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; linarith
  obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ :=
    admissible_cylinder_fits_of_selected_scales d hd L hL_ge hL u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq h_scales M hM
  let B₂ : ℝ := ((k : ℝ) + 1) * C_comp
  have hB₂_nonneg : 0 ≤ B₂ := by positivity
  let B : ℝ := B₁ + C_comp + B₂
  have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ B := by positivity
  let C_KS : ℝ := 2 * Real.sqrt 32 * (L + 1) * B + 32 * (L + 1) * B ^ 2 + 64 * B
  have hC_KS_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_KS := by positivity
  have h_denom_pos : 0 < (C_KS + 1) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_delta_pos : 0 < (1 / 64 : ℝ) / ((C_KS + 1) ^ 2) := div_pos (by norm_num) h_denom_pos
  obtain ⟨i₂, hi₂⟩ :=
    (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_scales.2.1) ((1 / 64 : ℝ) / ((C_KS + 1) ^ 2)) h_delta_pos
  refine ⟨C_KS, max i₁ i₂, hC_KS_nonneg, ?_⟩
  intro i hi x t hxt
  have hi₁_le : i₁ ≤ i := (le_max_left i₁ i₂).trans hi
  have hi₂_le : i₂ ≤ i := (le_max_right i₁ i₂).trans hi
  obtain ⟨hθ_pos, hθ_lt, hθ_sq, h_adm⟩ := hi₁ i hi₁_le
  let θ : ℝ := Real.sqrt (32 * lam_seq i)
  obtain ⟨_, _, hr_pos, _, hlam_pos, hlam_lt, _, _⟩ := h_scales.1 i
  obtain ⟨hP_base_fit, hP_base_lower, hP_base_upper, hO_eb⟩ := h_base i
  have hP_base_bdd :
      IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (θ ^ 2) (P_base i) := by
    refine ⟨?_, hP_base_lower, hP_base_upper⟩
    dsimp [θ]
    rw [hθ_sq]
    exact hP_base_fit
  have h_zi_dist : ‖z_seq i - z_seq i‖ ≤ M * r_seq i := by
    rw [sub_self, norm_zero]
    positivity
  have hRr_pos : 0 < R * r_seq i := mul_pos hR_pos hr_pos
  have hRr_le_M : R * r_seq i ≤ M * r_seq i :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [M]; linarith) hr_pos.le
  obtain ⟨P_R, hP_R⟩ := h_adm (z_seq i) h_zi_dist (R * r_seq i) hRr_pos hRr_le_M
  have hr_le_M : r_seq i ≤ M * r_seq i := by
    have h1 : 1 * r_seq i ≤ M * r_seq i :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [M]; linarith) hr_pos.le
    linarith
  have hr_le_mRr : r_seq i ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (R * r_seq i) := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * R := by
      change 1 ≤ R * R
      nlinarith
    have h2 : 1 * r_seq i ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * R) * r_seq i :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hr_pos.le
    linarith
  have hRr_le_mr : R * r_seq i ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * r_seq i := le_refl _
  obtain ⟨h_dir_R_rev, h_norm_R_rev⟩ :=
    same_center_multi_scale_cylinder_comparison d hd L C_comp hC_comp
      (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (M * r_seq i) θ hθ_pos hθ_lt (h_adm (z_seq i) h_zi_dist)
      m (r_seq i) (R * r_seq i) hr_pos hRr_pos hr_le_M hRr_le_M hr_le_mRr hRr_le_mr
      (P_base i) P_R hP_base_bdd hP_R
  have h_dir_R : ‖(‖P_R‖⁻¹) • P_R - (‖P_base i‖⁻¹) • P_base i‖ ≤ B₁ * θ := by
    rw [norm_sub_rev]
    exact h_dir_R_rev
  have h_norm_R : |‖P_R‖ - ‖P_base i‖| ≤ B₁ * θ ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact h_norm_R_rev
  obtain ⟨hz_dist_2K, h_displaced⟩ :=
    displaced_box_center_cylinder_comparison d hd L C_comp hC_comp
      (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) ‖P_base i‖ (lam_seq i) K R B₁
      (O_base i) (P_base i) P_R
      hr_pos hlam_pos hlam_lt hK_pos hB₁_nonneg hR_K hR_B₁ hO_eb rfl
      hP_R h_dir_R h_norm_R x t hxt
  let z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    z_seq i + r_seq i • O_base i (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt (lam_seq i) • x) t)
  have hz_dist_M : ‖z - z_seq i‖ ≤ M * r_seq i := by
    have h1 : 2 * K * r_seq i ≤ M * r_seq i :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [M]; linarith) hr_pos.le
    exact hz_dist_2K.trans h1
  obtain ⟨P_zR, hP_zR⟩ := h_adm z hz_dist_M (R * r_seq i) hRr_pos hRr_le_M
  obtain ⟨h_dir_zR, h_norm_zR⟩ := h_displaced P_zR hP_zR
  have hSr_pos : 0 < S * r_seq i := mul_pos hS_pos hr_pos
  have hSr_le_M : S * r_seq i ≤ M * r_seq i :=

def IsCylinderComparisonConstant (d : ℕ) (L C_comp : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < C_comp ∧
  ∀ (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z z' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (H H' θ : ℝ)
    (P P' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
    0 < θ → θ < 1 / 2 →
    1 / 2 ≤ ‖P‖ → ‖P‖ ≤ L + 1 →
    1 / 2 ≤ ‖P'‖ → ‖P'‖ ≤ L + 1 →
    let n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P‖⁻¹) • P
    let n' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P'‖⁻¹) • P'
    ((z' = z ∧ 0 < H ∧ H ≤ H' ∧ H' ≤ 2 * H ∧
      IsCylinderFitAt U z H (θ ^ 2) P ∧ IsCylinderFitAt U z H' (θ ^ 2) P') ∨
     (H' = H ∧ 0 < H ∧ |inner ℝ (z' - z) n| ≤ H / 4 ∧
      ‖(z' - z) - (inner ℝ (z' - z) n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H / 4 ∧
      IsCylinderFitAt U z H (θ ^ 2) P ∧ IsCylinderFitAt U z' H (θ ^ 2) P')) →
    ‖P - P'‖ ≤ C_comp * θ ∧
    ‖n - n'‖ ≤ C_comp * θ ∧

    obtain ⟨⟨p, q⟩, _, σ, hσ_mono, hpq_tendsto⟩ := hK_slope_compact.tendsto_subseq h_mem_slope
    have hp_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => p_m (σ j)) Filter.atTop (nhds p) :=
      (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mp hpq_tendsto |>.1
    have hq_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => q_m (σ j)) Filter.atTop (nhds q) :=
      (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mp hpq_tendsto |>.2
    let μ : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => σ j + n₀
    have hμ_mono : StrictMono μ := fun j₁ j₂ hj => Nat.add_lt_add_right (hσ_mono hj) n₀
    have hνσ_mono : StrictMono (fun j => ν (σ j)) := hk_mono.comp hμ_mono
    have hlam_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => lam_seq (ν (σ j))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      hlam_tendsto.comp hνσ_mono.tendsto_atTop
    have hA_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => 1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
      have h_mul : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j)) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 * q)) :=
        hlam_sub.mul hq_tendsto
      rw [zero_mul] at h_mul
      simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add h_mul
    have hA_inv_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => (1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
      simpa using hA_tendsto.inv₀ one_ne_zero
    have hp_eff_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => (1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹ • p_m (σ j))
        Filter.atTop (nhds p) := by
      simpa using hA_inv_tendsto.smul hp_tendsto
    obtain ⟨j₁, hj₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hp_eff_tendsto 1 zero_lt_one
    let a : ℝ := q + ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2
    refine ⟨p, a, fun h ℓ hℓ hh => ?_⟩
    have hℓ_half : |ℓ| ≤ S / 2 := by dsimp [S]; linarith
    have h_bound_j : ∀ j : ℕ, j₁ ≤ j →
        |v_seq (ν (σ j)) (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v_seq (ν (σ j)) (mkSpaceTime x t) -
          inner ℝ (p_m (σ j)) h - q_m (σ j) * ℓ| ≤ 256 * R := by
      intro j hj
      have h_diff_p : ‖p - (1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹ • p_m (σ j)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [norm_sub_rev, ← dist_eq_norm]
        exact le_of_lt (hj₁ j hj)
      have h_shear_j : ‖h - ((1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹ * ℓ) • p_m (σ j)‖ ≤ S := by
        have h_id : h - ((1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹ * ℓ) • p_m (σ j) =
            (h - ℓ • p) + ℓ • (p - (1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹ • p_m (σ j)) := by
          rw [smul_sub, mul_comm _ ℓ, mul_smul, sub_add_sub_cancel]
        rw [h_id]
        have h_tri := norm_add_le (h - ℓ • p) (ℓ • (p - (1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹ • p_m (σ j)))
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h_tri
        have h_mul : |ℓ| * ‖p - (1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹ • p_m (σ j)‖ ≤ R * 1 := by
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg ℓ, norm_nonneg (p - (1 + lam_seq (ν (σ j)) * q_m (σ j))⁻¹ • p_m (σ j))]
        dsimp [S]
        linarith
      have h_b := hbox_m (σ j) h ℓ hℓ_half h_shear_j
      dsimp [S] at h_b
      linarith
    have hv₁_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => v_seq (ν (σ j)) (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (v (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)))) :=
      (hv_tendsto (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ))).comp hμ_mono.tendsto_atTop
    have hv₀_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => v_seq (ν (σ j)) (mkSpaceTime x t))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (v (mkSpaceTime x t))) :=
      (hv_tendsto (mkSpaceTime x t)).comp hμ_mono.tendsto_atTop
    have h_inner_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => inner ℝ (p_m (σ j)) h)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (inner ℝ p h)) :=
      Filter.Tendsto.inner hp_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds
    have h_qℓ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => q_m (σ j) * ℓ)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (q * ℓ)) :=
      hq_tendsto.mul tendsto_const_nhds
    have h_lhs_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun j => |v_seq (ν (σ j)) (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v_seq (ν (σ j)) (mkSpaceTime x t) -
          inner ℝ (p_m (σ j)) h - q_m (σ j) * ℓ|)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds |v (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p h - q * ℓ|) :=
      (((hv₁_tendsto.sub hv₀_tendsto).sub h_inner_tendsto).sub h_qℓ_tendsto).abs
    have h_lim := le_of_tendsto h_lhs_tendsto (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨j₁, h_bound_j⟩)
    have ha_eq : a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2 = q := by dsimp [a]; ring
    rw [ha_eq]
    exact h_lim
  exact ⟨v, k, hv0, hv_cont, hk_mono, hv_unif, hv_fits⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨_, k, P_seq, O_seq, hk_mono, h_fit, hv_unif⟩ := hv_limit
  let v_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
    fun i => anisotropicRescale (liftFunc (u_seq (k i))) (z_seq (k i)) (r_seq (k i)) ‖P_seq i‖ (lam_seq (k i)) (O_seq i)
  have hlam_k_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => lam_seq (k i)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    h_scales.2.1.comp hk_mono.tendsto_atTop
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀ hv_le_ϕ
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
    let ρ : ℝ := r₀ / 2
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := half_pos hr₀_pos
    have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ ⊆ V :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hr₀_pos)).trans hr₀_sub
    have hw_norm_le : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, ‖w‖ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1 := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_dist : ‖w - z₀‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      have h_tri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖w - z₀‖ + ‖z₀‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (w - z₀) z₀
      linarith
    let ψ₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun w => ϕ w + (1 : ℝ) * ‖w - z₀‖ ^ 4
    obtain ⟨hψ₁_C2, hψ₁_lim⟩ :=
      quartic_perturbation_and_rescaled_jet_limit d hd V hV_open z₀ hz₀ ϕ hϕ_C2 1
    obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ :=
      anisotropic_rescale_domain_and_continuity d hd L hL_ge hL u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq h_scales
        k hk_mono P_seq O_seq z₀ ρ hρ_pos
    have hf₁_cont : ∀ i : ℕ, i₁ ≤ i →
        ContinuousOn (fun w => v_seq i w - ψ₁ w) (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) := by
      intro i hi
      exact (hi₁ i hi).2.sub (hψ₁_C2.continuousOn.mono h_cb_sub)
    have hf₁_unif : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
          ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, |(v_seq i w - ψ₁ w) - (v w - ψ₁ w)| ≤ ε := by
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hv_unif (‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1) ε (by positivity) hε
      refine ⟨i₀, fun i hi w hw => ?_⟩
      have h_eq : (v_seq i w - ψ₁ w) - (v w - ψ₁ w) = v_seq i w - v w := by ring
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hi₀ i hi w (hw_norm_le w hw)
    have hf₁_z₀ : v z₀ - ψ₁ z₀ = 0 := by
      simp [ψ₁, hϕ_z₀]
    have hf₁_margin : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, v w - ψ₁ w ≤ -‖w - z₀‖ ^ 4 := by
      intro w hw
      have h_le : v w ≤ ϕ w := hv_le_ϕ w (h_cb_sub hw)
      dsimp [ψ₁]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨i₂, w_seq, hi₁_le_i₂, hw_tendsto, hw_max⟩ :=
      interior_maximizer_seq_of_quartic_margin d z₀ ρ hρ_pos
        (fun i w => v_seq i w - ψ₁ w) (fun w => v w - ψ₁ w) i₁
        hf₁_cont hf₁_unif hf₁_z₀ hf₁_margin
    have h_jet_nonneg : ∀ i : ℕ, i₂ ≤ i →
        let ξ_i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
          mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ψ₁ (w_seq i)))
            (1 + lam_seq (k i) * projTime (gradient ψ₁ (w_seq i)))
        0 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ₁) (w_seq i) ξ_i ξ_i := by
      intro i hi
      let j := k i
      obtain ⟨hu_j, _, hr_j, _, hlam_j, _⟩ := h_scales.1 j
      have hU_har_j : IsInfinityHarmonicOn (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16)) :=
        (hL (u_seq j) hu_j).1
      have hc_pos : 0 < ‖P_seq i‖ := by linarith [(h_fit i).2.1]
      have hψ₁_W : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ₁ (Metric.ball z₀ ρ) :=
        hψ₁_C2.mono (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans h_cb_sub)
      have h_dom_W : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ ρ,
          z_seq j + r_seq j • O_seq i (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt (lam_seq j) • projSpace w) (projTime w)) ∈
            Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16) :=
        fun w hw => (hi₁ i (hi₁_le_i₂.trans hi)).1 w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw)
      exact (anisotropic_pullback_test_and_infinityLaplacian d hd (liftFunc (u_seq j)) hU_har_j
        (z_seq j) (r_seq j) ‖P_seq i‖ (lam_seq j) hr_j hc_pos hlam_j (O_seq i)
        (Metric.ball z₀ ρ) Metric.isOpen_ball (w_seq i) (hw_max i hi).1 ψ₁ hψ₁_W h_dom_W).1
        (hw_max i hi).2
    exact ge_of_tendsto (hψ₁_lim w_seq (fun i => lam_seq (k i)) hw_tendsto hlam_k_tendsto)
      (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨i₂, h_jet_nonneg⟩)
  · intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀ hϕ_le_v
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
    let ρ : ℝ := r₀ / 2
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := half_pos hr₀_pos
    have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ ⊆ V :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hr₀_pos)).trans hr₀_sub
    have hw_norm_le : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, ‖w‖ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1 := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_dist : ‖w - z₀‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      have h_tri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖w - z₀‖ + ‖z₀‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (w - z₀) z₀
      linarith
    let ψ_neg : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun w => ϕ w + (-1 : ℝ) * ‖w - z₀‖ ^ 4
    obtain ⟨hψ_neg_C2, hψ_neg_lim⟩ :=
      quartic_perturbation_and_rescaled_jet_limit d hd V hV_open z₀ hz₀ ϕ hϕ_C2 (-1)
    obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ :=
      anisotropic_rescale_domain_and_continuity d hd L hL_ge hL u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq h_scales
        k hk_mono P_seq O_seq z₀ ρ hρ_pos
    have hf_neg_cont : ∀ i : ℕ, i₁ ≤ i →
        ContinuousOn (fun w => ψ_neg w - v_seq i w) (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) := by
      intro i hi
      exact (hψ_neg_C2.continuousOn.mono h_cb_sub).sub (hi₁ i hi).2
    have hf_neg_unif : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
          ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, |(ψ_neg w - v_seq i w) - (ψ_neg w - v w)| ≤ ε := by
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hv_unif (‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1) ε (by positivity) hε
      refine ⟨i₀, fun i hi w hw => ?_⟩
      have h_eq : (ψ_neg w - v_seq i w) - (ψ_neg w - v w) = -(v_seq i w - v w) := by ring
      rw [h_eq, abs_neg]
      exact hi₀ i hi w (hw_norm_le w hw)
    have hf_neg_z₀ : ψ_neg z₀ - v z₀ = 0 := by
      simp [ψ_neg, hϕ_z₀]
    have hf_neg_margin : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, ψ_neg w - v w ≤ -‖w - z₀‖ ^ 4 := by
      intro w hw
      have h_le : ϕ w ≤ v w := hϕ_le_v w (h_cb_sub hw)
      dsimp [ψ_neg]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨i₂, w_seq, hi₁_le_i₂, hw_tendsto, hw_max⟩ :=
      interior_maximizer_seq_of_quartic_margin d z₀ ρ hρ_pos
        (fun i w => ψ_neg w - v_seq i w) (fun w => ψ_neg w - v w) i₁
        hf_neg_cont hf_neg_unif hf_neg_z₀ hf_neg_margin
    have h_jet_nonpos : ∀ i : ℕ, i₂ ≤ i →
        let ξ_i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
          mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ψ_neg (w_seq i)))
            (1 + lam_seq (k i) * projTime (gradient ψ_neg (w_seq i)))
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ_neg) (w_seq i) ξ_i ξ_i ≤ 0 := by
      intro i hi
      let j := k i
      obtain ⟨hu_j, _, hr_j, _, hlam_j, _⟩ := h_scales.1 j
      have hU_har_j : IsInfinityHarmonicOn (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16)) :=
        (hL (u_seq j) hu_j).1
      have hc_pos : 0 < ‖P_seq i‖ := by linarith [(h_fit i).2.1]
      have hψ_neg_W : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ_neg (Metric.ball z₀ ρ) :=
        hψ_neg_C2.mono (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans h_cb_sub)
      have h_dom_W : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ ρ,
          z_seq j + r_seq j • O_seq i (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt (lam_seq j) • projSpace w) (projTime w)) ∈
            Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16) :=
        fun w hw => (hi₁ i (hi₁_le_i₂.trans hi)).1 w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw)
      have h_min : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ ρ,
          v_seq i (w_seq i) - ψ_neg (w_seq i) ≤ v_seq i w - ψ_neg w := by
        intro w hw
        have h_le := (hw_max i hi).2 w hw
        linarith
      exact (anisotropic_pullback_test_and_infinityLaplacian d hd (liftFunc (u_seq j)) hU_har_j
        (z_seq j) (r_seq j) ‖P_seq i‖ (lam_seq j) hr_j hc_pos hlam_j (O_seq i)
        (Metric.ball z₀ ρ) Metric.isOpen_ball (w_seq i) (hw_max i hi).1 ψ_neg hψ_neg_W h_dom_W).2
        h_min
    exact le_of_tendsto (hψ_neg_lim w_seq (fun i => lam_seq (k i)) hw_tendsto hlam_k_tendsto)
      (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨i₂, h_jet_nonpos⟩)

subgoal_signatures.name: anisotropic_rescale_domain_and_continuity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (hL : HasUniformNormalizedLiftBounds d L)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_scales : HasSelectedBlowupScales d u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq)
    (k : ℕ → ℕ) (hk_mono : StrictMono k)
    (P_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (O_seq : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))
    (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ i₁ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₁ ≤ i →
      let j := k i
      (∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ,
        z_seq j + r_seq j • O_seq i (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt (lam_seq j) • projSpace w) (projTime w)) ∈
          Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (anisotropicRescale (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (z_seq j) (r_seq j) ‖P_seq i‖ (lam_seq j) (O_seq i))
        (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ)

subgoal_signatures.name: interior_maximizer_seq_of_quartic_margin
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (f_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (i₁ : ℕ)
    (hf_cont : ∀ i : ℕ, i₁ ≤ i → ContinuousOn (f_seq i) (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ))
    (hf_unif : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
        ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, |f_seq i w - f w| ≤ ε)
    (hf_z₀ : f z₀ = 0)
    (hf_margin : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, f w ≤ -‖w - z₀‖ ^ 4) :
    ∃ (i₂ : ℕ) (w_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      i₁ ≤ i₂ ∧
      Filter.Tendsto w_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i₂ ≤ i →
        w_seq i ∈ Metric.ball z₀ ρ ∧
        ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ ρ, f_seq i w ≤ f_seq i (w_seq i))

subgoal_signatures.name: anisotropic_pullback_test_and_infinityLaplacian
subgoal_signatures.statement:

by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))
  have hz_closed : ∀ i : ℕ, z_seq i ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (3 / 4) :=
    fun i => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hz_seq i)
  obtain ⟨z_star, hz_star, ϕ₀, hϕ₀_mono, hz_conv₀⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) (3 / 4)).tendsto_subseq hz_closed
  let K : Set E := Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (27 / 32)
  have hK_sub : K ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E) (7 / 8) :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by norm_num)
  have : CompactSpace K :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) (27 / 32))
  have hL_pos : 0 < L := by linarith
  have h2L_pos : 0 < 2 * L := by linarith
  have hf_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (fun x : K => U_seq (ϕ₀ n) x.1) := by
    intro n
    rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
    intro b ε hε
    refine ⟨ε / (2 * L), div_pos hε h2L_pos, ?_⟩
    intro a hab
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have h_lip := hU_lip (ϕ₀ n) a.1 (hK_sub a.2) b.1 (hK_sub b.2)
    have h_dist : ‖a.1 - b.1‖ < ε / (2 * L) := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact hab
    have h_mul : L * ‖a.1 - b.1‖ < L * (ε / (2 * L)) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_dist hL_pos
    have h_eq : L * (ε / (2 * L)) = ε / 2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hL_pos]
    linarith
  let F : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction K ℝ :=
    fun n => BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact ⟨fun x : K => U_seq (ϕ₀ n) x.1, hf_cont n⟩
  have hF_apply : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : K), F n x = U_seq (ϕ₀ n) x.1 :=
    fun n x => BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact_apply _ _
  let A : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction K ℝ) := Set.range F
  let s : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2
  have hs_compact : IsCompact s := isCompact_Icc
  have hA_mem : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction K ℝ) (x : K), f ∈ A → f x ∈ s := by
    rintro f x ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [hF_apply]
    exact abs_le.mp (hU_bdd (ϕ₀ n) x.1 (hK_sub x.2))
  have hA_equi : Equicontinuous (fun f : A => (f : K → ℝ)) := by
    intro x₀
    rw [Metric.equicontinuousAt_iff]
    intro ε hε
    refine ⟨ε / (2 * L), div_pos hε h2L_pos, ?_⟩
    intro x hx f
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := f.2
    have h_eq_fx₀ : (f : K → ℝ) x₀ = U_seq (ϕ₀ n) x₀.1 := by
      rw [← hn]
      exact hF_apply n x₀
    have h_eq_fx : (f : K → ℝ) x = U_seq (ϕ₀ n) x.1 := by
      rw [← hn]
      exact hF_apply n x
    rw [h_eq_fx₀, h_eq_fx, Real.dist_eq]
    have h_lip := hU_lip (ϕ₀ n) x₀.1 (hK_sub x₀.2) x.1 (hK_sub x.2)
    have h_dist : ‖x₀.1 - x.1‖ < ε / (2 * L) := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev, ← dist_eq_norm]
      exact hx
    have h_mul : L * ‖x₀.1 - x.1‖ < L * (ε / (2 * L)) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_dist hL_pos
    have h_eq : L * (ε / (2 * L)) = ε / 2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hL_pos]
    linarith
  have hA_compact : IsCompact (closure A) :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli s hs_compact A hA_mem hA_equi
  have hF_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, F n ∈ closure A :=
    fun n => subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self n)
  obtain ⟨g₀, _, ϕ₁, hϕ₁_mono, hg₀_conv⟩ := hA_compact.tendsto_subseq hF_mem
  let ϕ : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => ϕ₀ (ϕ₁ m)
  have hϕ_mono : StrictMono ϕ := hϕ₀_mono.comp hϕ₁_mono
  have hz_conv : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => z_seq (ϕ m)) Filter.atTop (nhds z_star) :=
    hz_conv₀.comp hϕ₁_mono.tendsto_atTop
  classical
  let U₀ : E → ℝ := fun z => if hz : z ∈ K then g₀ ⟨z, hz⟩ else 0
  have hU₀_on_K : ∀ (z : E) (hz : z ∈ K), U₀ z = g₀ ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
    intro z hz
    simp [U₀, hz]
  have h_pt_le_dist : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : E) (hz : z ∈ K),
      |U_seq (ϕ m) z - U₀ z| ≤ dist (F (ϕ₁ m)) g₀ := by
    intro m z hz
    rw [hU₀_on_K z hz]
    have hF_val : U_seq (ϕ m) z = F (ϕ₁ m) ⟨z, hz⟩ := (hF_apply (ϕ₁ m) ⟨z, hz⟩).symm
    rw [hF_val, ← Real.dist_eq]
    exact BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_coe_le_dist (⟨z, hz⟩ : K)
  have hU_conv : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m →
        ∀ z ∈ K, |U_seq (ϕ m) z - U₀ z| ≤ ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hg₀_conv ε hε
    refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm z hz => ?_⟩
    exact le_trans (h_pt_le_dist m z hz) (le_of_lt (hm₀ m hm))
  have hU₀_lip : ∀ z₁ ∈ K, ∀ z₂ ∈ K, |U₀ z₁ - U₀ z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hU_conv (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    have h1 : |U₀ z₁ - U_seq (ϕ m₀) z₁| ≤ ε / 2 := by
      rw [abs_sub_comm]
      exact hm₀ m₀ le_rfl z₁ hz₁
    have h2 : |U_seq (ϕ m₀) z₂ - U₀ z₂| ≤ ε / 2 :=
      hm₀ m₀ le_rfl z₂ hz₂
    have h_mid : |U_seq (ϕ m₀) z₁ - U_seq (ϕ m₀) z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ :=
      hU_lip (ϕ m₀) z₁ (hK_sub hz₁) z₂ (hK_sub hz₂)
    have h_tri1 := abs_sub_le (U₀ z₁) (U_seq (ϕ m₀) z₁) (U₀ z₂)
    have h_tri2 := abs_sub_le (U_seq (ϕ m₀) z₁) (U_seq (ϕ m₀) z₂) (U₀ z₂)
    linarith
  exact ⟨U₀, z_star, ϕ, hz_star, hU₀_lip, hϕ_mono, hz_conv, hU_conv⟩
