proof.tactics:
by
  have hU₀_cont : ContinuousOn U₀ (Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32)) := by
    rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
    intro b hb ε hε
    let M : ℝ := max L 1 + 1
    have hM_pos : 0 < M := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max L 1 := le_max_right L 1
      linarith
    refine ⟨ε / M, div_pos hε hM_pos, fun a ha hdist => ?_⟩
    have ha_cl : a ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (27 / 32) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall ha
    have hb_cl : b ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (27 / 32) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hb
    have hlip := hU₀_lip a ha_cl b hb_cl
    have hL_le : L ≤ M := by
      have : L ≤ max L 1 := le_max_left L 1
      linarith
    have h_norm_lt : ‖a - b‖ < ε / M := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hdist
    have h1 : L * ‖a - b‖ ≤ M * ‖a - b‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL_le (norm_nonneg (a - b))
    have h2 : M * ‖a - b‖ < M * (ε / M) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_norm_lt hM_pos
    have h3 : M * (ε / M) = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hM_pos)
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    linarith
  have h_s2 : ∀ (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
      (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (c : ℝ),
      infinityLaplacian (fun y => ψ y + c) z = infinityLaplacian ψ z ∧
      infinityLaplacian (fun y => -ψ y) z = -infinityLaplacian ψ z := by
    intro ψ z c
    constructor
    · have hf : fderiv ℝ (fun y => ψ y + c) = fderiv ℝ ψ := by
        ext y v
        rw [fderiv_add_const]
      have hg : gradient (fun y => ψ y + c) z = gradient ψ z := by
        simp [gradient, hf]
      simp [infinityLaplacian, hf, hg]
    · have hf : fderiv ℝ (fun y => -ψ y) = -fderiv ℝ ψ := by
        ext y v
        change fderiv ℝ (-ψ) y v = (-fderiv ℝ ψ) y v
        rw [fderiv_neg]
        rfl
      have hf2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => -ψ y)) z = -fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z := by
        rw [hf, fderiv_neg]
      have hg : gradient (fun y => -ψ y) z = -gradient ψ z := by
        simp [gradient, hf]
      simp [infinityLaplacian, hf2, hg]
  have h_s3 : ∀ (V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))
      (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
      (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2) V ∧
      ContinuousAt (infinityLaplacian (fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2)) z₀ ∧
      infinityLaplacian (fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2) z₀ = infinityLaplacian ϕ z₀ := by
    intro V z₀ ϕ hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2
    let q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun y => ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2
    let g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun y => (q y) ^ 2
    let ψ₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y + g y
    have hq_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) q := (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).norm_sq ℝ
    have hg_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g := hq_smooth.pow 2
    have hg_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g V := (hg_smooth.of_le (by simp)).contDiffOn
    have hψ₁_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ₁ V := hϕ_c2.add hg_c2
    have h_fderiv_c1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ψ₁) V :=
      hψ₁_c2.fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open (by norm_num)
    have h_fderiv2_cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ₁)) V :=
      h_fderiv_c1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open le_rfl
    have h_fderiv1_cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ ψ₁) V :=
      hψ₁_c2.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open (by norm_num)
    have h_grad_cont : ContinuousOn (gradient ψ₁) V :=
      (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))).symm.continuous.comp_continuousOn
        h_fderiv1_cont
    have h_lap_cont : ContinuousOn (infinityLaplacian ψ₁) V :=
      (h_fderiv2_cont.clm_apply h_grad_cont).clm_apply h_grad_cont
    have h_lap_contAt : ContinuousAt (infinityLaplacian ψ₁) z₀ :=
      h_lap_cont.continuousAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V)
    have hq_diff : Differentiable ℝ q := hq_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
    have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := hg_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
    have hq0 : q z₀ = 0 := by simp [q]
    have hq'_z0 : fderiv ℝ q z₀ = 0 := by
      have h1 := ((hasFDerivAt_id z₀).sub_const z₀).norm_sq
      have h2 := h1.fderiv
      simpa [q] using h2
    have h_mul : g = q * q := by
      ext x
      exact sq (q x)
    have hg_fderiv_eq : fderiv ℝ g = q • fderiv ℝ q + q • fderiv ℝ q := by
      ext y v
      have h_has := ((hq_diff y).hasFDerivAt.mul (hq_diff y).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
      rw [h_mul, h_has]
      rfl
    have hg1 : fderiv ℝ g z₀ = 0 := by
      rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
      simp [hq0]
    have hq'_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ q) :=
      (hq_smooth.of_le (by simp : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞))).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hq'_diff : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ q) := hq'_smooth.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hg2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z₀ = 0 := by
      have h_smul := (hq_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt.smul (hq'_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt
      have h_add := (h_smul.add h_smul).fderiv
      rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
      simpa [hq0, hq'_z0] using h_add
    have hψ₁_fderiv_V : ∀ y ∈ V, fderiv ℝ ψ₁ y = fderiv ℝ ϕ y + fderiv ℝ g y := by
      intro y hy
      have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ y :=
        (hϕ_c2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      exact fderiv_add hϕ_diff (hg_diff y)
    have hψ₁_fderiv_z0 : fderiv ℝ ψ₁ z₀ = fderiv ℝ ϕ z₀ := by
      rw [hψ₁_fderiv_V z₀ hz₀_V, hg1, add_zero]
    have hψ₁_grad_z0 : gradient ψ₁ z₀ = gradient ϕ z₀ := by
      simp [gradient, hψ₁_fderiv_z0]
    have h_ev : fderiv ℝ ψ₁ =ᶠ[nhds z₀] fderiv ℝ ϕ + fderiv ℝ g :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V) (fun y hy => hψ₁_fderiv_V y hy)
    have hϕ'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
      have hϕ'_c1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ :=
        (hϕ_c2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V)).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
      exact hϕ'_c1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hg'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z₀ := by
      have h_smul := (hq_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt.smul (hq'_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt
      rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
      exact (h_smul.add h_smul).differentiableAt
    have hψ₁_fderiv2_z0 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ₁) z₀ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
      rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_add hϕ'_diff_z0 hg'_diff_z0, hg2, add_zero]
    refine ⟨hψ₁_c2, h_lap_contAt, ?_⟩
    change infinityLaplacian ψ₁ z₀ = infinityLaplacian ϕ z₀
    simp [infinityLaplacian, hψ₁_fderiv2_z0, hψ₁_grad_z0]
  have upper_viscosity_of_uniform_limit :
      ∀ (G_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
        (W₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        (∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (G_seq m) (Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16))) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16),
          ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
          ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
            IsOpen V → z ∈ V → V ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
            ϕ z = G_seq m z → (∀ y ∈ V, G_seq m y ≤ ϕ y) → 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ϕ z) →
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
          ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m →
            ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
              |G_seq m z - W₀ z| ≤ ε) →
        ∀ z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
          ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
          ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
            IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → V ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
            ϕ z₀ = W₀ z₀ → (∀ y ∈ V, W₀ y ≤ ϕ y) → 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ϕ z₀ := by
    intro G_seq W₀ hG_cont hG_sub hG_conv z₀ hz₀_ball ϕ V hV_open hz₀_V hV_sub hϕ_c2 h_touch_eq h_touch_le
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open z₀ hz₀_V
    let ρ : ℝ := ρ₀ / 2
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := half_pos hρ₀_pos
    let K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ
    have hK_sub_V : K ⊆ V :=
      subset_trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hρ₀_pos)) hρ₀_sub
    have hK_sub_27 : K ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 (27 / 32) :=
      subset_trans hK_sub_V (subset_trans hV_sub Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
    have hK_sub_15 : K ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16) :=
      subset_trans hK_sub_V (subset_trans hV_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by norm_num)))
    obtain ⟨hψ₁_c2, hψ₁_contAt, hψ₁_eq⟩ := h_s3 V z₀ ϕ hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2
    let ψ₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2
    have h_ex_max : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ ym ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, G_seq m y - ψ₁ y ≤ G_seq m ym - ψ₁ ym := by
      intro m
      have h_cont_m : ContinuousOn (fun y => G_seq m y - ψ₁ y) K :=
        ((hG_cont m).mono hK_sub_15).sub (hψ₁_c2.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_V)
      have hK_nonempty : K.Nonempty := ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le⟩
      obtain ⟨ym, hym_K, hym_max⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall z₀ ρ).exists_isMaxOn hK_nonempty h_cont_m
      exact ⟨ym, hym_K, fun y hy => isMaxOn_iff.mp hym_max y hy⟩
    choose y_seq hy_seq using h_ex_max
    have hy_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto y_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro r hr_pos
      let r' : ℝ := min r ρ
      have hr'_pos : 0 < r' := lt_min hr_pos hρ_pos
      let ε : ℝ := (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4
      have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
      obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hG_conv ε hε_pos
      refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      have hym_K : y_seq m ∈ K := (hy_seq m).1
      have hz₀_K : z₀ ∈ K := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le
      have h_max_z₀ : G_seq m z₀ - ψ₁ z₀ ≤ G_seq m (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m) :=
        (hy_seq m).2 z₀ hz₀_K
      have hG_ym := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm (y_seq m) (hK_sub_27 hym_K))).1
      have hG_z₀ := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm z₀ (hK_sub_27 hz₀_K))).2
      have hW_ym : W₀ (y_seq m) ≤ ϕ (y_seq m) := h_touch_le (y_seq m) (hK_sub_V hym_K)
      have hψ₁_z₀ : ψ₁ z₀ = W₀ z₀ := by simp [ψ₁, h_touch_eq]
      have hψ₁_ym : ψ₁ (y_seq m) = ϕ (y_seq m) + (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 := rfl
      have h_quartic_le : (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ε := by linarith
      have h_lt_r' : ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ < r' := by
        by_contra h_not_lt
        push_neg at h_not_lt
        have h_sq1 : r' ^ 2 ≤ ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hr'_pos.le h_not_lt 2
        have h_sq2 : (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_sq1 2
        have h_pos_r4 : 0 < (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
        dsimp [ε] at h_quartic_le
        linarith
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lt_r' (min_le_left r ρ)
    let W : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := Metric.ball z₀ ρ
    have h_ev_W : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, y_seq m ∈ W :=
      hy_tendsto.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pos))
    have hW_sub_V : W ⊆ V := subset_trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hK_sub_V
    have hW_sub_15 : W ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16) :=
      subset_trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hK_sub_15
    have h_ev_nonneg : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ψ₁ (y_seq m) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_W] with m hym_W
      let ψ_tilde : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
        fun y => ψ₁ y + (G_seq m (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m))
      have hψ_tilde_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ_tilde W :=
        (hψ₁_c2.mono hW_sub_V).add contDiffOn_const
      have hψ_tilde_eq : ψ_tilde (y_seq m) = G_seq m (y_seq m) := by
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]
        ring
      have hψ_tilde_le : ∀ y ∈ W, G_seq m y ≤ ψ_tilde y := by
        intro y hy
        have h_le := (hy_seq m).2 y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]
        linarith
      have h_visc := hG_sub m (y_seq m) (hW_sub_15 hym_W) ψ_tilde W
        Metric.isOpen_ball hym_W hW_sub_15 hψ_tilde_c2 hψ_tilde_eq hψ_tilde_le
      rw [(h_s2 ψ₁ (y_seq m) (G_seq m (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m))).1] at h_visc
      exact h_visc
    have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => infinityLaplacian ψ₁ (y_seq m)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (infinityLaplacian ψ₁ z₀)) :=
      hψ₁_contAt.tendsto.comp hy_tendsto
    have h_z₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ψ₁ z₀ := ge_of_tendsto h_lim h_ev_nonneg
    rwa [hψ₁_eq] at h_z₀_nonneg
  refine ⟨hU₀_cont, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact upper_viscosity_of_uniform_limit F_seq U₀
      (fun m => (hF_har m).1) (fun m => (hF_har m).2.1) hF_conv
  · intro z₀ hz₀_ball ϕ V hV_open hz₀_V hV_sub hϕ_c2 h_touch_eq h_touch_le
    let G_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun m y => -F_seq m y
    let W₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun y => -U₀ y
    have hG_cont : ∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (G_seq m) (Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16)) :=
      fun m => (hF_har m).1.neg
    have hG_sub : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16),
        ∀ ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
        ∀ V' : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          IsOpen V' → z ∈ V' → V' ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V' →
          ψ z = G_seq m z → (∀ y ∈ V', G_seq m y ≤ ψ y) → 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ψ z := by
      intro m z hz ψ V' hV'_open hz_V' hV'_sub hψ_c2 hψ_eq hψ_le
      have h_neg_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => -ψ y) V' := hψ_c2.neg
      have h_neg_eq : (fun y => -ψ y) z = F_seq m z := by
        dsimp [G_seq] at hψ_eq
        linarith
      have h_neg_le : ∀ y ∈ V', (fun y => -ψ y) y ≤ F_seq m y := by
        intro y hy
        have := hψ_le y hy
        dsimp [G_seq] at this
        linarith
      have h_sub := (hF_har m).2.2 z hz (fun y => -ψ y) V'
        hV'_open hz_V' hV'_sub h_neg_c2 h_neg_eq h_neg_le
      rw [(h_s2 ψ z 0).2] at h_sub
      linarith
    have hG_conv : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m →
          ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
            |G_seq m z - W₀ z| ≤ ε := by
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hF_conv ε hε
      refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm z hz => ?_⟩
      have h_eq : G_seq m z - W₀ z = -(F_seq m z - U₀ z) := by
        dsimp [G_seq, W₀]
        ring
      rw [h_eq, abs_neg]
      exact hm₀ m hm z hz
    have h_negϕ_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => -ϕ y) V := hϕ_c2.neg
    have h_negϕ_eq : (fun y => -ϕ y) z₀ = W₀ z₀ := by
      dsimp [W₀]
      linarith
    have h_negϕ_le : ∀ y ∈ V, W₀ y ≤ (fun y => -ϕ y) y := by
      intro y hy
      have := h_touch_le y hy
      dsimp [W₀]
      linarith
    have h_res := upper_viscosity_of_uniform_limit G_seq W₀ hG_cont hG_sub hG_conv
      z₀ hz₀_ball (fun y => -ϕ y) V hV_open hz₀_V hV_sub h_negϕ_c2 h_negϕ_eq h_negϕ_le
    rw [(h_s2 ϕ z₀ 0).2] at h_res
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (R : ℝ)
    (hU_har : IsInfinityHarmonicOn U (Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16)))
    (hU_lip : ∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8),
      ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8),
        |U z₁ - U z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖)
    (hz_star : z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hR_pos : 0 < R) (hR_le : R ≤ 1 / 16) :
    IsInfinityHarmonicOn (isotropicBlowup U z_star R) (Metric.ball 0 1) ∧
    (∀ X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₁ - isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₂| ≤ L * ‖X₁ - X₂‖)

signature.name: isotropicBlowup_infinityHarmonic_and_lipschitz
signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (R : ℝ)
    (hU_har : IsInfinityHarmonicOn U (Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16)))
    (hU_lip : ∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8),
      ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8),
        |U z₁ - U z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖)
    (hz_star : z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hR_pos : 0 < R) (hR_le : R ≤ 1 / 16) :
    IsInfinityHarmonicOn (isotropicBlowup U z_star R) (Metric.ball 0 1) ∧
    (∀ X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₁ - isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₂| ≤ L * ‖X₁ - X₂‖)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hR_ne : R ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR_pos
  have hz_norm : ‖z_star‖ ≤ 3 / 4 := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hz_star
  have h_maps : ∀ X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      z_star + R • X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8) ∧
      z_star + R • X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16) := by
    intro X hX
    have hX_norm : ‖X‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hX
    have h1 : ‖z_star + R • X‖ ≤ ‖z_star‖ + ‖R • X‖ := norm_add_le z_star (R • X)
    have h2 : ‖R • X‖ = R * ‖X‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR_pos]
    have h3 : R * ‖X‖ < R * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hX_norm hR_pos
    constructor
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
  have h_lip_blowup : ∀ X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₁ - isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₂| ≤ L * ‖X₁ - X₂‖ := by
    intro X₁ hX₁ X₂ hX₂
    have hZ₁ : z_star + R • X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8) :=
      (h_maps X₁ hX₁).1
    have hZ₂ : z_star + R • X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8) :=
      (h_maps X₂ hX₂).1
    have h_diff_eq : isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₁ - isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₂ =
        (U (z_star + R • X₁) - U (z_star + R • X₂)) / R := by
      unfold isotropicBlowup
      ring
    have h_vec_sub : (z_star + R • X₁) - (z_star + R • X₂) = R • (X₁ - X₂) := by
      rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← smul_sub]
    have h_norm_sub : ‖(z_star + R • X₁) - (z_star + R • X₂)‖ = R * ‖X₁ - X₂‖ := by
      rw [h_vec_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR_pos]
    have h_ulip := hU_lip (z_star + R • X₁) hZ₁ (z_star + R • X₂) hZ₂
    rw [h_norm_sub] at h_ulip
    rw [h_diff_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hR_pos, div_le_iff₀ hR_pos]
    linarith
  let S : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    fun Z => R⁻¹ • (Z - z_star)
  have hS_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 2 S :=
    (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).const_smul R⁻¹
  have hS_cont : Continuous S := hS_smooth.continuous
  have hS_fderiv : ∀ Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      HasFDerivAt S (R⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) Z := by
    intro Z
    exact ((hasFDerivAt_id Z).sub_const z_star).const_smul R⁻¹
  have hSZ_inv : ∀ X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), S (z_star + R • X) = X := by
    intro X
    dsimp [S]
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hR_ne, one_smul]
  have hTS_inv : ∀ Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), z_star + R • S Z = Z := by
    intro Z
    dsimp [S]
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hR_ne, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
  have h_pullback : ∀ (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
      (V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) (X₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      IsOpen V → X₀ ∈ V → V ⊆ Metric.ball 0 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
      ϕ X₀ = isotropicBlowup U z_star R X₀ →
      let V_R := S ⁻¹' V
      let Z₀ := z_star + R • X₀
      let Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun Z => U z_star + R * ϕ (S Z)
      IsOpen V_R ∧ Z₀ ∈ V_R ∧ V_R ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Φ V_R ∧ Φ Z₀ = U Z₀ ∧
      infinityLaplacian Φ Z₀ = R⁻¹ * infinityLaplacian ϕ X₀ := by
    intro ϕ V X₀ hV_open hX₀_V hV_sub hϕ_diff hϕ_X₀ V_R Z₀ Φ
    have hVR_open : IsOpen V_R := hV_open.preimage hS_cont
    have hZ₀_mem : Z₀ ∈ V_R := by
      change S Z₀ ∈ V
      rw [hSZ_inv X₀]
      exact hX₀_V
    have hVR_sub : V_R ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16) := by
      intro Z hZ
      have hSZ_ball : S Z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1 := hV_sub hZ
      have h_in := (h_maps (S Z) hSZ_ball).2
      rwa [hTS_inv Z] at h_in
    have hΦ_diff : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Φ V_R := by
      have h_comp : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (ϕ ∘ S) V_R :=
        hϕ_diff.comp hS_smooth.contDiffOn (fun Z hZ => hZ)
      change ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun Z => U z_star + R • (ϕ ∘ S) Z) V_R
      exact contDiffOn_const.add (h_comp.const_smul R)
    have hΦ_Z₀ : Φ Z₀ = U Z₀ := by
      dsimp [Φ, Z₀]
      rw [hSZ_inv X₀, hϕ_X₀]
      unfold isotropicBlowup
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hR_ne, add_sub_cancel]
    have h_fderiv_on : ∀ Z ∈ V_R, fderiv ℝ Φ Z = fderiv ℝ ϕ (S Z) := by
      intro Z hZ
      have h_diff_Z : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ (S Z) :=
        (hϕ_diff.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hZ)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have h_has : HasFDerivAt Φ
          (R • ((fderiv ℝ ϕ (S Z)).comp (R⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))))) Z := by
        change HasFDerivAt (fun W => U z_star + R • (ϕ ∘ S) W) _ Z
        exact ((h_diff_Z.hasFDerivAt.comp Z (hS_fderiv Z)).const_smul R).const_add (U z_star)
      have h_simp : R • ((fderiv ℝ ϕ (S Z)).comp (R⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))) =
          fderiv ℝ ϕ (S Z) := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id, smul_smul,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ hR_ne, one_smul]
      rw [h_simp] at h_has
      exact h_has.fderiv
    have h_grad_Z₀ : gradient Φ Z₀ = gradient ϕ X₀ := by
      unfold gradient
      rw [h_fderiv_on Z₀ hZ₀_mem, hSZ_inv X₀]
    have h_ev : fderiv ℝ Φ =ᶠ[nhds Z₀] (fun Z => fderiv ℝ ϕ (S Z)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVR_open.mem_nhds hZ₀_mem) h_fderiv_on
    have h_fderiv2_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) (S Z₀) := by
      rw [hSZ_inv X₀]
      exact ((hϕ_diff.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hX₀_V)).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt_one
    have h_fderiv2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) Z₀ = R⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) X₀ := by
      rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq]
      have h_has2 : HasFDerivAt (fun Z => fderiv ℝ ϕ (S Z))
          ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) (S Z₀)).comp (R⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))) Z₀ :=
        h_fderiv2_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp Z₀ (hS_fderiv Z₀)
      rw [h_has2.fderiv, hSZ_inv X₀, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id]
    have h_lap : infinityLaplacian Φ Z₀ = R⁻¹ * infinityLaplacian ϕ X₀ := by
      unfold infinityLaplacian
      rw [h_fderiv2, h_grad_Z₀]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact ⟨hVR_open, hZ₀_mem, hVR_sub, hΦ_diff, hΦ_Z₀, h_lap⟩
  rcases hU_har with ⟨hU_cont, hU_sub, hU_sup⟩
  have h_cont_blowup : ContinuousOn (isotropicBlowup U z_star R) (Metric.ball 0 1) := by
    have hT_cont : Continuous (fun X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => z_star + R • X) :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul R)
    have hU_comp : ContinuousOn (fun X => U (z_star + R • X)) (Metric.ball 0 1) :=
      hU_cont.comp hT_cont.continuousOn (fun X hX => (h_maps X hX).2)
    change ContinuousOn (fun X => (U (z_star + R • X) - U z_star) / R) (Metric.ball 0 1)
    exact (hU_comp.sub continuousOn_const).div_const R
  refine ⟨⟨h_cont_blowup, ?_, ?_⟩, h_lip_blowup⟩
  · intro X₀ hX₀ ϕ V hV_open hX₀_V hV_sub hϕ_diff hϕ_X₀ hϕ_ge
    obtain ⟨hVR_open, hZ₀_mem, hVR_sub, hΦ_diff, hΦ_Z₀, h_lap⟩ :=
      h_pullback ϕ V X₀ hV_open hX₀_V hV_sub hϕ_diff hϕ_X₀
    have hΦ_ge : ∀ Z ∈ S ⁻¹' V, U Z ≤ U z_star + R * ϕ (S Z) := by
      intro Z hZ
      have h_ineq := hϕ_ge (S Z) hZ
      unfold isotropicBlowup at h_ineq
      rw [hTS_inv Z, div_le_iff₀ hR_pos] at h_ineq
      linarith
    have h_visc := hU_sub (z_star + R • X₀) ((h_maps X₀ hX₀).2)
      (fun Z => U z_star + R * ϕ (S Z)) (S ⁻¹' V)
      hVR_open hZ₀_mem hVR_sub hΦ_diff hΦ_Z₀ hΦ_ge
    rw [h_lap] at h_visc
    exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_visc (inv_pos.mpr hR_pos)
  · intro X₀ hX₀ ϕ V hV_open hX₀_V hV_sub hϕ_diff hϕ_X₀ hϕ_le
    obtain ⟨hVR_open, hZ₀_mem, hVR_sub, hΦ_diff, hΦ_Z₀, h_lap⟩ :=
      h_pullback ϕ V X₀ hV_open hX₀_V hV_sub hϕ_diff hϕ_X₀
    have hΦ_le : ∀ Z ∈ S ⁻¹' V, U z_star + R * ϕ (S Z) ≤ U Z := by
      intro Z hZ
      have h_ineq := hϕ_le (S Z) hZ
      unfold isotropicBlowup at h_ineq
      rw [hTS_inv Z, le_div_iff₀ hR_pos] at h_ineq
      linarith
    have h_visc := hU_sup (z_star + R • X₀) ((h_maps X₀ hX₀).2)
      (fun Z => U z_star + R * ϕ (S Z)) (S ⁻¹' V)
      hVR_open hZ₀_mem hVR_sub hΦ_diff hΦ_Z₀ hΦ_le
    rw [h_lap] at h_visc
    exact nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right h_visc (inv_pos.mpr hR_pos)

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (U_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (ϕ : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hz_seq : ∀ i : ℕ, z_seq i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hr_seq : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < r_seq i ∧ r_seq i ≤ (1 / (8 * (i + 1 : ℝ))) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖))
    (hz_star : z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hϕ_mono : StrictMono ϕ)
    (hz_conv : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => z_seq (ϕ m)) Filter.atTop (nhds z_star))
    (hU_conv : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m →
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
          |U_seq (ϕ m) z - U₀ z| ≤ ε) :
    ∃ (k₁ : ℕ → ℕ) (R_seq : ℕ → ℝ),
      StrictMono k₁ ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, 0 < R_seq i ∧ R_seq i ≤ 1 / 16) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto R_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => r_seq (k₁ i) / R_seq i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ‖z_seq (k₁ i) - z_star‖ / R_seq i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
        ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
          ∀ X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
            |isotropicBlowup (U_seq (k₁ i)) z_star (R_seq i) X -
              isotropicBlowup U₀ z_star (R_seq i) X| ≤ δ)

    (U_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  let R_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => 1 / (16 * ((i : ℝ) + 1))
  let τ : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => (1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1)) * R_seq i / 2
  have hR_pos : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < R_seq i := by
    intro i
    dsimp [R_seq]
    positivity
  have hτ_pos : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < τ i := by
    intro i
    have hR := hR_pos i
    dsimp [τ]
    positivity
  have hR_le : ∀ i : ℕ, R_seq i ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    intro i
    dsimp [R_seq]
    have hi : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg i
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have hR_bounds : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < R_seq i ∧ R_seq i ≤ 1 / 16 :=
    fun i => ⟨hR_pos i, hR_le i⟩
  have hR_le_inv : ∀ i : ℕ, R_seq i ≤ 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro i
    dsimp [R_seq]
    have hi : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg i
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have h2τ_eq : ∀ i : ℕ, 2 * τ i = (1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1)) * R_seq i := by
    intro i
    dsimp [τ]
    ring
  have hτ_le_inv : ∀ i : ℕ, τ i ≤ (1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1)) * R_seq i := by
    intro i
    have h1 := hτ_pos i
    have h2 := h2τ_eq i
    linarith
  have hr_conv : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => r_seq (ϕ m)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine squeeze_zero (fun m => le_of_lt (hr_seq (ϕ m)).1) (fun m => ?_)
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    have hz_lt : ‖z_seq (ϕ m)‖ < 3 / 4 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz_seq (ϕ m)
    have hz_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖z_seq (ϕ m)‖ := norm_nonneg (z_seq (ϕ m))
    have h_dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ 3 / 4 - ‖z_seq (ϕ m)‖ := by linarith
    have h_dist_le : 3 / 4 - ‖z_seq (ϕ m)‖ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hm_le : (m : ℝ) ≤ (ϕ m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (hϕ_mono.id_le m)
    have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    have h_coeff : 1 / (8 * (ϕ m + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
    calc
      r_seq (ϕ m) ≤ (1 / (8 * (ϕ m + 1 : ℝ))) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq (ϕ m)‖) := (hr_seq (ϕ m)).2
      _ ≤ (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) * 1 := by
        exact mul_le_mul h_coeff h_dist_le h_dist_nonneg (by positivity)
      _ = 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) := mul_one _
  have h_ex_M : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, M ≤ m →
      r_seq (ϕ m) ≤ τ i ∧
      ‖z_seq (ϕ m) - z_star‖ ≤ τ i ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
        |U_seq (ϕ m) z - U₀ z| ≤ τ i) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hr_conv (τ i) (hτ_pos i)
    obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hz_conv (τ i) (hτ_pos i)
    obtain ⟨M₃, hM₃⟩ := hU_conv (τ i) (hτ_pos i)
    refine ⟨max M₁ (max M₂ M₃), fun m hm => ?_⟩
    have hm₁ : M₁ ≤ m := le_trans (le_max_left M₁ (max M₂ M₃)) hm
    have hm₂ : M₂ ≤ m := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left M₂ M₃) (le_max_right M₁ (max M₂ M₃))) hm
    have hm₃ : M₃ ≤ m := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right M₂ M₃) (le_max_right M₁ (max M₂ M₃))) hm
    have hr_m : r_seq (ϕ m) ≤ τ i := by
      have h_dist := hM₁ m hm₁
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (hr_seq (ϕ m)).1] at h_dist
      exact le_of_lt h_dist
    have hz_m : ‖z_seq (ϕ m) - z_star‖ ≤ τ i := by
      have h_dist := hM₂ m hm₂
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h_dist
      exact le_of_lt h_dist
    exact ⟨hr_m, hz_m, hM₃ m hm₃⟩
  choose M hM using h_ex_M
  let ψ : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => Nat.rec (M 0) (fun n prev => max (prev + 1) (M (n + 1))) i
  have hψ_mono : StrictMono ψ := by
    apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
    intro n
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self (ψ n)) (le_max_left (ψ n + 1) (M (n + 1)))
  have hM_le_ψ : ∀ i : ℕ, M i ≤ ψ i := by
    intro i
    rcases i with _ | i
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact le_max_right (ψ i + 1) (M (i + 1))
  let k₁ : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => ϕ (ψ i)
  have hk₁_mono : StrictMono k₁ := hϕ_mono.comp hψ_mono
  have h_step : ∀ i : ℕ,
      r_seq (k₁ i) ≤ τ i ∧
      ‖z_seq (k₁ i) - z_star‖ ≤ τ i ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
        |U_seq (k₁ i) z - U₀ z| ≤ τ i) :=
    fun i => hM i (ψ i) (hM_le_ψ i)
  have hR_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto R_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun i => le_of_lt (hR_pos i)) hR_le_inv
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hr_ratio : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => r_seq (k₁ i) / R_seq i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine squeeze_zero (fun i => div_nonneg (le_of_lt (hr_seq (k₁ i)).1) (le_of_lt (hR_pos i)))
      (fun i => ?_) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (hR_pos i)]
    exact le_trans (h_step i).1 (hτ_le_inv i)
  have hz_ratio : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ‖z_seq (k₁ i) - z_star‖ / R_seq i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine squeeze_zero (fun i => div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (hR_pos i)))
      (fun i => ?_) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (hR_pos i)]
    exact le_trans (h_step i).2.1 (hτ_le_inv i)
  have h_approx : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
        ∀ X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
          |isotropicBlowup (U_seq (k₁ i)) z_star (R_seq i) X -
            isotropicBlowup U₀ z_star (R_seq i) X| ≤ δ := by
    intro δ hδ_pos
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ_pos
    refine ⟨i₀, fun i hi X hX => ?_⟩
    have hz_star_norm : ‖z_star‖ ≤ 3 / 4 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hz_star
    have hz_star_mem : z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    have hX_norm : ‖X‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hX
    have h_shift_mem : z_star + R_seq i • X ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have h_tri : ‖z_star + R_seq i • X‖ ≤ ‖z_star‖ + ‖R_seq i • X‖ := norm_add_le z_star (R_seq i • X)
      have h_smul : ‖R_seq i • X‖ = R_seq i * ‖X‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (hR_pos i))]
      have h_prod : R_seq i * ‖X‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
        calc
          R_seq i * ‖X‖ ≤ R_seq i * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hX_norm) (le_of_lt (hR_pos i))
          _ = R_seq i := mul_one _
          _ ≤ 1 / 16 := hR_le i
      linarith
    have hU_shift : |U_seq (k₁ i) (z_star + R_seq i • X) - U₀ (z_star + R_seq i • X)| ≤ τ i :=
      (h_step i).2.2 (z_star + R_seq i • X) h_shift_mem
    have hU_center : |U_seq (k₁ i) z_star - U₀ z_star| ≤ τ i :=
      (h_step i).2.2 z_star hz_star_mem
    have h_diff_eq : isotropicBlowup (U_seq (k₁ i)) z_star (R_seq i) X -
        isotropicBlowup U₀ z_star (R_seq i) X =
        ((U_seq (k₁ i) (z_star + R_seq i • X) - U₀ (z_star + R_seq i • X)) -
          (U_seq (k₁ i) z_star - U₀ z_star)) / R_seq i := by
      dsimp [isotropicBlowup]
      ring
    have h_blowup_le : |isotropicBlowup (U_seq (k₁ i)) z_star (R_seq i) X -
        isotropicBlowup U₀ z_star (R_seq i) X| ≤ 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by
      rw [h_diff_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos (hR_pos i), div_le_iff₀ (hR_pos i)]
      have h_abs_sub := abs_sub (U_seq (k₁ i) (z_star + R_seq i • X) - U₀ (z_star + R_seq i • X))
        (U_seq (k₁ i) z_star - U₀ z_star)
      have h2 := h2τ_eq i
      linarith
    have hi_le : (i₀ : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hi
    have hi₀_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i₀ : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg i₀
    have h_inv_le : 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((i₀ : ℝ) + 1) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
    linarith
  exact ⟨k₁, R_seq, hk₁_mono, hR_bounds, hR_tendsto, hr_ratio, hz_ratio, h_approx⟩

    HasSphericalConeComparison U₀

signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hU₀_har : IsInfinityHarmonicOn U₀ (Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32))) :
    HasSphericalConeComparison U₀

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hd
  have deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv :
      ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
        {f : E → ℝ} {W : Set E}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : E}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f W → ∀ (ξ : E),
        deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => f (z₀ + t • ξ))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ ξ := by
    intro E _ _ f W hW z₀ hz₀ hf ξ
    have h_pre : IsOpen ((fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W) :=
      hW.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W := by simp [hz₀]
    have h_ev : (fun t : ℝ => deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (z₀ + s • ξ)) t) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        (fun t : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + t • ξ)) ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [h_pre.mem_nhds h0_mem] with t ht
      have hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z₀ + t • ξ) :=
        ((hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds ht)).differentiableAt (by norm_num))
      have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ξ t := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
      exact (hf_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h_line).deriv
    rw [h_ev.deriv_eq]
    have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f z₀ := hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)
    have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ := hcd.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hf2_diff : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀) (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) := by
      simpa using (hcd1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have h_line0 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • ξ) ξ 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
    have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + t • ξ))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ) 0 :=
      hf2_diff.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line0
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ξ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_comp).deriv
  have hasFDerivAt_norm_sub :
      ∀ {z₁ Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))}, Z - z₁ ≠ 0 →
        HasFDerivAt (fun x => ‖x - z₁‖) ((‖Z - z₁‖⁻¹) • innerSL ℝ (Z - z₁)) Z := by
    intro z₁ Z h
    have h_pos : 0 < ‖Z - z₁‖ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr h)
    have h_sq : HasFDerivAt (fun x => ‖x - z₁‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ (Z - z₁)) Z := by
      simpa using (hasFDerivAt_id Z |>.sub_const z₁).norm_sq
    have h_sqrt : HasDerivAt Real.sqrt (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (‖Z - z₁‖ ^ 2))) (‖Z - z₁‖ ^ 2) :=
      Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt h_pos.ne'
    have h_comp := h_sqrt.comp_hasFDerivAt Z h_sq
    have h_eq : (Real.sqrt ∘ fun x => ‖x - z₁‖ ^ 2) = (fun x => ‖x - z₁‖) := by
      ext x; exact Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [h_eq, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h_comp
    convert h_comp using 1
    ext v
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have infinityLaplacian_neg :
      ∀ {ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ} {V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))},
        IsOpen V → ∀ {z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))}, z₀ ∈ V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
        infinityLaplacian (fun y => -ϕ y) z₀ = -infinityLaplacian ϕ z₀ := by
    intro ϕ V hV z₀ hz₀ hϕ_C2
    have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ z₀ :=
      (hϕ_C2.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hgrad_neg : gradient (fun y => -ϕ y) z₀ = -gradient ϕ z₀ := by
      apply HasGradientAt.gradient
      rw [hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt, map_neg]
      exact (hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mp hϕ_diff.hasGradientAt).neg
    set ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := gradient ϕ z₀
    unfold infinityLaplacian
    rw [hgrad_neg, ← deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hV hz₀ hϕ_C2.neg (-ξ)]
    have h_d1 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => -ϕ (z₀ + t • (-ξ))) =
        fun t : ℝ => -deriv (fun s : ℝ => ϕ (z₀ + s • (-ξ))) t := by
      ext t
      exact deriv.neg
    have h_d2 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => -deriv (fun s : ℝ => ϕ (z₀ + s • (-ξ))) t) 0 =
        -deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => ϕ (z₀ + s • (-ξ)))) 0 := deriv.neg
    rw [h_d1, h_d2, deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hV hz₀ hϕ_C2 (-ξ)]
    simp only [map_neg, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, neg_neg, ξ]
  have upper_cone_comp :
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        ContinuousOn w (Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32)) →
        (∀ z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
          ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
          ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
            IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → V ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
            ϕ z₀ = w z₀ → (∀ y ∈ V, w y ≤ ϕ y) → 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ϕ z₀) →
        ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r M : ℝ),
          0 < r → ‖z‖ + r < 27 / 32 → 0 ≤ M →
          (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall z r, w Z - w z ≤ M * r) →
          ∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall z r, w Z - w z ≤ M * ‖Z - z‖ := by
    intro w hw_cont hw_upper z r M hr_pos hzr hM_nonneg h_bd Z₀ hZ₀
    by_contra h_not_le
    set δ₀ : ℝ := w Z₀ - w z - M * ‖Z₀ - z‖
    have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := by dsimp [δ₀]; linarith
    set ε : ℝ := δ₀ / (3 * r)
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε := div_pos hδ₀_pos (by linarith)
    have hε_r : 3 * (ε * r) = δ₀ := by
      dsimp [ε]
      have hr_ne : (3 * r) ≠ 0 := by linarith
      calc 3 * (δ₀ / (3 * r) * r) = (δ₀ / (3 * r)) * (3 * r) := by ring
        _ = δ₀ := div_mul_cancel₀ δ₀ hr_ne
    set M_ε : ℝ := M + 2 * ε
    set γ_ε : ℝ := ε / r
    have hγε_pos : 0 < γ_ε := div_pos hε_pos hr_pos
    have hγε_r : γ_ε * r = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε hr_pos.ne'
    set Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
      fun Z => w z + M_ε * ‖Z - z‖ - γ_ε * ‖Z - z‖ ^ 2
    set K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := Metric.closedBall z r
    have hK_sub : K ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32) := by
      intro Z hZ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hZ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      have h_tri : ‖Z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖Z - z‖ := by simpa using norm_add_le z (Z - z)
      linarith
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K := isCompact_closedBall z r
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ := by dsimp [Φ]; fun_prop
    have h_diff_cont : ContinuousOn (fun Z => w Z - Φ Z) K :=
      (hw_cont.mono hK_sub).sub hΦ_cont.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨Z_star, hZ_star_mem, hZ_star_max⟩ :=
      hK_compact.exists_isMaxOn ⟨Z₀, hZ₀⟩ h_diff_cont
    have hZ₀_norm : ‖Z₀ - z‖ ≤ r := by simpa [K, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hZ₀
    have hZ_star_pos : 0 < w Z_star - Φ Z_star := by
      have h_ge : w Z₀ - Φ Z₀ ≤ w Z_star - Φ Z_star := hZ_star_max hZ₀
      have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ γ_ε * ‖Z₀ - z‖ ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hγε_pos.le (sq_nonneg _)
      have h_2ε : 2 * ε * ‖Z₀ - z‖ ≤ 2 * (ε * r) := by nlinarith
      have h_Φ_Z₀ : w Z₀ - Φ Z₀ = δ₀ - 2 * ε * ‖Z₀ - z‖ + γ_ε * ‖Z₀ - z‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [Φ, M_ε, δ₀]; ring
      linarith
    have hZ_star_ne : Z_star - z ≠ 0 := by
      intro h_eq
      have hZ_eq : Z_star = z := sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq
      subst hZ_eq
      dsimp [Φ] at hZ_star_pos
      simp at hZ_star_pos
    set ρ : ℝ := ‖Z_star - z‖
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hZ_star_ne
    have hρ_le : ρ ≤ r := by simpa [K, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, ρ] using hZ_star_mem
    have hρ_lt : ρ < r := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hρ_le with hlt | heq
      · exact hlt
      · exfalso
        have h_bd_star : w Z_star - w z ≤ M * r := h_bd Z_star hZ_star_mem
        have hΦ_star : Φ Z_star = w z + M * r + ε * r := by
          dsimp [Φ, M_ε]
          change w z + (M + 2 * ε) * ρ - γ_ε * ρ ^ 2 = w z + M * r + ε * r
          rw [heq]
          linear_combination -r * hγε_r
        have h_pos_εr : 0 < ε * r := mul_pos hε_pos hr_pos
        linarith
    set V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := Metric.ball z r \ {z}
    have hV_open : IsOpen V := Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
    have hZ_star_V : Z_star ∈ V := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, ρ] using hρ_lt
      · simp [sub_ne_zero.mp hZ_star_ne]
    have hV_sub_K : V ⊆ K := Set.sdiff_subset.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hV_sub_ball : V ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32) := hV_sub_K.trans hK_sub
    set ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun Z => Φ Z + (w Z_star - Φ Z_star)
    have hϕ_C2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V := by
      intro Z hZ
      have h_ne : Z - z ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hZ.2
      have h_norm_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => ‖x - z‖) Z :=
        ContDiffAt.norm ℝ (contDiffAt_id.sub contDiffAt_const) h_ne
      have hΦ_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 Φ Z := by
        dsimp [Φ]
        exact ((contDiffAt_const.add (contDiffAt_const.mul h_norm_cd)).sub
          (contDiffAt_const.mul (h_norm_cd.pow 2)))
      exact (hΦ_cd.add contDiffAt_const).contDiffWithinAt
    have hϕ_eq : ϕ Z_star = w Z_star := by dsimp [ϕ]; ring
    have hϕ_ge : ∀ Z ∈ V, w Z ≤ ϕ Z := by
      intro Z hZ
      have h_le_max : w Z - Φ Z ≤ w Z_star - Φ Z_star := hZ_star_max (hV_sub_K hZ)
      dsimp [ϕ]
      linarith
    have h_visc : 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ϕ Z_star :=
      hw_upper Z_star (hV_sub_ball hZ_star_V) ϕ V hV_open hZ_star_V hV_sub_ball hϕ_C2 hϕ_eq hϕ_ge
    set s : ℝ := M_ε - 2 * γ_ε * ρ
    have hs_pos : 0 < s := by
      have h_lt : γ_ε * ρ < γ_ε * r := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hρ_lt hγε_pos
      dsimp [s, M_ε]
      linarith
    set e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (ρ⁻¹) • (Z_star - z)
    have he_norm : ‖e‖ = 1 := by
      dsimp [e]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_pos.le), inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne']
    set ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := s • e
    have h_grad : gradient ϕ Z_star = ξ := by
      apply HasGradientAt.gradient
      rw [hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
      have h_f1 := hasFDerivAt_norm_sub hZ_star_ne
      have h_f2 : HasFDerivAt (fun x => ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ (Z_star - z)) Z_star := by
        simpa using (hasFDerivAt_id Z_star |>.sub_const z).norm_sq
      have h_fΦ := (((hasFDerivAt_const (w z) Z_star).add (h_f1.const_mul M_ε)).sub
        (h_f2.const_mul γ_ε)).add (hasFDerivAt_const (w Z_star - Φ Z_star) Z_star)
      convert h_fΦ using 1
      ext v
      simp only [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,
        innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, ξ, e, s, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real]
      have h_ρ : ρ * ρ⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne'
      linear_combination -2 * γ_ε * inner ℝ (Z_star - z) v * h_ρ
    have h_lap_eq : infinityLaplacian ϕ Z_star =
        deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => ϕ (Z_star + t • ξ))) 0 := by
      unfold infinityLaplacian
      rw [h_grad, deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hV_open hZ_star_V hϕ_C2 ξ]
    set q : ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun t => w z + M_ε * (ρ + t * s) - γ_ε * (ρ + t * s) ^ 2 + (w Z_star - Φ Z_star)
    have h_ev_q : (fun t : ℝ => ϕ (Z_star + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] q := by
      have h_open_t : IsOpen { t : ℝ | 0 < ρ + t * s } :=
        isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))
      have h0_t : (0 : ℝ) ∈ { t : ℝ | 0 < ρ + t * s } := by simp [hρ_pos]
      filter_upwards [h_open_t.mem_nhds h0_t] with t ht
      have h_vec : Z_star + t • ξ - z = (ρ + t * s) • e := by
        ext i
        simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ξ, e]
        have h_ρ : ρ * ρ⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne'
        linear_combination -(Z_star i - z i) * h_ρ
      have h_norm_t : ‖Z_star + t • ξ - z‖ = ρ + t * s := by
        rw [h_vec, norm_smul, he_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht)]
      dsimp [ϕ, Φ, q]
      rw [h_norm_t]
    have h_d2_eq : deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => ϕ (Z_star + t • ξ))) 0 = deriv (deriv q) 0 := by
      have h_d1 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => ϕ (Z_star + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] deriv q :=
        h_ev_q.deriv
      exact h_d1.deriv_eq
    have h_q_d1 : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv q t = M_ε * s - 2 * γ_ε * s * (ρ + t * s) := by
      intro t
      have hd : HasDerivAt q (M_ε * s - 2 * γ_ε * s * (ρ + t * s)) t := by
        dsimp [q]
        have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ρ + x * s) s t := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const s |>.const_add ρ
        have h_sq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (ρ + x * s) ^ 2) (2 * (ρ + t * s) * s) t := by
          convert h_lin.pow 2 using 1
          ring
        convert (((hasDerivAt_const t (w z)).add (h_lin.const_mul M_ε)).sub
          (h_sq.const_mul γ_ε)).add (hasDerivAt_const t (w Z_star - Φ Z_star)) using 1
        ring
      exact hd.deriv
    have h_q_d2 : deriv (deriv q) 0 = -2 * γ_ε * s ^ 2 := by
      have h_fun : deriv q = fun t : ℝ => M_ε * s - 2 * γ_ε * s * (ρ + t * s) := by
        ext t; exact h_q_d1 t
      rw [h_fun]
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M_ε * s - 2 * γ_ε * s * (ρ + t * s)) (-2 * γ_ε * s ^ 2) 0 := by
        have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ρ + x * s) s 0 := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).mul_const s |>.const_add ρ
        convert (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (M_ε * s)).sub (h_lin.const_mul (2 * γ_ε * s)) using 1
        ring
      exact hd2.deriv
    rw [h_lap_eq, h_d2_eq, h_q_d2] at h_visc
    have h_neg : 0 < 2 * γ_ε * s ^ 2 := mul_pos (by linarith) (sq_pos_of_pos hs_pos)
    linarith
  intro z r M hr_pos hzr hM_nonneg
  rcases hU₀_har with ⟨hU₀_cont, hU₀_upper, hU₀_lower⟩
  refine ⟨upper_cone_comp U₀ hU₀_cont hU₀_upper z r M hr_pos hzr hM_nonneg, ?_⟩
  intro h_bd_low Z hZ
  have h_neg_upper :
      ∀ z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
        ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
        ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → V ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
          ϕ z₀ = -U₀ z₀ → (∀ y ∈ V, -U₀ y ≤ ϕ y) → 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ϕ z₀ := by
    intro z₀ hz₀ ϕ V hV hz₀_V hV_sub hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀ hϕ_ge
    have hψ_le : infinityLaplacian (fun y => -ϕ y) z₀ ≤ 0 :=
      hU₀_lower z₀ hz₀ (fun y => -ϕ y) V hV hz₀_V hV_sub hϕ_C2.neg (by linarith)
        (fun y hy => by linarith [hϕ_ge y hy])
    rw [infinityLaplacian_neg hV hz₀_V hϕ_C2] at hψ_le
    linarith
  have h_bd_neg : ∀ Z' ∈ Metric.closedBall z r, (-U₀ Z') - (-U₀ z) ≤ M * r := by
    intro Z' hZ'
    linarith [h_bd_low Z' hZ']
  have h_res :=
    upper_cone_comp (fun y => -U₀ y) hU₀_cont.neg h_neg_upper z r M hr_pos hzr hM_nonneg h_bd_neg Z hZ
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (hU₀_cone : HasSphericalConeComparison U₀)
    (hU₀_lip : ∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
      ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
        |U₀ z₁ - U₀ z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖)
    (hz_star : z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4)) :
    ∃ L_star : ℝ, L_star ≤ L ∧ HasCommonInfinitesimalSlope U₀ z_star L_star

(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))

      ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),

    (hz_star : z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4)) :

proof.tactics:
by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))
  have hL_pos : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ L := by linarith
  have hz_norm : ‖z_star‖ ≤ 3 / 4 := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hz_star
  have hz_add_mem : ∀ k : E, ‖k‖ ≤ 1 / 16 → z_star + k ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (27 / 32) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have h_tri : ‖z_star + k‖ ≤ ‖z_star‖ + ‖k‖ := norm_add_le z_star k
    linarith
  have hz_mem_ball : z_star ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (27 / 32) := by
    simpa using hz_add_mem 0 (by simp)
  have hU₀_cont_shift : ∀ r : ℝ, r ≤ 1 / 16 →
      ContinuousOn (fun k : E => U₀ (z_star + k)) (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r) := by
    intro r hr_le
    rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
    intro b hb ε hε
    refine ⟨ε / L, div_pos hε hL_pos, fun a ha hab => ?_⟩
    have ha_norm : ‖a‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      have ha' : ‖a‖ ≤ r := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using ha
      linarith
    have hb_norm : ‖b‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      have hb' : ‖b‖ ≤ r := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hb
      linarith
    have h_lip := hU₀_lip (z_star + a) (hz_add_mem a ha_norm) (z_star + b) (hz_add_mem b hb_norm)
    have h_sub : (z_star + a) - (z_star + b) = a - b := add_sub_add_left_eq_sub a b z_star
    rw [h_sub] at h_lip
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hab
    have h_lt : L * ‖a - b‖ < L * (ε / L) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hab hL_pos
    have h_eq : L * (ε / L) = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hL_pos)
    linarith
  have h_ex_plus : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ h_p : E,
      0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 16 →
        h_p ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r ∧
        ∀ k ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r,
          U₀ (z_star + k) - U₀ z_star ≤ U₀ (z_star + h_p) - U₀ z_star := by
    intro r
    by_cases hr : 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 / 16
    · have h_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r) := isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) r
      have h_ne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r).Nonempty :=
        ⟨0, Metric.mem_closedBall_self (le_of_lt hr.1)⟩
      have h_cont : ContinuousOn (fun k : E => U₀ (z_star + k) - U₀ z_star)
          (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r) :=
        (hU₀_cont_shift r hr.2).sub continuousOn_const
      obtain ⟨h_p, hh_p_mem, hh_p_max⟩ := h_comp.exists_isMaxOn h_ne h_cont
      refine ⟨h_p, fun _ _ => ⟨hh_p_mem, ?_⟩⟩
      exact isMaxOn_iff.mp hh_p_max
    · refine ⟨0, fun hr1 hr2 => False.elim (hr ⟨hr1, hr2⟩)⟩
  have h_ex_minus : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ h_m : E,
      0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 16 →
        h_m ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r ∧
        ∀ k ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r,
          U₀ z_star - U₀ (z_star + k) ≤ U₀ z_star - U₀ (z_star + h_m) := by
    intro r
    by_cases hr : 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 / 16
    · have h_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r) := isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) r
      have h_ne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r).Nonempty :=
        ⟨0, Metric.mem_closedBall_self (le_of_lt hr.1)⟩
      have h_cont : ContinuousOn (fun k : E => U₀ z_star - U₀ (z_star + k))
          (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r) :=
        continuousOn_const.sub (hU₀_cont_shift r hr.2)
      obtain ⟨h_m, hh_m_mem, hh_m_max⟩ := h_comp.exists_isMaxOn h_ne h_cont

    have h1 : L_star_plus ≤ S_plus r := hLp_le_S r hr_pos hr_le16
    have h2 : S_plus r ≤ S_minus R + 2 * L * r / R := h_cross_plus r R hr_pos hr_le_R hR_le32
    linarith
  have hLm_le_Lp : L_star_minus ≤ L_star_plus := by
    apply le_csInf hNe_plus
    rintro _ ⟨R₀, ⟨hR₀_pos, hR₀_le⟩, rfl⟩
    let R : ℝ := min R₀ (1 / 32)
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_min hR₀_pos (by norm_num)
    have hR_le32 : R ≤ 1 / 32 := min_le_right R₀ (1 / 32)
    have hR_le_R₀ : R ≤ R₀ := min_le_left R₀ (1 / 32)
    have hSp_R_le : S_plus R ≤ S_plus R₀ :=
      hS_plus_mono R R₀ hR_pos hR_le_R₀ hR₀_le
    apply le_trans _ hSp_R_le
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε_pos
    let r : ℝ := min R (ε * R / (2 * L))
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min hR_pos (by positivity)
    have hr_le_R : r ≤ R := min_le_left R (ε * R / (2 * L))
    have hr_le16 : r ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith
    have hr_le_eps : r ≤ ε * R / (2 * L) := min_le_right R (ε * R / (2 * L))
    have h_err : 2 * L * r / R ≤ ε := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hR_pos]
      have h_mul : 2 * L * r ≤ 2 * L * (ε * R / (2 * L)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_le_eps (by positivity)
      have h_eq : 2 * L * (ε * R / (2 * L)) = ε * R :=
        mul_div_cancel₀ (ε * R) (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h1 : L_star_minus ≤ S_minus r := hLm_le_S r hr_pos hr_le16
    have h2 : S_minus r ≤ S_plus R + 2 * L * r / R := h_cross_minus r R hr_pos hr_le_R hR_le32
    linarith
  have hL_eq : L_star_plus = L_star_minus := le_antisymm hLp_le_Lm hLm_le_Lp
  refine ⟨L_star_plus, hLp_le_L, hLp_nonneg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r hr_pos hr_le
    refine ⟨⟨h_plus r, (hh_plus r hr_pos hr_le).1, ?_⟩,
            ⟨h_minus r, (hh_minus r hr_pos hr_le).1, ?_⟩⟩
    · have h_le : L_star_plus * r ≤ S_plus r * r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hLp_le_S r hr_pos hr_le) (le_of_lt hr_pos)
      linarith [hS_plus_mul r hr_pos]
    · have h_le : L_star_plus * r ≤ S_minus r * r := by
        rw [hL_eq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hLm_le_S r hr_pos hr_le) (le_of_lt hr_pos)
      linarith [hS_minus_mul r hr_pos]
  · intro ε hε_pos
    have h_lt_p : sInf A_plus < L_star_plus + ε := by
      change L_star_plus < L_star_plus + ε
      linarith
    have h_lt_m : sInf A_minus < L_star_plus + ε := by
      change L_star_minus < L_star_plus + ε
      linarith
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨r₁, ⟨hr₁_pos, hr₁_le⟩, rfl⟩, hr₁_lt⟩ :=
      (csInf_lt_iff hBdd_plus hNe_plus).mp h_lt_p
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨r₂, ⟨hr₂_pos, hr₂_le⟩, rfl⟩, hr₂_lt⟩ :=
      (csInf_lt_iff hBdd_minus hNe_minus).mp h_lt_m
    let ρ₀ : ℝ := min r₁ r₂
    have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos
    have hρ₀_le1 : ρ₀ ≤ r₁ := min_le_left r₁ r₂
    have hρ₀_le2 : ρ₀ ≤ r₂ := min_le_right r₁ r₂
    have hρ₀_le16 : ρ₀ ≤ 1 / 16 := le_trans hρ₀_le1 hr₁_le
    have hSp_ρ₀ : S_plus ρ₀ ≤ L_star_plus + ε :=
      le_trans (hS_plus_mono ρ₀ r₁ hρ₀_pos hρ₀_le1 hr₁_le) (le_of_lt hr₁_lt)
    have hSm_ρ₀ : S_minus ρ₀ ≤ L_star_plus + ε :=
      le_trans (hS_minus_mono ρ₀ r₂ hρ₀_pos hρ₀_le2 hr₂_le) (le_of_lt hr₂_lt)
    refine ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, fun h hh_norm => ?_⟩
    have hh_mem : h ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ₀ := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hh_norm
    have h_up := h_cone_plus ρ₀ hρ₀_pos hρ₀_le16 h hh_mem
    have h_low := h_cone_minus ρ₀ hρ₀_pos hρ₀_le16 h hh_mem
    have h_up' : S_plus ρ₀ * ‖h‖ ≤ (L_star_plus + ε) * ‖h‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSp_ρ₀ (norm_nonneg h)
    have h_low' : S_minus ρ₀ * ‖h‖ ≤ (L_star_plus + ε) * ‖h‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSm_ρ₀ (norm_nonneg h)
    exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (R_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (L_star : ℝ)
    (hU₀_cone : HasSphericalConeComparison U₀)
    (hU₀_lip : ∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
      ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
        |U₀ z₁ - U₀ z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖)
    (hz_star : z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hR_bounds : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < R_seq i ∧ R_seq i ≤ 1 / 16)
    (hR_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto R_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (hL_star : HasCommonInfinitesimalSlope U₀ z_star L_star) :
    ∃ (k₂ : ℕ → ℕ) (V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      StrictMono k₂ ∧
      V 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
        ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
          ∀ X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
            |isotropicBlowup U₀ z_star (R_seq (k₂ i)) X - V X| ≤ δ) ∧
      (∀ X Y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), |V X - V Y| ≤ L_star * ‖X - Y‖) ∧
      (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
        (∃ x_R ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) R, V x_R = L_star * R) ∧
        (∃ y_R ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) R, V y_R = -L_star * R))

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hd
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))
  let V_seq : ℕ → E → ℝ := fun i X => isotropicBlowup U₀ z_star (R_seq i) X
  have hL_pos : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hR_pos : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < R_seq i := fun i => (hR_bounds i).1
  have hz_star_norm : ‖z_star‖ ≤ 3 / 4 := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hz_star
  have hV_seq_zero : ∀ i : ℕ, V_seq i 0 = 0 := by
    intro i
    simp [V_seq, isotropicBlowup]
  have h_eventual_lip : ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M →
      ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, N ≤ i →
        ∀ X ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) M,
          ∀ Y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) M,
            |V_seq i X - V_seq i Y| ≤ L * ‖X - Y‖ := by
    intro M hM
    have hδ_pos : 0 < 3 / (32 * M) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hR_tendsto (3 / (32 * M)) hδ_pos
    refine ⟨N, fun i hi X hX Y hY => ?_⟩
    have hR_lt : R_seq i < 3 / (32 * M) := by
      have h1 := hN i hi
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (hR_pos i)] at h1
      exact h1
    have hRM_lt : R_seq i * M < 3 / 32 := by
      have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hR_lt hM
      have h_eq : 3 / (32 * M) * M = 3 / 32 := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hM]
      linarith
    have h_in_ball : ∀ W ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) M,
        z_star + R_seq i • W ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (27 / 32) := by
      intro W hW
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      have hW_norm : ‖W‖ ≤ M := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hW
      have h_tri : ‖z_star + R_seq i • W‖ ≤ ‖z_star‖ + ‖R_seq i • W‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      have h_smul : ‖R_seq i • W‖ = R_seq i * ‖W‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (hR_pos i))]
      have h_le : R_seq i * ‖W‖ ≤ R_seq i * M :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW_norm (le_of_lt (hR_pos i))
      linarith
    have h_diff : V_seq i X - V_seq i Y =
        (U₀ (z_star + R_seq i • X) - U₀ (z_star + R_seq i • Y)) / R_seq i := by
      dsimp [V_seq, isotropicBlowup]
      ring
    rw [h_diff, abs_div, abs_of_pos (hR_pos i), div_le_iff₀ (hR_pos i)]
    have h_lip := hU₀_lip (z_star + R_seq i • X) (h_in_ball X hX)
      (z_star + R_seq i • Y) (h_in_ball Y hY)
    have h_sub_eq : (z_star + R_seq i • X) - (z_star + R_seq i • Y) = R_seq i • (X - Y) := by
      rw [smul_sub]
      abel
    have h_norm_sub : ‖(z_star + R_seq i • X) - (z_star + R_seq i • Y)‖ = R_seq i * ‖X - Y‖ := by
      rw [h_sub_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (hR_pos i))]
    rw [h_norm_sub] at h_lip
    linarith
  choose N_lip hN_lip using h_eventual_lip
  let N_Y : E → ℕ := fun Y => N_lip (‖Y‖ + 1) (by positivity)
  let B : E → ℝ := fun Y => L * ‖Y‖ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N_Y Y), |V_seq j Y|
  have hV_in_Icc : ∀ (i : ℕ) (Y : E), V_seq i Y ∈ Set.Icc (-B Y) (B Y) := by
    intro i Y
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, ← abs_le]
    by_cases hi : i < N_Y Y
    · have h_mem : i ∈ Finset.range (N_Y Y) := Finset.mem_range.mpr hi
      have h_le_sum : |V_seq i Y| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N_Y Y), |V_seq j Y| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (V_seq j Y)) h_mem
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ L * ‖Y‖ := by positivity
      dsimp [B]
      linarith
    · have hi_ge : N_Y Y ≤ i := not_lt.mp hi
      have hY_mem : Y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (‖Y‖ + 1) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        linarith
      have h0_mem : (0 : E) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (‖Y‖ + 1) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_zero]
        positivity
      have h_lip := hN_lip (‖Y‖ + 1) (by positivity) i hi_ge Y hY_mem 0 h0_mem
      rw [hV_seq_zero i, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h_lip
      have h_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N_Y Y), |V_seq j Y| :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      dsimp [B]
      linarith
  obtain ⟨D, hD_count, hD_dense⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_dense E
  have : Countable D := hD_count.to_subtype
  have : FirstCountableTopology (D → ℝ) :=
    TopologicalSpace.instFirstCountableTopologyForallOfCountable
  have hK_D_compact : IsCompact {g : D → ℝ | ∀ y : D, g y ∈ Set.Icc (-B y.1) (B y.1)} :=
    isCompact_pi_infinite (fun _ : D => isCompact_Icc)
  obtain ⟨g_inf, _, k₂, hk₂, hg_conv⟩ :=
    hK_D_compact.tendsto_subseq (fun i (y : D) => hV_in_Icc i y.1)
  have h_pt_D : ∀ y : D, Filter.Tendsto (fun i => V_seq (k₂ i) y.1) Filter.atTop (nhds (g_inf y)) :=
    tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hg_conv
  have h_unif_cauchy : ∀ (M ε : ℝ), 0 < M → 0 < ε →
      ∃ I₀ : ℕ, ∀ i j : ℕ, I₀ ≤ i → I₀ ≤ j →
        ∀ X ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) M,
          |V_seq (k₂ i) X - V_seq (k₂ j) X| ≤ ε := by
    intro M ε hM hε
    let η : ℝ := ε / (3 * L)
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := by positivity
    have h_net_ex : ∀ x : E, ∃ y : E, y ∈ D ∧ y ∈ Metric.ball x (η / 2) := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨y, hyB, hyD⟩ :=
        hD_dense.inter_open_nonempty (Metric.ball x (η / 2)) Metric.isOpen_ball
          (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (half_pos hη_pos))
      exact ⟨y, hyD, hyB⟩
    choose y_net hy_net_D hy_net_ball using h_net_ex
    have h_nhds : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) M,
        Metric.ball (y_net x) (η / 2) ∈ nhds x := by
      intro x _
      apply Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
      exact Metric.mem_ball.mp (hy_net_ball x)
    obtain ⟨t, ht_sub, ht_cov⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) M).elim_nhds_subcover
        (fun x => Metric.ball (y_net x) (η / 2)) h_nhds
    have h_conv_y : ∀ x : E, ∃ I_x : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, I_x ≤ i →
        |V_seq (k₂ i) (y_net x) - g_inf ⟨y_net x, hy_net_D x⟩| < ε / 6 := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨I_x, hI_x⟩ :=
        Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (h_pt_D ⟨y_net x, hy_net_D x⟩) (ε / 6) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨I_x, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hI_x i hi
    choose I_x hI_x using h_conv_y
    let I₁ : ℕ := t.sup I_x
    let I₀ : ℕ := max I₁ (N_lip (M + η) (by positivity))
    refine ⟨I₀, fun i j hi hj X hX => ?_⟩
    have hX_cov := ht_cov hX
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hX_cov
    obtain ⟨x, hx_t, hX_ball⟩ := hX_cov
    have hx_norm : ‖x‖ ≤ M := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using ht_sub x hx_t
    have hyx_dist : ‖y_net x - x‖ < η / 2 := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact Metric.mem_ball.mp (hy_net_ball x)
    have hXy_dist : ‖X - y_net x‖ < η / 2 := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hX_ball
    have hy_mem : y_net x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (M + η) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have h_tri : ‖y_net x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y_net x - x‖ := norm_le_insert' (y_net x) x
      linarith
    have hX_mem : X ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (M + η) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have hX_norm : ‖X‖ ≤ M := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hX
      linarith
    have h_N_le_ki : N_lip (M + η) (by positivity) ≤ k₂ i :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hi) (hk₂.id_le i)
    have h_N_le_kj : N_lip (M + η) (by positivity) ≤ k₂ j :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hj) (hk₂.id_le j)
    have h_lip_i : |V_seq (k₂ i) X - V_seq (k₂ i) (y_net x)| ≤ ε / 3 := by
      have h1 := hN_lip (M + η) (by positivity) (k₂ i) h_N_le_ki X hX_mem (y_net x) hy_mem
      have h2 : L * ‖X - y_net x‖ ≤ L * η :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt hL_pos)
      have h3 : L * η = ε / 3 := by
        dsimp [η]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hL_pos]
      linarith
    have h_lip_j : |V_seq (k₂ j) (y_net x) - V_seq (k₂ j) X| ≤ ε / 3 := by
      have h1 := hN_lip (M + η) (by positivity) (k₂ j) h_N_le_kj (y_net x) hy_mem X hX_mem
      rw [norm_sub_rev] at h1
      have h2 : L * ‖X - y_net x‖ ≤ L * η :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt hL_pos)
      have h3 : L * η = ε / 3 := by
        dsimp [η]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hL_pos]
      linarith
    have hIx_le_i : I_x x ≤ i := le_trans (Finset.le_sup hx_t) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hi)
    have hIx_le_j : I_x x ≤ j := le_trans (Finset.le_sup hx_t) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hj)
    have h_mid_i := hI_x x i hIx_le_i
    have h_mid_j := hI_x x j hIx_le_j
    have h_mid : |V_seq (k₂ i) (y_net x) - V_seq (k₂ j) (y_net x)| ≤ ε / 3 := by
      have h_tri := abs_sub_le (V_seq (k₂ i) (y_net x)) (g_inf ⟨y_net x, hy_net_D x⟩)
        (V_seq (k₂ j) (y_net x))
      rw [abs_sub_comm (g_inf ⟨y_net x, hy_net_D x⟩)] at h_tri
      linarith
    have h_tri1 := abs_sub_le (V_seq (k₂ i) X) (V_seq (k₂ i) (y_net x)) (V_seq (k₂ j) X)
    have h_tri2 := abs_sub_le (V_seq (k₂ i) (y_net x)) (V_seq (k₂ j) (y_net x)) (V_seq (k₂ j) X)
    linarith
  have h_pt_cauchy : ∀ X : E, CauchySeq (fun i => V_seq (k₂ i) X) := by
    intro X
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀⟩ := h_unif_cauchy (‖X‖ + 1) (ε / 2) (by positivity) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨I₀, fun i hi j hj => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have hX_mem : X ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (‖X‖ + 1) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    have h_le := hI₀ i j hi hj X hX_mem
    linarith
  choose V hV_tendsto using fun X => cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (h_pt_cauchy X)
  have hV0 : V 0 = 0 := by
    have h_zero_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => V_seq (k₂ i) 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simp_rw [hV_seq_zero]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hV_tendsto 0) h_zero_tendsto
  have hV_conv : ∀ (M δ : ℝ), 0 < M → 0 < δ →
      ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
        ∀ X ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) M, |V_seq (k₂ i) X - V X| ≤ δ := by
    intro M δ hM hδ
    obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀⟩ := h_unif_cauchy M δ hM hδ
    refine ⟨I₀, fun i hi X hX => ?_⟩

    intro X Y

    rw [← hL0, hV0, sub_zero, zero_mul] at h1

        have h_sq1 : t ^ 2 - 2 * t * u + u ^ 2 ≤ ‖X - t • e‖ ^ 2 := by

          have h_sq : (t - u) ^ 2 ≤ ‖X - t • e‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith

            rw [hVX, hV_nte]
            ring
          linarith [le_abs_self (V X - V (-(t • e)))]

          have h_sq : (t + u) ^ 2 ≤ ‖X + t • e‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith

    have huv : u = v := by
      by_contra h_ne

        have hw0 := abs_le.mp (hU₁ w hw hw_cent x t (by linarith) (by linarith))
        have h_ev_abs := abs_le.mp h_ev
        have hPR : P₁ * R = 2 * U₁ + C₁ * R := by
          dsimp [P₁]
          have hR_ne : R ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR
          field_simp [hR_ne]
        have h_mul : ‖p‖ * R ≤ P₁ * R := by
          linarith [h_ev_abs.1, hw1.2, hw0.1, hPR]
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_mul hR
    have ha_le : |a| ≤ A₁ := by
      let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := R • p
      have hR_abs : |R| ≤ R := by rw [abs_of_pos hR]
      have hh_ad : ‖h - R • p‖ ≤ R := by simp [h, le_of_lt hR]
      have h_ev := hfit h R hR_abs hh_ad
      have h_ip : inner ℝ p h = R * ‖p‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [h]
        rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      have h_alg :
          w (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + R)) - w (mkSpaceTime x t) -
            inner ℝ p h - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * R =
          w (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + R)) - w (mkSpaceTime x t) -
            (a + ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * R := by
        rw [h_ip]
        ring

      have hh_norm : ‖h‖ ≤ R * P₁ := by
        dsimp [h]
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_le (le_of_lt hR)
      have hxh_norm : ‖x + h‖ ≤ M + R * (1 + P₁) := by
        have := norm_add_le x h
        nlinarith
      have htR_abs : |t + R| ≤ M + R * (1 + P₁) := by
        have h1 := abs_add_le t R
        rw [abs_of_pos hR] at h1
        nlinarith
      have hw1 := abs_le.mp (hU₂ w hw hw_cent (x + h) (t + R) hxh_norm htR_abs)
      have hw0 := abs_le.mp (hU₂ w hw hw_cent x t (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith))
      have h_ev_abs := abs_le.mp h_ev
      have hp_sq : ‖p‖ ^ 2 ≤ P₁ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp_le 2
      have hp_sq_nn : 0 ≤ ‖p‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have hAR : A₁ * R = 2 * U₂ + C₁ * R + (P₁ ^ 2 / 2) * R := by
        dsimp [A₁]
        have hR_ne : R ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR
        field_simp [hR_ne]
      have ha_low : ( -A₁ ) * R ≤ a * R := by
        nlinarith [h_ev_abs.2, hw1.1, hw0.2, hp_sq, hp_sq_nn, hAR]
      have ha_high : a * R ≤ A₁ * R := by
        nlinarith [h_ev_abs.1, hw1.2, hw0.1, hp_sq, hp_sq_nn, hAR]
      rw [abs_le]
      exact ⟨le_of_mul_le_mul_right ha_low hR, le_of_mul_le_mul_right ha_high hR⟩
    exact ⟨le_trans hp_le (le_max_left P₁ A₁), le_trans ha_le (le_max_right P₁ A₁)⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM⟩ := h_growth 1 zero_le_one ε hε
    refine ⟨M, hM_pos, ?_⟩
    intro w hw hw_cent y hy
    exact hM w hw hw_cent y 1 (by norm_num) hy
  · intro x t R hR
    let M : ℝ := max ‖x‖ |t|

    obtain ⟨B_fit, hB_nn, hB⟩ := h_fit_bound M R hM_nn hR
    refine ⟨B_fit, hB_nn, ?_⟩
    intro w hw hw_cent

  · intro K hK
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨U, hU_nn, hU⟩ := h_box_bound K (le_of_lt hK)
      refine ⟨U, hU_nn, ?_⟩
      intro w hw hw_cent z hzx hzt
      rw [← h_mk_proj z]
      exact hU w hw hw_cent (projSpace z) (projTime z) hzx hzt
    · intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀_nn, hB₀⟩ := h_fit_bound K 1 (le_of_lt hK) zero_lt_one
      let D₀ : ℝ := B₀ + 4 * B₁
      have hD₀_pos : 0 < D₀ := by dsimp [D₀]; linarith
      let D₁ : ℝ := C₁ + 2 * D₀ + D₀ ^ 2 / 2
      have hD₁_pos : 0 < D₁ := by dsimp [D₁]; positivity
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_ge ((25 / 7 : ℝ) * (D₁ / ε))
      have hD₁_le_pow : D₁ * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ ε := by
        have h1 := h_ind_3225 k
        have h2 : D₁ / ε ≤ (32 / 25 : ℝ) ^ k := by linarith
        have h3 : D₁ ≤ (32 / 25 : ℝ) ^ k * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp h2
        have h4 : D₁ * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ ((32 / 25 : ℝ) ^ k * ε) * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (by positivity)
        have h_pow_inv : (32 / 25 : ℝ) ^ k * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k = 1 := by
          rw [← mul_pow]
          norm_num
        have h_eq : ((32 / 25 : ℝ) ^ k * ε) * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k = ε := by
          calc ((32 / 25 : ℝ) ^ k * ε) * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k
            _ = ε * ((32 / 25 : ℝ) ^ k * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k) := by ring
            _ = ε * 1 := by rw [h_pow_inv]
            _ = ε := mul_one ε
        linarith
      let P_k : ℝ := B₀ + B₁ * (k : ℝ)

      have hrk_pos : 0 < r_k := by dsimp [r_k]; positivity

      have h_denom_pos : 0 < 2 * (1 + P_k) := by linarith
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := div_pos hrk_pos h_denom_pos
      have hδ_mul : δ * (2 * (1 + P_k)) = r_k := div_mul_cancel₀ r_k (ne_of_gt h_denom_pos)
      have hδ_le_rk : δ ≤ r_k := by nlinarith
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, ?_⟩
      intro w hw hw_cent z₁ z₂ hz₁x hz₁t _hz₂x _hz₂t hz_dist
      let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := projSpace z₁
      let t : ℝ := projTime z₁
      have h_ex_fit : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
          IsFitAt d C₁ w x t ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) p a := by
        intro n
        exact hw.2.2.2 x t ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) (by positivity)
      let p : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun n => Classical.choose (h_ex_fit n)
      let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_ex_fit n))
      have hfit : ∀ n : ℕ, IsFitAt d C₁ w x t ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) (p n) (a n) := by
        intro n
        exact Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_ex_fit n))
      have hpa_n : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖p n‖ ≤ B₀ + B₁ * (n : ℝ) ∧ |a n| ≤ B₀ + B₁ * (n : ℝ) := by
        intro n
        induction' n with n ih
        · have hfit0 : IsFitAt d C₁ w x t 1 (p 0) (a 0) := by
            simpa using hfit 0

            ring

            rw [← h_r_eq]
            exact hfit n
          have h_step := h_two_scale w x t ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) (by positivity)
            (p (n + 1)) (p n) (a (n + 1)) (a n) (hfit (n + 1)) hfit_double

          have hp_tri : ‖p (n + 1)‖ ≤ ‖p n‖ + ‖p n - p (n + 1)‖ := by
            have := norm_sub_le (p n) (p n - p (n + 1))
            simpa using this
          have ha_tri : |a (n + 1)| ≤ |a n| + |a n - a (n + 1)| := by
            have := abs_sub (a n) (a n - a (n + 1))
            simpa using this
          push_cast
          constructor <;> linarith [ih.1, ih.2, h_step.1, ha_step, h3C₁_le_B₁, hp_tri, ha_tri]
      have hpk_le : ‖p k‖ ≤ P_k := (hpa_n k).1
      have hak_le : |a k| ≤ P_k := (hpa_n k).2
      let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := projSpace z₂ - x
      let ℓ : ℝ := projTime z₂ - t
      have h_proj := h_proj_sub z₁ z₂
      have hh_le_δ : ‖h‖ ≤ δ := le_trans h_proj.1 hz_dist
      have hℓ_le_δ : |ℓ| ≤ δ := le_trans h_proj.2 hz_dist
      have hh_le_rk : ‖h‖ ≤ r_k := le_trans hh_le_δ hδ_le_rk
      have hℓ_le_rk : |ℓ| ≤ r_k := le_trans hℓ_le_δ hδ_le_rk
      have hh_shear : ‖h - ℓ • p k‖ ≤ r_k := by
        have h1 : ‖h - ℓ • p k‖ ≤ ‖h‖ + ‖ℓ • p k‖ := norm_sub_le h (ℓ • p k)
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
        have h2 : |ℓ| * ‖p k‖ ≤ δ * P_k :=
          mul_le_mul hℓ_le_δ hpk_le (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hδ_pos)
        nlinarith [h1, h2, hh_le_δ, hδ_mul, hrk_pos]
      have h_fit_k := hfit k h ℓ hℓ_le_rk hh_shear
      have hz₁_eq : mkSpaceTime x t = z₁ := h_mk_proj z₁
      have hz₂_eq : mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ) = z₂ := by
        dsimp [x, t, h, ℓ]
        rw [add_sub_cancel, add_sub_cancel]
        exact h_mk_proj z₂
      rw [hz₁_eq, hz₂_eq] at h_fit_k
      have h_fit_abs := abs_le.mp h_fit_k
      have h_cs : |inner ℝ (p k) h| ≤ P_k * r_k := by
        have h1 : |inner ℝ (p k) h| ≤ ‖p k‖ * ‖h‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm (p k) h
        have h2 : ‖p k‖ * ‖h‖ ≤ P_k * r_k :=
          mul_le_mul hpk_le hh_le_rk (norm_nonneg _) hPk_nn
        exact le_trans h1 h2
      have h_cs_abs := abs_le.mp h_cs
      have h_ak_ell : |a k * ℓ| ≤ P_k * r_k := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul hak_le hℓ_le_rk (abs_nonneg _) hPk_nn
      have h_ak_abs := abs_le.mp h_ak_ell
      have h_pk_sq_ell : |(‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ| ≤ (P_k ^ 2 / 2) * r_k := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
        have hp_sq : ‖p k‖ ^ 2 ≤ P_k ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hpk_le 2
        have h_half : ‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ P_k ^ 2 / 2 := by linarith
        exact mul_le_mul h_half hℓ_le_rk (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have h_pk_abs := abs_le.mp h_pk_sq_ell
      have h_lin_1 : (a k - ‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ = a k * ℓ - (‖p k‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ := by ring
      have h_lin_2 : (C₁ + 2 * P_k + P_k ^ 2 / 2) * r_k =
          C₁ * r_k + P_k * r_k + P_k * r_k + (P_k ^ 2 / 2) * r_k := by ring
      have hw_diff : |w z₁ - w z₂| ≤ (C₁ + 2 * P_k + P_k ^ 2 / 2) * r_k := by
        rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith [h_fit_abs.1, h_fit_abs.2, h_cs_abs.1, h_cs_abs.2,
          h_ak_abs.1, h_ak_abs.2, h_pk_abs.1, h_pk_abs.2, h_lin_1, h_lin_2]
      have h54_ge_1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have hPk_exp : P_k ≤ D₀ * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        dsimp [P_k, D₀]
        have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k := by linarith [h_ind_54 k]
        nlinarith
      have hPk_sq_exp : P_k ^ 2 ≤ D₀ ^ 2 * (25 / 16 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        have h1 : P_k ^ 2 ≤ (D₀ * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hPk_nn hPk_exp 2
        have h2 : (D₀ * (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 = D₀ ^ 2 * (25 / 16 : ℝ) ^ k := by
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm k 2, pow_mul]
          norm_num
        linarith
      have h54_le_2516 : (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (25 / 16 : ℝ) ^ k :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) k
      have h2516_ge_1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (25 / 16 : ℝ) ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have h_coef_exp : C₁ + 2 * P_k + P_k ^ 2 / 2 ≤ D₁ * (25 / 16 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        dsimp [D₁]
        nlinarith
      have h_mod_exp : (C₁ + 2 * P_k + P_k ^ 2 / 2) * r_k ≤ D₁ * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        have h1 : (C₁ + 2 * P_k + P_k ^ 2 / 2) * r_k ≤ (D₁ * (25 / 16 : ℝ) ^ k) * r_k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coef_exp (le_of_lt hrk_pos)
        have h2 : (D₁ * (25 / 16 : ℝ) ^ k) * r_k = D₁ * (25 / 32 : ℝ) ^ k := by
          dsimp [r_k]
          rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
          norm_num
        linarith
      exact le_trans hw_diff (le_trans h_mod_exp hD₁_le_pow)
