proof.tactics:
by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))
  have h_mk_proj : ∀ w : E, mkSpaceTime (projSpace w) (projTime w) = w := by
    intro w
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime]
    · intro k
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace]
  have h_mk_add : ∀ (x h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ),
      mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ) = mkSpaceTime x t + mkSpaceTime h ℓ := by
    intro x h t ℓ
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime]
    · intro k
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
  have h_mk_sub : ∀ (x₁ x₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₁ t₂ : ℝ),
      mkSpaceTime x₁ t₁ - mkSpaceTime x₂ t₂ = mkSpaceTime (x₁ - x₂) (t₁ - t₂) := by
    intro x₁ x₂ t₁ t₂
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime]
    · intro k
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projSpace_sub : ∀ w w' : E, projSpace (w' - w) = projSpace w' - projSpace w := by
    intro w w'
    ext k
    simp [projSpace]
    rfl
  have h_norm_projTime : ∀ w : E, |projTime w| ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    simpa [projTime, Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le w (Fin.last d)
  have h_norm_projSpace : ∀ w : E, ‖projSpace w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖projSpace w i‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖w (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp [projSpace]
    rw [h_eq]
    have h_last : 0 ≤ ‖w (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  have h_norm_mk : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      ‖mkSpaceTime x t‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + |t| := by
    intro x t
    have h_split : mkSpaceTime x t = mkSpaceTime x 0 + mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t := by
      have h1 := h_mk_add x 0 0 t
      rwa [add_zero, zero_add] at h1
    have h_nx : ‖mkSpaceTime x 0‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖x i‖ ^ 2 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      have h_last : ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      linarith
    have h_nt : ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ ≤ |t| := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, ← Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg t)]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      have h_last : ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 = |t| ^ 2 := by
        simp [mkSpaceTime, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith
    calc ‖mkSpaceTime x t‖ = ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 + mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ := by rw [h_split]
      _ ≤ ‖mkSpaceTime x 0‖ + ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ + |t| := add_le_add h_nx h_nt
  have h_bdd : ∀ w : E, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, |v_seq j w| ≤ B := by
    intro w
    let K : ℝ := ‖w‖ + 1
    have hK_pos : 0 < K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
    obtain ⟨U, hU_nonneg, hU⟩ := (h_bounds.2.2 K hK_pos).1
    refine ⟨U, hU_nonneg, fun j => ?_⟩
    have hx_le : ‖projSpace w‖ ≤ K := by
      have := h_norm_projSpace w
      dsimp [K]; linarith
    have ht_le : |projTime w| ≤ K := by
      have := h_norm_projTime w
      dsimp [K]; linarith
    exact hU (v_seq j) (hv_seq j).1 (hv_seq j).2.1 w hx_le ht_le
  have h_equi : ∀ K ε : ℝ, 0 < K → 0 < ε →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w w' : E, ‖w‖ ≤ K → ‖w' - w‖ ≤ δ →
          |v_seq j w' - v_seq j w| ≤ ε := by
    intro K ε hK hε
    have hK1_pos : 0 < K + 1 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀⟩ := (h_bounds.2.2 (K + 1) hK1_pos).2 ε hε
    let δ : ℝ := min δ₀ 1
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₀_pos zero_lt_one
    refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun j w w' hw hww' => ?_⟩

      (hq_smooth.of_le (by simp : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞))).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hq'_diff : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ q) := hq'_smooth.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hg2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z₀ = 0 := by
      have h_smul := (hq_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt.smul (hq'_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt
      have h_add := (h_smul.add h_smul).fderiv
      rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
      simpa [hq0, hq'_z0] using h_add
    have hϕ'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
      have hϕ'_c1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ :=
        (hϕ_c2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V)).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
      exact hϕ'_c1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hg'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z₀ := by
      have h_smul := (hq_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt.smul (hq'_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt
      rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
      exact (h_smul.add h_smul).differentiableAt
    have h_op_contAt : ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → ContinuousAt (limitingOperator ψ) z₀ := by
      intro ψ hψ_c2
      have h_fderiv_c1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ψ) V :=
        hψ_c2.fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open (by norm_num)
      have h_fderiv2_cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ)) V :=
        h_fderiv_c1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open le_rfl
      have h_fderiv1_cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ ψ) V :=
        hψ_c2.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open (by norm_num)
      have h_grad_cont : ContinuousOn (gradient ψ) V :=
        (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm.continuous.comp_continuousOn h_fderiv1_cont
      have h_xi_ψ_cont : ContinuousOn (fun y => mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ψ y)) 1) V :=
        h_xi_cont.comp_continuousOn h_grad_cont
      have h_op_cont : ContinuousOn (limitingOperator ψ) V :=
        (h_fderiv2_cont.clm_apply h_xi_ψ_cont).clm_apply h_xi_ψ_cont
      exact h_op_cont.continuousAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · let ψ₁ : E → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y + g y
      have hψ₁_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ₁ V := hϕ_c2.add hg_c2
      have hψ₁_fderiv_V : ∀ y ∈ V, fderiv ℝ ψ₁ y = fderiv ℝ ϕ y + fderiv ℝ g y := by
        intro y hy
        have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ y :=
          (hϕ_c2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
        exact fderiv_add hϕ_diff (hg_diff y)
      have hψ₁_fderiv_z0 : fderiv ℝ ψ₁ z₀ = fderiv ℝ ϕ z₀ := by
        rw [hψ₁_fderiv_V z₀ hz₀_V, hg1, add_zero]
      have hψ₁_grad_z0 : gradient ψ₁ z₀ = gradient ϕ z₀ := by
        simp [gradient, hψ₁_fderiv_z0]
      have h_ev : fderiv ℝ ψ₁ =ᶠ[nhds z₀] fderiv ℝ ϕ + fderiv ℝ g :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V) (fun y hy => hψ₁_fderiv_V y hy)
      have hψ₁_fderiv2_z0 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ₁) z₀ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
        rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_add hϕ'_diff_z0 hg'_diff_z0, hg2, add_zero]
      refine ⟨hψ₁_c2, h_op_contAt ψ₁ hψ₁_c2, ?_⟩
      change limitingOperator ψ₁ z₀ = limitingOperator ϕ z₀
      simp [limitingOperator, hψ₁_fderiv2_z0, hψ₁_grad_z0]
    · let ψ₂ : E → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y - g y
      have hψ₂_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ₂ V := hϕ_c2.sub hg_c2
      have hψ₂_fderiv_V : ∀ y ∈ V, fderiv ℝ ψ₂ y = fderiv ℝ ϕ y - fderiv ℝ g y := by
        intro y hy
        have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ y :=
          (hϕ_c2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
        exact fderiv_sub hϕ_diff (hg_diff y)
      have hψ₂_fderiv_z0 : fderiv ℝ ψ₂ z₀ = fderiv ℝ ϕ z₀ := by
        rw [hψ₂_fderiv_V z₀ hz₀_V, hg1, sub_zero]
      have hψ₂_grad_z0 : gradient ψ₂ z₀ = gradient ϕ z₀ := by
        simp [gradient, hψ₂_fderiv_z0]
      have h_ev : fderiv ℝ ψ₂ =ᶠ[nhds z₀] fderiv ℝ ϕ - fderiv ℝ g :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V) (fun y hy => hψ₂_fderiv_V y hy)
      have hψ₂_fderiv2_z0 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ₂) z₀ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
        rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_sub hϕ'_diff_z0 hg'_diff_z0, hg2, sub_zero]
      refine ⟨hψ₂_c2, h_op_contAt ψ₂ hψ₂_c2, ?_⟩
      change limitingOperator ψ₂ z₀ = limitingOperator ϕ z₀
      simp [limitingOperator, hψ₂_fderiv2_z0, hψ₂_grad_z0]
  have hv_sub : ∀ z₀ : E, ∀ ϕ : E → ℝ, ∀ V : Set E,
      IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z₀ = v z₀ → (∀ y ∈ V, v y ≤ ϕ y) →
      0 ≤ limitingOperator ϕ z₀ := by
    intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2 h_touch_eq h_touch_le
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open z₀ hz₀_V
    let ρ : ℝ := ρ₀ / 2
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := half_pos hρ₀_pos
    let K : Set E := Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ
    have hK_sub_V : K ⊆ V :=
      subset_trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hρ₀_pos)) hρ₀_sub
    have hK_norm : ∀ y ∈ K, ‖y‖ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_dist : ‖y - z₀‖ ≤ ρ := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]
        exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hy
      have h_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ + ‖z₀‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - z₀) z₀
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hψ₁_c2, hψ₁_contAt, hψ₁_eq⟩ := (h_s3 V z₀ ϕ hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2).1
    let ψ₁ : E → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2
    have h_ex_max : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ ym ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, v_seq (φ m) y - ψ₁ y ≤ v_seq (φ m) ym - ψ₁ ym := by
      intro m
      have h_cont_m : ContinuousOn (fun y => v_seq (φ m) y - ψ₁ y) K :=
        (hv_seq (φ m)).1.1.continuousOn.sub (hψ₁_c2.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_V)
      have hK_nonempty : K.Nonempty := ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le⟩
      obtain ⟨ym, hym_K, hym_max⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall z₀ ρ).exists_isMaxOn hK_nonempty h_cont_m
      exact ⟨ym, hym_K, fun y hy => isMaxOn_iff.mp hym_max y hy⟩
    choose y_seq hy_seq using h_ex_max
    have hy_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto y_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro r hr_pos
      let r' : ℝ := min r ρ
      have hr'_pos : 0 < r' := lt_min hr_pos hρ_pos
      let ε : ℝ := (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4
      have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
      obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hv_unif (‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1) ε (by positivity) hε_pos
      refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      have hym_K : y_seq m ∈ K := (hy_seq m).1
      have hz₀_K : z₀ ∈ K := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le
      have h_max_z₀ : v_seq (φ m) z₀ - ψ₁ z₀ ≤ v_seq (φ m) (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m) :=
        (hy_seq m).2 z₀ hz₀_K
      have hG_ym := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm (y_seq m) (hK_norm (y_seq m) hym_K))).1
      have hG_z₀ := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm z₀ (hK_norm z₀ hz₀_K))).2
      have hW_ym : v (y_seq m) ≤ ϕ (y_seq m) := h_touch_le (y_seq m) (hK_sub_V hym_K)
      have hψ₁_z₀ : ψ₁ z₀ = v z₀ := by simp [ψ₁, h_touch_eq]
      have hψ₁_ym : ψ₁ (y_seq m) = ϕ (y_seq m) + (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 := rfl
      have h_quartic_le : (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ε := by linarith
      have h_lt_r' : ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ < r' := by
        by_contra h_not_lt
        push_neg at h_not_lt
        have h_sq1 : r' ^ 2 ≤ ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hr'_pos.le h_not_lt 2
        have h_sq2 : (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_sq1 2
        have h_pos_r4 : 0 < (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
        dsimp [ε] at h_quartic_le
        linarith
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lt_r' (min_le_left r ρ)
    let W : Set E := Metric.ball z₀ ρ
    have h_ev_W : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, y_seq m ∈ W :=
      hy_tendsto.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pos))
    have hW_sub_V : W ⊆ V := subset_trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hK_sub_V
    have h_ev_nonneg : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ limitingOperator ψ₁ (y_seq m) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_W] with m hym_W
      let ψ_tilde : E → ℝ := fun y => ψ₁ y + (v_seq (φ m) (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m))
      have hψ_tilde_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ_tilde W :=
        (hψ₁_c2.mono hW_sub_V).add contDiffOn_const
      have hψ_tilde_eq : ψ_tilde (y_seq m) = v_seq (φ m) (y_seq m) := by
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]; ring
      have hψ_tilde_le : ∀ y ∈ W, v_seq (φ m) y ≤ ψ_tilde y := by
        intro y hy
        have h_le := (hy_seq m).2 y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]; linarith
      have h_visc := (hv_seq (φ m)).1.2.1 (y_seq m) ψ_tilde W
        Metric.isOpen_ball hym_W hψ_tilde_c2 hψ_tilde_eq hψ_tilde_le
      rwa [h_s2 ψ₁ (y_seq m) (v_seq (φ m) (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m))] at h_visc
    have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => limitingOperator ψ₁ (y_seq m)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (limitingOperator ψ₁ z₀)) :=
      hψ₁_contAt.tendsto.comp hy_tendsto
    have h_z₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ limitingOperator ψ₁ z₀ := ge_of_tendsto h_lim h_ev_nonneg
    rwa [hψ₁_eq] at h_z₀_nonneg
  have hv_super : ∀ z₀ : E, ∀ ϕ : E → ℝ, ∀ V : Set E,
      IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z₀ = v z₀ → (∀ y ∈ V, ϕ y ≤ v y) →
      limitingOperator ϕ z₀ ≤ 0 := by
    intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2 h_touch_eq h_touch_le
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open z₀ hz₀_V
    let ρ : ℝ := ρ₀ / 2
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := half_pos hρ₀_pos
    let K : Set E := Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ
    have hK_sub_V : K ⊆ V :=
      subset_trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hρ₀_pos)) hρ₀_sub
    have hK_norm : ∀ y ∈ K, ‖y‖ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_dist : ‖y - z₀‖ ≤ ρ := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]
        exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hy
      have h_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ + ‖z₀‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - z₀) z₀
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hψ₂_c2, hψ₂_contAt, hψ₂_eq⟩ := (h_s3 V z₀ ϕ hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2).2
    let ψ₂ : E → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y - (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2
    have h_ex_max : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ ym ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ψ₂ y - v_seq (φ m) y ≤ ψ₂ ym - v_seq (φ m) ym := by
      intro m
      have h_cont_m : ContinuousOn (fun y => ψ₂ y - v_seq (φ m) y) K :=
        (hψ₂_c2.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_V).sub (hv_seq (φ m)).1.1.continuousOn
      have hK_nonempty : K.Nonempty := ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le⟩
      obtain ⟨ym, hym_K, hym_max⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall z₀ ρ).exists_isMaxOn hK_nonempty h_cont_m
      exact ⟨ym, hym_K, fun y hy => isMaxOn_iff.mp hym_max y hy⟩
    choose y_seq hy_seq using h_ex_max
    have hy_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto y_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro r hr_pos
      let r' : ℝ := min r ρ
      have hr'_pos : 0 < r' := lt_min hr_pos hρ_pos
      let ε : ℝ := (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4
      have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
      obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hv_unif (‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1) ε (by positivity) hε_pos
      refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      have hym_K : y_seq m ∈ K := (hy_seq m).1
      have hz₀_K : z₀ ∈ K := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le
      have h_max_z₀ : ψ₂ z₀ - v_seq (φ m) z₀ ≤ ψ₂ (y_seq m) - v_seq (φ m) (y_seq m) :=
        (hy_seq m).2 z₀ hz₀_K
      have hG_ym := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm (y_seq m) (hK_norm (y_seq m) hym_K))).2
      have hG_z₀ := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm z₀ (hK_norm z₀ hz₀_K))).1
      have hW_ym : ϕ (y_seq m) ≤ v (y_seq m) := h_touch_le (y_seq m) (hK_sub_V hym_K)
      have hψ₂_z₀ : ψ₂ z₀ = v z₀ := by simp [ψ₂, h_touch_eq]
      have hψ₂_ym : ψ₂ (y_seq m) = ϕ (y_seq m) - (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 := rfl
      have h_quartic_le : (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ε := by linarith
      have h_lt_r' : ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ < r' := by
        by_contra h_not_lt
        push_neg at h_not_lt
        have h_sq1 : r' ^ 2 ≤ ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hr'_pos.le h_not_lt 2
        have h_sq2 : (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_sq1 2
        have h_pos_r4 : 0 < (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
        dsimp [ε] at h_quartic_le
        linarith
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lt_r' (min_le_left r ρ)
    let W : Set E := Metric.ball z₀ ρ
    have h_ev_W : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, y_seq m ∈ W :=
      hy_tendsto.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pos))
    have hW_sub_V : W ⊆ V := subset_trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hK_sub_V
    have h_ev_nonpos : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, limitingOperator ψ₂ (y_seq m) ≤ 0 := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_W] with m hym_W
      let ψ_tilde : E → ℝ := fun y => ψ₂ y + (v_seq (φ m) (y_seq m) - ψ₂ (y_seq m))
      have hψ_tilde_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ_tilde W :=
        (hψ₂_c2.mono hW_sub_V).add contDiffOn_const
      have hψ_tilde_eq : ψ_tilde (y_seq m) = v_seq (φ m) (y_seq m) := by
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]; ring
      have hψ_tilde_le : ∀ y ∈ W, ψ_tilde y ≤ v_seq (φ m) y := by
        intro y hy
        have h_le := (hy_seq m).2 y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]; linarith
      have h_visc := (hv_seq (φ m)).1.2.2.1 (y_seq m) ψ_tilde W
        Metric.isOpen_ball hym_W hψ_tilde_c2 hψ_tilde_eq hψ_tilde_le
      rwa [h_s2 ψ₂ (y_seq m) (v_seq (φ m) (y_seq m) - ψ₂ (y_seq m))] at h_visc
    have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => limitingOperator ψ₂ (y_seq m)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (limitingOperator ψ₂ z₀)) :=
      hψ₂_contAt.tendsto.comp hy_tendsto
    have h_z₀_nonpos : limitingOperator ψ₂ z₀ ≤ 0 := le_of_tendsto h_lim h_ev_nonpos
    rwa [hψ₂_eq] at h_z₀_nonpos
  exact ⟨v, φ, hφ_mono, ⟨hv_cont, hv_sub, hv_super, hv_fits⟩, hv_cent, hv_jensen, h_conv⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (hv_subquad : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ (M : ℝ), 0 < M ∧
        ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          M ≤ ‖y‖ → |v (mkSpaceTime y 1)| ≤ ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
      (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧
      (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧
      (∑ i, θ i • y i = 0) ∧
      (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) - (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i‖ ^ 2) / 2 =
        barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) ∧
      (∀ i, v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 =
        quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0)) ∧
      barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) =
        quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_mk_cont : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => mkSpaceTime y 1) := by
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp (continuous_pi (fun j => ?_))
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]; exact continuous_const
    · intro i; simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (continuous_apply i).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous
  obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM⟩ := hv_subquad (1 / 4) (by norm_num)
  have h_main : ∀ (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B →
      ∃ (R : ℝ), 0 < R ∧
        ∀ (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ‖b‖ ≤ B →
          (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
            v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0)) ∧
          (∃ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
            ‖y‖ ≤ R ∧
            v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0)) ∧
          (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
            v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) →
            ‖y‖ ≤ R) := by
    intro B hB

      let w : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ :=
        fun i => if h : i.1 < k then w₀ (σ ⟨i.1, h⟩).1 else 0
      let z : Fin (d + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
        fun i => if h : i.1 < k then (σ ⟨i.1, h⟩).1 else y₀
      have hw_nonneg : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1), 0 ≤ w i := by
        intro i
        dsimp [w]
        split_ifs with h
        · exact hw₀_nonneg (σ ⟨i.1, h⟩).1 (σ ⟨i.1, h⟩).2
        · exact le_rfl
      have hz_mem : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1), z i ∈ E := by
        intro i
        dsimp [z]
        split_ifs with h
        · exact ht_sub (σ ⟨i.1, h⟩).2
        · exact hy₀
      let e_emb : Fin k ↪ Fin (d + 1) := Fin.castLEEmb hk
      have h_not_mem : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1), i ∉ Finset.map e_emb Finset.univ → ¬ (i.1 < k) := by
        intro i hi h_lt
        apply hi
        rw [Finset.mem_map]
        refine ⟨⟨i.1, h_lt⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        ext
        simp [e_emb]
      have hw_sum : ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), w i = 1 := by
        calc ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), w i
          _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.map e_emb Finset.univ, w i := by
              refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) ?_).symm
              intro i _ hi
              have h_nlt := h_not_mem i hi
              dsimp [w]
              exact dif_neg h_nlt
          _ = ∑ j : Fin k, w (e_emb j) := Finset.sum_map Finset.univ e_emb w
          _ = ∑ j : Fin k, w₀ (σ j).1 := by
              congr 1 with j
              have hj : (e_emb j).1 < k := j.2
              dsimp [w]
              rw [dif_pos hj]
              rfl
          _ = ∑ y : ↥t, w₀ y.1 := Fintype.sum_equiv σ (fun j => w₀ (σ j).1) (fun y => w₀ y.1) (fun _ => rfl)
          _ = ∑ y ∈ t, w₀ y := Finset.sum_coe_sort t w₀
          _ = 1 := hw₀_sum
      have hwz_sum : ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), w i • z i = x := by
        calc ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), w i • z i
          _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.map e_emb Finset.univ, w i • z i := by
              refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) ?_).symm
              intro i _ hi
              have h_nlt := h_not_mem i hi
              have hw_zero : w i = 0 := by dsimp [w]; exact dif_neg h_nlt
              rw [hw_zero, zero_smul]
          _ = ∑ j : Fin k, w (e_emb j) • z (e_emb j) :=
              Finset.sum_map Finset.univ e_emb (fun i => w i • z i)
          _ = ∑ j : Fin k, w₀ (σ j).1 • (σ j).1 := by
              congr 1 with j
              have hj : (e_emb j).1 < k := j.2
              dsimp [w, z]
              rw [dif_pos hj, dif_pos hj]
              rfl
          _ = ∑ y : ↥t, w₀ y.1 • y.1 :=
              Fintype.sum_equiv σ (fun j => w₀ (σ j).1 • (σ j).1) (fun y => w₀ y.1 • y.1) (fun _ => rfl)
          _ = ∑ y ∈ t, w₀ y • y := Finset.sum_coe_sort t (fun y => w₀ y • y)
          _ = x := hw₀_comb
      refine ⟨(w, z), ⟨⟨hw_nonneg, hw_sum⟩, fun i _ => hz_mem i⟩, hwz_sum⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨w, z⟩, ⟨⟨hw_nonneg, hw_sum⟩, hz_mem⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [mem_convexHull_iff_exists_fintype]
      exact ⟨Fin (d + 1), inferInstance, w, z, hw_nonneg, hw_sum, fun i => hz_mem i (Set.mem_univ i), rfl⟩
  have hD_comp : IsCompact D :=
    IsCompact.prod (isCompact_stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (isCompact_univ_pi (fun _ => hE_comp))
  have hΨ_cont : Continuous Ψ := by
    refine continuous_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => ?_)
    exact ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst).smul ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd)
  have h_conv_closed : IsClosed (convexHull ℝ E) := by
    rw [h_conv_eq]
    exact (hD_comp.image hΨ_cont).isClosed
  have h0_mem : (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) ∈ convexHull ℝ E := by
    by_contra h0_not_mem
    obtain ⟨f, u, hu_pos, hu_lt⟩ :=
      geometric_hahn_banach_point_closed (convex_convexHull ℝ E) h_conv_closed h0_not_mem
    rw [map_zero] at hu_pos
    let e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
      (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))).symm f
    obtain ⟨y, hyE, h_inner_le⟩ := hE_dir e
    have hy_conv : y ∈ convexHull ℝ E := subset_convexHull ℝ E hyE
    have h_fy_gt : u < f y := hu_lt y hy_conv
    have h_fy_eq : f y = inner ℝ e y := by
      dsimp [e]
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply.symm
    linarith
  rw [h_conv_eq] at h0_mem
  obtain ⟨⟨w, z⟩, ⟨⟨hw_nonneg, hw_sum⟩, hz_mem⟩, hwz_zero⟩ := h0_mem
  dsimp [Ψ] at hwz_zero
  let S_pos : Finset (Fin (d + 1)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (d + 1) => 0 < w i)
  have h_zero_of_not_mem : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ, i ∉ S_pos → w i = 0 := by
    intro i _ hi
    have h_not_pos : ¬ (0 < w i) := by
      intro h_pos
      exact hi (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, h_pos⟩)
    exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_not_pos) (hw_nonneg i)
  have hS_sum : ∑ i ∈ S_pos, w i = 1 := by
    calc ∑ i ∈ S_pos, w i
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, w i := Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) h_zero_of_not_mem
      _ = 1 := hw_sum
  have hS_comb : ∑ i ∈ S_pos, w i • z i = 0 := by
    calc ∑ i ∈ S_pos, w i • z i
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, w i • z i := by
          refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) ?_
          intro i hi h_not
          rw [h_zero_of_not_mem i hi h_not, zero_smul]
      _ = 0 := hwz_zero
  let N : ℕ := Fintype.card ↥S_pos
  let τ : Fin N ≃ ↥S_pos := (Fintype.equivFin ↥S_pos).symm
  let θ : Fin N → ℝ := fun j => w (τ j).1
  let y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun j => z (τ j).1
  have hθ_pos : ∀ j : Fin N, 0 < θ j := by
    intro j
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (τ j).2).2
  have hθ_sum : ∑ j : Fin N, θ j = 1 := by
    calc ∑ j : Fin N, w (τ j).1
      _ = ∑ x : ↥S_pos, w x.1 := Fintype.sum_equiv τ (fun j => w (τ j).1) (fun x => w x.1) (fun _ => rfl)
      _ = ∑ i ∈ S_pos, w i := Finset.sum_coe_sort S_pos w
      _ = 1 := hS_sum
  have hy_mean : ∑ j : Fin N, θ j • y j = 0 := by
    calc ∑ j : Fin N, w (τ j).1 • z (τ j).1
      _ = ∑ x : ↥S_pos, w x.1 • z x.1 :=
          Fintype.sum_equiv τ (fun j => w (τ j).1 • z (τ j).1) (fun x => w x.1 • z x.1) (fun _ => rfl)
      _ = ∑ i ∈ S_pos, w i • z i := Finset.sum_coe_sort S_pos (fun i => w i • z i)
      _ = 0 := hS_comb
  have hy_opt : ∀ j : Fin N,
      v (mkSpaceTime (y j) 1) - ‖y j - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
    intro j
    exact hz_mem (τ j).1 (Set.mem_univ _)
  have h_proj_s : projSpace (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1) = 0 := by
    ext i; simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_proj_t : projTime (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1) = 1 := by
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_var : ∀ (N' : ℕ) (θ' : Fin N' → ℝ) (y' : Fin N' → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∑ i, θ' i = 1) → (∑ i, θ' i • y' i = 0) →
      (∑ i, θ' i * v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1)) - (∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i‖ ^ 2) / 2 =
        (∑ i, θ' i * (v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1) - ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    intro N' θ' y' hθ'_sum hy'_mean
    have h_inner_zero : ∑ i, θ' i * inner ℝ (y' i) b = 0 := by
      calc ∑ i, θ' i * inner ℝ (y' i) b
        _ = ∑ i, inner ℝ (θ' i • y' i) b := by
            congr 1 with i
            rw [real_inner_smul_left]
        _ = inner ℝ (∑ i, θ' i • y' i) b := by rw [← sum_inner]
        _ = 0 := by rw [hy'_mean, inner_zero_left]
    have h_norm_sum : ∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2 =
        (∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i‖ ^ 2) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
      calc ∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2
        _ = ∑ i, (θ' i * ‖y' i‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (θ' i * inner ℝ (y' i) b) + θ' i * ‖b‖ ^ 2) := by
            congr 1 with i
            rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
            ring
        _ = (∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i‖ ^ 2) - 2 * (∑ i, θ' i * inner ℝ (y' i) b) +
              (∑ i, θ' i) * ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = (∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i‖ ^ 2) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [h_inner_zero, hθ'_sum]
            ring
    have h_rhs : ∑ i, θ' i * (v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1) - ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2) =
        (∑ i, θ' i * v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1)) - (∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2) / 2 := by
      calc ∑ i, θ' i * (v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1) - ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)
        _ = (∑ i, θ' i * v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1)) - ∑ i, (θ' i * ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2) / 2 := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            congr 1 with i
            ring
        _ = (∑ i, θ' i * v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1)) - (∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2) / 2 := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [h_rhs, h_norm_sum]
    ring
  set val_star : ℝ := quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2
  have h_att_val : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) - (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i‖ ^ 2) / 2 = val_star := by
    rw [h_var N θ y hθ_sum hy_mean]
    have h_sum_opt : ∑ i, θ i * (v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2) =
        quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
      calc ∑ i, θ i * (v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)
        _ = ∑ i, θ i * quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
            congr 1 with i
            rw [hy_opt i]
        _ = (∑ i, θ i) * quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
            rw [hθ_sum, one_mul]
    rw [h_sum_opt]
  let S_bary : Set ℝ := { val : ℝ | ∃ (N' : ℕ) (θ' : Fin N' → ℝ) (y' : Fin N' → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
    (∀ i, 0 < θ' i) ∧ (∑ i, θ' i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ' i • y' i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)) ∧
    val = (∑ i, θ' i * v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)))) -
      (∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) }
  have h_mem : val_star ∈ S_bary := by
    refine ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_proj_s]; exact hy_mean
    · rw [h_proj_t, h_proj_s]
      simp only [sub_zero, mul_one]
      exact h_att_val.symm
  have h_ub : ∀ val ∈ S_bary, val ≤ val_star := by
    rintro val ⟨N', θ', y', hθ'_pos, hθ'_sum, hy'_mean, rfl⟩
    rw [h_proj_s] at hy'_mean
    rw [h_proj_t, h_proj_s]
    simp only [sub_zero, mul_one]
    rw [h_var N' θ' y' hθ'_sum hy'_mean]
    have h_sum_le : ∑ i, θ' i * (v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1) - ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2) ≤
        quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
      calc ∑ i, θ' i * (v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) 1) - ‖y' i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)
        _ ≤ ∑ i, θ' i * quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i _
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_le b (y' i)) (le_of_lt (hθ'_pos i))
        _ = (∑ i, θ' i) * quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
            rw [hθ'_sum, one_mul]
    dsimp [val_star]
    linarith
  have h_bary_eq : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = val_star := by
    change sSup S_bary = val_star
    exact le_antisymm (csSup_le ⟨val_star, h_mem⟩ h_ub) (le_csSup ⟨val_star, h_ub⟩ h_mem)
  exact ⟨N, θ, y, b, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, h_att_val.trans h_bary_eq.symm, hy_opt, h_bary_eq⟩

(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ_pos : 0 < κ) (h_bounds : HasCenteredClassABounds d C₁)
    (w_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hφ : StrictMono φ)
    (hw_seq : ∀ m : ℕ,
      InLimitingClassA d C₁ (w_seq m) ∧
      IsCenteredAt d C₁ (w_seq m) 0 1 ∧
      HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ (w_seq m) ∧
      κ ^ 2 / 2 - κ / ((φ m : ℝ) + 1) ≤
        barycentricEnvelope d 1 (w_seq m) (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - (w_seq m) (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
    (hv_class : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (h_conv : ConvergesLocUnif d w_seq v)
    (hb_dual : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) =
      quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2) :
    barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_cont_mk : ∀ (t : ℝ),
      Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => mkSpaceTime y t) := by
    intro t
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp ?_
    rw [continuous_pi_iff]
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
      exact continuous_const
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (continuous_apply i).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous
  let z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
  have hz₀_space : projSpace z₀ = 0 := h_projSpace 0 1
  have hz₀_time : projTime z₀ = 1 := h_projTime 0 1
  have h_bary_mem : ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      f z₀ ∈ { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace z₀) ∧
        val = (∑ i, θ i * f (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) } := by
    intro f
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => 0, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, by simp [hz₀_space], ?_⟩
    simp [hz₀_space, hz₀_time, z₀]
  have h_ub : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v z₀ - v z₀ ≤ κ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have h_le : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v z₀ ≤ v z₀ + κ ^ 2 / 2 := by
      apply csSup_le ⟨v z₀, h_bary_mem v⟩
      rintro val ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
      let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
      have hx_eq : x = projSpace z₀ := hy_mean
      have hx_zero : x = 0 := hy_mean.trans hz₀_space
      let S_var : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2
      let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt S_var
      have hS_nonneg : 0 ≤ S_var := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro i _
        exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
      have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = S_var := Real.sq_sqrt hS_nonneg
      have h_jen := hv_jensen (projTime z₀) N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
      change (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) -
        v (mkSpaceTime x (projTime z₀)) ≤ κ * r at h_jen
      have h_mk_x : mkSpaceTime x (projTime z₀) = z₀ := by
        rw [hx_zero, hz₀_time]
      rw [h_mk_x] at h_jen
      have h_var_eq : (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) = r ^ 2 := by
        rw [← hx_eq, hr_sq]
      rw [h_var_eq]
      have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (r - κ)
      linarith
    linarith
  let zb : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime b 0
  have hzb_space : projSpace zb = b := h_projSpace b 0
  have hzb_time : projTime zb = 0 := h_projTime b 0
  obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM⟩ := h_bounds.1 (1 / 4) (by norm_num)
  let R_star : ℝ := max (max M (8 * ‖b‖)) 1
  have hR_ge_M : M ≤ R_star := le_trans (le_max_left M (8 * ‖b‖)) (le_max_left _ 1)
  have hR_ge_b : 8 * ‖b‖ ≤ R_star := le_trans (le_max_right M (8 * ‖b‖)) (le_max_left _ 1)
  have hR_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ R_star := le_max_right _ 1
  have hR_pos : 0 < R_star := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hR_ge_one
  have h_tail : ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      R_star ≤ ‖y‖ → |w (mkSpaceTime y 1)| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 →
      w (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ - ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    intro w y hy_R hw_growth
    have hw_le : w (mkSpaceTime y 1) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
      le_trans (le_abs_self _) hw_growth
    have h_norm_sub : ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ y b + ‖b‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_sub_sq_real y b
    have h_inner : inner ℝ y b ≤ ‖y‖ * ‖b‖ :=
      le_trans (le_abs_self _) (abs_real_inner_le_norm y b)
    have hy_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
    have h_yb : 8 * (‖y‖ * ‖b‖) ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h8b : 8 * ‖b‖ ≤ ‖y‖ := le_trans hR_ge_b hy_R
      nlinarith
    have hy_sq : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg ‖y‖
    linarith
  let g_v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun y =>
    v (mkSpaceTime y (projTime zb + 1)) - ‖y - projSpace zb‖ ^ 2 / (2 * 1)
  have hg_v_eq : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      g_v y = v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    intro y
    dsimp [g_v]
    rw [hzb_time, zero_add, hzb_space]
    ring
  have hg_v_cont : Continuous g_v := by
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ ?_
    · exact hv_class.1.comp (h_cont_mk (projTime zb + 1))
    · exact ((continuous_norm.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).pow 2).div_const (2 * 1)
  have h_bdd_v : BddAbove (g_v '' Set.univ) := by
    obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀⟩ :=
      (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) R_star).bddAbove_image
        hg_v_cont.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max U₀ (- ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2), ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
    rcases le_or_gt ‖y‖ R_star with hy_le | hy_gt
    · have hy_mem : y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) R_star := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hy_le
      exact le_trans (hU₀ ⟨y, hy_mem, rfl⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hy_R : R_star ≤ ‖y‖ := le_of_lt hy_gt
      have hy_M : M ≤ ‖y‖ := le_trans hR_ge_M hy_R
      have h_est := h_tail v y hy_R (hM v hv_class hv_cent y hy_M)
      rw [← hg_v_eq y] at h_est
      exact le_trans h_est (le_max_right _ _)
  have hv_le_quad : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      v (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb := by
    intro y
    rw [← hg_v_eq y]
    exact le_csSup h_bdd_v ⟨y, Set.mem_univ y, rfl⟩
  have h_quad_lb : - ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb := by
    simpa [hv_cent.1, neg_div] using hv_le_quad 0
  have h_lb_dual : κ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    have hε2 : 0 < ε / 2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_conv R_star hR_pos (ε / 2) hε2
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * κ / ε)
    let m : ℕ := max N₀ K
    have hm_N₀ : N₀ ≤ m := le_max_left N₀ K
    have hm_K : K ≤ m := le_max_right N₀ K
    have hφ_m : m ≤ φ m := hφ.id_le m
    have hK_φ : (K : ℝ) ≤ (φ m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast le_trans hm_K hφ_m
    have hφ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (φ m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have h_err : κ / ((φ m : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ε / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hφ_pos]
      have h1 : 2 * κ / ε < (φ m : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
      have h2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp h1
      linarith
    have hw_pt : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        w_seq m (mkSpaceTime y 1) - ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2 := by
      intro y
      rcases le_or_gt ‖y‖ R_star with hy_le | hy_gt
      · have h_diff := hN₀ m hm_N₀ (mkSpaceTime y 1)
          (by simpa [h_projSpace] using hy_le)
          (by rw [h_projTime, abs_of_pos zero_lt_one]; exact hR_ge_one)
        have hw_le_v : w_seq m (mkSpaceTime y 1) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y 1) + ε / 2 := by
          linarith [(abs_sub_le_iff.mp h_diff).1]
        have hv_y := hv_le_quad y
        linarith
      · have hy_R : R_star ≤ ‖y‖ := le_of_lt hy_gt
        have hy_M : M ≤ ‖y‖ := le_trans hR_ge_M hy_R
        have h_est := h_tail (w_seq m) y hy_R
          (hM (w_seq m) (hw_seq m).1 (hw_seq m).2.1 y hy_M)
        linarith
    have hw_bary_le : barycentricEnvelope d 1 (w_seq m) z₀ ≤
        quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / 2 + ε / 2 := by
      apply csSup_le ⟨w_seq m z₀, h_bary_mem (w_seq m)⟩
      rintro val ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
      have hy_zero : ∑ i, θ i • y i = 0 := hy_mean.trans hz₀_space
      have h_var_shift : (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2) =
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2) + ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_sub_sq : ∀ i : Fin N,
            θ i * ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 =
              θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z₀‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (θ i • y i) b + θ i * ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
          intro i
          rw [hz₀_space, sub_zero, norm_sub_sq_real (y i) b, real_inner_smul_left]
          ring
        simp_rw [h_sub_sq, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
          ← sum_inner, hy_zero, inner_zero_left, mul_zero, sub_zero, ← Finset.sum_mul,
          hθ_sum, one_mul]
      have h_sum_pt : (∑ i, θ i * (w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)) ≤
          quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2 := by
        calc ∑ i, θ i * (w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)
          _ ≤ ∑ i, θ i * (quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2) := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro i _
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hw_pt (y i)) (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i))
          _ = (∑ i, θ i) * (quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2) := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          _ = quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v zb + ε / 2 := by
              rw [hθ_sum, one_mul]
      have h_lhs_id : (∑ i, θ i * (w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2 / 2)) =
          (∑ i, θ i * w_seq m (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z₀))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - b‖ ^ 2) / 2 := by
        rw [hz₀_time, Finset.sum_div]
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        congr 1 with i
        ring
      linarith
    have hw_gap := (hw_seq m).2.2.2
    have hw_zero : w_seq m z₀ = 0 := (hw_seq m).2.1.1
    linarith
  have hv_zero : v z₀ = 0 := hv_cent.1
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₀ : ℝ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀)
    (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv₀ : InLimitingClassA d C₀ v₀)
    (h_horiz : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (c : ℝ),
      ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), v₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) = inner ℝ p x + c) :
    IsAffineSpaceTime d v₀

signature.name: affine_of_horizontally_affine_classA
signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₀ : ℝ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀)
    (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv₀ : InLimitingClassA d C₀ v₀)
    (h_horiz : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (c : ℝ),
      ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), v₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) = inner ℝ p x + c) :
    IsAffineSpaceTime d v₀

proof.tactics:
by
  let p : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun t => Classical.choose (h_horiz t)
  let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_horiz t))
  have hv_slice : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      v₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) = inner ℝ (p t) x + c t :=
    fun t x => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_horiz t)) x
  have h_s1 : Continuous p ∧ Continuous c ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, ‖p t - p 0‖ ≤ 2 * C₀ := by
    have h_mk_cont : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Continuous (fun t : ℝ => mkSpaceTime x t) := by
      intro x
      unfold mkSpaceTime
      apply Continuous.comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous
      rw [continuous_pi_iff]
      intro j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
      · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
        exact continuous_id
      · intro i
        simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        exact continuous_const
    have hc_eq : c = fun t => v₀ (mkSpaceTime 0 t) := by
      ext t
      have h0 := hv_slice t 0
      simp only [inner_zero_right, zero_add] at h0
      exact h0.symm
    have hc_cont : Continuous c := by
      rw [hc_eq]
      exact hv₀.1.comp (h_mk_cont 0)
    have hp_cont : Continuous p := by
      have hp_eq : p = fun t => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).symm
          (fun i => v₀ (mkSpaceTime (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) t) - c t) := by
        ext t i
        have hi := hv_slice t (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
        rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, one_mul, RCLike.conj_to_real] at hi
        simp only [EuclideanSpace.equiv, PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv_symm_apply]
        linarith
      rw [hp_eq]
      apply Continuous.comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).symm.continuous
      rw [continuous_pi_iff]
      intro i
      exact (hv₀.1.comp (h_mk_cont (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))).sub hc_cont
    refine ⟨hp_cont, hc_cont, ?_⟩
    intro t
    set R : ℝ := |t| + 1
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := by positivity
    obtain ⟨p_R, a_R, h_fit⟩ := hv₀.2.2.2 0 0 R hR_pos
    have h_slope_diff : ∀ ℓ : ℝ, |ℓ| ≤ R → ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖w‖ ≤ R →
        |inner ℝ (p ℓ - p_R) w| ≤ C₀ * R := by
      intro ℓ hℓ w hw
      have h_plus : ‖(ℓ • p_R + w) - ℓ • p_R‖ ≤ R := by
        simpa [add_sub_cancel_left] using hw
      have h_minus : ‖(ℓ • p_R - w) - ℓ • p_R‖ ≤ R := by
        simpa [sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg] using hw
      have hf1 := h_fit (ℓ • p_R + w) ℓ hℓ h_plus
      have hf2 := h_fit (ℓ • p_R - w) ℓ hℓ h_minus
      simp only [zero_add] at hf1 hf2
      rw [hv_slice ℓ (ℓ • p_R + w)] at hf1
      rw [hv_slice ℓ (ℓ • p_R - w)] at hf2
      set A := inner ℝ (p ℓ) (ℓ • p_R + w) + c ℓ - v₀ (mkSpaceTime 0 0) -
        inner ℝ p_R (ℓ • p_R + w) - (a_R - ‖p_R‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ
      set B := inner ℝ (p ℓ) (ℓ • p_R - w) + c ℓ - v₀ (mkSpaceTime 0 0) -
        inner ℝ p_R (ℓ • p_R - w) - (a_R - ‖p_R‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ
      have hAB : A - B = 2 * inner ℝ (p ℓ - p_R) w := by
        simp only [A, B, inner_add_right, inner_sub_right, inner_sub_left]
        ring
      have h_abs : |A - B| ≤ 2 * (C₀ * R) := by
        calc |A - B| ≤ |A| + |B| := abs_sub A B
          _ ≤ C₀ * R + C₀ * R := add_le_add hf1 hf2
          _ = 2 * (C₀ * R) := by ring
      rw [hAB, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)] at h_abs
      linarith
    have ht_le : |t| ≤ R := by simp [R]
    have h0_le : |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ R := by
      rw [abs_zero]
      exact le_of_lt hR_pos
    set u := p t - p 0
    by_cases hu : u = 0
    · simp [u, hu, hC₀]
    · have hu_pos : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hu
      set w := (R / ‖u‖) • u
      have hw_norm : ‖w‖ ≤ R := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hR_pos hu_pos),
          div_mul_cancel₀ R (ne_of_gt hu_pos)]
      have h1 := h_slope_diff t ht_le w hw_norm
      have h2 := h_slope_diff 0 h0_le w hw_norm
      have h_inner_u : inner ℝ u w = R * ‖u‖ := by
        simp only [w, inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hu_pos]
      have h_sub_u : inner ℝ u w = inner ℝ (p t - p_R) w - inner ℝ (p 0 - p_R) w := by
        rw [← inner_sub_left]
        congr 1
        simp [u]
      have h_le : inner ℝ u w ≤ 2 * C₀ * R := by
        have h_abs : |inner ℝ u w| ≤ C₀ * R + C₀ * R := by
          rw [h_sub_u]
          exact le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add h1 h2)
        linarith [le_abs_self (inner ℝ u w)]
      rw [h_inner_u] at h_le
      nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hp_cont, hc_cont, hp_bdd⟩ := h_s1
  have h_test : ∀ (p₀ x y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α : ℝ)
      (V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α) V ∧
      limitingOperator (sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α) (mkSpaceTime y₀ s₀) =
        c₂ + α * ‖p₀ + α • (y₀ - x)‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro p₀ x y₀ s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α V
    let P₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime p₀ 0
    let e_t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
    let z₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime x s₀
    have h_inner_P₀ : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        inner ℝ P₀ z = inner ℝ p₀ (projSpace z) := by
      intro z
      simp only [P₀, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace]
    have h_inner_et : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        inner ℝ e_t (z - z₁) = projTime z - s₀ := by
      intro z
      simp only [e_t, z₁, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime]
    have h_norm_sq : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        ‖z - z₁‖ ^ 2 = ‖projSpace z - x‖ ^ 2 + (projTime z - s₀) ^ 2 := by
      intro z
      simp only [z₁, PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace, projTime]
    have h_eq : sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α = fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
        innerSL ℝ P₀ z + c₀ + c₁ * (innerSL ℝ e_t z - inner ℝ e_t z₁) +
        ((c₂ - α) / 2) * (innerSL ℝ e_t z - inner ℝ e_t z₁) ^ 2 + (α / 2) * ‖z - z₁‖ ^ 2 := by
      ext z
      unfold sliceQuadTest
      simp only [innerSL_apply_apply]
      rw [← inner_sub_right, h_inner_P₀ z, h_inner_et z, h_norm_sq z]
      ring
    have h_cd : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α) V := by
      rw [h_eq]
      apply ContDiff.contDiffOn
      have h1 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => innerSL ℝ P₀ z) :=
        (innerSL ℝ P₀).contDiff
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
          innerSL ℝ e_t z - inner ℝ e_t z₁) :=
        (innerSL ℝ e_t).contDiff.sub contDiff_const
      have h3 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => ‖z - z₁‖ ^ 2) :=
        (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).norm_sq ℝ
      exact (((h1.add contDiff_const).add (contDiff_const.mul h2)).add
        (contDiff_const.mul (h2.pow 2))).add (contDiff_const.mul h3)
    refine ⟨h_cd, ?_⟩
    let G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := fun z =>
      P₀ + (c₁ + (c₂ - α) * (innerSL ℝ e_t z - inner ℝ e_t z₁)) • e_t + α • (z - z₁)
    have h_fderiv1 : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        HasFDerivAt (sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α) (innerSL ℝ (G z)) z := by
      intro z
      rw [h_eq]
      have hd_sub : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => w - z₁)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) z :=
        (hasFDerivAt_id z).sub_const z₁
      have hd_P₀ : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => innerSL ℝ P₀ w)
          (innerSL ℝ P₀) z :=
        (innerSL ℝ P₀).hasFDerivAt
      have hd_et : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
          innerSL ℝ e_t w - inner ℝ e_t z₁) (innerSL ℝ e_t) z :=
        (innerSL ℝ e_t).hasFDerivAt.sub_const (inner ℝ e_t z₁)
      have hd_et_sq := hd_et.pow 2
      have hd_norm := hd_sub.norm_sq
      have hd_all := (((hd_P₀.add_const c₀).add (hd_et.const_mul c₁)).add
        (hd_et_sq.const_mul ((c₂ - α) / 2))).add (hd_norm.const_mul (α / 2))
      convert hd_all using 1
      ext v
      simp only [G, add_apply, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, innerSL_apply_apply,
        inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul,
        Nat.cast_ofNat]
      ring
    have h_fderiv_eq : fderiv ℝ (sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α) = fun z => innerSL ℝ (G z) := by
      ext z v
      rw [(h_fderiv1 z).fderiv]
    let z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime y₀ s₀
    have h_grad_z₀ : gradient (sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α) z₀ = G z₀ := by
      have h_dual : innerSL ℝ (G z₀) =
          InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (G z₀) := by
        ext v
        simp [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply]
      have h_f0 : HasFDerivAt (sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α)
          (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (G z₀)) z₀ := by
        rw [← h_dual]
        exact h_fderiv1 z₀
      exact (hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mpr h_f0).gradient
    have h_proj_G : projSpace (G z₀) = p₀ + α • (y₀ - x) := by
      have hz₀_et : innerSL ℝ e_t z₀ - inner ℝ e_t z₁ = 0 := by
        rw [innerSL_apply_apply, ← inner_sub_right, h_inner_et z₀]
        simp [z₀, projTime, mkSpaceTime]
      have hG_z₀ : G z₀ = P₀ + c₁ • e_t + α • (z₀ - z₁) := by
        change P₀ + (c₁ + (c₂ - α) * (innerSL ℝ e_t z₀ - inner ℝ e_t z₁)) • e_t + α • (z₀ - z₁) = _
        rw [hz₀_et, mul_zero, add_zero]
      rw [hG_z₀]
      ext i
      simp [projSpace, P₀, e_t, z₀, z₁, mkSpaceTime, smul_eq_mul]
    let G' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
      ((c₂ - α) • (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (innerSL ℝ e_t) e_t)) +
        α • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    have h_fderiv_G : HasFDerivAt G G' z₀ := by
      have hd_sub : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => w - z₁)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) z₀ :=
        (hasFDerivAt_id z₀).sub_const z₁
      have hd_et : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
          innerSL ℝ e_t w - inner ℝ e_t z₁) (innerSL ℝ e_t) z₀ :=
        (innerSL ℝ e_t).hasFDerivAt.sub_const (inner ℝ e_t z₁)
      have hd_coef : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
          c₁ + (c₂ - α) * (innerSL ℝ e_t w - inner ℝ e_t z₁))
          ((c₂ - α) • innerSL ℝ e_t) z₀ := by
        simpa using (hd_et.const_mul (c₂ - α)).const_add c₁
      have hd_term1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
          (c₁ + (c₂ - α) * (innerSL ℝ e_t w - inner ℝ e_t z₁)) • e_t)
          (((c₂ - α) • innerSL ℝ e_t).smulRight e_t) z₀ :=
        hd_coef.smul_const e_t
      have hd_term2 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => α • (w - z₁))
          (α • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) z₀ :=
        hd_sub.const_smul α
      have hd_G := (hd_term1.const_add P₀).add hd_term2
      convert hd_G using 1
      ext v i
      simp [G', smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
    have h_fderiv2 : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (sliceQuadTest d p₀ x s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α))
        ((innerSL ℝ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ]
          (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ)).comp G') z₀ := by
      rw [h_fderiv_eq]
      exact (innerSL ℝ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ]
        (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ)).hasFDerivAt.comp z₀ h_fderiv_G
    unfold limitingOperator
    rw [h_fderiv2.fderiv, h_grad_z₀, h_proj_G]
    set q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := p₀ + α • (y₀ - x)
    let ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime q 1
    change (((innerSL ℝ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ]
      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ)).comp G') ξ) ξ = c₂ + α * ‖q‖ ^ 2
    have h_et_ξ : inner ℝ e_t ξ = 1 := by
      simp only [e_t, ξ, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
    have h_ξ_ξ : inner ℝ ξ ξ = ‖q‖ ^ 2 + 1 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      simp only [ξ, PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
    simp only [G', ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, add_apply, smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, innerSL_apply_apply,
      inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real, h_et_ξ, h_ξ_ξ]
    ring
  have h_chord : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous F →
      (∀ (u w s₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ), u < s₀ → s₀ < w →
        (∀ s : ℝ, u < s → s < w → F s ≤ F s₀ + c₁ * (s - s₀) + (c₂ / 2) * (s - s₀) ^ 2) →
        0 ≤ c₂) →
      ∀ (u t w : ℝ), u ≤ t → t ≤ w → (w - u) * F t ≤ (w - t) * F u + (t - u) * F w := by
    intro F hF_cont h_sub u t w hut htw
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hut with rfl | hut_lt
    · ring_nf; rfl
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le htw with rfl | htw_lt
    · ring_nf; rfl
    have huw : u < w := lt_trans hut_lt htw_lt
    have hwu_pos : 0 < w - u := sub_pos.mpr huw
    by_contra h_not
    have h_gt : (w - t) * F u + (t - u) * F w < (w - u) * F t := lt_of_not_ge h_not
    set m : ℝ := (F w - F u) / (w - u)
    set L : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => F u + m * (s - u)
    have hLu : L u = F u := by simp [L]
    have hLw : L w = F w := by
      simp only [L, m]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hwu_pos]
      ring
    have h_gap_mul : (w - u) * (F t - L t) = (w - u) * F t - ((w - t) * F u + (t - u) * F w) := by
      simp only [L, m]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hwu_pos]
      ring
    have h_gap_pos : 0 < F t - L t := by
      have h_prod_pos : 0 < (w - u) * (F t - L t) := by linarith
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_right h_prod_pos (le_of_lt hwu_pos)
    have h_denom_pos : 0 < 2 * (t - u) * (w - t) := by
      have : 0 < t - u := sub_pos.mpr hut_lt
      have : 0 < w - t := sub_pos.mpr htw_lt
      positivity
    set δ : ℝ := (F t - L t) / (2 * (t - u) * (w - t))
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := div_pos h_gap_pos h_denom_pos
    set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => F s - L s - δ * (s - u) * (w - s)
    have hg_cont : Continuous g := by
      unfold g L
      fun_prop
    have hg_u : g u = 0 := by simp [g, hLu]
    have hg_w : g w = 0 := by simp [g, hLw]
    have hg_t : g t = (F t - L t) / 2 := by
      simp only [g, δ]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hut_lt), ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr htw_lt)]
      ring
    have hg_t_pos : 0 < g t := by linarith
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀_mem, hs₀_max⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt huw)) hg_cont.continuousOn
    have ht_mem : t ∈ Set.Icc u w := ⟨le_of_lt hut_lt, le_of_lt htw_lt⟩
    have hgs₀_pos : 0 < g s₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hg_t_pos (hs₀_max ht_mem)
    have hs₀_ne_u : s₀ ≠ u := by
      intro h_eq
      rw [h_eq, hg_u] at hgs₀_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hgs₀_pos
    have hs₀_ne_w : s₀ ≠ w := by
      intro h_eq
      rw [h_eq, hg_w] at hgs₀_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hgs₀_pos
    have hus₀ : u < s₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne hs₀_mem.1 (Ne.symm hs₀_ne_u)
    have hs₀w : s₀ < w := lt_of_le_of_ne hs₀_mem.2 hs₀_ne_w
    set c₁ : ℝ := m + δ * (u + w - 2 * s₀)
    set c₂ : ℝ := -2 * δ
    have h_quad : ∀ s : ℝ, u < s → s < w →
        F s ≤ F s₀ + c₁ * (s - s₀) + (c₂ / 2) * (s - s₀) ^ 2 := by
      intro s hus hsw
      have hs_mem : s ∈ Set.Icc u w := ⟨le_of_lt hus, le_of_lt hsw⟩
      have h_le : g s ≤ g s₀ := hs₀_max hs_mem
      have h_id : L s + δ * (s - u) * (w - s) + (F s₀ - L s₀ - δ * (s₀ - u) * (w - s₀)) =
          F s₀ + c₁ * (s - s₀) + (c₂ / 2) * (s - s₀) ^ 2 := by
        simp only [L, c₁, c₂]
        ring
      linarith [h_le, h_id]
    have hc₂_nonneg : 0 ≤ c₂ := h_sub u w s₀ c₁ c₂ hus₀ hs₀w h_quad
    linarith
  have h_mk_id : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z) = z := by
    intro z
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime]
    · intro i
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace]
  have h_projSpace_mk : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s) = y := by
    intro y s
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime_mk : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime y s) = s := by
    intro y s
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime_cont : Continuous (@projTime d) := by
    unfold projTime
    exact (continuous_apply (Fin.last d)).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).continuous
  set M_p : ℝ := ‖p 0‖ + 2 * C₀
  have hMp_sq : ∀ s : ℝ, ‖p s‖ ^ 2 ≤ M_p ^ 2 := by
    intro s
    have h_norm : ‖p s‖ ≤ M_p := by
      have h_tri : ‖p s‖ ≤ ‖p 0‖ + ‖p s - p 0‖ := by
        simpa [add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le (p 0) (p s - p 0)
      linarith [hp_bdd s]
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖p s‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  let h_x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun x s => inner ℝ (p s) x + c s + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖p s‖ ^ 2
  let H_x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun x s => h_x x s + (M_p ^ 2 / 2) * s ^ 2
  have hHx_cont : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Continuous (H_x x) := by
    intro x
    unfold H_x h_x
    have h1 : Continuous (fun s => inner ℝ (p s) x) :=
      Continuous.inner hp_cont continuous_const
    have h2 : Continuous (fun s => ‖p s‖ ^ 2) := (hp_cont.norm).pow 2
    fun_prop
  have h_sq_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      v₀ (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤ h_x x s + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x y s
    rw [hv_slice s y]
    unfold h_x
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖(y - x) - p s‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_comm, inner_sub_right] at h_nonneg
    linarith
  have h_sq_eq : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      v₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + p s) s) = h_x x s + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖(x + p s) - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x s
    rw [hv_slice s (x + p s), add_sub_cancel_left]
    unfold h_x
    rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    ring
  have hHx_chord : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (u t w : ℝ),
      u ≤ t → t ≤ w → (w - u) * H_x x t ≤ (w - t) * H_x x u + (t - u) * H_x x w := by
    intro x
    apply h_chord (H_x x) (hHx_cont x)
    intro u w s₀ c₁ c₂ hus₀ hs₀w h_quad
    let V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := (@projTime d) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo u w
    have hV_open : IsOpen V := isOpen_Ioo.preimage h_projTime_cont
    let y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x + p s₀
    let z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime y₀ s₀
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ V := by simp [V, z₀, h_projTime_mk, hus₀, hs₀w]
    let Φ := sliceQuadTest d 0 x s₀ (h_x x s₀) (c₁ - M_p ^ 2 * s₀) (c₂ - M_p ^ 2) 1
    have hΦ_test := h_test 0 x y₀ s₀ (h_x x s₀) (c₁ - M_p ^ 2 * s₀) (c₂ - M_p ^ 2) 1 V
    have hΦ_z₀ : Φ z₀ = v₀ z₀ := by
      unfold Φ sliceQuadTest
      rw [h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk, h_sq_eq x s₀]
      simp [y₀]
    have hΦ_ge : ∀ z ∈ V, v₀ z ≤ Φ z := by
      intro z hz
      have h_u_z : u < projTime z := hz.1
      have h_z_w : projTime z < w := hz.2
      have h_v_le : v₀ z ≤ h_x x (projTime z) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖projSpace z - x‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_tmp := h_sq_comp x (projSpace z) (projTime z)
        rwa [h_mk_id z] at h_tmp
      have h_H_le := h_quad (projTime z) h_u_z h_z_w
      unfold H_x at h_H_le
      unfold Φ sliceQuadTest
      simp only [inner_zero_left, zero_add]
      linarith
    have h_visc := hv₀.2.1 z₀ Φ V hV_open hz₀_mem hΦ_test.1 hΦ_z₀ hΦ_ge
    rw [hΦ_test.2] at h_visc
    have h_norm_p : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) + (1 : ℝ) • (y₀ - x)‖ ^ 2 = ‖p s₀‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp [y₀]
    rw [h_norm_p] at h_visc
    linarith [hMp_sq s₀]
  have hHx_mid : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      2 * H_x x s ≤ H_x x 0 + H_x x (2 * s) := by
    intro x s
    rcases le_or_gt 0 s with hs | hs
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs with rfl | hs_pos
      · ring_nf; linarith
      · have h_ch := hHx_chord x 0 s (2 * s) (le_of_lt hs_pos) (by linarith)
        nlinarith
    · have h_ch := hHx_chord x (2 * s) s 0 (by linarith) (le_of_lt hs)
      nlinarith
  have hp_double : ∀ s : ℝ, p (2 * s) - p 0 = (2 : ℝ) • (p s - p 0) := by
    intro s
    set q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (2 : ℝ) • p s - p 0 - p (2 * s)
    set B : ℝ := H_x 0 0 + H_x 0 (2 * s) - 2 * H_x 0 s
    have h_in : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), inner ℝ q x ≤ B := by
      intro x
      have hm := hHx_mid x s
      have h_diff : ∀ t : ℝ, H_x x t = H_x 0 t + inner ℝ (p t) x := by
        intro t
        simp only [H_x, h_x, inner_zero_right]
        ring
      rw [h_diff s, h_diff 0, h_diff (2 * s)] at hm
      have hq_in : inner ℝ q x = 2 * inner ℝ (p s) x - inner ℝ (p 0) x - inner ℝ (p (2 * s)) x := by
        simp only [q, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real]
      linarith
    have hq_zero : q = 0 := by
      by_contra hq_ne
      have hq_sq_pos : 0 < ‖q‖ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hq_ne)
      have h_test_x := h_in (((|B| + 1) / ‖q‖ ^ 2) • q)
      rw [inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
        div_mul_cancel₀ (|B| + 1) (ne_of_gt hq_sq_pos)] at h_test_x
      linarith [le_abs_self B]
    calc p (2 * s) - p 0 = (2 : ℝ) • (p s - p 0) - q := by
          simp only [q]; module
      _ = (2 : ℝ) • (p s - p 0) := by rw [hq_zero, sub_zero]
  have hp_pow : ∀ (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ), p ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * s) - p 0 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) • (p s - p 0) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro s
      simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro s
      have h_mul : (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * s = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (2 * s) := by ring
      rw [h_mul, ih (2 * s), hp_double s, smul_smul, ← pow_succ]
  have hp_const : ∀ t : ℝ, p t = p 0 := by
    intro t
    by_contra h_ne
    have h_pos : 0 < ‖p t - p 0‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_ne)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * C₀ / ‖p t - p 0‖)
    have h_bdd_k := hp_bdd ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * t)
    rw [hp_pow k t, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k)] at h_bdd_k
    have hk_lt_pow : (k : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self
    have h_gt : 2 * C₀ < (k : ℝ) * ‖p t - p 0‖ := (div_lt_iff₀ h_pos).mp hk
    have h_pow_gt : (k : ℝ) * ‖p t - p 0‖ < (2 : ℝ) ^ k * ‖p t - p 0‖ :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hk_lt_pow h_pos
    linarith
  have hc_upper : ∀ (u t w : ℝ), u ≤ t → t ≤ w →
      (w - u) * c t ≤ (w - t) * c u + (t - u) * c w := by
    apply h_chord c hc_cont
    intro u w s₀ c₁ c₂ hus₀ hs₀w h_quad
    let V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := (@projTime d) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo u w
    have hV_open : IsOpen V := isOpen_Ioo.preimage h_projTime_cont
    let z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 s₀
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ V := by simp [V, z₀, h_projTime_mk, hus₀, hs₀w]
    let Φ := sliceQuadTest d (p 0) 0 s₀ (c s₀) c₁ c₂ 0
    have hΦ_test := h_test (p 0) 0 0 s₀ (c s₀) c₁ c₂ 0 V
    have hΦ_z₀ : Φ z₀ = v₀ z₀ := by
      rw [hv_slice s₀ 0, hp_const s₀]
      unfold Φ sliceQuadTest
      rw [h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk]
      ring
    have hΦ_ge : ∀ z ∈ V, v₀ z ≤ Φ z := by
      intro z hz
      have h_vz : v₀ z = inner ℝ (p 0) (projSpace z) + c (projTime z) := by
        calc v₀ z = v₀ (mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z)) := by rw [h_mk_id z]
          _ = inner ℝ (p (projTime z)) (projSpace z) + c (projTime z) :=
              hv_slice (projTime z) (projSpace z)
          _ = inner ℝ (p 0) (projSpace z) + c (projTime z) := by rw [hp_const (projTime z)]
      have h_c_le := h_quad (projTime z) hz.1 hz.2
      unfold Φ sliceQuadTest
      linarith
    have h_visc := hv₀.2.1 z₀ Φ V hV_open hz₀_mem hΦ_test.1 hΦ_z₀ hΦ_ge
    rw [hΦ_test.2] at h_visc
    linarith
  have hc_lower : ∀ (u t w : ℝ), u ≤ t → t ≤ w →
      (w - u) * (-c t) ≤ (w - t) * (-c u) + (t - u) * (-c w) := by
    apply h_chord (fun s => -c s) hc_cont.neg
    intro u w s₀ c₁ c₂ hus₀ hs₀w h_quad
    let V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := (@projTime d) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo u w
    have hV_open : IsOpen V := isOpen_Ioo.preimage h_projTime_cont
    let z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 s₀
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ V := by simp [V, z₀, h_projTime_mk, hus₀, hs₀w]
    let Φ := sliceQuadTest d (p 0) 0 s₀ (c s₀) (-c₁) (-c₂) 0
    have hΦ_test := h_test (p 0) 0 0 s₀ (c s₀) (-c₁) (-c₂) 0 V
    have hΦ_z₀ : Φ z₀ = v₀ z₀ := by
      rw [hv_slice s₀ 0, hp_const s₀]
      unfold Φ sliceQuadTest
      rw [h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk]
      ring
    have hΦ_le : ∀ z ∈ V, Φ z ≤ v₀ z := by
      intro z hz
      have h_vz : v₀ z = inner ℝ (p 0) (projSpace z) + c (projTime z) := by
        calc v₀ z = v₀ (mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z)) := by rw [h_mk_id z]
          _ = inner ℝ (p (projTime z)) (projSpace z) + c (projTime z) :=
              hv_slice (projTime z) (projSpace z)
          _ = inner ℝ (p 0) (projSpace z) + c (projTime z) := by rw [hp_const (projTime z)]
      have h_c_le := h_quad (projTime z) hz.1 hz.2
      unfold Φ sliceQuadTest
      linarith
    have h_visc := hv₀.2.2.1 z₀ Φ V hV_open hz₀_mem hΦ_test.1 hΦ_z₀ hΦ_le
    rw [hΦ_test.2] at h_visc
    linarith
  have hc_chord_eq : ∀ (u t w : ℝ), u ≤ t → t ≤ w →
      (w - u) * c t = (w - t) * c u + (t - u) * c w := by
    intro u t w hut htw
    have h1 := hc_upper u t w hut htw
    have h2 := hc_lower u t w hut htw
    linarith
  have hc_aff : ∀ t : ℝ, c t = c 0 + (c 1 - c 0) * t := by
    intro t
    rcases le_total t 0 with ht0 | ht0
    · have h_eq := hc_chord_eq t 0 1 ht0 (by norm_num)
      linarith
    · rcases le_total t 1 with ht1 | ht1
      · have h_eq := hc_chord_eq 0 t 1 ht0 ht1
        linarith
      · have h_eq := hc_chord_eq 0 1 t (by norm_num) ht1
        linarith
  refine ⟨mkSpaceTime (p 0) (c 1 - c 0), c 0, fun z => ?_⟩
  have h_inner : inner ℝ (mkSpaceTime (p 0) (c 1 - c 0)) z =
      inner ℝ (p 0) (projSpace z) + (c 1 - c 0) * projTime z := by
    simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace, projTime, mul_comm]
  calc v₀ z = v₀ (mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z)) := by rw [h_mk_id z]
    _ = inner ℝ (p (projTime z)) (projSpace z) + c (projTime z) :=
        hv_slice (projTime z) (projSpace z)
    _ = inner ℝ (p 0) (projSpace z) + (c 0 + (c 1 - c 0) * projTime z) := by
        rw [hp_const (projTime z), hc_aff (projTime z)]
    _ = inner ℝ (mkSpaceTime (p 0) (c 1 - c 0)) z + c 0 := by
        rw [h_inner]; ring

affine_of_horizontally_affine_classA.definitions:
noncomputable def sliceQuadTest (d : ℕ) (p₀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  inner ℝ p₀ (projSpace z) + c₀ + c₁ * (projTime z - s₀) +
    (c₂ / 2) * (projTime z - s₀) ^ 2 + (α / 2) * ‖projSpace z - x‖ ^ 2

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀)
    (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv₀ : InLimitingClassA d C₀ v₀)
    (h_not_horiz : ¬ ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (c : ℝ),

proof.tactics:
by
  have test_s1 : ∀ (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ),
      (¬ ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (c : ℝ),
        ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), g x = inner ℝ p x + c) →
      ∃ (lam : ℝ) (y₁ y₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        0 < lam ∧ lam < 1 ∧ y₁ ≠ y₂ ∧
        (1 - lam) * g y₁ + lam * g y₂ ≠ g ((1 - lam) • y₁ + lam • y₂) := by
    intro g h_not_aff
    by_contra h_all
    push_neg at h_all
    have h_conv : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam < 1 → ∀ (y₁ y₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        g ((1 - lam) • y₁ + lam • y₂) = (1 - lam) * g y₁ + lam * g y₂ := by
      intro lam h0 h1 y₁ y₂
      by_cases hne : y₁ = y₂
      · subst hne
        have h_smul : (1 - lam) • y₁ + lam • y₁ = y₁ := by
          rw [← add_smul, sub_add_cancel, one_smul]
        rw [h_smul]
        ring
      · exact (h_all lam y₁ y₂ h0 h1 hne).symm
    let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x => g x - g 0
    have h0 : h 0 = 0 := sub_self (g 0)
    have h_conv_h : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam < 1 → ∀ (y₁ y₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        h ((1 - lam) • y₁ + lam • y₂) = (1 - lam) * h y₁ + lam * h y₂ := by
      intro lam hlam0 hlam1 y₁ y₂
      dsimp [h]
      rw [h_conv lam hlam0 hlam1 y₁ y₂]
      ring
    have h_smul_Ioo : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam < 1 → ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        h (lam • x) = lam * h x := by
      intro lam hlam0 hlam1 x
      have := h_conv_h lam hlam0 hlam1 0 x
      simpa [h0] using this
    have h_smul_gt_one : ∀ (c : ℝ), 1 < c → ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        h (c • x) = c * h x := by
      intro c hc x
      have hc_pos : 0 < c := by linarith
      have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc_pos
      have h_inv_pos : 0 < c⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hc_pos
      have h_inv_lt : c⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hc
      have h_eq := h_smul_Ioo c⁻¹ h_inv_pos h_inv_lt (c • x)
      rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc_ne, one_smul] at h_eq
      calc h (c • x) = c * (c⁻¹ * h (c • x)) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc_ne, one_mul]

    have h_smul_nonneg : ∀ (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        h (c • x) = c * h x := by
      intro c hc x
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc with rfl | hc_pos
      · simp [h0]
      · rcases lt_trichotomy c 1 with hc_lt | rfl | hc_gt
        · exact h_smul_Ioo c hc_pos hc_lt x
        · simp
        · exact h_smul_gt_one c hc_gt x
    have h_neg : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), h (-x) = -h x := by
      intro x
      have h_half := h_conv_h (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x (-x)
      have h_mid : (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) • x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (-x) = 0 := by
        ext i
        simp
        ring
      rw [h_mid, h0] at h_half
      linarith
    have h_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), h (c • x) = c * h x := by
      intro c x
      rcases le_or_gt 0 c with hc | hc

      · have h_neg_c : 0 ≤ -c := by linarith

        ring

      intro x y
      have h_half := h_conv_h (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ((2 : ℝ) • x) ((2 : ℝ) • y)
      have h_mid : (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) • ((2 : ℝ) • x) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((2 : ℝ) • y) = x + y := by

        simp
        ring

  have test_s2 : ∀ (C₁ : ℝ), C₀ ≤ C₁ →

      InLimitingClassA d C₁ (fun z => -v (mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (-projTime z))) := by
    intro C₁ hC v hv
    let S_fun : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=

      · intro i

      ext j

      · simp only [PiLp.add_apply, hS_last]
        ring
      · intro i
        simp only [PiLp.add_apply, hS_castSucc]

      · simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hS_last]
        ring

    let S_lin : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=

      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_

      · rw [hS_apply, hS_apply, hS_last, hS_last]
        simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
        ring
    have h_op : ∀ (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),

      intro ϕ z
      let ϕ_tilde : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := -(ϕ ∘ S)
      have h_fderiv1 : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),

        dsimp [ϕ_tilde]
        rw [fderiv_neg]
        congr 1

        intro u

      have h_fderiv1_eq : fderiv ℝ ϕ_tilde = -(A ∘ (fderiv ℝ ϕ ∘ S)) := by

        simp only [Pi.neg_apply, Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply,

      linarith
    · intro z ϕ V hV_open hzV hϕ_c2 hϕ_eq hϕ_le
      let ϕ_tilde : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun w => -ϕ (S w)

      have h_projT : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),

        intro y s

  rw [not_forall] at h_not_horiz

  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h_def_ne with h_lt | h_gt
  · let w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
      fun z => -v₀ (mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (-projTime z))
    have hw₀_class : InLimitingClassA d (max C₀ 1) w₀ :=
      test_s2 (max C₀ 1) (le_max_left C₀ 1) v₀ hv₀
    refine ⟨w₀, -t₀, 2, θ₀, y₀, hw₀_class, hθ₀_pos, hθ₀_sum, hr₀_pos, ?_⟩

  · have hv₀_max : InLimitingClassA d (max C₀ 1) v₀ := by
      refine ⟨hv₀.1, hv₀.2.1, hv₀.2.2.1, fun x t R hR => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨p, a, hpa⟩ := hv₀.2.2.2 x t R hR
      exact ⟨p, a, fun h ℓ hℓ hh =>
        le_trans (hpa h ℓ hℓ hh) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left C₀ 1) (le_of_lt hR))⟩
    refine ⟨v₀, t₀, 2, θ₀, y₀, hv₀_max, hθ₀_pos, hθ₀_sum, hr₀_pos, ?_⟩
    have h_eq := h_eval g
    dsimp [g] at h_eq h_gt
    rw [h_eq]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hw₀ : InLimitingClassA d C₁ w₀)
    (t₀ : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ) (θ₀ : Fin N₀ → ℝ) (y₀ : Fin N₀ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hθ₀_pos : ∀ i, 0 < θ₀ i) (hθ₀_sum : ∑ i, θ₀ i = 1)
    (hr₀_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ₀ i * ‖y₀ i - ∑ j, θ₀ j • y₀ j‖ ^ 2))
    (h_def_pos : 0 < (∑ i, θ₀ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y₀ i) t₀)) -
      w₀ (mkSpaceTime (∑ j, θ₀ j • y₀ j) t₀)) :
    ∃ κ : ℝ,
      0 < κ ∧
      HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ w₀ ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ,
        ∃ (t_j : ℝ) (N_j : ℕ) (θ_j : Fin N_j → ℝ) (y_j : Fin N_j → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ_j i) ∧
          (∑ i, θ_j i = 1) ∧
          0 < Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ_j i * ‖y_j i - ∑ k, θ_j k • y_j k‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (κ - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ_j i * ‖y_j i - ∑ k, θ_j k • y_j k‖ ^ 2) ≤
            (∑ i, θ_j i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_j i) t_j)) -
              w₀ (mkSpaceTime (∑ k, θ_j k • y_j k) t_j)

(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hw₀ : InLimitingClassA d C₁ w₀)
    (t₀ : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ) (θ₀ : Fin N₀ → ℝ) (y₀ : Fin N₀ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hθ₀_pos : ∀ i, 0 < θ₀ i) (hθ₀_sum : ∑ i, θ₀ i = 1)
    (hr₀_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ₀ i * ‖y₀ i - ∑ j, θ₀ j • y₀ j‖ ^ 2))
    (h_def_pos : 0 < (∑ i, θ₀ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y₀ i) t₀)) -
      w₀ (mkSpaceTime (∑ j, θ₀ j • y₀ j) t₀)) :
    ∃ κ : ℝ,

      HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ w₀ ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ,
        ∃ (t_j : ℝ) (N_j : ℕ) (θ_j : Fin N_j → ℝ) (y_j : Fin N_j → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
