proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_zero_var : ∀ (t : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) →
      Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - ∑ k, θ k • y k‖ ^ 2) ≤ 0 →
      Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - ∑ k, θ k • y k‖ ^ 2) = 0 ∧
      (∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime (∑ k, θ k • y k) t) = 0 := by
    intro t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hr_le
    set x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ k, θ k • y k
    set V : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hr_eq : Real.sqrt V = 0 := le_antisymm hr_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg V)
    have hV_eq : V = 0 := by
      have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hV_nonneg
      rw [hr_eq] at hsq
      linarith
    have h_terms : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)), θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _))).mp hV_eq
    have hy_eq : ∀ i : Fin N, y i = x := by
      intro i
      have hi := h_terms i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have h_sq_zero : ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        cases mul_eq_zero.mp hi with
        | inl hθ0 => linarith [hθ_pos i]
        | inr hsq0 => exact hsq0
      have h_norm_zero : ‖y i - x‖ = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h_sq_zero
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp h_norm_zero)
    have h_sum_w : (∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) = w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
      calc ∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)
        _ = ∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
            rw [hy_eq i]
        _ = (∑ i, θ i) * w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) := by rw [hθ_sum, one_mul]
    exact ⟨hr_eq, by linarith⟩
  
  have h_lin_cancel : ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
      (p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∑ i, θ i = 1) →
      ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - ∑ k, θ k • y k) = 0 := by
    intro N θ y p₀ hθ_sum
    set x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ k, θ k • y k
    have h_step : ∀ i : Fin N,
        θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x) = inner ℝ p₀ (θ i • y i) - θ i * inner ℝ p₀ x := by
      intro i
      rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right]
      ring
    calc ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x)
      _ = ∑ i, (inner ℝ p₀ (θ i • y i) - θ i * inner ℝ p₀ x) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => h_step i)
      _ = (∑ i, inner ℝ p₀ (θ i • y i)) - ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ x := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ = inner ℝ p₀ (∑ i, θ i • y i) - (∑ i, θ i) * inner ℝ p₀ x := by
          rw [← inner_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = inner ℝ p₀ x - 1 * inner ℝ p₀ x := by
          rw [hθ_sum]
      _ = 0 := by ring
  
  have h_two_radius : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ∃ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
          r * (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p₀ h) ≤
            C₁ * (5 * r ^ 2 + 3 * ‖h‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro x t r hr
    obtain ⟨p₀, a₀, hp₀⟩ := hw₀.2.2.2 x t r hr
    have hp₀_horiz : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖u‖ ≤ r →
        |w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + u) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p₀ u| ≤ C₁ * r := by
      intro u hu
      have h0 : |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ r := by simp [le_of_lt hr]
      have hu0 : ‖u - (0 : ℝ) • p₀‖ ≤ r := by simpa using hu
      have hfit := hp₀ u 0 h0 hu0
      simpa using hfit
    refine ⟨p₀, fun h => ?_⟩
    set R : ℝ := r + ‖h‖
    have h_norm_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖h‖ := norm_nonneg h
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
    obtain ⟨p_R, a_R, hp_R⟩ := hw₀.2.2.2 x t R hR_pos
    have hp_R_horiz : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖v‖ ≤ R →
        |w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + v) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p_R v| ≤ C₁ * R := by
      intro v hv
      have h0 : |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ R := by simp [le_of_lt hR_pos]
      have hv0 : ‖v - (0 : ℝ) • p_R‖ ≤ R := by simpa using hv
      have hfit := hp_R v 0 h0 hv0
      simpa using hfit
    set u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (r / R) • h
    have hrR_nonneg : 0 ≤ r / R := div_nonneg (le_of_lt hr) (le_of_lt hR_pos)
    have hu_norm : ‖u‖ = (r / R) * ‖h‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hrR_nonneg]
    have hu_le_r : ‖u‖ ≤ r := by
      rw [hu_norm]
      have h_le : (r / R) * ‖h‖ ≤ (r / R) * R :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hrR_nonneg
      have h_cancel : (r / R) * R = r := div_mul_cancel₀ r (ne_of_gt hR_pos)
      linarith
    have hu_le_R : ‖u‖ ≤ R := by linarith
    have h_fit_r_u : w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + u) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p₀ u ≤ C₁ * r :=
      (abs_le.mp (hp₀_horiz u hu_le_r)).2
    have h_fit_R_u : -(C₁ * R) ≤ w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + u) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p_R u :=
      (abs_le.mp (hp_R_horiz u hu_le_R)).1
    have h_diff_u : inner ℝ p_R u - inner ℝ p₀ u ≤ C₁ * (r + R) := by linarith
    have h_inner_u : inner ℝ p_R u - inner ℝ p₀ u = (r / R) * (inner ℝ p_R h - inner ℝ p₀ h) := by
      simp only [u, real_inner_smul_right]
      ring
    rw [h_inner_u] at h_diff_u
    have h_mul_R : R * ((r / R) * (inner ℝ p_R h - inner ℝ p₀ h)) ≤ R * (C₁ * (r + R)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_u (le_of_lt hR_pos)
    have h_R_cancel : R * ((r / R) * (inner ℝ p_R h - inner ℝ p₀ h)) =
        r * (inner ℝ p_R h - inner ℝ p₀ h) := by
      calc R * ((r / R) * (inner ℝ p_R h - inner ℝ p₀ h))
        _ = (R * (r / R)) * (inner ℝ p_R h - inner ℝ p₀ h) := by ring
        _ = r * (inner ℝ p_R h - inner ℝ p₀ h) := by rw [mul_div_cancel₀ r (ne_of_gt hR_pos)]
    rw [h_R_cancel] at h_mul_R
    have hh_le_R : ‖h‖ ≤ R := by linarith
    have h_fit_R_h : w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p_R h ≤ C₁ * R :=
      (abs_le.mp (hp_R_horiz h hh_le_R)).2
    have h_mul_r : r * (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p_R h) ≤
        r * (C₁ * R) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_fit_R_h (le_of_lt hr)
    have h_comb : r * (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p₀ h) ≤
        C₁ * (3 * r ^ 2 + 4 * r * ‖h‖ + ‖h‖ ^ 2) := by
      have h_alg : C₁ * (3 * r ^ 2 + 4 * r * ‖h‖ + ‖h‖ ^ 2) =
          R * (C₁ * (r + R)) + r * (C₁ * R) := by
        simp only [R]
        ring
      linarith
    have h_sq : 0 ≤ C₁ * (2 * (r - ‖h‖) ^ 2) :=
      mul_nonneg hC₁ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg (r - ‖h‖)))
    linarith
  
  have hw₀_8C₁ : HasHorizontalJensenBound d (8 * C₁) w₀ := by
    intro t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only
    set x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
    set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)
    by_cases hr : r ≤ 0
    · obtain ⟨hr_eq, h_def_eq⟩ := h_zero_var t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hr
      change r = 0 at hr_eq
      change (∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) = 0 at h_def_eq
      change (∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ (8 * C₁) * r
      rw [hr_eq, h_def_eq, mul_zero]
    · push_neg at hr
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := h_two_radius x t r hr
      have h_pt : ∀ i : Fin N,
          θ i * (r * (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x))) ≤
            θ i * (C₁ * (5 * r ^ 2 + 3 * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)) := by
        intro i
        have hi := hp₀ (y i - x)
        rw [add_sub_cancel] at hi
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i))
      have h_sum_le :
          ∑ i, θ i * (r * (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x))) ≤
            ∑ i, θ i * (C₁ * (5 * r ^ 2 + 3 * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_pt i)
      have h_lhs :
          ∑ i, θ i * (r * (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x))) =
            r * ((∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - (∑ i, θ i) * w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) -
              ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x)) := by
        calc ∑ i, θ i * (r * (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x)))
          _ = r * ∑ i, (θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t) - θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) -
                θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x)) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
          _ = r * ((∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - (∑ i, θ i) * w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t) -
                ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      have h_lin0 : ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x) = 0 := h_lin_cancel N θ y p₀ hθ_sum
      rw [hθ_sum, one_mul, h_lin0, sub_zero] at h_lhs
      have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _))
      have hr_sq : ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hV_nonneg).symm
      have h_rhs :
          ∑ i, θ i * (C₁ * (5 * r ^ 2 + 3 * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)) = r * ((8 * C₁) * r) := by
        calc ∑ i, θ i * (C₁ * (5 * r ^ 2 + 3 * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2))
          _ = ∑ i, (C₁ * 5 * r ^ 2 * θ i + C₁ * 3 * (θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
          _ = C₁ * 5 * r ^ 2 * (∑ i, θ i) + C₁ * 3 * (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          _ = C₁ * 5 * r ^ 2 * 1 + C₁ * 3 * r ^ 2 := by rw [hθ_sum, hr_sq]
          _ = r * ((8 * C₁) * r) := by ring
      rw [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_sum_le
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_sum_le hr
  
  let S : Set ℝ := { κ' : ℝ | HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ' w₀ }
  let κ : ℝ := sInf S
  have hS_ne : S.Nonempty := ⟨8 * C₁, hw₀_8C₁⟩
  set x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ j, θ₀ j • y₀ j
  set r₀ : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ₀ i * ‖y₀ i - x₀‖ ^ 2)
  set D₀ : ℝ := (∑ i, θ₀ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y₀ i) t₀)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)
  have hS_lb : ∀ κ' ∈ S, D₀ / r₀ ≤ κ' := by
    intro κ' hκ'
    have h_bound := hκ' t₀ N₀ θ₀ y₀ hθ₀_pos hθ₀_sum
    dsimp only at h_bound
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hr₀_pos).mpr h_bound
  have hS_bdd : BddBelow S := ⟨D₀ / r₀, hS_lb⟩
  have hκ_ge : D₀ / r₀ ≤ κ := le_csInf hS_ne hS_lb
  have hD₀_div_pos : 0 < D₀ / r₀ := div_pos h_def_pos hr₀_pos
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := lt_of_lt_of_le hD₀_div_pos hκ_ge
  have hw₀_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ w₀ := by
    intro t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only
    set x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
    set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)
    set D : ℝ := (∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x t)
    by_cases hr : r ≤ 0
    · obtain ⟨hr_eq, hD_eq⟩ := h_zero_var t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hr
      change r = 0 at hr_eq
      change D = 0 at hD_eq
      change D ≤ κ * r
      rw [hr_eq, hD_eq, mul_zero]
    · push_neg at hr
      have h_lb : ∀ κ' ∈ S, D / r ≤ κ' := by
        intro κ' hκ'
        have h_bound := hκ' t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
        dsimp only at h_bound
        exact (div_le_iff₀ hr).mpr h_bound
      have h_le_κ : D / r ≤ κ := le_csInf hS_ne h_lb
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hr).mp h_le_κ
  have h_configs : ∀ j : ℕ,
      ∃ (t_j : ℝ) (N_j : ℕ) (θ_j : Fin N_j → ℝ) (y_j : Fin N_j → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ_j i) ∧
        (∑ i, θ_j i = 1) ∧
        0 < Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ_j i * ‖y_j i - ∑ k, θ_j k • y_j k‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (κ - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ_j i * ‖y_j i - ∑ k, θ_j k • y_j k‖ ^ 2) ≤
          (∑ i, θ_j i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_j i) t_j)) -
            w₀ (mkSpaceTime (∑ k, θ_j k • y_j k) t_j) := by
    intro j
    set ε_j : ℝ := min (κ / 2) (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
    have hj_pos : 0 < (j : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε_j := lt_min (by linarith) (div_pos zero_lt_one hj_pos)
    have h_lt_κ : κ - ε_j < κ := by linarith
    have h_not_mem : κ - ε_j ∉ S := notMem_of_lt_csInf h_lt_κ hS_bdd
    change ¬ HasHorizontalJensenBound d (κ - ε_j) w₀ at h_not_mem
    unfold HasHorizontalJensenBound at h_not_mem
    push_neg at h_not_mem
    obtain ⟨t_j, N_j, θ_j, y_j, hθ_j_pos, hθ_j_sum, h_viol⟩ := h_not_mem
    set x_j : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ k, θ_j k • y_j k
    set r_j : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ_j i * ‖y_j i - x_j‖ ^ 2)
    set D_j : ℝ := (∑ i, θ_j i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_j i) t_j)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_j t_j)
    change ¬ (D_j ≤ (κ - ε_j) * r_j) at h_viol
    push_neg at h_viol
    have hr_j_pos : 0 < r_j := by
      by_contra hr_le
      push_neg at hr_le
      obtain ⟨hr_eq, hD_eq⟩ := h_zero_var t_j N_j θ_j y_j hθ_j_pos hθ_j_sum hr_le
      change r_j = 0 at hr_eq
      change D_j = 0 at hD_eq
      rw [hr_eq, hD_eq, mul_zero] at h_viol
      exact lt_irrefl 0 h_viol
    have hε_le : ε_j ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := min_le_right (κ / 2) (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
    have h_coeff : κ - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ κ - ε_j := by linarith
    have h_mul : (κ - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) * r_j ≤ (κ - ε_j) * r_j :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coeff (le_of_lt hr_j_pos)

noncomputable def shearedFrameTransform (d : ℕ)
    (w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ R : ℝ)
    (p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₀ : ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let y := projSpace z
  let s := projTime z
  (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + R • (y + (s - 1) • p₀)) (t₀ + R * (s - 1))) -
    w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) / R -
    inner ℝ p₀ y - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s - 1)

by
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_bary_mem : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∈
        { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
          val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t)))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) } := by
    intro x t
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => x, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [h_projSpace]
    · simp [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  have h_bary_ub : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ val ∈
        { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
          val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t)))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) },
        val ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 := by
    intro x t ht val hval
    rcases hval with ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
    rw [h_projSpace] at hy_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projTime]
    have hj := hv_jensen t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at hj
    rw [hy_mean] at hj
    set V : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2
    set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt V
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = V := Real.sq_sqrt hV_nonneg
    have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ * t) ^ 2 / (2 * t) :=
      div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have h_id : κ * r - V / (2 * t) = κ ^ 2 * t / 2 - (r - κ * t) ^ 2 / (2 * t) := by
      rw [← hr_sq]
      have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
      field_simp [ht_ne]
      ring
    linarith
  have hW_comp : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • y i = x) →
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤
            shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    intro x t ht N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hy_mean
    unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope
    rw [h_projTime]
    have h_le : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) ≤
          barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
      apply le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2, h_bary_ub x t ht⟩
      refine ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [h_projSpace, hy_mean]
      · rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
    linarith
  have hW_sand : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    intro x t ht
    unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope
    rw [h_projTime]
    have h_lb : v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) :=
      le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2, h_bary_ub x t ht⟩ (h_bary_mem x t)
    have h_ub : barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 :=
      csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t), h_bary_mem x t⟩ (h_bary_ub x t ht)
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hQ_ub : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < t → 0 < ℓ →
      ∀ b ∈ (fun y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y' (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) + ℓ)) -
          ‖y' - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ,
        b ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) + ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    rintro x t ℓ ht hℓ b ⟨y', -, rfl⟩
    rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
    have hW_le_v : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y' (t + ℓ)) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime y' (t + ℓ)) :=
      (hW_sand y' (t + ℓ) (by linarith)).2
    have hv_le := (h_comp x y' t ℓ hℓ).1
    linarith
  have hW_quad_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < t → 0 < ℓ →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) -
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    intro x y t ℓ ht hℓ
    have h_in : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) -
        ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ∈
          (fun y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
            shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y' (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) + ℓ)) -
              ‖y' - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ := by
      refine ⟨y, Set.mem_univ y, ?_⟩
      rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
    have h_le_sup : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) -
        ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x t) :=
      le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t) + ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t), hQ_ub x t ℓ ht hℓ⟩ h_in
    unfold slopePlus
    have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ
    have h_mul : ℓ * ((quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x t) -
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) / ℓ) =
      quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x t) -
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) :=
      mul_div_cancel₀ _ hℓ_ne
    linarith
  have hW_ub : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h →
      slopePlus d h (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime 0 1) ≤
        slopePlus d h v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
    intro h hh
    have h_sup_le : quadEnvelopePlus d h (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime 0 1) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) + h * slopePlus d h v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
      apply csSup_le
      · exact ⟨_, ⟨0, Set.mem_univ 0, rfl⟩⟩
      · exact hQ_ub 0 1 h zero_lt_one hh
    have hW_eq : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
      unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope
      rw [h_projTime]
      linarith [hv_gap]
    change (quadEnvelopePlus d h (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime 0 1) -
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)) / h ≤
      slopePlus d h v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hh]
    linarith [h_sup_le, hW_eq]
  exact ⟨hW_comp, hW_sand, hW_quad_comp, hW_ub⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_attain : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)))
    (h_mono : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ₁ → ℓ₁ ≤ ℓ₂ →
      slopePlus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopePlus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      slopeMinus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (hW_comp : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • y i = x) →
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤
            shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (hW_quad_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < t → 0 < ℓ →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) -
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (x₀ x₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ ℓ τ : ℝ)
    (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓτ : ℓ ≤ τ) :
    shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₁ (t₀ + ℓ)) -
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) - ‖x₁ - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d τ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hτ : 0 < τ := lt_of_lt_of_le hℓ hℓτ
  have hτ_ne : τ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hτ
  have h_var : ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y z : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
      (x_y x_z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • y i = x_y) → (∑ i, θ i • z i = x_z) → 0 < s →
      (∑ i, θ i * (‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s))) + (∑ i, θ i * ‖z i - x_z‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀) =
        ‖x_y - x_z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) + (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x_y‖ ^ 2) / (2 * (t₀ + s)) +
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖t₀ • (y i - x_y) - (t₀ + s) • (z i - x_z)‖ ^ 2) /
          (2 * t₀ * s * (t₀ + s)) := by
    intro N θ y z x_y x_z s hθ_sum hy_mean hz_mean hs
    let ξ : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => y i - x_y
    let ζ : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => z i - x_z
    let a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x_y - x_z
    let w : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => ξ i - ζ i
    have hw_eq : ∀ i, θ i • w i = (θ i • y i - θ i • x_y) - (θ i • z i - θ i • x_z) := by
      intro i
      simp only [w, ξ, ζ, smul_sub]
    have hw_sum : ∑ i, θ i • w i = 0 := by
      simp_rw [hw_eq, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, hy_mean, hz_mean, hθ_sum,
        one_smul, sub_self]
    have hyz_eq : ∀ i, y i - z i = a + w i := by
      intro i
      simp only [a, w, ξ, ζ]
      abel
    have h_norm_yz : ∀ i, θ i * ‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2 =
        θ i * ‖a‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ a (θ i • w i) + θ i * ‖w i‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro i
      rw [hyz_eq i, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right]
      ring
    have h_sum_yz : ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ∑ i, θ i * ‖w i‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp_rw [h_norm_yz]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hθ_sum, one_mul,
          ← Finset.mul_sum, ← inner_sum, hw_sum, inner_zero_right, mul_zero, add_zero]
    have h_res_sq : ∀ i, ‖t₀ • ξ i - (t₀ + s) • ζ i‖ ^ 2 =
        t₀ ^ 2 * ‖ξ i‖ ^ 2 - 2 * t₀ * (t₀ + s) * inner ℝ (ξ i) (ζ i) +
          (t₀ + s) ^ 2 * ‖ζ i‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro i
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
      ring
    have h_pt : ∀ i,
        θ i * ‖w i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) + θ i * ‖ζ i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * t₀) =
          θ i * ‖ξ i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (t₀ + s)) +
          θ i * ‖t₀ • ξ i - (t₀ + s) • ζ i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * t₀ * s * (t₀ + s)) := by
      intro i
      have ht₀_ne : t₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht₀
      have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs
      have hts_ne : t₀ + s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (add_pos ht₀ hs)
      have hw_sq : ‖w i‖ ^ 2 = ‖ξ i‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (ξ i) (ζ i) + ‖ζ i‖ ^ 2 :=
        norm_sub_sq_real (ξ i) (ζ i)
      rw [hw_sq, h_res_sq i]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h_sum_pt :
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖w i‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s) + (∑ i, θ i * ‖ζ i‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀) =
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ i‖ ^ 2) / (2 * (t₀ + s)) +
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖t₀ • ξ i - (t₀ + s) • ζ i‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀ * s * (t₀ + s)) := by
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, h_pt]
    simp_rw [← mul_div_assoc, ← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [h_sum_yz, add_div, add_assoc]
    exact (congrArg (‖a‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) + ·) h_sum_pt).trans (add_assoc _ _ _).symm
  have h_interp : ∀ (z_pt y_pt : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ∃ y_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_pt (t₀ + ℓ)) - ‖y_pt - z_pt‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          (1 - ℓ / τ) * v (mkSpaceTime z_pt t₀) +
          (ℓ / τ) * (v (mkSpaceTime y_hat (t₀ + τ)) - ‖y_hat - z_pt‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ)) := by
    intro z_pt y_pt
    obtain ⟨y_hat, hy_hat⟩ := (h_attain z_pt t₀ τ hτ).1
    refine ⟨y_hat, ?_⟩
    have h_c := (h_comp z_pt y_pt t₀ ℓ hℓ).1
    have h_m := (h_mono z_pt t₀ ℓ τ hℓ hℓτ).1
    have h_m_mul : ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime z_pt t₀) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d τ v (mkSpaceTime z_pt t₀) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_m (le_of_lt hℓ)
    have h_scale : v (mkSpaceTime z_pt t₀) + ℓ * slopePlus d τ v (mkSpaceTime z_pt t₀) =
        (1 - ℓ / τ) * v (mkSpaceTime z_pt t₀) +
        (ℓ / τ) * (v (mkSpaceTime y_hat (t₀ + τ)) - ‖y_hat - z_pt‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ)) := by
      have h_mul_τ : ℓ * slopePlus d τ v (mkSpaceTime z_pt t₀) =
          (ℓ / τ) * (τ * slopePlus d τ v (mkSpaceTime z_pt t₀)) := by
        field_simp
      rw [h_mul_τ, ← hy_hat]
      ring
    linarith
  have h_config : ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • y i = x₁) →
      (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (t₀ + ℓ))) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x₁‖ ^ 2) / (2 * (t₀ + ℓ)) ≤
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) +
        κ ^ 2 * (t₀ + ℓ) / 2 + ‖x₁ - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) +
        ℓ * slopePlus d τ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) := by
    intro N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hy_mean
    let z : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
      fun i => x₀ + (t₀ / (t₀ + ℓ)) • (y i - x₁)
    have hz_eq : ∀ i, θ i • z i =
        θ i • x₀ + (t₀ / (t₀ + ℓ)) • (θ i • y i - θ i • x₁) := by
      intro i
      simp only [z, smul_add]
      rw [smul_comm, smul_sub]
    have hz_mean : ∑ i, θ i • z i = x₀ := by
      simp_rw [hz_eq, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        ← Finset.sum_smul, hy_mean, hθ_sum, one_smul, sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero]
    have h_res_zero : ∀ i, t₀ • (y i - x₁) - (t₀ + ℓ) • (z i - x₀) = 0 := by
      intro i
      have htℓ_ne : t₀ + ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (add_pos ht₀ hℓ)
      have hz_sub : z i - x₀ = (t₀ / (t₀ + ℓ)) • (y i - x₁) := add_sub_cancel_left x₀ _
      rw [hz_sub, smul_smul, mul_div_cancel₀ t₀ htℓ_ne, sub_self]
    have h_var_ℓ := h_var N θ y z x₁ x₀ ℓ hθ_sum hy_mean hz_mean hℓ
    simp only [h_res_zero, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow,
      mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_div, add_zero] at h_var_ℓ
    let y_hat : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
      fun i => Classical.choose (h_interp (z i) (y i))
    have hy_hat : ∀ i,
        v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (t₀ + ℓ)) - ‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          (1 - ℓ / τ) * v (mkSpaceTime (z i) t₀) +
          (ℓ / τ) * (v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (t₀ + τ)) - ‖y_hat i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ)) :=
      fun i => Classical.choose_spec (h_interp (z i) (y i))
    have h_sum_interp :
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (t₀ + ℓ))) -
          (∑ i, θ i * (‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ))) ≤
          (1 - ℓ / τ) * (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z i) t₀)) +
          (ℓ / τ) * ((∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (t₀ + τ))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * (‖y_hat i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ)))) := by
      have h_le : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ,
          θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (t₀ + ℓ)) - θ i * (‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) ≤
            (1 - ℓ / τ) * (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z i) t₀)) +
            (ℓ / τ) * (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (t₀ + τ)) -
              θ i * (‖y_hat i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ))) := by
        intro i _
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hy_hat i) (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i))
        calc θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (t₀ + ℓ)) - θ i * (‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ))
          _ = θ i * (v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (t₀ + ℓ)) - ‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) := by ring
          _ ≤ θ i * ((1 - ℓ / τ) * v (mkSpaceTime (z i) t₀) +
                (ℓ / τ) * (v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (t₀ + τ)) -
                  ‖y_hat i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ))) := h_mul
          _ = (1 - ℓ / τ) * (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z i) t₀)) +
              (ℓ / τ) * (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (t₀ + τ)) -
                θ i * (‖y_hat i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ))) := by ring
      have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_le
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at h_sum
      exact h_sum
    let x_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y_hat i
    have h_var_τ := h_var N θ y_hat z x_hat x₀ τ hθ_sum rfl hz_mean hτ
    have h_res_nonneg :
        0 ≤ (∑ i, θ i * ‖t₀ • (y_hat i - x_hat) - (t₀ + τ) • (z i - x₀)‖ ^ 2) /
          (2 * t₀ * τ * (t₀ + τ)) := by
      apply div_nonneg
      · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro i _
        exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
      · positivity
    have h_var_τ_le :
        ‖x_hat - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ) + (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_hat i - x_hat‖ ^ 2) / (2 * (t₀ + τ)) ≤
          (∑ i, θ i * (‖y_hat i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ))) +
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖z i - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀) := by
      linarith [h_var_τ, h_res_nonneg]
    have h_comp_z := hW_comp x₀ t₀ ht₀ N θ z hθ_pos hθ_sum hz_mean
    have h_comp_yhat :=
      hW_comp x_hat (t₀ + τ) (add_pos ht₀ hτ) N θ y_hat hθ_pos hθ_sum rfl
    have h_quad_xhat := hW_quad_comp x₀ x_hat t₀ τ ht₀ hτ
    have h_step_0 :
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z i) t₀)) ≤
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖z i - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀) +
          κ ^ 2 * t₀ / 2 +
          shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) := by
      linarith [h_comp_z]
    have h_step_τ :
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (t₀ + τ))) -
          (∑ i, θ i * (‖y_hat i - z i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ))) ≤
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖z i - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀) +
          κ ^ 2 * (t₀ + τ) / 2 +
          shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) +
          τ * slopePlus d τ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) := by
      linarith [h_comp_yhat, h_quad_xhat, h_var_τ_le]
    have h_w1_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - ℓ / τ := sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one hτ).mpr hℓτ)
    have h_w2_nonneg : 0 ≤ ℓ / τ := div_nonneg (le_of_lt hℓ) (le_of_lt hτ)
    have h_mul_0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_step_0 h_w1_nonneg
    have h_mul_τ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_step_τ h_w2_nonneg
    have h_comb_rhs :
        (1 - ℓ / τ) * ((∑ i, θ i * ‖z i - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀) +
          κ ^ 2 * t₀ / 2 +
          shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) +
        (ℓ / τ) * ((∑ i, θ i * ‖z i - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀) +
          κ ^ 2 * (t₀ + τ) / 2 +
          shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) +
          τ * slopePlus d τ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) =
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖z i - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t₀) +
          κ ^ 2 * (t₀ + ℓ) / 2 +
          shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) +
          ℓ * slopePlus d τ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    linarith [h_var_ℓ, h_sum_interp, h_mul_0, h_mul_τ, h_comb_rhs]
  have h_time : projTime (mkSpaceTime x₁ (t₀ + ℓ)) = t₀ + ℓ := by
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_space : projSpace (mkSpaceTime x₁ (t₀ + ℓ)) = x₁ := by
    ext j
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_bary_le :
      barycentricEnvelope d (projTime (mkSpaceTime x₁ (t₀ + ℓ))) v (mkSpaceTime x₁ (t₀ + ℓ)) ≤
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) +
        κ ^ 2 * (t₀ + ℓ) / 2 + ‖x₁ - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) +
        ℓ * slopePlus d τ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) := by
    unfold barycentricEnvelope
    rw [h_time, h_space]
    apply csSup_le
    · refine ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x₁ (t₀ + ℓ)), 1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => x₁,
        fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
      simp
    · rintro val ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
      exact h_config N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hy_mean
  unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope at *
  rw [h_time] at h_bary_le ⊢
  linarith [h_bary_le]

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (κ H_star : ℝ)
    (hκ_pos : 0 < κ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (hv_gap : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2)
    (hv_slope_minus : Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H_star))
    (hW_comp : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • y i = x) →
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤
            shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (hW_sand : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (hW_quad_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < t → 0 < ℓ →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) -
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (hW_step_mono : ∀ (x₀ x₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ ℓ τ : ℝ),
      0 < t₀ → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ τ →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₁ (t₀ + ℓ)) -
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) - ‖x₁ - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          ℓ * slopePlus d τ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀))
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    H_star ≤ slopePlus d h (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime 0 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).injective
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have hW_center : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
    dsimp [shiftedBarycentricEnvelope]
    rw [h_projTime]
    linarith [hv_gap]
  
  have h_step : ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ 1 / 2 →
      ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ C₀ * ℓ ∧
        (h + ℓ) * (slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - ℓ) ≤
          quadEnvelopePlus d (h + ℓ) (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) -
            shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) := by
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := h_growth (1 / 2) 1 (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
    have hM₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ M₀ := by
      have h0 := hM₀ 0 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      have h_abs : 0 ≤ |v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)| := abs_nonneg _
      simp only [norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero,
        add_zero] at h0
      linarith
    refine ⟨4 * (2 * M₀ + 1), by linarith, fun ℓ hℓ_pos hℓ_le => ?_⟩
    have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ_pos
    have h_qminus_eq : quadEnvelopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) =
        v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
      dsimp [slopeMinus]
      field_simp [hℓ_ne]
      ring
    have h_lt_csInf : quadEnvelopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) <
        v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) + ℓ ^ 2 := by
      linarith [sq_pos_of_pos hℓ_pos]
    obtain ⟨val, ⟨y, _, rfl⟩, hy_lt⟩ :=
      exists_lt_of_csInf_lt (Set.univ_nonempty.image _) h_lt_csInf
    dsimp only at hy_lt
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace, sub_zero] at hy_lt
    have hy_loc : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (2 * M₀ + 1) * ℓ := by
      have h_c0 := (h_comp 0 0 1 ℓ hℓ_pos).2
      simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow,
        zero_div, sub_zero] at h_c0
      have h_v0_ub : v (mkSpaceTime 0 (1 - ℓ)) ≤ M₀ := by
        have h0 := hM₀ 0 (1 - ℓ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        simp only [norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero,
          add_zero] at h0
        exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h0
      have h_vy_lb : -M₀ - 1 / 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) := by
        have hy := hM₀ y (1 - ℓ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have hy' := neg_le_of_abs_le hy
        linarith
      have hℓ_sq : ℓ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      have h_div_ub : ‖y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤ 2 * M₀ + 1 + 1 / 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by linarith
      have h_mul_ub : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * M₀ + 1 + 1 / 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (2 * ℓ) :=
        (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)).mp h_div_ub
      have h_y_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg ‖y‖
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨y, hy_loc, ?_⟩
    have hW_y_le : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) := (hW_sand y (1 - ℓ) (by linarith)).2
    have h_mono := hW_step_mono y 0 (1 - ℓ) ℓ (h + ℓ) (by linarith) hℓ_pos (by linarith)
    have h_time_eq : 1 - ℓ + ℓ = 1 := sub_add_cancel 1 ℓ
    have h_norm_eq : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) - y‖ = ‖y‖ := by rw [zero_sub, norm_neg]
    rw [h_time_eq, h_norm_eq, hW_center] at h_mono
    have h_ℓ_slope : ℓ * (slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d (h + ℓ) (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) := by
      linarith
    have h_slope : slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - ℓ ≤
        slopePlus d (h + ℓ) (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) :=
      le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_ℓ_slope hℓ_pos
    dsimp [slopePlus] at h_slope
    have h_mul := (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < h + ℓ)).mp h_slope
    linarith
  
  have h_lsc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ ρ → ‖y‖ ≤ ρ →
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - δ ≤
          shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) := by
    intro δ hδ_pos
    have h_bary_nonempty : { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)) ∧
        val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)))) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) }.Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨_, 1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => projSpace (mkSpaceTime 0 1), fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, by simp, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨val, ⟨N, θ, z₀, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hz₀_mean, rfl⟩, hval_gt⟩ :=
      exists_lt_of_lt_csSup h_bary_nonempty
        (by linarith : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - δ / 2 <
          barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
    rw [h_projSpace] at hz₀_mean
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace] at hval_gt
    let F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ → ℝ := fun p =>
      (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z₀ i + p.1) (1 - p.2))) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖z₀ i - 0‖ ^ 2) / (2 * (1 - p.2)) -
        κ ^ 2 * (1 - p.2) / 2
    have hF_cont : ContinuousAt F (0, 0) := by
      have h_sum_cont : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ =>
          ∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z₀ i + p.1) (1 - p.2))) := by
        apply continuous_finsetSum
        intro i _
        refine continuous_const.mul (hv_cont.comp ?_)
        refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp (continuous_pi ?_)
        intro k
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ k
        · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
          exact continuous_const.sub continuous_snd
        · intro j
          simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
          exact ((continuous_apply j).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous).comp
            (continuous_const.add continuous_fst)
      refine ((h_sum_cont.continuousAt.sub ?_).sub ?_)
      · refine ContinuousAt.div continuousAt_const ?_ (by norm_num)
        exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd)).continuousAt
      · exact ((continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd)).div_const 2).continuousAt
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hF_cont (δ / 2) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨min (ρ₀ / 2) (1 / 2), by positivity, min_le_right _ _, fun ℓ y hℓ_pos hℓ_le hy_le => ?_⟩
    have h_dist : dist (y, ℓ) (0, 0) < ρ₀ := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_zero_right, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos]
      have h1 : ‖y‖ ≤ ρ₀ / 2 := le_trans hy_le (min_le_left _ _)
      have h2 : ℓ ≤ ρ₀ / 2 := le_trans hℓ_le (min_le_left _ _)
      have h3 : max ‖y‖ ℓ ≤ ρ₀ / 2 := max_le h1 h2
      linarith
    have hF_close := hρ₀ h_dist
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hF_close
    have hF_00 : F (0, 0) =
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z₀ i) 1)) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖z₀ i - 0‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) - κ ^ 2 * 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [F]
      simp
    have hW_01 : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) =
        barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - κ ^ 2 * 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [shiftedBarycentricEnvelope]
      rw [h_projTime]
    have hF_lb : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - δ ≤ F (y, ℓ) := by
      linarith [abs_lt.mp hF_close]
    have h_mean_trans : ∑ i, θ i • (z₀ i + y) = y := by
      calc ∑ i, θ i • (z₀ i + y)
        _ = (∑ i, θ i • z₀ i) + ∑ i, θ i • y := by
            simp [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = 0 + (∑ i, θ i) • y := by rw [hz₀_mean, ← Finset.sum_smul]
        _ = y := by rw [hθ_sum, one_smul, zero_add]
    have h_comp_trans := hW_comp y (1 - ℓ) (by linarith [min_le_right (ρ₀ / 2) (1 / 2)])
      N θ (fun i => z₀ i + y) hθ_pos hθ_sum h_mean_trans
    have hF_eq : F (y, ℓ) =
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z₀ i + y) (1 - ℓ))) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖(z₀ i + y) - y‖ ^ 2) / (2 * (1 - ℓ)) - κ ^ 2 * (1 - ℓ) / 2 := by
      dsimp [F]
      congr 2
      congr 1
      congr 1 with i
      rw [add_sub_cancel_right, sub_zero]
    linarith
  
  have h_pert : ∃ R_h : ℝ, 0 ≤ R_h ∧ ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ h → ‖y‖ ≤ 1 →
      quadEnvelopePlus d (h + ℓ) (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime y (1 - ℓ)) ≤
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) +
          h * slopePlus d h (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime 0 1) +
          (ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖) / (2 * h ^ 2) := by
    let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
    let z₀ := mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1
    let Q_h := W z₀ + h * slopePlus d h W z₀
    obtain ⟨M_h, hM_h⟩ := h_growth (1 + h) (1 + h) (1 / (16 * h)) (by positivity)
    let R_h := Real.sqrt (max 0 (16 * h * (M_h + 1 / (4 * h) - Q_h)))
    have hR_h_nonneg : 0 ≤ R_h := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hR_h_sq : 16 * h * (M_h + 1 / (4 * h) - Q_h) ≤ R_h ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [R_h]
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_max_left 0 _)]
      exact le_max_right 0 _
    refine ⟨R_h, hR_h_nonneg, fun ℓ y hℓ_pos hℓ_le hy_le => ?_⟩
    apply csSup_le (Set.univ_nonempty.image _)
    rintro val ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace]
    have h_time_sync : 1 - ℓ + (h + ℓ) = 1 + h := by ring
    rw [h_time_sync]
    have h_err_nonneg : 0 ≤ (ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖) / (2 * h ^ 2) := by positivity
    by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R_h
    · 
      have h_quad := hW_quad_comp 0 x 1 h zero_lt_one hh
      rw [sub_zero] at h_quad
      have hW_ub : W (mkSpaceTime x (1 + h)) ≤ Q_h + ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * h) := by
        dsimp [Q_h, W, z₀] at *
        linarith
      have h_diff_eq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * h) - ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (h + ℓ)) =
          ((h + ℓ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 - h * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) / (2 * h * (h + ℓ)) := by
        have hh_ne : h ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hh
        have hhl_ne : h + ℓ ≠ 0 := by linarith
        field_simp [hh_ne, hhl_ne]
      have h_norm_sub : ‖x‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := norm_sub_sq_real x y
        have h2 := real_inner_le_norm x y
        have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg ‖y‖
        linarith
      have h_x_sq_le : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ R_h ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
      have h_xy_le : ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ ≤ R_h * ‖y‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx (norm_nonneg y)
      have h_num_le : (h + ℓ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 - h * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 ≤
          ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖ := by
        nlinarith
      have h_num_nonneg : 0 ≤ ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖ := by positivity
      have h_div1 : ((h + ℓ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 - h * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) / (2 * h * (h + ℓ)) ≤
          (ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖) / (2 * h * (h + ℓ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le (by positivity)
      have h_div2 : (ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖) / (2 * h * (h + ℓ)) ≤
          (ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖) / (2 * h ^ 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left h_num_nonneg (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
      linarith
    · 
      push_neg at hx
      have hW_growth : W (mkSpaceTime x (1 + h)) ≤ M_h + 1 / (16 * h) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_s := (hW_sand x (1 + h) (by linarith)).2
        have h_g := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hM_h x (1 + h) le_rfl le_rfl)
        exact le_trans h_s h_g
      have h_pen_step1 : ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (4 * h) ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (h + ℓ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity) (by linarith)
      have h_norm_lb : ‖x‖ ^ 2 - 2 ≤ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := norm_sub_sq_real x y
        have h2 := real_inner_le_norm x y
        have h3 : 0 ≤ (‖x‖ - 2 * ‖y‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (‖x‖ - 2 * ‖y‖)
        have h4 : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
        nlinarith
      have h_pen_step2 : (‖x‖ ^ 2 - 2) / (8 * h) ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (4 * h) := by
        have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_norm_lb (by positivity : 0 ≤ 8 * h)
        have h_eq : 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (8 * h) = ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (4 * h) := by ring
        linarith
      have h_x_sq_gt : R_h ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_R_bound : M_h + 1 / (4 * h) - R_h ^ 2 / (16 * h) ≤ Q_h := by
        have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hR_h_sq (by positivity : 0 ≤ 16 * h)
        have hh_ne : h ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hh
        have h_cancel : 16 * h * (M_h + 1 / (4 * h) - Q_h) / (16 * h) =
            M_h + 1 / (4 * h) - Q_h := by
          field_simp [hh_ne]
        linarith
      have h_x_bound : M_h + 1 / (4 * h) - ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (16 * h) ≤
          M_h + 1 / (4 * h) - R_h ^ 2 / (16 * h) := by
        have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_x_sq_gt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 16 * h)
        linarith
      have h_alg : M_h + 1 / (16 * h) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 - (‖x‖ ^ 2 - 2) / (8 * h) =
          M_h + 1 / (4 * h) - ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (16 * h) := by
        have hh_ne : h ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hh
        field_simp [hh_ne]
        ring
      linarith
  
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀_nonneg, h_step⟩ := h_step
  obtain ⟨R_h, hR_h_nonneg, h_pert⟩ := h_pert
  let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
  let z₀ := mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1
  have h_mul_le : h * H_star ≤ h * slopePlus d h W z₀ := by
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε_pos
    let δ := (2 / 5 : ℝ) * ε
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by positivity
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ_pos, hρ_le, h_lsc_δ⟩ := h_lsc δ hδ_pos
    let ε_y := min ρ (min 1 (h * δ / (R_h + 1)))
    have hε_y_pos : 0 < ε_y := by positivity
    let ℓ₁ := min h (min ρ (min (ε_y ^ 2 / (C₀ + 1)) (h ^ 2 * δ / (R_h ^ 2 + 1))))
    have hℓ₁_pos : 0 < ℓ₁ := by positivity
    have h_ev : ∀ ℓ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ℓ₁,
        (h + ℓ) * (slopeMinus d ℓ v z₀ - ℓ) ≤ h * slopePlus d h W z₀ + ε := by
      intro ℓ ⟨hℓ_pos, hℓ_le⟩
      have hℓ_le_h : ℓ ≤ h := le_trans hℓ_le (min_le_left _ _)
      have hℓ_le_ρ : ℓ ≤ ρ := le_trans hℓ_le (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have hℓ_le_half : ℓ ≤ 1 / 2 := le_trans hℓ_le_ρ hρ_le
      have hℓ_le_C₀ : ℓ ≤ ε_y ^ 2 / (C₀ + 1) :=
        le_trans hℓ_le (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
      have hℓ_le_Rh : ℓ ≤ h ^ 2 * δ / (R_h ^ 2 + 1) :=
        le_trans hℓ_le (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
      obtain ⟨y, hy_sq, hy_step⟩ := h_step ℓ hℓ_pos hℓ_le_half
      have hy_sq_le : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε_y ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : C₀ * ℓ ≤ (C₀ + 1) * ℓ := by nlinarith
        have h2 : (C₀ + 1) * ℓ ≤ ε_y ^ 2 := by
          have := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < C₀ + 1)).mp hℓ_le_C₀
          linarith
        linarith
      have hy_le_εy : ‖y‖ ≤ ε_y := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg y, sq_nonneg (‖y‖ + ε_y)]
      have hy_le_ρ : ‖y‖ ≤ ρ := le_trans hy_le_εy (min_le_left _ _)
      have hy_le_1 : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 := le_trans hy_le_εy (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have hy_le_Rh : ‖y‖ ≤ h * δ / (R_h + 1) :=
        le_trans hy_le_εy (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
      have h_w_lsc := h_lsc_δ ℓ y hℓ_pos hℓ_le_ρ hy_le_ρ
      have h_w_pert := h_pert ℓ y hℓ_pos hℓ_le_h hy_le_1
      have h_term1 : ℓ * R_h ^ 2 ≤ h ^ 2 * δ := by
        have h1 : ℓ * R_h ^ 2 ≤ ℓ * (R_h ^ 2 + 1) := by nlinarith
        have h2 : ℓ * (R_h ^ 2 + 1) ≤ h ^ 2 * δ :=
          (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < R_h ^ 2 + 1)).mp hℓ_le_Rh
        linarith
      have h_term2 : 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖ ≤ 2 * h ^ 2 * δ := by
        have h1 : R_h * ‖y‖ ≤ (R_h + 1) * ‖y‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
        have h2 : ‖y‖ * (R_h + 1) ≤ h * δ :=
          (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < R_h + 1)).mp hy_le_Rh
        nlinarith
      have h_err_le : (ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖) / (2 * h ^ 2) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ := by
        have h_sum : ℓ * R_h ^ 2 + 2 * h * R_h * ‖y‖ ≤ 3 * h ^ 2 * δ := by linarith
        have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sum (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * h ^ 2)
        have hh_ne : h ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hh
        have h_eq : 3 * h ^ 2 * δ / (2 * h ^ 2) = (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ := by
          field_simp [hh_ne]
        linarith
      dsimp [W, z₀, δ] at *
      linarith
    have h_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => (h + ℓ) * (slopeMinus d ℓ v z₀ - ℓ))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (h * H_star)) := by
      have h_id : Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ : ℝ => ℓ) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds Filter.tendsto_id
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ : ℝ => h + ℓ) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (h + 0)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.add h_id
      have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ : ℝ => slopeMinus d ℓ v z₀ - ℓ)
          (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (H_star - 0)) :=
        hv_slope_minus.sub h_id
      have h3 := h1.mul h2
      simpa using h3
    exact le_of_tendsto h_tendsto (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioc_mem_nhdsGT hℓ₁_pos) h_ev)
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_mul_le hh

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) :
    (∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))) ∧
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ L →
        (v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) → ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ) ∧
        (v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) → ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ))

proof.tactics:
by
  have projSpace_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime x s) = x := by
    intro x s
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have projTime_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime x s) = s := by
    intro x s
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
  have continuous_mkSpaceTime_left : ∀ s : ℝ,
      Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => mkSpaceTime y s) := by
    intro s
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    apply (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _).comp
    rw [continuous_pi_iff]
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
      exact continuous_const
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (continuous_apply i).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous
  have norm_sq_le_two_sub_add : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x y
    have h_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖x‖ := by
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - x) x
    have h_sq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖y - x‖ + ‖x‖) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg y) h_tri 2
    have h_amgm : 0 ≤ (‖y - x‖ - ‖x‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (‖y - x‖ - ‖x‖)
    linarith
  have h_master : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ L →
        (∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
          v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
            ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
          v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
            ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
        ((∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
          v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
            ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
        (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
          v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
            ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))) ∧
        (∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
          (v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
            ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) → ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ) ∧
          (v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
            ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) → ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ)) := by
    intro x t L hL
    have hε_pos : 0 < 1 / (8 * L) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := h_growth (t - L) (t + L) (1 / (8 * L)) hε_pos
    let M_x : ℝ := max M₀ 0 + ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L)
    have hM_x_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_x := by
      have h1 : 0 ≤ max M₀ 0 := le_max_right M₀ 0
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hM₀_le : M₀ ≤ max M₀ 0 := le_max_left M₀ 0
    have hv_shifted : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        t - L ≤ s → s ≤ t + L →
        -M_x - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y s) ∧
        v (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤ M_x + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) := by
      intro y s hs₁ hs₂
      have h_abs := hM₀ y s hs₁ hs₂
      have h_abs' := abs_le.mp h_abs
      have h_norm := norm_sq_le_two_sub_add x y
      have h_mul : (1 / (8 * L)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (1 / (8 * L)) * (2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_norm (le_of_lt hε_pos)
      have h_ring : (1 / (8 * L)) * (2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) =
          ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) + ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) := by ring
      constructor <;> linarith [h_abs'.1, h_abs'.2, h_mul, h_ring, hM₀_le]
    have hv_x : ∀ s : ℝ, t - L ≤ s → s ≤ t + L →
        -M_x ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x s) ∧ v (mkSpaceTime x s) ≤ M_x := by
      intro s hs₁ hs₂
      have h_xx := hv_shifted x s hs₁ hs₂
      simpa [sub_self] using h_xx
    let C : ℝ := 8 * M_x
    have hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
    let R : ℝ := Real.sqrt (C * L)
    have hR_nonneg : 0 ≤ R := Real.sqrt_nonneg (C * L)
    have hB_compact : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x R) := isCompact_closedBall x R
    have hx_mem : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x R := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR_nonneg
    refine ⟨C, hC_nonneg, ?_⟩
    intro ℓ hℓ hℓL
    let Φ_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
      fun y => v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)
    let Φ_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
      fun y => v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)
    have h_quad_cont : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) :=
      ((continuous_norm.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).pow 2).div_const (2 * ℓ)
    have hΦ_plus_cont : Continuous Φ_plus :=
      (hv_cont.comp (continuous_mkSpaceTime_left (t + ℓ))).sub h_quad_cont
    have hΦ_minus_cont : Continuous Φ_minus :=
      (hv_cont.comp (continuous_mkSpaceTime_left (t - ℓ))).add h_quad_cont
    have h_loc_plus : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        Φ_plus x ≤ Φ_plus y → ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ := by
      intro y hy
      have hs₁ : t - L ≤ t + ℓ := by linarith
      have hs₂ : t + ℓ ≤ t + L := by linarith
      have hv_y := (hv_shifted y (t + ℓ) hs₁ hs₂).2
      have hv_x_lb := (hv_x (t + ℓ) hs₁ hs₂).1
      have hΦ_x : Φ_plus x = v (mkSpaceTime x (t + ℓ)) := by
        simp [Φ_plus]
      have h_div_le : ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) ≤ ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg ‖y - x‖) (by positivity) (by linarith)
      have h_div_two : ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) = 2 * (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ)) := by ring
      have h_bound : ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ) ≤ 2 * M_x := by
        dsimp only [Φ_plus] at hy
        linarith
      have h_mul := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * ℓ)).mp h_bound
      linarith
    have h_loc_minus : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        Φ_minus y ≤ Φ_minus x → ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ := by
      intro y hy
      have hs₁ : t - L ≤ t - ℓ := by linarith
      have hs₂ : t - ℓ ≤ t + L := by linarith
      have hv_y := (hv_shifted y (t - ℓ) hs₁ hs₂).1
      have hv_x_ub := (hv_x (t - ℓ) hs₁ hs₂).2
      have hΦ_x : Φ_minus x = v (mkSpaceTime x (t - ℓ)) := by
        simp [Φ_minus]
      have h_div_le : ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) ≤ ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg ‖y - x‖) (by positivity) (by linarith)
      have h_div_two : ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) = 2 * (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ)) := by ring
      have h_bound : ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ) ≤ 2 * M_x := by
        dsimp only [Φ_minus] at hy
        linarith
      have h_mul := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * ℓ)).mp h_bound
      linarith
    have h_mem_ball : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ → y ∈ Metric.closedBall x R := by
      intro y hy
      have h_le_CL : ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * L :=
        le_trans hy (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓL hC_nonneg)
      have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_le_CL
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (y - x))] at h_sqrt
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      exact h_sqrt
    obtain ⟨y_plus, hy_plus_mem, hy_plus_max⟩ :=
      hB_compact.exists_isMaxOn ⟨x, hx_mem⟩ hΦ_plus_cont.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨y_minus, hy_minus_mem, hy_minus_min⟩ :=
      hB_compact.exists_isMinOn ⟨x, hx_mem⟩ hΦ_minus_cont.continuousOn
    have hy_plus_ge_x : Φ_plus x ≤ Φ_plus y_plus := isMaxOn_iff.mp hy_plus_max x hx_mem
    have hy_minus_le_x : Φ_minus y_minus ≤ Φ_minus x := isMinOn_iff.mp hy_minus_min x hx_mem
    have h_max_all : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Φ_plus y ≤ Φ_plus y_plus := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : Φ_plus x ≤ Φ_plus y
      · exact isMaxOn_iff.mp hy_plus_max y (h_mem_ball y (h_loc_plus y hy))
      · linarith
    have h_min_all : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Φ_minus y_minus ≤ Φ_minus y := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : Φ_minus y ≤ Φ_minus x
      · exact isMinOn_iff.mp hy_minus_min y (h_mem_ball y (h_loc_minus y hy))
      · linarith
    have h_mem_plus : Φ_plus y_plus ∈ Φ_plus '' Set.univ :=
      Set.mem_image_of_mem Φ_plus (Set.mem_univ y_plus)
    have h_ub_plus : ∀ b ∈ Φ_plus '' Set.univ, b ≤ Φ_plus y_plus := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
      exact h_max_all y
    have h_sSup_plus : sSup (Φ_plus '' Set.univ) = Φ_plus y_plus :=
      le_antisymm (csSup_le ⟨Φ_plus y_plus, h_mem_plus⟩ h_ub_plus)
        (le_csSup ⟨Φ_plus y_plus, h_ub_plus⟩ h_mem_plus)
    have h_quadPlus : quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) = Φ_plus y_plus := by
      simp only [quadEnvelopePlus, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
      exact h_sSup_plus
    have h_slopePlus : ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) =
        Φ_plus y_plus - v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
      unfold slopePlus

      rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩

      le_antisymm (csInf_le ⟨Φ_minus y_minus, h_lb_minus⟩ h_mem_minus)

      unfold slopeMinus

by
  have h_cont_mk : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    refine (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _).comp (continuous_pi_iff.mpr fun j => ?_)
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simpa [Fin.snoc_last] using continuous_snd
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ i).comp continuous_fst
  have h_abstract : ∀ (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C →
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ → ℝ) (E : ℝ → ℝ),
        Continuous w → w (x, 0) = 0 → E 0 = 0 →
        (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
          w (y, ℓ) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤ E ℓ) →
        (∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ →
          ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), w (y, ℓ) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) = E ℓ) →
        (∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ L →
          w (y, ℓ) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) = E ℓ → ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ) →
        ContinuousOn E (Set.Icc 0 L) := by
    intro C hC w E hw_cont hw0 hE0 h_comp_w h_attain_w h_loc_w ℓ₀ hℓ₀
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hℓ₀.1 with hℓ₀_eq | hℓ₀_pos
    · subst hℓ₀_eq
      rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀⟩ :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hw_cont.continuousAt (x := (x, 0))) ε hε
      have hC1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < C + 1 := by linarith
      let δ := min L (min (δ₀ / 2) (δ₀ ^ 2 / (2 * (C + 1))))
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hL (lt_min (half_pos hδ₀_pos) (by positivity))
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun ℓ hℓ hdist => ?_⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq, hE0, sub_zero]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hℓ.1 with hℓ_eq | hℓ_pos
      · subst hℓ_eq
        rw [hE0, abs_zero]
        exact hε
      · rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos] at hdist
        have hℓ_lt_δ₀ : ℓ < δ₀ := by
          have : ℓ < δ₀ / 2 :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
          linarith
        have hCℓ_lt : (C + 1) * ℓ < δ₀ ^ 2 := by
          have h1 : ℓ < δ₀ ^ 2 / (2 * (C + 1)) :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
          have h2 : ℓ * (2 * (C + 1)) < δ₀ ^ 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp h1
          have h3 : 0 < δ₀ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hδ₀_pos
          nlinarith
        have h_low : -ε < E ℓ := by
          have h_cx := h_comp_w x ℓ hℓ_pos
          simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
            zero_pow, zero_div, sub_zero] at h_cx
          have hd_x : dist (x, ℓ) (x, (0 : ℝ)) < δ₀ := by
            rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff, dist_self, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos]
            exact ⟨hδ₀_pos, hℓ_lt_δ₀⟩
          have hw_x := hδ₀ hd_x
          rw [Real.dist_eq, hw0, sub_zero] at hw_x
          linarith [(abs_lt.mp hw_x).1]
        have h_high : E ℓ < ε := by
          obtain ⟨y_ℓ, hy_ℓ⟩ := h_attain_w ℓ hℓ_pos
          have hy_loc : ‖y_ℓ - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ := h_loc_w ℓ y_ℓ hℓ_pos hℓ.2 hy_ℓ
          have hy_sq : ‖y_ℓ - x‖ ^ 2 < δ₀ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
          have hy_norm : ‖y_ℓ - x‖ < δ₀ := by
            nlinarith [norm_nonneg (y_ℓ - x)]
          have hd_y : dist (y_ℓ, ℓ) (x, (0 : ℝ)) < δ₀ := by
            rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff, dist_eq_norm, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos]
            exact ⟨hy_norm, hℓ_lt_δ₀⟩
          have hw_y := hδ₀ hd_y
          rw [Real.dist_eq, hw0, sub_zero] at hw_y
          have h_pen_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y_ℓ - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) :=
            div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
          linarith [(abs_lt.mp hw_y).2]
        exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨h_low, h_high⟩
    · rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
      intro ε hε
      let R : ℝ := C * L + 1
      have hR_pos : 0 < R := by positivity
      let K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) := Metric.closedBall x R ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 L
      have hK_compact : IsCompact K := (isCompact_closedBall x R).prod isCompact_Icc
      have hw_uc : UniformContinuousOn w K :=
        hK_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hw_cont.continuousOn
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩ :=
        Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hw_uc (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
      let a : ℝ := ℓ₀ / 2
      have ha_pos : 0 < a := half_pos hℓ₀_pos
      let δ : ℝ := min a (min δ₁ (ε * a ^ 2 / R))
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min ha_pos (lt_min hδ₁_pos (by positivity))
      have h_one_sided : ∀ ℓ₁ ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ∀ ℓ₂ ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,

        have hℓ₁_pos : 0 < ℓ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le ha_pos ha₁
        have hℓ₂_pos : 0 < ℓ₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le ha_pos ha₂
        obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩ := h_attain_w ℓ₁ hℓ₁_pos
        have hy₁_loc : ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ₁ := h_loc_w ℓ₁ y₁ hℓ₁_pos hℓ₁.2 hy₁
        have hy₁_CL : ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * L := by nlinarith [hℓ₁.2]
        have hy₁_R : ‖y₁ - x‖ ≤ R := by
          have h_sq : 0 ≤ (‖y₁ - x‖ - 1 / 2) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
          change ‖y₁ - x‖ ≤ C * L + 1
          nlinarith
        have hy₁_ball : y₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall x R := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          exact hy₁_R
        have hp₁ : (y₁, ℓ₁) ∈ K := ⟨hy₁_ball, hℓ₁⟩
        have hp₂ : (y₁, ℓ₂) ∈ K := ⟨hy₁_ball, hℓ₂⟩
        have h_dist_p : dist (y₁, ℓ₁) (y₁, ℓ₂) < δ₁ := by
          rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff, dist_self, Real.dist_eq]
          refine ⟨hδ₁_pos,
            lt_of_lt_of_le h_diff (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))⟩
        have hw_diff : w (y₁, ℓ₁) - w (y₁, ℓ₂) < ε / 2 := by
          have h_uc_app := hδ₁ (y₁, ℓ₁) hp₁ (y₁, ℓ₂) hp₂ h_dist_p
          rw [Real.dist_eq] at h_uc_app
          linarith [(abs_lt.mp h_uc_app).2]
        have h_comp₂ := h_comp_w y₁ ℓ₂ hℓ₂_pos
        have h_pen_diff : ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ₂) - ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ₁) < ε / 2 := by
          have h_alg : ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ₂) - ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ₁) =
              (‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 * (ℓ₁ - ℓ₂)) / (2 * ℓ₁ * ℓ₂) := by
            field_simp
          rw [h_alg, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          have h_diff_R : |ℓ₁ - ℓ₂| < ε * a ^ 2 / R :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le h_diff (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
          have h_mul_R : |ℓ₁ - ℓ₂| * R < ε * a ^ 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ hR_pos).mp h_diff_R
          have h_num1 : ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 * (ℓ₁ - ℓ₂) ≤ R * |ℓ₁ - ℓ₂| := by
            have : ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ R := by change ‖y₁ - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * L + 1; linarith
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖y₁ - x‖, le_abs_self (ℓ₁ - ℓ₂), abs_nonneg (ℓ₁ - ℓ₂)]
          have h_a_le : a ^ 2 ≤ ℓ₁ * ℓ₂ := by nlinarith
          nlinarith
        linarith
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun ℓ hℓ hdist => ?_⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist ⊢
      have h_lt_a : |ℓ - ℓ₀| < a := lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (min_le_left _ _)
      have ha_ℓ : a ≤ ℓ := by
        have h_sub : ℓ₀ - ℓ < ℓ₀ / 2 := (abs_sub_lt_iff.mp h_lt_a).2
        change ℓ₀ / 2 ≤ ℓ
        linarith
      have ha_ℓ₀ : a ≤ ℓ₀ := by change ℓ₀ / 2 ≤ ℓ₀; linarith
      have h1 : E ℓ - E ℓ₀ < ε := h_one_sided ℓ hℓ ℓ₀ hℓ₀ ha_ℓ ha_ℓ₀ hdist
      have h2 : E ℓ₀ - E ℓ < ε := by
        rw [abs_sub_comm] at hdist
        exact h_one_sided ℓ₀ hℓ₀ ℓ hℓ ha_ℓ₀ ha_ℓ hdist
      exact abs_sub_lt_iff.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC, h_loc_C⟩ := h_loc x t L hL
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine h_abstract C hC
      (fun p => v (mkSpaceTime p.1 (t + p.2)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t))
      (fun ℓ => ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact (hv_cont.comp (h_cont_mk.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.add continuous_snd)))).sub continuous_const
    · simp
    · simp
    · intro y ℓ hℓ
      exact (h_comp x y t ℓ hℓ).1
    · intro ℓ hℓ
      exact (h_attain x t ℓ hℓ).1
    · intro ℓ y hℓ hℓL
      exact (h_loc_C ℓ y hℓ hℓL).1
  · refine h_abstract C hC
      (fun p => v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime p.1 (t - p.2)))
      (fun ℓ => ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact continuous_const.sub (hv_cont.comp (h_cont_mk.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd))))
    · simp
    · simp
    · intro y ℓ hℓ
      exact (h_comp x y t ℓ hℓ).2
    · intro ℓ hℓ
      exact (h_attain x t ℓ hℓ).2
    · intro ℓ y hℓ hℓL
      exact (h_loc_C ℓ y hℓ hℓL).2
