  have deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv :
      ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
        {f : E → ℝ} {W : Set E}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : E}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f W → ∀ (ξ : E),
        deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (z₀ + s • ξ))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ ξ := by
    intro E _ _ f W hW z₀ hz₀ hf ξ
    have h_pre : IsOpen ((fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ⁻¹' W) :=
      hW.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ⁻¹' W := by simp [hz₀]
    have h_ev : (fun s : ℝ => deriv (fun r : ℝ => f (z₀ + r • ξ)) s) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        (fun s : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ)) ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [h_pre.mem_nhds h0_mem] with s hs
      have hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ) :=
        ((hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hs)).differentiableAt (by norm_num))
      have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => z₀ + r • ξ) ξ s := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
      exact (hf_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h_line).deriv
    rw [h_ev.deriv_eq]
    have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f z₀ := hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)
    have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ := hcd.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hf2_diff : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀) (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) := by
      simpa using (hcd1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have h_line0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ξ 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
    have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ) 0 :=
      hf2_diff.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line0
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ξ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_comp).deriv
  set U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :=
    {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) | projTime z ≠ t}
  set Ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
    parabolicTestFunc d x t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂
  have hU_open : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne.preimage projTimeCLM.continuous
  have h_time_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => projTime z) :=
    projTimeCLM.contDiff
  have h_space_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => projSpace z) :=
    projSpaceCLM.contDiff
  have h_P_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
      c₀ + c₁ * (projTime z - τ₀) + (c₂ / 2) * (projTime z - τ₀) ^ 2) :=
    (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul (h_time_cd.sub contDiff_const))).add
      (contDiff_const.mul ((h_time_cd.sub contDiff_const).pow 2))
  have h_N_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => ‖projSpace z - x‖ ^ 2) :=
    (h_space_cd.sub contDiff_const).norm_sq ℝ
  have h_D_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => 2 * (projTime z - t)) :=
    contDiff_const.mul (h_time_cd.sub contDiff_const)
  have h_D_ne : ∀ z ∈ U, 2 * (projTime z - t) ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz)
  have hΨ_C2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Ψ U :=
    h_P_cd.contDiffOn.add (h_N_cd.contDiffOn.div h_D_cd.contDiffOn h_D_ne)
  refine ⟨hΨ_C2, ?_⟩
  set z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀
  set Δ₀ : ℝ := τ₀ - t
  set q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := Δ₀⁻¹ • (y₀ - x)
  have hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U := by
    change projTime (mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀) ≠ t
    rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    exact hτ₀
  have hΔ₀_ne : Δ₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hτ₀
  have hΨ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ z₀ :=
    (hΨ_C2.contDiffAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hΨ_fd : HasFDerivAt Ψ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient Ψ z₀)) z₀ :=
    hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mp hΨ_diff.hasGradientAt
  have h_grad_space : projSpace (gradient Ψ z₀) = q := by
    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
    intro h
    set v_h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime h 0
    set α_h : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := fun s => z₀ + s • v_h
    have h_line : HasDerivAt α_h v_h 0 := by
      simpa [α_h] using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v_h |>.const_add z₀
    have hα0 : α_h 0 = z₀ := by simp [α_h]
    have h_fd0 : HasFDerivAt Ψ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient Ψ z₀)) (α_h 0) := by
      rw [hα0]; exact hΨ_fd
    have h_val : (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient Ψ z₀)) v_h =
        inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient Ψ z₀)) h := by
      rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime]
      simp [v_h, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    have h_d1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (α_h s)) (inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient Ψ z₀)) h) 0 := by
      rw [← h_val]
      exact h_fd0.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line
    have h_poly_eq : (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (α_h s)) =
        fun s : ℝ => (c₀ + ‖y₀ - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * Δ₀)) +
          (Δ₀⁻¹ * inner ℝ (y₀ - x) h) * s + (‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * Δ₀)) * s ^ 2 := by
      ext s
      dsimp [Ψ, parabolicTestFunc, α_h, z₀, v_h]
      rw [projTime_add, projTime_smul, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
        projSpace_add, projSpace_smul, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
      have h_sub : y₀ + s • h - x = (y₀ - x) + s • h := by abel
      have h_norm : ‖y₀ + s • h - x‖ ^ 2 =
          ‖y₀ - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * s * inner ℝ (y₀ - x) h + s ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_sub, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          mul_pow, sq_abs]
        ring
      have h_time_sub : τ₀ + s * 0 - t = Δ₀ := by dsimp [Δ₀]; ring
      have h_time_τ : τ₀ + s * 0 - τ₀ = 0 := by ring
      rw [h_norm, h_time_sub, h_time_τ, inv_eq_one_div]
      have h2Δ₀_ne : 2 * Δ₀ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hΔ₀_ne
      field_simp [hΔ₀_ne, h2Δ₀_ne]
      ring
    have h_d2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (α_h s)) (inner ℝ q h) 0 := by
      rw [h_poly_eq]
      have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s) 1 0 := hasDerivAt_id 0
      have h_comb := ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (c₀ + ‖y₀ - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * Δ₀))).add
        (h_id.const_mul (Δ₀⁻¹ * inner ℝ (y₀ - x) h))).add
        ((h_id.pow 2).const_mul (‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * Δ₀)))
      convert h_comb using 1
      dsimp [q]
      rw [real_inner_smul_left]
      ring
    exact h_d1.unique h_d2
  set ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime q 1
  change limitingOperator Ψ z₀ = c₂
  unfold limitingOperator
  rw [h_grad_space, ← deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hU_open hz₀ hΨ_C2 ξ]
  set Q : ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun s => (c₀ + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Δ₀) + (c₁ + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2) * s + (c₂ / 2) * s ^ 2
  have hW_open : IsOpen {s : ℝ | Δ₀ + s ≠ 0} :=
    isOpen_ne.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have h0_W : (0 : ℝ) ∈ {s : ℝ | Δ₀ + s ≠ 0} := by
    change Δ₀ + 0 ≠ 0
    simpa using hΔ₀_ne
  have h_ev_Q : (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (z₀ + s • ξ)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] Q := by
    filter_upwards [hW_open.mem_nhds h0_W] with s hs
    change Δ₀ + s ≠ 0 at hs
    dsimp [Ψ, parabolicTestFunc, Q, z₀, ξ]
    rw [projTime_add, projTime_smul, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
      projSpace_add, projSpace_smul, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
    have h_space_vec : y₀ + s • q - x = (Δ₀ + s) • q := by
      have h_sub : y₀ + s • q - x = (y₀ - x) + s • q := by abel
      have h_Δq : Δ₀ • q = y₀ - x := smul_inv_smul₀ hΔ₀_ne (y₀ - x)
      rw [h_sub, ← h_Δq, ← add_smul]
    have h_norm_sq : ‖y₀ + s • q - x‖ ^ 2 = (Δ₀ + s) ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_space_vec, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    have h_time_sub : τ₀ + s * 1 - t = Δ₀ + s := by dsimp [Δ₀]; ring
    have h_time_τ : τ₀ + s * 1 - τ₀ = s := by ring
    rw [h_norm_sq, h_time_sub, h_time_τ]
    have h2s_ne : 2 * (Δ₀ + s) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hs
    field_simp [hs, h2s_ne]
    ring
  have h_d2_eq : deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (z₀ + s • ξ))) 0 = deriv (deriv Q) 0 :=
    h_ev_Q.deriv.deriv_eq
  rw [h_d2_eq]
  have h_Q_d1 : deriv Q = fun s : ℝ => (c₁ + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2) + c₂ * s := by
    ext s
    have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => r) 1 s := hasDerivAt_id s
    have hd : HasDerivAt Q ((c₁ + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2) + c₂ * s) s := by
      dsimp [Q]
      convert ((hasDerivAt_const s (c₀ + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Δ₀)).add
        (h_id.const_mul (c₁ + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2))).add ((h_id.pow 2).const_mul (c₂ / 2)) using 1
      ring
    exact hd.deriv
  rw [h_Q_d1]
  have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (c₁ + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2) + c₂ * s) c₂ 0 := by
    have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s) 1 0 := hasDerivAt_id 0
    convert (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (c₁ + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2)).add (h_id.const_mul c₂) using 1
    ring
  exact hd2.deriv

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_attain : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)))
    (h_cont : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ContinuousOn (fun ℓ => ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) (Set.Icc 0 L) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun ℓ => ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) (Set.Icc 0 L))
    (h_test : ∀ (x y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ), τ₀ ≠ t →
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (parabolicTestFunc d x t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂)
        {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) | projTime z ≠ t} ∧
      limitingOperator (parabolicTestFunc d x t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂) (mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀) = c₂)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℝ) (hℓ₁ : 0 < ℓ₁) (hℓ₁₂ : ℓ₁ ≤ ℓ₂) :
    slopePlus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopePlus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
    slopeMinus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t)

proof.tactics:
by
  have projTime_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime y s) = s := by
    intro y s
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
  have projSpace_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s) = y := by
    intro y s
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have mkSpaceTime_proj : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z) = z := by
    intro z
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro i
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have continuous_projTime : Continuous (projTime : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) :=
    PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin (d + 1) => ℝ) (Fin.last d)
  have h_chord : ∀ (E : ℝ → ℝ) (S : ℝ),
      0 < ℓ₁ → ℓ₁ < ℓ₂ →
      ContinuousOn E (Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂) →
      E 0 = 0 → E ℓ₂ = ℓ₂ * S → ℓ₁ * S < E ℓ₁ →
      ∃ ℓ₀ δ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ₀ ∧ ℓ₀ < ℓ₂ ∧ 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ ℓ ∈ Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂,
          E ℓ ≤ E ℓ₀ + (S + δ * ℓ₂ - 2 * δ * ℓ₀) * (ℓ - ℓ₀) - δ * (ℓ - ℓ₀) ^ 2 := by
    intro E S hℓ₁_pos hℓ₁₂_lt hE_cont hE0 hE2 hE_gt
    have hℓ₂_pos : 0 < ℓ₂ := lt_trans hℓ₁_pos hℓ₁₂_lt
    have h_diff_pos : 0 < ℓ₂ - ℓ₁ := sub_pos.mpr hℓ₁₂_lt
    have hD_pos : 0 < E ℓ₁ - ℓ₁ * S := sub_pos.mpr hE_gt
    set D : ℝ := E ℓ₁ - ℓ₁ * S
    set δ : ℝ := D / (2 * ℓ₁ * (ℓ₂ - ℓ₁))
    have h_denom_pos : 0 < 2 * ℓ₁ * (ℓ₂ - ℓ₁) := by positivity
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := div_pos hD_pos h_denom_pos
    let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ => E ℓ - S * ℓ - δ * (ℓ * (ℓ₂ - ℓ))
    have hh_cont : ContinuousOn h (Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂) := by
      refine (hE_cont.sub (continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id)).sub ?_
      exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_id.mul (continuousOn_const.sub continuousOn_id))
    have h_nonempty : (Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂).Nonempty := Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt hℓ₂_pos)
    obtain ⟨ℓ₀, hℓ₀_mem, hℓ₀_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn h_nonempty hh_cont
    rw [isMaxOn_iff] at hℓ₀_max
    have hh0 : h 0 = 0 := by
      simp only [h, hE0]
      ring
    have hh2 : h ℓ₂ = 0 := by
      simp only [h, hE2]
      ring
    have h_δ_prod : δ * (ℓ₁ * (ℓ₂ - ℓ₁)) = D / 2 := by
      have h_ne1 : ℓ₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ₁_pos
      have h_ne2 : ℓ₂ - ℓ₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_diff_pos
      dsimp [δ]
      field_simp
    have hh1 : h ℓ₁ = D / 2 := by
      dsimp [h]
      rw [h_δ_prod]
      dsimp [D]
      ring
    have hℓ₁_mem : ℓ₁ ∈ Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂ := ⟨le_of_lt hℓ₁_pos, le_of_lt hℓ₁₂_lt⟩
    have hh0_pos : 0 < h ℓ₀ := by
      have hh1_le : h ℓ₁ ≤ h ℓ₀ := hℓ₀_max ℓ₁ hℓ₁_mem
      linarith
    have hℓ₀_ne0 : ℓ₀ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h_eq
      rw [h_eq, hh0] at hh0_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hh0_pos
    have hℓ₀_ne2 : ℓ₀ ≠ ℓ₂ := by
      intro h_eq
      rw [h_eq, hh2] at hh0_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hh0_pos
    have hℓ₀_pos : 0 < ℓ₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne hℓ₀_mem.1 (Ne.symm hℓ₀_ne0)
    have hℓ₀_lt : ℓ₀ < ℓ₂ := lt_of_le_of_ne hℓ₀_mem.2 hℓ₀_ne2
    refine ⟨ℓ₀, δ, hℓ₀_pos, hℓ₀_lt, hδ_pos, ?_⟩
    intro ℓ hℓ_mem
    have h_le : h ℓ ≤ h ℓ₀ := hℓ₀_max ℓ hℓ_mem
    dsimp [h] at h_le
    have h_poly : S * ℓ + δ * (ℓ * (ℓ₂ - ℓ)) + (E ℓ₀ - S * ℓ₀ - δ * (ℓ₀ * (ℓ₂ - ℓ₀))) =
        E ℓ₀ + (S + δ * ℓ₂ - 2 * δ * ℓ₀) * (ℓ - ℓ₀) - δ * (ℓ - ℓ₀) ^ 2 := by ring
    linarith
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hℓ₁₂ with rfl | hℓ₁₂_lt
  · exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
  have hℓ₂_pos : 0 < ℓ₂ := lt_trans hℓ₁ hℓ₁₂_lt
  let z_x := mkSpaceTime x t
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra h_not_le
    push_neg at h_not_le
    let E_plus : ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ => ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v z_x
    let S_plus : ℝ := slopePlus d ℓ₂ v z_x
    have hE_gt : ℓ₁ * S_plus < E_plus ℓ₁ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_not_le hℓ₁
    have hE_cont : ContinuousOn E_plus (Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂) := (h_cont x t ℓ₂ hℓ₂_pos).1
    have hE0 : E_plus 0 = 0 := zero_mul _
    have hE2 : E_plus ℓ₂ = ℓ₂ * S_plus := rfl
    obtain ⟨ℓ₀, δ, hℓ₀_pos, hℓ₀_lt, hδ_pos, h_upper⟩ :=
      h_chord E_plus S_plus hℓ₁ hℓ₁₂_lt hE_cont hE0 hE2 hE_gt
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := (h_attain x t ℓ₀ hℓ₀_pos).1
    let τ₀ : ℝ := t + ℓ₀
    let c₀ : ℝ := v z_x + E_plus ℓ₀
    let c₁ : ℝ := S_plus + δ * ℓ₂ - 2 * δ * ℓ₀
    let c₂ : ℝ := -2 * δ
    let Ψ_plus := parabolicTestFunc d x t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂
    let z₀ := mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀
    let V_plus : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :=
      {z | t < projTime z} ∩ {z | projTime z < t + ℓ₂}
    have hV_open : IsOpen V_plus :=
      IsOpen.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_projTime)
        (isOpen_lt continuous_projTime continuous_const)
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ V_plus := by
      simp only [V_plus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, z₀, projTime_mkSpaceTime, τ₀]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hτ₀_ne : τ₀ ≠ t := by
      dsimp [τ₀]
      linarith
    have hΨ_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Ψ_plus V_plus := by
      refine (h_test x y₀ t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ hτ₀_ne).1.mono ?_
      intro z hz
      simp only [V_plus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
      exact ne_of_gt hz.1
    have hΨ_z₀ : Ψ_plus z₀ = v z₀ := by
      dsimp [Ψ_plus, parabolicTestFunc, z₀, τ₀, c₀, z_x, E_plus] at hy₀ ⊢
      rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      have h_sub1 : t + ℓ₀ - (t + ℓ₀) = 0 := by ring
      have h_sub2 : t + ℓ₀ - t = ℓ₀ := by ring
      rw [h_sub1, h_sub2]
      linarith
    have hΨ_ge : ∀ z ∈ V_plus, v z ≤ Ψ_plus z := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [V_plus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz
      let y := projSpace z
      let ℓ := projTime z - t
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ := by dsimp [ℓ]; linarith
      have hℓ_lt : ℓ < ℓ₂ := by dsimp [ℓ]; linarith
      have hℓ_mem : ℓ ∈ Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂ := ⟨le_of_lt hℓ_pos, le_of_lt hℓ_lt⟩
      have hz_eq : mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ) = z := by
        have ht : t + ℓ = projTime z := by dsimp [ℓ]; ring
        rw [ht]
        exact mkSpaceTime_proj z
      have h_comp_z := (h_comp x y t ℓ hℓ_pos).1
      rw [hz_eq] at h_comp_z
      have h_up_ℓ := h_upper ℓ hℓ_mem
      dsimp [Ψ_plus, parabolicTestFunc, τ₀, c₀, c₁, c₂, z_x, E_plus, y, ℓ] at h_comp_z h_up_ℓ ⊢
      have h_poly : c₁ * (projTime z - (t + ℓ₀)) + (-2 * δ / 2) * (projTime z - (t + ℓ₀)) ^ 2 =
          c₁ * (projTime z - t - ℓ₀) - δ * (projTime z - t - ℓ₀) ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith
    have h_visc := hv.2.1 z₀ Ψ_plus V_plus hV_open hz₀_mem hΨ_c2 hΨ_z₀ hΨ_ge
    have h_op := (h_test x y₀ t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ hτ₀_ne).2
    dsimp [Ψ_plus, z₀, c₂] at h_visc h_op
    linarith
  · by_contra h_not_le
    push_neg at h_not_le
    let E_minus : ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ => ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v z_x
    let S_minus : ℝ := slopeMinus d ℓ₂ v z_x
    have hE_gt : ℓ₁ * S_minus < E_minus ℓ₁ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_not_le hℓ₁
    have hE_cont : ContinuousOn E_minus (Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂) := (h_cont x t ℓ₂ hℓ₂_pos).2
    have hE0 : E_minus 0 = 0 := zero_mul _
    have hE2 : E_minus ℓ₂ = ℓ₂ * S_minus := rfl
    obtain ⟨ℓ₀, δ, hℓ₀_pos, hℓ₀_lt, hδ_pos, h_upper⟩ :=
      h_chord E_minus S_minus hℓ₁ hℓ₁₂_lt hE_cont hE0 hE2 hE_gt
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := (h_attain x t ℓ₀ hℓ₀_pos).2
    let τ₀ : ℝ := t - ℓ₀
    let c₀ : ℝ := v z_x - E_minus ℓ₀
    let c₁ : ℝ := S_minus + δ * ℓ₂ - 2 * δ * ℓ₀
    let c₂ : ℝ := 2 * δ
    let Ψ_minus := parabolicTestFunc d x t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂
    let z₀ := mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀
    let V_minus : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :=
      {z | t - ℓ₂ < projTime z} ∩ {z | projTime z < t}
    have hV_open : IsOpen V_minus :=
      IsOpen.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_projTime)
        (isOpen_lt continuous_projTime continuous_const)
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ V_minus := by
      simp only [V_minus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, z₀, projTime_mkSpaceTime, τ₀]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hτ₀_ne : τ₀ ≠ t := by
      dsimp [τ₀]
      linarith
    have hΨ_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Ψ_minus V_minus := by
      refine (h_test x y₀ t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ hτ₀_ne).1.mono ?_
      intro z hz
      simp only [V_minus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
      exact ne_of_lt hz.2
    have hΨ_z₀ : Ψ_minus z₀ = v z₀ := by
      dsimp [Ψ_minus, parabolicTestFunc, z₀, τ₀, c₀, z_x, E_minus] at hy₀ ⊢
      rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      have h_sub1 : t - ℓ₀ - (t - ℓ₀) = 0 := by ring
      have h_denom : 2 * (t - ℓ₀ - t) = -(2 * ℓ₀) := by ring
      rw [h_sub1, h_denom, div_neg]
      linarith
    have hΨ_le : ∀ z ∈ V_minus, Ψ_minus z ≤ v z := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [V_minus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz
      let y := projSpace z
      let ℓ := t - projTime z
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ := by dsimp [ℓ]; linarith
      have hℓ_lt : ℓ < ℓ₂ := by dsimp [ℓ]; linarith
      have hℓ_mem : ℓ ∈ Set.Icc 0 ℓ₂ := ⟨le_of_lt hℓ_pos, le_of_lt hℓ_lt⟩
      have hz_eq : mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ) = z := by
        have ht : t - ℓ = projTime z := by dsimp [ℓ]; ring
        rw [ht]
        exact mkSpaceTime_proj z
      have h_comp_z := (h_comp x y t ℓ hℓ_pos).2
      rw [hz_eq] at h_comp_z
      have h_up_ℓ := h_upper ℓ hℓ_mem
      dsimp [Ψ_minus, parabolicTestFunc, τ₀, c₀, c₁, c₂, z_x, E_minus, y, ℓ] at h_comp_z h_up_ℓ ⊢
      have h_denom : 2 * (projTime z - t) = -(2 * (t - projTime z)) := by ring
      rw [h_denom, div_neg]
      have h_poly : c₁ * (projTime z - (t - ℓ₀)) + (2 * δ / 2) * (projTime z - (t - ℓ₀)) ^ 2 =
          -(c₁ * (t - projTime z - ℓ₀) - δ * (t - projTime z - ℓ₀) ^ 2) := by ring
      linarith
    have h_visc := hv.2.2.1 z₀ Ψ_minus V_minus hV_open hz₀_mem hΨ_c2 hΨ_z₀ hΨ_le
    have h_op := (h_test x y₀ t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ hτ₀_ne).2
    dsimp [Ψ_minus, z₀, c₂] at h_visc h_op
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_attain : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)))
    (h_mono : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ₁ → ℓ₁ ≤ ℓ₂ →
      slopePlus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopePlus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      slopeMinus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) :
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t L : ℝ),
      (∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ → ℓ < 1 → L ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) →
      ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → L ≤ slopePlus d h v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t L : ℝ),
      (∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ → L ≤ slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) →
      ∃ H_star : ℝ, HasCommonSlopeLimit d v (mkSpaceTime x t) H_star)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_loc : ∀ (t₁ t₂ R₀ ℓ₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ R₀ → 0 < ℓ₀ →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
        ∀ (x' y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t' ℓ : ℝ),
          ‖x'‖ ≤ R₀ → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ ℓ₀ →
          (t₁ ≤ t' + ℓ → t' + ℓ ≤ t₂ →
            v (mkSpaceTime y (t' + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' t') - ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
              ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x' t') →
            ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ) ∧
          (t₁ ≤ t' - ℓ → t' - ℓ ≤ t₂ →
            v (mkSpaceTime x' t') - v (mkSpaceTime y (t' - ℓ)) - ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
              ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x' t') →
            ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ) := by
    intro t₁ t₂ R₀ ℓ₀ hR₀ hℓ₀
    have hε_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (8 * ℓ₀) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_growth t₁ t₂ (1 / (8 * ℓ₀)) hε_pos
    let C : ℝ := 8 * max M 0 + (3 / (2 * ℓ₀)) * R₀ ^ 2
    have hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
    have h_coercive : ∀ (x' y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s ℓ : ℝ),
        ‖x'‖ ≤ R₀ → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ ℓ₀ → t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ →
        ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤ |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| + |v (mkSpaceTime x' s)| →
        ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ := by
      intro x' y s ℓ hx' hℓ_pos hℓ_le hs₁ hs₂ h_ineq
      have hy_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - x'‖ + R₀ := by
        have h1 : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - x'‖ + ‖x'‖ := by
          simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - x') x'
        linarith
      have hx'_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖x'‖ := norm_nonneg x'
      have hy_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
      have hx'_sq : ‖x'‖ ^ 2 ≤ R₀ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hy_sq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 + 2 * R₀ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖y - x'‖ + R₀) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        have h2 : 0 ≤ (‖y - x'‖ - R₀) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (‖y - x'‖ - R₀)
        linarith
      have hvy := hM y s hs₁ hs₂
      have hvx' := hM x' s hs₁ hs₂
      have hM_le : M ≤ max M 0 := le_max_left M 0
      have h_sum_bound : |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| + |v (mkSpaceTime x' s)| ≤
          C / 4 + ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ₀) := by
        have h1 : (1 / (8 * ℓ₀)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
            (1 / (8 * ℓ₀)) * (2 * ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 + 2 * R₀ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy_sq (by positivity)
        have h2 : (1 / (8 * ℓ₀)) * ‖x'‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (8 * ℓ₀)) * R₀ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx'_sq (by positivity)
        have hC_def : C = 8 * max M 0 + (3 / (2 * ℓ₀)) * R₀ ^ 2 := rfl
        have h_alg : 2 * max M 0 + (1 / (8 * ℓ₀)) * (2 * ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 + 2 * R₀ ^ 2) +
            (1 / (8 * ℓ₀)) * R₀ ^ 2 = C / 4 + ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ₀) := by
          rw [hC_def]
          have hℓ₀_ne : ℓ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ₀
          field_simp [hℓ₀_ne]
          ring
        linarith
      have h_div_ineq : ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤ C / 4 + ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ₀) :=
        le_trans h_ineq h_sum_bound
      have h_mul : 4 * ℓ * (‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) ≤
          4 * ℓ * (C / 4 + ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ₀)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div_ineq (by positivity)
      have h_lhs : 4 * ℓ * (‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) = 2 * ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 := by
        have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ_pos
        field_simp [hℓ_ne]
        ring
      have h_rhs : 4 * ℓ * (C / 4 + ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ₀)) =
          C * ℓ + ℓ * (‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / ℓ₀) := by
        have hℓ₀_ne : ℓ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ₀
        field_simp [hℓ₀_ne]
      have h_scale : ℓ * (‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / ℓ₀) ≤ ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : ℓ * (‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / ℓ₀) ≤ ℓ₀ * (‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / ℓ₀) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hℓ_le (by positivity)
        have h2 : ℓ₀ * (‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / ℓ₀) = ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hℓ₀)
        linarith
      linarith
    refine ⟨C, hC_nonneg, fun x' y t' ℓ hx' hℓ_pos hℓ_le => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro hs₁ hs₂ h_opt
      have h_stat := (h_comp x' x' t' ℓ hℓ_pos).1
      simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow,
        zero_div, sub_zero] at h_stat
      have h1 : ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          v (mkSpaceTime y (t' + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x' (t' + ℓ)) := by linarith
      have h2 : v (mkSpaceTime y (t' + ℓ)) ≤ |v (mkSpaceTime y (t' + ℓ))| := le_abs_self _
      have h3 : -|v (mkSpaceTime x' (t' + ℓ))| ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x' (t' + ℓ)) := neg_abs_le _
      exact h_coercive x' y (t' + ℓ) ℓ hx' hℓ_pos hℓ_le hs₁ hs₂ (by linarith)
    · intro hs₁ hs₂ h_opt
      have h_stat := (h_comp x' x' t' ℓ hℓ_pos).2
      simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow,
        zero_div, sub_zero] at h_stat
      have h1 : ‖y - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          v (mkSpaceTime x' (t' - ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t' - ℓ)) := by linarith
      have h2 : v (mkSpaceTime x' (t' - ℓ)) ≤ |v (mkSpaceTime x' (t' - ℓ))| := le_abs_self _
      have h3 : -|v (mkSpaceTime y (t' - ℓ))| ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y (t' - ℓ)) := neg_abs_le _
      exact h_coercive x' y (t' - ℓ) ℓ hx' hℓ_pos hℓ_le hs₁ hs₂ (by linarith)
  have h_cross : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t h ε : ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < ε →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ → ℓ < δ →
          slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopePlus d h v (mkSpaceTime x t) + ε ∧
          slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopeMinus d h v (mkSpaceTime x t) + ε := by
    intro x t h ε hh hε
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁_nonneg, hC₁_bound⟩ :=
      h_loc (t - 1) (t + 1) ‖x‖ 1 (norm_nonneg x) zero_lt_one
    let R₁ : ℝ := C₁ + 1
    have hR₁_ge : 1 ≤ R₁ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂_nonneg, hC₂_bound⟩ :=
      h_loc (t - 1 - h) (t + 1 + h) (‖x‖ + R₁) h (by positivity) hh
    let R₂ : ℝ := C₂ * h + 1
    have hR₂_ge : 1 ≤ R₂ := by nlinarith
    let R_space : ℝ := ‖x‖ + R₁ + R₂
    let V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => v (mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2)
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2) := by
      unfold mkSpaceTime
      apply Continuous.comp (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _)
      rw [continuous_pi_iff]
      intro j

    have h_tendsto_p : Filter.Tendsto f_p (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H_p) :=

    have h_tendsto_m : Filter.Tendsto f_m (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H_m) :=
      h_mono_m.tendsto_nhdsGT h_bdd_m
    have h_le_mp : H_m ≤ H_p := by
      apply le_csInf h_nonempty_p
      rintro y ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
      apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := h_cross x t h ε hh hε
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < δ / 2 := by positivity
      have hℓ_lt_δ : δ / 2 < δ := by linarith
      have h_mem : f_m (δ / 2) ∈ f_m '' Set.Ioi 0 := ⟨δ / 2, hℓ_pos, rfl⟩
      have h1 : H_m ≤ f_m (δ / 2) := csInf_le h_bdd_m h_mem
      have h2 : f_m (δ / 2) ≤ f_p h + ε := (hδ (δ / 2) hℓ_pos hℓ_lt_δ).1
      linarith
    have h_le_pm : H_p ≤ H_m := by
      apply le_csInf h_nonempty_m
      rintro y ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
      apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := h_cross x t h ε hh hε
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < δ / 2 := by positivity
      have hℓ_lt_δ : δ / 2 < δ := by linarith
      have h_mem : f_p (δ / 2) ∈ f_p '' Set.Ioi 0 := ⟨δ / 2, hℓ_pos, rfl⟩
      have h1 : H_p ≤ f_p (δ / 2) := csInf_le h_bdd_p h_mem
      have h2 : f_p (δ / 2) ≤ f_m h + ε := (hδ (δ / 2) hℓ_pos hℓ_lt_δ).2
      linarith
    have h_eq : H_p = H_m := le_antisymm h_le_pm h_le_mp
    refine ⟨H_p, h_tendsto_p, ?_⟩
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_tendsto_m

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_mono : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ₁ → ℓ₁ ≤ ℓ₂ →
      slopePlus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopePlus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      slopeMinus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (b y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hy₀_opt : v (mkSpaceTime y₀ 1) - ‖y₀ - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 =
      quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0))
    (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ_lt : ℓ < 1) :
    slopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime y₀ 1)

signature.name: support_point_backward_slope_lower_bound
signature.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_mono : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ₁ → ℓ₁ ≤ ℓ₂ →

    (b y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hy₀_opt : v (mkSpaceTime y₀ 1) - ‖y₀ - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 =
      quadEnvelopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0))
    (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ_lt : ℓ < 1) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have h1mℓ_pos : 0 < 1 - ℓ := by linarith
  have h1mℓ_le : 1 - ℓ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have h1mℓ_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - ℓ := by linarith
  have hℓ_nonneg : 0 ≤ ℓ := by linarith
  let y_ℓ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := b + (1 - ℓ) • (y₀ - b)
  have hy_b : y_ℓ - b = (1 - ℓ) • (y₀ - b) := add_sub_cancel_left b ((1 - ℓ) • (y₀ - b))
  have hy_y0 : y_ℓ - y₀ = -(ℓ • (y₀ - b)) := by
    change b + (1 - ℓ) • (y₀ - b) - y₀ = -(ℓ • (y₀ - b))
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  have h_cost_fwd : ‖y_ℓ - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - ℓ)) = (1 - ℓ) * ‖y₀ - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [hy_b, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg h1mℓ_nonneg]
    have h1mℓ_ne : 1 - ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h1mℓ_pos
    field_simp
  have h_cost_bwd : ‖y_ℓ - y₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) = ℓ * ‖y₀ - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [hy_y0, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hℓ_nonneg]
    have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ_pos
    field_simp
  have h_fwd := (h_comp b y_ℓ 0 (1 - ℓ) h1mℓ_pos).1
  rw [zero_add, h_cost_fwd] at h_fwd
  have h_bwd := (h_comp y₀ y_ℓ 1 ℓ hℓ_pos).2
  rw [h_cost_bwd] at h_bwd
  have h_sp1 : slopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) =
      v (mkSpaceTime y₀ 1) - ‖y₀ - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 - v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
    unfold slopePlus
    rw [div_one, ← hy₀_opt]
  have h_mono_sp := (h_mono b 0 (1 - ℓ) 1 h1mℓ_pos h1mℓ_le).1
  have h_mul_mono :
      (1 - ℓ) * slopePlus d (1 - ℓ) v (mkSpaceTime b 0) ≤
        (1 - ℓ) * slopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mono_sp h1mℓ_nonneg
  have h_cost_sum :
      (1 - ℓ) * ‖y₀ - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 + ℓ * ‖y₀ - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 = ‖y₀ - b‖ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    ring
  have h_sp1_split :
      (1 - ℓ) * slopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) +
        ℓ * slopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) =
        slopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) := by
    ring
  have h_mul_goal :
      ℓ * slopePlus d 1 v (mkSpaceTime b 0) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime y₀ 1) := by
    linarith [h_fwd, h_bwd, h_sp1, h_mul_mono, h_cost_sum, h_sp1_split]
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_mul_goal hℓ_pos

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ κ : ℝ) (hκ_pos : 0 < κ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (hv_gap : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_attain : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)))
    (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hθ_pos : ∀ i, 0 < θ i)
    (hθ_sum : ∑ i, θ i = 1)
    (hy_mean : ∑ i, θ i • y i = 0)
    (hy_att : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) - (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i‖ ^ 2) / 2 =
      barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
    (B₀ ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ)
    (h_support_slope : ∀ i, B₀ ≤ slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) :
    B₀ - κ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)

signature.name: barycenter_forward_slope_transfer
signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ κ : ℝ) (hκ_pos : 0 < κ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (hv_gap : barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_attain : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)))
    (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hθ_pos : ∀ i, 0 < θ i)
    (hθ_sum : ∑ i, θ i = 1)
    (hy_mean : ∑ i, θ i • y i = 0)
    (hy_att : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) - (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i‖ ^ 2) / 2 =
      barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
    (B₀ ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ)
    (h_support_slope : ∀ i, B₀ ≤ slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) :
    B₀ - κ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_norm_smul_sq : ∀ (c : ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ‖c • w‖ ^ 2 = c ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro c w
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  have h_pw_ineq : ∀ (u w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ℓ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ℓ) * ‖u - w‖ ^ 2 + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro u w
    have h1 := norm_sub_sq_real u w
    have h2 := norm_sub_sq_real u ((1 + ℓ) • w)
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, h_norm_smul_sq] at h2
    have h_id : ‖u - (1 + ℓ) • w‖ ^ 2 =
        (1 + ℓ) * ‖u - w‖ ^ 2 + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - ℓ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination h2 - (1 + ℓ) * h1
    linarith [sq_nonneg ‖u - (1 + ℓ) • w‖, h_id]

  
  let S : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i‖ ^ 2
  let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt S
  have hS_nonneg : 0 ≤ S := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = S := Real.sq_sqrt hS_nonneg
  have h_jen1 := hv_jensen 1 N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
  dsimp only at h_jen1
  rw [hy_mean] at h_jen1
  simp only [sub_zero] at h_jen1
  change (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) ≤ κ * r at h_jen1
  have h_att1 : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) =
      (κ ^ 2 + r ^ 2) / 2 := by
    linarith [hy_att, hv_gap, hr_sq]
  have hr_sub_mul : (r - κ) * (r - κ) = 0 := by
    have h_expand : (r - κ) * (r - κ) = r ^ 2 + κ ^ 2 - 2 * (κ * r) := by ring
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ) * (r - κ) := mul_self_nonneg (r - κ)
    linarith [h_jen1, h_att1, h_nonneg, h_expand]
  have hr_eq : r = κ := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hr_sub_mul with h | h <;> linarith
  have hS_eq : S = κ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hr_sq, hr_eq]
  have hv_sum1 : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_att1, hr_eq]
    ring

  
  let y_hat : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun i => Classical.choose ((h_attain (y i) 1 ℓ hℓ_pos).1)
  have hy_hat_spec : ∀ i,
      v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) -
        ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
      ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) :=
    fun i => Classical.choose_spec ((h_attain (y i) 1 ℓ hℓ_pos).1)
  have h2ℓ_ne : (2 * ℓ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hy_hat_ineq : ∀ i : Fin N,
      θ i * (2 * ℓ ^ 2 * B₀) ≤
        2 * ℓ * (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ))) -
        2 * ℓ * (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) -
        θ i * ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    have h_eq : 2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ)) -
        2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 =
        2 * ℓ * (ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) := by
      calc 2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ)) -
            2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) - ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2
        _ = (v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) -
              ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) * (2 * ℓ) := by
            rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2ℓ_ne]
            ring
        _ = 2 * ℓ * (ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) := by
            rw [hy_hat_spec i]
            ring
    have h_slp : ℓ * B₀ ≤ ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_support_slope i) (le_of_lt hℓ_pos)
    have h_slp2 : 2 * ℓ * (ℓ * B₀) ≤ 2 * ℓ * (ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_slp (by linarith)
    have h_base : 2 * ℓ ^ 2 * B₀ ≤
        2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ)) -
        2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) -
        ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_ring : 2 * ℓ ^ 2 * B₀ = 2 * ℓ * (ℓ * B₀) := by ring
      linarith
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_base (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i))
    linarith
  have h_sum_s3 : 2 * ℓ ^ 2 * B₀ ≤
      2 * ℓ * (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ))) -
      2 * ℓ * (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) -
      ∑ i, θ i * ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hy_hat_ineq i)
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hθ_sum, one_mul] at h_sum
    exact h_sum

  
  let x_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y_hat i
  let ξ_hat : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => y_hat i - x_hat
  have h_mean_diff : ∑ i, θ i • (ξ_hat i - y i) = 0 := by
    have h_pt : ∀ i, θ i • (ξ_hat i - y i) = θ i • y_hat i - θ i • x_hat - θ i • y i := by
      intro i
      simp only [ξ_hat, smul_sub]
    simp_rw [h_pt]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, hθ_sum, one_smul, hy_mean]
    abel
  have h_orth_pt : ∀ i : Fin N,
      θ i * ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 =
        θ i * ‖x_hat‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ x_hat (θ i • (ξ_hat i - y i)) +
        θ i * ‖ξ_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    have h_split : y_hat i - y i = x_hat + (ξ_hat i - y i) := by
      dsimp only [ξ_hat]
      abel
    rw [h_split, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  have h_orth : (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2) =
      ‖x_hat‖ ^ 2 + ∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp_rw [h_orth_pt]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      ← inner_sum, hθ_sum, one_mul, h_mean_diff, inner_zero_right, mul_zero, add_zero]

  
  let S' : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ_hat i‖ ^ 2
  let r' : ℝ := Real.sqrt S'
  have hS'_nonneg : 0 ≤ S' := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hr'_sq : r' ^ 2 = S' := Real.sq_sqrt hS'_nonneg
  have h_pw_weighted : ∀ i : Fin N,
      ℓ * (θ i * ‖ξ_hat i‖ ^ 2) ≤
        (1 + ℓ) * (θ i * ‖ξ_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2) + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * (θ i * ‖y i‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro i
    have h_pw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_pw_ineq (ξ_hat i) (y i)) (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i))
    linarith
  have h_pw_sum : ℓ * r' ^ 2 ≤
      (1 + ℓ) * (∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2) + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * κ ^ 2 := by
    have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => h_pw_weighted i)
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h_sum
    change ℓ * S' ≤ (1 + ℓ) * (∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2) + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * S at h_sum
    rw [← hr'_sq, hS_eq] at h_sum
    exact h_sum
  have h_defect : 2 * ℓ * (κ * r') ≤
      (∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2) + (2 * ℓ + ℓ ^ 2) * κ ^ 2 := by
    have h_sq : 0 ≤ (r' - (1 + ℓ) * κ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have h_Id : (1 + ℓ) * (2 * ℓ * (κ * r')) =
        ℓ * r' ^ 2 + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) ^ 2 * κ ^ 2 - ℓ * (r' - (1 + ℓ) * κ) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_comb : (1 + ℓ) * (2 * ℓ * (κ * r')) ≤
        (1 + ℓ) * ((∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ_hat i - y i‖ ^ 2) + (2 * ℓ + ℓ ^ 2) * κ ^ 2) := by
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ℓ * (r' - (1 + ℓ) * κ) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hℓ_pos) h_sq
      have h_rhs : ℓ * (1 + ℓ) * κ ^ 2 + ℓ * (1 + ℓ) ^ 2 * κ ^ 2 =
          (1 + ℓ) * ((2 * ℓ + ℓ ^ 2) * κ ^ 2) := by ring
      linarith [h_Id, h_pw_sum, h_nonneg, h_rhs]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_comb (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + ℓ)

  
  have h_jen2 := hv_jensen (1 + ℓ) N θ y_hat hθ_pos hθ_sum
  dsimp only at h_jen2
  change (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ))) - v (mkSpaceTime x_hat (1 + ℓ)) ≤
    κ * r' at h_jen2
  have h_comp0 := (h_comp 0 x_hat 1 ℓ hℓ_pos).1
  rw [sub_zero] at h_comp0
  have h_comp0_clear :
      2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime x_hat (1 + ℓ)) - 2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - ‖x_hat‖ ^ 2 ≤
        2 * ℓ ^ 2 * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
    have h_eq : 2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime x_hat (1 + ℓ)) - 2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - ‖x_hat‖ ^ 2 =
        (v (mkSpaceTime x_hat (1 + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - ‖x_hat‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) * (2 * ℓ) := by
      rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2ℓ_ne]
      ring
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_comp0 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ℓ)
    have h_rhs : ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) * (2 * ℓ) =
        2 * ℓ ^ 2 * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by ring
    linarith
  have h_jen2_scaled :
      2 * ℓ * (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) (1 + ℓ))) -
        2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime x_hat (1 + ℓ)) ≤ 2 * ℓ * (κ * r') := by
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_jen2 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ℓ)
    linarith
  have hv_sum1_scaled :
      2 * ℓ * (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) -
        2 * ℓ * v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = 2 * ℓ * κ ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination (2 * ℓ) * hv_sum1
  have h_final_scaled :
      2 * ℓ ^ 2 * (B₀ - κ ^ 2 / 2) ≤ 2 * ℓ ^ 2 * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
    have h_alg : (2 * ℓ + ℓ ^ 2) * κ ^ 2 - 2 * ℓ * κ ^ 2 =
        2 * ℓ ^ 2 * B₀ - 2 * ℓ ^ 2 * (B₀ - κ ^ 2 / 2) := by ring
    linarith [h_sum_s3, h_orth, h_defect, h_comp0_clear, h_jen2_scaled, hv_sum1_scaled, h_alg]
  have h2ℓ_sq_pos : 0 < 2 * ℓ ^ 2 := by positivity
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_final_scaled h2ℓ_sq_pos

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_attain : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)))
    (h_mono : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ₁ → ℓ₁ ≤ ℓ₂ →
      slopePlus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopePlus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      slopeMinus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (R L₀ : ℝ) (x_end : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (x_r : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (τ_r ε_r : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hx_lim : Filter.Tendsto x_r Filter.atTop (nhds x_end))
    (hτ_lim : Filter.Tendsto τ_r Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (h_seq : ∀ r : ℕ,
      0 < τ_r r ∧ τ_r r ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < ε_r r ∧ ε_r r ≤ τ_r r / 4 ∧
      ‖x_r r‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧ L₀ ≤ driftFunctional d κ (ε_r r) v (mkSpaceTime (x_r r) (τ_r r))) :
    ∃ L_end : ℝ, ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ → L_end ≤ slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_mk_cont : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    apply (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _).comp
    rw [continuous_pi_iff]
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
      exact continuous_snd
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact ((continuous_apply i).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous).comp continuous_fst
  have hv_seq_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun r => v (mkSpaceTime (x_r r) (τ_r r)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0))) :=
    ((hv_cont.comp h_mk_cont).tendsto (x_end, 0)).comp (hx_lim.prodMk_nhds hτ_lim)
  have norm_sq_le_two_sub_add : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x y
    have h_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖x‖ := by
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - x) x
    have h_sq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖y - x‖ + ‖x‖) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg y) h_tri 2
    have h_amgm : 0 ≤ (‖y - x‖ - ‖x‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (‖y - x‖ - ‖x‖)
    linarith
  have norm_sq_sub_le_of_sq_le : ∀ (y x₁ x₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (B : ℝ),
      ‖y - x₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ B →
      ‖y - x₂‖ ^ 2 - ‖y - x₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ (B + 1) * ‖x₁ - x₂‖ + ‖x₁ - x₂‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro y x₁ x₂ B hB
    have h_tri : ‖y - x₂‖ ≤ ‖y - x₁‖ + ‖x₁ - x₂‖ := by
      simpa [sub_add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - x₁) (x₁ - x₂)
    have h_sq : ‖y - x₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖y - x₁‖ + ‖x₁ - x₂‖) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg (y - x₂)) h_tri 2
    have h_lin : 2 * ‖y - x₁‖ ≤ B + 1 := by
      have h_sq1 : 0 ≤ (‖y - x₁‖ - 1) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (‖y - x₁‖ - 1)
      linarith
    have h_mul : (2 * ‖y - x₁‖) * ‖x₁ - x₂‖ ≤ (B + 1) * ‖x₁ - x₂‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_lin (norm_nonneg (x₁ - x₂))
    linarith
  have h_bary_mem : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∈
        { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
          val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t)))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) } := by
    intro x t
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => x, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [h_projSpace]
    · simp [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  have h_bary_ub : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ val ∈
        { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
          val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t)))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) },
        val ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 := by
    intro x t ht val hval
    rcases hval with ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
    rw [h_projSpace] at hy_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projTime]
    have hj := hv_jensen t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at hj
    rw [hy_mean] at hj
    set V : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2
    set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt V
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = V := Real.sq_sqrt hV_nonneg
    have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ * t) ^ 2 / (2 * t) :=
      div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have h_id : κ * r - V / (2 * t) = κ ^ 2 * t / 2 - (r - κ * t) ^ 2 / (2 * t) := by
      rw [← hr_sq]
      have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
      field_simp [ht_ne]
      ring
    linarith
  have hW_le_v : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    intro x t ht
    unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope
    rw [h_projTime]
    have h_ub : barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 :=
      csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t), h_bary_mem x t⟩ (h_bary_ub x t ht)
    linarith
  have h_drift_ub : ∀ r : ℕ,
      2 * L₀ ≤ slopePlus d (ε_r r) v (mkSpaceTime (x_r r) (τ_r r)) +
        slopeMinus d (ε_r r) v (mkSpaceTime (x_r r) (τ_r r)) := by
    intro r
    obtain ⟨hτ_pos, _, hε_pos, _, _, h_drift⟩ := h_seq r
    set x := x_r r
    set τ := τ_r r
    set ε := ε_r r
    set z_r := mkSpaceTime x τ
    have hQ_ub : ∀ b ∈ (fun y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y' (projTime z_r + ε)) -
          ‖y' - projSpace z_r‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε)) '' Set.univ,
        b ≤ v z_r + ε * slopePlus d ε v z_r := by
      rintro b ⟨y', -, rfl⟩
      rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
      have hW_le : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y' (τ + ε)) ≤
          v (mkSpaceTime y' (τ + ε)) :=
        hW_le_v y' (τ + ε) (by linarith)
      have hv_le := (h_comp x y' τ ε hε_pos).1
      linarith
    have h_sup_le : quadEnvelopePlus d ε (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) z_r ≤
        v z_r + ε * slopePlus d ε v z_r := by
      apply csSup_le
      · exact ⟨_, ⟨x, Set.mem_univ x, rfl⟩⟩
      · exact hQ_ub
    have h_drift_mul : 2 * ε * L₀ ≤
        quadEnvelopePlus d ε (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) z_r -
          quadEnvelopeMinus d ε v z_r := by
      have h2ε : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ε := by positivity
      have h_le := (le_div_iff₀ h2ε).mp h_drift
      linarith
    have h_minus_mul : ε * slopeMinus d ε v z_r = v z_r - quadEnvelopeMinus d ε v z_r := by
      unfold slopeMinus
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hε_pos)
    have h_sum_mul : ε * (2 * L₀) ≤ ε * (slopePlus d ε v z_r + slopeMinus d ε v z_r) := by
      linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_sum_mul hε_pos
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := h_growth (-1) 1 (1 / 4) (by norm_num)
  let M_back : ℝ := 2 * M₀ + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (R + 1) ^ 2
  let L_end : ℝ := 2 * L₀ - M_back
  have h_slope_r : ∀ r : ℕ,
      L_end ≤ slopePlus d (ε_r r) v (mkSpaceTime (x_r r) (τ_r r)) := by
    intro r
    obtain ⟨hτ_pos, hτ_le, hε_pos, hε_le, hx_le, _⟩ := h_seq r
    set x := x_r r
    set τ := τ_r r
    set ε := ε_r r
    set z_r := mkSpaceTime x τ
    have h_mono_minus : slopeMinus d ε v z_r ≤ slopeMinus d 1 v z_r :=
      (h_mono x τ ε 1 hε_pos (by linarith)).2
    obtain ⟨y_minus, hy_minus⟩ := (h_attain x τ 1 zero_lt_one).2
    have hv_x : v (mkSpaceTime x τ) ≤ M₀ + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
      (abs_le.mp (hM₀ x τ (by linarith) (by linarith))).2
    have hv_ym : -v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (τ - 1)) ≤ M₀ + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖y_minus‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_abs := (abs_le.mp (hM₀ y_minus (τ - 1) (by linarith) (by linarith))).1
      linarith
    have hym_sq : ‖y_minus‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_sq_le_two_sub_add x y_minus
    have hx_sq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (R + 1) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg x) hx_le 2
    have h_minus_ub : slopeMinus d ε v z_r ≤ M_back := by
      dsimp [M_back]
      linarith
    have h_two := h_drift_ub r
    dsimp [L_end]
    linarith
  refine ⟨L_end, fun ℓ hℓ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨M_ℓ, hM_ℓ⟩ := h_growth ℓ ℓ (1 / (8 * ℓ)) (by positivity)
  let B_ℓ : ℝ := 8 * ℓ * max M_ℓ 0 + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (R + 1) ^ 2
  let R_err : ℕ → ℝ := fun r =>
    τ_r r * L_end + (v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - v (mkSpaceTime (x_r r) (τ_r r))) +
      ((B_ℓ + 1) * ‖x_r r - x_end‖ + ‖x_r r - x_end‖ ^ 2) / (2 * ℓ)
  have h_step_r : ∀ r : ℕ, τ_r r < ℓ / 2 →
      ℓ * L_end ≤ ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) + R_err r := by
    intro r hτ_lt
    obtain ⟨hτ_pos, _, hε_pos, hε_le, hx_le, _⟩ := h_seq r
    set x := x_r r
    set τ := τ_r r
    set ε := ε_r r
    set z_r := mkSpaceTime x τ
    let h_r : ℝ := ℓ - τ
    have hh_r_pos : 0 < h_r := by dsimp [h_r]; linarith
    have hh_r_le : h_r ≤ ℓ := by dsimp [h_r]; linarith
    have hε_le_hr : ε ≤ h_r := by dsimp [h_r]; linarith
    have hτ_add_hr : τ + h_r = ℓ := by dsimp [h_r]; ring
    have h_slope_hr : L_end ≤ slopePlus d h_r v z_r :=
      le_trans (h_slope_r r) ((h_mono x τ ε h_r hε_pos hε_le_hr).1)
    have h_mul_hr : (ℓ - τ) * L_end ≤ h_r * slopePlus d h_r v z_r := by
      have h_le := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_slope_hr (le_of_lt hh_r_pos)
      dsimp [h_r] at h_le ⊢
      linarith
    obtain ⟨y_plus, hy_plus⟩ := (h_attain x τ h_r hh_r_pos).1
    rw [hτ_add_hr] at hy_plus
    have h_stat : v (mkSpaceTime x ℓ) - v z_r ≤ h_r * slopePlus d h_r v z_r := by
      have h_c := (h_comp x x τ h_r hh_r_pos).1
      rw [hτ_add_hr] at h_c
      simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
        zero_pow, zero_div, sub_zero] at h_c
      exact h_c
    have h_pen_le : ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤ ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * h_r) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg ‖y_plus - x‖) (by positivity) (by linarith)
    have h_diff_le : ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus ℓ) - v (mkSpaceTime x ℓ) := by
      linarith
    have hv_yp : v (mkSpaceTime y_plus ℓ) ≤ M_ℓ + (1 / (8 * ℓ)) * ‖y_plus‖ ^ 2 :=
      (abs_le.mp (hM_ℓ y_plus ℓ le_rfl le_rfl)).2
    have hv_xℓ : -v (mkSpaceTime x ℓ) ≤ M_ℓ + (1 / (8 * ℓ)) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_abs := (abs_le.mp (hM_ℓ x ℓ le_rfl le_rfl)).1
      linarith
    have hyp_sq : ‖y_plus‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_sq_le_two_sub_add x y_plus
    have hx_sq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (R + 1) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg x) hx_le 2
    have h_one_8ℓ_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (8 * ℓ) := by positivity
    have h_yp_bound : (1 / (8 * ℓ)) * ‖y_plus‖ ^ 2 ≤
        2 * (‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (8 * ℓ)) + 2 * ((1 / (8 * ℓ)) * (R + 1) ^ 2) := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyp_sq h_one_8ℓ_pos
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx_sq h_one_8ℓ_pos
      have h3 : (1 / (8 * ℓ)) * (2 * ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) =
          2 * (‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (8 * ℓ)) + 2 * ((1 / (8 * ℓ)) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by ring
      linarith
    have h_xℓ_bound : (1 / (8 * ℓ)) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (8 * ℓ)) * (R + 1) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx_sq h_one_8ℓ_pos
    have h_div_rel : ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) = 4 * (‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (8 * ℓ)) := by ring
    have hM_max : M_ℓ ≤ max M_ℓ 0 := le_max_left M_ℓ 0
    have h_div_4ℓ : ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (8 * ℓ) ≤
        max M_ℓ 0 + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((1 / (8 * ℓ)) * (R + 1) ^ 2) := by
      linarith
    have h_disp_bound : ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ B_ℓ := by
      have h8ℓ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 8 * ℓ := by positivity
      have h_mul8 := (div_le_iff₀ h8ℓ_pos).mp h_div_4ℓ
      have h_id8 : (max M_ℓ 0 + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((1 / (8 * ℓ)) * (R + 1) ^ 2)) * (8 * ℓ) = B_ℓ := by
        dsimp [B_ℓ]
        have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ
        field_simp [hℓ_ne]
      linarith
    have h_quad_diff : ‖y_plus - x_end‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ((B_ℓ + 1) * ‖x - x_end‖ + ‖x - x_end‖ ^ 2) / (2 * ℓ) := by
      have h_sub := norm_sq_sub_le_of_sq_le y_plus x x_end B_ℓ h_disp_bound
      have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sub (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ℓ)
      have h_sub_div : (‖y_plus - x_end‖ ^ 2 - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * ℓ) =
          ‖y_plus - x_end‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) := sub_div _ _ _
      linarith
    have h_comp_end : v (mkSpaceTime y_plus ℓ) - v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) -
        ‖y_plus - x_end‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤ ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) := by
      have hc := (h_comp x_end y_plus 0 ℓ hℓ).1
      rw [zero_add] at hc
      exact hc
    dsimp [R_err]
    linarith
  have h_norm_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun r => ‖x_r r - x_end‖) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mp hx_lim
  have hR_err_lim : Filter.Tendsto R_err Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun r => τ_r r * L_end) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 * L_end)) :=
      hτ_lim.mul_const L_end
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun r => v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - v (mkSpaceTime (x_r r) (τ_r r)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0))) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.sub hv_seq_lim
    have h3 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun r => ((B_ℓ + 1) * ‖x_r r - x_end‖ + ‖x_r r - x_end‖ ^ 2) / (2 * ℓ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (((B_ℓ + 1) * 0 + 0 ^ 2) / (2 * ℓ))) :=
      ((h_norm_lim.const_mul (B_ℓ + 1)).add (h_norm_lim.pow 2)).div_const (2 * ℓ)
    have h_sum := (h1.add h2).add h3
    have h_zero : 0 * L_end + (v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0)) +
        ((B_ℓ + 1) * 0 + 0 ^ 2) / (2 * ℓ) = 0 := by ring
    rw [h_zero] at h_sum
    exact h_sum
  have h_ev : ∀ᶠ r in Filter.atTop,
      ℓ * L_end ≤ ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) + R_err r := by
    have h_ev_lt : ∀ᶠ r in Filter.atTop, τ_r r < ℓ / 2 :=
      hτ_lim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < ℓ / 2))
    exact h_ev_lt.mono h_step_r
  have h_lim_le : ℓ * L_end ≤ ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) + 0 :=
    ge_of_tendsto (tendsto_const_nhds.add hR_err_lim) h_ev
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hℓ

(d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    (t₀ L_low : ℝ) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀)
    (x_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (x_s : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ε_s : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hx_lim : Filter.Tendsto x_s Filter.atTop (nhds x_star))
    (hε_lim : Filter.Tendsto ε_s Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (h_seq : ∀ s : ℕ,
      0 < ε_s s ∧ ε_s s ≤ t₀ / 4 ∧
      L_low ≤ driftFunctional d κ (ε_s s) v (mkSpaceTime (x_s s) t₀)) :
    shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x_star t₀) = v (mkSpaceTime x_star t₀)
