proof.tactics:
by
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_cont_mk : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    refine (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _).comp (continuous_pi_iff.mpr fun j => ?_)
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simpa [Fin.snoc_last] using continuous_snd
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ i).comp continuous_fst
  have h_cont_Phi : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => v (mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2)) :=
    hv_cont.comp h_cont_mk
  have h_norm_add_sq : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖a + b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : ‖a + b‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ := norm_add_le a b
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖a + b‖ := norm_nonneg (a + b)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (‖a‖ - ‖b‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (‖a‖ - ‖b‖)
    nlinarith
  have h_bary_mem : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∈
        { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
          val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t)))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) } := by
    intro x t
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => x, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [h_projSpace]
    · simp [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  have h_bary_ub : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ val ∈
        { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
          val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t)))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) },
        val ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 := by
    intro x t ht val hval
    rcases hval with ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
    rw [h_projSpace] at hy_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projTime]
    have hj := hv_jensen t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at hj
    rw [hy_mean] at hj
    set V : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2
    set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt V
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = V := Real.sq_sqrt hV_nonneg
    have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ * t) ^ 2 / (2 * t) :=
      div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have h_id : κ * r - V / (2 * t) = κ ^ 2 * t / 2 - (r - κ * t) ^ 2 / (2 * t) := by
      rw [← hr_sq]
      have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
      field_simp [ht_ne]
      ring
    linarith
  have hW_comp : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • y i = x) →
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤
            shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    intro x t ht N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hy_mean
    unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope
    rw [h_projTime]
    have h_le : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) ≤
          barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
      apply le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2, h_bary_ub x t ht⟩
      refine ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [h_projSpace, hy_mean]
      · rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
    linarith
  have hW_sand : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    intro x t ht
    unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope
    rw [h_projTime]
    have h_lb : v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) :=
      le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2, h_bary_ub x t ht⟩ (h_bary_mem x t)
    have h_ub : barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 :=
      csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t), h_bary_mem x t⟩ (h_bary_ub x t ht)
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hW_trunc : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • y i = x) →
        4 * κ ^ 2 * t ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2 →
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤
            v (mkSpaceTime x t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 := by
    intro x t ht N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hy_mean hV_ge
    have hj := hv_jensen t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at hj
    rw [hy_mean] at hj
    set V : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2
    set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt V
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = V := Real.sq_sqrt hV_nonneg
    have h_term1 : 0 ≤ (V - 4 * κ ^ 2 * t ^ 2) / (4 * t) :=
      div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h_term2 : 0 ≤ (r - 2 * κ * t) ^ 2 / (4 * t) :=
      div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have h_id : κ * r - V / (2 * t) =
        -((V - 4 * κ ^ 2 * t ^ 2) / (4 * t)) - (r - 2 * κ * t) ^ 2 / (4 * t) := by
      rw [← hr_sq]
      have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
      field_simp [ht_ne]
      ring
    linarith
  have hW_elim : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t B : ℝ), 0 < t →
      (∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • y i = x) →
        (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) -
          (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) - κ ^ 2 * t / 2 ≤ B) →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ B := by
    intro x t B ht h_all
    unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope
    rw [h_projTime]
    have h_sup : barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ B + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 := by
      apply csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t), h_bary_mem x t⟩
      rintro val ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
      rw [h_projSpace] at hy_mean ⊢
      rw [h_projTime]
      have h_b := h_all N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum hy_mean
      linarith
    linarith
  let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
  let z_star := mkSpaceTime x_star t₀
  apply le_antisymm (hW_sand x_star t₀ ht₀).2
  by_contra h_not_le
  push_neg at h_not_le
  let δ : ℝ := (v z_star - W z_star) / 4
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  let η₁ : ℝ := δ / 4
  let η₂ : ℝ := δ / (28 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2)
  have hη₁_pos : 0 < η₁ := by positivity
  have hη₂_pos : 0 < η₂ := by positivity
  have h_shift : ∃ ρ_shift : ℝ, 0 < ρ_shift ∧
      ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ε : ℝ),
        ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ρ_shift → 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ t₀ → ε ≤ ρ_shift →
        ∀ (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          v (mkSpaceTime ξ (t₀ + ε)) - v (mkSpaceTime (ξ - y + x_star) t₀) ≤
            η₁ + η₂ * ‖ξ - y‖ ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := h_growth 0 (2 * t₀) (η₂ / 8) (by positivity)
    let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right M₀ 0
    have hM_bound : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        0 ≤ s → s ≤ 2 * t₀ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + (η₂ / 8) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro y s hs₁ hs₂
      have h1 := hM₀ y s hs₁ hs₂
      have h2 : M₀ ≤ M := le_max_left M₀ 0
      linarith
    let C_tail : ℝ := 2 * M + η₂ * (1 + ‖x_star‖ ^ 2)
    have hC_tail_pos : 0 < C_tail := by positivity
    let R_cut : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * C_tail / η₂) + 1
    have hR_cut_pos : 0 < R_cut := by positivity
    let K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) :=
      Metric.closedBall x_star (R_cut + 1) ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 (2 * t₀)
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K := (isCompact_closedBall x_star (R_cut + 1)).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hPhi_uc : UniformContinuousOn (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => v (mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2)) K :=
      hK_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous h_cont_Phi.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨δ_uc, hδ_uc_pos, hδ_uc⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hPhi_uc η₁ hη₁_pos
    let ρ_shift : ℝ := min 1 (δ_uc / 2)
    have hρ_shift_pos : 0 < ρ_shift := lt_min zero_lt_one (half_pos hδ_uc_pos)
    refine ⟨ρ_shift, hρ_shift_pos, fun y ε hy hε₀ hε_t₀ hε_ρ ξ => ?_⟩
    have hy_one : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ 1 := le_trans hy (min_le_left _ _)
    by_cases h_in : ‖ξ - y‖ ≤ R_cut
    · have hξ_ball : ξ ∈ Metric.closedBall x_star (R_cut + 1) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have h_tri : ‖ξ - x_star‖ ≤ ‖ξ - y‖ + ‖y - x_star‖ := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub ξ y x_star
        linarith
      have hξ_shift_ball : ξ - y + x_star ∈ Metric.closedBall x_star (R_cut + 1) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_right]
        linarith
      have hp₁ : (ξ, t₀ + ε) ∈ K := ⟨hξ_ball, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
      have hp₂ : (ξ - y + x_star, t₀) ∈ K := ⟨hξ_shift_ball, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
      have h_dist : dist (ξ, t₀ + ε) (ξ - y + x_star, t₀) < δ_uc := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
        have h_fst : dist ξ (ξ - y + x_star) = ‖y - x_star‖ := by
          rw [dist_eq_norm]
          congr 1
          abel
        have h_snd : dist (t₀ + ε) t₀ = ε := by
          rw [Real.dist_eq, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_nonneg hε₀]
        rw [h_fst, h_snd]
        have hy_δ : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ δ_uc / 2 := le_trans hy (min_le_right _ _)
        have hε_δ : ε ≤ δ_uc / 2 := le_trans hε_ρ (min_le_right _ _)
        constructor <;> linarith
      have h_uc_app := hδ_uc (ξ, t₀ + ε) hp₁ (ξ - y + x_star, t₀) hp₂ h_dist
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h_uc_app
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ η₂ * ‖ξ - y‖ ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hη₂_pos) (sq_nonneg _)
      linarith [(abs_lt.mp h_uc_app).2]
    · push_neg at h_in
      have hy_sq_one : ‖y - x_star‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (y - x_star)]
      have hy_norm_sq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y - x_star‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x_star‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := h_norm_add_sq (y - x_star) x_star
        rw [sub_add_cancel] at h1
        exact h1
      have hξ_norm_sq : ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖ξ - y‖ ^ 2 + 4 + 4 * ‖x_star‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := h_norm_add_sq (ξ - y) y
        rw [sub_add_cancel] at h1
        linarith
      have hξ_shift_norm_sq : ‖ξ - y + x_star‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖ξ - y‖ ^ 2 + 4 + 4 * ‖x_star‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := h_norm_add_sq (ξ - y) x_star
        have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖x_star‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        linarith
      have hv₁ := hM_bound ξ (t₀ + ε) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hv₂ := hM_bound (ξ - y + x_star) t₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hv₁_ub : v (mkSpaceTime ξ (t₀ + ε)) ≤ M + (η₂ / 8) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 := (abs_le.mp hv₁).2
      have hv₂_lb : -(M + (η₂ / 8) * ‖ξ - y + x_star‖ ^ 2) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime (ξ - y + x_star) t₀) :=
        (abs_le.mp hv₂).1
      have h_diff_tail : v (mkSpaceTime ξ (t₀ + ε)) - v (mkSpaceTime (ξ - y + x_star) t₀) ≤
          C_tail + (η₂ / 2) * ‖ξ - y‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [C_tail]
        nlinarith
      have h_sqrt_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * C_tail / η₂) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h_R_ge : Real.sqrt (2 * C_tail / η₂) ≤ ‖ξ - y‖ := by
        dsimp [R_cut] at h_in
        linarith
      have h_sq_ge : 2 * C_tail / η₂ ≤ ‖ξ - y‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_sq_eq : (Real.sqrt (2 * C_tail / η₂)) ^ 2 = 2 * C_tail / η₂ :=
          Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
        nlinarith
      have h_C_le : C_tail ≤ (η₂ / 2) * ‖ξ - y‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ hη₂_pos).mp h_sq_ge
        linarith
      linarith
  obtain ⟨ρ_shift, hρ_shift_pos, hρ_shift⟩ := h_shift
  obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁_pos, hρ₁⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (h_cont_Phi.continuousAt (x := (x_star, t₀))) δ hδ_pos
  let ρ_W : ℝ := min (ρ₁ / 2) (min ρ_shift (δ / (7 * κ ^ 2)))
  have hρ_W_pos : 0 < ρ_W := lt_min (half_pos hρ₁_pos) (lt_min hρ_shift_pos (by positivity))
  have h_usc : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ε : ℝ),
      ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ρ_W → 0 < ε → ε ≤ t₀ / 4 → ε ≤ ρ_W →
      W (mkSpaceTime y (t₀ + ε)) ≤ W z_star + δ := by
    intro y ε hy_W hε_pos hε_t₀ hε_W
    let τ : ℝ := t₀ + ε
    have hτ_pos : 0 < τ := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
    apply hW_elim y τ (W z_star + δ) hτ_pos
    intro N θ ξ hθ_pos hθ_sum hξ_mean
    set V : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ i - y‖ ^ 2
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    by_cases hV : 4 * κ ^ 2 * τ ^ 2 ≤ V
    · have h_tr := hW_trunc y τ hτ_pos N θ ξ hθ_pos hθ_sum hξ_mean hV
      have h_sand_star := (hW_sand x_star t₀ ht₀).1
      have h_dist : dist (y, τ) (x_star, t₀) < ρ₁ := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff, dist_eq_norm, Real.dist_eq]
        have h_sub : τ - t₀ = ε := by dsimp [τ]; ring
        rw [h_sub, abs_of_pos hε_pos]
        have hy_1 : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ρ₁ / 2 := le_trans hy_W (min_le_left _ _)
        have hε_1 : ε ≤ ρ₁ / 2 := le_trans hε_W (min_le_left _ _)
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hv_close := hρ₁ h_dist
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hv_close
      have hv_ub : v (mkSpaceTime y τ) - v z_star < δ := (abs_lt.mp hv_close).2
      have hκ_sq_pos : 0 < κ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hκ
      have h_pen_mono : κ ^ 2 * t₀ / 2 ≤ κ ^ 2 * τ / 2 := by
        dsimp [τ]
        nlinarith
      dsimp [W, z_star] at h_sand_star hv_ub ⊢
      linarith
    · have hV_lt : V < 4 * κ ^ 2 * τ ^ 2 := lt_of_not_ge hV
      have hτ_le : τ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * t₀ := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
      have hτ_sq : τ ^ 2 ≤ (7 / 4 : ℝ) * t₀ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hκ_sq_pos : 0 < κ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hκ
      have hV_le : V ≤ 7 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      let ξ_tilde : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => ξ i - y + x_star
      have hξ_tilde_mean : ∑ i, θ i • ξ_tilde i = x_star := by
        have h_rw : ∀ i, θ i • ξ_tilde i = θ i • ξ i - θ i • (y - x_star) := by
          intro i
          dsimp [ξ_tilde]
          rw [← smul_sub]
          congr 1
          abel
        simp_rw [h_rw, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, hξ_mean, hθ_sum, one_smul,
          sub_sub_cancel]
      have hξ_tilde_var : ∑ i, θ i * ‖ξ_tilde i - x_star‖ ^ 2 = V := by
        dsimp [ξ_tilde, V]
        simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]
      have h_comp_star := hW_comp x_star t₀ ht₀ N θ ξ_tilde hθ_pos hθ_sum hξ_tilde_mean
      rw [hξ_tilde_var] at h_comp_star
      have hy_shift : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ρ_shift :=
        le_trans hy_W (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have hε_shift : ε ≤ ρ_shift :=
        le_trans hε_W (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have h_sum_shift : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (ξ i) τ)) -
          (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (ξ_tilde i) t₀)) ≤ η₁ + η₂ * V := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        have h_le : ∑ i, (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (ξ i) τ) - θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (ξ_tilde i) t₀)) ≤
            ∑ i, (θ i * η₁ + η₂ * (θ i * ‖ξ i - y‖ ^ 2)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          have hi := hρ_shift y ε hy_shift (le_of_lt hε_pos) (by linarith) hε_shift (ξ i)
          have hθi : 0 ≤ θ i := le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)
          dsimp [ξ_tilde, τ] at hi ⊢
          nlinarith
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hθ_sum, one_mul] at h_le
        exact h_le
      have h_eta_V : η₁ + η₂ * V ≤ δ / 2 := by
        have h_mul : (δ / (28 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2)) * V ≤
            (δ / (28 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2)) * (7 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV_le (by positivity)
        have h_eq : (δ / (28 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2)) * (7 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2) = δ / 4 := by
          have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ
          have ht₀_ne : t₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht₀
          field_simp [hκ_ne, ht₀_ne]
          ring
        dsimp [η₁, η₂]
        linarith
      have h_pen_shift : V / (2 * t₀) - V / (2 * τ) ≤ δ / 2 := by
        have h_alg : V / (2 * t₀) - V / (2 * τ) = (V * ε) / (2 * t₀ * τ) := by
          dsimp [τ]
          have ht₀_ne : t₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht₀
          have hτ_ne : t₀ + ε ≠ 0 := by linarith
          field_simp [ht₀_ne, hτ_ne]
          ring
        rw [h_alg, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        have hε_bound : ε ≤ δ / (7 * κ ^ 2) :=
          le_trans hε_W (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
        have hε_κ : 7 * κ ^ 2 * ε ≤ δ := by
          have h1 := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 7 * κ ^ 2)).mp hε_bound
          linarith
        have h_num : V * ε ≤ 7 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * ε :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hV_le (le_of_lt hε_pos)
        have h_num2 : 7 * κ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * ε ≤ δ * t₀ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        have h_denom : δ * t₀ ^ 2 ≤ δ / 2 * (2 * t₀ * τ) := by
          have h_diff : δ / 2 * (2 * t₀ * τ) - δ * t₀ ^ 2 = δ * t₀ * ε := by
            dsimp [τ]
            ring
          have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ δ * t₀ * ε := by positivity
          linarith
        linarith
      have h_pen_mono : κ ^ 2 * t₀ / 2 ≤ κ ^ 2 * τ / 2 := by
        dsimp [τ]
        nlinarith
      dsimp [W, z_star] at h_comp_star ⊢
      linarith
  obtain ⟨M₀_c, hM₀_c⟩ := h_growth 0 (2 * t₀) (1 / (2 * t₀)) (by positivity)
  let M_c : ℝ := max M₀_c 0
  have hM_c_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_c := le_max_right M₀_c 0
  have hM_c_bound : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      0 ≤ s → s ≤ 2 * t₀ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M_c + (1 / (2 * t₀)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro y s hs₁ hs₂
    have h1 := hM₀_c y s hs₁ hs₂
    have h2 : M₀_c ≤ M_c := le_max_left M₀_c 0
    linarith
  let C_base : ℝ := M_c + (1 / t₀) * (‖x_star‖ + 1) ^ 2
  have hC_base_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_base := by positivity
  let C_star : ℝ := |v z_star| + |W z_star| + C_base + 1
  have hC_star_pos : 0 < C_star := by positivity
  let ρ : ℝ := min 1 ρ_W
  have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := lt_min zero_lt_one hρ_W_pos
  have hx_ev : ∀ᶠ s : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ‖x_s s - x_star‖ ≤ ρ / 2 := by
    have h_ball : Metric.ball x_star (ρ / 2) ∈ nhds x_star := Metric.ball_mem_nhds x_star (half_pos hρ_pos)
    filter_upwards [hx_lim h_ball] with s hs
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hs
    exact le_of_lt hs
  have hε_ev1 : ∀ᶠ s : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ε_s s ≤ ρ :=
    hε_lim.eventually (eventually_le_nhds hρ_pos)
  have hε_ev2 : ∀ᶠ s : ℕ in Filter.atTop, 4 * C_star * ε_s s ≤ (ρ / 2) ^ 2 := by
    have h_thresh_pos : 0 < (ρ / 2) ^ 2 / (4 * C_star) := by positivity
    filter_upwards [hε_lim.eventually (eventually_le_nhds h_thresh_pos)] with s hs
    have h1 := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * C_star)).mp hs
    linarith
  have h_lim_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => 2 * ε_s s * L_low) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h0 : (2 : ℝ) * 0 * L_low = 0 := by ring
    rw [← h0]
    exact (hε_lim.const_mul 2).mul_const L_low
  have h_drift_ev : ∀ᶠ s : ℕ in Filter.atTop, -δ < 2 * ε_s s * L_low :=
    h_lim_zero.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds (by linarith))
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨⟨⟨hx_s_ρ, hε_s_ρ⟩, hε_s_thresh⟩, h_drift_s⟩⟩ :=
    (((hx_ev.and hε_ev1).and hε_ev2).and h_drift_ev).exists
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε_s s := (h_seq s).1
  have hε_t₀ : ε_s s ≤ t₀ / 4 := (h_seq s).2.1
  have hx_s_one : ‖x_s s - x_star‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have : ρ ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  have h_growth_shift : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (τ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ 2 * t₀ → |v (mkSpaceTime y τ)| ≤ C_base + (1 / t₀) * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro y τ hτ₁ hτ₂
    have hv_b := hM_c_bound y τ hτ₁ hτ₂
    have hx_norm : ‖x_s s‖ ≤ ‖x_star‖ + 1 := by
      have h_tri := norm_le_insert' (x_s s) x_star
      linarith
    have hx_sq : ‖x_s s‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖x_star‖ + 1) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (x_s s)]
    have hy_sq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (‖x_star‖ + 1) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := h_norm_add_sq (y - x_s s) (x_s s)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at h1
      linarith
    have h_div_pos : 0 < 1 / (2 * t₀) := by positivity
    have h_mul : (1 / (2 * t₀)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 / t₀) * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 + (1 / t₀) * (‖x_star‖ + 1) ^ 2 := by
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy_sq (le_of_lt h_div_pos)
      have h_eq : (1 / (2 * t₀)) * (2 * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (‖x_star‖ + 1) ^ 2) =
          (1 / t₀) * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 + (1 / t₀) * (‖x_star‖ + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith
    dsimp [C_base]
    linarith
  have h_pen_dom_far : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      4 * C_star * ε_s s ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 →
      C_star + (1 / t₀) * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε_s s) := by
    intro y hy
    have h_diff_eq : ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε_s s) - (1 / t₀) * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 * (t₀ - 2 * ε_s s) / (2 * ε_s s * t₀) := by
      have hε_ne : ε_s s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hε_pos
      have ht₀_ne : t₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht₀
      field_simp [hε_ne, ht₀_ne]
    have h_ge_quarter : ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ε_s s) ≤
        ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 * (t₀ - 2 * ε_s s) / (2 * ε_s s * t₀) := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      have h_alg : ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 * (t₀ - 2 * ε_s s) * (4 * ε_s s) -
          ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 * (2 * ε_s s * t₀) =
        2 * (‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 * ε_s s) * (t₀ - 4 * ε_s s) := by ring
      have h_prod_nonneg : 0 ≤ (‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 * ε_s s) * (t₀ - 4 * ε_s s) :=
        mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h_cstar : C_star ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ε_s s) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    linarith
  have h_minus_s : v z_star - δ ≤ quadEnvelopeMinus d (ε_s s) v (mkSpaceTime (x_s s) t₀) := by
    apply le_csInf
    · exact ⟨_, ⟨x_s s, Set.mem_univ (x_s s), rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro b ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
      rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
      by_cases hy : 4 * C_star * ε_s s ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2
      · have hv_b := h_growth_shift y (t₀ - ε_s s) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have hv_lb : -(C_base + (1 / t₀) * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y (t₀ - ε_s s)) :=
          (abs_le.mp hv_b).1
        have h_pen_dom := h_pen_dom_far y hy
        have hv_star_le : v z_star ≤ |v z_star| := le_abs_self (v z_star)
        have hW_abs_nonneg : 0 ≤ |W z_star| := abs_nonneg (W z_star)
        dsimp [C_star] at h_pen_dom
        linarith
      · push_neg at hy
        have hy_sq_ρ : ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 < (ρ / 2) ^ 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hy hε_s_thresh
        have hy_ρ_half : ‖y - x_s s‖ ≤ ρ / 2 := by
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg (y - x_s s)]
        have hy_ρ : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ρ := by
          have h_tri : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ + ‖x_s s - x_star‖ :=
            norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub y (x_s s) x_star
          linarith
        have h_dist : dist (y, t₀ - ε_s s) (x_star, t₀) < ρ₁ := by
          rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff, dist_eq_norm, Real.dist_eq]
          have h_sub : t₀ - ε_s s - t₀ = -ε_s s := by ring
          rw [h_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hε_pos]
          have hy_1 : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ρ₁ / 2 :=
            le_trans hy_ρ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
          have hε_1 : ε_s s ≤ ρ₁ / 2 :=
            le_trans hε_s_ρ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
          constructor <;> linarith
        have hv_close := hρ₁ h_dist
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hv_close
        have hv_lb : v z_star - δ < v (mkSpaceTime y (t₀ - ε_s s)) := by
          linarith [(abs_lt.mp hv_close).1]
        have h_pen_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε_s s) :=
          div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
        linarith
  have h_plus_s : quadEnvelopePlus d (ε_s s) W (mkSpaceTime (x_s s) t₀) ≤ W z_star + δ := by
    apply csSup_le
    · exact ⟨_, ⟨x_s s, Set.mem_univ (x_s s), rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro b ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
      rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
      by_cases hy : 4 * C_star * ε_s s ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2
      · have hW_le_v : W (mkSpaceTime y (t₀ + ε_s s)) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y (t₀ + ε_s s)) :=
          (hW_sand y (t₀ + ε_s s) (by linarith)).2
        have hv_b := h_growth_shift y (t₀ + ε_s s) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have hv_ub : v (mkSpaceTime y (t₀ + ε_s s)) ≤ C_base + (1 / t₀) * ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 :=
          (abs_le.mp hv_b).2
        have h_pen_dom := h_pen_dom_far y hy
        have hW_star_ge : -|W z_star| ≤ W z_star := neg_abs_le (W z_star)
        have hv_abs_nonneg : 0 ≤ |v z_star| := abs_nonneg (v z_star)
        dsimp [C_star] at h_pen_dom
        linarith
      · push_neg at hy
        have hy_sq_ρ : ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 < (ρ / 2) ^ 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hy hε_s_thresh
        have hy_ρ_half : ‖y - x_s s‖ ≤ ρ / 2 := by
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg (y - x_s s)]
        have hy_ρ : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ρ := by
          have h_tri : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ + ‖x_s s - x_star‖ :=
            norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub y (x_s s) x_star
          linarith
        have hy_W : ‖y - x_star‖ ≤ ρ_W := le_trans hy_ρ (min_le_right _ _)
        have hε_W : ε_s s ≤ ρ_W := le_trans hε_s_ρ (min_le_right _ _)
        have hW_ub := h_usc y (ε_s s) hy_W hε_pos hε_t₀ hε_W
        have h_pen_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y - x_s s‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε_s s) :=
          div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
        linarith
  have h_j_lb : L_low ≤ driftFunctional d κ (ε_s s) v (mkSpaceTime (x_s s) t₀) := (h_seq s).2.2
  dsimp [driftFunctional] at h_j_lb
  have h_two_ε_pos : 0 < 2 * ε_s s := by positivity
  have h_mul_lb : 2 * ε_s s * L_low ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d (ε_s s) W (mkSpaceTime (x_s s) t₀) -
        quadEnvelopeMinus d (ε_s s) v (mkSpaceTime (x_s s) t₀) := by
    have h1 := (le_div_iff₀ h_two_ε_pos).mp h_j_lb
    linarith
  dsimp [W, z_star, δ] at h_minus_s h_plus_s h_drift_s h_mul_lb
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ κ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (R K L₀ D₀ : ℝ) (M_blk N_seq : ℕ → ℕ) (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x_term : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (x_mk p_mk : ℕ → ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (a_mk : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_pre : HasPrelimitWalkContacts d C₁ κ v R K L₀ D₀ M_blk N_seq ε_seq x_term x_mk p_mk a_mk)
    (h_contact : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
      (x_s : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ε_s : ℕ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ j →
      let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
      Filter.Tendsto x_s Filter.atTop (nhds x_star) →
      Filter.Tendsto ε_s Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      (∀ s : ℕ, 0 < ε_s s ∧ ε_s s ≤ δ_j / 4 ∧
        L₀ - D₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ driftFunctional d κ (ε_s s) v (mkSpaceTime (x_s s) δ_j)) →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x_star δ_j) = v (mkSpaceTime x_star δ_j))
    (x_end : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (φ₀ : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hφ₀_mono : StrictMono φ₀)
    (hx_end : Filter.Tendsto (fun r => x_term (φ₀ r)) Filter.atTop (nhds x_end))
    (h : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    ∃ (j : ℕ) (x p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
      h ≤ j ∧
      let r_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x r_j) = v (mkSpaceTime x r_j) ∧
      IsFitAt d C₁ v x r_j r_j p a ∧
      ‖x_end - x + r_j • p‖ ≤ K * r_j

proof.tactics:
by
  let K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ
  have hz₀_K : z₀ ∈ K := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le
  have hK_nonempty : K.Nonempty := ⟨z₀, hz₀_K⟩
  have hK_compact : IsCompact K := isCompact_closedBall z₀ ρ
  have h_ex_max : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ wi ∈ K, i₁ ≤ i → ∀ w ∈ K, f_seq i w ≤ f_seq i wi := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i₁ ≤ i
    · obtain ⟨wi, hwi_K, hwi_max⟩ := hK_compact.exists_isMaxOn hK_nonempty (hf_cont i hi)
      exact ⟨wi, hwi_K, fun _ w hw => isMaxOn_iff.mp hwi_max w hw⟩
    · exact ⟨z₀, hz₀_K, fun h_le => False.elim (hi h_le)⟩
  choose w_seq hw_seq using h_ex_max
  have hw_K : ∀ i : ℕ, w_seq i ∈ K := fun i => (hw_seq i).1
  have hw_max_K : ∀ i : ℕ, i₁ ≤ i → ∀ w ∈ K, f_seq i w ≤ f_seq i (w_seq i) :=
    fun i hi w hw => (hw_seq i).2 hi w hw
  have hw_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto w_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro r hr_pos
    let δ : ℝ := min r ρ
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hr_pos hρ
    let ε : ℝ := δ ^ 4 / 4
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hf_unif ε hε_pos
    refine ⟨max i₁ i₀, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    have hi₁ : i₁ ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_left i₁ i₀) hi
    have hi₀_le : i₀ ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_right i₁ i₀) hi
    have hwi_K : w_seq i ∈ K := hw_K i
    have h_max_z₀ : f_seq i z₀ ≤ f_seq i (w_seq i) := hw_max_K i hi₁ z₀ hz₀_K
    have h_unif_wi : f_seq i (w_seq i) - f (w_seq i) ≤ ε :=
      (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hi₀ i hi₀_le (w_seq i) hwi_K)).1
    have h_unif_z₀ : f z₀ - f_seq i z₀ ≤ ε :=
      (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hi₀ i hi₀_le z₀ hz₀_K)).2
    have h_marg_wi : f (w_seq i) ≤ -‖w_seq i - z₀‖ ^ 4 := hf_margin (w_seq i) hwi_K
    have h_quartic_le : ‖w_seq i - z₀‖ ^ 4 ≤ 2 * ε := by linarith
    have h_lt_δ : ‖w_seq i - z₀‖ < δ := by
      by_contra h_not_lt
      have h_le_norm : δ ≤ ‖w_seq i - z₀‖ := not_lt.mp h_not_lt
      have h_pow : δ ^ 4 ≤ ‖w_seq i - z₀‖ ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hδ_pos.le h_le_norm 4
      have hδ4_pos : 0 < δ ^ 4 := by positivity
      dsimp [ε] at h_quartic_le
      linarith
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lt_δ (min_le_left r ρ)
  have h_ev_ball : ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, w_seq i ∈ Metric.ball z₀ ρ :=
    hw_tendsto.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ))
  obtain ⟨i₃, hi₃⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp h_ev_ball
  refine ⟨max i₁ i₃, w_seq, le_max_left i₁ i₃, hw_tendsto, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have hi₁ : i₁ ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_left i₁ i₃) hi
  have hi₃_le : i₃ ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_right i₁ i₃) hi
  exact ⟨hi₃ i hi₃_le, fun w hw => hw_max_K i hi₁ w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw)⟩

        inner ℝ z₁ z₂ = inner ℝ (projSpace z₁) (projSpace z₂) + projTime z₁ * projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [projSpace, projTime, mul_comm]
  let projTimeCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := projTime
        map_add' := projTime_add
        map_smul' := projTime_smul }
  have deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv :
      ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
        {f : E → ℝ} {V : Set E}, IsOpen V → ∀ {z₀ : E}, z₀ ∈ V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f V → ∀ (v : E),
        deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => f (z₀ + t • v))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ v v := by
    intro E _ _ f V hV z₀ hz₀ hf v
    have h_pre : IsOpen ((fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • v) ⁻¹' V) :=
      hV.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • v) ⁻¹' V := by simp [hz₀]
    have h_ev : (fun t : ℝ => deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (z₀ + s • v)) t) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        (fun t : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + t • v)) v) := by
      filter_upwards [h_pre.mem_nhds h0_mem] with t ht
      have hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z₀ + t • v) :=
        ((hf.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds ht)).differentiableAt (by norm_num))
      have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • v) v t := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const v |>.const_add z₀
      exact (hf_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h_line).deriv
    rw [h_ev.deriv_eq]
    have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f z₀ := hf.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hz₀)
    have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ := hcd.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hf2_diff : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀) (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • v) := by
      simpa using (hcd1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have h_line0 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => z₀ + t • v) v 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v |>.const_add z₀
    have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + t • v))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ v) 0 :=
      hf2_diff.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line0
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_comp).deriv
  let stretchCLM : ℝ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :=
    fun s => LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := fun w => mkSpaceTime (s • projSpace w) (projTime w)
        map_add' := fun w₁ w₂ => by
          rw [projSpace_add, smul_add, projTime_add, mkSpaceTime_add]
        map_smul' := fun a w => by
          rw [projSpace_smul, smul_comm s a, projTime_smul, RingHom.id_apply, mkSpaceTime_smul] }
  have stretchCLM_apply :
      ∀ (s : ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        stretchCLM s w = mkSpaceTime (s • projSpace w) (projTime w) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have stretchCLM_comp_apply :
      ∀ (s₁ s₂ : ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        stretchCLM s₁ (stretchCLM s₂ w) = stretchCLM (s₁ * s₂) w := by
    intro s₁ s₂ w
    rw [stretchCLM_apply, stretchCLM_apply, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
      smul_smul, ← stretchCLM_apply]
  have stretchCLM_one :
      ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), stretchCLM 1 w = w := by
    intro w
    rw [stretchCLM_apply, one_smul, mkSpaceTime_projSpace_projTime]
  let σ : ℝ := Real.sqrt lam
  have hσ_pos : 0 < σ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hσ_pos
  have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
  have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
  have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlam
  have hσ_sq : σ * σ = lam := Real.mul_self_sqrt (le_of_lt hlam)
  let O_clm : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    O.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap
  let O_symm_clm : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    O.symm.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap
  let M : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    (r • O_clm).comp (stretchCLM σ)
  let M_inv : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    (stretchCLM σ⁻¹).comp (r⁻¹ • O_symm_clm)
  have hM_apply : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      M w = r • O (mkSpaceTime (σ • projSpace w) (projTime w)) := fun _ => rfl
  have hM_inv_M : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), M_inv (M w) = w := by
    intro w
    change stretchCLM σ⁻¹ (r⁻¹ • O.symm (r • O (stretchCLM σ w))) = w
    rw [O.symm.map_smul, O.symm_apply_apply, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr_ne, one_smul,
      stretchCLM_comp_apply, inv_mul_cancel₀ hσ_ne, stretchCLM_one]
  have hM_M_inv : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), M (M_inv u) = u := by
    intro u
    change r • O (stretchCLM σ (stretchCLM σ⁻¹ (r⁻¹ • O.symm u))) = u
    rw [stretchCLM_comp_apply, mul_inv_cancel₀ hσ_ne, stretchCLM_one,
      map_smul, O.apply_symm_apply, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne, one_smul]
  let T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    fun w => z_c + M w
  let T_inv : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    fun Z => M_inv (Z - z_c)
  have hT_inv_T : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), T_inv (T w) = w := by
    intro w
    dsimp [T, T_inv]
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, hM_inv_M]
  have hT_T_inv : ∀ Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), T (T_inv Z) = Z := by
    intro Z
    dsimp [T, T_inv]
    rw [hM_M_inv, add_sub_cancel]
  let V_phys : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := T_inv ⁻¹' W
  let Z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := T w₀
  have hT_inv_C2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 T_inv :=
    M_inv.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hT_inv_cont : Continuous T_inv := hT_inv_C2.continuous
  have hV_open : IsOpen V_phys := hW_open.preimage hT_inv_cont
  have hZ₀_V : Z₀ ∈ V_phys := by
    change T_inv Z₀ ∈ W
    rw [hT_inv_T w₀]
    exact hw₀
  have hV_sub : V_phys ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16) := by
    intro Z hZ
    have h_in : T (T_inv Z) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16) :=
      h_dom (T_inv Z) hZ
    rwa [hT_T_inv Z] at h_in
  have hZ₀_ball : Z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (15 / 16) :=
    hV_sub hZ₀_V
  let K : ℝ := r * c * lam
  have hK_pos : 0 < K := mul_pos (mul_pos hr hc) hlam
  have hK_ne : K ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hK_pos
  let C₀ : ℝ := U z_c + K * (v_res w₀ - ψ w₀)
  let Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
    fun Z => C₀ + (r * c) * projTime (T_inv Z) + K * ψ (T_inv Z)
  have h_U_T : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      U (T w) = U z_c + (r * c) * projTime w + K * v_res w := by
    intro w
    have h_def : v_res w = (U (T w) - U z_c - r * c * projTime w) / K := rfl
    rw [h_def, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hK_ne]
    ring
  have h_Φ_sub_U : ∀ Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      Φ Z - U Z = K * ((v_res w₀ - ψ w₀) - (v_res (T_inv Z) - ψ (T_inv Z))) := by
    intro Z
    have h1 := h_U_T (T_inv Z)
    rw [hT_T_inv Z] at h1
    dsimp [Φ, C₀]
    linarith
  have hΦ_Z₀ : Φ Z₀ = U Z₀ := by
    have h1 := h_Φ_sub_U Z₀
    rw [hT_inv_T w₀] at h1
    linarith
  have hΦ_C2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Φ V_phys := by
    have h_pt : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun Z => (r * c) * projTime (T_inv Z)) V_phys := by
      change ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun Z => (r * c) • (projTimeCLM ∘ T_inv) Z) V_phys
      exact (projTimeCLM.contDiff.comp hT_inv_C2).contDiffOn.const_smul (r * c)
    have h_ψ_comp : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun Z => K * ψ (T_inv Z)) V_phys := by
      change ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun Z => K • (ψ ∘ T_inv) Z) V_phys
      exact (hψ_C2.comp hT_inv_C2.contDiffOn (fun Z hZ => hZ)).const_smul K
    exact (contDiffOn_const.add h_pt).add h_ψ_comp
  let ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (c / r) • ξ
  let η : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := M ζ
  have hη_eq : η = c • O (stretchCLM σ ξ) := by
    dsimp [η, ζ]
    rw [map_smul, hM_apply, ← stretchCLM_apply, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ c hr_ne]
  have hgrad_Φ : gradient Φ Z₀ = η := by
    apply HasGradientAt.gradient
    rw [hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
    have hT_inv_fd : HasFDerivAt T_inv M_inv Z₀ := by
      change HasFDerivAt (fun Z => M_inv (Z - z_c)) (M_inv.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _)) Z₀
      exact (M_inv.hasFDerivAt (x := Z₀ - z_c)).comp Z₀ ((hasFDerivAt_id Z₀).sub_const z_c)
    have hpt_fd : HasFDerivAt (fun Z => (r * c) * projTime (T_inv Z))
        ((r * c) • (projTimeCLM.comp M_inv)) Z₀ := by
      change HasFDerivAt (fun Z => (r * c) • (projTimeCLM (T_inv Z))) _ Z₀
      exact (projTimeCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp Z₀ hT_inv_fd).const_smul (r * c)
    have hψ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ w₀ :=
      (hψ_C2.contDiffAt (hW_open.mem_nhds hw₀)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hψ_fd0 : HasFDerivAt ψ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ψ w₀)) (T_inv Z₀) := by
      rw [hT_inv_T w₀]
      exact hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mp hψ_diff.hasGradientAt
    have hψ_fd : HasFDerivAt (fun Z => K * ψ (T_inv Z))
        (K • ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ψ w₀)).comp M_inv)) Z₀ := by
      change HasFDerivAt (fun Z => K • ψ (T_inv Z)) _ Z₀
      exact (hψ_fd0.comp Z₀ hT_inv_fd).const_smul K
    have hΦ_fd : HasFDerivAt Φ
        (((r * c) • (projTimeCLM.comp M_inv)) +
          (K • ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ψ w₀)).comp M_inv))) Z₀ := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun Z => C₀ + (r * c) * projTime (T_inv Z))
          (0 + (r * c) • (projTimeCLM.comp M_inv)) Z₀ :=
        (hasFDerivAt_const C₀ Z₀).add hpt_fd
      rw [zero_add] at h1
      exact h1.add hψ_fd
    have h_clm_eq : InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ η =
        ((r * c) • (projTimeCLM.comp M_inv)) +
          (K • ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ψ w₀)).comp M_inv)) := by
      ext H
      set h := M_inv H
      have hH : H = r • O (stretchCLM σ h) := by
        have h1 := (hM_M_inv H).symm
        rwa [hM_apply, ← stretchCLM_apply] at h1
      change inner ℝ η H = (r * c) * projTime h + K * inner ℝ (gradient ψ w₀) h
      rw [hη_eq, hH, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, RCLike.conj_to_real,
        O.inner_map_map, stretchCLM_apply, stretchCLM_apply,
        inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
        projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
        projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
        inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, RCLike.conj_to_real,
        inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime (gradient ψ w₀) h]
      dsimp [K]
      linear_combination (r * c * inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient ψ w₀)) (projSpace h)) * hσ_sq
    rw [h_clm_eq]
    exact hΦ_fd
  have h_ray_T_inv : ∀ s : ℝ, T_inv (Z₀ + s • η) = w₀ + s • ζ := by
    intro s
    change M_inv (z_c + M w₀ + s • M ζ - z_c) = w₀ + s • ζ
    have h_vec : z_c + M w₀ + s • M ζ - z_c = M (w₀ + s • ζ) := by
      rw [M.map_add w₀ (s • ζ), M.map_smul s ζ, add_assoc, add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [h_vec, hM_inv_M]
  let A₀ : ℝ := C₀ + (r * c) * projTime w₀
  let B₀ : ℝ := (r * c) * projTime ζ
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ψ (w₀ + s • ζ)
  have h_ray_Φ : (fun s : ℝ => Φ (Z₀ + s • η)) = (fun s : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * s + K * g s) := by
    ext s
    dsimp [Φ, A₀, B₀, g]
    rw [h_ray_T_inv s, projTime_add, projTime_smul]
    ring
  have h_lap_Φ : infinityLaplacian Φ Z₀ = (lam * c ^ 3 / r) * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) w₀ ξ ξ := by
    unfold infinityLaplacian
    rw [hgrad_Φ, ← deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hV_open hZ₀_V hΦ_C2 η, h_ray_Φ]
    have h_pre_s : IsOpen ((fun s : ℝ => w₀ + s • ζ) ⁻¹' W) :=
      hW_open.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_s : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun s : ℝ => w₀ + s • ζ) ⁻¹' W := by simp [hw₀]
    have h_ev1 : deriv (fun s : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * s + K * g s) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        (fun s : ℝ => B₀ + K * deriv g s) := by
      filter_upwards [h_pre_s.mem_nhds h0_s] with s hs
      have hψ_diff_s : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ (w₀ + s • ζ) :=
        (hψ_C2.contDiffAt (hW_open.mem_nhds hs)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have h_line_s : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w₀ + t • ζ) ζ s := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const ζ |>.const_add w₀
      have hg_diff_s : HasDerivAt g (deriv g s) s :=
        (hψ_diff_s.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h_line_s).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have h_lin_s : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * t) B₀ s := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul B₀).const_add A₀
      exact (h_lin_s.add (hg_diff_s.const_mul K)).deriv
    rw [h_ev1.deriv_eq, deriv_const_add, deriv_const_mul_field,
      deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hW_open hw₀ hψ_C2 ζ]
    dsimp [ζ, K]
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp [hr_ne]
  have h_pref_pos : 0 < lam * c ^ 3 / r := div_pos (mul_pos hlam (pow_pos hc 3)) hr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h_max
    have h_upper : ∀ Z ∈ V_phys, U Z ≤ Φ Z := by
      intro Z hZ
      have h_le : v_res (T_inv Z) - ψ (T_inv Z) ≤ v_res w₀ - ψ w₀ := h_max (T_inv Z) hZ
      have h_sub := h_Φ_sub_U Z
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ K * ((v_res w₀ - ψ w₀) - (v_res (T_inv Z) - ψ (T_inv Z))) :=
        mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hK_pos) (sub_nonneg.mpr h_le)
      linarith
    have h_visc : 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian Φ Z₀ :=
      hU_har.2.1 Z₀ hZ₀_ball Φ V_phys hV_open hZ₀_V hV_sub hΦ_C2 hΦ_Z₀ h_upper
    rw [h_lap_Φ] at h_visc
    exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_visc h_pref_pos
  · intro h_min
    have h_lower : ∀ Z ∈ V_phys, Φ Z ≤ U Z := by
      intro Z hZ
      have h_le : v_res w₀ - ψ w₀ ≤ v_res (T_inv Z) - ψ (T_inv Z) := h_min (T_inv Z) hZ
      have h_sub := h_Φ_sub_U Z
      have h_nonpos : K * ((v_res w₀ - ψ w₀) - (v_res (T_inv Z) - ψ (T_inv Z))) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hK_pos) (sub_nonpos.mpr h_le)
      linarith
    have h_visc : infinityLaplacian Φ Z₀ ≤ 0 :=
      hU_har.2.2 Z₀ hZ₀_ball Φ V_phys hV_open hZ₀_V hV_sub hΦ_C2 hΦ_Z₀ h_lower
    rw [h_lap_Φ] at h_visc
    exact nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right h_visc h_pref_pos

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) (hV_open : IsOpen V)
    (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ V)
    (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hϕ_C2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V)
    (σ : ℝ) :
    let ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun w => ϕ w + σ * ‖w - z₀‖ ^ 4
    ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V ∧
    ∀ (w_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (μ_seq : ℕ → ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto w_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) →
      Filter.Tendsto μ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun i =>
          let ξ_i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
            mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ψ (w_seq i)))
              (1 + μ_seq i * projTime (gradient ψ (w_seq i)))
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) (w_seq i) ξ_i ξ_i)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (limitingOperator ϕ z₀))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ψ
  let q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun w => ‖w - z₀‖ ^ 2
  let q₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun w => (q w) ^ 2
  let g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun w => σ * q₂ w
  have hψ_eq : ψ = fun w => ϕ w + g w := by
    ext w
    dsimp [ψ, g, q₂, q]
    ring
  have hq_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) q := (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).norm_sq ℝ
  have hq₂_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) q₂ := hq_smooth.pow 2
  have hg_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g := contDiff_const.mul hq₂_smooth
  have hg_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g V := (hg_smooth.of_le (by simp)).contDiffOn
  have hψ_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V := by
    rw [hψ_eq]
    exact hϕ_C2.add hg_c2
  refine ⟨hψ_c2, ?_⟩
  have h_fderiv_c1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ψ) V :=
    hψ_c2.fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open (by norm_num)
  have h_fderiv2_cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ)) V :=
    h_fderiv_c1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open le_rfl
  have h_fderiv2_contAt : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ)) z₀ :=
    h_fderiv2_cont.continuousAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
  have h_fderiv1_cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ ψ) V :=
    hψ_c2.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open (by norm_num)
  have h_grad_cont : ContinuousOn (gradient ψ) V :=
    (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))).symm.continuous.comp_continuousOn
      h_fderiv1_cont
  have h_grad_contAt : ContinuousAt (gradient ψ) z₀ :=
    h_grad_cont.continuousAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
  have hq_diff : Differentiable ℝ q := hq_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  have hq₂_diff : Differentiable ℝ q₂ := hq₂_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := hg_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  have hq0 : q z₀ = 0 := by simp [q]
  have hq'_z0 : fderiv ℝ q z₀ = 0 := by
    have h1 := ((hasFDerivAt_id z₀).sub_const z₀).norm_sq
    have h2 := h1.fderiv
    simpa [q] using h2
  have h_mul : q₂ = q * q := by
    ext x
    exact sq (q x)
  have hq₂_fderiv_eq : fderiv ℝ q₂ = q • fderiv ℝ q + q • fderiv ℝ q := by
    ext y v
    have h_has := ((hq_diff y).hasFDerivAt.mul (hq_diff y).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    rw [h_mul, h_has]
    rfl
  have hq₂_1 : fderiv ℝ q₂ z₀ = 0 := by
    rw [hq₂_fderiv_eq]
    simp [hq0]
  have hq'_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ q) :=
    (hq_smooth.of_le (by simp : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞))).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hq'_diff : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ q) := hq'_smooth.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hq₂_2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ q₂) z₀ = 0 := by
    have h_smul := (hq_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt.smul (hq'_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt
    have h_add := (h_smul.add h_smul).fderiv
    rw [hq₂_fderiv_eq]
    simpa [hq0, hq'_z0] using h_add
  have hq₂'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ q₂) z₀ := by
    have h_smul := (hq_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt.smul (hq'_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt
    rw [hq₂_fderiv_eq]
    exact (h_smul.add h_smul).differentiableAt
  have hg_fderiv_eq : fderiv ℝ g = σ • fderiv ℝ q₂ := by
    ext y v
    have h_has := ((hq₂_diff y).hasFDerivAt.const_mul σ).fderiv
    exact congrArg (fun L => L v) h_has
  have hg1 : fderiv ℝ g z₀ = 0 := by
    rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
    simp [hq₂_1]
  have hg'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z₀ := by
    rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
    exact (hq₂'_diff_z0.hasFDerivAt.const_smul σ).differentiableAt
  have hg2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z₀ = 0 := by
    have h_csmul := (hq₂'_diff_z0.hasFDerivAt.const_smul σ).fderiv
    rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
    simpa [hq₂_2] using h_csmul
  have hψ_fderiv_V : ∀ y ∈ V, fderiv ℝ ψ y = fderiv ℝ ϕ y + fderiv ℝ g y := by
    intro y hy
    have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ y :=
      (hϕ_C2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    rw [hψ_eq]
    exact fderiv_add hϕ_diff (hg_diff y)
  have hψ_fderiv_z0 : fderiv ℝ ψ z₀ = fderiv ℝ ϕ z₀ := by
    rw [hψ_fderiv_V z₀ hz₀, hg1, add_zero]
  have hψ_grad_z0 : gradient ψ z₀ = gradient ϕ z₀ := by
    simp [gradient, hψ_fderiv_z0]
  have h_ev : fderiv ℝ ψ =ᶠ[nhds z₀] fderiv ℝ ϕ + fderiv ℝ g :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀) (fun y hy => hψ_fderiv_V y hy)
  have hϕ'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
    have hϕ'_c1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ :=
      (hϕ_C2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀)).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    exact hϕ'_c1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hψ_fderiv2_z0 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z₀ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
    rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_add hϕ'_diff_z0 hg'_diff_z0, hg2, add_zero]
  have projSpace_add :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projSpace (z₁ + z₂) = projSpace z₁ + projSpace z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_add :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projTime (z₁ + z₂) = projTime z₁ + projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    simp [projTime]
  have projSpace_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        projSpace (c • z) = c • projSpace z := by
    intro c z
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        projTime (c • z) = c * projTime z := by
    intro c z
    simp [projTime]
  have mkSpaceTime_add :
      ∀ (x₁ x₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₁ t₂ : ℝ),
        mkSpaceTime (x₁ + x₂) (t₁ + t₂) = mkSpaceTime x₁ t₁ + mkSpaceTime x₂ t₂ := by
    intro x₁ x₂ t₁ t₂
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro j
      simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have mkSpaceTime_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
        mkSpaceTime (c • x) (c * t) = c • mkSpaceTime x t := by
    intro c x t
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro j
      simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  let projSpaceCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := projSpace
        map_add' := projSpace_add
        map_smul' := projSpace_smul }
  let projTimeCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := projTime
        map_add' := projTime_add
        map_smul' := projTime_smul }
  let mkSpaceCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := fun x => mkSpaceTime x 0
        map_add' := fun x₁ x₂ => by simpa using mkSpaceTime_add x₁ x₂ 0 0
        map_smul' := fun c x => by simpa using mkSpaceTime_smul c x 0 }
  let mkTimeCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := fun t => mkSpaceTime 0 t
        map_add' := fun t₁ t₂ => by simpa using mkSpaceTime_add 0 0 t₁ t₂
        map_smul' := fun c t => by simpa using mkSpaceTime_smul c 0 t }
  have mkSpaceTime_eq_clm :
      ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
        mkSpaceTime x t = mkSpaceCLM x + mkTimeCLM t := by
    intro x t
    change mkSpaceTime x t = mkSpaceTime x 0 + mkSpaceTime 0 t
    simpa using mkSpaceTime_add x 0 0 t
  intro w_seq μ_seq hw_tendsto hμ_tendsto
  have h_grad_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => gradient ψ (w_seq i)) Filter.atTop (nhds (gradient ϕ z₀)) := by
    rw [← hψ_grad_z0]
    exact h_grad_contAt.tendsto.comp hw_tendsto
  have h_space_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => projSpace (gradient ψ (w_seq i)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀))) :=
    (projSpaceCLM.continuous.tendsto (gradient ϕ z₀)).comp h_grad_tendsto
  have h_time_grad_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => projTime (gradient ψ (w_seq i)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (projTime (gradient ϕ z₀))) :=
    (projTimeCLM.continuous.tendsto (gradient ϕ z₀)).comp h_grad_tendsto
  have h_time_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => 1 + μ_seq i * projTime (gradient ψ (w_seq i)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add (hμ_tendsto.mul h_time_grad_tendsto)
  let ξ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀)) 1
  have h_ξ_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun i =>
          mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ψ (w_seq i)))
            (1 + μ_seq i * projTime (gradient ψ (w_seq i))))
        Filter.atTop (nhds ξ₀) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => mkSpaceCLM (projSpace (gradient ψ (w_seq i))))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (mkSpaceCLM (projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀)))) :=
      (mkSpaceCLM.continuous.tendsto (projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀))).comp h_space_tendsto
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => mkTimeCLM (1 + μ_seq i * projTime (gradient ψ (w_seq i))))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (mkTimeCLM 1)) :=
      (mkTimeCLM.continuous.tendsto (1 : ℝ)).comp h_time_tendsto
    have h3 := h1.add h2
    simp only [← mkSpaceTime_eq_clm] at h3
    exact h3
  have h_fderiv2_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) (w_seq i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀)) := by
    rw [← hψ_fderiv2_z0]
    exact h_fderiv2_contAt.tendsto.comp hw_tendsto
  have h_step1 :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun i =>
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) (w_seq i)
            (mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ψ (w_seq i)))
              (1 + μ_seq i * projTime (gradient ψ (w_seq i)))))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ ξ₀)) :=
    (isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.tendsto (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀, ξ₀)).comp
      (h_fderiv2_tendsto.prodMk_nhds h_ξ_tendsto)
  exact (isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.tendsto (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ ξ₀, ξ₀)).comp
    (h_step1.prodMk_nhds h_ξ_tendsto)

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
    Continuous v →
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ), 0 < R →
      ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ), IsFitAt d C₁ v x t R p a) →
    ∀ (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (r a₀ : ℝ),
      0 < r →
      IsFitAt d C₁ v x₀ r r p₀ a₀ →
      let w := fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀
      Continuous w ∧
      IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 ∧
      (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ →
        ∃ (p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a' : ℝ), IsFitAt d C₁ w y s ρ p' a')

    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ), 0 < R →

    ∀ (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (r a₀ : ℝ),
      0 < r →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d C₁ v hv hv_fits x₀ p₀ r a₀ hr h_fit₀
  dsimp only
  set w := fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀
  have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have hc_projSpace : Continuous (projSpace (d := d)) := by
    unfold projSpace
    fun_prop
  have hc_projTime : Continuous (projTime (d := d)) := by
    unfold projTime
    fun_prop
  have hc_mkSpaceTime : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    apply Continuous.comp (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _)
    rw [continuous_pi_iff]
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simpa [Fin.snoc_last] using continuous_snd
    · intro i
      have hc_coord : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => p.1 i) :=
        ((continuous_apply i).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous).comp continuous_fst
      simpa [Fin.snoc_castSucc] using hc_coord
  have hw_cont : Continuous w := by
    change Continuous (fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀)
    unfold fittedFrameTransform
    have hc_pair : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
        (x₀ + r • (projSpace z + (projTime z - 1) • p₀), r * projTime z)) := by
      fun_prop
    have hc_arg : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
        mkSpaceTime (x₀ + r • (projSpace z + (projTime z - 1) • p₀)) (r * projTime z)) :=
      hc_mkSpaceTime.comp hc_pair
    have hc_v : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
        v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + r • (projSpace z + (projTime z - 1) • p₀)) (r * projTime z))) :=
      hv.comp hc_arg
    fun_prop
  have h_cov : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s ρ : ℝ)
      (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
      IsFitAt d C₁ v (x₀ + r • (y + (s - 1) • p₀)) (r * s) (r * ρ) p a →
      IsFitAt d C₁ w y s ρ (p - p₀) (a - a₀) := by
    intro y s ρ p a h_fit h ℓ hℓ hh
    set x_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x₀ + r • (y + (s - 1) • p₀)
    set t_c : ℝ := r * s
    set H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := r • (h + ℓ • p₀)
    set L : ℝ := r * ℓ
    have hL : |L| ≤ r * ρ := by
      dsimp [L]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓ (le_of_lt hr)
    have hH_eq : H - L • p = r • (h - ℓ • (p - p₀)) := by
      dsimp [H, L]
      module
    have hH : ‖H - L • p‖ ≤ r * ρ := by
      rw [hH_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (le_of_lt hr)
    have h_v_bound := h_fit H L hL hH
    have h_space_arg :
        x₀ + r • ((y + h) + (s + ℓ - 1) • p₀) = x_c + H := by
      dsimp [x_c, H]
      module
    have h_time_arg :
        r * (s + ℓ) = t_c + L := by
      dsimp [t_c, L]
      ring
    have h_inner_H : inner ℝ p H = r * (inner ℝ p h + ℓ * inner ℝ p p₀) := by
      dsimp [H]
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    have h_norm_sub : ‖p - p₀‖ ^ 2 = ‖p‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ p p₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_sub_sq_real p p₀
    have h_inner_p0 : inner ℝ p₀ (y + h) = inner ℝ p₀ y + inner ℝ p₀ h :=
      inner_add_right p₀ y h
    have h_inner_sub : inner ℝ (p - p₀) h = inner ℝ p h - inner ℝ p₀ h :=
      inner_sub_left p p₀ h
    have h_rem_eq :
        w (mkSpaceTime (y + h) (s + ℓ)) - w (mkSpaceTime y s) -
          inner ℝ (p - p₀) h - (a - a₀ - ‖p - p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ =
        (v (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - v (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) -
          inner ℝ p H - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * L) / r := by
      change fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime (y + h) (s + ℓ)) -
          fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime y s) -
          inner ℝ (p - p₀) h - (a - a₀ - ‖p - p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ = _
      unfold fittedFrameTransform
      dsimp only
      rw [h_projSpace (y + h) (s + ℓ), h_projTime (y + h) (s + ℓ),
        h_projSpace y s, h_projTime y s,
        h_space_arg, h_time_arg]
      change (v (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r)) / r -
          inner ℝ p₀ (y + h) - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s + ℓ - 1) -
          ((v (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) - v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r)) / r -
            inner ℝ p₀ y - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s - 1)) -
          inner ℝ (p - p₀) h - (a - a₀ - ‖p - p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ =
        (v (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - v (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) -
          inner ℝ p H - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (r * ℓ)) / r
      rw [h_inner_p0, h_inner_sub, h_norm_sub, h_inner_H]
      field_simp [hr_ne]
      ring
    rw [h_rem_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hr, div_le_iff₀ hr]
    calc |v (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - v (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) -
            inner ℝ p H - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * L|
      _ ≤ C₁ * (r * ρ) := h_v_bound
      _ = C₁ * ρ * r := by ring
  have hw_01 : w (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = 0 := by
    change fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = 0
    unfold fittedFrameTransform
    dsimp only
    rw [h_projSpace 0 1, h_projTime 0 1]
    simp
  have hw_fit01 : IsFitAt d C₁ w 0 1 1 0 0 := by
    have h_fit01_v : IsFitAt d C₁ v (x₀ + r • (0 + ((1 : ℝ) - 1) • p₀)) (r * 1) (r * 1) p₀ a₀ := by
      simpa using h_fit₀
    have h_cov01 := h_cov 0 1 1 p₀ a₀ h_fit01_v
    simpa using h_cov01
  have hw_fits : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ →
      ∃ (p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a' : ℝ), IsFitAt d C₁ w y s ρ p' a' := by
    intro y s ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨p, a, h_fit⟩ :=
      hv_fits (x₀ + r • (y + (s - 1) • p₀)) (r * s) (r * ρ) (mul_pos hr hρ)
    exact ⟨p - p₀, a - a₀, h_cov y s ρ p a h_fit⟩
  exact ⟨hw_cont, ⟨hw_01, hw_fit01⟩, hw_fits⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
    InLimitingClassA d C₁ v →
    ∀ (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (r a₀ : ℝ),
      0 < r →
      let w := fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
        ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z = w z → (∀ y ∈ V, w y ≤ ϕ y) →
          0 ≤ limitingOperator ϕ z) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
        ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z = w z → (∀ y ∈ V, ϕ y ≤ w y) →
          limitingOperator ϕ z ≤ 0)

      have hϕ_s_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ (z₀ + s • ζ) :=

      have h_line_s : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => z₀ + τ • ζ) ζ s := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const ζ |>.const_add z₀
      have hg_diff : HasDerivAt g (deriv g s) s :=
        (hϕ_s_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h_line_s).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have h_id_s : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => τ) 1 s := hasDerivAt_id s
      have h_comb : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * τ + r * g τ) (B₀ + r * deriv g s) s := by
        convert ((hasDerivAt_const s A₀).add (h_id_s.const_mul B₀)).add (hg_diff.const_mul r) using 1
        ring
      exact h_comb.deriv
    have h_d2_ray : deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * s + r * g s)) 0 =
        r * deriv (deriv g) 0 := by
      rw [h_ev_d1.deriv_eq, deriv_const_add B₀, deriv_const_mul_field r]
    have h_dd_g : deriv (deriv g) 0 = r⁻¹ * (r⁻¹ * limitingOperator ϕ z₀) := by
      dsimp [g]
      rw [deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 ζ]
      dsimp [ζ, limitingOperator, ξ_ϕ]
      rw [map_smul, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have h_lim_eq : limitingOperator ϕ z₀ = r * limitingOperator ψ w_c := by
      rw [h_lim_ψ, h_d2_ray, h_dd_g]
      field_simp [hr_ne]
    exact ⟨hV'_open, hw_c_mem, hψ_C2, hψ_wc, hψ_diff_eq, h_lim_eq⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀ h_upper
    obtain ⟨hV'_open, hw_c_mem, hψ_C2, hψ_wc, hψ_diff_eq, h_lim_eq⟩ :=
      h_pullback z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀
    have hψ_upper : ∀ u ∈ Ψ ⁻¹' V, v u ≤
        v w_orig + r * (ϕ (Ψ u) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ u - z_one)) := by
      intro u hu
      have h_le : 0 ≤ ϕ (Ψ u) - w (Ψ u) := sub_nonneg.mpr (h_upper (Ψ u) hu)
      have h_diff := hψ_diff_eq u
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ r * (ϕ (Ψ u) - w (Ψ u)) := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hr) h_le
      linarith
    have h_op_ψ : 0 ≤ limitingOperator
        (fun u => v w_orig + r * (ϕ (Ψ u) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ u - z_one))) (Φ z₀) :=
      hv.2.1 (Φ z₀) _ (Ψ ⁻¹' V) hV'_open hw_c_mem hψ_C2 hψ_wc hψ_upper
    rw [h_lim_eq]
    exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hr) h_op_ψ
  · intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀ h_lower
    obtain ⟨hV'_open, hw_c_mem, hψ_C2, hψ_wc, hψ_diff_eq, h_lim_eq⟩ :=
      h_pullback z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀
    have hψ_lower : ∀ u ∈ Ψ ⁻¹' V,
        v w_orig + r * (ϕ (Ψ u) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ u - z_one)) ≤ v u := by
      intro u hu
      have h_le : ϕ (Ψ u) - w (Ψ u) ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr (h_lower (Ψ u) hu)
      have h_diff := hψ_diff_eq u
      have h_nonpos : r * (ϕ (Ψ u) - w (Ψ u)) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hr) h_le
      linarith
    have h_op_ψ : limitingOperator
        (fun u => v w_orig + r * (ϕ (Ψ u) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ u - z_one))) (Φ z₀) ≤ 0 :=
      hv.2.2.1 (Φ z₀) _ (Ψ ⁻¹' V) hV'_open hw_c_mem hψ_C2 hψ_wc hψ_lower
    rw [h_lim_eq]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hr) h_op_ψ

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
    ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v →
      ∀ (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (r a₀ : ℝ),
        0 < r →
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r) = v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r) →
        let w := fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀
        HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ w ∧
        barycentricEnvelope d 1 w (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - w (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2

signature.name: fitted_frame_barycentric_covariance
signature.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
    ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v →
      ∀ (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (r a₀ : ℝ),
        0 < r →
        shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r) = v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r) →
        let w := fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀

        barycentricEnvelope d 1 w (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - w (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d κ hκ_pos v hv_jensen x₀ p₀ r a₀ hr h_env
  dsimp only
  set w := fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀
  have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime u t) = u := by
    intro u t
    ext j
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime u t) = t := by
    intro u t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have hw_eval : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      w (mkSpaceTime u s) =
        (v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + r • (u + (s - 1) • p₀)) (r * s)) - v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r)) / r -
          inner ℝ p₀ u - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s - 1) := by
    intro u s
    change fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime u s) = _
    dsimp [fittedFrameTransform]
    rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  have hw_slice : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      w (mkSpaceTime u 1) =
        (v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + r • u) r) - v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r)) / r - inner ℝ p₀ u := by
    intro u
    rw [hw_eval u 1]
    simp
  have hw_zero : w (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hw_slice 0]
    simp
  have h_env_eq : barycentricEnvelope d r v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r) =
      v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r) + κ ^ 2 * r / 2 := by
    unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope at h_env
    rw [h_projTime] at h_env
    linarith
  have hw_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ w := by
    intro s N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only
    set x_bar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
    set rho : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x_bar‖ ^ 2)
    let t_hat : ℝ := r * s
    let y_hat : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => x₀ + r • (y i + (s - 1) • p₀)
    let x_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x₀ + r • (x_bar + (s - 1) • p₀)
    let c_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x₀ + r • ((s - 1) • p₀)
    have hy_hat_eq : ∀ i, y_hat i = r • y i + c_vec := by
      intro i
      dsimp [y_hat, c_vec]
      rw [smul_add]
      abel
    have hx_hat_eq : x_hat = r • x_bar + c_vec := by
      dsimp [x_hat, c_vec]
      rw [smul_add]
      abel
    have hx_hat : ∑ i, θ i • y_hat i = x_hat := by
      have h_term : ∀ i, θ i • y_hat i = r • (θ i • y i) + θ i • c_vec := by
        intro i
        rw [hy_hat_eq i, smul_add, smul_comm r (θ i) (y i)]
      simp_rw [h_term]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_smul, hθ_sum, one_smul, ← hx_hat_eq]
    have h_diff : ∀ i, y_hat i - x_hat = r • (y i - x_bar) := by
      intro i
      rw [hy_hat_eq i, hx_hat_eq, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← smul_sub]
    have hr_hat : Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_hat i - (∑ j, θ j • y_hat j)‖ ^ 2) = r * rho := by
      rw [hx_hat]
      have h_norm_sq : ∀ i, θ i * ‖y_hat i - x_hat‖ ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (θ i * ‖y i - x_bar‖ ^ 2) := by
        intro i
        rw [h_diff i, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hr)]
        ring
      simp_rw [h_norm_sq]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg r), Real.sqrt_sq (le_of_lt hr)]
    have h_inner_sum : ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar) = 0 := by
      have h_term : ∀ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar) =
          inner ℝ p₀ (θ i • y i) - θ i * inner ℝ p₀ x_bar := by
        intro i
        rw [inner_sub_right, mul_sub, real_inner_smul_right]
      simp_rw [h_term]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← inner_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, hθ_sum, one_mul]
      exact sub_self (inner ℝ p₀ x_bar)
    have h_defect :
        (∑ i, θ i * w (mkSpaceTime (y i) s)) - w (mkSpaceTime x_bar s) =
        ((∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat)) -
          v (mkSpaceTime (∑ i, θ i • y_hat i) t_hat)) / r := by
      rw [hx_hat]
      have h_pt : ∀ i,
          w (mkSpaceTime (y i) s) - w (mkSpaceTime x_bar s) =
          (v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat) - v (mkSpaceTime x_hat t_hat)) / r -
            inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar) := by
        intro i
        rw [hw_eval (y i) s, hw_eval x_bar s, inner_sub_right]
        dsimp [y_hat, x_hat, t_hat]
        ring
      calc (∑ i, θ i * w (mkSpaceTime (y i) s)) - w (mkSpaceTime x_bar s)
        _ = (∑ i, θ i * w (mkSpaceTime (y i) s)) - (∑ i, θ i) * w (mkSpaceTime x_bar s) := by
            rw [hθ_sum, one_mul]
        _ = ∑ i, θ i * (w (mkSpaceTime (y i) s) - w (mkSpaceTime x_bar s)) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
            ring
        _ = ∑ i, (θ i * ((v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat) - v (mkSpaceTime x_hat t_hat)) / r) -
            θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
            rw [h_pt i, mul_sub]
        _ = (∑ i, (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat) - θ i * v (mkSpaceTime x_hat t_hat)) / r) -
            ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            congr 1
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
            ring
        _ = ((∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat)) -
            v (mkSpaceTime x_hat t_hat)) / r := by
            rw [h_inner_sum, sub_zero, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
              hθ_sum, one_mul]
    have hv_step := hv_jensen t_hat N θ y_hat hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at hv_step
    rw [hr_hat] at hv_step
    rw [h_defect, div_le_iff₀ hr]
    linarith
  let z_w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
  let z_v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime x₀ r
  let S_w : Set ℝ :=
    { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace z_w) ∧
      val = (∑ i, θ i * w (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z_w))) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z_w‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) }
  let S_v : Set ℝ :=
    { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace z_v) ∧
      val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z_v))) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z_v‖ ^ 2) / (2 * r) }
  have hSw_ne : S_w.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, 1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => 0, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [z_w, h_projSpace]
    · simp [z_w, h_projSpace, h_projTime, hw_zero]
  have hSw_ub : ∀ val ∈ S_w, val ≤ κ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rintro val ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
    dsimp [z_w] at hy_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projSpace] at hy_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projTime]
    have hj := hw_jensen 1 N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at hj
    rw [hy_mean, hw_zero] at hj
    set V : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - 0‖ ^ 2
    set rho : ℝ := Real.sqrt V
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hrho_sq : rho ^ 2 = V := Real.sq_sqrt hV_nonneg
    have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (rho - κ) ^ 2 / 2 := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have h_id : κ * rho - V / (2 * 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2 - (rho - κ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
      rw [← hrho_sq]
      ring
    linarith
  have hSw_bdd : BddAbove S_w := ⟨κ ^ 2 / 2, hSw_ub⟩
  have h_env_w_ub : barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w ≤ κ ^ 2 / 2 :=
    csSup_le hSw_ne hSw_ub
  have hSv_ne : S_v.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨v z_v, 1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => x₀, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [z_v, h_projSpace]
    · simp [z_v, h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  have hSv_ub : ∀ val_v ∈ S_v, val_v ≤ v z_v + r * barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w := by
    rintro val_v ⟨N, θ, y_tilde, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_tilde_mean, rfl⟩
    dsimp [z_v] at hy_tilde_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projSpace] at hy_tilde_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projTime]
    let y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => r⁻¹ • (y_tilde i - x₀)
    have hy_mean : ∑ i, θ i • y i = 0 := by
      change ∑ i, θ i • (r⁻¹ • (y_tilde i - x₀)) = 0
      have h_comm : ∀ i, θ i • (r⁻¹ • (y_tilde i - x₀)) = r⁻¹ • (θ i • (y_tilde i - x₀)) := by
        intro i
        exact smul_comm (θ i) r⁻¹ (y_tilde i - x₀)
      simp_rw [h_comm, ← Finset.smul_sum, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul,
        hθ_sum, one_smul, hy_tilde_mean]
      simp
    have hy_rec : ∀ i, x₀ + r • y i = y_tilde i := by
      intro i
      change x₀ + r • (r⁻¹ • (y_tilde i - x₀)) = y_tilde i
      rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
    have hy_tilt : ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i) = 0 := by
      have h_in : ∀ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i) = inner ℝ p₀ (θ i • y i) := by
        intro i
        exact (real_inner_smul_right p₀ (y i) (θ i)).symm
      simp_rw [h_in, ← inner_sum, hy_mean, inner_zero_right]
    have hy_val : ∑ i, θ i * w (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) =
        ((∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_tilde i) r)) - v z_v) / r := by
      have h_w : ∀ i, θ i * w (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1) =
          (θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_tilde i) r) - θ i * v z_v) / r -
            θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i) := by
        intro i
        rw [hw_slice (y i), hy_rec i]
        dsimp [z_v]
        ring
      simp_rw [h_w]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hy_tilt, sub_zero, ← Finset.sum_div,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hθ_sum, one_mul]
    have hy_pen : (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_tilde i - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * r) =
        r * ((∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - 0‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1)) := by
      have h_term : ∀ i, θ i * ‖y_tilde i - x₀‖ ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (θ i * ‖y i - 0‖ ^ 2) := by
        intro i
        have h_diff_i : y_tilde i - x₀ = r • (y i - 0) := by
          rw [sub_zero]
          dsimp [y]
          rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne, one_smul]
        rw [h_diff_i, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hr)]
        ring
      simp_rw [h_term, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      field_simp [hr_ne]
    let val_w : ℝ := (∑ i, θ i * w (mkSpaceTime (y i) 1)) -
      (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - 0‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1)
    have h_mem_w : val_w ∈ S_w := by
      refine ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, ?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp [z_w]
        rw [h_projSpace, hy_mean]
      · dsimp [z_w, val_w]
        rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
    have h_le_w : val_w ≤ barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w :=
      le_csSup hSw_bdd h_mem_w
    have h_rel : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_tilde i) r)) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_tilde i - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (2 * r) = v z_v + r * val_w := by
      dsimp [val_w]
      rw [hy_val, hy_pen]
      field_simp [hr_ne]
      ring
    rw [h_rel]
    have h_mul : r * val_w ≤ r * barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le_w (le_of_lt hr)
    linarith
  have h_env_v_ub : barycentricEnvelope d r v z_v ≤ v z_v + r * barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w :=
    csSup_le hSv_ne hSv_ub
  have h_env_w_lb : κ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w := by
    have h_ineq : r * (κ ^ 2 / 2) ≤ r * barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w := by
      dsimp [z_v] at h_env_v_ub
      linarith [h_env_eq, h_env_v_ub]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_ineq hr
  have h_env_w_eq : barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w = κ ^ 2 / 2 :=
    le_antisymm h_env_w_ub h_env_w_lb
  refine ⟨hw_jensen, ?_⟩
  change barycentricEnvelope d 1 w z_w - w z_w = κ ^ 2 / 2
  rw [h_env_w_eq, hw_zero, sub_zero]

    HasUniformSubquadraticGrowth d C₁ →
    ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (x₀ p₀ x_end : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (r a₀ : ℝ),

      IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
      ∀ (ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →

          slopePlus d (r * ℓ) v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - a₀ ∧
        slopeMinus d ℓ w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) =
          slopeMinus d (r * ℓ) v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - a₀

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d hd C₁ hC₁ h_growth v x₀ p₀ x_end r a₀ hr
  dsimp only
  set w := fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀
  set b₀ := r⁻¹ • (x_end - x₀ + r • p₀)
  intro hw_class hw_cent ℓ hℓ
  have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
  have hℓ_ne : ℓ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓ
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
