    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_cont_mk : ∀ (t : ℝ), Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => mkSpaceTime y t) := by
    intro t
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
    apply continuous_pi
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
      exact continuous_const
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (continuous_apply i).comp (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).continuous
  have hrb₀ : r • b₀ = x_end - x₀ + r • p₀ := by
    dsimp [b₀]
    exact smul_inv_smul₀ hr_ne (x_end - x₀ + r • p₀)
  have h_coord_shift : ∀ (y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      x₀ + r • (y' + (s - 1) • p₀) = x_end + r • (y' - b₀ + s • p₀) := by
    intro y' s
    have h1 : r • (y' + (s - 1) • p₀) = r • y' + r • (s • p₀) - r • p₀ := by
      rw [smul_add, sub_smul, one_smul, smul_sub]
      abel
    have h2 : r • (y' - b₀ + s • p₀) = r • y' - r • b₀ + r • (s • p₀) := by
      rw [smul_add, smul_sub]
    rw [h1, h2, hrb₀]
    abel
  have h_coord_zero : x₀ + r • (b₀ + (0 - 1 : ℝ) • p₀) = x_end := by
    rw [h_coord_shift b₀ 0, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  let ϕ_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun y' => x_end + r • (y' - b₀ + ℓ • p₀)
  let ψ_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun y => b₀ - ℓ • p₀ + r⁻¹ • (y - x_end)
  let ϕ_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun y' => x_end + r • (y' - b₀ - ℓ • p₀)
  let ψ_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun y => b₀ + ℓ • p₀ + r⁻¹ • (y - x_end)
  have hϕψ_plus : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ϕ_plus (ψ_plus y) = y := by
    intro y
    dsimp [ϕ_plus, ψ_plus]
    have h_sub : b₀ - ℓ • p₀ + r⁻¹ • (y - x_end) - b₀ + ℓ • p₀ = r⁻¹ • (y - x_end) := by abel
    rw [h_sub, smul_inv_smul₀ hr_ne, add_sub_cancel]
  have hϕψ_minus : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ϕ_minus (ψ_minus y) = y := by
    intro y
    dsimp [ϕ_minus, ψ_minus]
    have h_sub : b₀ + ℓ • p₀ + r⁻¹ • (y - x_end) - b₀ - ℓ • p₀ = r⁻¹ • (y - x_end) := by abel
    rw [h_sub, smul_inv_smul₀ hr_ne, add_sub_cancel]
  have hw_b₀ : w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) =
      (v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r)) / r -
        inner ℝ p₀ b₀ - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (0 - 1) := by
    change fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) = _
    unfold fittedFrameTransform
    dsimp only
    rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime, h_coord_zero, mul_zero]
  have hw_plus : ∀ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      w (mkSpaceTime y' ℓ) =
        (v (mkSpaceTime (ϕ_plus y') (r * ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r)) / r -
          inner ℝ p₀ y' - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (ℓ - 1) := by
    intro y'
    change fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime y' ℓ) = _
    unfold fittedFrameTransform
    dsimp only
    rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime, h_coord_shift y' ℓ]
  have hw_minus : ∀ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      w (mkSpaceTime y' (-ℓ)) =
        (v (mkSpaceTime (ϕ_minus y') (-(r * ℓ))) - v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r)) / r -
          inner ℝ p₀ y' - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (-ℓ - 1) := by
    intro y'
    change fittedFrameTransform d v x₀ r p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime y' (-ℓ)) = _
    unfold fittedFrameTransform
    dsimp only
    rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime, h_coord_shift y' (-ℓ), neg_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg, mul_neg]
  have h_norm_plus : ∀ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      ‖ϕ_plus y' - x_end‖ ^ 2 =
        r ^ 2 * (‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ℓ * (inner ℝ p₀ y' - inner ℝ p₀ b₀) + ℓ ^ 2 * ‖p₀‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro y'
    have h_sub : ϕ_plus y' - x_end = r • ((y' - b₀) + ℓ • p₀) := by
      dsimp [ϕ_plus]
      exact add_sub_cancel_left x_end (r • (y' - b₀ + ℓ • p₀))
    rw [h_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, norm_add_sq_real]
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm p₀ (y' - b₀), inner_sub_right]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    ring
  have h_norm_minus : ∀ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      ‖ϕ_minus y' - x_end‖ ^ 2 =
        r ^ 2 * (‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ℓ * (inner ℝ p₀ y' - inner ℝ p₀ b₀) + ℓ ^ 2 * ‖p₀‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro y'
    have h_sub : ϕ_minus y' - x_end = r • ((y' - b₀) - ℓ • p₀) := by
      dsimp [ϕ_minus]
      exact add_sub_cancel_left x_end (r • (y' - b₀ - ℓ • p₀))
    rw [h_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, norm_sub_sq_real]
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm p₀ (y' - b₀), inner_sub_right]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    ring
  set f_w_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
    fun y' => w (mkSpaceTime y' ℓ) - ‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)
  set f_v_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
    fun y => v (mkSpaceTime y (r * ℓ)) - ‖y - x_end‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (r * ℓ))
  set f_w_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
    fun y' => w (mkSpaceTime y' (-ℓ)) + ‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)
  set f_v_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
    fun y => v (mkSpaceTime y (-(r * ℓ))) + ‖y - x_end‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (r * ℓ))
  have h_id_plus : ∀ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      f_v_plus (ϕ_plus y') =
        v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) + r * (f_w_plus y' - w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) + a₀ * ℓ) := by
    intro y'
    dsimp [f_v_plus, f_w_plus]
    rw [h_norm_plus y', hw_plus y', hw_b₀]
    field_simp [hr_ne, hℓ_ne]
    ring
  have h_id_minus : ∀ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      f_v_minus (ϕ_minus y') =
        v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) - r * (w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) - f_w_minus y' + a₀ * ℓ) := by
    intro y'
    dsimp [f_v_minus, f_w_minus]
    rw [h_norm_minus y', hw_minus y', hw_b₀]
    field_simp [hr_ne, hℓ_ne]
    ring
  have h_bdd_phi : ∀ (σ t : ℝ), |σ| = 1 → |t| ≤ ℓ →
      ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        σ * w (mkSpaceTime y' t) - ‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤ B := by
    intro σ t hσ ht
    have hε_pos : 0 < 1 / (4 * ℓ) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM_bound⟩ := h_growth ℓ (le_of_lt hℓ) (1 / (4 * ℓ)) hε_pos
    let K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) := Metric.closedBall 0 M
    let Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
      fun y' => σ * w (mkSpaceTime y' t) - ‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ :=
      (continuous_const.mul (hw_class.1.comp (h_cont_mk t))).sub
        (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm.pow 2).div_const (2 * ℓ))
    obtain ⟨B_K, hB_K⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) M).bddAbove_image hΦ_cont.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max B_K (‖b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)), fun y' => ?_⟩
    by_cases hy' : ‖y'‖ ≤ M
    · have hy'K : y' ∈ K := by simpa [K, mem_closedBall_zero_iff] using hy'
      exact le_trans (hB_K ⟨y', hy'K, rfl⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    · push_neg at hy'
      have hw_abs : |w (mkSpaceTime y' t)| ≤ (1 / (4 * ℓ)) * ‖y'‖ ^ 2 :=
        hM_bound w hw_class hw_cent y' t ht (le_of_lt hy')
      have hw_y' : σ * w (mkSpaceTime y' t) ≤ ‖y'‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ) := by
        have h1 : σ * w (mkSpaceTime y' t) ≤ |σ * w (mkSpaceTime y' t)| := le_abs_self _
        rw [abs_mul, hσ, one_mul] at h1
        rw [one_div_mul_eq_div] at hw_abs
        linarith
      have h_tri : ‖y'‖ ≤ ‖y' - b₀‖ + ‖b₀‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y' - b₀) b₀
      have h_sq : ‖y'‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖b₀‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : 0 ≤ ‖y'‖ := norm_nonneg y'
        have h2 : 0 ≤ (‖y' - b₀‖ - ‖b₀‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        nlinarith
      have h_div : ‖y'‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ) ≤ ‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) + ‖b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) := by
        have h_eq : ‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) + ‖b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
            (2 * ‖y' - b₀‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖b₀‖ ^ 2) / (4 * ℓ) := by
          field_simp [hℓ_ne]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sq (by positivity)
      have h_le : Φ y' ≤ ‖b₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) := by
        dsimp [Φ]
        linarith
      exact le_trans h_le (le_max_right _ _)
  have h_bdd_w_plus : BddAbove (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) := by
    obtain ⟨B_plus, hB_plus⟩ := h_bdd_phi 1 ℓ (by norm_num) (by rw [abs_of_pos hℓ])
    refine ⟨B_plus, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y', _, rfl⟩
    have h1 := hB_plus y'
    dsimp [f_w_plus]
    linarith
  have h_bdd_w_minus : BddBelow (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) := by
    obtain ⟨B_minus, hB_minus⟩ := h_bdd_phi (-1) (-ℓ) (by norm_num) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hℓ])
    refine ⟨-B_minus, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y', _, rfl⟩
    have h1 := hB_minus y'
    dsimp [f_w_minus]
    linarith
  have h_v_plus_ub : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      f_v_plus y ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) +
        r * (sSup (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) - w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) + a₀ * ℓ) := by
    intro y
    have h_id := h_id_plus (ψ_plus y)
    rw [hϕψ_plus y] at h_id
    have h_le : f_w_plus (ψ_plus y) ≤ sSup (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) :=
      le_csSup h_bdd_w_plus ⟨ψ_plus y, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    nlinarith
  have h_bdd_v_plus : BddAbove (f_v_plus '' Set.univ) := by
    refine ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) +
      r * (sSup (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) - w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) + a₀ * ℓ), ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, _, rfl⟩
    exact h_v_plus_ub y
  have h_sup_v_le : sSup (f_v_plus '' Set.univ) ≤
      v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) +
        r * (sSup (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) - w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) + a₀ * ℓ) := by
    apply csSup_le (Set.univ_nonempty.image _)
    rintro _ ⟨y, _, rfl⟩
    exact h_v_plus_ub y
  have h_sup_w_le : sSup (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) ≤
      (sSup (f_v_plus '' Set.univ) - v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) +
        r * (w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) - a₀ * ℓ)) / r := by
    apply csSup_le (Set.univ_nonempty.image _)
    rintro _ ⟨y', _, rfl⟩
    rw [le_div_iff₀' hr]
    have h_id := h_id_plus y'
    have h_le : f_v_plus (ϕ_plus y') ≤ sSup (f_v_plus '' Set.univ) :=
      le_csSup h_bdd_v_plus ⟨ϕ_plus y', Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    linarith
  have h_sup_v_ge : v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) +
      r * (sSup (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) - w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) + a₀ * ℓ) ≤
        sSup (f_v_plus '' Set.univ) := by
    have h_mul := (le_div_iff₀' hr).mp h_sup_w_le
    linarith
  have h_sup_eq : sSup (f_v_plus '' Set.univ) =
      v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) +
        r * (sSup (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) - w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) + a₀ * ℓ) :=
    le_antisymm h_sup_v_le h_sup_v_ge
  have h_v_minus_lb : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) -
        r * (w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) - sInf (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) + a₀ * ℓ) ≤ f_v_minus y := by
    intro y
    have h_id := h_id_minus (ψ_minus y)
    rw [hϕψ_minus y] at h_id
    have h_ge : sInf (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) ≤ f_w_minus (ψ_minus y) :=
      csInf_le h_bdd_w_minus ⟨ψ_minus y, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    nlinarith
  have h_bdd_v_minus : BddBelow (f_v_minus '' Set.univ) := by
    refine ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) -
      r * (w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) - sInf (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) + a₀ * ℓ), ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, _, rfl⟩
    exact h_v_minus_lb y
  have h_inf_v_ge : v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) -
      r * (w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) - sInf (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) + a₀ * ℓ) ≤
        sInf (f_v_minus '' Set.univ) := by
    apply le_csInf (Set.univ_nonempty.image _)
    rintro _ ⟨y, _, rfl⟩
    exact h_v_minus_lb y
  have h_inf_w_ge : (sInf (f_v_minus '' Set.univ) - v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) +
      r * (w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) + a₀ * ℓ)) / r ≤ sInf (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) := by
    apply le_csInf (Set.univ_nonempty.image _)
    rintro _ ⟨y', _, rfl⟩
    rw [div_le_iff₀' hr]
    have h_id := h_id_minus y'
    have h_ge : sInf (f_v_minus '' Set.univ) ≤ f_v_minus (ϕ_minus y') :=
      csInf_le h_bdd_v_minus ⟨ϕ_minus y', Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    linarith
  have h_inf_v_le : sInf (f_v_minus '' Set.univ) ≤
      v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) -
        r * (w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) - sInf (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) + a₀ * ℓ) := by
    have h_mul := (div_le_iff₀' hr).mp h_inf_w_ge
    linarith
  have h_inf_eq : sInf (f_v_minus '' Set.univ) =
      v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) -
        r * (w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) - sInf (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) + a₀ * ℓ) :=
    le_antisymm h_inf_v_le h_inf_v_ge
  have h_qplus_w : quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) = sSup (f_w_plus '' Set.univ) := by
    unfold quadEnvelopePlus
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace, zero_add]
  have h_qplus_v : quadEnvelopePlus d (r * ℓ) v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) = sSup (f_v_plus '' Set.univ) := by
    unfold quadEnvelopePlus
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace, zero_add]
  have h_qminus_w : quadEnvelopeMinus d ℓ w (mkSpaceTime b₀ 0) = sInf (f_w_minus '' Set.univ) := by
    unfold quadEnvelopeMinus
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace, zero_sub]
  have h_qminus_v : quadEnvelopeMinus d (r * ℓ) v (mkSpaceTime x_end 0) = sInf (f_v_minus '' Set.univ) := by
    unfold quadEnvelopeMinus
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace, zero_sub]
  constructor
  · unfold slopePlus
    rw [h_qplus_w, h_qplus_v, h_sup_eq]
    field_simp [hr_ne, hℓ_ne]
    ring
  · unfold slopeMinus
    rw [h_qminus_w, h_qminus_v, h_inf_eq]
    field_simp [hr_ne, hℓ_ne]
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L δ ε : ℝ)
    (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L) (hδ_pos : 0 < δ) (hε_pos : 0 < ε)
    (hε_le : ε ≤ δ / (320 * (1 + 4 * L)))
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (P_star x₀ y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (hP_star : ‖P_star‖ ≤ L)
    (hU_lip : ∀ X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |U X₁ - U X₂| ≤ L * ‖X₁ - X₂‖)
    (hU_approx : ∀ X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      |U X - inner ℝ P_star X| ≤ ε)
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (1 / 4))
    (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (1 / 4))
    (h_viol : δ * ‖x₀ - y₀‖ < U x₀ + U y₀ - 2 * U ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x₀ + y₀))) :
    let c₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x₀ + y₀)
    ∃ (x_hat y_hat z_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      x_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
      y_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
      z_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
      0 < ‖x_hat - y_hat‖ ∧
      ‖x_hat - y_hat‖ ≤ 10 * ε / δ ∧
      ‖z_hat - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat + y_hat)‖ ≤ 4 * L * ‖x_hat - y_hat‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat + y_hat) - c₀‖ < 1 / 4 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
          ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
            x ≠ y →
            U x + U y - 2 * U z - threePointPenaltyPsi L δ P_star c₀ x y z ≤
              U x_hat + U y_hat - 2 * U z_hat -
                threePointPenaltyPsi L δ P_star c₀ x_hat y_hat z_hat

    · exact isMaxOn_iff.mp hp_hat_max (x, (y, z)) ⟨⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, h_ge⟩
    · push_neg at h_ge
      have h_up := (h_bounds x hx y hy z hz hne).2.2.2
      have h_lt1 : M₁ * ‖x - y‖ < M₁ * ρ_min := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_ge hM₁_pos
      have h_le2 : ρ_min ≤ μ₀ / (2 * M₁) := min_le_right _ _
      have h_le3 : M₁ * ρ_min ≤ M₁ * (μ₀ / (2 * M₁)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le2 (le_of_lt hM₁_pos)
      have h_eq : M₁ * (μ₀ / (2 * M₁)) = μ₀ / 2 := by
        have hM₁_ne : M₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hM₁_pos
        field_simp
      linarith
  
  let c_hat := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat + y_hat)
  let h_hat := z_hat - c_hat
  let r_hat := ‖x_hat - y_hat‖
  have hc_hat_B : c_hat ∈ B := h_mid_mem x_hat hx_hat_B y_hat hy_hat_B
  obtain ⟨hb1_hat, hb2_hat, hb3_hat, _⟩ := h_bounds x_hat hx_hat_B y_hat hy_hat_B z_hat hz_hat_B hne_hat
  have hr_hat_le_ε : r_hat ≤ 10 * ε / δ := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ_pos]
    linarith
  have hh_hat_le : ‖h_hat‖ ≤ 4 * L * r_hat ^ 2 := by
    have h_max_c : Φ x_hat y_hat c_hat ≤ Φ x_hat y_hat z_hat :=
      h_global_max x_hat hx_hat_B y_hat hy_hat_B c_hat hc_hat_B hne_hat
    have h_ineq : ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 2 ≤ 4 * L * ‖h_hat‖ := by linarith
    have h_ineq2 : ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * L * r_hat ^ 2 * ‖h_hat‖ := by
      have hr2_pos : 0 < r_hat ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr_hat_pos
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hr2_pos] at h_ineq
      linarith
    by_contra h_gt
    push_neg at h_gt
    have hh_pos : 0 < ‖h_hat‖ := by
      have : 0 < 4 * L * r_hat ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
    nlinarith
  have hc_hat_lt : ‖c_hat - c₀‖ < 1 / 4 := by
    have h_prod_pos : 0 < (2 * L + 6 * L ^ 2 - (4 / 5 : ℝ) * threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat) * r_hat :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hΦ_hat_pos hb3_hat
    have h_factor_pos : 0 < 2 * L + 6 * L ^ 2 - (4 / 5 : ℝ) * threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat :=
      pos_of_mul_pos_left h_prod_pos (le_of_lt hr_hat_pos)
    by_contra h_ge
    push_neg at h_ge
    have h_sq_ge : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ‖c_hat - c₀‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h_cut_expand : (4 / 5 : ℝ) * threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat =
        (2 / 5 : ℝ) * δ + 16 * (2 * L + 6 * L ^ 2 + 1) * ‖c_hat - c₀‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [threePointCutoff]
      ring
    have h_coeff_pos : 0 < 2 * L + 6 * L ^ 2 + 1 := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hc_hat_norm : ‖c_hat‖ < 1 / 2 := by
    have h_tri : ‖c_hat‖ ≤ ‖c₀‖ + ‖c_hat - c₀‖ := by
      have h_eq : c_hat = c₀ + (c_hat - c₀) := by abel
      conv_lhs => rw [h_eq]
      exact norm_add_le c₀ (c_hat - c₀)
    linarith
  have hr_hat_small : r_hat ≤ 1 / (32 * (1 + 4 * L)) := by
    have h_denom_pos : 0 < 320 * (1 + 4 * L) := by positivity
    have h1 : 10 * ε ≤ 10 * (δ / (320 * (1 + 4 * L))) := by linarith
    have h2 : 10 * ε / δ ≤ 10 * (δ / (320 * (1 + 4 * L))) / δ :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt hδ_pos)
    have h3 : 10 * (δ / (320 * (1 + 4 * L))) / δ = 1 / (32 * (1 + 4 * L)) := by
      have hδ_ne : δ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδ_pos
      have hL_ne : 1 + 4 * L ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp
      ring
    linarith
  have hr_hat_le_32 : r_hat ≤ 1 / 32 := by
    have : 1 / (32 * (1 + 4 * L)) ≤ 1 / 32 := by
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hh_hat_small : ‖h_hat‖ < 1 / 32 := by
    have hr_hat_le1 : r_hat ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hr2_le_r : r_hat ^ 2 ≤ r_hat := by nlinarith
    have h1 : 4 * L * r_hat ^ 2 ≤ 4 * L * r_hat := by nlinarith
    have h2 : 4 * L * r_hat ≤ 4 * L * (1 / (32 * (1 + 4 * L))) := by nlinarith
    have h3 : 4 * L * (1 / (32 * (1 + 4 * L))) < (1 + 4 * L) * (1 / (32 * (1 + 4 * L))) := by
      have : 0 < 1 / (32 * (1 + 4 * L)) := by positivity
      nlinarith
    have h4 : (1 + 4 * L) * (1 / (32 * (1 + 4 * L))) = 1 / 32 := by
      have : 1 + 4 * L ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp
    linarith
  have h_half_r_norm : ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat - y_hat)‖ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num)]
  have hx_hat_ball : x_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have h_tri : ‖x_hat‖ ≤ ‖c_hat‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat := by
      have h1 := h_x_decomp x_hat y_hat
      conv_lhs => rw [h1]
      have h2 := norm_add_le c_hat ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat - y_hat))
      linarith
    linarith
  have hy_hat_ball : y_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have h_tri : ‖y_hat‖ ≤ ‖c_hat‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat := by
      have h1 := h_y_decomp x_hat y_hat
      conv_lhs => rw [h1]
      have h2 := norm_sub_le c_hat ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat - y_hat))
      linarith
    linarith
  have hz_hat_ball : z_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have h_tri : ‖z_hat‖ ≤ ‖c_hat‖ + ‖h_hat‖ := by
      have h_eq : z_hat = c_hat + h_hat := (add_sub_cancel c_hat z_hat).symm
      conv_lhs => rw [h_eq]
      exact norm_add_le c_hat h_hat
    linarith
  exact ⟨x_hat, y_hat, z_hat, hx_hat_ball, hy_hat_ball, hz_hat_ball,
    hr_hat_pos, hr_hat_le_ε, hh_hat_le, hc_hat_lt, h_global_max⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L δ : ℝ)
    (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L) (hδ_pos : 0 < δ)
    (P_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (hP_star : ‖P_star‖ ≤ L) :
    ∃ r_max : ℝ, 0 < r_max ∧
      ∀ (c₀ x_hat y_hat z_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        x_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) →
        y_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) →
        z_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) →
        0 < ‖x_hat - y_hat‖ →
        ‖x_hat - y_hat‖ ≤ r_max →
        ‖z_hat - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat + y_hat)‖ ≤ 4 * L * ‖x_hat - y_hat‖ ^ 2 →
        ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat + y_hat) - c₀‖ < 1 / 4 →
        ∃ (p₁ p₂ p₀ e_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K ρ : ℝ),
          ‖e_hat‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < α ∧ 0 < β ∧ 0 < γ ∧ 0 < K ∧ 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
          (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
            ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
              ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
                x_hat + x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
                y_hat + y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
                z_hat + z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
                x_hat + x ≠ y_hat + y ∧
                threePointPenaltyPsi L δ P_star c₀ (x_hat + x) (y_hat + y) (z_hat + z) -
                  threePointPenaltyPsi L δ P_star c₀ x_hat y_hat z_hat ≤
                    inner ℝ p₁ x + inner ℝ p₂ y - 2 * inner ℝ p₀ z +
                      threePointQuadForm e_hat α β γ K x y z) ∧
          threePointQuadForm e_hat (α / 2) (2 * β) (2 * γ) (2 * K) p₁ p₂ p₀ < 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have midpoint_deviation_penalty_taylor_bound :
      ∀ (w_hat w h_hat h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        0 < ‖w_hat‖ →
        ‖h_hat‖ ≤ 4 * L * ‖w_hat‖ ^ 2 →
        ‖w‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w_hat‖ →
        let r_hat : ℝ := ‖w_hat‖
        let e_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := r_hat⁻¹ • w_hat
        let s : ℝ := inner ℝ e_hat w
        0 < ‖w_hat + w‖ ∧
        ‖h_hat + h‖ ^ 2 / ‖w_hat + w‖ ^ 2 - ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 2 ≤
          2 * inner ℝ h_hat h / r_hat ^ 2 - (2 * ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 3) * s +
          (5 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 + 1920 * L ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro w_hat w h_hat h hr_pos hh_le hw_le r_hat e_hat s
    set r : ℝ := ‖w_hat + w‖
    have hr_ge : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat ≤ r := by
      have h_tri : r_hat ≤ r + ‖w‖ := by
        simpa [r_hat, r] using norm_sub_le (w_hat + w) w
      linarith
    have hr_pos' : 0 < r := by linarith
    refine ⟨hr_pos', ?_⟩
    have hr_sq_ge : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * r_hat ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hr_sq_pos : 0 < r ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hr_hat_ne : r_hat ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr_pos
    have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr_pos'
    have h_inner_w : inner ℝ w_hat w = r_hat * s := by
      have hs_eq : s = r_hat⁻¹ * inner ℝ w_hat w := by
        simp [s, e_hat, inner_smul_left]
      rw [hs_eq, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_hat_ne, one_mul]
    have hr_sq_eq : r ^ 2 = r_hat ^ 2 + 2 * r_hat * s + ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := norm_add_sq_real w_hat w
      change r ^ 2 = r_hat ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ w_hat w + ‖w‖ ^ 2 at h1
      rw [h_inner_w] at h1
      linarith
    have he_norm : ‖e_hat‖ = 1 := by
      simp [e_hat, norm_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr_hat_ne, r_hat]
    have hs_abs : |s| ≤ ‖w‖ := by
      have h_cs := abs_real_inner_le_norm e_hat w
      rw [he_norm, one_mul] at h_cs
      exact h_cs
    have hs_sq : s ^ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs s, ← sq_abs ‖w‖, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg w)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg s) hs_abs 2
    have hs_le : s ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat := le_trans (le_abs_self s) (le_trans hs_abs hw_le)
    have hh_sq_eq : ‖h_hat + h‖ ^ 2 = ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ h_hat h + ‖h‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_add_sq_real h_hat h
    have h_decomp :
        ‖h_hat + h‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 - ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 2 =
          2 * inner ℝ h_hat h / r_hat ^ 2 - (2 * ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 3) * s +
          ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 * ((r_hat ^ 3 - r_hat * r ^ 2 + 2 * s * r ^ 2) / (r_hat ^ 3 * r ^ 2)) +
          (2 * inner ℝ h_hat h * (r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2)) / (r_hat ^ 2 * r ^ 2) +
          ‖h‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 := by
      rw [hh_sq_eq]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h_p1 : ‖h‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 ≤ (4 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hr_sq_pos]
      have h_id : (4 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 * r ^ 2 - ‖h‖ ^ 2 =
          (4 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * r_hat ^ 2) := by
        field_simp
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (4 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * r_hat ^ 2) :=
        mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h_num2 : r_hat ^ 3 - r_hat * r ^ 2 + 2 * s * r ^ 2 ≤ 5 * r_hat * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_id : r_hat ^ 3 - r_hat * r ^ 2 + 2 * s * r ^ 2 =
          -r_hat * ‖w‖ ^ 2 + 4 * r_hat * s ^ 2 + 2 * s * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hr_sq_eq]
        ring
      rw [h_id]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖w‖]
    have hh_hat_sq : ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 ≤ 16 * L ^ 2 * r_hat ^ 4 := by
      have h1 : ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 ≤ (4 * L * r_hat ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg h_hat) hh_le 2
      linarith [show (4 * L * r_hat ^ 2) ^ 2 = 16 * L ^ 2 * r_hat ^ 4 by ring]
    have h_p2 : ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 * ((r_hat ^ 3 - r_hat * r ^ 2 + 2 * s * r ^ 2) / (r_hat ^ 3 * r ^ 2)) ≤
        320 * L ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_div : (r_hat ^ 3 - r_hat * r ^ 2 + 2 * s * r ^ 2) / (r_hat ^ 3 * r ^ 2) ≤
          (20 * ‖w‖ ^ 2) / r_hat ^ 4 := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        calc (r_hat ^ 3 - r_hat * r ^ 2 + 2 * s * r ^ 2) * r_hat ^ 4
            ≤ (5 * r_hat * ‖w‖ ^ 2) * r_hat ^ 4 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_num2 (by positivity)
          _ = 20 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 * (r_hat ^ 3 * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * r_hat ^ 2)) := by ring
          _ ≤ 20 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 * (r_hat ^ 3 * r ^ 2) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_sq_ge (by positivity)
      calc ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 * ((r_hat ^ 3 - r_hat * r ^ 2 + 2 * s * r ^ 2) / (r_hat ^ 3 * r ^ 2))
          ≤ ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 * ((20 * ‖w‖ ^ 2) / r_hat ^ 4) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div (sq_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ (16 * L ^ 2 * r_hat ^ 4) * ((20 * ‖w‖ ^ 2) / r_hat ^ 4) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh_hat_sq (by positivity)
        _ = 320 * L ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
          field_simp
          ring
    have h_p3 : (2 * inner ℝ h_hat h * (r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2)) / (r_hat ^ 2 * r ^ 2) ≤
        (1 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 + 1600 * L ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_diff_abs : |r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2| ≤ (5 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat * ‖w‖ := by
        have h_eq : r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2 = -2 * r_hat * s - ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by linarith [hr_sq_eq]
        rw [h_eq, abs_le]
        have hw_sq_le : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat * ‖w‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
        have hs_b := abs_le.mp hs_abs
        constructor <;> nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
      have h_inner_h : |inner ℝ h_hat h| ≤ 4 * L * r_hat ^ 2 * ‖h‖ := by
        calc |inner ℝ h_hat h| ≤ ‖h_hat‖ * ‖h‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm h_hat h
          _ ≤ (4 * L * r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh_le (norm_nonneg h)
      have h_num3 : 2 * inner ℝ h_hat h * (r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2) ≤ 20 * L * r_hat ^ 3 * ‖h‖ * ‖w‖ := by
        calc 2 * inner ℝ h_hat h * (r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2)
            ≤ |2 * inner ℝ h_hat h * (r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2)| := le_abs_self _
          _ = 2 * |inner ℝ h_hat h| * |r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
          _ ≤ 2 * (4 * L * r_hat ^ 2 * ‖h‖) * ((5 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat * ‖w‖) := by
            gcongr
          _ = 20 * L * r_hat ^ 3 * ‖h‖ * ‖w‖ := by ring
      have h_quot3 : (2 * inner ℝ h_hat h * (r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2)) / (r_hat ^ 2 * r ^ 2) ≤
          80 * L * (‖h‖ / r_hat) * ‖w‖ := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        calc 2 * inner ℝ h_hat h * (r_hat ^ 2 - r ^ 2)
            ≤ 20 * L * r_hat ^ 3 * ‖h‖ * ‖w‖ := h_num3
          _ = 80 * L * (‖h‖ / r_hat) * ‖w‖ * (r_hat ^ 2 * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * r_hat ^ 2)) := by
            field_simp
            ring
          _ ≤ 80 * L * (‖h‖ / r_hat) * ‖w‖ * (r_hat ^ 2 * r ^ 2) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_sq_ge (by positivity)
      have h_amgm : 80 * L * (‖h‖ / r_hat) * ‖w‖ ≤
          (1 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 + 1600 * L ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_sq : 0 ≤ (‖h‖ / r_hat - 40 * L * ‖w‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        have h_id : (1 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 + 1600 * L ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 -
            80 * L * (‖h‖ / r_hat) * ‖w‖ = (‖h‖ / r_hat - 40 * L * ‖w‖) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp
          ring
        linarith
      linarith
    have h_combine : (4 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 + (1 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 =
        (5 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    linarith
  have concave_sep_penalty_vector_bound :
      ∀ (w_hat w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        0 < ‖w_hat‖ →
        ‖w_hat‖ ≤ 1 →
        ‖w‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w_hat‖ →
        let r_hat : ℝ := ‖w_hat‖
        let e_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := r_hat⁻¹ • w_hat
        let s : ℝ := inner ℝ e_hat w

        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h_r1
        linarith
      linarith
    have ha_ge : δ / 4 ≤ a := by
      dsimp [a]
      nlinarith
    have ha_le : a ≤ δ / 2 + B_out := by
      dsimp [a]
      nlinarith
    have ha_abs : |a| ≤ δ / 2 + B_out := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, ha_le⟩
    have h_term1 : -(α / 2) * (inner ℝ e_hat (p₁ - p₂)) ^ 2 ≤ -(C_pos + 1) := by
      rw [hp_inner]
      have ha_sq : (δ / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * a) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_step1 : -(α / 2) * (2 * a) ^ 2 ≤ -(δ ^ 3 / (4096 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) := by
        dsimp [α]
        have h_pos_α : 0 ≤ δ / (512 * Real.sqrt r_hat) / 2 := by positivity
        have h_mul : (δ / (512 * Real.sqrt r_hat) / 2) * (δ / 2) ^ 2 ≤
            (δ / (512 * Real.sqrt r_hat) / 2) * (2 * a) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha_sq h_pos_α
        have h_eq : (δ / (512 * Real.sqrt r_hat) / 2) * (δ / 2) ^ 2 =
            δ ^ 3 / (4096 * Real.sqrt r_hat) := by ring
        linarith
      have h_sqrt_le : Real.sqrt r_hat ≤ δ ^ 3 / (4096 * (C_pos + 1)) := by
        have h_sq := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hr_le_r₂
        dsimp [r₂] at h_sq
        rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h_sq
      have h_step2 : C_pos + 1 ≤ δ ^ 3 / (4096 * Real.sqrt r_hat) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h_sqrt_le
        linarith
      linarith
    have hp_mid : p₀ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (p₁ + p₂) = -(((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B) := by
      dsimp [p₁, p₂, p₀]
      module
    have hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ concaveSepPenalty r_hat := by
      dsimp [concaveSepPenalty]
      have : r_hat * Real.sqrt r_hat ≤ r_hat * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_hat_le_one (le_of_lt hr_pos)
      linarith
    have hf_le_r : concaveSepPenalty r_hat ≤ r_hat := by
      dsimp [concaveSepPenalty]
      have : 0 ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * (r_hat * Real.sqrt r_hat) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hg_norm : ‖g_B‖ ≤ 8 * B_out := by
      have h1 : ‖g_B‖ = 32 * B_out * ‖c_hat - c₀‖ := by
        rw [show g_B = (32 * B_out) • (c_hat - c₀) from rfl, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have h_fg_norm : ‖((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B‖ ≤ 4 * B_out * r_hat := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg g_B]
    have h_mid_norm : ‖p₀ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (p₁ + p₂)‖ ≤ 4 * B_out * r_hat := by
      rw [hp_mid, norm_neg]
      exact h_fg_norm
    have h_term3 : (2 * γ) * ‖p₀ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (p₁ + p₂)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 160 * B_out ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [γ]
      have h_sq : ‖p₀ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (p₁ + p₂)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (4 * B_out * r_hat) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_mid_norm 2
      calc (2 * (5 / r_hat ^ 2)) * ‖p₀ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (p₁ + p₂)‖ ^ 2
          ≤ (2 * (5 / r_hat ^ 2)) * (4 * B_out * r_hat) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq (by positivity)
        _ = 160 * B_out ^ 2 := by
            field_simp
            ring
    have h_hhat_norm : ‖(r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat‖ ≤ 4 * L := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have h_ae_norm : ‖a • e_hat‖ ≤ δ / 2 + B_out := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, he_norm, mul_one]
      exact ha_abs
    have h_fg_norm_le : ‖((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B‖ ≤ 4 * B_out := by
      nlinarith [h_fg_norm]
    have hp₀_norm : ‖p₀‖ ≤ M_p := by
      have h1 := norm_sub_le P_star ((r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat)
      dsimp [p₀, M_p]
      linarith
    have hp₁_norm : ‖p₁‖ ≤ M_p := by
      have h1 := norm_add_le
        (P_star + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B - (r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat) (a • e_hat)
      have h2 := norm_sub_le
        (P_star + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B) ((r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat)
      have h3 := norm_add_le P_star (((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B)
      dsimp [p₁, M_p]
      linarith
    have hp₂_norm : ‖p₂‖ ≤ M_p := by
      have h1 := norm_sub_le
        (P_star + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B - (r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat) (a • e_hat)
      have h2 := norm_sub_le
        (P_star + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B) ((r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat)
      have h3 := norm_add_le P_star (((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B)
      dsimp [p₂, M_p]
      linarith
    have hp₀_sq : ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ M_p ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp₀_norm 2
    have hp₁_sq : ‖p₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ M_p ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp₁_norm 2
    have hp₂_sq : ‖p₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ M_p ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp₂_norm 2
    have h_term4 : (2 * K') * (‖p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖p₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2) ≤ 6 * K * M_p ^ 2 := by
      change (2 * K) * (‖p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖p₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2) ≤ 6 * K * M_p ^ 2
      nlinarith
    dsimp [threePointQuadForm]
    have h_cpos_def : C_pos = 160 * B_out ^ 2 + 6 * K * M_p ^ 2 := rfl
    linarith
  obtain ⟨r_max, hr_max_pos, hr_max_le_one, h_neg⟩ := coupled_velocity_quadForm_neg
  refine ⟨r_max, hr_max_pos, ?_⟩
  intro c₀ x_hat y_hat z_hat hx_hat hy_hat hz_hat hr_pos hr_le_max hh_le hc_lt
  set c_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x_hat + y_hat)
  set w_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := x_hat - y_hat
  set r_hat : ℝ := ‖w_hat‖
  set h_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z_hat - c_hat
  set e_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := r_hat⁻¹ • w_hat
  set C : ℝ := 2 * L
  set B_out : ℝ := (5 / 4 : ℝ) * (C + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * C ^ 2 + 1)
  set g_B : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (32 * B_out) • (c_hat - c₀)
  set a : ℝ := threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * (1 - (3 / 16 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt r_hat) -
    2 * ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 3
  set p₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    P_star + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B - (r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat + a • e_hat
  set p₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    P_star + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) • g_B - (r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat - a • e_hat
  set p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    P_star - (r_hat ^ 2)⁻¹ • h_hat
  set α : ℝ := δ / (512 * Real.sqrt r_hat)
  set β : ℝ := threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * (1 / r_hat + 1 / (128 * Real.sqrt r_hat))
  set γ : ℝ := 5 / r_hat ^ 2
  set K : ℝ := 3840 * L ^ 2 + 24 * B_out
  set ρ : ℝ := min (min (1 / 8) (r_hat / 4))
    (min (3 / 4 - ‖x_hat‖) (min (3 / 4 - ‖y_hat‖) (3 / 4 - ‖z_hat‖)))
  have hr_hat_pos : 0 < r_hat := hr_pos
  have hr_hat_ne : r_hat ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr_hat_pos
  have he_norm : ‖e_hat‖ = 1 := by
    simp [e_hat, norm_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr_hat_ne, r_hat]
  have hC_pos : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
  have hB_pos : 0 < B_out := by dsimp [B_out]; positivity
  have h_cutoff_ge : δ / 2 ≤ threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat := by
    change δ / 2 ≤ δ / 2 + 16 * B_out * ‖c_hat - c₀‖ ^ 2
    have : 0 ≤ 16 * B_out * ‖c_hat - c₀‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  have h_cutoff_pos : 0 < threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat := by linarith
  have hα_pos : 0 < α := by dsimp [α]; positivity
  have hβ_pos : 0 < β := by dsimp [β]; positivity
  have hγ_pos : 0 < γ := by dsimp [γ]; positivity
  have hK_pos : 0 < K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
  have hx_hat_lt : ‖x_hat‖ < 3 / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hx_hat
  have hy_hat_lt : ‖y_hat‖ < 3 / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hy_hat
  have hz_hat_lt : ‖z_hat‖ < 3 / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz_hat
  have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := by
    dsimp [ρ]
    refine lt_min (lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity))
      (lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)))
  have hρ_le_eighth : ρ ≤ 1 / 8 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρ_le_r : ρ ≤ r_hat / 4 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hρ_le_x : ρ ≤ 3 / 4 - ‖x_hat‖ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρ_le_y : ρ ≤ 3 / 4 - ‖y_hat‖ :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hρ_le_z : ρ ≤ 3 / 4 - ‖z_hat‖ :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  refine ⟨p₁, p₂, p₀, e_hat, α, β, γ, K, ρ, he_norm, hα_pos, hβ_pos, hγ_pos, hK_pos,
    hρ_pos, hρ_le_eighth, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy z hz
    have hx_norm : ‖x‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hx
    have hy_norm : ‖y‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hy
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hz
    have hx_cb : x_hat + x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      linarith [norm_add_le x_hat x]
    have hy_cb : y_hat + y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      linarith [norm_add_le y_hat y]
    have hz_cb : z_hat + z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      linarith [norm_add_le z_hat z]
    set c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)
    set w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := x - y
    set h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z - c
    set s : ℝ := inner ℝ e_hat w
    set w_perp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := w - s • e_hat
    have hw_le : ‖w‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_hat := by
      have h1 : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_sub_le x y
      linarith
    have hr_le_one : r_hat ≤ 1 := le_trans hr_le_max hr_max_le_one
    obtain ⟨hr_pert_pos, h_s1⟩ :=
      midpoint_deviation_penalty_taylor_bound w_hat w h_hat h hr_pos hh_le hw_le
    obtain ⟨hf₁_le, hf_diff, h_s2⟩ :=
      concave_sep_penalty_vector_bound w_hat w hr_pos hr_le_one hw_le
    obtain ⟨_, h_s3⟩ :=
      three_point_cutoff_product_bound c₀ c_hat c w hc_lt
        (concaveSepPenalty r_hat) (concaveSepPenalty ‖w_hat + w‖) hf₁_le hf_diff
    have h_xy_sub : (x_hat + x) - (y_hat + y) = w_hat + w := by
      dsimp [w_hat, w]
      abel
    have h_c_add : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((x_hat + x) + (y_hat + y)) = c_hat + c := by
      dsimp [c_hat, c]
      module
    have h_h_add : (z_hat + z) - (c_hat + c) = h_hat + h := by
      dsimp [h_hat, h]
      abel
    have h_xy_ne : x_hat + x ≠ y_hat + y := by
      intro h_eq
      have h_zero : ‖(x_hat + x) - (y_hat + y)‖ = 0 := by
        rw [h_eq, sub_self, norm_zero]
      rw [h_xy_sub] at h_zero
      linarith
    refine ⟨hx_cb, hy_cb, hz_cb, h_xy_ne, ?_⟩
    change (2 * inner ℝ h_hat h / r_hat ^ 2 - (2 * ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 3) * s +
        (5 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 + 1920 * L ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≥
        ‖h_hat + h‖ ^ 2 / ‖w_hat + w‖ ^ 2 - ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 2) at h_s1
    change (concaveSepPenalty ‖w_hat + w‖ - concaveSepPenalty r_hat ≤
        (1 - (3 / 16 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt r_hat) * s -
        (1 / (256 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) * s ^ 2 +
        (1 / r_hat + 1 / (128 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) * ‖w_perp‖ ^ 2) at h_s2
    change (threePointCutoff L δ c₀ (c_hat + c) * concaveSepPenalty ‖w_hat + w‖ -
        threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * concaveSepPenalty r_hat ≤
        concaveSepPenalty r_hat * inner ℝ g_B c +
        threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * (concaveSepPenalty ‖w_hat + w‖ - concaveSepPenalty r_hat) +
        12 * B_out * (4 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2)) at h_s3
    have h_s2_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_s2 (le_of_lt h_cutoff_pos)
    have h_s2_quad :
        threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat *
          ((1 - (3 / 16 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt r_hat) * s -
            (1 / (256 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) * s ^ 2 +
            (1 / r_hat + 1 / (128 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) * ‖w_perp‖ ^ 2) ≤
          threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * (1 - (3 / 16 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt r_hat) * s -
          α * s ^ 2 + β * ‖w_perp‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_alpha_le :
          α * s ^ 2 ≤ threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * (1 / (256 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) * s ^ 2 := by
        have h_coeff : α ≤ threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * (1 / (256 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) := by
          calc α = (δ / 2) * (1 / (256 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) := by dsimp [α]; ring
            _ ≤ threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * (1 / (256 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_cutoff_ge (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coeff (sq_nonneg s)
      have h_beta_eq :
          threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * ((1 / r_hat + 1 / (128 * Real.sqrt r_hat)) * ‖w_perp‖ ^ 2) =
            β * ‖w_perp‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [β]
        ring
      linarith
    have h_para : 4 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
      have h4c : 4 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 = ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [c]
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
        ring
      rw [h4c, show w = x - y from rfl, norm_add_sq_real x y, norm_sub_sq_real x y]
      ring
    have hw_sq_le_xy : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
      linarith [sq_nonneg ‖c‖]
    have h_lin_id :
        inner ℝ P_star ((x_hat + x) + (y_hat + y) - (2 : ℝ) • (z_hat + z)) -
          inner ℝ P_star (x_hat + y_hat - (2 : ℝ) • z_hat) +
          concaveSepPenalty r_hat * inner ℝ g_B c +
          2 * inner ℝ h_hat h / r_hat ^ 2 +
          a * s =
          inner ℝ p₁ x + inner ℝ p₂ y - 2 * inner ℝ p₀ z := by
      have h_p_vec : (x_hat + x) + (y_hat + y) - (2 : ℝ) • (z_hat + z) =
          (x_hat + y_hat - (2 : ℝ) • z_hat) + (x + y - (2 : ℝ) • z) := by
        module
      rw [h_p_vec]
      dsimp [p₁, p₂, p₀, s, c, h, w]
      simp only [inner_add_left, inner_sub_left, inner_add_right, inner_sub_right,
        inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, RCLike.conj_to_real]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h_psi_diff :
        threePointPenaltyPsi L δ P_star c₀ (x_hat + x) (y_hat + y) (z_hat + z) -
          threePointPenaltyPsi L δ P_star c₀ x_hat y_hat z_hat =
          (inner ℝ P_star ((x_hat + x) + (y_hat + y) - (2 : ℝ) • (z_hat + z)) -
            inner ℝ P_star (x_hat + y_hat - (2 : ℝ) • z_hat)) +
          (threePointCutoff L δ c₀ (c_hat + c) * concaveSepPenalty ‖w_hat + w‖ -
            threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * concaveSepPenalty r_hat) +
          (‖h_hat + h‖ ^ 2 / ‖w_hat + w‖ ^ 2 - ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [threePointPenaltyPsi]
      rw [h_xy_sub, h_c_add, h_h_add]
      change (inner ℝ P_star ((x_hat + x) + (y_hat + y) - (2 : ℝ) • (z_hat + z)) +
          threePointCutoff L δ c₀ (c_hat + c) * concaveSepPenalty ‖w_hat + w‖ +
          ‖h_hat + h‖ ^ 2 / ‖w_hat + w‖ ^ 2) -
        (inner ℝ P_star (x_hat + y_hat - (2 : ℝ) • z_hat) +
          threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * concaveSepPenalty r_hat +
          ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 2) = _
      ring
    have h_quad_eq :
        threePointQuadForm e_hat α β γ K x y z =
          -α * s ^ 2 + β * ‖w_perp‖ ^ 2 + (5 / r_hat ^ 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 +
          K * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [threePointQuadForm, s, w_perp, w, h, c, γ]
    have h_a_s :
        threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c_hat * (1 - (3 / 16 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt r_hat) * s -
          (2 * ‖h_hat‖ ^ 2 / r_hat ^ 3) * s = a * s := by
      dsimp [a]
      ring
    have h_K_bound :
        1920 * L ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 + 12 * B_out * (4 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2) ≤
          K * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
      have h_z_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      dsimp [K]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  · exact h_neg c₀ c_hat w_hat h_hat β hr_pos hr_le_max hh_le hc_lt

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x_hat y_hat z_hat p₁ p₂ p₀ e_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (α β γ K ρ : ℝ)
    (hU_har : IsInfinityHarmonicOn U (Metric.ball 0 1))
    (hU_lip : ∀ X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |U X₁ - U X₂| ≤ L * ‖X₁ - X₂‖)
    (hx_hat : x_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hy_hat : y_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hz_hat : z_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (he_hat : ‖e_hat‖ = 1)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hβ : 0 < β) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (hρ_le : ρ ≤ 1 / 8)
    (h_upper : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
          (U (x_hat + x) - U x_hat - inner ℝ p₁ x) +
            (U (y_hat + y) - U y_hat - inner ℝ p₂ y) -
            2 * (U (z_hat + z) - U z_hat - inner ℝ p₀ z) ≤
              threePointQuadForm e_hat α β γ K x y z) :
    ∃ (lam : ℝ) (u_hat₁ u_hat₂ u_hat₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      0 < lam ∧
      u_hat₁ 0 = 0 ∧ u_hat₂ 0 = 0 ∧ u_hat₃ 0 = 0 ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₁ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₂ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₃ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₁ p₁ (ρ / 2) ∧
      HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₂ p₂ (ρ / 2) ∧
      HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₃ (-(2 : ℝ) • p₀) (ρ / 2) ∧
      ∀ ξ₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (ρ / 2),
        ∀ ξ₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (ρ / 2),
          ∀ ξ₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (ρ / 2),
            u_hat₁ ξ₁ + u_hat₂ ξ₂ + u_hat₃ ξ₃ ≤
              threePointQuadForm e_hat (α / 2) (2 * β) (2 * γ) (2 * K) ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃

signature.name: sup_convolution_semiconvex_reduction
signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x_hat y_hat z_hat p₁ p₂ p₀ e_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (α β γ K ρ : ℝ)
    (hU_har : IsInfinityHarmonicOn U (Metric.ball 0 1))
    (hU_lip : ∀ X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |U X₁ - U X₂| ≤ L * ‖X₁ - X₂‖)
    (hx_hat : x_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hy_hat : y_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (hz_hat : z_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4))
    (he_hat : ‖e_hat‖ = 1)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hβ : 0 < β) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (hρ_le : ρ ≤ 1 / 8)
    (h_upper : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
          (U (x_hat + x) - U x_hat - inner ℝ p₁ x) +
            (U (y_hat + y) - U y_hat - inner ℝ p₂ y) -
            2 * (U (z_hat + z) - U z_hat - inner ℝ p₀ z) ≤
              threePointQuadForm e_hat α β γ K x y z) :
    ∃ (lam : ℝ) (u_hat₁ u_hat₂ u_hat₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      0 < lam ∧
      u_hat₁ 0 = 0 ∧ u_hat₂ 0 = 0 ∧ u_hat₃ 0 = 0 ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₁ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₂ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₃ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₁ p₁ (ρ / 2) ∧
      HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₂ p₂ (ρ / 2) ∧
      HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₃ (-(2 : ℝ) • p₀) (ρ / 2) ∧
      ∀ ξ₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (ρ / 2),
        ∀ ξ₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (ρ / 2),
          ∀ ξ₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (ρ / 2),
            u_hat₁ ξ₁ + u_hat₂ ξ₂ + u_hat₃ ξ₃ ≤
              threePointQuadForm e_hat (α / 2) (2 * β) (2 * γ) (2 * K) ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hd
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))
  let localSupConv : ℝ → ℝ → (E → ℝ) → E → ℝ := fun r l u ξ =>
    sSup ((fun w => u w - (l / 2) * ‖w - ξ‖ ^ 2) '' Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r)
  let quadTestFunc : ℝ → E → E → (E →L[ℝ] E) → E → ℝ := fun c b Z₀ X Y =>
    c + inner ℝ b (Y - Z₀) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (Y - Z₀)) (Y - Z₀)
  
  have h_sup_spec : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam →
      ∀ (u : E → ℝ), ContinuousOn u (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ) →
        (∀ ξ : E, ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
          u w - (lam / 2) * ‖w - ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ localSupConv ρ lam u ξ) ∧
        (∀ ξ : E, ∃ w₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
          localSupConv ρ lam u ξ = u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
        ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => localSupConv ρ lam u ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro lam _hlam u hu_cont
    let K₀ : Set E := Metric.closedBall 0 ρ
    have hK₀_comp : IsCompact K₀ := isCompact_closedBall 0 ρ
    have hK₀_nonempty : K₀.Nonempty := Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr (le_of_lt hρ_pos)
    have hg_cont : ∀ ξ : E, ContinuousOn (fun w => u w - (lam / 2) * ‖w - ξ‖ ^ 2) K₀ := by
      intro ξ
      refine hu_cont.sub ?_
      exact (continuous_const.mul (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm).pow 2)).continuousOn
    have h_le : ∀ ξ : E, ∀ w ∈ K₀, u w - (lam / 2) * ‖w - ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ localSupConv ρ lam u ξ := by
      intro ξ w hw
      have h_bdd : BddAbove ((fun w => u w - (lam / 2) * ‖w - ξ‖ ^ 2) '' K₀) :=
        (hK₀_comp.image_of_continuousOn (hg_cont ξ)).bddAbove
      exact le_csSup h_bdd (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hw)
    have h_attain : ∀ ξ : E, ∃ w₀ ∈ K₀, localSupConv ρ lam u ξ = u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro ξ
      obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, hmax⟩ := hK₀_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK₀_nonempty (hg_cont ξ)
      refine ⟨w₀, hw₀, le_antisymm ?_ (h_le ξ w₀ hw₀)⟩
      apply csSup_le (hK₀_nonempty.image _)
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact hmax hw
    refine ⟨h_le, h_attain, convex_univ, ?_⟩
    intro ξ₁ _ ξ₂ _ a b ha hb hab
    obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, hw₀_eq⟩ := h_attain (a • ξ₁ + b • ξ₂)
    have h1 := h_le ξ₁ w₀ hw₀
    have h2 := h_le ξ₂ w₀ hw₀
    have h_id : ∀ ξ : E,
        (u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ‖ ^ 2) + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 =
          u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀‖ ^ 2 + lam * inner ℝ w₀ ξ := by
      intro ξ
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
      ring
    have h_comb : (localSupConv ρ lam u (a • ξ₁ + b • ξ₂) + (lam / 2) * ‖a • ξ₁ + b • ξ₂‖ ^ 2) =
        a * ((u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ₁‖ ^ 2) + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ₁‖ ^ 2) +
        b * ((u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ₂‖ ^ 2) + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ₂‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [hw₀_eq, h_id (a • ξ₁ + b • ξ₂), h_id ξ₁, h_id ξ₂, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right,
        inner_smul_right]
      linear_combination (-(u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀‖ ^ 2)) * hab
    dsimp only
    rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, h_comb]
    nlinarith

  
  have h_quad : ∀ (c : ℝ) (b Z₀ : E) (X : E →L[ℝ] E),
      (∀ v w : E, inner ℝ (X v) w = inner ℝ v (X w)) →
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (quadTestFunc c b Z₀ X) ∧
      infinityLaplacian (quadTestFunc c b Z₀ X) Z₀ = inner ℝ (X b) b := by
    intro c b Z₀ X hX_symm
    let L_dual : E →L[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
      (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap
    have hL_apply : ∀ u h : E, L_dual u h = inner ℝ u h := by
      intro u h
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply
    have h_sub : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun Y : E => Y - Z₀) := contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const
    have h_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ 2 (quadTestFunc c b Z₀ X) := by
      dsimp only [quadTestFunc]
      refine (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.inner ℝ h_sub)).add ?_
      exact contDiff_const.mul ((X.contDiff.comp h_sub).inner ℝ h_sub)
    have h_fderiv1 : ∀ Y : E,
        HasFDerivAt (quadTestFunc c b Z₀ X) (L_dual (b + X (Y - Z₀))) Y := by
      intro Y
      have hd_sub : HasFDerivAt (fun W : E => W - Z₀) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) Y :=
        (hasFDerivAt_id Y).sub_const Z₀
      have hd_X : HasFDerivAt (fun W : E => X (W - Z₀)) X Y := by
        have h_eq : (fun W : E => X (W - Z₀)) = (fun W : E => X W - X Z₀) := by
          funext W; exact map_sub X W Z₀
        rw [h_eq]
        exact X.hasFDerivAt.sub_const (X Z₀)
      have hd_lin : HasFDerivAt (fun W : E => inner ℝ b (W - Z₀)) (L_dual b) Y := by
        have h_eq : (fun W : E => inner ℝ b (W - Z₀)) = (fun W : E => (L_dual b) W - (L_dual b) Z₀) := by
          funext W
          rw [hL_apply, hL_apply, inner_sub_right]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (L_dual b).hasFDerivAt.sub_const ((L_dual b) Z₀)
      have hd_quad := hd_X.inner ℝ hd_sub
      have hd_all := ((hd_lin.const_add c).add (hd_quad.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)))
      refine hd_all.congr_fderiv ?_
      ext h
      simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, fderivInnerCLM_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_add, hL_apply]
      have h_sym : inner ℝ (X (Y - Z₀)) h = inner ℝ (X h) (Y - Z₀) := by
        rw [hX_symm h (Y - Z₀), real_inner_comm]
      linarith
    have h_grad : gradient (quadTestFunc c b Z₀ X) Z₀ = b := by
      have hd0 := h_fderiv1 Z₀
      rw [sub_self, map_zero, add_zero] at hd0
      have hg : HasGradientAt (quadTestFunc c b Z₀ X) b Z₀ :=
        hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mpr hd0
      exact hg.gradient
    have h_fderiv_eq : fderiv ℝ (quadTestFunc c b Z₀ X) = fun Y => L_dual (b + X (Y - Z₀)) := by
      funext Y
      exact (h_fderiv1 Y).fderiv
    have h_fderiv2 : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (quadTestFunc c b Z₀ X)) (L_dual.comp X) Z₀ := by
      rw [h_fderiv_eq]
      have hd_inner : HasFDerivAt (fun Y : E => b + X (Y - Z₀)) X Z₀ := by
        have h_eq : (fun W : E => X (W - Z₀)) = (fun W : E => X W - X Z₀) := by
          funext W; exact map_sub X W Z₀
        have hd_X : HasFDerivAt (fun W : E => X (W - Z₀)) X Z₀ := by
          rw [h_eq]
          exact X.hasFDerivAt.sub_const (X Z₀)
        exact hd_X.const_add b
      exact L_dual.hasFDerivAt.comp Z₀ hd_inner
    refine ⟨h_contDiff, ?_⟩
    unfold infinityLaplacian
    rw [h_fderiv2.fderiv, h_grad, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hL_apply]

  
  have h_transfer : ∀ (M lam δ_test : ℝ),
      0 < lam → 0 < δ_test → 8 * M ≤ lam * ρ →
      ∀ (u u_hat : E → ℝ) (ξ₀ q : E) (X : E →L[ℝ] E),
        (∀ w₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ, ∀ w₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
          |u w₁ - u w₂| ≤ M * ‖w₁ - w₂‖) →
        (∀ ξ : E, ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
          u w - (lam / 2) * ‖w - ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ u_hat ξ) →
        (∀ ξ : E, ∃ w₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
          u_hat ξ = u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ‖ ^ 2) →
        ξ₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (ρ / 2) →
        (∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ_test,
          u_hat ξ ≤ u_hat ξ₀ + inner ℝ q (ξ - ξ₀) +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (ξ - ξ₀)) (ξ - ξ₀)) →
        ∃ (w₀ : E) (r₁ : ℝ),
          0 < r₁ ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r₁, w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) ρ) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r₁,
            u w ≤ u w₀ + inner ℝ q (w - w₀) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (w - w₀)) (w - w₀)) := by
    intro M lam δ_test _hlam hδ hlam_ge u u_hat ξ₀ q X hu_lip h_le h_attain hξ₀ h_touch
    obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, hw₀_eq⟩ := h_attain ξ₀
    have hξ₀_norm : ‖ξ₀‖ < ρ / 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hξ₀
    have hξ₀_cb : ξ₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    have h_self := h_le ξ₀ ξ₀ hξ₀_cb
    rw [sub_self, norm_zero, sq, mul_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, hw₀_eq] at h_self
    have h_lip := hu_lip w₀ hw₀ ξ₀ hξ₀_cb
    have h_quad_le : (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ M * ‖w₀ - ξ₀‖ := by
      linarith [le_abs_self (u w₀ - u ξ₀)]
    have h_dist_le : ‖w₀ - ξ₀‖ ≤ ρ / 4 := by
      by_cases h_zero : ‖w₀ - ξ₀‖ = 0
      · linarith
      · have h_pos : 0 < ‖w₀ - ξ₀‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm h_zero)
        have h_div : (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ₀‖ ≤ M := by nlinarith
        nlinarith
    have hw₀_norm : ‖w₀‖ < 3 * ρ / 4 := by
      have h_tri : ‖w₀‖ ≤ ‖ξ₀‖ + ‖w₀ - ξ₀‖ := by
        simpa [add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le ξ₀ (w₀ - ξ₀)
      linarith
    let r₁ : ℝ := min δ_test (ρ - ‖w₀‖)
    have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min hδ (by linarith)
    refine ⟨w₀, r₁, hr₁_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw
      have hw_dist : ‖w - w₀‖ < r₁ := by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
      have hr₁_le : r₁ ≤ ρ - ‖w₀‖ := min_le_right _ _
      have h_tri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖w₀‖ + ‖w - w₀‖ := by
        simpa [add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le w₀ (w - w₀)
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    · intro w hw
      have hw_dist : ‖w - w₀‖ < r₁ := by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
      have hr₁_le1 : r₁ ≤ δ_test := min_le_left _ _
      have hr₁_le2 : r₁ ≤ ρ - ‖w₀‖ := min_le_right _ _
      have hw_cb : w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ := by
        have h_tri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖w₀‖ + ‖w - w₀‖ := by
          simpa [add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le w₀ (w - w₀)
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        linarith
      let ξ : E := ξ₀ + (w - w₀)
      have hξ_sub : ξ - ξ₀ = w - w₀ := add_sub_cancel_left ξ₀ (w - w₀)
      have hξ_mem : ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ_test := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hξ_sub]
        linarith
      have hw_sub : w - ξ = w₀ - ξ₀ := by
        simp only [ξ]
        abel
      have h1 := h_le ξ w hw_cb
      have h2 := h_touch ξ hξ_mem
      rw [hw_sub] at h1
      rw [hw₀_eq, hξ_sub] at h2
      linarith

  
  have h_quad_ineq : ∀ (x y z ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : E) (lam : ℝ),
      8 * (α + β + γ + K) ≤ lam →
      threePointQuadForm e_hat α β γ K x y z -
        (lam / 2) * (‖x - ξ₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖y - ξ₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - ξ₃‖ ^ 2) ≤
        threePointQuadForm e_hat (α / 2) (2 * β) (2 * γ) (2 * K) ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ := by
    intro x y z ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ lam hlam
    have h_para_add : ∀ u v : E, ‖u + v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro u v
      have h1 := norm_add_sq_real u v
      have h2 := norm_sub_sq_real u v
      have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
    have h_para_sub : ∀ u v : E, ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro u v
      have h1 := norm_add_sq_real u v
      have h2 := norm_sub_sq_real u v
      have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖u + v‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
    let δ₁ : E := x - ξ₁
    let δ₂ : E := y - ξ₂
    let δ₃ : E := z - ξ₃
    have hx_eq : x = ξ₁ + δ₁ := (add_sub_cancel ξ₁ x).symm
    have hy_eq : y = ξ₂ + δ₂ := (add_sub_cancel ξ₂ y).symm
    have hz_eq : z = ξ₃ + δ₃ := (add_sub_cancel ξ₃ z).symm
    have hxy_eq : x - y = (ξ₁ - ξ₂) + (δ₁ - δ₂) := by
      simp only [δ₁, δ₂]; abel
    let a := inner ℝ e_hat (ξ₁ - ξ₂)
    let b := inner ℝ e_hat (δ₁ - δ₂)
    have hab_eq : inner ℝ e_hat (x - y) = a + b := by rw [hxy_eq, inner_add_right]
    have hb_sq : b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_cs : |b| ≤ ‖e_hat‖ * ‖δ₁ - δ₂‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm e_hat (δ₁ - δ₂)
      rw [he_hat, one_mul] at h_cs
      have h_sq : b ^ 2 ≤ ‖δ₁ - δ₂‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs b]
        exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_abs, abs_norm])
      exact le_trans h_sq (h_para_sub δ₁ δ₂)
    have h_alg1 : -(a + b) ^ 2 ≤ -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
      have : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (a + 2 * b) ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
    have h_term1 : -α * (inner ℝ e_hat (x - y)) ^ 2 ≤
        -(α / 2) * (inner ℝ e_hat (ξ₁ - ξ₂)) ^ 2 + 2 * α * (‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [hab_eq]; nlinarith
    let P_perp : E → E := fun v => v - (inner ℝ e_hat v) • e_hat
    have hP_add : P_perp (x - y) = P_perp (ξ₁ - ξ₂) + P_perp (δ₁ - δ₂) := by
      simp only [P_perp, hxy_eq, inner_add_right, add_smul]; abel
    have hP_norm_le : ∀ v : E, ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro v
      dsimp only [P_perp]
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, he_hat, mul_one,
        sq_abs, real_inner_comm e_hat v]
      have : 0 ≤ (inner ℝ e_hat v) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
    have h_term2_step : ‖P_perp (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        2 * ‖P_perp (ξ₁ - ξ₂)‖ ^ 2 + 4 * (‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2) := by
      have h1 : ‖P_perp (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
          2 * ‖P_perp (ξ₁ - ξ₂)‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖P_perp (δ₁ - δ₂)‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hP_add]; exact h_para_add (P_perp (ξ₁ - ξ₂)) (P_perp (δ₁ - δ₂))
      have h2 := hP_norm_le (δ₁ - δ₂)
      have h3 := h_para_sub δ₁ δ₂
      linarith
    have h_term2 : β * ‖(x - y) - (inner ℝ e_hat (x - y)) • e_hat‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * β) * ‖(ξ₁ - ξ₂) - (inner ℝ e_hat (ξ₁ - ξ₂)) • e_hat‖ ^ 2 +
          4 * β * (‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2) := by
      dsimp only [P_perp] at h_term2_step; nlinarith
    let m_ξ : E := ξ₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (ξ₁ + ξ₂)
    let m_δ : E := δ₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (δ₁ + δ₂)
    have hm_eq : z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y) = m_ξ + m_δ := by
      simp only [m_ξ, m_δ, δ₁, δ₂, δ₃, smul_add, smul_sub]; abel
    have hm_δ_le : ‖m_δ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖δ₃‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := h_para_sub δ₃ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (δ₁ + δ₂))
      have h2 : ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (δ₁ + δ₂)‖ ^ 2 = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖δ₁ + δ₂‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]; ring
      have h3 := h_para_add δ₁ δ₂
      linarith
    have h_term3 : γ * ‖z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * γ) * ‖ξ₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (ξ₁ + ξ₂)‖ ^ 2 +
          2 * γ * (2 * ‖δ₃‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2) := by
      have h1 : ‖z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖m_ξ‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖m_δ‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hm_eq]; exact h_para_add m_ξ m_δ
      nlinarith
    have hx_sq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖ξ₁‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hx_eq]; exact h_para_add ξ₁ δ₁
    have hy_sq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖ξ₂‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hy_eq]; exact h_para_add ξ₂ δ₂
    have hz_sq : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖ξ₃‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖δ₃‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hz_eq]; exact h_para_add ξ₃ δ₃
    have h_term4 : K * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ≤
        (2 * K) * (‖ξ₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖ξ₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖ξ₃‖ ^ 2) +
          2 * K * (‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖δ₃‖ ^ 2) := by nlinarith
    have hδ₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖δ₁‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have hδ₂_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖δ₂‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have hδ₃_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖δ₃‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    unfold threePointQuadForm
    dsimp only [δ₁, δ₂, δ₃] at h_term1 h_term2 h_term3 h_term4 hδ₁_nonneg hδ₂_nonneg hδ₃_nonneg
    nlinarith

  
  let u₁ : E → ℝ := fun x => U (x_hat + x) - U x_hat - inner ℝ p₁ x
  let u₂ : E → ℝ := fun y => U (y_hat + y) - U y_hat - inner ℝ p₂ y
  let u₃ : E → ℝ := fun z => -2 * (U (z_hat + z) - U z_hat - inner ℝ p₀ z)
  let M : ℝ := 2 * L + ‖p₁‖ + ‖p₂‖ + 2 * ‖p₀‖
  have hM_pos : 0 < M := by
    have : 0 ≤ ‖p₁‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have : 0 ≤ ‖p₂‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have : 0 ≤ ‖p₀‖ := norm_nonneg _
    linarith
  let lam : ℝ := 8 * (α + β + γ + K) + 8 * M / ρ
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by positivity
  have hlam_ge1 : 8 * (α + β + γ + K) ≤ lam := by
    dsimp only [lam]
    have : 0 ≤ 8 * M / ρ := by positivity
    linarith
  have hlam_ge2 : 8 * M ≤ lam * ρ := by
    have h_eq : (8 * M / ρ) * ρ = 8 * M := div_mul_cancel₀ (8 * M) (ne_of_gt hρ_pos)
    have : 0 ≤ 8 * (α + β + γ + K) * ρ := by positivity
    dsimp only [lam]
    linarith
  let u_hat₁ : E → ℝ := localSupConv ρ lam u₁
  let u_hat₂ : E → ℝ := localSupConv ρ lam u₂
  let u_hat₃ : E → ℝ := localSupConv ρ lam u₃
  have h_ball_in : ∀ (v_hat : E), v_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (3 / 4) →
      ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ, v_hat + w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1 := by
    intro v_hat hv_hat w hw
    have hv : ‖v_hat‖ < 3 / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hv_hat
    have hw' : ‖w‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hw
    have h_tri := norm_add_le v_hat w
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    linarith
  have h_shift_cont_lip : ∀ (v_hat p : E), v_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (3 / 4) →
      ContinuousOn (fun w => U (v_hat + w) - U v_hat - inner ℝ p w) (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ) ∧
      (∀ w₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ, ∀ w₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
        |(U (v_hat + w₁) - U v_hat - inner ℝ p w₁) -
          (U (v_hat + w₂) - U v_hat - inner ℝ p w₂)| ≤ (L + ‖p‖) * ‖w₁ - w₂‖) := by
    intro v_hat p hv_hat
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hU_comp : ContinuousOn (fun w => U (v_hat + w)) (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ) :=
        hU_har.1.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id).continuousOn (fun w hw => h_ball_in v_hat hv_hat w hw)
      exact (hU_comp.sub continuousOn_const).sub (continuous_const.inner continuous_id).continuousOn
    · intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
      have h1 := hU_lip (v_hat + w₁) (h_ball_in v_hat hv_hat w₁ hw₁) (v_hat + w₂) (h_ball_in v_hat hv_hat w₂ hw₂)
      have h_sub_eq : (v_hat + w₁) - (v_hat + w₂) = w₁ - w₂ := add_sub_add_left_eq_sub w₁ w₂ v_hat
      rw [h_sub_eq] at h1
      have h_alg : (U (v_hat + w₁) - U v_hat - inner ℝ p w₁) -
          (U (v_hat + w₂) - U v_hat - inner ℝ p w₂) =
          (U (v_hat + w₁) - U (v_hat + w₂)) - inner ℝ p (w₁ - w₂) := by
        rw [inner_sub_right]; ring
      rw [h_alg]
      have h_tri := abs_sub (U (v_hat + w₁) - U (v_hat + w₂)) (inner ℝ p (w₁ - w₂))
      have h_cs := abs_real_inner_le_norm p (w₁ - w₂)
      linarith
  have hu₁_cont : ContinuousOn u₁ (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ) := (h_shift_cont_lip x_hat p₁ hx_hat).1
  have hu₂_cont : ContinuousOn u₂ (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ) := (h_shift_cont_lip y_hat p₂ hy_hat).1
  have hu₃_cont : ContinuousOn u₃ (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ) :=
    continuousOn_const.mul (h_shift_cont_lip z_hat p₀ hz_hat).1
  have hu₁_lip : ∀ w₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ, ∀ w₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
      |u₁ w₁ - u₁ w₂| ≤ M * ‖w₁ - w₂‖ := by
    intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
    have h1 := (h_shift_cont_lip x_hat p₁ hx_hat).2 w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
    have hM_ge : L + ‖p₁‖ ≤ M := by
      dsimp only [M]
      have : 0 ≤ ‖p₂‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have : 0 ≤ ‖p₀‖ := norm_nonneg _
      linarith
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM_ge (norm_nonneg _))
  have hu₂_lip : ∀ w₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ, ∀ w₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
      |u₂ w₁ - u₂ w₂| ≤ M * ‖w₁ - w₂‖ := by
    intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
    have h1 := (h_shift_cont_lip y_hat p₂ hy_hat).2 w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
    have hM_ge : L + ‖p₂‖ ≤ M := by
      dsimp only [M]
      have : 0 ≤ ‖p₁‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have : 0 ≤ ‖p₀‖ := norm_nonneg _
      linarith
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM_ge (norm_nonneg _))
  have hu₃_lip : ∀ w₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ, ∀ w₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
      |u₃ w₁ - u₃ w₂| ≤ M * ‖w₁ - w₂‖ := by
    intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
    have h1 := (h_shift_cont_lip z_hat p₀ hz_hat).2 w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
    have h_eq : u₃ w₁ - u₃ w₂ = -2 * ((U (z_hat + w₁) - U z_hat - inner ℝ p₀ w₁) -
        (U (z_hat + w₂) - U z_hat - inner ℝ p₀ w₂)) := by
      dsimp only [u₃]; ring
    rw [h_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_neg (by norm_num : (-2 : ℝ) < 0), neg_neg]
    have hM_ge : 2 * (L + ‖p₀‖) ≤ M := by
      dsimp only [M]
      have : 0 ≤ ‖p₁‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have : 0 ≤ ‖p₂‖ := norm_nonneg _
      linarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (w₁ - w₂)]
  obtain ⟨h_le₁, h_attain₁, h_conv₁⟩ := h_sup_spec lam hlam_pos u₁ hu₁_cont
  obtain ⟨h_le₂, h_attain₂, h_conv₂⟩ := h_sup_spec lam hlam_pos u₂ hu₂_cont
  obtain ⟨h_le₃, h_attain₃, h_conv₃⟩ := h_sup_spec lam hlam_pos u₃ hu₃_cont
  have h_sum_le : ∀ ξ₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (ρ / 2),
      ∀ ξ₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (ρ / 2),
        ∀ ξ₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (ρ / 2),
          u_hat₁ ξ₁ + u_hat₂ ξ₂ + u_hat₃ ξ₃ ≤
            threePointQuadForm e_hat (α / 2) (2 * β) (2 * γ) (2 * K) ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ := by
    intro ξ₁ _hξ₁ ξ₂ _hξ₂ ξ₃ _hξ₃
    obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁, hw₁_eq⟩ := h_attain₁ ξ₁
    obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂, hw₂_eq⟩ := h_attain₂ ξ₂
    obtain ⟨w₃, hw₃, hw₃_eq⟩ := h_attain₃ ξ₃
    have h_up := h_upper w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂ w₃ hw₃
    have h_qi := h_quad_ineq w₁ w₂ w₃ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ lam hlam_ge1
    dsimp only [u_hat₁, u_hat₂, u_hat₃]
    rw [hw₁_eq, hw₂_eq, hw₃_eq]
    dsimp only [u₁, u₂, u₃]
    linarith
  have h0_mem_ρ : (0 : E) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self]; linarith
  have h0_mem_half : (0 : E) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (ρ / 2) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self]; linarith
  have hu₁0_ge : 0 ≤ u_hat₁ 0 := by
    have h := h_le₁ 0 0 h0_mem_ρ
    dsimp only [u₁, u_hat₁] at h ⊢
    simp only [add_zero, sub_self, inner_zero_right, norm_zero, sq, mul_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hu₂0_ge : 0 ≤ u_hat₂ 0 := by
    have h := h_le₂ 0 0 h0_mem_ρ
    dsimp only [u₂, u_hat₂] at h ⊢
    simp only [add_zero, sub_self, inner_zero_right, norm_zero, sq, mul_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hu₃0_ge : 0 ≤ u_hat₃ 0 := by
    have h := h_le₃ 0 0 h0_mem_ρ
    dsimp only [u₃, u_hat₃] at h ⊢
    simp only [add_zero, sub_self, inner_zero_right, norm_zero, sq, mul_zero] at h
    exact h
  have h_sum0 : u_hat₁ 0 + u_hat₂ 0 + u_hat₃ 0 ≤ 0 := by
    have h := h_sum_le 0 h0_mem_half 0 h0_mem_half 0 h0_mem_half
    have hq0 : threePointQuadForm e_hat (α / 2) (2 * β) (2 * γ) (2 * K) 0 0 0 = 0 := by
      unfold threePointQuadForm
      simp
    linarith
  have hu₁0 : u_hat₁ 0 = 0 := by linarith
  have hu₂0 : u_hat₂ 0 = 0 := by linarith
  have hu₃0 : u_hat₃ 0 = 0 := by linarith
  have h_sub_pos : ∀ (v_hat p : E) (u u_hat : E → ℝ),
      v_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (3 / 4) →
      (∀ w : E, u w = U (v_hat + w) - U v_hat - inner ℝ p w) →
      (∀ w₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ, ∀ w₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
        |u w₁ - u w₂| ≤ M * ‖w₁ - w₂‖) →
      (∀ ξ : E, ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
        u w - (lam / 2) * ‖w - ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ u_hat ξ) →
      (∀ ξ : E, ∃ w₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ,
        u_hat ξ = u w₀ - (lam / 2) * ‖w₀ - ξ‖ ^ 2) →
      HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat p (ρ / 2) := by
    intro v_hat p u u_hat hv_hat hu_def hu_lip h_le h_attain ξ₀ hξ₀ q X hX_symm ⟨δ_test, hδ_pos, h_touch⟩
    obtain ⟨w₀, r₁, hr₁_pos, hw_ball, hw_touch⟩ :=
      h_transfer M lam δ_test hlam_pos hδ_pos hlam_ge2 u u_hat ξ₀ q X hu_lip h_le h_attain hξ₀ h_touch
    let Z₀ : E := v_hat + w₀
    let V : Set E := Metric.ball Z₀ r₁
    let ϕ : E → ℝ := quadTestFunc (U Z₀) (p + q) Z₀ X
    have hV_sub_w : ∀ Y ∈ V, Y - v_hat ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r₁ := by
      intro Y hY
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hY ⊢
      have h_eq : (Y - v_hat) - w₀ = Y - Z₀ := by
        dsimp only [Z₀]; abel
      rwa [h_eq]
    have hV_sub : V ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1 := by
      intro Y hY
      have hw_in : Y - v_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) ρ := hw_ball (Y - v_hat) (hV_sub_w Y hY)
      have hw_cb : Y - v_hat ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw_in
      have hY_eq : v_hat + (Y - v_hat) = Y := add_sub_cancel v_hat Y
      rw [← hY_eq]
      exact h_ball_in v_hat hv_hat (Y - v_hat) hw_cb
    have hZ₀_in_V : Z₀ ∈ V := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁_pos
    have hZ₀_in : Z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1 := hV_sub hZ₀_in_V
    obtain ⟨hϕ_cd, hϕ_lap⟩ := h_quad (U Z₀) (p + q) Z₀ X hX_symm
    have hϕ_Z₀ : ϕ Z₀ = U Z₀ := by
      dsimp only [ϕ, quadTestFunc]
      simp
    have hϕ_ge : ∀ Y ∈ V, U Y ≤ ϕ Y := by
      intro Y hY
      let w : E := Y - v_hat
      have hw_in : w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r₁ := hV_sub_w Y hY
      have ht := hw_touch w hw_in
      rw [hu_def w, hu_def w₀] at ht
      have hY_eq : v_hat + w = Y := add_sub_cancel v_hat Y
      have hw_sub : w - w₀ = Y - Z₀ := by dsimp only [w, Z₀]; abel
      rw [hY_eq, hw_sub] at ht
      have h_inner : inner ℝ (p + q) (Y - Z₀) =
          inner ℝ p w - inner ℝ p w₀ + inner ℝ q (Y - Z₀) := by
        rw [inner_add_left, ← hw_sub, inner_sub_right]
      dsimp only [ϕ, quadTestFunc, Z₀]
      linarith
    have h_visc := hU_har.2.1 Z₀ hZ₀_in ϕ V Metric.isOpen_ball hZ₀_in_V hV_sub
      hϕ_cd.contDiffOn hϕ_Z₀ hϕ_ge
    rwa [hϕ_lap] at h_visc
  have hsub₁ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₁ p₁ (ρ / 2) :=
    h_sub_pos x_hat p₁ u₁ u_hat₁ hx_hat (fun _ => rfl) hu₁_lip h_le₁ h_attain₁
  have hsub₂ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₂ p₂ (ρ / 2) :=
    h_sub_pos y_hat p₂ u₂ u_hat₂ hy_hat (fun _ => rfl) hu₂_lip h_le₂ h_attain₂
  have hsub₃ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₃ (-(2 : ℝ) • p₀) (ρ / 2) := by
    intro ξ₀ hξ₀ q X hX_symm ⟨δ_test, hδ_pos, h_touch⟩
    obtain ⟨w₀, r₁, hr₁_pos, hw_ball, hw_touch⟩ :=
      h_transfer M lam δ_test hlam_pos hδ_pos hlam_ge2 u₃ u_hat₃ ξ₀ q X hu₃_lip h_le₃ h_attain₃ hξ₀ h_touch
    let Z₀ : E := z_hat + w₀
    let V : Set E := Metric.ball Z₀ r₁
    let b₃ : E := p₀ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • q
    let X₃ : E →L[ℝ] E := -(1 / 2 : ℝ) • X
    let ψ : E → ℝ := quadTestFunc (U Z₀) b₃ Z₀ X₃
    have hV_sub_w : ∀ Y ∈ V, Y - z_hat ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r₁ := by
      intro Y hY
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hY ⊢
      have h_eq : (Y - z_hat) - w₀ = Y - Z₀ := by
        dsimp only [Z₀]; abel
      rwa [h_eq]
    have hV_sub : V ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1 := by
      intro Y hY
      have hw_in : Y - z_hat ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) ρ := hw_ball (Y - z_hat) (hV_sub_w Y hY)
      have hw_cb : Y - z_hat ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ρ := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw_in
      have hY_eq : z_hat + (Y - z_hat) = Y := add_sub_cancel z_hat Y
      rw [← hY_eq]
      exact h_ball_in z_hat hz_hat (Y - z_hat) hw_cb
    have hZ₀_in_V : Z₀ ∈ V := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁_pos
    have hZ₀_in : Z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1 := hV_sub hZ₀_in_V
    have hX₃_symm : ∀ v w : E, inner ℝ (X₃ v) w = inner ℝ v (X₃ w) := by
      intro v w
      dsimp only [X₃]
      simp only [smul_apply, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, RCLike.conj_to_real, hX_symm v w]
    obtain ⟨hψ_cd, hψ_lap⟩ := h_quad (U Z₀) b₃ Z₀ X₃ hX₃_symm
    have hψ_Z₀ : ψ Z₀ = U Z₀ := by
      dsimp only [ψ, quadTestFunc]
      simp
    have hψ_le : ∀ Y ∈ V, ψ Y ≤ U Y := by
      intro Y hY
      let w : E := Y - z_hat
      have hw_in : w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r₁ := hV_sub_w Y hY
      have ht := hw_touch w hw_in
      dsimp only [u₃] at ht
      have hY_eq : z_hat + w = Y := add_sub_cancel z_hat Y
      have hw_sub : w - w₀ = Y - Z₀ := by dsimp only [w, Z₀]; abel
      rw [hY_eq, hw_sub] at ht
      have h_b₃ : inner ℝ b₃ (Y - Z₀) = inner ℝ p₀ w - inner ℝ p₀ w₀ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ q (Y - Z₀) := by
        dsimp only [b₃]
        rw [inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real, ← hw_sub, inner_sub_right]
      have h_X₃ : inner ℝ (X₃ (Y - Z₀)) (Y - Z₀) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (Y - Z₀)) (Y - Z₀) := by
        dsimp only [X₃]
        simp only [smul_apply, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real]
      dsimp only [ψ, quadTestFunc, Z₀]
      rw [h_b₃, h_X₃]
      linarith
    have h_visc := hU_har.2.2 Z₀ hZ₀_in ψ V Metric.isOpen_ball hZ₀_in_V hV_sub
      hψ_cd.contDiffOn hψ_Z₀ hψ_le
    rw [hψ_lap] at h_visc
    have hb₃_eq : b₃ = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (-(2 : ℝ) • p₀ + q) := by
      dsimp only [b₃]
      rw [smul_add, smul_smul]
      ext i
      simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have h_quad_eq : inner ℝ (X₃ b₃) b₃ =
        -(1 / 8 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (-(2 : ℝ) • p₀ + q)) (-(2 : ℝ) • p₀ + q) := by
      rw [hb₃_eq]
      dsimp only [X₃]
      simp only [map_neg, map_smul, smul_apply, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, RCLike.conj_to_real]
      ring
    linarith
  exact ⟨lam, u_hat₁, u_hat₂, u_hat₃, hlam_pos, hu₁0, hu₂0, hu₃0,
    h_conv₁, h_conv₂, h_conv₃, hsub₁, hsub₂, hsub₃, h_sum_le⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (lam r α' β' γ' K' : ℝ)
    (e_hat p₁ p₂ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (u_hat₁ u_hat₂ u_hat₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hα' : 0 < α') (hβ' : 0 < β') (hγ' : 0 < γ') (hK' : 0 < K')
    (hu₁0 : u_hat₁ 0 = 0) (hu₂0 : u_hat₂ 0 = 0) (hu₃0 : u_hat₃ 0 = 0)
    (hconv₁ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₁ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hconv₂ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₂ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hconv₃ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₃ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hsub₁ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₁ p₁ r)
    (hsub₂ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₂ p₂ r)
    (hsub₃ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₃ (-(2 : ℝ) • p₀) r)
    (hsum : ∀ ξ₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
      ∀ ξ₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
        ∀ ξ₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,

    0 ≤ threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K' p₁ p₂ p₀

signature.name: semiconvex_sum_quadForm_nonneg
signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (lam r α' β' γ' K' : ℝ)
    (e_hat p₁ p₂ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (u_hat₁ u_hat₂ u_hat₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hα' : 0 < α') (hβ' : 0 < β') (hγ' : 0 < γ') (hK' : 0 < K')
    (hu₁0 : u_hat₁ 0 = 0) (hu₂0 : u_hat₂ 0 = 0) (hu₃0 : u_hat₃ 0 = 0)
    (hconv₁ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₁ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hconv₂ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₂ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hconv₃ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₃ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hsub₁ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₁ p₁ r)
    (hsub₂ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₂ p₂ r)
    (hsub₃ : HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest u_hat₃ (-(2 : ℝ) • p₀) r)
    (hsum : ∀ ξ₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
      ∀ ξ₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
        ∀ ξ₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
