    0 ≤ threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K' p₁ p₂ p₀

proof.tactics:
by
  by_contra h_neg
  push_neg at h_neg
  let Q₀ : ℝ := threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K' p₁ p₂ p₀
  let ε : ℝ := -Q₀
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by
    dsimp [ε, Q₀]
    linarith
  let S_p : ℝ := ‖p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖p₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2
  have hSp_nonneg : 0 ≤ S_p := by positivity
  let η : ℝ := ε / (2 * (S_p + 1))
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := by positivity
  have hK_η_pos : 0 < K' + η := by positivity
  have hQ_η_p : threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) p₁ p₂ p₀ ≤ -ε / 2 := by
    have h_eq : threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) p₁ p₂ p₀ = Q₀ + η * S_p := by
      dsimp only [threePointQuadForm, Q₀, S_p]
      ring
    have h_eta_le : η * S_p ≤ η * (S_p + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt hη_pos)
    have h_eta_eq : η * (S_p + 1) = ε / 2 := by
      dsimp [η]
      have h_pos : 0 < S_p + 1 := by positivity
      field_simp
    have h_Q₀ : Q₀ = -ε := by ring
    linarith
  obtain ⟨J₁, N₁, hJ₁_prox, hN₁_vol, hN₁_diff⟩ :=
    convex_proximal_map_and_ae_differentiable d (fun ξ => u_hat₁ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) hconv₁
  obtain ⟨J₂, N₂, hJ₂_prox, hN₂_vol, hN₂_diff⟩ :=
    convex_proximal_map_and_ae_differentiable d (fun ξ => u_hat₂ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) hconv₂
  obtain ⟨J₃, N₃, hJ₃_prox, hN₃_vol, hN₃_diff⟩ :=
    convex_proximal_map_and_ae_differentiable d (fun ξ => u_hat₃ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) hconv₃
  let C_Q : ℝ := 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 + 2 * β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * γ' + (K' + η)
  obtain ⟨hC_Q_pos, hQ_taylor, hQ_quad, hQ_lip⟩ :=
    threePointQuadForm_taylor_and_grad_bounds d e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) hα' hβ' hγ' hK_η_pos
  change 0 < C_Q at hC_Q_pos
  change ∀ h₁ h₂ h₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    |threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) h₁ h₂ h₃| ≤
      C_Q * (‖h₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₃‖ ^ 2) at hQ_quad
  change ∀ x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    ‖threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃ -
      threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
      2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) ∧
    ‖threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃ -
      threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
      2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) ∧
    ‖threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃ -
      threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
      2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) at hQ_lip
  let C_q : ℝ := 6 * C_Q + η / 4
  have hC_q_pos : 0 < C_q := by positivity
  let g₁_p := threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) p₁ p₂ p₀
  let g₂_p := threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) p₁ p₂ p₀
  let g₃_p := threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) p₁ p₂ p₀
  let G_p : ℝ := ‖g₁_p‖ + ‖g₂_p‖ + ‖g₃_p‖ + 3 * C_Q + 1
  have hG_p_pos : 0 < G_p := by positivity
  let δ : ℝ := min (r / 2) (min (1 / C_q) (ε / (4 * G_p * C_q)))
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by positivity
  have hδ_le_r2 : δ ≤ r / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_lt_r : δ < r := by linarith
  have hδ_le_inv : δ ≤ 1 / C_q := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ_le_eps : δ ≤ ε / (4 * G_p * C_q) := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hCq_δ_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_q * δ := by positivity
  have hCq_δ_le_one : C_q * δ ≤ 1 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_le_inv (le_of_lt hC_q_pos)
    rwa [mul_one_div_cancel (ne_of_gt hC_q_pos)] at this
  have hGp_Cq_δ_le : G_p * (C_q * δ) ≤ ε / 4 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_le_eps (by positivity : 0 ≤ G_p * C_q)
    have h_eq : G_p * C_q * (ε / (4 * G_p * C_q)) = ε / 4 := by
      have h_ne1 : G_p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hG_p_pos
      have h_ne2 : C_q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hC_q_pos
      field_simp
    linarith
  obtain ⟨ξ_bar₁, ξ_bar₂, ξ_bar₃, v₁, v₂, v₃,
    hξ₁_ball, hξ₂_ball, hξ₃_ball, hv₁_cb, hv₂_cb, hv₃_cb,
    hξ₁_not_N, hξ₂_not_N, hξ₃_not_N, h_max⟩ :=
    jensen_perturbed_maximizer_on_full_measure d lam r α' β' γ' K' η δ C_Q
      e_hat u_hat₁ u_hat₂ u_hat₃ N₁ N₂ N₃
      hlam hr hη_pos hδ_pos hδ_lt_r hC_Q_pos hu₁0 hu₂0 hu₃0
      hconv₁ hconv₂ hconv₃ hsum hQ_taylor hQ_quad hQ_lip hN₁_vol hN₂_vol hN₃_vol
  have hξ₁_norm : ‖ξ_bar₁‖ < δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hξ₁_ball
  have hξ₂_norm : ‖ξ_bar₂‖ < δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hξ₂_ball
  have hξ₃_norm : ‖ξ_bar₃‖ < δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hξ₃_ball
  have hv₁_norm : ‖v₁‖ ≤ η * δ / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hv₁_cb
  have hv₂_norm : ‖v₂‖ ≤ η * δ / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hv₂_cb
  have hv₃_norm : ‖v₃‖ ≤ η * δ / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hv₃_cb
  let q₁ := threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃ - v₁
  let q₂ := threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃ - v₂
  let q₃ := threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃ - v₃
  have hg₁_zero : threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) 0 0 0 = 0 := by
    simp [threePointQuadGrad₁]
  have hg₂_zero : threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) 0 0 0 = 0 := by
    simp [threePointQuadGrad₂]
  have hg₃_zero : threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 0 0 = 0 := by
    simp [threePointQuadGrad₃]
  have h_lip_bar := hQ_lip ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃ 0 0 0
  rw [hg₁_zero, hg₂_zero, hg₃_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h_lip_bar
  have h2CQ_ξ_le : 2 * C_Q * (‖ξ_bar₁‖ + ‖ξ_bar₂‖ + ‖ξ_bar₃‖) ≤ 6 * C_Q * δ := by
    have h_sum_le : ‖ξ_bar₁‖ + ‖ξ_bar₂‖ + ‖ξ_bar₃‖ ≤ 3 * δ := by linarith
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_le (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * C_Q)
    linarith
  have hq₁_norm : ‖q₁‖ ≤ C_q * δ := by
    have h_tri : ‖q₁‖ ≤ ‖threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃‖ + ‖v₁‖ :=
      norm_sub_le _ _
    have h_g := h_lip_bar.1
    have h_eq : (6 * C_Q + η / 4) * δ = 6 * C_Q * δ + η * δ / 4 := by ring
    change ‖q₁‖ ≤ (6 * C_Q + η / 4) * δ
    linarith
  have hq₂_norm : ‖q₂‖ ≤ C_q * δ := by
    have h_tri : ‖q₂‖ ≤ ‖threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃‖ + ‖v₂‖ :=
      norm_sub_le _ _
    have h_g := h_lip_bar.2.1
    have h_eq : (6 * C_Q + η / 4) * δ = 6 * C_Q * δ + η * δ / 4 := by ring
    change ‖q₂‖ ≤ (6 * C_Q + η / 4) * δ
    linarith
  have hq₃_norm : ‖q₃‖ ≤ C_q * δ := by
    have h_tri : ‖q₃‖ ≤ ‖threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃‖ + ‖v₃‖ :=
      norm_sub_le _ _
    have h_g := h_lip_bar.2.2
    have h_eq : (6 * C_Q + η / 4) * δ = 6 * C_Q * δ + η * δ / 4 := by ring
    change ‖q₃‖ ≤ (6 * C_Q + η / 4) * δ
    linarith
  have h_star : ∀ h₁ h₂ h₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ξ_bar₁ + h₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ →
      ξ_bar₂ + h₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ →
      ξ_bar₃ + h₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ →
      (u_hat₁ (ξ_bar₁ + h₁) - u_hat₁ ξ_bar₁ - inner ℝ q₁ h₁) +
        (u_hat₂ (ξ_bar₂ + h₂) - u_hat₂ ξ_bar₂ - inner ℝ q₂ h₂) +
        (u_hat₃ (ξ_bar₃ + h₃) - u_hat₃ ξ_bar₃ - inner ℝ q₃ h₃) ≤
          threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) h₁ h₂ h₃ := by
    intro h₁ h₂ h₃ hh₁ hh₂ hh₃
    have hm := h_max (ξ_bar₁ + h₁) hh₁ (ξ_bar₂ + h₂) hh₂ (ξ_bar₃ + h₃) hh₃
    have ht := hQ_taylor ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃ h₁ h₂ h₃
    have hi₁ : inner ℝ q₁ h₁ =
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃) h₁ - inner ℝ v₁ h₁ :=
      inner_sub_left _ _ _
    have hi₂ : inner ℝ q₂ h₂ =
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃) h₂ - inner ℝ v₂ h₂ :=
      inner_sub_left _ _ _
    have hi₃ : inner ℝ q₃ h₃ =
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃) h₃ - inner ℝ v₃ h₃ :=
      inner_sub_left _ _ _
    have hv₁_add : inner ℝ v₁ (ξ_bar₁ + h₁) = inner ℝ v₁ ξ_bar₁ + inner ℝ v₁ h₁ :=
      inner_add_right _ _ _
    have hv₂_add : inner ℝ v₂ (ξ_bar₂ + h₂) = inner ℝ v₂ ξ_bar₂ + inner ℝ v₂ h₂ :=
      inner_add_right _ _ _
    have hv₃_add : inner ℝ v₃ (ξ_bar₃ + h₃) = inner ℝ v₃ ξ_bar₃ + inner ℝ v₃ h₃ :=
      inner_add_right _ _ _
    linarith
  have hξ₁_cb : ξ_bar₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hξ₁_ball
  have hξ₂_cb : ξ_bar₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hξ₂_ball
  have hξ₃_cb : ξ_bar₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hξ₃_ball
  have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ - ‖ξ_bar₁‖ := by linarith
  have hδ₂_pos : 0 < δ - ‖ξ_bar₂‖ := by linarith
  have hδ₃_pos : 0 < δ - ‖ξ_bar₃‖ := by linarith
  have hub₁ : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ_bar₁ (δ - ‖ξ_bar₁‖),
      u_hat₁ ξ ≤ u_hat₁ ξ_bar₁ + inner ℝ q₁ (ξ - ξ_bar₁) + C_Q * ‖ξ - ξ_bar₁‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hξ_dist : ‖ξ - ξ_bar₁‖ < δ - ‖ξ_bar₁‖ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hξ
    have hξ_cb : ξ_bar₁ + (ξ - ξ_bar₁) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ := by
      rw [add_sub_cancel, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have h_tri := norm_add_le ξ_bar₁ (ξ - ξ_bar₁)
      rw [add_sub_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
    have hs := h_star (ξ - ξ_bar₁) 0 0 hξ_cb (by simpa using hξ₂_cb) (by simpa using hξ₃_cb)
    rw [add_sub_cancel, add_zero, add_zero, inner_zero_right, inner_zero_right] at hs
    have hq_bound := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hQ_quad (ξ - ξ_bar₁) 0 0)
    rw [norm_zero] at hq_bound
    linarith
  have hub₂ : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ_bar₂ (δ - ‖ξ_bar₂‖),
      u_hat₂ ξ ≤ u_hat₂ ξ_bar₂ + inner ℝ q₂ (ξ - ξ_bar₂) + C_Q * ‖ξ - ξ_bar₂‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hξ_dist : ‖ξ - ξ_bar₂‖ < δ - ‖ξ_bar₂‖ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hξ
    have hξ_cb : ξ_bar₂ + (ξ - ξ_bar₂) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ := by
      rw [add_sub_cancel, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have h_tri := norm_add_le ξ_bar₂ (ξ - ξ_bar₂)
      rw [add_sub_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
    have hs := h_star 0 (ξ - ξ_bar₂) 0 (by simpa using hξ₁_cb) hξ_cb (by simpa using hξ₃_cb)
    rw [add_zero, add_sub_cancel, add_zero, inner_zero_right, inner_zero_right] at hs
    have hq_bound := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hQ_quad 0 (ξ - ξ_bar₂) 0)
    rw [norm_zero] at hq_bound
    linarith
  have hub₃ : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ_bar₃ (δ - ‖ξ_bar₃‖),
      u_hat₃ ξ ≤ u_hat₃ ξ_bar₃ + inner ℝ q₃ (ξ - ξ_bar₃) + C_Q * ‖ξ - ξ_bar₃‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hξ_dist : ‖ξ - ξ_bar₃‖ < δ - ‖ξ_bar₃‖ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hξ
    have hξ_cb : ξ_bar₃ + (ξ - ξ_bar₃) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ := by
      rw [add_sub_cancel, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have h_tri := norm_add_le ξ_bar₃ (ξ - ξ_bar₃)
      rw [add_sub_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
    have hs := h_star 0 0 (ξ - ξ_bar₃) (by simpa using hξ₁_cb) (by simpa using hξ₂_cb) hξ_cb
    rw [add_zero, add_zero, add_sub_cancel, inner_zero_right, inner_zero_right] at hs
    have hq_bound := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hQ_quad 0 0 (ξ - ξ_bar₃))
    rw [norm_zero] at hq_bound
    linarith
  obtain ⟨X₁, hX₁_symm, hX₁_taylor⟩ :=
    second_order_taylor_of_proximal_differentiable d lam hlam u_hat₁ J₁ hconv₁ hJ₁_prox
      ξ_bar₁ q₁ C_Q (δ - ‖ξ_bar₁‖) hC_Q_pos hδ₁_pos hub₁ (hN₁_diff ξ_bar₁ hξ₁_not_N)
  obtain ⟨X₂, hX₂_symm, hX₂_taylor⟩ :=
    second_order_taylor_of_proximal_differentiable d lam hlam u_hat₂ J₂ hconv₂ hJ₂_prox
      ξ_bar₂ q₂ C_Q (δ - ‖ξ_bar₂‖) hC_Q_pos hδ₂_pos hub₂ (hN₂_diff ξ_bar₂ hξ₂_not_N)
  obtain ⟨X₃, hX₃_symm, hX₃_taylor⟩ :=
    second_order_taylor_of_proximal_differentiable d lam hlam u_hat₃ J₃ hconv₃ hJ₃_prox
      ξ_bar₃ q₃ C_Q (δ - ‖ξ_bar₃‖) hC_Q_pos hδ₃_pos hub₃ (hN₃_diff ξ_bar₃ hξ₃_not_N)
  let w₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := p₁ + q₁
  let w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := p₂ + q₂
  let w₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := p₀ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • q₃
  let S_w : ℝ := ‖w₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖w₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖w₃‖ ^ 2
  let κ : ℝ := ε / (8 * (S_w + 1))
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by positivity
  have hκ_Sw_le : κ * S_w ≤ ε / 8 := by
    have h_le : κ * S_w ≤ κ * (S_w + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt hκ_pos)
    have h_eq : κ * (S_w + 1) = ε / 8 := by
      dsimp [κ]
      have h_pos : 0 < S_w + 1 := by positivity
      field_simp
    linarith

noncomputable def threePointQuadGrad₁ {d : ℕ}
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  let w_perp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (x - y) - (inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e
  let w_perp2 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := w_perp - (inner ℝ e w_perp) • e
  (-2 * α * inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e +
    (2 * β) • w_perp2 -
    γ • (z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) +
    (2 * K) • x

noncomputable def threePointQuadGrad₂ {d : ℕ}
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  let w_perp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (x - y) - (inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e
  let w_perp2 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := w_perp - (inner ℝ e w_perp) • e
  (2 * α * inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e -
    (2 * β) • w_perp2 -
    γ • (z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) +
    (2 * K) • y

noncomputable def threePointQuadGrad₃ {d : ℕ}
    (γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  (2 * γ) • (z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) +
    (2 * K) • z

def IsProximalMapFor {d : ℕ}
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : Prop :=
  LipschitzWith 1 J ∧
  (∀ y w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    inner ℝ (y - J y) (w - J y) ≤ ψ w - ψ (J y)) ∧
  (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), J y = x)

noncomputable def threePointQuadGrad₂ {d : ℕ}
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  let w_perp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (x - y) - (inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e
  let w_perp2 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := w_perp - (inner ℝ e w_perp) • e
  (2 * α * inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e -
    (2 * β) • w_perp2 -
    γ • (z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) +
    (2 * K) • y

noncomputable def threePointQuadGrad₃ {d : ℕ}
    (γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  (2 * γ) • (z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) +
    (2 * K) • z

def IsProximalMapFor {d : ℕ}
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : Prop :=
  LipschitzWith 1 J ∧
  (∀ y w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    inner ℝ (y - J y) (w - J y) ≤ ψ w - ψ (J y)) ∧
  (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), J y = x)

    simp [projSpace]
    rfl
  have h_projTime_sub : ∀ w w' : E, projTime (w' - w) = projTime w' - projTime w := by
    intro w w'
    rfl
  have h_norm_projTime : ∀ w : E, |projTime w| ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    simpa [projTime, Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le w (Fin.last d)
  have h_norm_projSpace : ∀ w : E, ‖projSpace w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖projSpace w i‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖w (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp [projSpace]
    rw [h_eq]
    have h_last : 0 ≤ ‖w (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  have h_norm_mk : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      ‖mkSpaceTime x t‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + |t| := by
    intro x t
    have h_split : mkSpaceTime x t = mkSpaceTime x 0 + mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t := by
      have h1 := h_mk_add x 0 0 t
      rwa [add_zero, zero_add] at h1
    have h_nx : ‖mkSpaceTime x 0‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖x i‖ ^ 2 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      have h_last : ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      linarith
    have h_nt : ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ ≤ |t| := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, ← Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg t)]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      have h_last : ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 = |t| ^ 2 := by
        simp [mkSpaceTime, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith
    calc ‖mkSpaceTime x t‖ = ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 + mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ := by rw [h_split]
      _ ≤ ‖mkSpaceTime x 0‖ + ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ + |t| := add_le_add h_nx h_nt
  have h_bdd : ∀ w : E, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, |f_seq n w| ≤ B := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨U, hU_nonneg, hU⟩ := h_bounds.1 ‖w‖ (norm_nonneg w)
    refine ⟨U, hU_nonneg, fun n => ?_⟩
    exact hU (w_seq (φ₀ n)) (h_seq (φ₀ n)).1 (h_seq (φ₀ n)).2.1 w
      (h_norm_projSpace w) (h_norm_projTime w)
  have h_ball_equi : ∀ M ε : ℝ, 0 < M → 0 < ε →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ w w' : E, ‖w‖ ≤ M → ‖w' - w‖ ≤ δ →
          |f_seq n w' - f_seq n w| ≤ ε := by
    intro M ε hM hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := h_equi M hM ε hε
    refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun n w w' hw hww' => ?_⟩
    have hw_space : ‖projSpace w‖ ≤ M := le_trans (h_norm_projSpace w) hw
    have hw_time : |projTime w| ≤ M := le_trans (h_norm_projTime w) hw
    have h_diff_space : ‖projSpace w' - projSpace w‖ ≤ δ := by
      rw [← h_projSpace_sub]
      exact le_trans (h_norm_projSpace (w' - w)) hww'
    have h_diff_time : |projTime w' - projTime w| ≤ δ := by
      rw [← h_projTime_sub]
      exact le_trans (h_norm_projTime (w' - w)) hww'
    exact hδ (w_seq (φ₀ n)) (h_seq (φ₀ n)).1 (h_seq (φ₀ n)).2.1 w w'
      hw_space hw_time h_diff_space h_diff_time
  obtain ⟨D, hD_count, hD_dense⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_dense E
  haveI : Countable D := hD_count.to_subtype
  haveI : FirstCountableTopology (D → ℝ) :=
    TopologicalSpace.instFirstCountableTopologyForallOfCountable
  choose B hB_nonneg hB_bound using h_bdd
  let S_D : Set (D → ℝ) := { g | ∀ y : D, g y ∈ Set.Icc (-B y.1) (B y.1) }
  have hS_D_compact : IsCompact S_D :=
    isCompact_pi_infinite (fun y : D => isCompact_Icc)
  have hf_mem_SD : ∀ n : ℕ, (fun y : D => f_seq n y.1) ∈ S_D := by
    intro n y
    exact abs_le.mp (hB_bound y.1 n)
  obtain ⟨g₀, _, φ₁, hφ₁_mono, hg₀_tendsto⟩ := hS_D_compact.tendsto_subseq hf_mem_SD
  have hD_tendsto : ∀ y : D, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => f_seq (φ₁ m) y.1) Filter.atTop (nhds (g₀ y)) :=
    tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hg₀_tendsto
  have h_unif_cauchy : ∀ M ε : ℝ, 0 < M → 0 < ε →
      ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ m → N₀ ≤ n →
        ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ M → |f_seq (φ₁ m) w - f_seq (φ₁ n) w| ≤ ε := by
    intro M ε hM hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h_eq⟩ := h_ball_equi M (ε / 3) hM (by linarith)
    have h_dense_ball : ∀ z : E, ∃ y ∈ D, z ∈ Metric.ball y δ := by
      intro z
      obtain ⟨y, hy_ball, hy_D⟩ := Metric.dense_iff.mp hD_dense z δ hδ
      refine ⟨y, hy_D, ?_⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
      exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hy_ball
    choose y hy_D hy_ball using h_dense_ball
    have h_nhds : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) M, Metric.ball (y z) δ ∈ nhds z :=
      fun z _ => Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hy_ball z)
    obtain ⟨t, _, ht_cover⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) M).elim_nhds_subcover (fun z => Metric.ball (y z) δ) h_nhds
    have h_cauchy_y : ∀ z : E, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, N ≤ m → N ≤ n →
        |f_seq (φ₁ m) (y z) - f_seq (φ₁ n) (y z)| ≤ ε / 3 := by
      intro z
      have h_c : CauchySeq (fun m => f_seq (φ₁ m) (y z)) :=
        (hD_tendsto ⟨y z, hy_D z⟩).cauchySeq
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp h_c (ε / 3) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨N, fun m n hm hn => ?_⟩
      rw [← Real.dist_eq]
      exact le_of_lt (hN m hm n hn)
    choose N hN using h_cauchy_y
    let N₀ : ℕ := t.sup N
    refine ⟨N₀, fun m n hm hn w hw => ?_⟩
    have hw_mem : w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) M := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hw
    have hw_cov := ht_cover hw_mem
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hw_cov
    obtain ⟨z, hz_t, hw_ball⟩ := hw_cov
    have hyw_le : ‖y z - w‖ ≤ δ := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev, ← dist_eq_norm]
      exact le_of_lt (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw_ball)
    have hNz_le : N z ≤ t.sup N := Finset.le_sup hz_t
    have hNz_m : N z ≤ m := le_trans hNz_le hm
    have hNz_n : N z ≤ n := le_trans hNz_le hn
    have h_eq_m : |f_seq (φ₁ m) (y z) - f_seq (φ₁ m) w| ≤ ε / 3 :=
      h_eq (φ₁ m) w (y z) hw hyw_le
    have h_eq_n : |f_seq (φ₁ n) (y z) - f_seq (φ₁ n) w| ≤ ε / 3 :=
      h_eq (φ₁ n) w (y z) hw hyw_le
    have h_mid : |f_seq (φ₁ m) (y z) - f_seq (φ₁ n) (y z)| ≤ ε / 3 :=
      hN z m n hNz_m hNz_n
    have h1 := (abs_le.mp h_eq_m).1
    have h2 := (abs_le.mp h_eq_m).2
    have h3 := (abs_le.mp h_eq_n).1
    have h4 := (abs_le.mp h_eq_n).2
    have h5 := (abs_le.mp h_mid).1
    have h6 := (abs_le.mp h_mid).2
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h_pt_cauchy : ∀ w : E, CauchySeq (fun m => f_seq (φ₁ m) w) := by
    intro w
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_unif_cauchy (‖w‖ + 1) (ε / 2) (by positivity) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨N₀, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have h_le := hN₀ m n hm hn w (by linarith)
    linarith
  have h_pt_conv : ∀ w : E, ∃ a : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => f_seq (φ₁ m) w) Filter.atTop (nhds a) :=
    fun w => cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (h_pt_cauchy w)
  choose v_inf hv_tendsto using h_pt_conv
  have hv_unif : ∀ M ε : ℝ, 0 < M → 0 < ε →
      ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, N₀ ≤ m →
        ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ M → |f_seq (φ₁ m) w - v_inf w| ≤ ε := by
    intro M ε hM hε
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_unif_cauchy M ε hM hε
    refine ⟨N₀, fun m hm w hw => ?_⟩
    have h_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => |f_seq (φ₁ m) w - f_seq (φ₁ n) w|)
        Filter.atTop (nhds |f_seq (φ₁ m) w - v_inf w|) :=
      (tendsto_const_nhds.sub (hv_tendsto w)).abs
    refine le_of_tendsto h_tend (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩)
    exact hN₀ m n hm hn w hw
  have h_conv : ConvergesLocUnif d (fun m => w_seq ((φ₀ ∘ φ₁) m)) v_inf := by
    intro R hR ε hε
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := hv_unif (2 * R) ε (by linarith) hε
    refine ⟨N₀, fun m hm z hz_space hz_time => ?_⟩
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ ≤ 2 * R := by
      have h1 := h_norm_mk (projSpace z) (projTime z)
      rw [h_mk_proj z] at h1
      linarith
    exact hN₀ m hm z hz_norm
  have hv_cont : Continuous v_inf := by
    rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
    intro w ε hε
    let M : ℝ := ‖w‖ + 1
    have hM_pos : 0 < M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h_eq⟩ := h_ball_equi M (ε / 2) hM_pos (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun w' hw' => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have hw_le : ‖w‖ ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; linarith
    have hww'_le : ‖w' - w‖ ≤ δ := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact le_of_lt hw'
    have h_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => |f_seq (φ₁ m) w' - f_seq (φ₁ m) w|)
        Filter.atTop (nhds |v_inf w' - v_inf w|) :=
      ((hv_tendsto w').sub (hv_tendsto w)).abs
    have h_le : |v_inf w' - v_inf w| ≤ ε / 2 := by
      refine le_of_tendsto h_tend (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨0, fun m _ => ?_⟩)
      exact h_eq (φ₁ m) w w' hw_le hww'_le
    linarith
  refine ⟨v_inf, b, φ₀ ∘ φ₁, hφ₀_mono.comp hφ₁_mono, hv_cont, h_conv, ?_⟩
  exact hb_φ₀_tendsto.comp hφ₁_mono.tendsto_atTop

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ), 3 ≤ d → ∀ (C₁ : ℝ), 1 ≤ C₁ →
      HasUniformBoxAndFitBounds d C₁ →
      ∀ (f_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
        (v_inf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        (∀ m : ℕ, InLimitingClassA d C₁ (f_seq m) ∧ IsCenteredAt d C₁ (f_seq m) 0 1) →
        ConvergesLocUnif d f_seq v_inf →
        IsCenteredAt d C₁ v_inf 0 1 ∧
        (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ), 0 < R →
          ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
            ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ℓ : ℝ),
              |ℓ| ≤ R → ‖h - ℓ • p‖ ≤ R →
              |v_inf (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v_inf (mkSpaceTime x t) -
                inner ℝ p h - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ| ≤ C₁ * R)

signature.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ), 3 ≤ d → ∀ (C₁ : ℝ), 1 ≤ C₁ →
      HasUniformBoxAndFitBounds d C₁ →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d hd C₁ hC₁ h_bounds f_seq v_inf hf_seq h_conv
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))
  have h_projSpace_mk : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime_mk : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_mk_sub : ∀ (x₁ x₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₁ t₂ : ℝ),
      mkSpaceTime x₁ t₁ - mkSpaceTime x₂ t₂ = mkSpaceTime (x₁ - x₂) (t₁ - t₂) := by
    intro x₁ x₂ t₁ t₂
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime]
    · intro k
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
  have h_norm_mk_zero : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ‖mkSpaceTime x 0‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖x i‖ ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
    have h_last : ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
    linarith
  have hv_tendsto : ∀ z : E, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => f_seq m z) Filter.atTop (nhds (v_inf z)) := by
    intro z
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    let R_z : ℝ := ‖projSpace z‖ + |projTime z| + 1
    have hR_z_pos : 0 < R_z := by dsimp [R_z]; positivity
    have hz_sp : ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ R_z := by
      have : 0 ≤ |projTime z| := abs_nonneg _
      dsimp [R_z]; linarith
    have hz_tm : |projTime z| ≤ R_z := by
      have : 0 ≤ ‖projSpace z‖ := norm_nonneg _
      dsimp [R_z]; linarith
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h_conv R_z hR_z_pos (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have h_le := hN m hm z hz_sp hz_tm
    linarith
  have hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v_inf 0 1 := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_zero_seq : (fun m => f_seq m (mkSpaceTime 0 1)) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        ext m; exact (hf_seq m).2.1
      have h_t0 := hv_tendsto (mkSpaceTime 0 1)
      rw [h_zero_seq] at h_t0
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_t0 tendsto_const_nhds
    · intro h ℓ hℓ hh
      have h_tend : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun m => |f_seq m (mkSpaceTime (0 + h) (1 + ℓ)) - f_seq m (mkSpaceTime 0 1) -
            inner ℝ (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) h - (0 - ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ|)
          Filter.atTop
          (nhds |v_inf (mkSpaceTime (0 + h) (1 + ℓ)) - v_inf (mkSpaceTime 0 1) -
            inner ℝ (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) h - (0 - ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ|) :=
        ((((hv_tendsto (mkSpaceTime (0 + h) (1 + ℓ))).sub (hv_tendsto (mkSpaceTime 0 1))).sub
          tendsto_const_nhds).sub tendsto_const_nhds).abs
      refine le_of_tendsto h_tend (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨0, fun m _ => ?_⟩)
      exact (hf_seq m).2.2 h ℓ hℓ hh
  refine ⟨hv_cent, ?_⟩
  intro x t R hR
  let M : ℝ := ‖x‖ + |t|
  have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
  have hx_M : ‖x‖ ≤ M := by
    have : 0 ≤ |t| := abs_nonneg t
    dsimp [M]; linarith
  have ht_M : |t| ≤ M := by
    have : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
    dsimp [M]; linarith
  obtain ⟨B_fit, hB_fit_nonneg, hB_fit⟩ := h_bounds.2 M R hM_nonneg hR
  have h_fit_m : ∀ m : ℕ,
      ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
        ‖p‖ ≤ B_fit ∧ |a| ≤ B_fit ∧ IsFitAt d C₁ (f_seq m) x t R p a := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨p, a, h_fit⟩ := (hf_seq m).1.2.2.2 x t R hR
    obtain ⟨hp, ha⟩ := hB_fit (f_seq m) (hf_seq m).1 (hf_seq m).2 x t p a hx_M ht_M h_fit
    exact ⟨p, a, hp, ha, h_fit⟩
  choose p_m a_m hp_m ha_m hbox_m using h_fit_m
  let K_slope : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) :=
    Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) B_fit ×ˢ Set.Icc (-B_fit) B_fit
  have hK_slope_compact : IsCompact K_slope :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) B_fit).prod isCompact_Icc
  have h_mem_slope : ∀ m : ℕ, (p_m m, a_m m) ∈ K_slope := by
    intro m
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hp_m m
    · exact abs_le.mp (ha_m m)
  obtain ⟨⟨p, a⟩, _, σ, hσ_mono, hpa_tendsto⟩ := hK_slope_compact.tendsto_subseq h_mem_slope
  have hp_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => p_m (σ k)) Filter.atTop (nhds p) :=
    (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mp hpa_tendsto |>.1
  have ha_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => a_m (σ k)) Filter.atTop (nhds a) :=
    (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mp hpa_tendsto |>.2
  refine ⟨p, a, fun h ℓ hℓ hh => ?_⟩
  let h_k : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun k => ℓ • p_m (σ k) + (h - ℓ • p)
  have hh_k_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h_k Filter.atTop (nhds h) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ℓ • p_m (σ k) + (h - ℓ • p)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (ℓ • p + (h - ℓ • p))) :=
      (tendsto_const_nhds.smul hp_tendsto).add tendsto_const_nhds
    rwa [add_sub_cancel] at h1
  let z_k : ℕ → E := fun k => mkSpaceTime (x + h_k k) (t + ℓ)
  let z_star : E := mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)
  have hz_k_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto z_k Filter.atTop (nhds z_star) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hh_k_tendsto ε hε
    refine ⟨N₁, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have h_sub : z_k k - z_star = mkSpaceTime (h_k k - h) 0 := by
      dsimp [z_k, z_star]
      rw [h_mk_sub]
      have hx_sub : (x + h_k k) - (x + h) = h_k k - h := add_sub_add_left_eq_sub _ _ _
      rw [hx_sub, sub_self]
    have h_nm := h_norm_mk_zero (h_k k - h)
    rw [← h_sub] at h_nm
    have hk_lt : ‖h_k k - h‖ < ε := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact hN₁ k hk
    linarith
  let R_box : ℝ := ‖x‖ + |t| + ‖h‖ + R * B_fit + 2 * R + 1
  have hR_box_pos : 0 < R_box := by
    have : 0 ≤ R * B_fit := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR) hB_fit_nonneg
    dsimp [R_box]; positivity
  have hz_k_sp : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖projSpace (z_k k)‖ ≤ R_box := by
    intro k
    have h_hk_norm : ‖h_k k‖ ≤ R * B_fit + R := by
      dsimp [h_k]
      have h_tri := norm_add_le (ℓ • p_m (σ k)) (h - ℓ • p)
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h_tri
      have h_mul : |ℓ| * ‖p_m (σ k)‖ ≤ R * B_fit :=
        mul_le_mul hℓ (hp_m (σ k)) (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hR)
      linarith
    have h_x_hk : ‖x + h_k k‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + (R * B_fit + R) := by
      have := norm_add_le x (h_k k)
      linarith
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ |t| + ‖h‖ + R + 1 := by positivity
    dsimp [z_k, R_box]
    rw [h_projSpace_mk]
    linarith
  have hz_k_tm : ∀ k : ℕ, |projTime (z_k k)| ≤ R_box := by
    intro k
    have h_t_ℓ : |t + ℓ| ≤ |t| + R := by
      have := abs_add_le t ℓ
      linarith
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖h‖ + R * B_fit + R + 1 := by
      have : 0 ≤ R * B_fit := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR) hB_fit_nonneg
      positivity
    dsimp [z_k, R_box]
    rw [h_projTime_mk]
    linarith
  have hz_star_sp : ‖projSpace z_star‖ ≤ R_box := by
    have h_x_h : ‖x + h‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖h‖ := norm_add_le x h
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ |t| + R * B_fit + 2 * R + 1 := by
      have : 0 ≤ R * B_fit := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR) hB_fit_nonneg
      positivity
    dsimp [z_star, R_box]
    rw [h_projSpace_mk]
    linarith
  have hz_star_tm : |projTime z_star| ≤ R_box := by
    have h_t_ℓ : |t + ℓ| ≤ |t| + R := by
      have := abs_add_le t ℓ
      linarith
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖h‖ + R * B_fit + R + 1 := by
      have : 0 ≤ R * B_fit := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR) hB_fit_nonneg
      positivity
    dsimp [z_star, R_box]
    rw [h_projTime_mk]
    linarith
  have hv₁_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f_seq (σ k) (z_k k))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (v_inf z_star)) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    have hε4 : 0 < ε / 4 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_conv R_box hR_box_pos (ε / 4) hε4
    have h_cont_N₀ : Continuous (f_seq N₀) := (hf_seq N₀).1.1
    obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp
      ((h_cont_N₀.tendsto z_star).comp hz_k_tendsto) (ε / 4) hε4
    refine ⟨max N₀ K₁, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    have hk_N₀ : N₀ ≤ σ k :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left N₀ K₁) hk) (hσ_mono.id_le k)
    have hk_K₁ : K₁ ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_right N₀ K₁) hk
    have h_d1 : |f_seq (σ k) (z_k k) - v_inf (z_k k)| ≤ ε / 4 :=
      hN₀ (σ k) hk_N₀ (z_k k) (hz_k_sp k) (hz_k_tm k)
    have h_d2 : |f_seq N₀ (z_k k) - v_inf (z_k k)| ≤ ε / 4 :=
      hN₀ N₀ le_rfl (z_k k) (hz_k_sp k) (hz_k_tm k)
    have h_d3 : |f_seq N₀ (z_k k) - f_seq N₀ z_star| < ε / 4 := by
      rw [← Real.dist_eq]
      exact hK₁ k hk_K₁
    have h_d4 : |f_seq N₀ z_star - v_inf z_star| ≤ ε / 4 :=
      hN₀ N₀ le_rfl z_star hz_star_sp hz_star_tm
    have h1 := (abs_le.mp h_d1).1
    have h2 := (abs_le.mp h_d1).2
    have h3 := (abs_le.mp h_d2).1
    have h4 := (abs_le.mp h_d2).2
    have h5 := (abs_lt.mp h_d3).1
    have h6 := (abs_lt.mp h_d3).2
    have h7 := (abs_le.mp h_d4).1
    have h8 := (abs_le.mp h_d4).2
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hv₀_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f_seq (σ k) (mkSpaceTime x t))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (v_inf (mkSpaceTime x t))) :=
    (hv_tendsto (mkSpaceTime x t)).comp hσ_mono.tendsto_atTop
  have h_inner_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => inner ℝ (p_m (σ k)) (h_k k))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (inner ℝ p h)) :=
    hp_tendsto.inner hh_k_tendsto
  have h_aℓ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (a_m (σ k) - ‖p_m (σ k)‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ)
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ)) :=
    (ha_tendsto.sub ((hp_tendsto.norm.pow 2).div_const 2)).mul tendsto_const_nhds
  have h_lhs_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun k => |f_seq (σ k) (z_k k) - f_seq (σ k) (mkSpaceTime x t) -
        inner ℝ (p_m (σ k)) (h_k k) - (a_m (σ k) - ‖p_m (σ k)‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ|)
      Filter.atTop
      (nhds |v_inf z_star - v_inf (mkSpaceTime x t) - inner ℝ p h - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ|) :=
    (((hv₁_tendsto.sub hv₀_tendsto).sub h_inner_tendsto).sub h_aℓ_tendsto).abs
  refine le_of_tendsto h_lhs_tendsto (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨0, fun k _ => ?_⟩)
  have h_shear_k : ‖h_k k - ℓ • p_m (σ k)‖ ≤ R := by
    dsimp [h_k]
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact hbox_m (σ k) (h_k k) ℓ hℓ h_shear_k

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ)
      (f_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
      (v_inf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      (∀ m : ℕ, InLimitingClassA d C₁ (f_seq m)) →
      ConvergesLocUnif d f_seq v_inf →
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
        ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z = v_inf z → (∀ y ∈ V, v_inf y ≤ ϕ y) →
          0 ≤ limitingOperator ϕ z) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
        ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z = v_inf z → (∀ y ∈ V, ϕ y ≤ v_inf y) →
          limitingOperator ϕ z ≤ 0)

∀ (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ)
      (f_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d C₁ f_seq v_inf hf_seq h_conv
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))
  have h_mk_add : ∀ (x h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ),
      mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ) = mkSpaceTime x t + mkSpaceTime h ℓ := by
    intro x h t ℓ
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime]
    · intro k
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
  have h_mk_sub : ∀ (x₁ x₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₁ t₂ : ℝ),
      mkSpaceTime x₁ t₁ - mkSpaceTime x₂ t₂ = mkSpaceTime (x₁ - x₂) (t₁ - t₂) := by
    intro x₁ x₂ t₁ t₂
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime]
    · intro k
      simp [mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projSpace_sub : ∀ w w' : E, projSpace (w' - w) = projSpace w' - projSpace w := by
    intro w w'
    ext k
    simp [projSpace]
    rfl
  have h_norm_projTime : ∀ w : E, |projTime w| ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    simpa [projTime, Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le w (Fin.last d)
  have h_norm_projSpace : ∀ w : E, ‖projSpace w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖projSpace w i‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖w (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp [projSpace]
    rw [h_eq]
    have h_last : 0 ≤ ‖w (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  have h_norm_mk : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      ‖mkSpaceTime x t‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + |t| := by
    intro x t
    have h_split : mkSpaceTime x t = mkSpaceTime x 0 + mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t := by
      have h1 := h_mk_add x 0 0 t
      rwa [add_zero, zero_add] at h1
    have h_nx : ‖mkSpaceTime x 0‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖x i‖ ^ 2 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      have h_last : ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      linarith
    have h_nt : ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ ≤ |t| := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, ← Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg t)]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin d, ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
        simp [mkSpaceTime]
      have h_last : ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t (Fin.last d)‖ ^ 2 = |t| ^ 2 := by
        simp [mkSpaceTime, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith
    calc ‖mkSpaceTime x t‖ = ‖mkSpaceTime x 0 + mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ := by rw [h_split]
      _ ≤ ‖mkSpaceTime x 0‖ + ‖mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ + |t| := add_le_add h_nx h_nt
  have hv_unif : ∀ K ε : ℝ, 0 < K → 0 < ε →
      ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, N₀ ≤ m →
        ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ K → |f_seq m w - v_inf w| ≤ ε := by
    intro K ε hK hε
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_conv K hK ε hε
    refine ⟨N₀, fun m hm w hw => ?_⟩
    exact hN₀ m hm w (le_trans (h_norm_projSpace w) hw) (le_trans (h_norm_projTime w) hw)
  have h_xi_cont : Continuous (fun w : E => mkSpaceTime (projSpace w) 1) := by
    rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
    intro w ε hε
    refine ⟨ε, hε, fun w' hw' => ?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have h_sub : mkSpaceTime (projSpace w') 1 - mkSpaceTime (projSpace w) 1 =
        mkSpaceTime (projSpace (w' - w)) 0 := by
      rw [h_mk_sub, sub_self, h_projSpace_sub]
    have h_nm := h_norm_mk (projSpace (w' - w)) 0
    rw [← h_sub, abs_zero, add_zero] at h_nm
    have h_sp := h_norm_projSpace (w' - w)
    have hw'_lt : ‖w' - w‖ < ε := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hw'
    linarith
  have h_s2 : ∀ (ψ : E → ℝ) (z : E) (c : ℝ),
      limitingOperator (fun y => ψ y + c) z = limitingOperator ψ z := by
    intro ψ z c
    have hf : fderiv ℝ (fun y => ψ y + c) = fderiv ℝ ψ := by
      ext y u
      rw [fderiv_add_const]
    have hg : gradient (fun y => ψ y + c) z = gradient ψ z := by
      simp [gradient, hf]
    unfold limitingOperator
    rw [hf, hg]
  have h_s3 : ∀ (V : Set E) (z₀ : E) (ϕ : E → ℝ),
      IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
      (ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2) V ∧
        ContinuousAt (limitingOperator (fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2)) z₀ ∧
        limitingOperator (fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2) z₀ = limitingOperator ϕ z₀) ∧
      (ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => ϕ y - (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2) V ∧
        ContinuousAt (limitingOperator (fun y => ϕ y - (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2)) z₀ ∧
        limitingOperator (fun y => ϕ y - (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2) z₀ = limitingOperator ϕ z₀) := by
    intro V z₀ ϕ hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2
    let q : E → ℝ := fun y => ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2
    let g : E → ℝ := fun y => (q y) ^ 2
    have hq_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) q := (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).norm_sq ℝ
    have hg_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g := hq_smooth.pow 2
    have hg_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g V := (hg_smooth.of_le (by simp)).contDiffOn
    have hq_diff : Differentiable ℝ q := hq_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
    have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := hg_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
    have hq0 : q z₀ = 0 := by simp [q]
    have hq'_z0 : fderiv ℝ q z₀ = 0 := by
      have h1 := ((hasFDerivAt_id z₀).sub_const z₀).norm_sq
      have h2 := h1.fderiv
      simpa [q] using h2
    have h_mul : g = q * q := by
      ext x
      exact sq (q x)
    have hg_fderiv_eq : fderiv ℝ g = q • fderiv ℝ q + q • fderiv ℝ q := by
      ext y u
      have h_has := ((hq_diff y).hasFDerivAt.mul (hq_diff y).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
      rw [h_mul, h_has]
      rfl
    have hg1 : fderiv ℝ g z₀ = 0 := by
      rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
      simp [hq0]
    have hq'_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ q) :=
      (hq_smooth.of_le (by simp : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞))).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hq'_diff : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ q) := hq'_smooth.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hg2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z₀ = 0 := by
      have h_smul := (hq_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt.smul (hq'_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt
      have h_add := (h_smul.add h_smul).fderiv
      rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
      simpa [hq0, hq'_z0] using h_add
    have hϕ'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
      have hϕ'_c1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ :=
        (hϕ_c2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V)).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
      exact hϕ'_c1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hg'_diff_z0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z₀ := by
      have h_smul := (hq_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt.smul (hq'_diff z₀).hasFDerivAt
      rw [hg_fderiv_eq]
      exact (h_smul.add h_smul).differentiableAt
    have h_op_contAt : ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → ContinuousAt (limitingOperator ψ) z₀ := by
      intro ψ hψ_c2
      have h_fderiv_c1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ψ) V :=
        hψ_c2.fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open (by norm_num)
      have h_fderiv2_cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ)) V :=
        h_fderiv_c1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open le_rfl
      have h_fderiv1_cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ ψ) V :=
        hψ_c2.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV_open (by norm_num)
      have h_grad_cont : ContinuousOn (gradient ψ) V :=
        (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm.continuous.comp_continuousOn h_fderiv1_cont
      have h_xi_ψ_cont : ContinuousOn (fun y => mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ψ y)) 1) V :=
        h_xi_cont.comp_continuousOn h_grad_cont
      have h_op_cont : ContinuousOn (limitingOperator ψ) V :=
        (h_fderiv2_cont.clm_apply h_xi_ψ_cont).clm_apply h_xi_ψ_cont
      exact h_op_cont.continuousAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · let ψ₁ : E → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y + g y
      have hψ₁_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ₁ V := hϕ_c2.add hg_c2
      have hψ₁_fderiv_V : ∀ y ∈ V, fderiv ℝ ψ₁ y = fderiv ℝ ϕ y + fderiv ℝ g y := by
        intro y hy
        have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ y :=
          (hϕ_c2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
        exact fderiv_add hϕ_diff (hg_diff y)
      have hψ₁_fderiv_z0 : fderiv ℝ ψ₁ z₀ = fderiv ℝ ϕ z₀ := by
        rw [hψ₁_fderiv_V z₀ hz₀_V, hg1, add_zero]
      have hψ₁_grad_z0 : gradient ψ₁ z₀ = gradient ϕ z₀ := by
        simp [gradient, hψ₁_fderiv_z0]
      have h_ev : fderiv ℝ ψ₁ =ᶠ[nhds z₀] fderiv ℝ ϕ + fderiv ℝ g :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V) (fun y hy => hψ₁_fderiv_V y hy)
      have hψ₁_fderiv2_z0 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ₁) z₀ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
        rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_add hϕ'_diff_z0 hg'_diff_z0, hg2, add_zero]
      refine ⟨hψ₁_c2, h_op_contAt ψ₁ hψ₁_c2, ?_⟩
      change limitingOperator ψ₁ z₀ = limitingOperator ϕ z₀
      simp [limitingOperator, hψ₁_fderiv2_z0, hψ₁_grad_z0]
    · let ψ₂ : E → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y - g y
      have hψ₂_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ₂ V := hϕ_c2.sub hg_c2
      have hψ₂_fderiv_V : ∀ y ∈ V, fderiv ℝ ψ₂ y = fderiv ℝ ϕ y - fderiv ℝ g y := by
        intro y hy
        have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ y :=
          (hϕ_c2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
        exact fderiv_sub hϕ_diff (hg_diff y)
      have hψ₂_fderiv_z0 : fderiv ℝ ψ₂ z₀ = fderiv ℝ ϕ z₀ := by
        rw [hψ₂_fderiv_V z₀ hz₀_V, hg1, sub_zero]
      have hψ₂_grad_z0 : gradient ψ₂ z₀ = gradient ϕ z₀ := by
        simp [gradient, hψ₂_fderiv_z0]
      have h_ev : fderiv ℝ ψ₂ =ᶠ[nhds z₀] fderiv ℝ ϕ - fderiv ℝ g :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀_V) (fun y hy => hψ₂_fderiv_V y hy)
      have hψ₂_fderiv2_z0 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ₂) z₀ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z₀ := by
        rw [h_ev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_sub hϕ'_diff_z0 hg'_diff_z0, hg2, sub_zero]
      refine ⟨hψ₂_c2, h_op_contAt ψ₂ hψ₂_c2, ?_⟩
      change limitingOperator ψ₂ z₀ = limitingOperator ϕ z₀
      simp [limitingOperator, hψ₂_fderiv2_z0, hψ₂_grad_z0]
  have hv_sub : ∀ z₀ : E, ∀ ϕ : E → ℝ, ∀ V : Set E,
      IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z₀ = v_inf z₀ → (∀ y ∈ V, v_inf y ≤ ϕ y) →
      0 ≤ limitingOperator ϕ z₀ := by
    intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2 h_touch_eq h_touch_le
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open z₀ hz₀_V
    let ρ : ℝ := ρ₀ / 2
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := half_pos hρ₀_pos
    let K : Set E := Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ
    have hK_sub_V : K ⊆ V :=
      subset_trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hρ₀_pos)) hρ₀_sub
    have hK_norm : ∀ y ∈ K, ‖y‖ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_dist : ‖y - z₀‖ ≤ ρ := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]
        exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hy
      have h_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ + ‖z₀‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - z₀) z₀
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hψ₁_c2, hψ₁_contAt, hψ₁_eq⟩ := (h_s3 V z₀ ϕ hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2).1
    let ψ₁ : E → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y + (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2
    have h_ex_max : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ ym ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, f_seq m y - ψ₁ y ≤ f_seq m ym - ψ₁ ym := by
      intro m
      have h_cont_m : ContinuousOn (fun y => f_seq m y - ψ₁ y) K :=
        (hf_seq m).1.continuousOn.sub (hψ₁_c2.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_V)
      have hK_nonempty : K.Nonempty := ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le⟩
      obtain ⟨ym, hym_K, hym_max⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall z₀ ρ).exists_isMaxOn hK_nonempty h_cont_m
      exact ⟨ym, hym_K, fun y hy => isMaxOn_iff.mp hym_max y hy⟩
    choose y_seq hy_seq using h_ex_max
    have hy_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto y_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro r hr_pos
      let r' : ℝ := min r ρ
      have hr'_pos : 0 < r' := lt_min hr_pos hρ_pos
      let ε : ℝ := (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4
      have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
      obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hv_unif (‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1) ε (by positivity) hε_pos
      refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      have hym_K : y_seq m ∈ K := (hy_seq m).1
      have hz₀_K : z₀ ∈ K := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le
      have h_max_z₀ : f_seq m z₀ - ψ₁ z₀ ≤ f_seq m (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m) :=
        (hy_seq m).2 z₀ hz₀_K
      have hG_ym := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm (y_seq m) (hK_norm (y_seq m) hym_K))).1
      have hG_z₀ := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm z₀ (hK_norm z₀ hz₀_K))).2
      have hW_ym : v_inf (y_seq m) ≤ ϕ (y_seq m) := h_touch_le (y_seq m) (hK_sub_V hym_K)
      have hψ₁_z₀ : ψ₁ z₀ = v_inf z₀ := by simp [ψ₁, h_touch_eq]
      have hψ₁_ym : ψ₁ (y_seq m) = ϕ (y_seq m) + (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 := rfl
      have h_quartic_le : (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ε := by linarith
      have h_lt_r' : ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ < r' := by
        by_contra h_not_lt
        push_neg at h_not_lt
        have h_sq1 : r' ^ 2 ≤ ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hr'_pos.le h_not_lt 2
        have h_sq2 : (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_sq1 2
        have h_pos_r4 : 0 < (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
        dsimp [ε] at h_quartic_le
        linarith
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lt_r' (min_le_left r ρ)
    let W : Set E := Metric.ball z₀ ρ
    have h_ev_W : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, y_seq m ∈ W :=
      hy_tendsto.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pos))
    have hW_sub_V : W ⊆ V := subset_trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hK_sub_V
    have h_ev_nonneg : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ limitingOperator ψ₁ (y_seq m) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_W] with m hym_W
      let ψ_tilde : E → ℝ := fun y => ψ₁ y + (f_seq m (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m))
      have hψ_tilde_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ_tilde W :=
        (hψ₁_c2.mono hW_sub_V).add contDiffOn_const
      have hψ_tilde_eq : ψ_tilde (y_seq m) = f_seq m (y_seq m) := by
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]; ring
      have hψ_tilde_le : ∀ y ∈ W, f_seq m y ≤ ψ_tilde y := by
        intro y hy
        have h_le := (hy_seq m).2 y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]; linarith
      have h_visc := (hf_seq m).2.1 (y_seq m) ψ_tilde W
        Metric.isOpen_ball hym_W hψ_tilde_c2 hψ_tilde_eq hψ_tilde_le
      rwa [h_s2 ψ₁ (y_seq m) (f_seq m (y_seq m) - ψ₁ (y_seq m))] at h_visc
    have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => limitingOperator ψ₁ (y_seq m)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (limitingOperator ψ₁ z₀)) :=
      hψ₁_contAt.tendsto.comp hy_tendsto
    have h_z₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ limitingOperator ψ₁ z₀ := ge_of_tendsto h_lim h_ev_nonneg
    rwa [hψ₁_eq] at h_z₀_nonneg
  have hv_super : ∀ z₀ : E, ∀ ϕ : E → ℝ, ∀ V : Set E,
      IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z₀ = v_inf z₀ → (∀ y ∈ V, ϕ y ≤ v_inf y) →
      limitingOperator ϕ z₀ ≤ 0 := by
    intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2 h_touch_eq h_touch_le
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open z₀ hz₀_V
    let ρ : ℝ := ρ₀ / 2
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := half_pos hρ₀_pos
    let K : Set E := Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ
    have hK_sub_V : K ⊆ V :=
      subset_trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hρ₀_pos)) hρ₀_sub
    have hK_norm : ∀ y ∈ K, ‖y‖ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_dist : ‖y - z₀‖ ≤ ρ := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]
        exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hy
      have h_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ + ‖z₀‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - z₀) z₀
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hψ₂_c2, hψ₂_contAt, hψ₂_eq⟩ := (h_s3 V z₀ ϕ hV_open hz₀_V hϕ_c2).2
    let ψ₂ : E → ℝ := fun y => ϕ y - (‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2
    have h_ex_max : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ ym ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ψ₂ y - f_seq m y ≤ ψ₂ ym - f_seq m ym := by
      intro m
      have h_cont_m : ContinuousOn (fun y => ψ₂ y - f_seq m y) K :=
        (hψ₂_c2.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_V).sub (hf_seq m).1.continuousOn
      have hK_nonempty : K.Nonempty := ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le⟩
      obtain ⟨ym, hym_K, hym_max⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall z₀ ρ).exists_isMaxOn hK_nonempty h_cont_m
      exact ⟨ym, hym_K, fun y hy => isMaxOn_iff.mp hym_max y hy⟩
    choose y_seq hy_seq using h_ex_max
    have hy_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto y_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro r hr_pos
      let r' : ℝ := min r ρ
      have hr'_pos : 0 < r' := lt_min hr_pos hρ_pos
      let ε : ℝ := (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4
      have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
      obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hv_unif (‖z₀‖ + ρ + 1) ε (by positivity) hε_pos
      refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      have hym_K : y_seq m ∈ K := (hy_seq m).1
      have hz₀_K : z₀ ∈ K := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le
      have h_max_z₀ : ψ₂ z₀ - f_seq m z₀ ≤ ψ₂ (y_seq m) - f_seq m (y_seq m) :=
        (hy_seq m).2 z₀ hz₀_K
      have hG_ym := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm (y_seq m) (hK_norm (y_seq m) hym_K))).2
      have hG_z₀ := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hm₀ m hm z₀ (hK_norm z₀ hz₀_K))).1
      have hW_ym : ϕ (y_seq m) ≤ v_inf (y_seq m) := h_touch_le (y_seq m) (hK_sub_V hym_K)
      have hψ₂_z₀ : ψ₂ z₀ = v_inf z₀ := by simp [ψ₂, h_touch_eq]
      have hψ₂_ym : ψ₂ (y_seq m) = ϕ (y_seq m) - (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 := rfl
      have h_quartic_le : (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ε := by linarith
      have h_lt_r' : ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ < r' := by
        by_contra h_not_lt
        push_neg at h_not_lt
        have h_sq1 : r' ^ 2 ≤ ‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hr'_pos.le h_not_lt 2
        have h_sq2 : (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (‖y_seq m - z₀‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_sq1 2
        have h_pos_r4 : 0 < (r' ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
        dsimp [ε] at h_quartic_le
        linarith
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lt_r' (min_le_left r ρ)
    let W : Set E := Metric.ball z₀ ρ
    have h_ev_W : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, y_seq m ∈ W :=
      hy_tendsto.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pos))
    have hW_sub_V : W ⊆ V := subset_trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hK_sub_V
    have h_ev_nonpos : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, limitingOperator ψ₂ (y_seq m) ≤ 0 := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_W] with m hym_W
      let ψ_tilde : E → ℝ := fun y => ψ₂ y + (f_seq m (y_seq m) - ψ₂ (y_seq m))
      have hψ_tilde_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ_tilde W :=
        (hψ₂_c2.mono hW_sub_V).add contDiffOn_const
      have hψ_tilde_eq : ψ_tilde (y_seq m) = f_seq m (y_seq m) := by
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]; ring
      have hψ_tilde_le : ∀ y ∈ W, ψ_tilde y ≤ f_seq m y := by
        intro y hy
        have h_le := (hy_seq m).2 y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
        dsimp [ψ_tilde]; linarith
      have h_visc := (hf_seq m).2.2.1 (y_seq m) ψ_tilde W
        Metric.isOpen_ball hym_W hψ_tilde_c2 hψ_tilde_eq hψ_tilde_le
      rwa [h_s2 ψ₂ (y_seq m) (f_seq m (y_seq m) - ψ₂ (y_seq m))] at h_visc
    have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => limitingOperator ψ₂ (y_seq m)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (limitingOperator ψ₂ z₀)) :=
      hψ₂_contAt.tendsto.comp hy_tendsto
    have h_z₀_nonpos : limitingOperator ψ₂ z₀ ≤ 0 := le_of_tendsto h_lim h_ev_nonpos
    rwa [hψ₂_eq] at h_z₀_nonpos
  exact ⟨hv_sub, hv_super⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (hL : HasUniformNormalizedLiftBounds d L)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_scales : HasSelectedBlowupScales d u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 2 ≤ M) :
    ∃ i₁ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₁ ≤ i →
      let θ := Real.sqrt (32 * lam_seq i)
      0 < θ ∧ θ < 1 / 2 ∧ θ ^ 2 = 32 * lam_seq i ∧
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖z - z_seq i‖ ≤ M * r_seq i →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ M * r_seq i →
          ∃ P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
            IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L (liftFunc (u_seq i)) z r (θ ^ 2) P

signature.name: admissible_cylinder_fits_of_selected_scales
signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL_ge : 1 ≤ L)
    (hL : HasUniformNormalizedLiftBounds d L)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_scales : HasSelectedBlowupScales d u_seq z_seq r_seq lam_seq)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 2 ≤ M) :
    ∃ i₁ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₁ ≤ i →
      let θ := Real.sqrt (32 * lam_seq i)
      0 < θ ∧ θ < 1 / 2 ∧ θ ^ 2 = 32 * lam_seq i ∧
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖z - z_seq i‖ ≤ M * r_seq i →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ M * r_seq i →
          ∃ P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
            IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L (liftFunc (u_seq i)) z r (θ ^ 2) P

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ := h_scales.2.2 M hM
  refine ⟨i₁, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨hu_i, _, _, _, hlam_pos, hlam_lt, _, _⟩ := h_scales.1 i
  have h32_pos : 0 < 32 * lam_seq i := by linarith
  have h32_lt1 : 32 * lam_seq i < 1 := by linarith
  have hθ_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (32 * lam_seq i) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h32_pos
  have hθ_lt : Real.sqrt (32 * lam_seq i) < 1 / 2 := by
    exact (Real.sqrt_lt h32_pos.le (by norm_num)).mpr (by linarith)
  have hθ_sq : Real.sqrt (32 * lam_seq i) ^ 2 = 32 * lam_seq i :=
    Real.sq_sqrt h32_pos.le
  refine ⟨hθ_pos, hθ_lt, hθ_sq, fun z hz r hr_pos hr_le => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hz_ball, hr_adm, P, hP_fit⟩ := hi₁ i hi z hz r hr_pos hr_le
  obtain ⟨hP_norm_le, hP_time⟩ :=
    (hL (u_seq i) hu_i).2.2.2 z hz_ball r hr_pos hr_adm (32 * lam_seq i) h32_pos h32_lt1 P hP_fit
  have hP_upper : ‖P‖ ≤ L + 1 := by linarith
  have hP_time_ge : 1 / 2 ≤ projTime P := by
    have h1 := (abs_le.mp hP_time).1
    linarith
  have hP_coord_le : |projTime P| ≤ ‖P‖ := by
    simpa [projTime, Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le P (Fin.last d)
  have hP_lower : 1 / 2 ≤ ‖P‖ := by
    linarith [le_abs_self (projTime P)]
  refine ⟨P, ?_, hP_lower, hP_upper⟩
  rwa [hθ_sq]

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L C_comp : ℝ)
    (hC_comp : IsCylinderComparisonConstant d L C_comp)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (M_rad θ : ℝ)
    (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1 / 2)
    (h_fits : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ M_rad →
      ∃ P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z r (θ ^ 2) P)
    (k : ℕ) (H H' : ℝ)
    (hH_pos : 0 < H) (hH'_pos : 0 < H')
    (hH_le : H ≤ M_rad) (hH'_le : H' ≤ M_rad)
    (hHH' : H ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * H') (hH'H : H' ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * H)
    (P P' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (hP : IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z H (θ ^ 2) P)
    (hP' : IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z H' (θ ^ 2) P') :
    ‖(‖P‖⁻¹) • P - (‖P'‖⁻¹) • P'‖ ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * C_comp * θ ∧
    |‖P‖ - ‖P'‖| ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * C_comp * θ ^ 2

signature.name: same_center_multi_scale_cylinder_comparison
signature.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (L C_comp : ℝ)
    (hC_comp : IsCylinderComparisonConstant d L C_comp)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (M_rad θ : ℝ)
    (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1 / 2)
    (h_fits : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ M_rad →
      ∃ P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z r (θ ^ 2) P)
    (k : ℕ) (H H' : ℝ)
    (hH_pos : 0 < H) (hH'_pos : 0 < H')
    (hH_le : H ≤ M_rad) (hH'_le : H' ≤ M_rad)
    (hHH' : H ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * H') (hH'H : H' ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * H)
    (P P' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (hP : IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z H (θ ^ 2) P)
    (hP' : IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z H' (θ ^ 2) P') :
    ‖(‖P‖⁻¹) • P - (‖P'‖⁻¹) • P'‖ ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * C_comp * θ ∧
    |‖P‖ - ‖P'‖| ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * C_comp * θ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hC_pos, hC_body⟩ := hC_comp
  have h_single : ∀ (H₁ H₂ : ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      0 < H₁ → H₁ ≤ H₂ → H₂ ≤ 2 * H₁ →
      IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z H₁ (θ ^ 2) P₁ →
      IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z H₂ (θ ^ 2) P₂ →
      ‖(‖P₁‖⁻¹) • P₁ - (‖P₂‖⁻¹) • P₂‖ ≤ C_comp * θ ∧
      |‖P₁‖ - ‖P₂‖| ≤ C_comp * θ ^ 2 := by
    intro H₁ H₂ P₁ P₂ hH₁_pos hH₁₂ hH₂_2H₁ hP₁ hP₂
    exact (hC_body U z z H₁ H₂ θ P₁ P₂ hθ_pos hθ_lt hP₁.2.1 hP₁.2.2 hP₂.2.1 hP₂.2.2
      (Or.inl ⟨rfl, hH₁_pos, hH₁₂, hH₂_2H₁, hP₁.1, hP₂.1⟩)).2
  have h_ord : ∀ (m : ℕ) (H₁ H₂ : ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      0 < H₁ → H₁ ≤ H₂ → H₂ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H₁ → H₂ ≤ M_rad →
      IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z H₁ (θ ^ 2) P₁ →
      IsBoundedCylinderFitAt d L U z H₂ (θ ^ 2) P₂ →
      ‖(‖P₁‖⁻¹) • P₁ - (‖P₂‖⁻¹) • P₂‖ ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * C_comp * θ ∧
      |‖P₁‖ - ‖P₂‖| ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * C_comp * θ ^ 2 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro H₁ H₂ P₁ P₂ hH₁_pos hH₁₂ hH₂_pow hH₂_le hP₁ hP₂
      have hH₂_2H₁ : H₂ ≤ 2 * H₁ := by
        rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at hH₂_pow
        linarith
      obtain ⟨h_dir, h_norm⟩ := h_single H₁ H₂ P₁ P₂ hH₁_pos hH₁₂ hH₂_2H₁ hP₁ hP₂
      push_cast
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      intro H₁ H₂ P₁ P₂ hH₁_pos hH₁₂ hH₂_pow hH₂_le hP₁ hP₂
      let H_mid : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H₁
      rcases le_total H₂ H_mid with h_le | h_ge
      · obtain ⟨h_dir, h_norm⟩ := ih H₁ H₂ P₁ P₂ hH₁_pos hH₁₂ h_le hH₂_le hP₁ hP₂
        have hCθ_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_comp * θ := by positivity
        have hCθ2_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_comp * θ ^ 2 := by positivity
        push_cast
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · have h_pow_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
        have hH₁_mid : H₁ ≤ H_mid := by
          have h1 : 1 * H₁ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H₁ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pow_ge1 hH₁_pos.le
          dsimp [H_mid]
          linarith
        have hH_mid_pos : 0 < H_mid := hH₁_pos.trans_le hH₁_mid
        have hH_mid_le : H_mid ≤ M_rad := h_ge.trans hH₂_le
        have hH₂_2mid : H₂ ≤ 2 * H_mid := by
          have h_eq : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) * H₁ = 2 * H_mid := by
            dsimp [H_mid]
            rw [pow_succ']
            ring
          linarith
        obtain ⟨P_mid, hP_mid⟩ := h_fits H_mid hH_mid_pos hH_mid_le
        obtain ⟨h_dir1, h_norm1⟩ :=
          ih H₁ H_mid P₁ P_mid hH₁_pos hH₁_mid (le_refl _) hH_mid_le hP₁ hP_mid
        obtain ⟨h_dir2, h_norm2⟩ :=
          h_single H_mid H₂ P_mid P₂ hH_mid_pos h_ge hH₂_2mid hP_mid hP₂
        have h_dir_tri :
            ‖(‖P₁‖⁻¹) • P₁ - (‖P₂‖⁻¹) • P₂‖ ≤
              ‖(‖P₁‖⁻¹) • P₁ - (‖P_mid‖⁻¹) • P_mid‖ +
              ‖(‖P_mid‖⁻¹) • P_mid - (‖P₂‖⁻¹) • P₂‖ := by
          simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel] using
            norm_add_le ((‖P₁‖⁻¹) • P₁ - (‖P_mid‖⁻¹) • P_mid)
              ((‖P_mid‖⁻¹) • P_mid - (‖P₂‖⁻¹) • P₂)
        have h_norm_tri := abs_sub_le ‖P₁‖ ‖P_mid‖ ‖P₂‖
        push_cast
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  rcases le_total H H' with h_le | h_ge
  · exact h_ord k H H' P P' hH_pos h_le hH'H hH'_le hP hP'
  · obtain ⟨h_dir_rev, h_norm_rev⟩ := h_ord k H' H P' P hH'_pos h_ge hHH' hH_le hP' hP
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [norm_sub_rev]
      exact h_dir_rev
    · rw [abs_sub_comm]
      exact h_norm_rev

proof.tactics:
by
  intro z θ
  have h_mk_decomp : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      mkSpaceTime y s = mkSpaceTime y 0 + s • mkSpaceTime 0 1 := by
    intro y s
    ext m
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ m
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro i
      simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have h_mk_norm_sq : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      ‖mkSpaceTime y s‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 + s ^ 2 := by
    intro y s
    have h1 : ‖mkSpaceTime y s‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ (mkSpaceTime y s) (mkSpaceTime y s) := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm, sq]
    have h2 : ‖y‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ y y := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm, sq]
    rw [h1, h2, PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last, sq]
  have h_mk_norm_zero : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖mkSpaceTime y 0‖ = ‖y‖ := by
    intro y
    have hsq : ‖mkSpaceTime y 0‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_mk_norm_sq y 0]
      ring
    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (mkSpaceTime y 0)), ← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg y), hsq]
  have h_mk_norm_le : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      ‖mkSpaceTime y s‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + |s| := by
    intro y s
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ + |s| := add_nonneg (norm_nonneg y) (abs_nonneg s)
    have hsq : ‖mkSpaceTime y s‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖y‖ + |s|) ^ 2 := by
      have h_mul : 0 ≤ 2 * ‖y‖ * |s| := by positivity
      have h_abs_sq : |s| ^ 2 = s ^ 2 := sq_abs s
      linarith [h_mk_norm_sq y s]
    have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (mkSpaceTime y s)), Real.sqrt_sq h_nonneg] at hsqrt
  have h_proj_u : ∀ (u h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α : ℝ),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖h - (inner ℝ h u) • u‖ ≤ ‖h - α • u‖ := by
    intro u h α hu
    let s : ℝ := inner ℝ h u
    have h_expand : ∀ β : ℝ, ‖h - β • u‖ ^ 2 = ‖h‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (β * s) + β ^ 2 := by
      intro β
      have h_sub := norm_sub_sq_real h (β • u)
      have h_in : inner ℝ h (β • u) = β * s := real_inner_smul_right h u β
      have h_nm : ‖β • u‖ ^ 2 = β ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hu, mul_one, sq_abs]
      linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖h - s • u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖h - α • u‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := h_expand s
      have h2 := h_expand α
      have h3 : 0 ≤ (s - α) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (s - α)
      nlinarith
    have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (h - s • u)), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (h - α • u))] at hsqrt
  have h32_pos : 0 < 32 * lam := by linarith
  have h32_lt : 32 * lam < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hθ_pos : 0 < θ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h32_pos
  have hθ_lt : θ < 1 / 2 := by
    have h1 : Real.sqrt (32 * lam) < Real.sqrt ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt h32_pos.le h32_lt
    have h2 : Real.sqrt ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2) = 1 / 2 := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
    dsimp [θ]
    linarith
  have hsqrt_lam_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt lam := Real.sqrt_nonneg lam
  have hsqrt_lam_le_one : Real.sqrt lam ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 : Real.sqrt lam ≤ Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at h1
  have hsqrt_lam_le_θ : Real.sqrt lam ≤ θ := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hHR_pos : 0 < R * r := mul_pos hR_pos hr_pos
  have hxt_sq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 + t ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : ‖mkSpaceTime x t‖ ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (mkSpaceTime x t)]
    linarith [h_mk_norm_sq x t]
  have hx_le_K : ‖x‖ ≤ K := by
    have hsq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg t]
    have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x), Real.sqrt_sq hK_pos.le] at hsqrt
  have ht_le_K : |t| ≤ K := by
    have hsq : |t| ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖, sq_abs t]
    have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg t), Real.sqrt_sq hK_pos.le] at hsqrt
  let dz : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z - z₀
  have hdz_eq : dz = r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) t) := by
    dsimp [dz, z]
    exact add_sub_cancel_left z₀ (r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) t))
  have h_norm_lam_x : ‖Real.sqrt lam • x‖ = Real.sqrt lam * ‖x‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hsqrt_lam_nonneg]
  have hdz_norm : ‖z - z₀‖ ≤ 2 * K * r := by
    change ‖dz‖ ≤ 2 * K * r
    rw [hdz_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr_pos.le, O.norm_map]
    have h1 : ‖mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) t‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * ‖x‖ + |t| := by
      simpa [h_norm_lam_x] using h_mk_norm_le (Real.sqrt lam • x) t
    have h2 : Real.sqrt lam * ‖x‖ + |t| ≤ 2 * K := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hdz_norm, ?_⟩
  intro P_zR hP_zR
  obtain ⟨hP_R_fit, hP_R_low, hP_R_high⟩ := hP_R
  obtain ⟨hP_zR_fit, hP_zR_low, hP_zR_high⟩ := hP_zR
  let n_R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P_R‖⁻¹) • P_R
  let n₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P_base‖⁻¹) • P_base
  let n_zR : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P_zR‖⁻¹) • P_zR
  have hn_R_norm : ‖n_R‖ = 1 := by
    dsimp [n_R]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by linarith)]
  have h_ax_offset : |inner ℝ (z - z₀) n_R| ≤ (R * r) / 4 := by
    have hcs : |inner ℝ (z - z₀) n_R| ≤ ‖z - z₀‖ * ‖n_R‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm (z - z₀) n_R
    rw [hn_R_norm, mul_one] at hcs
    have h_2Kr : 2 * K * r ≤ (R * r) / 4 := by nlinarith
    linarith
  have h_tr_offset : ‖(z - z₀) - (inner ℝ (z - z₀) n_R) • n_R‖ ≤ θ * (R * r) / 4 := by
    change ‖dz - (inner ℝ dz n_R) • n_R‖ ≤ θ * (R * r) / 4
    have h_min : ‖dz - (inner ℝ dz n_R) • n_R‖ ≤ ‖dz - (r * t) • n_R‖ :=
      h_proj_u n_R dz (r * t) hn_R_norm
    have hdz_split : dz - (r * t) • n_R =
        r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) 0) + (r * t) • (n₀ - n_R) := by
      rw [hdz_eq, h_mk_decomp (Real.sqrt lam • x) t, O.map_add, O.map_smul, hO_eb]
      change r • (O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) 0) + t • n₀) - (r * t) • n_R =
        r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) 0) + (r * t) • (n₀ - n_R)
      rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_sub]
      abel
    have h_tri : ‖dz - (r * t) • n_R‖ ≤
        ‖r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) 0)‖ + ‖(r * t) • (n₀ - n_R)‖ := by
      rw [hdz_split]
      exact norm_add_le _ _
    have h_term1 : ‖r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) 0)‖ = r * (Real.sqrt lam * ‖x‖) := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr_pos.le, O.norm_map, h_mk_norm_zero, h_norm_lam_x]
    have h_term2 : ‖(r * t) • (n₀ - n_R)‖ = r * |t| * ‖n_R - n₀‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_pos, norm_sub_rev n₀ n_R]
    have h_term1_le : r * (Real.sqrt lam * ‖x‖) ≤ r * (θ * K) := by
      have h1 : Real.sqrt lam * ‖x‖ ≤ θ * K :=
        mul_le_mul hsqrt_lam_le_θ hx_le_K (norm_nonneg x) hθ_pos.le
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hr_pos.le
    have h_dir_R' : ‖n_R - n₀‖ ≤ B₁ * θ := h_dir_R
    have h_term2_le : r * |t| * ‖n_R - n₀‖ ≤ r * K * (B₁ * θ) := by
      have h1 : r * |t| ≤ r * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_le_K hr_pos.le
      exact mul_le_mul h1 h_dir_R' (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h_R_bound : r * (θ * K) + r * K * (B₁ * θ) ≤ θ * (R * r) / 4 := by
      have h1 : 4 * K * (1 + B₁) * (θ * r) ≤ R * (θ * r) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hR_B₁ (by positivity)
      linarith
    linarith
  have h_comp_res :=
    hC_comp.2 U z₀ z (R * r) (R * r) θ P_R P_zR
      hθ_pos hθ_lt hP_R_low hP_R_high hP_zR_low hP_zR_high
      (Or.inr ⟨rfl, hHR_pos, h_ax_offset, h_tr_offset, hP_R_fit, hP_zR_fit⟩)
  obtain ⟨_, h_dir_comp, h_norm_comp⟩ := h_comp_res
  have h_dir_final : ‖n_zR - n₀‖ ≤ (B₁ + C_comp) * θ := by
    have h1 : ‖n_zR - n_R‖ ≤ C_comp * θ := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev]
      exact h_dir_comp
    have h2 : ‖n_zR - n₀‖ ≤ ‖n_zR - n_R‖ + ‖n_R - n₀‖ := by
      simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le (n_zR - n_R) (n_R - n₀)
    have h3 : ‖n_R - n₀‖ ≤ B₁ * θ := h_dir_R
    linarith
  have h_norm_final : |‖P_zR‖ - c| ≤ (B₁ + C_comp) * θ ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : |‖P_zR‖ - ‖P_R‖| ≤ C_comp * θ ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_sub_comm]
      exact h_norm_comp
    have h2 : |‖P_zR‖ - c| ≤ |‖P_zR‖ - ‖P_R‖| + |‖P_R‖ - c| :=
      abs_sub_le ‖P_zR‖ ‖P_R‖ c
    have h3 : |‖P_R‖ - c| ≤ B₁ * θ ^ 2 := h_norm_R
    linarith
  exact ⟨h_dir_final, h_norm_final⟩

by

      projSpace z m = z (Fin.castSucc m) := fun _ _ => rfl
  have h_projTime_apply : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),

    rw [h_inner_phys, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
    nlinarith
  have h_trans_phys : ‖δ_phys - (inner ℝ δ_phys n) • n‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (32 * lam) * (S * r) := by
    have h_vec : δ_phys - (inner ℝ δ_phys n) • n = r • O (u - (inner ℝ u n_hat) • n_hat) := by
      dsimp [δ_phys]
      rw [h_inner_phys, ← h_O_n_hat, O.map_sub, O.map_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [h_vec, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hr_pos), O.norm_map]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_trans_u (le_of_lt hr_pos)
    linarith
  set z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z₀ + r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) t)
  have h_fit_ineq : |U (z + δ_phys) - U z - inner ℝ P δ_phys| ≤ (32 * lam) * (S * r) :=
    hP_fit.2 δ_phys h_ax_phys h_trans_phys
  have hz_add : z + δ_phys = z₀ + r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • (x + h)) (t + ℓ)) := by
    dsimp [z, δ_phys, u]
    rw [add_assoc, ← smul_add, ← O.map_add, ← h_mk_add, smul_add]
  have h_P_inner_phys : inner ℝ P δ_phys = r * c * ℓ + r * c * lam * (inner ℝ p' h + q' * ℓ) := by
    have h_P_O : P = O P_hat := (O.apply_symm_apply P).symm
    dsimp [δ_phys]
    rw [h_P_O, real_inner_smul_right, O.inner_map_map, ← h_cQ]
    dsimp [Q, u]
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, h_inner_split, h_projSpace_mk, h_projSpace_mk,
      h_projTime_mk, h_projTime_mk, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
      ← mul_assoc (Real.sqrt lam), Real.mul_self_sqrt (le_of_lt hlam_pos)]
    dsimp [A]
    ring
  set Δ_res : ℝ :=
    anisotropicRescale U z₀ r c lam O (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) -
      anisotropicRescale U z₀ r c lam O (mkSpaceTime x t) -
      inner ℝ p' h - q' * ℓ
  have h_res_ident : U (z + δ_phys) - U z - inner ℝ P δ_phys = (r * c * lam) * Δ_res := by
    have h_unfold1 : anisotropicRescale U z₀ r c lam O (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) =
        (U (z + δ_phys) - U z₀ - r * c * (t + ℓ)) / (r * c * lam) := by
      dsimp [anisotropicRescale]
      rw [h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk, ← hz_add]
    have h_unfold2 : anisotropicRescale U z₀ r c lam O (mkSpaceTime x t) =
        (U z - U z₀ - r * c * t) / (r * c * lam) := by
      dsimp [anisotropicRescale, z]
      rw [h_projSpace_mk, h_projTime_mk]
    dsimp [Δ_res]
    rw [h_unfold1, h_unfold2, h_P_inner_phys]
    have h_denom_ne : r * c * lam ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [h_denom_ne]
    ring
  have h_rcl_pos : 0 < r * c * lam := by positivity
  rw [h_res_ident, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_rcl_pos] at h_fit_ineq
  have h_half_pos : 0 < (1 / 2) * r * lam := by positivity
  have h_comb : ((1 / 2) * r * lam) * |Δ_res| ≤ ((1 / 2) * r * lam) * (64 * S) := by
    have h1 : (1 / 2) * r * lam ≤ r * c * lam := by nlinarith
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (abs_nonneg Δ_res)
    linarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_comb h_half_pos

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      Continuous w₀ →
      (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R' : ℝ), 0 < R' →
        ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ), IsFitAt d C₁ w₀ x t R' p a) →
      ∀ (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ R a₀ : ℝ),
        0 < R → IsFitAt d C₁ w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ →
        let v := shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀
        Continuous v ∧
        IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1 ∧
        (∀ (y_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s_c ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ →
          ∃ (p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a' : ℝ), IsFitAt d C₁ v y_c s_c ρ p' a')

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d C₁ w₀ hw₀ hw₀_fits x₀ p₀ t₀ R a₀ hR h_fit₀ v
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have hc_projSpace : Continuous (projSpace (d := d)) := by
    unfold projSpace
    fun_prop
  have hc_projTime : Continuous (projTime (d := d)) := by
    unfold projTime
    fun_prop
  have hc_mkSpaceTime :
      Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    apply Continuous.comp (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _)
    rw [continuous_pi_iff]
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
      exact continuous_snd
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ i).comp continuous_fst
  have hv_cont : Continuous v := by
    have h_arg : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
        (x₀ + R • (projSpace z + (projTime z - 1) • p₀),
          t₀ + R * (projTime z - 1))) := by
      fun_prop
    have h1 : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
        w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + R • (projSpace z + (projTime z - 1) • p₀))
          (t₀ + R * (projTime z - 1)))) :=
      hw₀.comp (hc_mkSpaceTime.comp h_arg)
    change Continuous (shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀)
    unfold shearedFrameTransform
    dsimp only
    fun_prop
  have h_cov : ∀ (y_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s_c ρ : ℝ)
      (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
      IsFitAt d C₁ w₀ (x₀ + R • (y_c + (s_c - 1) • p₀)) (t₀ + R * (s_c - 1)) (R * ρ) p a →
      IsFitAt d C₁ v y_c s_c ρ (p - p₀) (a - a₀) := by
    intro y_c s_c ρ p a h_fit h ℓ hℓ hh
    let x_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x₀ + R • (y_c + (s_c - 1) • p₀)
    let t_c : ℝ := t₀ + R * (s_c - 1)
    let H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := R • (h + ℓ • p₀)
    let L : ℝ := R * ℓ
    have hL : |L| ≤ R * ρ := by
      dsimp [L]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hR]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓ (le_of_lt hR)
    have hH_eq : H - L • p = R • (h - ℓ • (p - p₀)) := by
      dsimp [H, L]
      module
    have hH : ‖H - L • p‖ ≤ R * ρ := by
      rw [hH_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (le_of_lt hR)
    have h_bound := h_fit H L hL hH
    have hx_shift : x₀ + R • ((y_c + h) + (s_c + ℓ - 1) • p₀) = x_c + H := by
      dsimp [x_c, H]
      module
    have ht_shift : t₀ + R * (s_c + ℓ - 1) = t_c + L := by
      dsimp [t_c, L]
      ring
    have h_inner_H : inner ℝ p H = R * (inner ℝ p h + ℓ * inner ℝ p p₀) := by
      dsimp [H]
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    have h_inner_y : inner ℝ p₀ (y_c + h) = inner ℝ p₀ y_c + inner ℝ p₀ h :=
      inner_add_right p₀ y_c h
    have h_inner_sub : inner ℝ (p - p₀) h = inner ℝ p h - inner ℝ p₀ h :=
      inner_sub_left p p₀ h
    have h_norm_sub : ‖p - p₀‖ ^ 2 = ‖p‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ p p₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 :=
      norm_sub_sq_real p p₀
    have hR_ne : R ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR
    have h_rem :
        v (mkSpaceTime (y_c + h) (s_c + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime y_c s_c) -
          inner ℝ (p - p₀) h - (a - a₀ - ‖p - p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ =
        (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) -
          inner ℝ p H - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * L) / R := by
      change shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_c + h) (s_c + ℓ)) -
          shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime y_c s_c) -
          inner ℝ (p - p₀) h - (a - a₀ - ‖p - p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ =
        (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) -
          inner ℝ p H - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * L) / R
      unfold shearedFrameTransform
      dsimp only
      rw [h_projSpace (y_c + h) (s_c + ℓ), h_projTime (y_c + h) (s_c + ℓ),
        h_projSpace y_c s_c, h_projTime y_c s_c, hx_shift, ht_shift]
      change (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) / R -
          inner ℝ p₀ (y_c + h) - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s_c + ℓ - 1) -
          ((w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) / R -
            inner ℝ p₀ y_c - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s_c - 1)) -
          inner ℝ (p - p₀) h - (a - a₀ - ‖p - p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ =
        (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) -
          inner ℝ p H - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (R * ℓ)) / R
      rw [h_inner_y, h_inner_sub, h_norm_sub, h_inner_H]
      field_simp [hR_ne]
      ring
    rw [h_rem, abs_div, abs_of_pos hR, div_le_iff₀ hR]
    calc |w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x_c + H) (t_c + L)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_c t_c) -
          inner ℝ p H - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * L|
      _ ≤ C₁ * (R * ρ) := h_bound
      _ = C₁ * ρ * R := by ring
  have hv_01 : v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = 0 := by
    change shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = 0
    unfold shearedFrameTransform
    dsimp only
    rw [h_projSpace 0 1, h_projTime 0 1]
    simp
  have hv_fit01 : IsFitAt d C₁ v 0 1 1 0 0 := by
    have h_fit₀' : IsFitAt d C₁ w₀ (x₀ + R • (0 + ((1 : ℝ) - 1) • p₀)) (t₀ + R * (1 - 1)) (R * 1) p₀ a₀ := by
      simpa using h_fit₀
    have h_cov01 := h_cov 0 1 1 p₀ a₀ h_fit₀'
    simpa using h_cov01
  have hv_fits : ∀ (y_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s_c ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ →
      ∃ (p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a' : ℝ), IsFitAt d C₁ v y_c s_c ρ p' a' := by
    intro y_c s_c ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨p, a, h_fit⟩ := hw₀_fits (x₀ + R • (y_c + (s_c - 1) • p₀)) (t₀ + R * (s_c - 1)) (R * ρ) (mul_pos hR hρ)
    exact ⟨p - p₀, a - a₀, h_cov y_c s_c ρ p a h_fit⟩
  exact ⟨hv_cont, ⟨hv_01, hv_fit01⟩, hv_fits⟩
