proof.tactics:
by
  intro d C₁ w₀ hw₀ x₀ p₀ t₀ R a₀ hR
  set v := shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀
  have hR_ne : R ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR
  have projSpace_mkSpaceTime :
      ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s) = y := by
    intro y s
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have projTime_mkSpaceTime :
      ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime y s) = s := by
    intro y s
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
  have mkSpaceTime_projSpace_projTime :
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z) = z := by
    intro z
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro j
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have projSpace_add :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projSpace (z₁ + z₂) = projSpace z₁ + projSpace z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_add :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projTime (z₁ + z₂) = projTime z₁ + projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    simp [projTime]
  have projSpace_sub :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projSpace (z₁ - z₂) = projSpace z₁ - projSpace z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_sub :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projTime (z₁ - z₂) = projTime z₁ - projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    simp [projTime]
  have projSpace_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        projSpace (c • z) = c • projSpace z := by
    intro c z
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        projTime (c • z) = c * projTime z := by
    intro c z
    simp [projTime]
  have mkSpaceTime_add :
      ∀ (x₁ x₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₁ t₂ : ℝ),
        mkSpaceTime (x₁ + x₂) (t₁ + t₂) = mkSpaceTime x₁ t₁ + mkSpaceTime x₂ t₂ := by
    intro x₁ x₂ t₁ t₂
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro j
      simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        inner ℝ z₁ z₂ = inner ℝ (projSpace z₁) (projSpace z₂) + projTime z₁ * projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [projSpace, projTime, mul_comm]
  let projTimeCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := projTime
        map_add' := projTime_add
        map_smul' := projTime_smul }
  have deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv :
      ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
        {f : E → ℝ} {W : Set E}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : E}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f W → ∀ (ξ : E),
        deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (z₀ + s • ξ))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ ξ := by
    intro E _ _ f W hW z₀ hz₀ hf ξ
    have h_pre : IsOpen ((fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ⁻¹' W) :=
      hW.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ⁻¹' W := by simp [hz₀]
    have h_ev : (fun s : ℝ => deriv (fun r : ℝ => f (z₀ + r • ξ)) s) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        (fun s : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ)) ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [h_pre.mem_nhds h0_mem] with s hs
      have hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ) :=
        ((hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hs)).differentiableAt (by norm_num))
      have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => z₀ + r • ξ) ξ s := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
      exact (hf_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h_line).deriv
    rw [h_ev.deriv_eq]
    have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f z₀ := hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)
    have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ := hcd.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hf2_diff : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀) (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) := by
      simpa using (hcd1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have h_line0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ξ 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
    have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ) 0 :=
      hf2_diff.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line0
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ξ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_comp).deriv
  set e_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime p₀ 0
  set z_one : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime 0 1
  set w_orig : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀
  set q₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime p₀ (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2)
  let B_inv : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) - projTimeCLM.smulRight e_p
  let L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    R⁻¹ • B_inv
  have hL_apply : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      L u = R⁻¹ • (u - (projTime u) • e_p) := by
    intro u
    rfl
  have hprojSpace_L : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      projSpace (L u) = R⁻¹ • (projSpace u - (projTime u) • p₀) := by
    intro u
    rw [hL_apply, projSpace_smul, projSpace_sub, projSpace_smul, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
  have hprojTime_L : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      projTime (L u) = R⁻¹ * projTime u := by
    intro u
    rw [hL_apply, projTime_smul, projTime_sub, projTime_smul, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    ring
  set Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    fun z => mkSpaceTime (x₀ + R • (projSpace z + (projTime z - 1) • p₀))
      (t₀ + R * (projTime z - 1))
  set Ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    fun w => z_one + L (w - w_orig)
  have hΨΦ : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), Ψ (Φ z) = z := by
    intro z
    rw [← mkSpaceTime_projSpace_projTime (Ψ (Φ z))]
    have h_time : projTime (Ψ (Φ z)) = projTime z := by
      dsimp [Ψ, Φ, z_one, w_orig]
      rw [projTime_add, projTime_mkSpaceTime, hprojTime_L, projTime_sub,
        projTime_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      field_simp [hR_ne]
      ring
    have h_space : projSpace (Ψ (Φ z)) = projSpace z := by
      dsimp [Ψ, Φ, z_one, w_orig]
      rw [projSpace_add, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, zero_add, hprojSpace_L,
        projSpace_sub, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime,
        projTime_sub, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      have h1 : x₀ + R • (projSpace z + (projTime z - 1) • p₀) - x₀ =
          R • projSpace z + (R * (projTime z - 1)) • p₀ := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, smul_add, smul_smul]
      have h2 : t₀ + R * (projTime z - 1) - t₀ = R * (projTime z - 1) := by ring
      rw [h1, h2, add_sub_cancel_right, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hR_ne, one_smul]
    rw [h_space, h_time, mkSpaceTime_projSpace_projTime]
  have hΦΨ : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), Φ (Ψ w) = w := by
    intro w
    have h_time_Ψ : projTime (Ψ w) - 1 = R⁻¹ * (projTime w - t₀) := by
      dsimp [Ψ, z_one, w_orig]
      rw [projTime_add, projTime_mkSpaceTime, hprojTime_L, projTime_sub, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      ring
    have h_space_Ψ : projSpace (Ψ w) =
        R⁻¹ • ((projSpace w - x₀) - (projTime w - t₀) • p₀) := by
      dsimp [Ψ, z_one, w_orig]
      rw [projSpace_add, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, zero_add, hprojSpace_L,
        projSpace_sub, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_sub, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    dsimp [Φ]
    rw [h_time_Ψ, h_space_Ψ]
    have h_s : x₀ + R • (R⁻¹ • (projSpace w - x₀ - (projTime w - t₀) • p₀) +
        (R⁻¹ * (projTime w - t₀)) • p₀) = projSpace w := by
      rw [mul_smul R⁻¹ (projTime w - t₀) p₀, ← smul_add, sub_add_cancel,
        smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hR_ne, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
    have h_t : t₀ + R * (R⁻¹ * (projTime w - t₀)) = projTime w := by
      field_simp [hR_ne]
      ring
    rw [h_s, h_t, mkSpaceTime_projSpace_projTime]
  have hΨ_line : ∀ (w η : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (s : ℝ),
      Ψ (w + s • η) = Ψ w + s • L η := by
    intro w η s
    dsimp [Ψ]
    have h_sub : w + s • η - w_orig = (w - w_orig) + s • η := by abel
    rw [h_sub, map_add, map_smul, add_assoc]
  have hv_eq : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      v z = (w₀ (Φ z) - w₀ w_orig) / R - inner ℝ q₀ (z - z_one) := by
    intro z
    have h_in : inner ℝ q₀ (z - z_one) =
        inner ℝ p₀ (projSpace z) + (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (projTime z - 1) := by
      rw [inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime]
      dsimp [q₀, z_one]
      rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
        projSpace_sub, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, sub_zero,
        projTime_sub, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    dsimp [v, shearedFrameTransform, Φ, w_orig]
    rw [h_in]
    ring
  have h_pullback :
      ∀ (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
        (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
        (V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))),
        IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z₀ = v z₀ →
        let V' : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := Ψ ⁻¹' V
        let w_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := Φ z₀
        let ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
          fun w => w₀ w_orig + R * (ϕ (Ψ w) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ w - z_one))
        IsOpen V' ∧ w_c ∈ V' ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V' ∧ ψ w_c = w₀ w_c ∧
        (∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ψ w - w₀ w = R * (ϕ (Ψ w) - v (Ψ w))) ∧
        limitingOperator ϕ z₀ = R * limitingOperator ψ w_c := by
    intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀
    set V' : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) := Ψ ⁻¹' V
    set w_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := Φ z₀
    set ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
      fun w => w₀ w_orig + R * (ϕ (Ψ w) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ w - z_one))
    have hΨ_C2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ψ :=
      contDiff_const.add (L.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))
    have hV'_open : IsOpen V' := hV_open.preimage hΨ_C2.continuous
    have hΨ_wc : Ψ w_c = z₀ := hΨΦ z₀
    have hw_c_mem : w_c ∈ V' := by
      change Ψ w_c ∈ V
      rw [hΨ_wc]
      exact hz₀
    have hϕΨ_C2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun w => ϕ (Ψ w)) V' :=
      hϕ_C2.comp hΨ_C2.contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
    have h_in_C2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun w => inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ w - z_one)) := by
      change ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun w => (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ q₀) (Ψ w - z_one))
      exact (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ q₀).contDiff.comp (hΨ_C2.sub contDiff_const)
    have hψ_C2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V' :=
      contDiffOn_const.add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hϕΨ_C2.add h_in_C2.contDiffOn))
    have hψ_diff_eq : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        ψ w - w₀ w = R * (ϕ (Ψ w) - v (Ψ w)) := by
      intro w
      have hv_Ψ : v (Ψ w) = (w₀ w - w₀ w_orig) / R - inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ w - z_one) := by
        rw [hv_eq (Ψ w), hΦΨ w]
      dsimp [ψ]
      rw [hv_Ψ]
      field_simp [hR_ne]
      ring
    have hψ_wc : ψ w_c = w₀ w_c := by
      have h1 := hψ_diff_eq w_c
      rw [hΨ_wc, hϕ_z₀, sub_self, mul_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h1
      exact h1
    have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ z₀ :=
      (hϕ_C2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hϕ_fd : HasFDerivAt ϕ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ϕ z₀)) z₀ :=
      hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mp hϕ_diff.hasGradientAt
    have hψ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ w_c :=
      (hψ_C2.contDiffAt (hV'_open.mem_nhds hw_c_mem)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hψ_fd : HasFDerivAt ψ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ψ w_c)) w_c :=
      hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mp hψ_diff.hasGradientAt
    have h_grad_space : projSpace (gradient ψ w_c) = projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀) + p₀ := by
      apply ext_inner_right ℝ
      intro h
      set u_h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime h 0
      set α_h : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := fun s => w_c + s • u_h
      have h_line_w : HasDerivAt α_h u_h 0 := by
        simpa [α_h] using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const u_h |>.const_add w_c
      have hα0 : α_h 0 = w_c := by simp [α_h]
      have hψ_fd0 : HasFDerivAt ψ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ψ w_c)) (α_h 0) := by
        rw [hα0]; exact hψ_fd
      have h_val_ψ : (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ψ w_c)) u_h =
          inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient ψ w_c)) h := by
        rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime]
        simp [u_h, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      have h_d1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ψ (α_h s)) (inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient ψ w_c)) h) 0 := by
        rw [← h_val_ψ]
        exact hψ_fd0.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line_w
      have hL_uh : L u_h = R⁻¹ • u_h := by
        rw [hL_apply, projTime_mkSpaceTime, zero_smul, sub_zero]
      have hΨ_α : ∀ s : ℝ, Ψ (α_h s) = z₀ + s • (R⁻¹ • u_h) := by
        intro s
        dsimp [α_h]
        rw [hΨ_line, hΨ_wc, hL_uh]
      have h_in_uh : inner ℝ q₀ (R⁻¹ • u_h) = R⁻¹ * inner ℝ p₀ h := by
        rw [real_inner_smul_right, inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime]
        dsimp [q₀, u_h]
        simp [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      have hψ_α_eq : (fun s : ℝ => ψ (α_h s)) =
          fun s : ℝ => w₀ w_orig + R * (ϕ (z₀ + s • (R⁻¹ • u_h)) +
            (inner ℝ q₀ (z₀ - z_one) + s * (R⁻¹ * inner ℝ p₀ h))) := by
        ext s
        dsimp [ψ]
        rw [hΨ_α s]
        have h_sub : z₀ + s • (R⁻¹ • u_h) - z_one = (z₀ - z_one) + s • (R⁻¹ • u_h) := by abel
        rw [h_sub, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, h_in_uh]
      have h_line_z : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • (R⁻¹ • u_h)) (R⁻¹ • u_h) 0 := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (R⁻¹ • u_h) |>.const_add z₀
      have hϕ_fd0 : HasFDerivAt ϕ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ϕ z₀))
          (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • (R⁻¹ • u_h)) := by
        simpa using hϕ_fd
      have h_val_ϕ : (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient ϕ z₀)) (R⁻¹ • u_h) =
          R⁻¹ * inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀)) h := by
        rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply,
          inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime]
        simp [u_h, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      have h_d_ϕ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ϕ (z₀ + s • (R⁻¹ • u_h)))
          (R⁻¹ * inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀)) h) 0 := by
        rw [← h_val_ϕ]
        exact hϕ_fd0.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line_z
      have h_d_aff : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => inner ℝ q₀ (z₀ - z_one) + s * (R⁻¹ * inner ℝ p₀ h))
          (R⁻¹ * inner ℝ p₀ h) 0 := by
        have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s) 1 0 := hasDerivAt_id 0
        convert (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (inner ℝ q₀ (z₀ - z_one))).add
          (h_id.mul_const (R⁻¹ * inner ℝ p₀ h)) using 1
        ring
      have h_d2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ψ (α_h s))
          (inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀) + p₀) h) 0 := by
        rw [hψ_α_eq]
        convert (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (w₀ w_orig)).add
          ((h_d_ϕ.add h_d_aff).const_mul R) using 1
        rw [inner_add_left]
        field_simp [hR_ne]
        ring
      exact h_d1.unique h_d2
    set ξ_ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ψ w_c)) 1
    set ξ_ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ϕ z₀)) 1
    set ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := R⁻¹ • ξ_ϕ
    have hξ_ψ_eq : ξ_ψ = ξ_ϕ + e_p := by
      dsimp [ξ_ψ, ξ_ϕ, e_p]
      rw [h_grad_space, ← mkSpaceTime_add, add_zero]
    have hL_ξ : L ξ_ψ = ζ := by
      dsimp [ζ]
      rw [hL_apply, projTime_mkSpaceTime, one_smul, hξ_ψ_eq, add_sub_cancel_right]
    have hΨ_ray : ∀ s : ℝ, Ψ (w_c + s • ξ_ψ) = z₀ + s • ζ := by
      intro s
      rw [hΨ_line, hΨ_wc, hL_ξ]
    set A₀ : ℝ := w₀ w_orig + R * inner ℝ q₀ (z₀ - z_one)
    set B₀ : ℝ := R * inner ℝ q₀ ζ
    set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ϕ (z₀ + s • ζ)
    have hψ_ray_eq : (fun s : ℝ => ψ (w_c + s • ξ_ψ)) =
        fun s : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * s + R * g s := by
      ext s
      dsimp [ψ, A₀, B₀, g]
      rw [hΨ_ray s]
      have h_sub : z₀ + s • ζ - z_one = (z₀ - z_one) + s • ζ := by abel
      rw [h_sub, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right]
      ring
    have h_lim_ψ : limitingOperator ψ w_c =
        deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * s + R * g s)) 0 := by
      change fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) w_c ξ_ψ ξ_ψ = _
      rw [← deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hV'_open hw_c_mem hψ_C2 ξ_ψ, hψ_ray_eq]
    have hU_s_open : IsOpen ((fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ζ) ⁻¹' V) :=
      hV_open.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_U_s : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ζ) ⁻¹' V := by simp [hz₀]
    have h_ev_d1 : (fun s : ℝ => deriv (fun r : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * r + R * g r) s) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        fun s : ℝ => B₀ + R * deriv g s := by
      filter_upwards [hU_s_open.mem_nhds h0_U_s] with s hs
      have hϕ_s_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ϕ (z₀ + s • ζ) :=
        (hϕ_C2.contDiffAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hs)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have h_line_s : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => z₀ + r • ζ) ζ s := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const ζ |>.const_add z₀
      have hg_diff : HasDerivAt g (deriv g s) s :=
        (hϕ_s_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h_line_s).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have h_id_s : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => r) 1 s := hasDerivAt_id s
      have h_comb : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * r + R * g r) (B₀ + R * deriv g s) s := by
        convert ((hasDerivAt_const s A₀).add (h_id_s.const_mul B₀)).add (hg_diff.const_mul R) using 1
        ring
      exact h_comb.deriv
    have h_d2_ray : deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => A₀ + B₀ * s + R * g s)) 0 =
        R * deriv (deriv g) 0 := by
      rw [h_ev_d1.deriv_eq, deriv_const_add B₀, deriv_const_mul_field R]
    have h_dd_g : deriv (deriv g) 0 = R⁻¹ * (R⁻¹ * limitingOperator ϕ z₀) := by
      dsimp [g]
      rw [deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 ζ]
      dsimp [ζ, limitingOperator, ξ_ϕ]
      rw [map_smul, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have h_lim_eq : limitingOperator ϕ z₀ = R * limitingOperator ψ w_c := by
      rw [h_lim_ψ, h_d2_ray, h_dd_g]
      field_simp [hR_ne]
    exact ⟨hV'_open, hw_c_mem, hψ_C2, hψ_wc, hψ_diff_eq, h_lim_eq⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀ h_upper
    obtain ⟨hV'_open, hw_c_mem, hψ_C2, hψ_wc, hψ_diff_eq, h_lim_eq⟩ :=
      h_pullback z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀
    have hψ_upper : ∀ w ∈ Ψ ⁻¹' V, w₀ w ≤
        w₀ w_orig + R * (ϕ (Ψ w) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ w - z_one)) := by
      intro w hw
      have h_le : 0 ≤ ϕ (Ψ w) - v (Ψ w) := sub_nonneg.mpr (h_upper (Ψ w) hw)
      have h_diff := hψ_diff_eq w
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ R * (ϕ (Ψ w) - v (Ψ w)) := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR) h_le
      linarith
    have h_op_ψ : 0 ≤ limitingOperator
        (fun w => w₀ w_orig + R * (ϕ (Ψ w) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ w - z_one))) (Φ z₀) :=
      hw₀.2.1 (Φ z₀) _ (Ψ ⁻¹' V) hV'_open hw_c_mem hψ_C2 hψ_wc hψ_upper
    rw [h_lim_eq]
    exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR) h_op_ψ
  · intro z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀ h_lower
    obtain ⟨hV'_open, hw_c_mem, hψ_C2, hψ_wc, hψ_diff_eq, h_lim_eq⟩ :=
      h_pullback z₀ ϕ V hV_open hz₀ hϕ_C2 hϕ_z₀
    have hψ_lower : ∀ w ∈ Ψ ⁻¹' V,
        w₀ w_orig + R * (ϕ (Ψ w) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ w - z_one)) ≤ w₀ w := by
      intro w hw
      have h_le : ϕ (Ψ w) - v (Ψ w) ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr (h_lower (Ψ w) hw)
      have h_diff := hψ_diff_eq w
      have h_nonpos : R * (ϕ (Ψ w) - v (Ψ w)) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hR) h_le
      linarith
    have h_op_ψ : limitingOperator
        (fun w => w₀ w_orig + R * (ϕ (Ψ w) + inner ℝ q₀ (Ψ w - z_one))) (Φ z₀) ≤ 0 :=
      hw₀.2.2.1 (Φ z₀) _ (Ψ ⁻¹' V) hV'_open hw_c_mem hψ_C2 hψ_wc hψ_lower
    rw [h_lim_eq]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hR) h_op_ψ

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ w₀ →
      ∀ (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ R a₀ : ℝ),
        0 < R →
        HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ (shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀)

signature.name: sheared_frame_jensen_covariance
signature.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
      HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ w₀ →
      ∀ (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ R a₀ : ℝ),
        0 < R →
        HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ (shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d κ w₀ hw₀ x₀ p₀ t₀ R a₀ hR s N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
  dsimp only
  set x_bar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
  set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x_bar‖ ^ 2)
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime u t) = u := by
    intro u t
    ext j
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime u t) = t := by
    intro u t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  let t_hat : ℝ := t₀ + R * (s - 1)
  have hv_eval : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime u s) =
        (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + R • (u + (s - 1) • p₀)) t_hat) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) / R -
          inner ℝ p₀ u - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s - 1) := by
    intro u
    dsimp [shearedFrameTransform, t_hat]
    rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  let y_hat : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => x₀ + R • (y i + (s - 1) • p₀)
  let x_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x₀ + R • (x_bar + (s - 1) • p₀)
  let c_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x₀ + R • ((s - 1) • p₀)
  have hy_hat_eq : ∀ i, y_hat i = R • y i + c_vec := by
    intro i
    dsimp [y_hat, c_vec]
    rw [smul_add]
    abel
  have hx_hat_eq : x_hat = R • x_bar + c_vec := by
    dsimp [x_hat, c_vec]
    rw [smul_add]
    abel
  have hx_hat : ∑ i, θ i • y_hat i = x_hat := by
    have h_term : ∀ i, θ i • y_hat i = R • (θ i • y i) + θ i • c_vec := by
      intro i
      rw [hy_hat_eq i, smul_add, smul_comm R (θ i) (y i)]
    simp_rw [h_term]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_smul, hθ_sum, one_smul, ← hx_hat_eq]
  have h_diff : ∀ i, y_hat i - x_hat = R • (y i - x_bar) := by
    intro i
    rw [hy_hat_eq i, hx_hat_eq, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← smul_sub]
  have hr_hat : Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_hat i - (∑ j, θ j • y_hat j)‖ ^ 2) = R * r := by
    rw [hx_hat]
    have h_norm_sq : ∀ i, θ i * ‖y_hat i - x_hat‖ ^ 2 = R ^ 2 * (θ i * ‖y i - x_bar‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro i
      rw [h_diff i, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hR)]
      ring
    simp_rw [h_norm_sq]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg R), Real.sqrt_sq (le_of_lt hR)]
  have h_inner_sum : ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar) = 0 := by
    have h_term : ∀ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar) =
        inner ℝ p₀ (θ i • y i) - θ i * inner ℝ p₀ x_bar := by
      intro i
      rw [inner_sub_right, mul_sub, real_inner_smul_right]
    simp_rw [h_term]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← inner_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, hθ_sum, one_mul]
    exact sub_self (inner ℝ p₀ x_bar)
  have h_defect :
      (∑ i, θ i * shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) s)) -
        shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime x_bar s) =
      ((∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat)) -
        w₀ (mkSpaceTime (∑ i, θ i • y_hat i) t_hat)) / R := by
    rw [hx_hat]
    have h_pt : ∀ i,
        shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) s) -
          shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime x_bar s) =
        (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_hat t_hat)) / R -
          inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar) := by
      intro i
      rw [hv_eval (y i), hv_eval x_bar, inner_sub_right]
      dsimp [y_hat, x_hat]
      ring
    calc (∑ i, θ i * shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) s)) -
          shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime x_bar s)
      _ = (∑ i, θ i * shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) s)) -
          (∑ i, θ i) * shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime x_bar s) := by
          rw [hθ_sum, one_mul]
      _ = ∑ i, θ i * (shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) s) -
          shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime x_bar s)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          ring
      _ = ∑ i, (θ i * ((w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_hat t_hat)) / R) -
          θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          rw [h_pt i, mul_sub]
      _ = (∑ i, (θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat) - θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_hat t_hat)) / R) -
          ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y i - x_bar) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          congr 1
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          ring
      _ = ((∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y_hat i) t_hat)) -
          w₀ (mkSpaceTime x_hat t_hat)) / R := by
          rw [h_inner_sum, sub_zero, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
            hθ_sum, one_mul]
  have hw₀_step := hw₀ t_hat N θ y_hat hθ_pos hθ_sum
  dsimp only at hw₀_step
  rw [hr_hat] at hw₀_step
  rw [h_defect, div_le_iff₀ hR]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (κ δ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
      ∀ (w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ)
        (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) →
        let x₀ := ∑ j, θ j • y j
        let r₀ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x₀‖ ^ 2)
        0 < r₀ →
        (κ - δ) * r₀ ≤
          (∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t₀)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) →
        ∀ (p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₀ : ℝ),
          let R := r₀ / κ
          let v := shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀
          HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v →
          κ ^ 2 / 2 - κ * δ ≤ barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) - v (mkSpaceTime 0 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d κ δ hκ_pos w₀ t₀ N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum x₀ r₀ hr_pos h_def p₀ a₀ R v hv_jensen
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := div_pos hr_pos hκ_pos
  have hR_ne : R ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR_pos
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have hr₀_ne : r₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr_pos
  have hV₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x₀‖ ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hr₀_sq : r₀ ^ 2 = ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x₀‖ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hV₀_nonneg
  have hv_slice : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      v (mkSpaceTime u 1) =
        (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + R • u) t₀) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) / R - inner ℝ p₀ u := by
    intro u
    change shearedFrameTransform d w₀ x₀ t₀ R p₀ a₀ (mkSpaceTime u 1) = _
    unfold shearedFrameTransform
    simp [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  have hv_zero : v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hv_slice 0]
    simp
  have h_bary_ub : ∀ val ∈
      { val : ℝ | ∃ (N' : ℕ) (θ' : Fin N' → ℝ) (y' : Fin N' → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, 0 < θ' i) ∧ (∑ i, θ' i = 1) ∧
        (∑ i, θ' i • y' i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)) ∧
        val = (∑ i, θ' i * v (mkSpaceTime (y' i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)))) -
          (∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) },
      val ≤ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) + κ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rintro val ⟨N', θ', y', hθ'_pos, hθ'_sum, hy'_mean, rfl⟩
    rw [h_projSpace] at hy'_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projTime]
    have hj := hv_jensen 1 N' θ' y' hθ'_pos hθ'_sum
    dsimp only at hj
    rw [hy'_mean] at hj
    set V' : ℝ := ∑ i, θ' i * ‖y' i - 0‖ ^ 2
    set r' : ℝ := Real.sqrt V'
    have hV'_nonneg : 0 ≤ V' := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ'_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hr'_sq : r' ^ 2 = V' := Real.sq_sqrt hV'_nonneg
    have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r' - κ) ^ 2 / 2 := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have h_id : κ * r' - V' / (2 * 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2 - (r' - κ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
      rw [← hr'_sq]
      ring
    linarith
  let y_tilde : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun i => R⁻¹ • (y i - x₀)
  have hy_tilde_mean : ∑ i, θ i • y_tilde i = 0 := by
    change ∑ i, θ i • (R⁻¹ • (y i - x₀)) = 0
    have h_comm : ∀ i, θ i • (R⁻¹ • (y i - x₀)) = R⁻¹ • (θ i • (y i - x₀)) := by
      intro i
      exact smul_comm (θ i) R⁻¹ (y i - x₀)
    simp_rw [h_comm, ← Finset.smul_sum, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, hθ_sum, one_smul]
    change R⁻¹ • (x₀ - x₀) = 0
    simp
  have hy_tilde_rec : ∀ i, x₀ + R • y_tilde i = y i := by
    intro i
    change x₀ + R • (R⁻¹ • (y i - x₀)) = y i
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hR_ne, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
  have hy_tilde_var : ∑ i, θ i * ‖y_tilde i - 0‖ ^ 2 = κ ^ 2 := by
    have h_term : ∀ i, θ i * ‖y_tilde i - 0‖ ^ 2 = (R⁻¹) ^ 2 * (θ i * ‖y i - x₀‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro i
      change θ i * ‖R⁻¹ • (y i - x₀) - 0‖ ^ 2 = _
      rw [sub_zero, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
      ring
    simp_rw [h_term, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← hr₀_sq]
    change (r₀ / κ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * r₀ ^ 2 = κ ^ 2
    field_simp [hr₀_ne, hκ_ne]
  have hy_tilde_tilt : ∑ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y_tilde i) = 0 := by
    have h_in : ∀ i, θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y_tilde i) = inner ℝ p₀ (θ i • y_tilde i) := by
      intro i
      exact (real_inner_smul_right p₀ (y_tilde i) (θ i)).symm
    simp_rw [h_in, ← inner_sum, hy_tilde_mean, inner_zero_right]
  have hy_tilde_val : ∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_tilde i) 1) =
      ((∑ i, θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t₀)) - w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) / R := by
    have h_v : ∀ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_tilde i) 1) =
        (θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime (y i) t₀) - θ i * w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) / R -
          θ i * inner ℝ p₀ (y_tilde i) := by
      intro i
      rw [hv_slice (y_tilde i), hy_tilde_rec i]
      ring
    simp_rw [h_v]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hy_tilde_tilt, sub_zero, ← Finset.sum_div,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hθ_sum, one_mul]
  have hy_tilde_lb : (κ - δ) * κ ≤ ∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_tilde i) 1) := by
    rw [hy_tilde_val]
    have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_def (le_of_lt hR_pos)
    have h_lhs : (κ - δ) * r₀ / R = (κ - δ) * κ := by
      change (κ - δ) * r₀ / (r₀ / κ) = (κ - δ) * κ
      field_simp [hr₀_ne, hκ_ne]
    linarith
  have h_le_env : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_tilde i) 1)) -
      (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_tilde i - 0‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1) ≤
        barycentricEnvelope d 1 v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
    apply le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) + κ ^ 2 / 2, h_bary_ub⟩
    refine ⟨N, θ, y_tilde, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_projSpace, hy_tilde_mean]
    · rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  rw [hy_tilde_var] at h_le_env
  have h_alg : (κ - δ) * κ - κ ^ 2 / (2 * 1) = κ ^ 2 / 2 - κ * δ := by ring
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ η : ℝ), 0 < η →
      ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + η * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hQ : shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime (x + ℓ • Q) (t + ℓ)) - (ℓ / 2) * ‖Q‖ ^ 2 =
      quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
    quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime x t) + inner ℝ Q h - ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) ∧
    quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime x t) + inner ℝ Q h + ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * t)

    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hv_cont
  have _ := hκ
  have projSpace_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t' : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime x' t') = x' := by
    intro x' t'
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have projTime_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t' : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime x' t') = t' := by
    intro x' t'
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  let S_bary : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → Set ℝ := fun y s =>
    { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y_cfg : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y_cfg i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s)) ∧
      val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_cfg i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime y s)))) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s) }
  have hS_mem : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      v (mkSpaceTime y s) ∈ S_bary y s := by
    intro y s
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => y, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
    · simp [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
  have hS_ub : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), 0 < s →
      ∀ val ∈ S_bary y s, val ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2 := by
    intro y s hs val
    rintro ⟨N, θ, y_cfg, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
    rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime] at hy_mean
    rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    have h_var_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2)
    have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = ∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt h_var_nonneg
    have h_j := hv_jensen s N θ y_cfg hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at h_j
    rw [hy_mean] at h_j
    have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ * s) ^ 2 / (2 * s) :=
      div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h_alg : v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ * r - r ^ 2 / (2 * s) =
        v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2 - (r - κ * s) ^ 2 / (2 * s) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hs]
      ring
    have h_step : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_cfg i) s)) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ * r - r ^ 2 / (2 * s) := by
      rw [← hr_sq]
      linarith
    linarith
  have h_sand : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), 0 < s →
      v (mkSpaceTime y s) - κ ^ 2 * s / 2 ≤ shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y s) ∧
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y s) := by
    intro y s hs
    have h_sSup_ge : v (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤ barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y s) :=
      le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2, hS_ub y s hs⟩ (hS_mem y s)
    have h_sSup_le : barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2 :=
      csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime y s), hS_mem y s⟩ (hS_ub y s hs)
    dsimp [shiftedBarycentricEnvelope]
    rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    constructor <;> linarith
  let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
  have h_comp : ∀ (x' y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      W (mkSpaceTime y' (t + ℓ)) - ‖y' - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime x' t) := by
    intro x' y'
    have hs_pos : 0 < t + ℓ := by linarith
    have hη_pos : 0 < 1 / (4 * ℓ) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁⟩ := h_growth (t + ℓ) (t + ℓ) (1 / (4 * ℓ)) hη_pos
    have h_norm_ineq : ∀ y'' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        ‖y''‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y'' - x'‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x'‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro y''
      have h1 : y'' = (y'' - x') + x' := (sub_add_cancel y'' x').symm
      have h2 : ‖y''‖ ^ 2 = ‖y'' - x'‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ (y'' - x') x' + ‖x'‖ ^ 2 := by
        conv_lhs => rw [h1]
        exact norm_add_sq_real (y'' - x') x'
      have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖(y'' - x') - x'‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real] at h3
      linarith
    dsimp [quadEnvelopePlus]
    rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
    apply le_csSup
    · refine ⟨M₁ + ‖x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ), ?_⟩
      rintro val ⟨y'', -, rfl⟩
      dsimp only
      have hW_le : W (mkSpaceTime y'' (t + ℓ)) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y'' (t + ℓ)) :=
        (h_sand y'' (t + ℓ) hs_pos).2
      have hv_le : v (mkSpaceTime y'' (t + ℓ)) ≤ M₁ + (1 / (4 * ℓ)) * ‖y''‖ ^ 2 :=
        le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hM₁ y'' (t + ℓ) (le_refl _) (le_refl _))
      have h_yn := h_norm_ineq y''
      have h_alg : (1 / (4 * ℓ)) * (2 * ‖y'' - x'‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x'‖ ^ 2) - ‖y'' - x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ‖x'‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hℓ]
        ring
      have h_mul : (1 / (4 * ℓ)) * ‖y''‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (1 / (4 * ℓ)) * (2 * ‖y'' - x'‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x'‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_yn (le_of_lt hη_pos)
      linarith
    · exact ⟨y', Set.mem_univ y', rfl⟩
  have h_lower : quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime x t) + inner ℝ Q h - ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) := by
    have h_step := h_comp (x + h) (x + ℓ • Q)
    have h_diff : (x + ℓ • Q) - (x + h) = ℓ • Q - h := by abel
    have h_norm : ‖(x + ℓ • Q) - (x + h)‖ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 * ‖Q‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ℓ * inner ℝ Q h + ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_diff, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hℓ, mul_pow,
        real_inner_smul_left]
      ring
    have h_div : ‖(x + ℓ • Q) - (x + h)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
        (ℓ / 2) * ‖Q‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ Q h + ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) := by
      rw [h_norm]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hℓ]
    linarith
  have h_var_shift : ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (z : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
      (y_bar w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∑ i, θ i = 1) → (∑ i, θ i • z i = y_bar) →
      ∑ i, θ i * ‖(z i - y_bar) + w‖ ^ 2 = (∑ i, θ i * ‖z i - y_bar‖ ^ 2) + ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro N θ z y_bar w hθ_sum hz_mean
    have h_pt : ∀ i : Fin N,
        θ i * ‖(z i - y_bar) + w‖ ^ 2 =
          θ i * ‖z i - y_bar‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ (θ i • (z i - y_bar)) w + θ i * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro i
      rw [norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_left]
      ring
    have h_mean_zero : ∑ i : Fin N, θ i • (z i - y_bar) = 0 := by
      simp_rw [smul_sub]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hz_mean, ← Finset.sum_smul, hθ_sum, one_smul, sub_self]
    simp_rw [h_pt]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← sum_inner,
      h_mean_zero, inner_zero_left, mul_zero, add_zero, ← Finset.sum_mul, hθ_sum, one_mul]
  have h_semiconc : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s α : ℝ),
      0 < s → 0 < α → α < 1 →
      (1 - α) * W (mkSpaceTime y₁ s) + α * W (mkSpaceTime y₂ s) -
        α * (1 - α) * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) ≤
      W (mkSpaceTime ((1 - α) • y₁ + α • y₂) s) := by
    intro y₁ y₂ s α hs hα0 hα1
    have h1α : 0 < 1 - α := by linarith
    let y_α : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (1 - α) • y₁ + α • y₂
    have h_pair_le : ∀ val₁ ∈ S_bary y₁ s, ∀ val₂ ∈ S_bary y₂ s,
        (1 - α) * val₁ + α * val₂ - α * (1 - α) * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) ≤
          barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y_α s) := by
      rintro val₁ ⟨N₁, θ₁, z₁, hθ₁_pos, hθ₁_sum, hz₁_mean, rfl⟩
      rintro val₂ ⟨N₂, θ₂, z₂, hθ₂_pos, hθ₂_sum, hz₂_mean, rfl⟩
      rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime] at hz₁_mean hz₂_mean
      simp_rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      let θ_cat : Fin (N₁ + N₂) → ℝ :=
        @Fin.addCases N₁ N₂ (fun _ => ℝ) (fun i => (1 - α) * θ₁ i) (fun j => α * θ₂ j)
      let z_cat : Fin (N₁ + N₂) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
        @Fin.addCases N₁ N₂ (fun _ => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) z₁ z₂
      have hθ_cat_pos : ∀ k : Fin (N₁ + N₂), 0 < θ_cat k := by
        intro k
        refine @Fin.addCases N₁ N₂ (fun k => 0 < θ_cat k) ?_ ?_ k
        · intro i
          dsimp [θ_cat]
          rw [Fin.addCases_left]
          exact mul_pos h1α (hθ₁_pos i)
        · intro j
          dsimp [θ_cat]
          rw [Fin.addCases_right]
          exact mul_pos hα0 (hθ₂_pos j)
      have hθ_cat_sum : ∑ k : Fin (N₁ + N₂), θ_cat k = 1 := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
        simp only [θ_cat, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hθ₁_sum, hθ₂_sum]
        ring
      have hz_cat_mean : ∑ k : Fin (N₁ + N₂), θ_cat k • z_cat k = projSpace (mkSpaceTime y_α s) := by
        rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, Fin.sum_univ_add]
        simp only [θ_cat, z_cat, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, mul_smul]
        rw [← Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.smul_sum, hz₁_mean, hz₂_mean]
      have hv_cat : ∑ k : Fin (N₁ + N₂),
          θ_cat k * v (mkSpaceTime (z_cat k) (projTime (mkSpaceTime y_α s))) =
          (1 - α) * (∑ i : Fin N₁, θ₁ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z₁ i) s)) +
          α * (∑ j : Fin N₂, θ₂ j * v (mkSpaceTime (z₂ j) s)) := by
        rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime, Fin.sum_univ_add]
        simp only [θ_cat, z_cat, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, mul_assoc]
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have h_shift₁ : ∀ i : Fin N₁, z₁ i - y_α = (z₁ i - y₁) + (-(α • (y₂ - y₁))) := by
        intro i
        dsimp [y_α]
        rw [sub_smul 1 α y₁, one_smul, smul_sub]
        abel
      have h_shift₂ : ∀ j : Fin N₂, z₂ j - y_α = (z₂ j - y₂) + ((1 - α) • (y₂ - y₁)) := by
        intro j
        dsimp [y_α]
        rw [smul_sub, sub_smul, sub_smul, one_smul, one_smul]
        abel
      have h_norm_w₁ : ‖-(α • (y₂ - y₁))‖ ^ 2 = α ^ 2 * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hα0, mul_pow]
      have h_norm_w₂ : ‖(1 - α) • (y₂ - y₁)‖ ^ 2 = (1 - α) ^ 2 * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h1α, mul_pow]
      have hvar_cat : ∑ k : Fin (N₁ + N₂),
          θ_cat k * ‖z_cat k - projSpace (mkSpaceTime y_α s)‖ ^ 2 =
          (1 - α) * (∑ i : Fin N₁, θ₁ i * ‖z₁ i - y₁‖ ^ 2) +
          α * (∑ j : Fin N₂, θ₂ j * ‖z₂ j - y₂‖ ^ 2) +
          α * (1 - α) * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, Fin.sum_univ_add]
        simp only [θ_cat, z_cat, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, mul_assoc]
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        simp_rw [h_shift₁, h_shift₂]
        rw [h_var_shift N₁ θ₁ z₁ y₁ (-(α • (y₂ - y₁))) hθ₁_sum hz₁_mean,
            h_var_shift N₂ θ₂ z₂ y₂ ((1 - α) • (y₂ - y₁)) hθ₂_sum hz₂_mean,
            h_norm_w₁, h_norm_w₂]
        ring
      have h_cat_mem : (1 - α) * ((∑ i, θ₁ i * v (mkSpaceTime (z₁ i) s)) -
          (∑ i, θ₁ i * ‖z₁ i - y₁‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s)) +
        α * ((∑ j, θ₂ j * v (mkSpaceTime (z₂ j) s)) -
          (∑ j, θ₂ j * ‖z₂ j - y₂‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s)) -
        α * (1 - α) * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) ∈ S_bary y_α s := by
        refine ⟨N₁ + N₂, θ_cat, z_cat, hθ_cat_pos, hθ_cat_sum, hz_cat_mean, ?_⟩
        rw [hv_cat, hvar_cat]
        ring
      exact le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime y_α s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2, hS_ub y_α s hs⟩ h_cat_mem
    have h_step1 : ∀ val₂ ∈ S_bary y₂ s,
        (1 - α) * barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y₁ s) + α * val₂ -
          α * (1 - α) * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) ≤
        barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y_α s) := by
      intro val₂ hval₂
      have h_sup₁ : barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y₁ s) ≤
          (barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y_α s) - α * val₂ +
            α * (1 - α) * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s)) / (1 - α) := by
        apply csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime y₁ s), hS_mem y₁ s⟩
        intro val₁ hval₁
        rw [le_div_iff₀ h1α]
        have hp := h_pair_le val₁ hval₁ val₂ hval₂
        linarith
      rw [le_div_iff₀ h1α] at h_sup₁
      linarith
    have h_step2 : (1 - α) * barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y₁ s) +
        α * barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y₂ s) -
        α * (1 - α) * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) ≤
        barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y_α s) := by
      have h_sup₂ : barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y₂ s) ≤
          (barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y_α s) -
            (1 - α) * barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y₁ s) +
            α * (1 - α) * ‖y₂ - y₁‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s)) / α := by
        apply csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime y₂ s), hS_mem y₂ s⟩
        intro val₂ hval₂
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hα0]
        have hp := h_step1 val₂ hval₂
        linarith
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hα0] at h_sup₂
      linarith
    dsimp [W, shiftedBarycentricEnvelope]
    rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    linarith
  have h_upper : quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime x t) + inner ℝ Q h + ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * t) := by
    let s : ℝ := t + ℓ
    have hs_pos : 0 < s := by dsimp [s]; linarith
    let y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x + ℓ • Q
    change sSup ((fun y =>
        W (mkSpaceTime y (projTime (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t) + ℓ)) -
          ‖y - projSpace (mkSpaceTime (x + h) t)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ) ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ W (mkSpaceTime x t) + inner ℝ Q h + ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * t)
    rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
    have h_ne_xh : ((fun y => W (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - ‖y - (x + h)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) ''
        Set.univ).Nonempty :=
      ⟨W (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - ‖(x + h) - (x + h)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ),
        ⟨x + h, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩
    apply csSup_le h_ne_xh
    rintro val ⟨y', -, rfl⟩
    dsimp only
    let u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := y' - y
    have h_first_order : W (mkSpaceTime y' s) - W (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤
        inner ℝ Q u + ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) := by
      let A : ℝ := W (mkSpaceTime y' s) - W (mkSpaceTime y s) - inner ℝ Q u - ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s)
      let B : ℝ := ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)
      have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ B := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have h_alpha_bound : ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1 → A ≤ α * B := by
        intro α hα0 hα1
        let y_α : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (1 - α) • y + α • y'
        have hy_α_diff : y_α - x = ℓ • Q + α • u := by
          dsimp [y_α, y, u]
          rw [sub_smul 1 α (x + ℓ • Q), one_smul, smul_sub]
          abel
        have hy_α_norm : ‖y_α - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
            (ℓ / 2) * ‖Q‖ ^ 2 + α * inner ℝ Q u + α ^ 2 * B := by
          rw [hy_α_diff, norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul ℓ Q, norm_smul α u,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hℓ, abs_of_pos hα0,
            mul_pow, mul_pow, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
          dsimp [B]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hℓ]
        have h_comp_α := h_comp x y_α
        have h_W_α_ub : W (mkSpaceTime y_α s) ≤
            W (mkSpaceTime y s) + α * inner ℝ Q u + α ^ 2 * B := by
          dsimp [s, y] at h_comp_α ⊢
          linarith [h_comp_α, hQ, hy_α_norm]
        have h_sc := h_semiconc y y' s α hs_pos hα0 hα1
        have h_u_eq : y' - y = u := rfl
        rw [h_u_eq] at h_sc
        have h_alg_sc : (1 - α) * W (mkSpaceTime y s) + α * W (mkSpaceTime y' s) -
            α * (1 - α) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) =
            W (mkSpaceTime y s) + α * (W (mkSpaceTime y' s) - W (mkSpaceTime y s) - ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s)) +
            α ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) := by ring
        have h_drop : 0 ≤ α ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) :=
          div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
        have h_comb : α * A ≤ α * (α * B) - α ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) := by
          have h_alg_A : α * A = α * (W (mkSpaceTime y' s) - W (mkSpaceTime y s) - ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s)) -
              α * inner ℝ Q u := by dsimp [A]; ring
          have h_alg_B : α * (α * B) = α ^ 2 * B := by ring
          dsimp [y_α] at h_sc h_W_α_ub
          linarith [h_sc, h_W_α_ub, h_alg_sc, h_alg_A, h_alg_B]
        have h_comb2 : α * A ≤ α * (α * B) := by linarith
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_comb2 hα0
      have hA_nonpos : A ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra hA_pos
        push_neg at hA_pos
        let α₀ : ℝ := min (1 / 2) (A / (2 * (B + 1)))
        have hB1_pos : 0 < B + 1 := by linarith
        have hα₀_pos : 0 < α₀ := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hA_pos (by positivity))
        have hα₀_lt1 : α₀ < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
        have hα₀_le : α₀ ≤ A / (2 * (B + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
        have h_ab := h_alpha_bound α₀ hα₀_pos hα₀_lt1
        have h_mul1 : α₀ * B ≤ (A / (2 * (B + 1))) * B :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα₀_le hB_nonneg
        have h_mul2 : (A / (2 * (B + 1))) * B ≤ (A / (2 * (B + 1))) * (B + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt (div_pos hA_pos (by positivity)))
        have h_id : (A / (2 * (B + 1))) * (B + 1) = A / 2 := by
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hB1_pos]
        linarith
      dsimp [A] at hA_nonpos
      linarith
    have hy'_diff : y' - (x + h) = ℓ • Q + (u - h) := by
      dsimp [u, y]
      abel
    have hy'_norm : ‖y' - (x + h)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
        (ℓ / 2) * ‖Q‖ ^ 2 + inner ℝ Q u - inner ℝ Q h + ‖u - h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) := by
      rw [hy'_diff, norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul ℓ Q, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hℓ,
        mul_pow, real_inner_smul_left, inner_sub_right]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hℓ]
      ring
    have h_csq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (t / (2 * ℓ * s)) * ‖u - (s / t) • h‖ ^ 2 := by
      positivity
    have h_csq_id : ‖u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * s) - ‖u - h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
        ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * t) - (t / (2 * ℓ * s)) * ‖u - (s / t) • h‖ ^ 2 := by
      have hst_pos : 0 < s / t := div_pos hs_pos ht
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real u h, norm_sub_sq_real u ((s / t) • h),
        norm_smul (s / t) h, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hst_pos, mul_pow,
        real_inner_smul_right]
      dsimp [s]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt ht, ne_of_gt hℓ, ne_of_gt hs_pos]
      ring
    dsimp [s, y] at h_first_order h_csq_id h_csq_nonneg
    linarith [h_first_order, hy'_norm, h_csq_id, h_csq_nonneg, hQ]
  exact ⟨h_lower, h_upper⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ η : ℝ), 0 < η →
      ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + η * ‖y‖ ^ 2) :
    (∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s ε : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < ε →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime y (s + ε)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) ≤
        quadEnvelopePlus d ε (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x s) ∧
      quadEnvelopeMinus d ε v (mkSpaceTime x s) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime y (s - ε)) + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε)) ∧
    ∃ (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < t →
        IsOptimizingStepTriple d κ ε v x t (Q_plus x t ε) (Q_minus x t ε) (Q_zero x t ε)) ∧
      (∀ (R T : ℝ), 2 ≤ R → 2 ≤ T →
        ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧
          ∀ (ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
            0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → ‖x‖ ≤ R → ε < t → t ≤ T →
            ‖ε • Q_plus x t ε‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖ε • Q_minus x t ε‖ ≤ 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  have projSpace_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),

subgoal_signatures.name: envelope_attainment_and_slope_monotonicity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) :
    (∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))) ∧
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ₁ → ℓ₁ ≤ ℓ₂ →
      slopePlus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopePlus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      slopeMinus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_nonneg : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ psiPotential s := by
    intro s
    dsimp [psiPotential]
    have h_id : 2 * s ^ 2 * (Real.log s) ^ 2 - 6 * s ^ 2 * Real.log s + 8 * s ^ 2 =
        2 * (s * Real.log s - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 + (7 / 2 : ℝ) * s ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h_id]
    positivity
  let psiDeriv : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 4 * t * (Real.log t) ^ 2 - 8 * t * Real.log t + 10 * t
  let psiDeriv2 : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 4 * (Real.log t) ^ 2 + 2
  have hPsi' : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt psiPotential (psiDeriv t) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x) 1 t := hasDerivAt_id t
    have h_log : HasDerivAt Real.log t⁻¹ t := Real.hasDerivAt_log ht
    have h_sq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (↑(2 : ℕ) * t ^ (2 - 1) * 1) t := h_id.pow 2
    have h_log_sq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.log x ^ 2) (↑(2 : ℕ) * Real.log t ^ (2 - 1) * t⁻¹) t := h_log.pow 2
    have h_raw : HasDerivAt psiPotential
        (2 * (↑(2 : ℕ) * t ^ (2 - 1) * 1) * Real.log t ^ 2 +
          2 * t ^ 2 * (↑(2 : ℕ) * Real.log t ^ (2 - 1) * t⁻¹) -
          (6 * (↑(2 : ℕ) * t ^ (2 - 1) * 1) * Real.log t + 6 * t ^ 2 * t⁻¹) +
          8 * (↑(2 : ℕ) * t ^ (2 - 1) * 1)) t :=
      (((h_sq.const_mul (2 : ℝ)).mul h_log_sq).sub ((h_sq.const_mul (6 : ℝ)).mul h_log)).add
        (h_sq.const_mul (8 : ℝ))
    exact h_raw.congr_deriv (by dsimp [psiDeriv]; field_simp [ht]; ring)
  have hPsi'' : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt psiDeriv (psiDeriv2 t) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x) 1 t := hasDerivAt_id t
    have h_log : HasDerivAt Real.log t⁻¹ t := Real.hasDerivAt_log ht
    have h_log_sq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.log x ^ 2) (↑(2 : ℕ) * Real.log t ^ (2 - 1) * t⁻¹) t := h_log.pow 2
    have h_raw : HasDerivAt psiDeriv
        (4 * 1 * Real.log t ^ 2 + 4 * t * (↑(2 : ℕ) * Real.log t ^ (2 - 1) * t⁻¹) -
          (8 * 1 * Real.log t + 8 * t * t⁻¹) + 10 * 1) t :=
      (((h_id.const_mul (4 : ℝ)).mul h_log_sq).sub ((h_id.const_mul (8 : ℝ)).mul h_log)).add
        (h_id.const_mul (10 : ℝ))
    exact h_raw.congr_deriv (by dsimp [psiDeriv2]; field_simp [ht]; ring)
  have h_mono : ∀ s T : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ T → psiPotential s ≤ psiPotential T := by
    intro s T hs hsT

        intro x hx
        have hx_ne : x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hs hx.1)
        exact (hPsi' x hx_ne).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have h_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo s T, HasDerivAt psiPotential (psiDeriv x) x := by
        intro x hx
        have hx_ne : x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_trans hs hx.1)
        exact hPsi' x hx_ne
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hc_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope psiPotential psiDeriv hlt h_cont h_deriv
      have hc_pos : 0 < c := lt_trans hs hc.1
      have h_deriv_nonneg : 0 ≤ psiDeriv c := by
        dsimp [psiDeriv]
        have h_id : 4 * c * (Real.log c) ^ 2 - 8 * c * Real.log c + 10 * c =

        rw [h_id]

        rw [hc_eq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hTs)]

    intro s ε hε hsε

    have hF_cont : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc 0 ε) :=
      fun u hu => (hF_deriv u hu).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hF_deriv_oo : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) ε, HasDerivAt F (F' u) u :=
      fun u hu => hF_deriv u (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hu)
    obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁, hu₁_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope F F' hε hF_cont hF_deriv_oo
    have hF_diff : F ε - F 0 = F' u₁ * ε := by
      have h_sub : ε - 0 = ε := sub_zero ε
      rw [h_sub] at hu₁_eq
      rw [hu₁_eq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hε)]
    let a₁ : ℝ := (s - ε) + u₁
    let b₁ : ℝ := s + u₁
    have hab₁ : a₁ < b₁ := by dsimp [a₁, b₁]; linarith
    have hPsi'_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a₁ b₁, HasDerivAt psiDeriv (psiDeriv2 x) x := by
      intro x hx
      have hx_ne : x ≠ 0 := by
        have : a₁ ≤ x := hx.1
        dsimp [a₁] at this
        linarith [hu₁.1]
      exact hPsi'' x hx_ne
    have hPsi'_cont : ContinuousOn psiDeriv (Set.Icc a₁ b₁) :=
      fun x hx => (hPsi'_deriv x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hPsi'_deriv_oo : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a₁ b₁, HasDerivAt psiDeriv (psiDeriv2 x) x :=
      fun x hx => hPsi'_deriv x (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hx)
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξ_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope psiDeriv psiDeriv2 hab₁ hPsi'_cont hPsi'_deriv_oo
    have hF'_eq : F' u₁ = psiDeriv2 ξ * ε := by
      have h_ba : b₁ - a₁ = ε := by dsimp [a₁, b₁]; ring
      have h_num : psiDeriv b₁ - psiDeriv a₁ = F' u₁ := rfl
      rw [h_ba, h_num] at hξ_eq
      rw [hξ_eq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hε)]
    have h_sec_id : (psiPotential (s + ε) + psiPotential (s - ε)) / 2 - psiPotential s =
        (F ε - F 0) / 2 := by
      dsimp [F]
      have h1 : (s - ε) + ε = s := by ring
      have h2 : s + 0 = s := by ring
      have h3 : (s - ε) + 0 = s - ε := by ring
      rw [h1, h2, h3]
      ring
    have h_sec_xi : (psiPotential (s + ε) + psiPotential (s - ε)) / 2 - psiPotential s =
        ε ^ 2 * (2 * (Real.log ξ) ^ 2 + 1) := by
      rw [h_sec_id, hF_diff, hF'_eq]
      dsimp [psiDeriv2]
      ring
    have hs_pos : 0 < s := by linarith
    have hξ_gt : s - ε < ξ := by
      have : a₁ < ξ := hξ.1
      dsimp [a₁] at this
      linarith [hu₁.1]
    have hξ_lt : ξ < s + ε := by
      have : ξ < b₁ := hξ.2
      dsimp [b₁] at this
      linarith [hu₁.2]
    have hξ_pos : 0 < ξ := by linarith
    have h_s_div_xi : s / ξ ≤ 4 / 3 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hξ_pos]
      linarith
    have h_xi_div_s : ξ / s ≤ 5 / 4 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hs_pos]
      linarith
    have h_log_diff1 : Real.log s - Real.log ξ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have h_log_eq : Real.log (s / ξ) = Real.log s - Real.log ξ :=
        Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hs_pos) (ne_of_gt hξ_pos)
      have h_log_le : Real.log (s / ξ) ≤ s / ξ - 1 :=
        Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hs_pos hξ_pos)
      linarith
    have h_log_diff2 : Real.log ξ - Real.log s ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have h_log_eq : Real.log (ξ / s) = Real.log ξ - Real.log s :=
        Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hξ_pos) (ne_of_gt hs_pos)
      have h_log_le : Real.log (ξ / s) ≤ ξ / s - 1 :=
        Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hξ_pos hs_pos)
      linarith
    have h_log_quad : (Real.log s) ^ 2 + 1 / 2 ≤ 2 * (Real.log ξ) ^ 2 + 1 := by
      have h_sos : (2 * (Real.log ξ) ^ 2 + 1) - ((Real.log s) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) =
          (2 * Real.log ξ - Real.log s) ^ 2 +
            2 * (1 / 2 - (Real.log s - Real.log ξ)) * (1 / 2 + (Real.log s - Real.log ξ)) := by
        ring
      have h_f1 : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 - (Real.log s - Real.log ξ) := by linarith
      have h_f2 : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 + (Real.log s - Real.log ξ) := by linarith
      have h_prod : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 / 2 - (Real.log s - Real.log ξ)) * (1 / 2 + (Real.log s - Real.log ξ)) := by
        positivity
      have h_sq : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.log ξ - Real.log s) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
    rw [h_sec_xi]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log_quad (sq_nonneg ε)
  exact ⟨h_nonneg, h_mono, h_sec_diff⟩
