proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε' S_max M_vel C_vel B₀ y s act q_plus q_minus q_zero
    hε' hS_max hM_vel hC_vel hB₀ h_init h_pred h_step h_sh h_disc
  have h_card : (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, (1 : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin]
  have h_two_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by positivity
  have h_two_pow_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ h := le_of_lt h_two_pow_pos
  have h_flip_invol : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Involutive (flipBit h n) := by
    intro n ω
    ext i
    dsimp [flipBit]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have h_sum_flip : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ),
      (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, F (flipBit h n ω)) = ∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, F ω := by
    intro n F
    exact Fintype.sum_bijective (flipBit h n) (h_flip_invol n).bijective
      (fun ω => F (flipBit h n ω)) F (fun _ => rfl)
  have h_bit_flip_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ), n < h → ∀ (ω : Fin h → Bool),
      walkStepBit h (flipBit h n ω) n = !(walkStepBit h ω n) := by
    intro n hn ω
    dsimp [walkStepBit, flipBit]
    rw [dif_pos hn, dif_pos hn, if_pos rfl]
  have h_bit_flip_lt : ∀ (k n : ℕ), k < n → n < h → ∀ (ω : Fin h → Bool),
      walkStepBit h (flipBit h n ω) k = walkStepBit h ω k := by
    intro k n hkn hn ω
    have hkh : k < h := lt_trans hkn hn
    have hkne : k ≠ n := ne_of_lt hkn
    dsimp [walkStepBit, flipBit]
    rw [dif_pos hkh, dif_pos hkh, if_neg hkne]
  have h_s_pair : ∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      s (n + 1) ω + s (n + 1) (flipBit h n ω) = 2 * s n ω := by
    intro n hn ω
    have h_s_pred : s n (flipBit h n ω) = s n ω := (h_pred n n (le_refl n) hn ω).2.1
    have h_act_pred : act n (flipBit h n ω) = act n ω := (h_pred n n (le_refl n) hn ω).2.2.1
    cases h_act : act n ω
    · have h_act' : act n (flipBit h n ω) = false := h_act_pred.trans h_act
      have hs1 := ((h_step n hn ω).2 h_act).2
      have hs2 := ((h_step n hn (flipBit h n ω)).2 h_act').2
      linarith
    · have h_act' : act n (flipBit h n ω) = true := h_act_pred.trans h_act
      have hs1 := ((h_step n hn ω).1 h_act).2.1
      have hs2 := ((h_step n hn (flipBit h n ω)).1 h_act').2.1
      rw [h_bit_flip_eq n hn ω, h_s_pred] at hs2
      cases h_bit : walkStepBit h ω n <;> simp [h_bit] at hs1 hs2 <;> linarith
  have h_s_sum_step : ∀ n < h, (∑ ω, s (n + 1) ω) = ∑ ω, s n ω := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 : (∑ ω, (s (n + 1) ω + s (n + 1) (flipBit h n ω))) = ∑ ω, (2 * s n ω) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => h_s_pair n hn ω)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, h_sum_flip n (fun ω => s (n + 1) ω), ← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
    linarith
  have h_s_expect : uniformExp h (fun ω => s h ω) = 1 := by
    dsimp [uniformExp]
    have h_tele := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => ∑ ω, s n ω) h
    have h_zero : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, ((∑ ω, s (n + 1) ω) - (∑ ω, s n ω)) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro n hn
      rw [h_s_sum_step n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn), sub_self]
    have h_s0 : (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, s 0 ω) = (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
      trans (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, (1 : ℝ))
      · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => (h_init ω).2)
      · exact h_card
    have h_sh_sum : (∑ ω, s h ω) = (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by linarith
    rw [h_sh_sum, div_self (ne_of_gt h_two_pow_pos)]
  have h_psi_pair : ∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      2 * (if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) else 0) ≤
        psiPotential (s (n + 1) ω) + psiPotential (s (n + 1) (flipBit h n ω)) -
          2 * psiPotential (s n ω) := by
    intro n hn ω
    have h_s_pred : s n (flipBit h n ω) = s n ω := (h_pred n n (le_refl n) hn ω).2.1
    have h_act_pred : act n (flipBit h n ω) = act n ω := (h_pred n n (le_refl n) hn ω).2.2.1
    cases h_act : act n ω
    · have h_act' : act n (flipBit h n ω) = false := h_act_pred.trans h_act
      have hs1 := ((h_step n hn ω).2 h_act).2
      have hs2 := ((h_step n hn (flipBit h n ω)).2 h_act').2
      simp [h_act, hs1, hs2, h_s_pred]
      linarith
    · have h_act' : act n (flipBit h n ω) = true := h_act_pred.trans h_act
      have hs1 := ((h_step n hn ω).1 h_act).2.1
      have hs2 := ((h_step n hn (flipBit h n ω)).1 h_act').2.1
      have h4ε := ((h_step n hn ω).1 h_act).2.2.1
      have h_conv := h_psi.2.2 (s n ω) ε' hε' h4ε
      rw [h_bit_flip_eq n hn ω, h_s_pred] at hs2
      simp only [h_act, ↓reduceIte]
      cases h_bit : walkStepBit h ω n <;> simp [h_bit] at hs1 hs2 <;> rw [hs1, hs2] <;> linarith
  have h_psi_sum_step : ∀ n < h,
      (∑ ω, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) else 0) ≤
        (∑ ω, psiPotential (s (n + 1) ω)) - (∑ ω, psiPotential (s n ω)) := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω (_ : ω ∈ Finset.univ) => h_psi_pair n hn ω)
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        h_sum_flip n (fun ω => psiPotential (s (n + 1) ω)), ← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
    linarith
  have h_occ_sum : (∑ ω, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) else 0) ≤
      psiPotential S_max * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n (hn : n ∈ Finset.range h) =>
      h_psi_sum_step n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn))
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => ∑ ω, psiPotential (s n ω)) h] at h1
    have h_s0_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, psiPotential (s 0 ω) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => h_psi.1 (s 0 ω))
    have h_sh_le : (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, psiPotential (s h ω)) ≤ psiPotential S_max * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
      calc (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, psiPotential (s h ω))
        _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, psiPotential S_max :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_psi.2.1 (s h ω) S_max (h_sh ω).1 (h_sh ω).2)
        _ = (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, (1 : ℝ)) * psiPotential S_max := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul, one_mul]
        _ = psiPotential S_max * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by rw [h_card, mul_comm]
    linarith
  have h_act_eps_sum : (∑ ω, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 else 0) ≤
      2 * psiPotential S_max * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    have h_pt : ∀ ω, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 else 0) ≤
        2 * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) else 0) := by
      intro ω
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n _
      split_ifs
      · nlinarith [sq_nonneg ε', sq_nonneg (Real.log (s n ω))]
      · norm_num
    have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω (_ : ω ∈ Finset.univ) => h_pt ω)
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
    linarith
  have h_act_eps_expect : uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 else 0) ≤ 2 * psiPotential S_max := by
    dsimp [uniformExp]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ h_two_pow_pos).mpr h_act_eps_sum
  let M_step : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun k ω => if act k ω then (if walkStepBit h ω k then ε' • q_zero k ω else -(ε' • q_zero k ω)) else 0
  let M_sum : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun n ω => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, M_step k ω
  have h_M_pred : ∀ n < h, ∀ ω, M_sum n (flipBit h n ω) = M_sum n ω := by
    intro n hn ω
    dsimp [M_sum, M_step]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    have hkn : k < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
    have h_act_k : act k (flipBit h n ω) = act k ω := (h_pred k n (le_of_lt hkn) hn ω).2.2.1
    have h_q0_k : q_zero k (flipBit h n ω) = q_zero k ω := (h_pred k n (le_of_lt hkn) hn ω).2.2.2
    have h_bit_k : walkStepBit h (flipBit h n ω) k = walkStepBit h ω k := h_bit_flip_lt k n hkn hn ω
    rw [h_act_k, h_q0_k, h_bit_k]
  have h_M_pair : ∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      ‖M_sum (n + 1) ω‖ ^ 2 + ‖M_sum (n + 1) (flipBit h n ω)‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ‖M_sum n ω‖ ^ 2 =
        2 * (if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 else 0) := by
    intro n hn ω
    have h_Mn : M_sum n (flipBit h n ω) = M_sum n ω := h_M_pred n hn ω
    have h_act_n : act n (flipBit h n ω) = act n ω := (h_pred n n (le_refl n) hn ω).2.2.1
    have h_q0_n : q_zero n (flipBit h n ω) = q_zero n ω := (h_pred n n (le_refl n) hn ω).2.2.2
    have h_bit_n : walkStepBit h (flipBit h n ω) n = !(walkStepBit h ω n) := h_bit_flip_eq n hn ω
    have h_succ1 : M_sum (n + 1) ω = M_sum n ω + M_step n ω :=
      Finset.sum_range_succ (fun k => M_step k ω) n
    have h_succ2 : M_sum (n + 1) (flipBit h n ω) = M_sum n ω + M_step n (flipBit h n ω) := by
      rw [← h_Mn]
      exact Finset.sum_range_succ (fun k => M_step k (flipBit h n ω)) n
    rw [h_succ1, h_succ2]
    dsimp [M_step]
    rw [h_act_n, h_q0_n, h_bit_n]
    cases h_act : act n ω
    · simp
      ring
    · simp only [↓reduceIte]
      have h_para : ‖M_sum n ω + ε' • q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 + ‖M_sum n ω + -(ε' • q_zero n ω)‖ ^ 2 -
          2 * ‖M_sum n ω‖ ^ 2 = 2 * ((ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2) := by
        rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, norm_add_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real]
        have h_ns : ‖ε' • q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 = (ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
        linarith
      cases h_bit : walkStepBit h ω n <;> simp [h_bit] <;> linarith [h_para]
  have h_M_sum_step : ∀ n < h,
      (∑ ω, ‖M_sum (n + 1) ω‖ ^ 2) - (∑ ω, ‖M_sum n ω‖ ^ 2) =
        ∑ ω, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 : (∑ ω, (‖M_sum (n + 1) ω‖ ^ 2 + ‖M_sum (n + 1) (flipBit h n ω)‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ‖M_sum n ω‖ ^ 2)) =
        ∑ ω, 2 * (if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => h_M_pair n hn ω)
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        h_sum_flip n (fun ω => ‖M_sum (n + 1) ω‖ ^ 2),
        ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
    linarith
  have h_q0_sq_le : ∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      (if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
        4 * (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 *
          (if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) else 0) := by
    intro n hn ω
    cases h_act : act n ω
    · simp
    · simp only [↓reduceIte]
      have h_vel_n : ‖q_zero n ω‖ ≤ M_vel + C_vel * |Real.log (s n ω)| :=
        ((h_step n hn ω).1 h_act).2.2.2
      have h_L_nonneg : 0 ≤ |Real.log (s n ω)| := abs_nonneg _
      have h_q_le : ‖q_zero n ω‖ ≤ (M_vel + C_vel) * (1 + |Real.log (s n ω)|) := by
        nlinarith
      have h_q_sq : ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((M_vel + C_vel) * (1 + |Real.log (s n ω)|)) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (q_zero n ω)]
      have h_L_sq : |Real.log (s n ω)| ^ 2 = (Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 := sq_abs _
      have h_mult : (1 + |Real.log (s n ω)|) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|Real.log (s n ω)| - 1)]
      have h_comb : ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) := by
        calc ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2
          _ ≤ (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 * (1 + |Real.log (s n ω)|) ^ 2 := by
              linarith [show ((M_vel + C_vel) * (1 + |Real.log (s n ω)|)) ^ 2 =
                (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 * (1 + |Real.log (s n ω)|) ^ 2 by ring]
          _ ≤ (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 * (4 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mult (sq_nonneg _)
          _ = 4 * (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) := by ring
      have h_eps_comb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_comb (sq_nonneg ε')
      linarith
  have h_M_sq_sum : (∑ ω, ‖M_sum h ω‖ ^ 2) ≤
      4 * (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 * psiPotential S_max * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    have h_tele := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => ∑ ω, ‖M_sum n ω‖ ^ 2) h
    have h_M0 : (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, ‖M_sum 0 ω‖ ^ 2) = 0 := by
      simp [M_sum]
    have h_eq : (∑ ω, ‖M_sum h ω‖ ^ 2) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, ∑ ω, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
      have h1 : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, ((∑ ω, ‖M_sum (n + 1) ω‖ ^ 2) - (∑ ω, ‖M_sum n ω‖ ^ 2))) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, ∑ ω, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => h_M_sum_step n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn))
      linarith
    rw [h_eq, Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_le : (∑ ω, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ‖q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
        4 * (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 *
          (∑ ω, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 * ((Real.log (s n ω)) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) else 0) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro ω _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n hn => h_q0_sq_le n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) ω)
    have h_mult_occ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_occ_sum (show 0 ≤ 4 * (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 by positivity)
    linarith
  have h_psi_nonneg : 0 ≤ psiPotential S_max := h_psi.1 S_max
  have h_M_l1_sum : (∑ ω, ‖M_sum h ω‖) ≤
      2 * (M_vel + C_vel) * Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    have h_cs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ (fun ω => ‖M_sum h ω‖) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    simp only [mul_one, one_pow, h_card] at h_cs
    have h_rhs_le : (∑ ω, ‖M_sum h ω‖ ^ 2) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≤
        (2 * (M_vel + C_vel) * Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 2 := by
      calc (∑ ω, ‖M_sum h ω‖ ^ 2) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h
        _ ≤ (4 * (M_vel + C_vel) ^ 2 * psiPotential S_max * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_M_sq_sum h_two_pow_nonneg
        _ = (2 * (M_vel + C_vel) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max)) ^ 2 := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt h_psi_nonneg]
            ring
        _ = (2 * (M_vel + C_vel) * Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_sq_le : (∑ ω, ‖M_sum h ω‖) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * (M_vel + C_vel) * Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 2 :=
      le_trans h_cs h_rhs_le
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => norm_nonneg _)),
        Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h_sqrt
    exact h_sqrt
  let f_step : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun n ω => if act n ω then ε' else 0
  let g_step : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun n ω => if act n ω then
      (if walkStepBit h ω n then ‖q_plus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ else ‖q_minus n ω - q_zero n ω‖)
    else 0
  have h_err_step_norm : ∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      ‖(y (n + 1) ω - M_sum (n + 1) ω) - (y n ω - M_sum n ω)‖ = f_step n ω * g_step n ω := by
    intro n hn ω
    have h_succ : M_sum (n + 1) ω = M_sum n ω + M_step n ω :=
      Finset.sum_range_succ (fun k => M_step k ω) n
    have h_rearr : (y (n + 1) ω - M_sum (n + 1) ω) - (y n ω - M_sum n ω) =
        (y (n + 1) ω - y n ω) - M_step n ω := by
      rw [h_succ]
      abel
    rw [h_rearr]
    dsimp [M_step, f_step, g_step]
    cases h_act : act n ω
    · have hy := ((h_step n hn ω).2 h_act).1
      simp [hy]
    · have hy := ((h_step n hn ω).1 h_act).1
      simp only [↓reduceIte]
      cases h_bit : walkStepBit h ω n
      · simp only [h_bit, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hy ⊢
        have h_vec : y (n + 1) ω - y n ω - -(ε' • q_zero n ω) =
            -(ε' • (q_minus n ω - q_zero n ω)) := by
          rw [hy, smul_sub]
          abel
        rw [h_vec, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hε')]
      · simp only [h_bit, ↓reduceIte] at hy ⊢
        have h_vec : y (n + 1) ω - y n ω - ε' • q_zero n ω =
            ε' • (q_plus n ω - q_zero n ω) := by
          rw [hy, smul_sub]
          abel
        rw [h_vec, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hε')]
  let A_path : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 else 0
  let B_path : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (‖q_plus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 + ‖q_minus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2) else 0
  have h_A_nonneg : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ A_path ω := by
    intro ω
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro n _
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  have h_B_nonneg : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ B_path ω := by
    intro ω
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro n _
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  have h_err_path : ∀ ω, ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (A_path ω) * Real.sqrt (B_path ω) := by
    intro ω
    have h_tele := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => y n ω - M_sum n ω) h
    have h_zero0 : y 0 ω - M_sum 0 ω = 0 := by
      simp [(h_init ω).1, M_sum]
    rw [h_zero0, sub_zero] at h_tele
    have h_norm_le : ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, f_step n ω * g_step n ω := by
      rw [← h_tele]
      calc ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, ((y (n + 1) ω - M_sum (n + 1) ω) - (y n ω - M_sum n ω))‖
        _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, ‖(y (n + 1) ω - M_sum (n + 1) ω) - (y n ω - M_sum n ω)‖ :=
            norm_sum_le _ _
        _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, f_step n ω * g_step n ω :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => h_err_step_norm n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) ω)
    have h_cs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (Finset.range h) (fun n => f_step n ω) (fun n => g_step n ω)
    have h_f_sq : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, (f_step n ω) ^ 2) = A_path ω := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      dsimp [f_step]
      split_ifs <;> ring
    have h_g_sq : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, (g_step n ω) ^ 2) ≤ B_path ω := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n _
      dsimp [g_step]
      split_ifs <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖q_plus n ω - q_zero n ω‖, sq_nonneg ‖q_minus n ω - q_zero n ω‖]
    have h_sq_le : ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (A_path ω) * Real.sqrt (B_path ω)) ^ 2 := by
      calc ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖ ^ 2
        _ ≤ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, f_step n ω * g_step n ω) ^ 2 := by
            nlinarith [norm_nonneg (y h ω - M_sum h ω)]
        _ ≤ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, (f_step n ω) ^ 2) * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, (g_step n ω) ^ 2) := h_cs
        _ ≤ A_path ω * B_path ω := by
            rw [h_f_sq]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_g_sq (h_A_nonneg ω)
        _ = (Real.sqrt (A_path ω)) ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt (B_path ω)) ^ 2 := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt (h_A_nonneg ω), Real.sq_sqrt (h_B_nonneg ω)]
        _ = (Real.sqrt (A_path ω) * Real.sqrt (B_path ω)) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h_sqrt
    exact h_sqrt
  have h_disc_sum : (∑ ω, B_path ω) ≤ B₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    dsimp [uniformExp] at h_disc
    exact (div_le_iff₀ h_two_pow_pos).mp h_disc
  have h_err_l1_sum : (∑ ω, ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖) ≤
      Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * Real.sqrt (2 * B₀) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    have h_sum_le : (∑ ω, ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖) ≤
        ∑ ω, Real.sqrt (A_path ω) * Real.sqrt (B_path ω) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_err_path ω)
    have h_cs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ
      (fun ω => Real.sqrt (A_path ω)) (fun ω => Real.sqrt (B_path ω))
    have h_A_sq : (∑ ω, (Real.sqrt (A_path ω)) ^ 2) = ∑ ω, A_path ω :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => Real.sq_sqrt (h_A_nonneg ω))
    have h_B_sq : (∑ ω, (Real.sqrt (B_path ω)) ^ 2) = ∑ ω, B_path ω :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => Real.sq_sqrt (h_B_nonneg ω))
    rw [h_A_sq, h_B_sq] at h_cs
    have h_AB_le : (∑ ω, A_path ω) * (∑ ω, B_path ω) ≤
        (Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * Real.sqrt (2 * B₀) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 2 := by
      calc (∑ ω, A_path ω) * (∑ ω, B_path ω)
        _ ≤ (2 * psiPotential S_max * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) * (B₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) :=
            mul_le_mul h_act_eps_sum h_disc_sum
              (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => h_B_nonneg ω)) (by positivity)
        _ = (Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max)) ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt (2 * B₀)) ^ 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 2 := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt h_psi_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
            ring
        _ = (Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * Real.sqrt (2 * B₀) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_sq_le : (∑ ω, ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖) ^ 2 ≤
        (Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * Real.sqrt (2 * B₀) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 2 := by
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ ω, ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖ :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => norm_nonneg _)
      have h_sq1 : (∑ ω, ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖) ^ 2 ≤
          (∑ ω, Real.sqrt (A_path ω) * Real.sqrt (B_path ω)) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      exact le_trans h_sq1 (le_trans h_cs h_AB_le)
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => norm_nonneg _)),
        Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h_sqrt
    exact h_sqrt
  refine ⟨h_s_expect, h_act_eps_expect, ?_⟩
  dsimp [uniformExp]
  have h_tri_sum : (∑ ω, ‖y h ω‖) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * (2 * (M_vel + C_vel) + Real.sqrt (2 * B₀))) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    have h_pt : (∑ ω, ‖y h ω‖) ≤ (∑ ω, ‖M_sum h ω‖) + (∑ ω, ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro ω _
      have h_eq : y h ω = M_sum h ω + (y h ω - M_sum h ω) := by abel
      calc ‖y h ω‖
        _ = ‖M_sum h ω + (y h ω - M_sum h ω)‖ := by rw [← h_eq]
        _ ≤ ‖M_sum h ω‖ + ‖y h ω - M_sum h ω‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    linarith
  exact (div_le_iff₀ h_two_pow_pos).mpr h_tri_sum

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
    (κ H_star : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1)
    (hJ_start : Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => driftFunctional d κ ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H_star))
    (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hQ_drift : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < t →
      (driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Q_plus x t ε) (t + ε)) +
        driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (x - ε • Q_minus x t ε) (t - ε))) / 2 -
        driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≥
          (1 / (16 * (1 + Real.log 2))) *
            (‖Q_plus x t ε - Q_zero x t ε‖ ^ 2 + ‖Q_minus x t ε - Q_zero x t ε‖ ^ 2))
    (hQ_step : ∀ (R T : ℝ), 2 ≤ R → 2 ≤ T →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧
        ∀ (ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
          0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → ‖x‖ ≤ R → ε < t → t ≤ T →
          ‖ε • Q_plus x t ε‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖ε • Q_minus x t ε‖ ≤ 1)
    (C_vel C_ub : ℝ) (hC_vel : 0 < C_vel) (hC_ub : 0 < C_ub)
    (hQ_vel : ∀ (r : ℝ) (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₀ : ℝ),
      0 < r → IsFitAt d C₁ v x₀ r r p₀ a₀ →
      ∀ (K ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
        2 ≤ K → 0 < ε → ε ≤ r → ε < t → t ≤ K * r →
        ‖x - x₀ - (t - r) • p₀‖ ≤ K * r →
        ‖Q_zero x t ε - p₀‖ ≤ C_vel * (1 + Real.log K + |Real.log (t / r)|))
    (hJ_ub : ∀ (B ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      2 ≤ B → 0 < ε → ε ≤ B → ‖x‖ ≤ B → ε < t → t ≤ B →
      driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ C_ub * (1 + Real.log B) ^ 4)
    (h_psi : HasPsiPotentialBounds)
    (h_travel : HasPredictableTravelBound d) :
    ∃ (R L₀ D₀ B₀ : ℝ) (m_walk h_walk : ℕ → ℕ),
      HasOriginalWalkBounds d κ v Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero R L₀ D₀ B₀ m_walk h_walk

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨R, U_R, D_raw, B₀, m_walk, h_walk, hR, hD_raw_pos, hB₀_pos, hU_R, hD_raw, hB₀,
    h_R_bound, h_scales⟩ :=
    outer_cutoff_and_walk_scale_selection d κ H_star v hJ_start Q_plus Q_minus hQ_step
      C_vel C_ub hC_vel hC_ub h_psi
  refine ⟨R, U_R - 16 * D_raw, 16 * D_raw, B₀, m_walk, h_walk, hR, by linarith, hB₀_pos, ?_⟩
  intro N hN1
  obtain ⟨hNm, hε_pos, hε_le, h_step, hJ_init, h_horizon⟩ := h_scales N hN1
  have h_inv_all := fun (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjN : j ≤ N) =>
    stoppedWalk_pathwise_invariants_and_coupling d Q_plus Q_minus R hR (m_walk N) (h_walk N)
      h_step j hj1 (by omega)
  have h_drift_all := fun (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjN : j ≤ N) =>
    stoppedWalk_drift_submartingale_and_discrepancy d κ H_star v Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero
      hQ_drift C_ub hJ_ub R U_R D_raw B₀ hR hU_R hD_raw hB₀ (m_walk N) (h_walk N) j hj1 (by omega)
      hJ_init (fun n ω => ⟨((h_inv_all j hj1 hjN).1 n ω).1, ((h_inv_all j hj1 hjN).1 n ω).2.1,
        ((h_inv_all j hj1 hjN).1 n ω).2.2.1⟩)
      (fun n hn ω => (h_inv_all j hj1 hjN).2.1 n n (le_refl n) hn ω)
  have h_reach :=
    stoppedWalk_reach_prob_ge_three_quarters d C₁ v hv_cent Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero C_vel hC_vel
      hQ_vel h_psi h_travel R B₀ hR hB₀_pos h_R_bound (m_walk N) (h_walk N) N hN1 hNm h_horizon
      (h_inv_all N hN1 (le_refl N)).1 (h_inv_all N hN1 (le_refl N)).2.1
      (h_inv_all N hN1 (le_refl N)).2.2.1 (h_drift_all N hN1 (le_refl N)).1
  have h_good :=
    good_reached_walk_prob_of_reach_and_defects d κ v Q_plus Q_minus R U_R D_raw hD_raw_pos
      (fun k => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m_walk k)) h_walk N hN1 h_reach
      (fun j hj1 hjN ω => ⟨((h_inv_all j hj1 hjN).1 (h_walk N) ω).2.2.1,
        (h_inv_all j hj1 hjN).2.2.2 N hjN hNm ω⟩)
      (fun j hj1 hjN ω => (h_drift_all j hj1 hjN).2.1 ω)
      (fun j hj1 hjN => (h_drift_all j hj1 hjN).2.2)
  exact ⟨hNm, hε_pos, hε_le, h_step, h_good, (h_drift_all N hN1 (le_refl N)).1⟩

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(d : ℕ) (κ H_star : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hJ_start : Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => driftFunctional d κ ℓ v (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H_star))
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hQ_step : ∀ (R T : ℝ), 2 ≤ R → 2 ≤ T →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧
        ∀ (ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
          0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → ‖x‖ ≤ R → ε < t → t ≤ T →
          ‖ε • Q_plus x t ε‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖ε • Q_minus x t ε‖ ≤ 1)
    (C_vel C_ub : ℝ) (hC_vel : 0 < C_vel) (hC_ub : 0 < C_ub)
    (h_psi : HasPsiPotentialBounds) :
    ∃ (R U_R D_raw B₀ : ℝ) (m_walk h_walk : ℕ → ℕ),
      16 ≤ R ∧ 0 < D_raw ∧ 0 < B₀ ∧
      U_R = C_ub * (1 + Real.log (R + 1)) ^ 4 ∧
      U_R - H_star + 1 ≤ D_raw ∧
      B₀ = D_raw / (1 / (16 * (1 + Real.log 2))) ∧
      Real.sqrt (psiPotential 16) *
        (2 * (C_vel * (1 + Real.log R) + C_vel) + Real.sqrt (2 * B₀)) ≤ R / 8 ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
        let ε := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m_walk N)
        N + 2 ≤ m_walk N ∧
        0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) / 4 ∧
        (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
          ‖x‖ ≤ R → ε < t → t ≤ 16 →
          ‖ε • Q_plus x t ε‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖ε • Q_minus x t ε‖ ≤ 1) ∧
        H_star - 1 ≤ driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) ∧
        32 * psiPotential 16 + 1 ≤ (h_walk N : ℝ) * ε ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: stoppedWalk_pathwise_invariants_and_coupling
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 16 ≤ R) (m h : ℕ)
    (h_step : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      ‖x‖ ≤ R → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m < t → t ≤ 16 →
      ‖((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) • Q_plus x t ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      ‖((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) • Q_minus x t ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)‖ ≤ 1)
    (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjm : j + 2 ≤ m) :
    let ε := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m
    let δ_j := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool),
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n
      δ_j ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ 16 ∧ ‖z.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧ (z.2 ≤ δ_j → z.2 = δ_j)) ∧

            (if (isWalkActive d δ_j R z_mk || isPostMarkActive d p_sel δ_N R j K z_mk z) then
              if walkStepBit h ω n then (z.1 + ε • Q_plus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 + ε)
              else (z.1 - ε • Q_minus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 - ε)
            else z) = _
          rw [h_or]
          cases h_bit : walkStepBit h ω n
          · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, fittedRelPos, ε', δ_j]
            rw [← smul_smul, ← smul_sub]
            congr 1
            rw [sub_right_comm z.2 ε z_mk.2, sub_smul, smul_sub]
            abel
          · simp only [↓reduceIte, fittedRelPos, ε', δ_j]
            rw [← smul_smul, ← smul_add]
            congr 1
            rw [add_sub_right_comm z.2 ε z_mk.2, add_smul, smul_sub]
            abel
        have h_s_step :
            fittedRelTime d R j (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω (n + 1))
              (postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω (n + 1)) =
            if walkStepBit h ω n then
              fittedRelTime d R j z_mk z + ε'
            else
              fittedRelTime d R j z_mk z - ε' := by
          rw [hz_mk_next]
          change fittedRelTime d R j z_mk
            (if (isWalkActive d δ_j R z_mk || isPostMarkActive d p_sel δ_N R j K z_mk z) then
              if walkStepBit h ω n then (z.1 + ε • Q_plus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 + ε)
              else (z.1 - ε • Q_minus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 - ε)
            else z) = _
          rw [h_or]
          cases h_bit : walkStepBit h ω n
          · dsimp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, fittedRelTime]
            change (if isMarkReached d δ_j R z_mk then δ_j⁻¹ * (z.2 - ε) else 1) =
              (if isMarkReached d δ_j R z_mk then δ_j⁻¹ * z.2 else 1) - ε'
            rw [h_mr']
            simp only [↓reduceIte, ε']
            ring
          · dsimp only [↓reduceIte, fittedRelTime]
            change (if isMarkReached d δ_j R z_mk then δ_j⁻¹ * (z.2 + ε) else 1) =
              (if isMarkReached d δ_j R z_mk then δ_j⁻¹ * z.2 else 1) + ε'
            rw [h_mr']
            simp only [↓reduceIte, ε']
            ring
        have h_4eps : 4 * ε' ≤ fittedRelTime d R j z_mk z := by
          rw [hs_n_eq]
          dsimp [ε']
          have h4 : 4 * ε ≤ z.2 := by linarith
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hδ_j_pos))
          linarith
        have hs_lt8 : fittedRelTime d R j z_mk z < 8 := by
          rw [hs_n_eq]
          have hz_lt8' : z.2 < 8 * δ_j := hz_lt8
          have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz_lt8' (inv_pos.mpr hδ_j_pos)
          have h_cancel : δ_j⁻¹ * (8 * δ_j) = 8 := by
            rw [mul_comm (8 : ℝ) δ_j, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hδ_j_pos), one_mul]
          linarith
        have h_vel : ‖Q_zero z.1 z.2 ε - p_sel j z_mk.1‖ ≤
            M_vel + C_vel * |Real.log (fittedRelTime d R j z_mk z)| := by
          have hK2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ K := by linarith
          have hε_r : ε ≤ δ_j := by linarith
          have hε_t : ε < z.2 := by linarith
          have hz_lt8' : z.2 < 8 * δ_j := hz_lt8
          have ht_Kr : z.2 ≤ K * δ_j := by nlinarith
          have hx_Kr : ‖z.1 - z_mk.1 - (z.2 - δ_j) • p_sel j z_mk.1‖ ≤ K * δ_j := by
            have hy_norm : δ_j⁻¹ * ‖z.1 - z_mk.1 - (z.2 - δ_j) • p_sel j z_mk.1‖ < K := by
              have hy' := hy_ltK
              dsimp [fittedRelPos] at hy'
              have h_mk_t' : z_mk.2 = δ_j := h_mk_t
              rw [h_mk_t', norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hδ_j_pos))] at hy'
              exact hy'
            have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy_norm hδ_j_pos
            rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hδ_j_pos), one_mul] at h_mul
            linarith
          have h_q := hQ_vel δ_j z_mk.1 (p_sel j z_mk.1) (a_sel j z_mk.1) hδ_j_pos
            (hp_sel j z_mk.1) K ε z.1 z.2 hK2 hε_pos hε_r hε_t ht_Kr hx_Kr
          have h_div : z.2 / δ_j = fittedRelTime d R j z_mk z := by
            rw [hs_n_eq, div_eq_inv_mul]
          rw [h_div] at h_q
          dsimp [M_vel]
          linarith
        exact ⟨h_y_step, h_s_step, h_4eps, hs_lt8, h_vel⟩
      · intro h_inact
        cases h_mk_act : isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
        · have hz_mk_next : stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω (n + 1) =
              stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n := by
            dsimp only [stoppedWalk]
            rw [h_mk_act]
            rfl
          have hz_next : postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω (n + 1) =
              postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n := by
            dsimp only [postMarkWalk]
            change (if (isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n) ||
                isPostMarkActive d p_sel δ_N R j K
                  (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
                  (postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n)) then _ else _) = _
            rw [h_mk_act, h_inact]
            rfl
          rw [hz_mk_next, hz_next]
          exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        · have hn_eq := h_pre_couple n ω h_mk_act
          have hn1_eq : postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω (n + 1) =
              stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω (n + 1) := by
            dsimp only [postMarkWalk, stoppedWalk]
            change (if (isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n) ||
                isPostMarkActive d p_sel δ_N R j K
                  (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
                  (postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n)) then _ else _) = _
            rw [h_mk_act, Bool.true_or, hn_eq]
          rw [hn_eq, hn1_eq, h_diag_pos, h_diag_pos, h_diag_time, h_diag_time]
          exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hε'_le : ε' ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      dsimp [ε']
      have h4 : ε ≤ δ_j / 4 := by linarith
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hδ_j_pos))
      have h_cancel : δ_j⁻¹ * (δ_j / 4) = 1 / 4 := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hδ_j_pos), one_mul, one_div]
      linarith
    have h_time_bdd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool),
        0 < fittedRelTime d R j
          (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
          (postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n) ∧
        fittedRelTime d R j
          (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
          (postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n) ≤ 9 := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro ω
        rw [(h_init ω).2]
        norm_num
      | succ n ih =>
        intro ω
        obtain ⟨ih_pos, ih_le⟩ := ih ω
        obtain ⟨h_act_branch, h_inact_branch⟩ := h_step_all n ω
        cases h_act : isPostMarkActive d p_sel δ_N R j K
            (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
            (postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n)
        · obtain ⟨_, hs_eq⟩ := h_inact_branch h_act
          rw [hs_eq]
          exact ⟨ih_pos, ih_le⟩
        · obtain ⟨_, hs_eq, h4eps, hs_lt8, _⟩ := h_act_branch h_act
          rw [hs_eq]
          split_ifs
          · constructor <;> linarith
          · constructor <;> linarith
    refine ⟨h_init, ?_, fun ω => h_time_bdd h ω⟩
    intro n _ ω
    obtain ⟨h_act_branch, h_inact_branch⟩ := h_step_all n ω
    refine ⟨fun h_act => ?_, h_inact_branch⟩
    obtain ⟨hy, hs, h4, _, hvel⟩ := h_act_branch h_act
    exact ⟨hy, hs, h4, hvel⟩
  obtain ⟨h_init, h_step, h_s_bdd⟩ := h_s3
  let z_mk_fn : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ :=
    fun n ω => stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n
  let z_fn : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ :=
    fun n ω => postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n
  let y_fn : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun n ω => fittedRelPos d p_sel j (z_mk_fn n ω) (z_fn n ω)
  let s_fn : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun n ω => fittedRelTime d R j (z_mk_fn n ω) (z_fn n ω)
  let act_fn : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → Bool :=
    fun n ω => isPostMarkActive d p_sel δ_N R j K (z_mk_fn n ω) (z_fn n ω)
  let q_plus_fn : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun n ω => Q_plus (z_fn n ω).1 (z_fn n ω).2 ε - p_sel j (z_mk_fn n ω).1
  let q_minus_fn : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun n ω => Q_minus (z_fn n ω).1 (z_fn n ω).2 ε - p_sel j (z_mk_fn n ω).1
  let q_zero_fn : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun n ω => Q_zero (z_fn n ω).1 (z_fn n ω).2 ε - p_sel j (z_mk_fn n ω).1
  have h_flip_all : ∀ k n, k ≤ n → n < h → ∀ ω,
      y_fn k (flipBit h n ω) = y_fn k ω ∧
      s_fn k (flipBit h n ω) = s_fn k ω ∧
      act_fn k (flipBit h n ω) = act_fn k ω ∧
      q_zero_fn k (flipBit h n ω) = q_zero_fn k ω := by
    intro k n hkn hnh ω
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h_flip k n hkn hnh ω
    dsimp only [y_fn, s_fn, act_fn, q_zero_fn, z_mk_fn, z_fn]
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  have h_trav := h_travel h ε' 9 M_vel C_vel B₀ y_fn s_fn act_fn q_plus_fn q_minus_fn q_zero_fn
    hε'_pos (by norm_num) hM_vel_nonneg (le_of_lt hC_vel) (le_of_lt hB₀)
    h_init h_flip_all h_step h_s_bdd h_disc
  have hs_exp_le : uniformExp h (fun ω => s_fn h ω) ≤ 1 := le_of_eq h_trav.1
  have hy_exp_le : uniformExp h (fun ω => ‖y_fn h ω‖) ≤ K / 8 :=
    le_trans h_trav.2.2 hK_bound
  let G : (Fin h → Bool) → Prop :=
    isGoodReachedWalk d κ v Q_plus Q_minus R L₀ D₀ (fun k => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m_walk k)) h_walk N
  let E_loc : (Fin h → Bool) → Prop :=
    fun ω =>
      let z_term := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω h
      let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h
      ‖z_term.1 - z_mk.1 - (δ_N - δ_j) • p_sel j z_mk.1‖ ≤ K * δ_j
  let s_end : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ := fun ω => s_fn h ω
  let y_end : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ := fun ω => ‖y_fn h ω‖
  have h_imp : ∀ ω, G ω → s_end ω < 8 → y_end ω < K → E_loc ω :=
    fun ω hG hs_lt8 hy_ltK =>
      h_term_loc ω hG.1 (hG.2.2.2 j hj1 hjN).1 hs_lt8 hy_ltK
  classical
  have hK_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ K⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hK_pos)
  have h_pt : ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      (if G ω then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (1 / 8 : ℝ) * s_end ω - K⁻¹ * y_end ω ≤
        (if G ω ∧ E_loc ω then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro ω
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s_end ω := le_of_lt (h_s_bdd ω).1
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ y_end ω := norm_nonneg _
    have hy_term_nonneg : 0 ≤ K⁻¹ * y_end ω := mul_nonneg hK_inv_nonneg hy0
    by_cases hG : G ω
    · by_cases hE : E_loc ω
      · simp only [hG, hE, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
        linarith
      · simp only [hG, hE, and_false, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases hs8 : s_end ω < 8
        · have hyK : K ≤ y_end ω := by
            by_contra h_lt
            push_neg at h_lt
            exact hE (h_imp ω hG hs8 h_lt)
          have h_ky : 1 ≤ K⁻¹ * y_end ω := by
            calc (1 : ℝ) = K⁻¹ * K := (inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hK_pos)).symm
              _ ≤ K⁻¹ * y_end ω := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyK hK_inv_nonneg
          linarith
        · push_neg at hs8
          linarith
    · simp only [hG, false_and, ↓reduceIte]
      linarith
  have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun ω _ => h_pt ω)
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h_sum
  have h2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by positivity
  have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sum (le_of_lt h2_pos)
  have h_lhs :
      ((∑ x, if G x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - 1 / 8 * ∑ x, s_end x - K⁻¹ * ∑ x, y_end x) / 2 ^ h =
        uniformProb h G - (1 / 8 : ℝ) * uniformExp h s_end - K⁻¹ * uniformExp h y_end := by
    dsimp [uniformProb, uniformExp]
    ring
  have h_rhs :
      (∑ x, if G x ∧ E_loc x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h =
        uniformProb h (fun ω => G ω ∧ E_loc ω) := by
    dsimp [uniformProb, uniformExp]
    congr 2
    ext x
    by_cases hGE : G x ∧ E_loc x <;> simp [hGE]
  rw [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_div
  have h_y_bound : K⁻¹ * uniformExp h y_end ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    calc K⁻¹ * uniformExp h y_end ≤ K⁻¹ * (K / 8) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy_exp_le hK_inv_nonneg
      _ = (K⁻¹ * K) / 8 := by ring
      _ = 1 / 8 := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hK_pos)]
  linarith

fitted_frame_mark_localization.definitions:
open Classical in
noncomputable def isMarkReached (d : ℕ) (δ_j R : ℝ) (z_mk : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : Bool :=
  decide (isWalkActive d δ_j R z_mk = false ∧ z_mk.2 = δ_j)

noncomputable def fittedRelPos (d : ℕ)
    (p_sel : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (j : ℕ) (z_mk z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
  let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
  δ_j⁻¹ • (z.1 - z_mk.1 - (z.2 - z_mk.2) • p_sel j z_mk.1)

noncomputable def fittedRelTime (d : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (j : ℕ)
    (z_mk z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
  if isMarkReached d δ_j R z_mk then δ_j⁻¹ * z.2 else 1

open Classical in
noncomputable def isPostMarkActive (d : ℕ)
    (p_sel : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (δ_N R : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (z_mk z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : Bool :=
  let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
  decide (isMarkReached d δ_j R z_mk = true ∧
    isWalkActive d δ_N R z = true ∧ z.2 < 8 * δ_j ∧
    ‖fittedRelPos d p_sel j z_mk z‖ < K)

noncomputable def postMarkWalk (d : ℕ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (p_sel : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (ε δ_N R : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (h : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) :
    ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ
  | 0 => (0, 1)
  | n + 1 =>
    let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
    let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n
    let z := postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n
    if (isWalkActive d δ_j R z_mk || isPostMarkActive d p_sel δ_N R j K z_mk z) then
      if walkStepBit h ω n then
        (z.1 + ε • Q_plus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 + ε)
      else
        (z.1 - ε • Q_minus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 - ε)
    else z

informal_problem.statement:
(h_walk : ℕ → ℕ)
    (G : ∀ N : ℕ, (Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) → Prop)
    (E : ∀ N : ℕ, ℕ → (Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) → Prop)
    (h_prob : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N →
      uniformProb (h_walk N) (fun ω => G N ω ∧ E N j ω) ≥ 3 / 8) :
    ∃ (M_blk N_seq : ℕ → ℕ) (ω_seq : ∀ m : ℕ, Fin (h_walk (N_seq m)) → Bool),
      StrictMono N_seq ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, m + 1 ≤ N_seq m) ∧
      (∀ h : ℕ, h ≤ M_blk h) ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ,
        G (N_seq m) (ω_seq m) ∧
        ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m →
          ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ j ≤ N_seq m ∧ E (N_seq m) j (ω_seq m)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have h_prob_nonneg : ∀ (h₀ : ℕ) (P : (Fin h₀ → Bool) → Prop), 0 ≤ uniformProb h₀ P := by
    intro h₀ P
    dsimp [uniformProb, uniformExp]
    apply div_nonneg
    · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro ω _
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    · positivity
  have h_prob_le_one : ∀ (h₀ : ℕ) (P : (Fin h₀ → Bool) → Prop), uniformProb h₀ P ≤ 1 := by
    intro h₀ P
    dsimp [uniformProb, uniformExp]
    apply div_le_one_of_le₀
    · calc (∑ ω : Fin h₀ → Bool, @ite ℝ (P ω) (Classical.propDecidable (P ω)) 1 0)
        _ ≤ ∑ _ω : Fin h₀ → Bool, (1 : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro ω _
          split_ifs <;> norm_num
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ h₀ := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin]
    · positivity
  have h_prob_mono : ∀ (h₀ : ℕ) (P Q : (Fin h₀ → Bool) → Prop),
      (∀ ω, P ω → Q ω) → uniformProb h₀ P ≤ uniformProb h₀ Q := by
    intro h₀ P Q hPQ
    dsimp [uniformProb, uniformExp]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro ω _
      split_ifs with hP hQ
      · norm_num
      · exact absurd (hPQ ω hP) hQ
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
    · positivity
  let B : ∀ N : ℕ, ℕ → ℕ → (Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) → Prop :=
    fun N h M ω => G N ω ∧ ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M ∧ E N j ω
  let p : ℕ → (ℕ × ℕ) → ℝ :=
    fun N i => uniformProb (h_walk N) (B N i.1 i.2)
  have hp_mem : ∀ N : ℕ, p N ∈ { x : (ℕ × ℕ) → ℝ | ∀ i : ℕ × ℕ, x i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 } := by
    intro N i
    exact ⟨h_prob_nonneg _ _, h_prob_le_one _ _⟩
  have hp_mono : ∀ (N h M₁ M₂ : ℕ), M₁ ≤ M₂ → p N (h, M₁) ≤ p N (h, M₂) := by
    intro N h M₁ M₂ hM
    apply h_prob_mono
    rintro ω ⟨hG, j, hj1, hj2, hE⟩
    exact ⟨hG, j, hj1, le_trans hj2 hM, hE⟩
  have hp_lb : ∀ (N h M : ℕ), 1 ≤ h → h ≤ M → h ≤ N → 3 / 8 ≤ p N (h, M) := by
    intro N h M hh1 hhM hhN
    have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := le_trans hh1 hhN
    have h1 : 3 / 8 ≤ uniformProb (h_walk N) (fun ω => G N ω ∧ E N h ω) :=
      h_prob N hN1 h hh1 hhN
    have h2 : uniformProb (h_walk N) (fun ω => G N ω ∧ E N h ω) ≤ p N (h, M) := by
      apply h_prob_mono
      rintro ω ⟨hG, hE⟩
      exact ⟨hG, h, le_rfl, hhM, hE⟩
    exact le_trans h1 h2
  have hK_compact : IsCompact { x : (ℕ × ℕ) → ℝ | ∀ i : ℕ × ℕ, x i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 } :=
    isCompact_pi_infinite (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => isCompact_Icc)
  obtain ⟨p_lim, hp_lim_mem, φ, hφ_mono, hφ_tend⟩ := hK_compact.tendsto_subseq hp_mem
  have hp_tend : ∀ h M : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => p (φ k) (h, M)) Filter.atTop (nhds (p_lim (h, M))) := by
    intro h M
    exact (tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hφ_tend) (h, M)
  have hp_lim_nonneg : ∀ h M : ℕ, 0 ≤ p_lim (h, M) := fun h M => (hp_lim_mem (h, M)).1
  have hp_lim_le_one : ∀ h M : ℕ, p_lim (h, M) ≤ 1 := fun h M => (hp_lim_mem (h, M)).2
  have hp_lim_mono : ∀ (h M₁ M₂ : ℕ), M₁ ≤ M₂ → p_lim (h, M₁) ≤ p_lim (h, M₂) := by
    intro h M₁ M₂ hM
    exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto (hp_tend h M₁) (hp_tend h M₂)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun k => hp_mono (φ k) h M₁ M₂ hM))
  have hp_lim_lb : ∀ (h M : ℕ), 1 ≤ h → h ≤ M → 3 / 8 ≤ p_lim (h, M) := by
    intro h M hh1 hhM
    apply ge_of_tendsto (hp_tend h M)
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
    refine ⟨h, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    exact hp_lb (φ k) h M hh1 hhM (le_trans hk (hφ_mono.id_le k))
  have h_stab : ∀ h : ℕ, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, h ≤ M₀ ∧ ∀ M : ℕ, M₀ ≤ M →
      p_lim (h, M) - p_lim (h, M₀) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 3) := by
    intro h
    by_contra! h_no
    let ε : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 3)
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
    have h_next : ∀ m₀ : ℕ, ∃ M : ℕ, p_lim (h, m₀) + ε < p_lim (h, M) := by
      intro m₀
      obtain ⟨M, _, hM_gt⟩ := h_no (max m₀ h) (le_max_right m₀ h)
      have hm₀ : p_lim (h, m₀) ≤ p_lim (h, max m₀ h) := hp_lim_mono h m₀ (max m₀ h) (le_max_left m₀ h)
      exact ⟨M, by linarith⟩
    choose step h_step using h_next
    let a : ℕ → ℕ := fun r => Nat.recOn r h (fun _ prev => step prev)
    have ha_bound : ∀ r : ℕ, p_lim (h, h) + (r : ℝ) * ε ≤ p_lim (h, a r) := by
      intro r
      induction r with
      | zero =>
        change p_lim (h, h) + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ≤ p_lim (h, h)
        simp
      | succ r ih =>
        have h_s : p_lim (h, a r) + ε < p_lim (h, a (r + 1)) := h_step (a r)
        push_cast
        linarith
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / ε)
    have hr_ε : 1 < (r : ℝ) * ε := (div_lt_iff₀ hε_pos).mp hr
    have h1 := ha_bound r
    have h2 := hp_lim_nonneg h h
    have h3 := hp_lim_le_one h (a r)
    linarith
  choose M_blk hM_blk_ge hM_blk_tail using h_stab
  have h_subadd : ∀ (N m M_star : ℕ),
      m + 1 ≤ M_star →
      (∀ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), M_blk (r + 1) ≤ M_star) →
      p N (m + 1, M_star) -
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (p N (r + 1, M_star) - p N (r + 1, M_blk (r + 1))) ≤
        uniformProb (h_walk N) (fun ω =>
          G N ω ∧ ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m + 1 →
            ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ E N j ω) := by
    intro N m M_star hM_star_ge hM_star_blk
    let P_int : (Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) → Prop := fun ω =>
      G N ω ∧ ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m + 1 → ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ E N j ω
    let ind : ((Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) → Prop) → (Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) → ℝ :=
      fun Q ω => @ite ℝ (Q ω) (Classical.propDecidable (Q ω)) 1 0
    let D : ℕ → (Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) → ℝ :=
      fun r ω => ind (B N (r + 1) M_star) ω - ind (B N (r + 1) (M_blk (r + 1))) ω
    have hD_nonneg : ∀ (ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) (r : ℕ),
        r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1) → 0 ≤ D r ω := by
      intro ω r hr
      have h_le : M_blk (r + 1) ≤ M_star := hM_star_blk r hr
      by_cases h2 : B N (r + 1) (M_blk (r + 1)) ω
      · rcases h2 with ⟨hG, j, hj1, hj2, hE⟩
        have h1 : B N (r + 1) M_star ω := ⟨hG, j, hj1, le_trans hj2 h_le, hE⟩
        have h2' : B N (r + 1) (M_blk (r + 1)) ω := ⟨hG, j, hj1, hj2, hE⟩
        dsimp [D, ind]
        rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2']
        norm_num
      · dsimp [D, ind]
        rw [if_neg h2, sub_zero]
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have h_pt : ∀ ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool,
        ind (B N (m + 1) M_star) ω - ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), D r ω ≤ ind P_int ω := by
      intro ω
      have h_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), D r ω :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun r hr => hD_nonneg ω r hr)
      have hI_nonneg : 0 ≤ ind P_int ω := by dsimp [ind]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
      by_cases hB0 : B N (m + 1) M_star ω
      · have hU0 : ind (B N (m + 1) M_star) ω = 1 := if_pos hB0
        by_cases hP : P_int ω
        · have hI : ind P_int ω = 1 := if_pos hP
          linarith
        · have hI : ind P_int ω = 0 := if_neg hP
          rcases hB0 with ⟨hG, j_star, hj_star1, hj_star2, hE_star⟩
          have h_not_all : ¬ ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m + 1 →
              ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ E N j ω :=
            fun hall => hP ⟨hG, hall⟩
          push_neg at h_not_all
          rcases h_not_all with ⟨h₀, hh₀1, hh₀2, h_no_j⟩
          let r₀ : ℕ := h₀ - 1
          have hr₀_eq : r₀ + 1 = h₀ := by omega
          have hr₀_mem : r₀ ∈ Finset.range (m + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
          have hB_star : B N (r₀ + 1) M_star ω :=
            ⟨hG, j_star, by omega, hj_star2, hE_star⟩
          have hB_blk : ¬ B N (r₀ + 1) (M_blk (r₀ + 1)) ω := by
            rintro ⟨_, j, hj1, hj2, hE⟩
            rw [hr₀_eq] at hj1 hj2
            exact h_no_j j hj1 hj2 hE
          have hDr₀ : D r₀ ω = 1 := by
            dsimp [D, ind]
            rw [if_pos hB_star, if_neg hB_blk]
            ring
          have h_single : D r₀ ω ≤ ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), D r ω :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (fun r hr => hD_nonneg ω r hr) hr₀_mem
          linarith
      · have hU0 : ind (B N (m + 1) M_star) ω = 0 := if_neg hB0
        linarith
    have h_sum_le : (∑ ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool,
        (ind (B N (m + 1) M_star) ω - ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), D r ω)) ≤
        ∑ ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool, ind P_int ω :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_pt ω)
    have h_div_le := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sum_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (h_walk N))
    have h_lhs_eq : (∑ ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool,
        (ind (B N (m + 1) M_star) ω - ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), D r ω)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (h_walk N) =
        p N (m + 1, M_star) -
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (p N (r + 1, M_star) - p N (r + 1, M_blk (r + 1))) := by
      dsimp [p, uniformProb, uniformExp, D, ind]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_div, Finset.sum_comm]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_div]
    rw [← h_lhs_eq]
    exact h_div_le
  have h_geom : ∀ k : ℕ,
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range k, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (r + 4) = 1 / 8 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 3) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      simp
      norm_num
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      ring
  have h_ex : ∀ (m B_min : ℕ), ∃ N : ℕ, B_min ≤ N ∧
      ∃ ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool,
        G N ω ∧
        ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m →
          ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ j ≤ N ∧ E N j ω := by
    intro m B_min
    let M_star : ℕ := max (m + 1) ((Finset.range (m + 1)).sup (fun r => M_blk (r + 1)))
    have hM_star_ge : m + 1 ≤ M_star := le_max_left _ _
    have hM_star_blk : ∀ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), M_blk (r + 1) ≤ M_star := by
      intro r hr
      exact le_trans (Finset.le_sup (f := fun r => M_blk (r + 1)) hr) (le_max_right _ _)
    let F_m : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
      p (φ k) (m + 1, M_star) -
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (p (φ k) (r + 1, M_star) - p (φ k) (r + 1, M_blk (r + 1)))
    let L_m : ℝ :=
      p_lim (m + 1, M_star) -
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (p_lim (r + 1, M_star) - p_lim (r + 1, M_blk (r + 1)))
    have hF_tend : Filter.Tendsto F_m Filter.atTop (nhds L_m) := by
      apply Filter.Tendsto.sub (hp_tend (m + 1) M_star)
      apply tendsto_finset_sum
      intro r _
      exact Filter.Tendsto.sub (hp_tend (r + 1) M_star) (hp_tend (r + 1) (M_blk (r + 1)))
    have hL_pos : 0 < L_m := by
      have h_base : 3 / 8 ≤ p_lim (m + 1, M_star) := hp_lim_lb (m + 1) M_star (by omega) hM_star_ge
      have h_sum : ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          (p_lim (r + 1, M_star) - p_lim (r + 1, M_blk (r + 1))) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
        calc ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (p_lim (r + 1, M_star) - p_lim (r + 1, M_blk (r + 1)))
          _ ≤ ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (r + 4) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro r hr
            have h_t := hM_blk_tail (r + 1) M_star (hM_star_blk r hr)
            simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using h_t
          _ = 1 / 8 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1 + 3) := h_geom (m + 1)
          _ ≤ 1 / 8 := by
            have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1 + 3) := by positivity
            linarith
      dsimp [L_m]
      linarith
    have hF_ev : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, 0 < F_m k :=
      hF_tend.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hL_pos)
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hF_ev
    rcases hF_ev with ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩
    let k := max K₀ (max B_min M_star)
    let N := φ k
    have hk_K₀ : K₀ ≤ k := le_max_left _ _
    have hk_BM : max B_min M_star ≤ k := le_max_right _ _
    have hN_ge_k : k ≤ N := hφ_mono.id_le k
    have hB_le_N : B_min ≤ N := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk_BM) hN_ge_k
    have hM_le_N : M_star ≤ N := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk_BM) hN_ge_k
    have h_prob_pos : 0 < uniformProb (h_walk N) (fun ω =>
        G N ω ∧ ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m + 1 →
          ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ E N j ω) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hK₀ k hk_K₀) (h_subadd N m M_star hM_star_ge hM_star_blk)
    have h_ex_ω : ∃ ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool,
        G N ω ∧ ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m + 1 →
          ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ E N j ω := by
      by_contra h_none
      have h_none' := not_exists.mp h_none
      have h_zero : uniformProb (h_walk N) (fun ω =>
          G N ω ∧ ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m + 1 →
            ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ E N j ω) = 0 := by
        dsimp [uniformProb, uniformExp]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
        · ring
        · intro ω _
          exact if_neg (h_none' ω)
      linarith
    rcases h_ex_ω with ⟨ω, hG_ω, h_all_ω⟩
    refine ⟨N, hB_le_N, ω, hG_ω, ?_⟩
    intro h hh1 hhm
    obtain ⟨j, hj1, hj2, hE_j⟩ := h_all_ω h hh1 (by omega)
    have hr_mem : h - 1 ∈ Finset.range (m + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    have hM_blk_h : M_blk h ≤ M_star := by
      have h_eq : h - 1 + 1 = h := by omega
      simpa [h_eq] using hM_star_blk (h - 1) hr_mem
    exact ⟨j, hj1, hj2, le_trans hj2 (le_trans hM_blk_h hM_le_N), hE_j⟩
  choose nextN h_nextN_ge h_nextN_ω using h_ex
  let N_seq : ℕ → ℕ := fun m =>
    Nat.recOn m (nextN 0 1) (fun m₀ prev => nextN (m₀ + 1) (max (prev + 1) (m₀ + 2)))
  have hN_mono : StrictMono N_seq := by
    apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
    intro m
    have h_ge := h_nextN_ge (m + 1) (max (N_seq m + 1) (m + 2))
    have h_max : N_seq m + 1 ≤ max (N_seq m + 1) (m + 2) := le_max_left _ _
    change N_seq m < nextN (m + 1) (max (N_seq m + 1) (m + 2))
    omega
  have hN_ge : ∀ m : ℕ, m + 1 ≤ N_seq m := by
    intro m
    cases m with
    | zero =>
      change 1 ≤ nextN 0 1
      exact h_nextN_ge 0 1
    | succ m₀ =>
      have h_ge := h_nextN_ge (m₀ + 1) (max (N_seq m₀ + 1) (m₀ + 2))
      have h_max : m₀ + 2 ≤ max (N_seq m₀ + 1) (m₀ + 2) := le_max_right _ _
      change m₀ + 1 + 1 ≤ nextN (m₀ + 1) (max (N_seq m₀ + 1) (m₀ + 2))
      omega
  have h_ω_all : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ ω : Fin (h_walk (N_seq m)) → Bool,
      G (N_seq m) ω ∧
      ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m →
        ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ j ≤ N_seq m ∧ E (N_seq m) j ω := by
    intro m
    cases m with
    | zero =>
      exact h_nextN_ω 0 1
    | succ m₀ =>
      exact h_nextN_ω (m₀ + 1) (max (N_seq m₀ + 1) (m₀ + 2))
  choose ω_seq hω_seq using h_ω_all
  exact ⟨M_blk, N_seq, ω_seq, hN_mono, hN_ge, hM_blk_ge, hω_seq⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv_class : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v) :
    ∃ (C_shift C_box : ℝ), 0 < C_shift ∧ 0 < C_box ∧
      (∀ (r : ℝ) (x₀ p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₀ : ℝ),
        0 < r → IsFitAt d C₁ v x₀ r r p₀ a₀ →
        ∀ (K τ : ℝ) (x_tilde p_fit : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a_fit : ℝ),
          2 ≤ K → 0 < τ → τ ≤ 2 * K * r →
          ‖x_tilde - x₀ - (τ - r) • p₀‖ ≤ K * r →
          IsFitAt d C₁ v x_tilde τ τ p_fit a_fit →
          ‖p_fit - p₀‖ ≤ C_shift * (1 + Real.log K + |Real.log (τ / r)|)) ∧
      (IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1 →
        ∀ (K : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
          2 ≤ K → ‖z‖ ≤ K → |s - 1| ≤ K →
          |v (mkSpaceTime z s)| ≤ C_box * K * (1 + Real.log K) ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_one_step : ∀ (x_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t_c r₁ r₂ : ℝ)
      (p₁ p₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₁ a₂ : ℝ),
      0 < r₁ → r₁ ≤ r₂ → r₂ ≤ 2 * r₁ →
      IsFitAt d C₁ v x_c t_c r₁ p₁ a₁ →
      IsFitAt d C₁ v x_c t_c r₂ p₂ a₂ →
      ‖p₁ - p₂‖ + |a₁ - a₂| ≤ 20 * C₁ ^ 2 := by
    intro x_c t_c r₁ r₂ p₁ p₂ a₁ a₂ hr₁ hr₁₂ hr₂₁ hfit₁ hfit₂
    have hp_bound : ‖p₁ - p₂‖ ≤ 3 * C₁ := by
      by_cases hp0 : ‖p₁ - p₂‖ = 0
      · linarith
      · have hp_pos : 0 < ‖p₁ - p₂‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hp0)
        let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (r₁ / ‖p₁ - p₂‖) • (p₁ - p₂)
        have hh_norm : ‖h‖ = r₁ := by
          dsimp [h]
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hr₁ hp_pos),
            div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hp_pos)]
        have h1 := hfit₁ h 0 (by simp [le_of_lt hr₁]) (by simp [hh_norm])
        have h2 := hfit₂ h 0 (by simp; linarith) (by simp [hh_norm, hr₁₂])
        have h_inner : inner ℝ p₁ h - inner ℝ p₂ h = r₁ * ‖p₁ - p₂‖ := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left]
          dsimp [h]
          rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hp_pos]
        obtain ⟨h1_lo, h1_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h1
        obtain ⟨h2_lo, h2_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h2
        have h_r1_mul : r₁ * ‖p₁ - p₂‖ ≤ 3 * C₁ * r₁ := by nlinarith
        nlinarith
    have ha_bound : |a₁ - a₂| ≤ 3 * C₁ * (1 + 3 * C₁) + (9 / 2 : ℝ) * C₁ ^ 2 := by
      let ℓ : ℝ := r₁ / (1 + 3 * C₁)
      have hdenom_pos : 0 < 1 + 3 * C₁ := by linarith
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ := div_pos hr₁ hdenom_pos
      have hℓ_mul : ℓ * (1 + 3 * C₁) = r₁ := div_mul_cancel₀ r₁ (ne_of_gt hdenom_pos)
      have hℓ_le1 : ℓ ≤ r₁ := by nlinarith
      let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ℓ • p₁
      have h_diff2 : ‖h - ℓ • p₂‖ ≤ r₁ := by
        have h_eq : h - ℓ • p₂ = ℓ • (p₁ - p₂) := by
          dsimp [h]
          rw [← smul_sub]
        rw [h_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos]
        nlinarith

    have h_eval := hfit_R z (s - 1) hs_le_R hz_sheared
    have h0z : (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) + z = z := zero_add z
    have h1s : 1 + (s - 1) = s := add_sub_cancel 1 s
    rw [h0z, h1s, hv_cent.1, sub_zero] at h_eval
    let KL2 : ℝ := K * L ^ 2
    have hL_le_L2 : L ≤ L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hKL_le_KL2 : K * L ≤ KL2 := by dsimp [KL2]; nlinarith
    have hKL2_pos : 0 < KL2 := by positivity
    have h_inner_le : |inner ℝ p_R z| ≤ S₀ ^ 2 * KL2 := by
      have h_cs := abs_real_inner_le_norm p_R z
      have h1 : |inner ℝ p_R z| ≤ (S₀ ^ 2 * L) * K := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg p_R, norm_nonneg z]
      have h2 : (S₀ ^ 2 * L) * K = S₀ ^ 2 * (K * L) := by ring
      rw [h2] at h1
      nlinarith
    have h_a_s_le : |a_R * (s - 1)| ≤ S₀ ^ 2 * KL2 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      have h1 : |a_R| * |s - 1| ≤ (S₀ ^ 2 * L) * K := by
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg a_R, abs_nonneg (s - 1)]
      have h2 : (S₀ ^ 2 * L) * K = S₀ ^ 2 * (K * L) := by ring
      rw [h2] at h1
      nlinarith
    have h_p_sq_le : |‖p_R‖ ^ 2 * (s - 1)| ≤ S₀ ^ 4 * KL2 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      have hp_R_le' : ‖p_R‖ ≤ S₀ ^ 2 * L := by linarith
      have hp_sq : ‖p_R‖ ^ 2 ≤ (S₀ ^ 2 * L) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg p_R]
      have h1 : ‖p_R‖ ^ 2 * |s - 1| ≤ (S₀ ^ 2 * L) ^ 2 * K := by
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (s - 1), sq_nonneg ‖p_R‖]
      have h2 : (S₀ ^ 2 * L) ^ 2 * K = S₀ ^ 4 * KL2 := by dsimp [KL2]; ring
      linarith
    have h_eval_le : |v (mkSpaceTime z s) - inner ℝ p_R z - (a_R - ‖p_R‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s - 1)| ≤
        C₁ * S₀ ^ 2 * KL2 := by
      have h1 : C₁ * R = (C₁ * S₀ ^ 2) * (K * L) := by dsimp [R]; ring
      have h2 : 0 ≤ C₁ * S₀ ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hKL_le_KL2 h2]
    have h_S0_comb : 2 * S₀ ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * S₀ ^ 4 ≤ S₀ ^ 4 := by nlinarith
    obtain ⟨he_lo, he_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h_eval_le
    obtain ⟨hi_lo, hi_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h_inner_le
    obtain ⟨ha_lo, ha_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h_a_s_le
    obtain ⟨hp_lo, hp_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h_p_sq_le
    have h_target_eq : C_box * K * (1 + Real.log K) ^ 2 = (S₀ ^ 4 + C₁ * S₀ ^ 2) * KL2 := by
      dsimp [C_box, KL2, L]
      ring
    rw [h_target_eq, abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith

(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_class : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)

    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2)

    (h_fit : IsFitAt d C₁ v (x + ε • p₀) (t + ε) (t + ε) p_fit a_fit) :
    ‖Q_zero - p₀‖ ≤ 4 * C₁ + 2 * (1 + κ ^ 2) + 4 * ‖p_fit - p₀‖

(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
