proof.tactics:
by
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s) = y := by
    intro y s
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime y s) = s := by
    intro y s
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
  let S : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → Set ℝ := fun y s =>
    { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y_cfg : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y_cfg i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s)) ∧
      val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_cfg i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime y s)))) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s) }
  have hS_mem : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), v (mkSpaceTime y s) ∈ S y s := by
    intro y s
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => y, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [h_projSpace]
    · simp [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  have hS_ub : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), 0 < s →
      ∀ val ∈ S y s, val ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2 := by
    intro y s hs
    rintro val ⟨N, θ, y_cfg, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
    rw [h_projSpace] at hy_mean
    rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
    have h_var_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2)
    have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = ∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt h_var_nonneg
    have h_j := hv_jensen s N θ y_cfg hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at h_j
    rw [hy_mean] at h_j
    have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ * s) ^ 2 / (2 * s) :=
      div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h_alg : v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ * r - r ^ 2 / (2 * s) =
        v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2 - (r - κ * s) ^ 2 / (2 * s) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hs]
      ring
    have h_step : (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_cfg i) s)) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ * r - r ^ 2 / (2 * s) := by
      rw [← hr_sq]
      linarith
    change (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y_cfg i) s)) -
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - y‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2
    linarith
  have h_sand : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), 0 < s →
      v (mkSpaceTime y s) - κ ^ 2 * s / 2 ≤ W (mkSpaceTime y s) ∧
      W (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y s) := by
    intro y s hs
    have h_sSup_ge : v (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤ barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y s) :=
      le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2, hS_ub y s hs⟩ (hS_mem y s)
    have h_sSup_le : barycentricEnvelope d s v (mkSpaceTime y s) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y s) + κ ^ 2 * s / 2 :=
      csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime y s), hS_mem y s⟩ (hS_ub y s hs)
    dsimp [W, shiftedBarycentricEnvelope]
    rw [h_projTime]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h_var_decomp : ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y_cfg : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
      (z_c x_tilde : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ∑ i, θ i = 1 → ∑ i, θ i • y_cfg i = z_c →
      ∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 =
        (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - z_c‖ ^ 2) + ‖z_c - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro N θ y_cfg z_c x_tilde hθ_sum hy_mean
    have h_zero_mean : ∑ i, θ i • (y_cfg i - z_c) = 0 := by
      calc ∑ i, θ i • (y_cfg i - z_c)
        _ = ∑ i, (θ i • y_cfg i - θ i • z_c) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => smul_sub (θ i) (y_cfg i) z_c)
        _ = (∑ i, θ i • y_cfg i) - (∑ i, θ i) • z_c := by
            rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul]
        _ = 0 := by
            rw [hy_mean, hθ_sum, one_smul, sub_self]
    have h_pt : ∀ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 =
        θ i * ‖y_cfg i - z_c‖ ^ 2 +
        2 * inner ℝ (θ i • (y_cfg i - z_c)) (z_c - x_tilde) +
        θ i * ‖z_c - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro i
      have h_split : y_cfg i - x_tilde = (y_cfg i - z_c) + (z_c - x_tilde) := by abel
      rw [h_split, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_left]
      ring
    calc ∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - x_tilde‖ ^ 2
      _ = ∑ i, (θ i * ‖y_cfg i - z_c‖ ^ 2 +
          2 * inner ℝ (θ i • (y_cfg i - z_c)) (z_c - x_tilde) +
          θ i * ‖z_c - x_tilde‖ ^ 2) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => h_pt i)
      _ = (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - z_c‖ ^ 2) +
          2 * inner ℝ (∑ i, θ i • (y_cfg i - z_c)) (z_c - x_tilde) +
          (∑ i, θ i) * ‖z_c - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
            ← sum_inner, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = (∑ i, θ i * ‖y_cfg i - z_c‖ ^ 2) + ‖z_c - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [h_zero_mean, inner_zero_left, hθ_sum]
          ring
  have h_two_point : ∀ (τ : ℝ) (z₁ z₂ x_tilde : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (α₁ α₂ : ℝ),
      0 < τ → 0 < α₁ → 0 < α₂ → α₁ + α₂ = 1 → α₁ • z₁ + α₂ • z₂ = x_tilde →
      α₁ * W (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) + α₂ * W (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) -
        (α₁ * ‖z₁ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 + α₂ * ‖z₂ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2) / (2 * τ) ≤
        W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) := by
    intro τ z₁ z₂ x_tilde α₁ α₂ hτ hα₁ hα₂ hα_sum hα_mean
    let pen : ℝ := (α₁ * ‖z₁ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 + α₂ * ‖z₂ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2) / (2 * τ)
    have h_pt_conc : ∀ V₁ ∈ S z₁ τ, ∀ V₂ ∈ S z₂ τ,
        α₁ * V₁ + α₂ * V₂ - pen ≤ barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) := by
      rintro V₁ ⟨N₁, θ₁, y₁, hθ₁_pos, hθ₁_sum, hy₁_mean, rfl⟩
        V₂ ⟨N₂, θ₂, y₂, hθ₂_pos, hθ₂_sum, hy₂_mean, rfl⟩
      rw [h_projSpace] at hy₁_mean hy₂_mean
      simp only [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
      let θ_cat : Fin (N₁ + N₂) → ℝ :=
        Fin.addCases (fun i => α₁ * θ₁ i) (fun j => α₂ * θ₂ j)
      let y_cat : Fin (N₁ + N₂) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
        Fin.addCases y₁ y₂
      have hθ_cat_pos : ∀ k, 0 < θ_cat k := by
        intro k
        refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ k
        · intro i
          dsimp [θ_cat]
          rw [Fin.addCases_left]
          exact mul_pos hα₁ (hθ₁_pos i)
        · intro j
          dsimp [θ_cat]
          rw [Fin.addCases_right]
          exact mul_pos hα₂ (hθ₂_pos j)
      have hθ_cat_sum : ∑ k, θ_cat k = 1 := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
        simp only [θ_cat, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, ← Finset.mul_sum,
          hθ₁_sum, hθ₂_sum, mul_one, hα_sum]
      have hy_cat_mean : ∑ k, θ_cat k • y_cat k = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) := by
        rw [h_projSpace, Fin.sum_univ_add]
        simp only [θ_cat, y_cat, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, mul_smul,
          ← Finset.smul_sum, hy₁_mean, hy₂_mean, hα_mean]
      have h_val_sum : ∑ k, θ_cat k * v (mkSpaceTime (y_cat k) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ))) =
          α₁ * (∑ i, θ₁ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y₁ i) τ)) +
          α₂ * (∑ j, θ₂ j * v (mkSpaceTime (y₂ j) τ)) := by
        rw [h_projTime, Fin.sum_univ_add]
        simp only [θ_cat, y_cat, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, mul_assoc,
          ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have h_var_sum : ∑ k, θ_cat k * ‖y_cat k - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ)‖ ^ 2 =
          α₁ * ((∑ i, θ₁ i * ‖y₁ i - z₁‖ ^ 2) + ‖z₁ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2) +
          α₂ * ((∑ j, θ₂ j * ‖y₂ j - z₂‖ ^ 2) + ‖z₂ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2) := by
        rw [h_projSpace, Fin.sum_univ_add]
        simp only [θ_cat, y_cat, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, mul_assoc,
          ← Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [h_var_decomp N₁ θ₁ y₁ z₁ x_tilde hθ₁_sum hy₁_mean,
          h_var_decomp N₂ θ₂ y₂ z₂ x_tilde hθ₂_sum hy₂_mean]
      have h_cat_mem : α₁ * ((∑ i, θ₁ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y₁ i) τ)) -
            (∑ i, θ₁ i * ‖y₁ i - z₁‖ ^ 2) / (2 * τ)) +
          α₂ * ((∑ j, θ₂ j * v (mkSpaceTime (y₂ j) τ)) -
            (∑ j, θ₂ j * ‖y₂ j - z₂‖ ^ 2) / (2 * τ)) - pen ∈ S x_tilde τ := by
        refine ⟨N₁ + N₂, θ_cat, y_cat, hθ_cat_pos, hθ_cat_sum, hy_cat_mean, ?_⟩
        rw [h_val_sum, h_var_sum]
        dsimp [pen]
        ring
      exact le_csSup ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) + κ ^ 2 * τ / 2, hS_ub x_tilde τ hτ⟩ h_cat_mem
    have h_sup₁ : ∀ V₂ ∈ S z₂ τ,
        α₁ * barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) + α₂ * V₂ - pen ≤
          barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) := by
      intro V₂ hV₂
      have h_le : barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) ≤
          (barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - α₂ * V₂ + pen) / α₁ := by
        apply csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ), hS_mem z₁ τ⟩
        intro V₁ hV₁
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hα₁]
        linarith [h_pt_conc V₁ hV₁ V₂ hV₂]
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hα₁] at h_le
      linarith
    have h_sup₂ : α₁ * barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) +
        α₂ * barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) - pen ≤
          barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) := by
      have h_le : barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) ≤
          (barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) -
            α₁ * barycentricEnvelope d τ v (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) + pen) / α₂ := by
        apply csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ), hS_mem z₂ τ⟩
        intro V₂ hV₂
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hα₂]
        linarith [h_sup₁ V₂ hV₂]
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hα₂] at h_le
      linarith
    dsimp [W, shiftedBarycentricEnvelope, pen] at h_sup₂ ⊢
    rw [h_projTime, h_projTime, h_projTime]
    have h_shift_split : κ ^ 2 * τ / 2 = (α₁ + α₂) * (κ ^ 2 * τ / 2) := by
      rw [hα_sum, one_mul]
    linarith
  let τ : ℝ := t + ε
  let x_tilde : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x + ε • p₀
  let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ε • (Q_zero - p₀)
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hτ_pos : 0 < τ := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
  have hη_pos : 0 < 1 / (4 * ε) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁⟩ := h_growth τ τ (1 / (4 * ε)) hη_pos
  have h_norm_ineq : ∀ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      ‖y'‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y' - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro y'
    have h1 : y' = (y' - x) + x := (sub_add_cancel y' x).symm
    have h2 : ‖y'‖ ^ 2 = ‖y' - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ (y' - x) x + ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [h1]
      exact norm_add_sq_real (y' - x) x
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖(y' - x) - x‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real] at h3
    linarith
  have h_quad_comp : W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - ‖x_tilde - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) ≤
      quadEnvelopePlus d ε W (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    dsimp [quadEnvelopePlus]
    rw [h_projTime, h_projSpace]
    apply le_csSup
    · refine ⟨M₁ + ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε), ?_⟩
      rintro val ⟨y', -, rfl⟩
      dsimp only
      have hW_le : W (mkSpaceTime y' τ) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime y' τ) :=
        (h_sand y' τ hτ_pos).2
      have hv_le : v (mkSpaceTime y' τ) ≤ M₁ + (1 / (4 * ε)) * ‖y'‖ ^ 2 :=
        le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hM₁ y' τ (le_refl _) (le_refl _))
      have h_yn := h_norm_ineq y'
      have h_alg : (1 / (4 * ε)) * (2 * ‖y' - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) - ‖y' - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) =
          ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
        ring
      have h_mul : (1 / (4 * ε)) * ‖y'‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (1 / (4 * ε)) * (2 * ‖y' - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_yn (le_of_lt hη_pos)
      linarith
    · exact ⟨x_tilde, Set.mem_univ x_tilde, rfl⟩
  have h_opt_zero : W (mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Q_zero) τ) - (ε / 2) * ‖Q_zero‖ ^ 2 =
      quadEnvelopePlus d ε W (mkSpaceTime x t) := h_opt.1
  have hx_Q_eq : x + ε • Q_zero = x_tilde + h := by
    dsimp [x_tilde, h]
    module
  have hx_tilde_diff : x_tilde - x = ε • p₀ := by
    dsimp [x_tilde]
    abel
  have hεQ_eq : ε • Q_zero = ε • p₀ + h := by
    dsimp [h]
    module
  have h_norm_p₀ : ‖x_tilde - x‖ ^ 2 = ε ^ 2 * ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hx_tilde_diff, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε, mul_pow]
  have h_norm_Q₀ : ε ^ 2 * ‖Q_zero‖ ^ 2 =
      ε ^ 2 * ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ε * inner ℝ p₀ h + ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : ε ^ 2 * ‖Q_zero‖ ^ 2 = ‖ε • Q_zero‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε, mul_pow]
    rw [h1, hεQ_eq, norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε,
      mul_pow, real_inner_smul_left]
    ring
  have h_pen_diff : (ε / 2) * ‖Q_zero‖ ^ 2 - ‖x_tilde - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) =
      inner ℝ p₀ h + ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) := by
    have h2 : (ε / 2) * ‖Q_zero‖ ^ 2 = (ε ^ 2 * ‖Q_zero‖ ^ 2) / (2 * ε) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
    rw [h2, h_norm_Q₀, h_norm_p₀]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
    ring
  have h_comp_shift : ‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ε) ≤
      W (mkSpaceTime (x_tilde + h) τ) - W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - inner ℝ p₀ h := by
    rw [hx_Q_eq] at h_opt_zero
    linarith
  by_cases h_vel_zero : ‖Q_zero - p₀‖ = 0
  · rw [h_vel_zero]
    positivity
  · have h_vel_pos : 0 < ‖Q_zero - p₀‖ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm h_vel_zero)
    let ρ : ℝ := ‖h‖
    have hρ_eq : ρ = ε * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖ := by
      dsimp [ρ, h]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε]
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := by
      rw [hρ_eq]
      exact mul_pos hε h_vel_pos
    let h_fit_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := -((τ / ρ) • h)
    let z₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x_tilde + h
    let z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x_tilde + h_fit_vec
    have h_norm_hfit : ‖h_fit_vec‖ = τ := by
      dsimp [h_fit_vec]
      rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hτ_pos hρ_pos)]
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ τ (ne_of_gt hρ_pos)
    have h_fit_app := h_fit h_fit_vec 0
      (by simp; linarith)
      (by simp [h_norm_hfit, τ])
    have h_fit_lb : -C₁ * τ ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) - v (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - inner ℝ p_fit h_fit_vec := by
      have h1 := (abs_le.mp h_fit_app).1
      simpa [z₂, x_tilde, τ] using h1
    have h_inner_hfit : inner ℝ p_fit h_fit_vec = -(τ / ρ) * inner ℝ p_fit h := by
      dsimp [h_fit_vec]
      rw [inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right]
      ring
    have h_cs : inner ℝ p_fit h - inner ℝ p₀ h ≤ ‖p_fit - p₀‖ * ρ := by
      rw [← inner_sub_left]
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (abs_real_inner_le_norm (p_fit - p₀) h)
    have h_cs_scaled : (τ / ρ) * inner ℝ p_fit h - (τ / ρ) * inner ℝ p₀ h ≤
        ‖p_fit - p₀‖ * τ := by
      have h1 : (τ / ρ) * (inner ℝ p_fit h - inner ℝ p₀ h) ≤
          (τ / ρ) * (‖p_fit - p₀‖ * ρ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cs (le_of_lt (div_pos hτ_pos hρ_pos))
      have h2 : (τ / ρ) * (‖p_fit - p₀‖ * ρ) = ‖p_fit - p₀‖ * τ := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hρ_pos]
      linarith
    have hW_xtilde_ub : W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) :=
      (h_sand x_tilde τ hτ_pos).2
    have hW_z₂_lb : v (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) - κ ^ 2 * τ / 2 ≤ W (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) :=
      (h_sand z₂ τ hτ_pos).1
    have h_refl_bound : W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - W (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) -
        (τ / ρ) * inner ℝ p₀ h ≤ (C₁ + κ ^ 2 / 2 + ‖p_fit - p₀‖) * τ := by
      linarith
    let α₁ : ℝ := τ / (τ + ρ)
    let α₂ : ℝ := ρ / (τ + ρ)
    have hτρ_pos : 0 < τ + ρ := add_pos hτ_pos hρ_pos
    have hα₁_pos : 0 < α₁ := div_pos hτ_pos hτρ_pos
    have hα₂_pos : 0 < α₂ := div_pos hρ_pos hτρ_pos
    have hα_sum : α₁ + α₂ = 1 := by
      dsimp [α₁, α₂]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hτρ_pos]
    have hα_coeff : α₂ * (τ / ρ) = α₁ := by
      dsimp [α₁, α₂]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hρ_pos, ne_of_gt hτρ_pos]
    have hα_mean : α₁ • z₁ + α₂ • z₂ = x_tilde := by
      have h_lin : α₁ • z₁ + α₂ • z₂ = (α₁ + α₂) • x_tilde + (α₁ - α₂ * (τ / ρ)) • h := by
        dsimp [z₁, z₂, h_fit_vec]
        module
      rw [h_lin, hα_sum, hα_coeff, sub_self, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
    have hz₁_diff : ‖z₁ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [z₁, ρ]
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
    have hz₂_diff : ‖z₂ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 = τ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [z₂]
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left, h_norm_hfit]
    have h_pen_eq : (α₁ * ‖z₁ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2 + α₂ * ‖z₂ - x_tilde‖ ^ 2) / (2 * τ) =
        ρ / 2 := by
      rw [hz₁_diff, hz₂_diff]
      dsimp [α₁, α₂]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hτ_pos, ne_of_gt hτρ_pos]
      ring
    have h_conc := h_two_point τ z₁ z₂ x_tilde α₁ α₂ hτ_pos hα₁_pos hα₂_pos hα_sum hα_mean
    rw [h_pen_eq] at h_conc
    have h_chord_mul : (τ + ρ) *
        (α₁ * W (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) + α₂ * W (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) - ρ / 2) ≤
        (τ + ρ) * W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_conc (le_of_lt hτρ_pos)
    have h_chord_alg : (τ + ρ) *
        (α₁ * W (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) + α₂ * W (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) - ρ / 2) =
        τ * W (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) + ρ * W (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) - (τ + ρ) * ρ / 2 := by
      dsimp [α₁, α₂]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hτρ_pos]
    have h_p₀_scale : ρ * ((τ / ρ) * inner ℝ p₀ h) = τ * inner ℝ p₀ h := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hρ_pos]
    have h_chord_clean : τ * (W (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) - W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - inner ℝ p₀ h) ≤
        ρ * (W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - W (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) - (τ / ρ) * inner ℝ p₀ h) +
        (τ + ρ) * ρ / 2 := by
      linarith
    have h_lhs_mul : τ * (ρ ^ 2 / (2 * ε)) ≤
        τ * (W (mkSpaceTime z₁ τ) - W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - inner ℝ p₀ h) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_comp_shift (le_of_lt hτ_pos)
    have h_rhs_mul : ρ * (W (mkSpaceTime x_tilde τ) - W (mkSpaceTime z₂ τ) -
        (τ / ρ) * inner ℝ p₀ h) ≤ ρ * ((C₁ + κ ^ 2 / 2 + ‖p_fit - p₀‖) * τ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_refl_bound (le_of_lt hρ_pos)
    have h_combined : τ * (ρ ^ 2 / (2 * ε)) - ρ ^ 2 / 2 ≤
        ρ * τ * (C₁ + (1 + κ ^ 2) / 2 + ‖p_fit - p₀‖) := by
      linarith
    have h_lhs_id : 4 * (τ * (ρ ^ 2 / (2 * ε)) - ρ ^ 2 / 2) =
        (t - ε) * (ρ * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖) + ρ * τ * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖ := by
      have hρ_div : ρ ^ 2 / ε = ρ * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖ := by
        rw [hρ_eq]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
      calc 4 * (τ * (ρ ^ 2 / (2 * ε)) - ρ ^ 2 / 2)
        _ = (2 * τ - 2 * ε) * (ρ ^ 2 / ε) := by
            field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
            ring
        _ = ((t - ε) + τ) * (ρ * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖) := by
            rw [hρ_div]
            dsimp [τ]
            ring
        _ = (t - ε) * (ρ * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖) + ρ * τ * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖ := by
            ring
    have h_slack_pos : 0 ≤ (t - ε) * (ρ * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖) := by
      have htε : 0 ≤ t - ε := by linarith
      positivity
    have h_final_mul : ρ * τ * ‖Q_zero - p₀‖ ≤
        ρ * τ * (4 * C₁ + 2 * (1 + κ ^ 2) + 4 * ‖p_fit - p₀‖) := by
      linarith
    have hρτ_pos : 0 < ρ * τ := mul_pos hρ_pos hτ_pos
    nlinarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_class : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (h_comp : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y (t - ℓ)) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_attain : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      (∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
      (∃ y_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - ℓ)) - ‖y_minus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopeMinus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t)))
    (h_mono : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ₁ → ℓ₁ ≤ ℓ₂ →
      slopePlus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopePlus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
      slopeMinus d ℓ₁ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ slopeMinus d ℓ₂ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (C_box : ℝ) (hC_box : 0 < C_box)
    (h_box : ∀ (K : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      2 ≤ K → ‖z‖ ≤ K → |s - 1| ≤ K →
      |v (mkSpaceTime z s)| ≤ C_box * K * (1 + Real.log K) ^ 2) :
    ∃ C_ub : ℝ, 0 < C_ub ∧
      ∀ (B ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
        2 ≤ B → 0 < ε → ε ≤ B → ‖x‖ ≤ B → ε < t → t ≤ B →
        driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ C_ub * (1 + Real.log B) ^ 4

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_projSpace : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_projTime : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime x t) = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime]
  have h_bary_mem : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      v (mkSpaceTime x t) ∈
        { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
          val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t)))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) } := by
    intro x t
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => 1, fun _ => x, fun _ => zero_lt_one, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [h_projSpace]
    · simp [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
  have h_bary_ub : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∀ val ∈
        { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)) ∧
          val = (∑ i, θ i * v (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime (mkSpaceTime x t)))) -
            (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace (mkSpaceTime x t)‖ ^ 2) / (2 * t) },
        val ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 := by
    intro x t ht val hval
    rcases hval with ⟨N, θ, y, hθ_pos, hθ_sum, hy_mean, rfl⟩
    rw [h_projSpace] at hy_mean ⊢
    rw [h_projTime]
    have hj := hv_jensen t N θ y hθ_pos hθ_sum
    dsimp only at hj
    rw [hy_mean] at hj
    set V : ℝ := ∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2
    set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt V
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hθ_pos i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = V := Real.sq_sqrt hV_nonneg
    have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r - κ * t) ^ 2 / (2 * t) :=
      div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have h_id : κ * r - V / (2 * t) = κ ^ 2 * t / 2 - (r - κ * t) ^ 2 / (2 * t) := by
      rw [← hr_sq]
      have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
      field_simp [ht_ne]
      ring
    linarith
  have hW_le_v : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    intro x t ht
    unfold shiftedBarycentricEnvelope
    rw [h_projTime]
    have h_ub : barycentricEnvelope d t v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) + κ ^ 2 * t / 2 :=
      csSup_le ⟨v (mkSpaceTime x t), h_bary_mem x t⟩ (h_bary_ub x t ht)
    linarith
  have hP_W_le : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < t → 0 < ε →
      quadEnvelopePlus d ε (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) + ε * slopePlus d ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
    intro x t ε ht hε
    apply csSup_le
    · exact ⟨_, ⟨0, Set.mem_univ 0, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro b ⟨y', -, rfl⟩
      rw [h_projSpace, h_projTime]
      have hW := hW_le_v y' (t + ε) (by linarith)
      have hv_le := (h_comp x y' t ε hε).1
      linarith
  have hJ_le_slope : ∀ (B ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε ≤ B → ε < t →
      driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
        (slopePlus d B v (mkSpaceTime x t) + slopeMinus d B v (mkSpaceTime x t)) / 2 := by
    intro B ε x t hε hεB ht
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := by linarith
    have hP := hP_W_le x t ε ht_pos hε
    have hε_ne : ε ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hε
    have hM : ε * slopeMinus d ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) =
        v (mkSpaceTime x t) - quadEnvelopeMinus d ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) := by
      unfold slopeMinus
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hε_ne
    have h_mono_plus := (h_mono x t ε B hε hεB).1
    have h_mono_minus := (h_mono x t ε B hε hεB).2
    have h_plus_mul : ε * slopePlus d ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
        ε * slopePlus d B v (mkSpaceTime x t) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mono_plus (le_of_lt hε)
    have h_minus_mul : ε * slopeMinus d ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
        ε * slopeMinus d B v (mkSpaceTime x t) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mono_minus (le_of_lt hε)
    unfold driftFunctional
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ε)]
    linarith
  let A : ℝ := 32 * C_box
  let C_ub : ℝ := (4 * A ^ 2 + 2 * A + 3) ^ 2
  have hA_pos : 0 < A := by positivity
  have hC_ub_pos : 0 < C_ub := by positivity
  have h_disp_bound : ∀ (B : ℝ) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t σ : ℝ),
      2 ≤ B → ‖x‖ ≤ B → 0 < t → t ≤ B → |σ - 1| ≤ 3 * B →
      |v (mkSpaceTime y σ)| + |v (mkSpaceTime x t)| - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * B) ≤
        C_ub * B * (1 + Real.log B) ^ 4 := by
    intro B x y t σ hB hx ht_pos htB hσ
    have hB_pos : 0 < B := by linarith
    have h_logB_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log B := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    let L : ℝ := 1 + Real.log B
    have hL_ge_one : 1 ≤ L := by dsimp [L]; linarith
    have hL_pos : 0 < L := by linarith
    have hL_sq_ge_one : 1 ≤ L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    let r : ℝ := ‖y - x‖
    have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := norm_nonneg (y - x)
    let K : ℝ := 3 * B * L ^ 2 + r
    have hBL2_ge : B ≤ B * L ^ 2 := le_mul_of_one_le_right (le_of_lt hB_pos) hL_sq_ge_one
    have hK_ge_3B : 3 * B ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
    have hK_ge_two : 2 ≤ K := by linarith
    have hK_pos : 0 < K := by linarith
    have hx_K : ‖x‖ ≤ K := by linarith
    have ht_K : |t - 1| ≤ K := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hy_K : ‖y‖ ≤ K := by
      have h_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y - x‖ := by
        simpa [add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le x (y - x)
      change ‖y‖ ≤ 3 * B * L ^ 2 + r
      change ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + r at h_tri
      linarith
    have hσ_K : |σ - 1| ≤ K := by linarith
    have hv_x := h_box K x t hK_ge_two hx_K ht_K
    have hv_y := h_box K y σ hK_ge_two hy_K hσ_K
    have hv_sum : |v (mkSpaceTime y σ)| + |v (mkSpaceTime x t)| ≤
        2 * C_box * K * (1 + Real.log K) ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hBL2_pos : 0 < B * L ^ 2 := by positivity
    let X : ℝ := K / (B * L ^ 2)
    have hX_pos : 0 < X := div_pos hK_pos hBL2_pos
    let q : ℝ := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt X)
    have hq_pos : 0 < q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hX_pos)
    have hq_sq : q ^ 2 = Real.sqrt X := Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg X)
    have hq_pow4 : q ^ 4 = X := by
      calc q ^ 4 = (q ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = (Real.sqrt X) ^ 2 := by rw [hq_sq]
        _ = X := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hX_pos)
    have hK_eq : K = B * L ^ 2 * q ^ 4 := by
      rw [hq_pow4]
      dsimp [X]
      exact (mul_div_cancel₀ K (ne_of_gt hBL2_pos)).symm
    have hr_eq : r = B * L ^ 2 * (q ^ 4 - 3) := by
      have h1 : K = 3 * B * L ^ 2 + r := rfl
      linarith [hK_eq, h1]
    have hr_sq_div : r ^ 2 / (2 * B) = (1 / 2) * B * L ^ 4 * (q ^ 4 - 3) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hr_eq]
      have hB_ne : B ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hB_pos
      field_simp [hB_ne]
    have h_logK_eq : Real.log K = Real.log B + 2 * Real.log L + 4 * Real.log q := by
      rw [hK_eq]
      rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hBL2_pos) (by positivity)]
      rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hB_pos) (by positivity)]
      rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_logL_le : Real.log L ≤ L - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hL_pos
    have h_logq_le : Real.log q ≤ q - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hq_pos
    have h_logK_ub : 1 + Real.log K ≤ 4 * L * (1 + q) := by
      have h_L_def : 1 + Real.log B = L := rfl
      have h_prod : q ≤ L * q := le_mul_of_one_le_left (le_of_lt hq_pos) hL_ge_one
      linarith
    have h_logK_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log K := by
      have : 0 ≤ Real.log K := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h_logK_sq : (1 + Real.log K) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * L ^ 2 * (1 + q) ^ 2 := by
      calc (1 + Real.log K) ^ 2
        _ ≤ (4 * L * (1 + q)) ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = 16 * L ^ 2 * (1 + q) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_term1_ub : 2 * C_box * K * (1 + Real.log K) ^ 2 ≤
        B * L ^ 4 * (A * q ^ 4 * (1 + q) ^ 2) := by
      calc 2 * C_box * K * (1 + Real.log K) ^ 2
        _ ≤ 2 * C_box * K * (16 * L ^ 2 * (1 + q) ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_logK_sq (by positivity)
        _ = B * L ^ 4 * (A * q ^ 4 * (1 + q) ^ 2) := by
            rw [hK_eq]
            dsimp [A]
            ring
    have h_sos_id : C_ub - (A * q ^ 4 * (1 + q) ^ 2 - (1 / 2) * (q ^ 4 - 3) ^ 2) =
        9 / 2 + A * q ^ 4 * (q - 1) ^ 2 + (1 / 4) * q ^ 4 * (q ^ 2 - 4 * A) ^ 2 +
          (1 / 4) * (q ^ 4 - 2 * (4 * A ^ 2 + 2 * A + 3)) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [C_ub]
      ring
    have h_sos_nonneg : 0 ≤ 9 / 2 + A * q ^ 4 * (q - 1) ^ 2 +
        (1 / 4) * q ^ 4 * (q ^ 2 - 4 * A) ^ 2 +
        (1 / 4) * (q ^ 4 - 2 * (4 * A ^ 2 + 2 * A + 3)) ^ 2 := by
      positivity
    have h_poly_ub : A * q ^ 4 * (1 + q) ^ 2 - (1 / 2) * (q ^ 4 - 3) ^ 2 ≤ C_ub := by
      linarith
    have h_scaled_ub : B * L ^ 4 * (A * q ^ 4 * (1 + q) ^ 2 - (1 / 2) * (q ^ 4 - 3) ^ 2) ≤
        B * L ^ 4 * C_ub :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_poly_ub (by positivity)
    change |v (mkSpaceTime y σ)| + |v (mkSpaceTime x t)| - r ^ 2 / (2 * B) ≤ C_ub * B * L ^ 4
    linarith [hv_sum, h_term1_ub, hr_sq_div, h_scaled_ub]
  refine ⟨C_ub, hC_ub_pos, ?_⟩
  intro B ε x t hB hε hεB hx ht htB
  have hB_pos : 0 < B := by linarith
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by linarith
  obtain ⟨⟨y_plus, hy_plus⟩, ⟨y_minus, hy_minus⟩⟩ := h_attain x t B hB_pos
  have hσ_plus : |(t + B) - 1| ≤ 3 * B := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hσ_minus : |(t - B) - 1| ≤ 3 * B := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_ub_plus := h_disp_bound B x y_plus t (t + B) hB hx ht_pos htB hσ_plus
  have h_ub_minus := h_disp_bound B x y_minus t (t - B) hB hx ht_pos htB hσ_minus
  have hv_diff_plus : v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + B)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
      |v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + B))| + |v (mkSpaceTime x t)| := by
    linarith [le_abs_self (v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + B))), neg_le_abs (v (mkSpaceTime x t))]
  have hv_diff_minus : v (mkSpaceTime x t) - v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - B)) ≤
      |v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - B))| + |v (mkSpaceTime x t)| := by
    linarith [le_abs_self (v (mkSpaceTime x t)), neg_le_abs (v (mkSpaceTime y_minus (t - B)))]
  have h_B_slope_plus : B * slopePlus d B v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
      B * (C_ub * (1 + Real.log B) ^ 4) := by
    linarith [hy_plus, h_ub_plus, hv_diff_plus]
  have h_B_slope_minus : B * slopeMinus d B v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤
      B * (C_ub * (1 + Real.log B) ^ 4) := by
    linarith [hy_minus, h_ub_minus, hv_diff_minus]
  have h_slope_plus : slopePlus d B v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ C_ub * (1 + Real.log B) ^ 4 :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_B_slope_plus hB_pos
  have h_slope_minus : slopeMinus d B v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ C_ub * (1 + Real.log B) ^ 4 :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_B_slope_minus hB_pos
  have hJ := hJ_le_slope B ε x t hε hεB ht
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (x q_path y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hτ₀ : τ₀ ≠ t) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (movingParabolicTestFunc d x q_path t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂)
      {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) | projTime z ≠ t} ∧
    limitingOperator (movingParabolicTestFunc d x q_path t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂)
      (mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀) = c₂

proof.tactics:
by
  have projSpace_mkSpaceTime :
      ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s) = y := by
    intro y s
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have projTime_mkSpaceTime :
      ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ), projTime (mkSpaceTime y s) = s := by
    intro y s
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
  have projSpace_add :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projSpace (z₁ + z₂) = projSpace z₁ + projSpace z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_add :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        projTime (z₁ + z₂) = projTime z₁ + projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    simp [projTime]
  have projSpace_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        projSpace (c • z) = c • projSpace z := by
    intro c z
    ext i
    simp [projSpace]
  have projTime_smul :
      ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        projTime (c • z) = c * projTime z := by
    intro c z
    simp [projTime]
  have inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime :
      ∀ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        inner ℝ z₁ z₂ = inner ℝ (projSpace z₁) (projSpace z₂) + projTime z₁ * projTime z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [projSpace, projTime, mul_comm]
  let projSpaceCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := projSpace
        map_add' := projSpace_add
        map_smul' := projSpace_smul }
  let projTimeCLM : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := projTime
        map_add' := projTime_add
        map_smul' := projTime_smul }
  have deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv :
      ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
        {f : E → ℝ} {W : Set E}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : E}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f W → ∀ (ξ : E),
        deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (z₀ + s • ξ))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ ξ := by
    intro E _ _ f W hW z₀ hz₀ hf ξ
    have h_pre : IsOpen ((fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ⁻¹' W) :=
      hW.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ⁻¹' W := by simp [hz₀]
    have h_ev : (fun s : ℝ => deriv (fun r : ℝ => f (z₀ + r • ξ)) s) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        (fun s : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ)) ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [h_pre.mem_nhds h0_mem] with s hs
      have hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ) :=
        ((hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hs)).differentiableAt (by norm_num))
      have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => z₀ + r • ξ) ξ s := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
      exact (hf_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h_line).deriv
    rw [h_ev.deriv_eq]
    have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f z₀ := hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)
    have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ := hcd.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hf2_diff : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀) (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) := by
      simpa using (hcd1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have h_line0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • ξ) ξ 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const ξ |>.const_add z₀
    have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z₀ + s • ξ))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z₀ ξ) 0 :=
      hf2_diff.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line0
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ξ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_comp).deriv
  set U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :=
    {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) | projTime z ≠ t}
  set Ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
    movingParabolicTestFunc d x q_path t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂
  have hU_open : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne.preimage projTimeCLM.continuous
  have h_time_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => projTime z) :=
    projTimeCLM.contDiff
  have h_space_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => projSpace z) :=
    projSpaceCLM.contDiff
  have h_sub_t_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => projTime z - t) :=
    h_time_cd.sub contDiff_const
  have h_sub_t_ne : ∀ z ∈ U, projTime z - t ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => sub_ne_zero.mpr hz
  have h_P_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
      c₀ + c₁ * (projTime z - τ₀) + (c₂ / 2) * (projTime z - τ₀) ^ 2) :=
    (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul (h_time_cd.sub contDiff_const))).add
      (contDiff_const.mul ((h_time_cd.sub contDiff_const).pow 2))
  have h_L_cd : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
      ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * ((projTime z - t) * Real.log (projTime z - t))) U :=
    contDiffOn_const.mul (h_sub_t_cd.contDiffOn.mul (h_sub_t_cd.contDiffOn.log h_sub_t_ne))
  have h_N_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) =>
      ‖projSpace z - (x + (projTime z - t) • q_path)‖ ^ 2) :=
    (h_space_cd.sub (contDiff_const.add (h_sub_t_cd.smul contDiff_const))).norm_sq ℝ
  have h_D_cd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) => 2 * (projTime z - t)) :=
    contDiff_const.mul h_sub_t_cd
  have h_D_ne : ∀ z ∈ U, 2 * (projTime z - t) ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz)
  have hΨ_C2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Ψ U :=
    (h_P_cd.contDiffOn.sub h_L_cd).add (h_N_cd.contDiffOn.div h_D_cd.contDiffOn h_D_ne)
  refine ⟨hΨ_C2, ?_⟩
  set z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀
  set Δ₀ : ℝ := τ₀ - t
  set x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := x + Δ₀ • q_path
  set q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := Δ₀⁻¹ • (y₀ - x₀)
  have hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U := by
    change projTime (mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀) ≠ t
    rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    exact hτ₀
  have hΔ₀_ne : Δ₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hτ₀
  have hΨ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ z₀ :=
    (hΨ_C2.contDiffAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hΨ_fd : HasFDerivAt Ψ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient Ψ z₀)) z₀ :=
    hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mp hΨ_diff.hasGradientAt
  have h_grad_space : projSpace (gradient Ψ z₀) = q := by
    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
    intro h
    set v_h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime h 0
    set α_h : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := fun s => z₀ + s • v_h
    have h_line : HasDerivAt α_h v_h 0 := by
      simpa [α_h] using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v_h |>.const_add z₀
    have hα0 : α_h 0 = z₀ := by simp [α_h]
    have h_fd0 : HasFDerivAt Ψ (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient Ψ z₀)) (α_h 0) := by
      rw [hα0]; exact hΨ_fd
    have h_val : (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ _ (gradient Ψ z₀)) v_h =
        inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient Ψ z₀)) h := by
      rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, inner_eq_projSpace_add_projTime]
      simp [v_h, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    have h_d1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (α_h s)) (inner ℝ (projSpace (gradient Ψ z₀)) h) 0 := by
      rw [← h_val]
      exact h_fd0.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line
    have h_poly_eq : (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (α_h s)) =
        fun s : ℝ => (c₀ - ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * (Δ₀ * Real.log Δ₀) + ‖y₀ - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * Δ₀)) +
          (Δ₀⁻¹ * inner ℝ (y₀ - x₀) h) * s + (‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * Δ₀)) * s ^ 2 := by
      ext s
      dsimp [Ψ, movingParabolicTestFunc, α_h, z₀, v_h]
      rw [projTime_add, projTime_smul, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
        projSpace_add, projSpace_smul, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
      have h_time_sub : τ₀ + s * 0 - t = Δ₀ := by dsimp [Δ₀]; ring
      have h_time_τ : τ₀ + s * 0 - τ₀ = 0 := by ring
      rw [h_time_sub, h_time_τ]
      have h_sub : y₀ + s • h - (x + Δ₀ • q_path) = (y₀ - x₀) + s • h := by
        dsimp [x₀]; abel
      have h_norm : ‖y₀ + s • h - (x + Δ₀ • q_path)‖ ^ 2 =
          ‖y₀ - x₀‖ ^ 2 + 2 * s * inner ℝ (y₀ - x₀) h + s ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_sub, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          mul_pow, sq_abs]
        ring
      rw [h_norm, inv_eq_one_div]
      have h2Δ₀_ne : 2 * Δ₀ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hΔ₀_ne
      field_simp [hΔ₀_ne, h2Δ₀_ne]
      ring
    have h_d2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (α_h s)) (inner ℝ q h) 0 := by
      rw [h_poly_eq]
      have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s) 1 0 := hasDerivAt_id 0
      have h_comb := ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ)
        (c₀ - ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * (Δ₀ * Real.log Δ₀) + ‖y₀ - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * Δ₀))).add
        (h_id.const_mul (Δ₀⁻¹ * inner ℝ (y₀ - x₀) h))).add
        ((h_id.pow 2).const_mul (‖h‖ ^ 2 / (2 * Δ₀)))
      convert h_comb using 1
      dsimp [q]
      rw [real_inner_smul_left]
      ring
    exact h_d1.unique h_d2
  set ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime q 1
  set u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := q - q_path
  change limitingOperator Ψ z₀ = c₂
  unfold limitingOperator
  rw [h_grad_space, ← deriv_deriv_line_eq_fderiv_fderiv hU_open hz₀ hΨ_C2 ξ]
  set C_const : ℝ := c₀ + (Δ₀ / 2) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + Δ₀ * inner ℝ u q_path
  set C_lin : ℝ := c₁ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
  set Q : ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun s => C_const + C_lin * s + (c₂ / 2) * s ^ 2 +
      ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * ((Δ₀ ^ 2 / 2) * (Δ₀ + s)⁻¹ - (Δ₀ + s) * Real.log (Δ₀ + s))
  have hW_open : IsOpen {s : ℝ | Δ₀ + s ≠ 0} :=
    isOpen_ne.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have h0_W : (0 : ℝ) ∈ {s : ℝ | Δ₀ + s ≠ 0} := by
    change Δ₀ + 0 ≠ 0
    simpa using hΔ₀_ne
  have h_ev_Q : (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (z₀ + s • ξ)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] Q := by
    filter_upwards [hW_open.mem_nhds h0_W] with s hs
    change Δ₀ + s ≠ 0 at hs
    dsimp [Ψ, movingParabolicTestFunc, Q, z₀, ξ]
    rw [projTime_add, projTime_smul, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime,
      projSpace_add, projSpace_smul, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
    have h_time_sub : τ₀ + s * 1 - t = Δ₀ + s := by dsimp [Δ₀]; ring
    have h_time_τ : τ₀ + s * 1 - τ₀ = s := by ring
    rw [h_time_sub, h_time_τ]
    have h_Δq : Δ₀ • q = y₀ - x₀ := smul_inv_smul₀ hΔ₀_ne (y₀ - x₀)
    have h_space_vec : y₀ + s • q - (x + (Δ₀ + s) • q_path) = (Δ₀ + s) • u + Δ₀ • q_path := by
      have h_sub1 : y₀ + s • q - (x + (Δ₀ + s) • q_path) = (y₀ - x₀) + s • q - s • q_path := by
        dsimp [x₀]
        rw [add_smul]
        abel
      rw [h_sub1, ← h_Δq]
      dsimp [u]
      rw [add_smul, smul_sub, smul_sub]
      abel
    have h_norm_sq : ‖y₀ + s • q - (x + (Δ₀ + s) • q_path)‖ ^ 2 =
        (Δ₀ + s) ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (Δ₀ + s) * Δ₀ * inner ℝ u q_path + Δ₀ ^ 2 * ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_space_vec, norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
      ring
    rw [h_norm_sq]
    dsimp [C_const, C_lin]
    rw [inv_eq_one_div]
    have h2s_ne : 2 * (Δ₀ + s) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hs
    field_simp [hs, h2s_ne]
    ring
  have h_d2_eq : deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => Ψ (z₀ + s • ξ))) 0 = deriv (deriv Q) 0 :=
    h_ev_Q.deriv.deriv_eq
  rw [h_d2_eq]
  set Q₁ : ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun s => C_lin + c₂ * s +
      ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * (-(Δ₀ ^ 2 / 2) * ((Δ₀ + s) ^ 2)⁻¹ - Real.log (Δ₀ + s) - 1)
  have h_ev_Q1 : deriv Q =ᶠ[nhds 0] Q₁ := by
    filter_upwards [hW_open.mem_nhds h0_W] with s hs
    change Δ₀ + s ≠ 0 at hs
    have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => r) 1 s := hasDerivAt_id s
    have h_shift : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => Δ₀ + r) 1 s := by
      simpa using h_id.const_add Δ₀
    have h_inv : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (Δ₀ + r)⁻¹) (-1 / (Δ₀ + s) ^ 2) s := by
      simpa using h_shift.fun_inv hs
    have h_log : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => Real.log (Δ₀ + r)) (1 / (Δ₀ + s)) s := by
      simpa using h_shift.log hs
    have h_xlog : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (Δ₀ + r) * Real.log (Δ₀ + r))
        (1 * Real.log (Δ₀ + s) + (Δ₀ + s) * (1 / (Δ₀ + s))) s :=
      h_shift.mul h_log
    have h_comb := (((hasDerivAt_const s C_const).add (h_id.const_mul C_lin)).add
      ((h_id.pow 2).const_mul (c₂ / 2))).add
      (((h_inv.const_mul (Δ₀ ^ 2 / 2)).sub h_xlog).const_mul (‖q_path‖ ^ 2))
    have hd : HasDerivAt Q (Q₁ s) s := by
      dsimp [Q, Q₁]
      convert h_comb using 1
      rw [inv_eq_one_div]
      have h_sq_ne : (Δ₀ + s) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hs
      field_simp [hs, h_sq_ne]
      ring
    exact hd.deriv
  rw [h_ev_Q1.deriv_eq]
  have hΔ₀0_ne : Δ₀ + 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa using hΔ₀_ne
  have h_id0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s) 1 0 := hasDerivAt_id 0
  have h_shift0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Δ₀ + s) 1 0 := by
    simpa using h_id0.const_add Δ₀
  have h_inv_sq0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((Δ₀ + s) ^ 2)⁻¹)
      (-(2 * (Δ₀ + 0) ^ (2 - 1) * 1) / ((Δ₀ + 0) ^ 2) ^ 2) 0 :=
    (h_shift0.pow 2).fun_inv (pow_ne_zero 2 hΔ₀0_ne)
  have h_log0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.log (Δ₀ + s)) (1 / (Δ₀ + 0)) 0 :=
    h_shift0.log hΔ₀0_ne
  have h_comb0 := ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) C_lin).add (h_id0.const_mul c₂)).add
    ((((h_inv_sq0.const_mul (-(Δ₀ ^ 2 / 2))).sub h_log0).sub
      (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ))).const_mul (‖q_path‖ ^ 2))
  have hd2 : HasDerivAt Q₁ c₂ 0 := by
    dsimp [Q₁]
    convert h_comb0 using 1
    field_simp [hΔ₀_ne]
    ring
  exact hd2.deriv

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (hv : InLimitingClassA d C₁ v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ η : ℝ), 0 < η →
      ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + η * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    (h_test : ∀ (x q_path y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ), τ₀ ≠ t →
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (movingParabolicTestFunc d x q_path t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂)
        {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) | projTime z ≠ t} ∧
      limitingOperator (movingParabolicTestFunc d x q_path t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂)
        (mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀) = c₂)
    (x₀ q_path : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) +
      quadEnvelopePlus d (2 * ε) v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + (2 * ε) • q_path) t) -
      2 * quadEnvelopePlus d ε v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + ε • q_path) t) ≥
        -(2 * ε * Real.log 2) * ‖q_path‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have _hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁ := hC₁
  have projTime_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      projTime (mkSpaceTime y s) = s := by
    intro y s
    simp [projTime, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
  have projSpace_mkSpaceTime : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      projSpace (mkSpaceTime y s) = y := by
    intro y s
    ext i
    simp [projSpace, mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have mkSpaceTime_proj : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      mkSpaceTime (projSpace z) (projTime z) = z := by
    intro z
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, projTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro i
      simp [mkSpaceTime, projSpace, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have continuous_projTime : Continuous (projTime : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) :=
    PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin (d + 1) => ℝ) (Fin.last d)
  have h_cont_mk : Continuous (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ => mkSpaceTime p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold mkSpaceTime
    refine (ContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous _).comp (continuous_pi_iff.mpr fun j => ?_)
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simpa [Fin.snoc_last] using continuous_snd
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ i).comp continuous_fst
  have norm_sq_le_two_sub_add : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x y
    have h_tri : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖x‖ := by
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (y - x) x
    have h_sq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖y - x‖ + ‖x‖) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg y) h_tri 2
    have h_amgm : 0 ≤ (‖y - x‖ - ‖x‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (‖y - x‖ - ‖x‖)
    linarith
  let v_tilde : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ :=
    fun z => v (z + (projTime z - t) • mkSpaceTime q_path 0)
  have hv_tilde_cont : Continuous v_tilde :=
    hv.1.comp (continuous_id.add ((continuous_projTime.sub continuous_const).smul continuous_const))
  have hv_tilde_eval : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
      v_tilde (mkSpaceTime y s) = v (mkSpaceTime (y + (s - t) • q_path) s) := by
    intro y s
    dsimp [v_tilde]
    congr 1
    rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime]
    ext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_last]
    · intro i
      simp [mkSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have hv_tilde_base : v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) = v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) := by
    rw [hv_tilde_eval, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have h_growth_tilde : ∀ (t₁ t₂ η : ℝ), 0 < η →
      ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v_tilde (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + η * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro t₁ t₂ η hη
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := h_growth t₁ t₂ (η / 2) (half_pos hη)
    let K_t : ℝ := |t₁ - t| + |t₂ - t|
    let K : ℝ := K_t * ‖q_path‖
    refine ⟨M₀ + η * K ^ 2, ?_⟩
    intro y s hs₁ hs₂
    rw [hv_tilde_eval]
    let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (s - t) • q_path
    have hs_abs : |s - t| ≤ K_t := by
      have h1 : -(t₁ - t) ≤ |t₁ - t| := neg_le_abs (t₁ - t)
      have h2 : t₂ - t ≤ |t₂ - t| := le_abs_self (t₂ - t)
      have h3 : 0 ≤ |t₁ - t| := abs_nonneg (t₁ - t)
      have h4 : 0 ≤ |t₂ - t| := abs_nonneg (t₂ - t)
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by dsimp [K_t]; linarith, by dsimp [K_t]; linarith⟩
    have hw_le : ‖w‖ ≤ K := by
      dsimp [w, K]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_abs (norm_nonneg q_path)
    have hw_sq : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg w) hw_le 2
    have h_tri : ‖y + w‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_add_le y w
    have h_sq : ‖y + w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖y‖ + ‖w‖) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg (y + w)) h_tri 2
    have h_amgm : 0 ≤ (‖y‖ - ‖w‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (‖y‖ - ‖w‖)
    have hyw_sq : ‖y + w‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 + 2 * K ^ 2 := by linarith
    have h_mul : (η / 2) * ‖y + w‖ ^ 2 ≤ η * ‖y‖ ^ 2 + η * K ^ 2 := by
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyw_sq (le_of_lt (half_pos hη))
      linarith
    have h_v := hM₀ (y + w) s hs₁ hs₂
    dsimp [w] at h_v h_mul
    linarith
  have h_env_eq : ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) + ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) =
        quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + ℓ • q_path) t) := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    have h_quad_eq : quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) =
        quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + ℓ • q_path) t) := by
      unfold quadEnvelopePlus
      rw [projTime_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
      congr 1
      ext val
      simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨u + ℓ • q_path, ?_⟩
        rw [hv_tilde_eval]
        have h_time : t + ℓ - t = ℓ := by ring
        have h_space : u + ℓ • q_path - (x₀ + ℓ • q_path) = u - x₀ := by abel
        rw [h_time, h_space]
      · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨y - ℓ • q_path, ?_⟩
        rw [hv_tilde_eval]
        have h_time : t + ℓ - t = ℓ := by ring
        have h_add : y - ℓ • q_path + ℓ • q_path = y := sub_add_cancel y (ℓ • q_path)
        have h_sub : y - ℓ • q_path - x₀ = y - (x₀ + ℓ • q_path) := by abel
        rw [h_time, h_add, h_sub]
    unfold slopePlus
    rw [hv_tilde_base, h_quad_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hℓ)]
    ring
  let L : ℝ := 2 * ε
  have hL : 0 < L := by positivity
  have h_master_plus : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ L →
      (∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v_tilde (mkSpaceTime u (t + ℓ)) - v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) - ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t)) ∧
      (∃ u_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v_tilde (mkSpaceTime u_plus (t + ℓ)) - v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) - ‖u_plus - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t)) ∧
      (∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v_tilde (mkSpaceTime u (t + ℓ)) - v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) - ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) → ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ) := by
    have hη_pos : 0 < 1 / (8 * L) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := h_growth_tilde (t - L) (t + L) (1 / (8 * L)) hη_pos
    let M_x : ℝ := max M₀ 0 + ‖x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L)
    have hM_x_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_x := by
      have h1 : 0 ≤ max M₀ 0 := le_max_right M₀ 0
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hM₀_le : M₀ ≤ max M₀ 0 := le_max_left M₀ 0
    have hv_shifted : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        t - L ≤ s → s ≤ t + L →
        -M_x - ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) ≤ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime u s) ∧
        v_tilde (mkSpaceTime u s) ≤ M_x + ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) := by
      intro u s hs₁ hs₂
      have h_abs := hM₀ u s hs₁ hs₂
      have h_abs' := abs_le.mp h_abs
      have h_norm := norm_sq_le_two_sub_add x₀ u
      have h_mul : (1 / (8 * L)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (1 / (8 * L)) * (2 * ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x₀‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_norm (le_of_lt hη_pos)
      have h_ring : (1 / (8 * L)) * (2 * ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖x₀‖ ^ 2) =
          ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) + ‖x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) := by ring
      constructor <;> linarith [h_abs'.1, h_abs'.2, h_mul, h_ring, hM₀_le]
    have hv_x : ∀ s : ℝ, t - L ≤ s → s ≤ t + L →
        -M_x ≤ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ s) ∧ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ s) ≤ M_x := by
      intro s hs₁ hs₂
      have h_xx := hv_shifted x₀ s hs₁ hs₂
      simpa [sub_self] using h_xx
    let C : ℝ := 8 * M_x
    have hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
    let R : ℝ := Real.sqrt (C * L)
    have hR_nonneg : 0 ≤ R := Real.sqrt_nonneg (C * L)
    have hB_compact : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) := isCompact_closedBall x₀ R
    have hx_mem : x₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR_nonneg
    refine ⟨C, hC_nonneg, ?_⟩
    intro ℓ hℓ hℓL
    let Φ_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
      fun u => v_tilde (mkSpaceTime u (t + ℓ)) - ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)
    have h_quad_cont : Continuous (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) :=
      ((continuous_norm.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).pow 2).div_const (2 * ℓ)
    have hΦ_plus_cont : Continuous Φ_plus :=
      (hv_tilde_cont.comp (h_cont_mk.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))).sub h_quad_cont
    have h_loc_plus : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        Φ_plus x₀ ≤ Φ_plus u → ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ := by
      intro u hu
      have hs₁ : t - L ≤ t + ℓ := by linarith
      have hs₂ : t + ℓ ≤ t + L := by linarith
      have hv_u := (hv_shifted u (t + ℓ) hs₁ hs₂).2
      have hv_x_lb := (hv_x (t + ℓ) hs₁ hs₂).1
      have hΦ_x : Φ_plus x₀ = v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ (t + ℓ)) := by
        simp [Φ_plus]
      have h_div_le : ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * L) ≤ ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg ‖u - x₀‖) (by positivity) (by linarith)
      have h_div_two : ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) = 2 * (‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ)) := by ring
      have h_bound : ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (4 * ℓ) ≤ 2 * M_x := by
        dsimp only [Φ_plus] at hu
        linarith
      have h_mul := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * ℓ)).mp h_bound
      linarith
    have h_mem_ball : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ℓ → u ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R := by
      intro u hu
      have h_le_CL : ‖u - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * L :=
        le_trans hu (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓL hC_nonneg)
      have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_le_CL
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (u - x₀))] at h_sqrt
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      exact h_sqrt
    obtain ⟨u_plus, hu_plus_mem, hu_plus_max⟩ :=
      hB_compact.exists_isMaxOn ⟨x₀, hx_mem⟩ hΦ_plus_cont.continuousOn
    have hu_plus_ge_x : Φ_plus x₀ ≤ Φ_plus u_plus := isMaxOn_iff.mp hu_plus_max x₀ hx_mem
    have h_max_all : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Φ_plus u ≤ Φ_plus u_plus := by
      intro u
      by_cases hu : Φ_plus x₀ ≤ Φ_plus u
      · exact isMaxOn_iff.mp hu_plus_max u (h_mem_ball u (h_loc_plus u hu))
      · linarith
    have h_mem_plus : Φ_plus u_plus ∈ Φ_plus '' Set.univ :=
      Set.mem_image_of_mem Φ_plus (Set.mem_univ u_plus)
    have h_ub_plus : ∀ b ∈ Φ_plus '' Set.univ, b ≤ Φ_plus u_plus := by
      rintro _ ⟨u, -, rfl⟩
      exact h_max_all u
    have h_sSup_plus : sSup (Φ_plus '' Set.univ) = Φ_plus u_plus :=
      le_antisymm (csSup_le ⟨Φ_plus u_plus, h_mem_plus⟩ h_ub_plus)
        (le_csSup ⟨Φ_plus u_plus, h_ub_plus⟩ h_mem_plus)
    have h_quadPlus : quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) = Φ_plus u_plus := by
      simp only [quadEnvelopePlus, projTime_mkSpaceTime, projSpace_mkSpaceTime]
      exact h_sSup_plus
    have h_slopePlus : ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) =
        Φ_plus u_plus - v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) := by
      unfold slopePlus
      rw [h_quadPlus, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hℓ)]
    refine ⟨?_, ⟨u_plus, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro u
      have h1 := h_max_all u
      dsimp only [Φ_plus] at h1 h_slopePlus
      linarith
    · dsimp only [Φ_plus] at h_slopePlus
      linarith
    · intro u hu_eq
      have hu_ge : Φ_plus x₀ ≤ Φ_plus u := by
        dsimp only [Φ_plus] at hu_plus_ge_x h_slopePlus ⊢
        linarith
      exact h_loc_plus u hu_ge
  obtain ⟨C, hC, h_loc_C⟩ := h_master_plus
  have h_cont_tilde : ContinuousOn
      (fun ℓ => ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t)) (Set.Icc 0 L) := by
    let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun p => v_tilde (mkSpaceTime p.1 (t + p.2)) - v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t)
    let E₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ => ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v_tilde (mkSpaceTime x₀ t)
    have hw_cont : Continuous w :=
      (hv_tilde_cont.comp (h_cont_mk.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.add continuous_snd)))).sub
        continuous_const
    have hw0 : w (x₀, 0) = 0 := by simp [w]
    have hE0 : E₀ 0 = 0 := by simp [E₀]
    change ContinuousOn E₀ (Set.Icc 0 L)
    intro ℓ₀ hℓ₀
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hℓ₀.1 with hℓ₀_eq | hℓ₀_pos
    · subst hℓ₀_eq
      rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
      intro η hη
      obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀⟩ :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hw_cont.continuousAt (x := (x₀, 0))) η hη
      have hC1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < C + 1 := by linarith
      let δ := min L (min (δ₀ / 2) (δ₀ ^ 2 / (2 * (C + 1))))
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hL (lt_min (half_pos hδ₀_pos) (by positivity))
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun ℓ hℓ hdist => ?_⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq, hE0, sub_zero]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hℓ.1 with hℓ_eq | hℓ_pos
      · subst hℓ_eq
        rw [hE0, abs_zero]
        exact hη
      · rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos] at hdist
        have hℓ_lt_δ₀ : ℓ < δ₀ := by
          have : ℓ < δ₀ / 2 :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
          linarith
        have hCℓ_lt : (C + 1) * ℓ < δ₀ ^ 2 := by
          have h1 : ℓ < δ₀ ^ 2 / (2 * (C + 1)) :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
          have h2 : ℓ * (2 * (C + 1)) < δ₀ ^ 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp h1
          have h3 : 0 < δ₀ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hδ₀_pos
          nlinarith
        have h_low : -η < E₀ ℓ := by
          have h_cx : w (x₀, ℓ) - ‖x₀ - x₀‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤ E₀ ℓ :=
            (h_loc_C ℓ hℓ_pos hℓ.2).1 x₀

  let z_x := mkSpaceTime x₀ t
  let E : ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun ℓ => ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v_tilde z_x + ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * (ℓ * Real.log ℓ)
  let S : ℝ := E L / L
  have hE_cont : ContinuousOn E (Set.Icc 0 L) :=
    h_cont_tilde.add (continuousOn_const.mul Real.continuous_mul_log.continuousOn)
  have hE0 : E 0 = 0 := by
    dsimp [E]
    ring
  have hE2 : E L = L * S := by
    dsimp [S]
    exact (mul_div_cancel₀ (E L) (ne_of_gt hL)).symm
  have hε_lt_L : ε < L := by dsimp [L]; linarith
  have hE_mid : E ε ≤ ε * S := by
    by_contra h_not_le
    push_neg at h_not_le
    have h_diff_pos : 0 < L - ε := sub_pos.mpr hε_lt_L
    have hD_pos : 0 < E ε - ε * S := sub_pos.mpr h_not_le
    set D : ℝ := E ε - ε * S
    set δ : ℝ := D / (2 * ε * (L - ε))
    have h_denom_pos : 0 < 2 * ε * (L - ε) := by positivity
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := div_pos hD_pos h_denom_pos
    let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ => E ℓ - S * ℓ - δ * (ℓ * (L - ℓ))
    have hh_cont : ContinuousOn h (Set.Icc 0 L) := by
      refine (hE_cont.sub (continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id)).sub ?_
      exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_id.mul (continuousOn_const.sub continuousOn_id))
    have h_nonempty : (Set.Icc 0 L).Nonempty := Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt hL)
    obtain ⟨ℓ₀, hℓ₀_mem, hℓ₀_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn h_nonempty hh_cont
    rw [isMaxOn_iff] at hℓ₀_max
    have hh0 : h 0 = 0 := by
      simp only [h, hE0]
      ring
    have hh2 : h L = 0 := by
      simp only [h, hE2]
      ring
    have h_δ_prod : δ * (ε * (L - ε)) = D / 2 := by
      have h_ne1 : ε ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hε
      have h_ne2 : L - ε ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_diff_pos
      dsimp [δ]
      field_simp
    have hh1 : h ε = D / 2 := by
      dsimp [h]
      rw [h_δ_prod]
      dsimp [D]
      ring
    have hε_mem : ε ∈ Set.Icc 0 L := ⟨le_of_lt hε, le_of_lt hε_lt_L⟩
    have hh0_pos : 0 < h ℓ₀ := by
      have hh1_le : h ε ≤ h ℓ₀ := hℓ₀_max ε hε_mem
      linarith
    have hℓ₀_ne0 : ℓ₀ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h_eq
      rw [h_eq, hh0] at hh0_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hh0_pos
    have hℓ₀_ne2 : ℓ₀ ≠ L := by
      intro h_eq
      rw [h_eq, hh2] at hh0_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hh0_pos
    have hℓ₀_pos : 0 < ℓ₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne hℓ₀_mem.1 (Ne.symm hℓ₀_ne0)
    have hℓ₀_lt : ℓ₀ < L := lt_of_le_of_ne hℓ₀_mem.2 hℓ₀_ne2
    have h_upper : ∀ ℓ ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
        E ℓ ≤ E ℓ₀ + (S + δ * L - 2 * δ * ℓ₀) * (ℓ - ℓ₀) - δ * (ℓ - ℓ₀) ^ 2 := by
      intro ℓ hℓ_mem
      have h_le : h ℓ ≤ h ℓ₀ := hℓ₀_max ℓ hℓ_mem
      dsimp [h] at h_le
      have h_poly : S * ℓ + δ * (ℓ * (L - ℓ)) + (E ℓ₀ - S * ℓ₀ - δ * (ℓ₀ * (L - ℓ₀))) =
          E ℓ₀ + (S + δ * L - 2 * δ * ℓ₀) * (ℓ - ℓ₀) - δ * (ℓ - ℓ₀) ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith
    obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := (h_loc_C ℓ₀ hℓ₀_pos hℓ₀_mem.2).2.1
    let y₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := u₀ + ℓ₀ • q_path
    let τ₀ : ℝ := t + ℓ₀
    let c₀ : ℝ := v z_x + E ℓ₀
    let c₁ : ℝ := S + δ * L - 2 * δ * ℓ₀
    let c₂ : ℝ := -2 * δ
    let Ψ := movingParabolicTestFunc d x₀ q_path t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂
    let z₀ := mkSpaceTime y₀ τ₀
    let V_plus : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :=
      {z | t < projTime z} ∩ {z | projTime z < t + L}
    have hV_open : IsOpen V_plus :=
      IsOpen.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_projTime)
        (isOpen_lt continuous_projTime continuous_const)
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ V_plus := by
      simp only [V_plus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, z₀, projTime_mkSpaceTime, τ₀]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hτ₀_ne : τ₀ ≠ t := by
      dsimp [τ₀]
      linarith
    have hΨ_c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Ψ V_plus := by
      refine (h_test x₀ q_path y₀ t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ hτ₀_ne).1.mono ?_
      intro z hz
      simp only [V_plus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
      exact ne_of_gt hz.1
    have hΨ_z₀ : Ψ z₀ = v z₀ := by
      have hv_u₀ : v_tilde (mkSpaceTime u₀ (t + ℓ₀)) = v z₀ := by
        rw [hv_tilde_eval]
        have h_time : t + ℓ₀ - t = ℓ₀ := by ring
        rw [h_time]
      have hy₀_sub : y₀ - (x₀ + ℓ₀ • q_path) = u₀ - x₀ := by
        dsimp [y₀]
        abel
      rw [hv_u₀, hv_tilde_base] at hu₀
      dsimp [Ψ, movingParabolicTestFunc, z₀, τ₀, c₀, z_x, E] at hu₀ ⊢
      rw [projSpace_mkSpaceTime, projTime_mkSpaceTime]
      have h_sub1 : t + ℓ₀ - (t + ℓ₀) = 0 := by ring
      have h_sub2 : t + ℓ₀ - t = ℓ₀ := by ring
      rw [h_sub1, h_sub2, hy₀_sub]
      linarith
    have hΨ_ge : ∀ z ∈ V_plus, v z ≤ Ψ z := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [V_plus, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz
      let y := projSpace z
      let ℓ := projTime z - t
      let u := y - ℓ • q_path
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ := by dsimp [ℓ]; linarith
      have hℓ_lt : ℓ < L := by dsimp [ℓ]; linarith
      have hℓ_mem : ℓ ∈ Set.Icc 0 L := ⟨le_of_lt hℓ_pos, le_of_lt hℓ_lt⟩
      have hu_add : u + (t + ℓ - t) • q_path = y := by
        have ht_sub : t + ℓ - t = ℓ := by ring
        rw [ht_sub]
        dsimp [u]
        exact sub_add_cancel y (ℓ • q_path)
      have hz_eq : mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ) = z := by
        have ht : t + ℓ = projTime z := by dsimp [ℓ]; ring
        rw [ht]
        exact mkSpaceTime_proj z
      have hv_u : v_tilde (mkSpaceTime u (t + ℓ)) = v z := by
        rw [hv_tilde_eval, hu_add, hz_eq]
      have hu_sub : u - x₀ = y - (x₀ + ℓ • q_path) := by
        dsimp [u]
        abel
      have h_comp_z := (h_loc_C ℓ hℓ_pos hℓ_mem.2).1 u
      rw [hv_u, hv_tilde_base, hu_sub] at h_comp_z
      have h_up_ℓ := h_upper ℓ hℓ_mem
      dsimp [Ψ, movingParabolicTestFunc, τ₀, c₀, c₁, c₂, z_x, E, y, ℓ] at h_comp_z h_up_ℓ ⊢
      have h_poly : c₁ * (projTime z - (t + ℓ₀)) + (-2 * δ / 2) * (projTime z - (t + ℓ₀)) ^ 2 =
          c₁ * (projTime z - t - ℓ₀) - δ * (projTime z - t - ℓ₀) ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith
    have h_visc := hv.2.1 z₀ Ψ V_plus hV_open hz₀_mem hΨ_c2 hΨ_z₀ hΨ_ge
    have h_op := (h_test x₀ q_path y₀ t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ hτ₀_ne).2
    dsimp [Ψ, z₀, c₂] at h_visc h_op
    linarith
  have h2E_le : 2 * E ε ≤ E L := by
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE_mid (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
    have h_rhs : 2 * (ε * S) = E L := by
      dsimp [S, L]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
    linarith
  have h_log_mul : Real.log (2 * ε) = Real.log 2 + Real.log ε :=
    Real.log_mul two_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hε)
  have h_log_diff :
      ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * ((2 * ε) * Real.log (2 * ε)) -
        2 * (‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * (ε * Real.log ε)) =
        (2 * ε * Real.log 2) * ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_log_mul]
    ring
  have h_eq_ε := h_env_eq ε hε
  have h_eq_2ε := h_env_eq (2 * ε) hL
  dsimp [E, L, z_x] at h2E_le
  linarith

(d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_jensen : HasHorizontalJensenBound d κ v)
    (h_growth : ∀ (t₁ t₂ η : ℝ), 0 < η →
      ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (s : ℝ),
        t₁ ≤ s → s ≤ t₂ → |v (mkSpaceTime y s)| ≤ M + η * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    (h_comp_plus : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      v (mkSpaceTime y (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) ≤
        ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (h_attain_plus : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ℓ : ℝ), 0 < ℓ →
      ∃ y_plus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        v (mkSpaceTime y_plus (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) - ‖y_plus - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ) =
          ℓ * slopePlus d ℓ v (mkSpaceTime x t))
    (x b d_shift : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (ht : ε < t)
    (h_v_mid : ∀ (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      let q_path : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := (2 * ε)⁻¹ • (b - d_shift)
      v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t) +
        quadEnvelopePlus d (2 * ε) v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + (2 * ε) • q_path) t) -
        2 * quadEnvelopePlus d ε v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + ε • q_path) t) ≥
          -(2 * ε * Real.log 2) * ‖q_path‖ ^ 2) :
    let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
    W (mkSpaceTime (x + d_shift) t) +
      quadEnvelopePlus d (2 * ε) W (mkSpaceTime (x + b) t) -
      2 * quadEnvelopePlus d ε W (mkSpaceTime (x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (b + d_shift)) t) ≥
        -(Real.log 2 / (2 * ε)) * ‖b - d_shift‖ ^ 2

      exact h_ymid_le y_mid

    positivity

  have hw3 : 3 ≤ w := le_max_left 3 (16 * K_0)
  have hwK : 16 * K_0 ≤ w := le_max_right 3 (16 * K_0)

  have hw2_ge1 : 1 ≤ w ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hw4_ge1 : 1 ≤ w ^ 4 := by nlinarith

  have hR80 : 80 ≤ R := by
    have h_factor_pos : 0 < w ^ 3 + 3 * w ^ 2 + 9 * w + 27 := by positivity

  have hR2 : 2 ≤ R := by linarith
  have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := by linarith

  have h1logR1_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (R + 1) := by linarith

  have h_inner_ub : 2 * (C_vel * (1 + Real.log R) + C_vel) + Real.sqrt (2 * B₀) ≤

    push_cast
    linarith

        _ = 1 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hη_pos)]
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ := one_mul _
    have h_rhs : (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ * (η * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₀) = η := by

        _ = η * ((2 * (1 / 2) : ℝ) ^ m₀) := by rw [← mul_pow]

  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
  have h_delta_grid : ((2 ^ (m - j) : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε = δ_j := by
    have hm_split : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m - j) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
    dsimp [ε, δ_j]
    rw [hm_split, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  have h_one_grid : ((2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε = 1 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, ← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  have h_16_grid : ((2 ^ (m + 4) : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε = 16 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_add (2 : ℝ) m 4, mul_right_comm, ← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  have h_eps_lt_delta : ε < δ_j := by
    dsimp [ε, δ_j]
    exact pow_lt_pow_right_of_lt_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have h_grid_ind : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool),
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n
      (∃ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (m - j) ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 2 ^ (m + 4) ∧ z.2 = (k : ℝ) * ε) ∧ ‖z.1‖ ≤ R + 1 := by
    intro n ω
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      dsimp [stoppedWalk]
      refine ⟨⟨2 ^ m, ?_, ?_, h_one_grid.symm⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.sub_le m j)
      · exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.le_add_right m 4)
      · rw [norm_zero]
        linarith
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨⟨k, hk_lo, hk_hi, hk_eq⟩, h_norm⟩ := ih
      dsimp only [stoppedWalk]
      cases h_act : isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ⟨⟨k, hk_lo, hk_hi, hk_eq⟩, h_norm⟩
      · simp only [↓reduceIte]
        have h_act_prop : δ_j < (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ∧
            (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 < 16 ∧
            ‖(stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1‖ < R := by
          unfold isWalkActive at h_act
          exact decide_eq_true_iff.mp h_act
        rcases h_act_prop with ⟨ht_lo, ht_hi, hx_lt⟩
        have hk_gt : 2 ^ (m - j) < k := by
          have h1 : ((2 ^ (m - j) : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε < (k : ℝ) * ε := by
            linarith [h_delta_grid, hk_eq, ht_lo]
          exact Nat.cast_lt.mp (lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h1 (le_of_lt hε_pos))
        have hk_lt : k < 2 ^ (m + 4) := by
          have h2 : (k : ℝ) * ε < ((2 ^ (m + 4) : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε := by
            linarith [h_16_grid, hk_eq, ht_hi]
          exact Nat.cast_lt.mp (lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h2 (le_of_lt hε_pos))
        have hQ := h_step (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1
          (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2
          (le_of_lt hx_lt) (lt_trans h_eps_lt_delta ht_lo) (le_of_lt ht_hi)
        cases walkStepBit h ω n
        · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
          have hk_pos : 1 ≤ k := by
            have : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (m - j) := Nat.one_le_two_pow
            omega
          refine ⟨⟨k - 1, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
          · rw [hk_eq, Nat.cast_sub hk_pos, Nat.cast_one]
            ring
          · calc ‖(stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1 -
                ε • Q_minus (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1
                  (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ε‖
              _ ≤ ‖(stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1‖ +
                  ‖ε • Q_minus (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1
                    (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ε‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
              _ ≤ R + 1 := by linarith [hx_lt, hQ.2]
        · simp only [↓reduceIte]
          refine ⟨⟨k + 1, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
          · rw [hk_eq, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
            ring
          · calc ‖(stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1 +
                ε • Q_plus (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1
                  (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ε‖
              _ ≤ ‖(stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1‖ +
                  ‖ε • Q_plus (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1
                    (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ε‖ := norm_add_le _ _
              _ ≤ R + 1 := by linarith [hx_lt, hQ.1]
  have h_conj1 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool),
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n
      δ_j ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ 16 ∧ ‖z.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧ (z.2 ≤ δ_j → z.2 = δ_j) := by
    intro n ω
    obtain ⟨⟨k, hk_lo, hk_hi, hk_eq⟩, h_norm⟩ := h_grid_ind n ω
    have hz_lo : δ_j ≤ (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 := by
      rw [hk_eq, ← h_delta_grid]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk_lo) (le_of_lt hε_pos)
    have hz_hi : (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ≤ 16 := by
      rw [hk_eq, ← h_16_grid]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk_hi) (le_of_lt hε_pos)
    exact ⟨hz_lo, hz_hi, h_norm, fun hle => le_antisymm hle hz_lo⟩
  have h_conj2 : ∀ (k n : ℕ), k ≤ n → n < h → ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h (flipBit h n ω) k =
        stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω k := by
    intro k n hkn hnh ω
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      have hk_le : k ≤ n := by omega
      have hk_lt_h : k < h := by omega
      have hk_ne_n : k ≠ n := by omega
      have h_prev := ih hk_le
      have h_bit : walkStepBit h (flipBit h n ω) k = walkStepBit h ω k := by
        dsimp [walkStepBit, flipBit]
        rw [dif_pos hk_lt_h, dif_pos hk_lt_h, if_neg hk_ne_n]
      dsimp only [stoppedWalk]
      rw [h_prev, h_bit]
  have h_freeze : ∀ (ω : Fin h → Bool) (n p : ℕ), n ≤ p →
      isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n) = false →
      stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω p =
        stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n := by
    intro ω n p hnp h_inact
    induction p, hnp using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => rfl
    | succ p hnp ih =>
      dsimp only [stoppedWalk]
      rw [ih, h_inact]
      rfl
  have h_conj3 : ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h) = true →
      ∀ n < h, isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n) = true := by
    intro ω h_act_h n hnh
    cases h_act_n : isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
    · have h_eq := h_freeze ω n h (le_of_lt hnh) h_act_n
      rw [h_eq, h_act_n] at h_act_h
      exact Bool.noConfusion h_act_h
    · rfl
  have h_conj4 : ∀ (N : ℕ), j ≤ N → N + 2 ≤ m → ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      let δ_N := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N
      (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω h).2 = δ_N →
      (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h).2 = δ_j := by
    intro N hjN hNm ω δ_N h_reach_N
    have h_delta_le : δ_N ≤ δ_j :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hjN
    have h_couple : ∀ n : ℕ,
        stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n =
          stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω n ∨
        (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 = δ_j := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact Or.inl rfl
      | succ n ih =>
        rcases ih with h_eq | h_at_j
        · dsimp only [stoppedWalk]
          cases h_act_j : isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n)
          · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
            cases h_act_N : isWalkActive d δ_N R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω n)
            · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
              exact Or.inl h_eq
            · have h_act_N_prop : δ_N < (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω n).2 ∧
                  (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω n).2 < 16 ∧
                  ‖(stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω n).1‖ < R := by
                unfold isWalkActive at h_act_N
                exact decide_eq_true_iff.mp h_act_N
              have h_inact_j_prop : ¬ (δ_j < (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ∧
                  (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 < 16 ∧
                  ‖(stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1‖ < R) := by
                unfold isWalkActive at h_act_j
                exact decide_eq_false_iff_not.mp h_act_j
              rw [← h_eq] at h_act_N_prop
              have h_le_j : (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ≤ δ_j := by
                by_contra h_not_le
                push_neg at h_not_le
                exact h_inact_j_prop ⟨h_not_le, h_act_N_prop.2.1, h_act_N_prop.2.2⟩
              exact Or.inr ((h_conj1 n ω).2.2.2 h_le_j)
          · have h_act_j_prop : δ_j < (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 ∧
                (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).2 < 16 ∧
                ‖(stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n).1‖ < R := by
              unfold isWalkActive at h_act_j
              exact decide_eq_true_iff.mp h_act_j
            have h_act_N : isWalkActive d δ_N R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω n) = true := by
              unfold isWalkActive
              rw [← h_eq]
              exact decide_eq_true_iff.mpr
                ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt h_delta_le h_act_j_prop.1, h_act_j_prop.2.1, h_act_j_prop.2.2⟩
            rw [h_act_N, h_eq]
            exact Or.inl rfl
        · have h_act_j : isWalkActive d δ_j R (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n) = false := by
            unfold isWalkActive
            apply decide_eq_false_iff_not.mpr
            intro h_all
            linarith [h_all.1, h_at_j]
          dsimp only [stoppedWalk]
          rw [h_act_j]
          simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
          exact Or.inr h_at_j
    rcases h_couple h with h_eq_h | h_at_j_h
    · have h_le_j : (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h).2 ≤ δ_j := by
        rw [h_eq_h, h_reach_N]
        exact h_delta_le
      exact (h_conj1 h ω).2.2.2 h_le_j
    · exact h_at_j_h
  exact ⟨h_conj1, h_conj2, h_conj3, h_conj4⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (κ H_star : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hQ_drift : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < t →
      (driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Q_plus x t ε) (t + ε)) +
        driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (x - ε • Q_minus x t ε) (t - ε))) / 2 -
        driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≥
          (1 / (16 * (1 + Real.log 2))) *
            (‖Q_plus x t ε - Q_zero x t ε‖ ^ 2 + ‖Q_minus x t ε - Q_zero x t ε‖ ^ 2))
    (C_ub : ℝ)
    (hJ_ub : ∀ (B ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      2 ≤ B → 0 < ε → ε ≤ B → ‖x‖ ≤ B → ε < t → t ≤ B →
      driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ C_ub * (1 + Real.log B) ^ 4)
    (R U_R D_raw B₀ : ℝ) (hR : 16 ≤ R)
    (hU_R : U_R = C_ub * (1 + Real.log (R + 1)) ^ 4)
    (hD_raw : U_R - H_star + 1 ≤ D_raw)
    (hB₀ : B₀ = D_raw / (1 / (16 * (1 + Real.log 2))))
    (m h j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjm : j + 2 ≤ m)
    (hJ_init : H_star - 1 ≤ driftFunctional d κ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) v (mkSpaceTime 0 1))
    (h_inv : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool),
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) R h ω n
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ 16 ∧ ‖z.1‖ ≤ R + 1)
    (h_flip : ∀ (n : ℕ), n < h → ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) R h (flipBit h n ω) n =
        stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) R h ω n) :
    let ε := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m
    let δ_j := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n
      if isWalkActive d δ_j R z then
        (‖Q_plus z.1 z.2 ε - Q_zero z.1 z.2 ε‖ ^ 2 +
         ‖Q_minus z.1 z.2 ε - Q_zero z.1 z.2 ε‖ ^ 2)
      else 0) ≤ B₀ ∧
    (∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      let z_h := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h
      0 ≤ U_R - driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime z_h.1 z_h.2)) ∧
    uniformExp h (fun ω =>
      let z_h := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h
      U_R - driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime z_h.1 z_h.2)) ≤ D_raw
