proof.tactics:
by
  let ε : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m
  let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
  let c : ℝ := 1 / (16 * (1 + Real.log 2))
  let z : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ :=
    fun n ω => stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n
  let J : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun n ω => driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2)
  let D : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun n ω =>
      if isWalkActive d δ_j R (z n ω) then
        (‖Q_plus (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε - Q_zero (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε‖ ^ 2 +
         ‖Q_minus (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε - Q_zero (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε‖ ^ 2)
      else 0
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
  have hε_lt_δ : ε < δ_j :=
    pow_lt_pow_right_of_lt_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hδ_le_one : δ_j ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hc_pos : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have h_card : (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, (1 : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin]
  have h_two_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by positivity
  have h_flip_invol : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Involutive (flipBit h n) := by
    intro n ω
    ext i
    dsimp [flipBit]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have h_sum_flip : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ),
      (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, F (flipBit h n ω)) = ∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, F ω := by
    intro n F
    exact Fintype.sum_bijective (flipBit h n) (h_flip_invol n).bijective
      (fun ω => F (flipBit h n ω)) F (fun _ => rfl)
  have h_bit_flip_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ), n < h → ∀ (ω : Fin h → Bool),
      walkStepBit h (flipBit h n ω) n = !(walkStepBit h ω n) := by
    intro n hn ω
    dsimp [walkStepBit, flipBit]
    rw [dif_pos hn, dif_pos hn, if_pos rfl]
  have h_J_pair : ∀ n < h, ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      2 * (c * D n ω) ≤ J (n + 1) ω + J (n + 1) (flipBit h n ω) - 2 * J n ω := by
    intro n hn ω
    have hz_flip : z n (flipBit h n ω) = z n ω := h_flip n hn ω
    have hz1 : z (n + 1) ω =
        if isWalkActive d δ_j R (z n ω) then
          if walkStepBit h ω n then
            ((z n ω).1 + ε • Q_plus (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε, (z n ω).2 + ε)
          else
            ((z n ω).1 - ε • Q_minus (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε, (z n ω).2 - ε)
        else z n ω := rfl
    have hz2 : z (n + 1) (flipBit h n ω) =
        if isWalkActive d δ_j R (z n ω) then
          if !(walkStepBit h ω n) then
            ((z n ω).1 + ε • Q_plus (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε, (z n ω).2 + ε)
          else
            ((z n ω).1 - ε • Q_minus (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε, (z n ω).2 - ε)
        else z n ω := by
      change (if isWalkActive d δ_j R (z n (flipBit h n ω)) then
          if walkStepBit h (flipBit h n ω) n then
            ((z n (flipBit h n ω)).1 + ε • Q_plus (z n (flipBit h n ω)).1 (z n (flipBit h n ω)).2 ε,
             (z n (flipBit h n ω)).2 + ε)
          else
            ((z n (flipBit h n ω)).1 - ε • Q_minus (z n (flipBit h n ω)).1 (z n (flipBit h n ω)).2 ε,
             (z n (flipBit h n ω)).2 - ε)
        else z n (flipBit h n ω)) = _
      rw [hz_flip, h_bit_flip_eq n hn ω]
    dsimp only [J, D]
    rw [hz1, hz2]
    cases h_act : isWalkActive d δ_j R (z n ω)
    · simp; linarith
    · simp only [↓reduceIte]
      have h_t_ge : δ_j ≤ (z n ω).2 := (h_inv n ω).1
      have hε_lt_t : ε < (z n ω).2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_δ h_t_ge
      have h_drift := hQ_drift (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε hε_pos hε_lt_t
      cases h_bit : walkStepBit h ω n <;>
        simp only [h_bit, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] <;>
        linarith
  have h_J_sum_step : ∀ n < h,
      c * (∑ ω, D n ω) ≤ (∑ ω, J (n + 1) ω) - (∑ ω, J n ω) := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω (_ : ω ∈ Finset.univ) => h_J_pair n hn ω)
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        h_sum_flip n (fun ω => J (n + 1) ω), ← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
    linarith
  have h_disc_tele : c * (∑ ω, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, D n ω) ≤
      (∑ ω, J h ω) - (∑ ω, J 0 ω) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
    have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n (hn : n ∈ Finset.range h) =>
      h_J_sum_step n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn))
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => ∑ ω, J n ω) h] at h1
    exact h1
  have h_J0_sum : (H_star - 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≤ ∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, J 0 ω := by
    have h_eq : (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, J 0 ω) =
        driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
      calc (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, J 0 ω)
        _ = ∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := rfl
        _ = (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, (1 : ℝ)) * driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul, one_mul]
        _ = driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime 0 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
            rw [h_card, mul_comm]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hJ_init (le_of_lt h_two_pow_pos)
  have h_D_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, D n ω := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro ω _
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro n _
    dsimp [D]
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  have h_Jh_le : ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool, J h ω ≤ U_R := by
    intro ω
    have h_inv_h := h_inv h ω
    have hB_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R + 1 := by linarith
    have hε_le_B : ε ≤ R + 1 := by linarith
    have hx_le_B : ‖(z h ω).1‖ ≤ R + 1 := h_inv_h.2.2
    have hε_lt_th : ε < (z h ω).2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_δ h_inv_h.1
    have hth_le_B : (z h ω).2 ≤ R + 1 := by linarith [h_inv_h.2.1]
    have h_ub := hJ_ub (R + 1) ε (z h ω).1 (z h ω).2 hB_ge hε_pos hε_le_B hx_le_B hε_lt_th hth_le_B
    linarith [hU_R]
  have h_Jh_sum_le : (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, J h ω) ≤ U_R * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    calc (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, J h ω)
      _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, U_R := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_Jh_le ω)
      _ = (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, (1 : ℝ)) * U_R := by rw [Finset.sum_mul, one_mul]
      _ = U_R * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by rw [h_card, mul_comm]
  have h_raw_pow : (U_R - H_star + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≤ D_raw * (2 : ℝ) ^ h :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD_raw (le_of_lt h_two_pow_pos)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [uniformExp]
    have h_c_sum : c * (∑ ω, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, D n ω) ≤ D_raw * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
      linarith
    have h_sum_le : (∑ ω, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, D n ω) ≤ B₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
      rw [hB₀, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hc_pos]
      linarith
    exact (div_le_iff₀ h_two_pow_pos).mpr h_sum_le
  · intro ω
    linarith [h_Jh_le ω]
  · dsimp [uniformExp]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ h_two_pow_pos]
    have h_sub_sum : (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, (U_R - J h ω)) =
        U_R * (2 : ℝ) ^ h - ∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, J h ω := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have h_const : (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, U_R) = U_R * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
        calc (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, U_R)
          _ = (∑ _ : Fin h → Bool, (1 : ℝ)) * U_R := by rw [Finset.sum_mul, one_mul]
          _ = U_R * (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by rw [h_card, mul_comm]
      rw [h_const]
    have h_disc_nonneg : 0 ≤ c * (∑ ω, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, D n ω) :=
      mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hc_pos) h_D_nonneg
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hv_cent : IsCenteredAt d C₁ v 0 1)
    (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (C_vel : ℝ) (hC_vel : 0 < C_vel)
    (hQ_vel : ∀ (r : ℝ) (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₀ : ℝ),
      0 < r → IsFitAt d C₁ v x₀ r r p₀ a₀ →
      ∀ (K ε : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
        2 ≤ K → 0 < ε → ε ≤ r → ε < t → t ≤ K * r →
        ‖x - x₀ - (t - r) • p₀‖ ≤ K * r →
        ‖Q_zero x t ε - p₀‖ ≤ C_vel * (1 + Real.log K + |Real.log (t / r)|))
    (h_psi : HasPsiPotentialBounds)
    (h_travel : HasPredictableTravelBound d)
    (R B₀ : ℝ) (hR : 16 ≤ R) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (h_R_bound : Real.sqrt (psiPotential 16) *
      (2 * (C_vel * (1 + Real.log R) + C_vel) + Real.sqrt (2 * B₀)) ≤ R / 8)
    (m h N : ℕ) (hN1 : 1 ≤ N) (hNm : N + 2 ≤ m)
    (h_horizon : 32 * psiPotential 16 + 1 ≤ (h : ℝ) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 2)
    (h_inv : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool),
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R h ω n
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ 16 ∧ ‖z.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
      (z.2 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N → z.2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N))
    (h_flip : ∀ (k n : ℕ), k ≤ n → n < h → ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R h (flipBit h n ω) k =
        stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R h ω k)
    (h_act_pers : ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      isWalkActive d ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R
        (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R h ω h) = true →
      ∀ n < h, isWalkActive d ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R
        (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R h ω n) = true)
    (h_disc : uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R h ω n
      if isWalkActive d ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R z then
        (‖Q_plus z.1 z.2 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) - Q_zero z.1 z.2 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)‖ ^ 2 +
         ‖Q_minus z.1 z.2 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) - Q_zero z.1 z.2 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)‖ ^ 2)
      else 0) ≤ B₀) :
    let ε := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m
    let δ_N := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N
    uniformProb h (fun ω => (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω h).2 = δ_N) ≥ 3 / 4

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let ε : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m
  let δ_N : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N
  let M_vel : ℝ := C_vel * (1 + Real.log R)
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by positivity
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_N := by positivity
  have hS_max : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 16 := by norm_num
  have h1_le_R : (1 : ℝ) ≤ R := by linarith
  have h_logR_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log R := Real.log_nonneg h1_le_R
  have hC_vel_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_vel := le_of_lt hC_vel
  have hM_vel_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_vel := by
    dsimp [M_vel]
    exact mul_nonneg hC_vel_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hB₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ B₀ := le_of_lt hB₀
  have hε_le_one : ε ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h4ε_le_δ : 4 * ε ≤ δ_N := by
    have h_pow : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 2) :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hNm
    have h_split : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 2) = δ_N * (1 / 4) := by
      dsimp [δ_N]
      rw [pow_add]
      ring
    dsimp [ε]
    linarith
  let z : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ :=
    fun n ω => stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω n
  let y : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun n ω => (z n ω).1
  let s : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ := fun n ω => (z n ω).2
  let act : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → Bool := fun n ω => isWalkActive d δ_N R (z n ω)
  let q_plus : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun n ω => Q_plus (y n ω) (s n ω) ε
  let q_minus : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun n ω => Q_minus (y n ω) (s n ω) ε
  let q_zero : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun n ω => Q_zero (y n ω) (s n ω) ε
  have h_init : ∀ ω, y 0 ω = 0 ∧ s 0 ω = 1 := by
    intro ω
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have h_pred : ∀ k n, k ≤ n → n < h → ∀ ω,
      y k (flipBit h n ω) = y k ω ∧
      s k (flipBit h n ω) = s k ω ∧
      act k (flipBit h n ω) = act k ω ∧
      q_zero k (flipBit h n ω) = q_zero k ω := by
    intro k n hkn hnh ω
    have h_eq : z k (flipBit h n ω) = z k ω := h_flip k n hkn hnh ω
    dsimp [y, s, act, q_zero]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  have h_step_trans : ∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      (act n ω = true →
        y (n + 1) ω = (if walkStepBit h ω n then y n ω + ε • q_plus n ω else y n ω - ε • q_minus n ω) ∧
        s (n + 1) ω = (if walkStepBit h ω n then s n ω + ε else s n ω - ε) ∧
        4 * ε ≤ s n ω ∧
        ‖q_zero n ω‖ ≤ M_vel + C_vel * |Real.log (s n ω)|) ∧
      (act n ω = false → y (n + 1) ω = y n ω ∧ s (n + 1) ω = s n ω) := by
    intro n hn ω
    constructor
    · intro h_act
      have h_z_succ : z (n + 1) ω =
          if walkStepBit h ω n then
            (y n ω + ε • q_plus n ω, s n ω + ε)
          else
            (y n ω - ε • q_minus n ω, s n ω - ε) := by
        change (if isWalkActive d δ_N R (z n ω) then
          if walkStepBit h ω n then
            ((z n ω).1 + ε • Q_plus (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε, (z n ω).2 + ε)
          else
            ((z n ω).1 - ε • Q_minus (z n ω).1 (z n ω).2 ε, (z n ω).2 - ε)
        else z n ω) = _
        have h_act' : isWalkActive d δ_N R (z n ω) = true := h_act
        rw [if_pos h_act']
      have hy_succ : y (n + 1) ω =
          if walkStepBit h ω n then y n ω + ε • q_plus n ω else y n ω - ε • q_minus n ω := by
        dsimp [y]
        rw [h_z_succ]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
      have hs_succ : s (n + 1) ω =
          if walkStepBit h ω n then s n ω + ε else s n ω - ε := by
        dsimp [s]
        rw [h_z_succ]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
      have h_act_bounds : δ_N < s n ω ∧ s n ω < 16 ∧ ‖y n ω‖ < R := by
        have h_dec : decide (δ_N < (z n ω).2 ∧ (z n ω).2 < 16 ∧ ‖(z n ω).1‖ < R) = true := h_act
        exact of_decide_eq_true h_dec
      have h4ε_le_s : 4 * ε ≤ s n ω := by linarith [h4ε_le_δ, h_act_bounds.1]
      have hq_bound : ‖q_zero n ω‖ ≤ M_vel + C_vel * |Real.log (s n ω)| := by
        have h_vel := hQ_vel 1 0 0 0 zero_lt_one hv_cent.2 R ε (y n ω) (s n ω)
          (by linarith [hR]) hε_pos hε_le_one (by linarith [h4ε_le_s, hε_pos])
          (by linarith [h_act_bounds.2.1, hR])
          (by
            simp only [sub_zero, smul_zero, mul_one]
            exact le_of_lt h_act_bounds.2.2)
        simp only [sub_zero, div_one] at h_vel
        dsimp [q_zero, M_vel]
        linarith
      exact ⟨hy_succ, hs_succ, h4ε_le_s, hq_bound⟩
    · intro h_inact
      have h_z_succ : z (n + 1) ω = z n ω := by
        change (if isWalkActive d δ_N R (z n ω) then _ else z n ω) = z n ω
        have h_inact' : isWalkActive d δ_N R (z n ω) = false := h_inact
        rw [h_inact']
        rfl
      exact ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst h_z_succ, congr_arg Prod.snd h_z_succ⟩
  have h_term_s : ∀ ω, 0 < s h ω ∧ s h ω ≤ 16 := by
    intro ω
    have h_inv_h := h_inv h ω
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hδ_pos h_inv_h.1, h_inv_h.2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨h_exp_s, h_exp_occ, h_exp_y_raw⟩ :=
    h_travel h ε 16 M_vel C_vel B₀ y s act q_plus q_minus q_zero
      hε_pos hS_max hM_vel_nonneg hC_vel_nonneg hB₀_nonneg
      h_init h_pred h_step_trans h_term_s h_disc
  have h_exp_y : uniformExp h (fun ω => ‖y h ω‖) ≤ R / 8 :=
    le_trans h_exp_y_raw h_R_bound
  let D_occ : ℝ := 32 * psiPotential 16 + 1
  let A : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, if act n ω then ε ^ 2 else 0
  have h_psi16_nonneg : 0 ≤ psiPotential 16 := h_psi.1 16
  have hD_occ_pos : 0 < D_occ := by
    dsimp [D_occ]
    linarith
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
  have h_pt : ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      1 - (if s h ω = δ_N then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        A ω / D_occ + s h ω / 16 + ‖y h ω‖ / R := by
    intro ω
    have hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A ω := by
      dsimp [A]
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro n _
      split_ifs <;> positivity
    have h_t1_nonneg : 0 ≤ A ω / D_occ := div_nonneg hA_nonneg (le_of_lt hD_occ_pos)
    have h_t2_nonneg : 0 ≤ s h ω / 16 := by linarith [(h_term_s ω).1]
    have h_t3_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖y h ω‖ / R := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hR_pos)
    by_cases h_reach_ω : s h ω = δ_N
    · rw [if_pos h_reach_ω]
      linarith
    · rw [if_neg h_reach_ω]
      have h_inv_h := h_inv h ω
      have h_gt_δ : δ_N < s h ω := by
        by_contra h_le
        push_neg at h_le
        exact h_reach_ω (h_inv_h.2.2.2 h_le)
      cases h_act_h : act h ω
      · have h_not_act : ¬ (δ_N < s h ω ∧ s h ω < 16 ∧ ‖y h ω‖ < R) :=
          of_decide_eq_false h_act_h
        have h_exit : 16 ≤ s h ω ∨ R ≤ ‖y h ω‖ := by
          by_contra h_neither
          push_neg at h_neither
          exact h_not_act ⟨h_gt_δ, h_neither.1, h_neither.2⟩
        rcases h_exit with hs_ge | hy_ge
        · have h_t2_ge : 1 ≤ s h ω / 16 := by linarith
          linarith
        · have h_t3_ge : 1 ≤ ‖y h ω‖ / R := (le_div_iff₀ hR_pos).mpr (by linarith)
          linarith
      · have h_all_act : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range h, act n ω = true := by
          intro n hn
          exact h_act_pers ω h_act_h n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
        have hA_eq : A ω = (h : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [A]
          have h_sum_congr :
              (∑ n ∈ Finset.range h, if act n ω then ε ^ 2 else 0) =
                ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range h, ε ^ 2 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro n hn
            rw [h_all_act n hn, if_pos rfl]
          rw [h_sum_congr, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        have h_t1_ge : 1 ≤ A ω / D_occ := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hD_occ_pos, one_mul, hA_eq]
          exact h_horizon
        linarith
  have h_sum_le :
      (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, (1 - (if s h ω = δ_N then (1 : ℝ) else 0))) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≤
        (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, (A ω / D_occ + s h ω / 16 + ‖y h ω‖ / R)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_pt ω)
    · positivity
  have h_two_pow_ne : (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h_lhs_eq :
      (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, (1 - (if s h ω = δ_N then (1 : ℝ) else 0))) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h =
        1 - uniformProb h (fun ω => s h ω = δ_N) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool, nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    rw [mul_one, sub_div, div_self h_two_pow_ne]
    congr 1
  have h_rhs_eq :
      (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, (A ω / D_occ + s h ω / 16 + ‖y h ω‖ / R)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h =
        uniformExp h A / D_occ +
          uniformExp h (fun ω => s h ω) / 16 +
          uniformExp h (fun ω => ‖y h ω‖) / R := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div, add_div]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_div, div_right_comm _ _ ((2 : ℝ) ^ h)]
    rfl
  have h_b1 : uniformExp h A / D_occ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hD_occ_pos]
    dsimp [D_occ]
    linarith [h_exp_occ, h_psi16_nonneg]
  have h_b2 : uniformExp h (fun ω => s h ω) / 16 = 1 / 16 := by
    rw [h_exp_s]
  have h_b3 : uniformExp h (fun ω => ‖y h ω‖) / R ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hR_pos]
    linarith [h_exp_y]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R U_R D_raw : ℝ) (hD_raw : 0 < D_raw)
    (ε_walk : ℕ → ℝ) (h_walk : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hN1 : 1 ≤ N)
    (h_reach : uniformProb (h_walk N) (fun ω =>
      (stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus (ε_walk N) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R (h_walk N) ω (h_walk N)).2 =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) ≥ 3 / 4)
    (h_box_couple : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N → ∀ ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool,
      let h := h_walk N
      let ε := ε_walk N
      let z_term := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R h ω h
      let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) R h ω h
      ‖z_mk.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧ (z_term.2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N → z_mk.2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j))
    (h_def_nonneg : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N → ∀ ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool,
      let h := h_walk N
      let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus (ε_walk N) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) R h ω h
      0 ≤ U_R - driftFunctional d κ (ε_walk N) v (mkSpaceTime z_mk.1 z_mk.2))
    (h_def_exp : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N →
      let h := h_walk N
      uniformExp h (fun ω =>
        let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus (ε_walk N) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) R h ω h
        U_R - driftFunctional d κ (ε_walk N) v (mkSpaceTime z_mk.1 z_mk.2)) ≤ D_raw) :
    uniformProb (h_walk N)
      (isGoodReachedWalk d κ v Q_plus Q_minus R (U_R - 16 * D_raw) (16 * D_raw) ε_walk h_walk N) ≥
        5 / 8

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let h : ℕ := h_walk N
  let ε : ℝ := ε_walk N
  let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
  let z_mk : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ :=
    fun j ω => stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε (δ j) R h ω h
  let Δ : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun j ω => U_R - driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (z_mk j ω).1 (z_mk j ω).2)
  let S_N : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun ω => Δ N ω + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j * Δ j ω
  have h_geom_eq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j = 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (Nat.succ_pos n), ih, pow_succ]
      ring
  have h_geom_le : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [h_geom_eq N]
    have h_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N := by positivity
    linarith
  have h_exp_eq : uniformExp h S_N =
      uniformExp h (fun ω => Δ N ω) +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j * uniformExp h (fun ω => Δ j ω) := by
    dsimp [uniformExp, S_N]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div, Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_div (Finset.Icc 1 N)]
    have h_inner : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, δ j * Δ j ω) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j * ((∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, Δ j ω) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, mul_div_assoc]
    rw [h_inner]
  have h_exp_N : uniformExp h (fun ω => Δ N ω) ≤ D_raw :=
    h_def_exp N hN1 (le_refl N)
  have h_exp_sum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j * uniformExp h (fun ω => Δ j ω) ≤ D_raw := by
    calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j * uniformExp h (fun ω => Δ j ω)
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j * D_raw := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => ?_)
          rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj with ⟨hj1, hjN⟩
          have hδ_nonneg : 0 ≤ δ j := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_def_exp j hj1 hjN) hδ_nonneg
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j) * D_raw := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ 1 * D_raw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_geom_le (le_of_lt hD_raw)
      _ = D_raw := one_mul D_raw
  have h_exp_S : uniformExp h S_N ≤ 2 * D_raw := by
    linarith [h_exp_eq, h_exp_N, h_exp_sum]
  have h_S_nonneg : ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool, 0 ≤ S_N ω := by
    intro ω
    have hΔN : 0 ≤ Δ N ω := h_def_nonneg N hN1 (le_refl N) ω
    have h_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j * Δ j ω := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j hj => ?_)
      rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj with ⟨hj1, hjN⟩
      have hδ : 0 ≤ δ j := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
      exact mul_nonneg hδ (h_def_nonneg j hj1 hjN ω)
    dsimp [S_N]
    linarith
  let P_reach : (Fin h → Bool) → Prop := fun ω => (z_mk N ω).2 = δ N
  let P_good : (Fin h → Bool) → Prop :=
    isGoodReachedWalk d κ v Q_plus Q_minus R (U_R - 16 * D_raw) (16 * D_raw) ε_walk h_walk N
  have h_good_of_le : ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool, P_reach ω → S_N ω ≤ 16 * D_raw → P_good ω := by
    intro ω h_reach_ω h_S_le
    have hΔN_nonneg : 0 ≤ Δ N ω := h_def_nonneg N hN1 (le_refl N) ω
    have h_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ j * Δ j ω := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j hj => ?_)
      rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj with ⟨hj1, hjN⟩
      have hδ : 0 ≤ δ j := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
      exact mul_nonneg hδ (h_def_nonneg j hj1 hjN ω)
    have hΔN_le : Δ N ω ≤ 16 * D_raw := by
      dsimp [S_N] at h_S_le
      linarith
    refine ⟨h_reach_ω, (h_box_couple N hN1 (le_refl N) ω).1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change U_R - 16 * D_raw ≤ driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (z_mk N ω).1 (δ N))
      rw [← h_reach_ω]
      dsimp [Δ] at hΔN_le
      linarith
    · intro j hj1 hjN
      have h_reach_j : (z_mk j ω).2 = δ j := (h_box_couple j hj1 hjN ω).2 h_reach_ω
      refine ⟨h_reach_j, (h_box_couple j hj1 hjN ω).1, ?_⟩
      have hj_mem : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hj1, hjN⟩
      have h_term_le_sum : δ j * Δ j ω ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, δ i * Δ i ω := by
        refine Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => δ i * Δ i ω) (fun i hi => ?_) hj_mem
        rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hi with ⟨hi1, hiN⟩
        have hδ : 0 ≤ δ i := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
        exact mul_nonneg hδ (h_def_nonneg i hi1 hiN ω)
      have h_term_le : δ j * Δ j ω ≤ 16 * D_raw := by
        dsimp [S_N] at h_S_le
        linarith
      have h_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_term_le h_pow_pos
      have h_cancel : δ j * Δ j ω * (2 : ℝ) ^ j = Δ j ω := by
        dsimp [δ]
        calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j * Δ j ω * (2 : ℝ) ^ j
          _ = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j * (2 : ℝ) ^ j) * Δ j ω := by ring
          _ = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2) ^ j * Δ j ω := by rw [← mul_pow]
          _ = Δ j ω := by norm_num
      rw [h_cancel] at h_mul
      change (U_R - 16 * D_raw) - (16 * D_raw) * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤
        driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime (z_mk j ω).1 (δ j))
      rw [← h_reach_j]
      dsimp [Δ] at h_mul
      linarith
  have h_ind_le : ∀ ω : Fin h → Bool,
      (if P_reach ω then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if P_good ω then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        S_N ω / (16 * D_raw) := by
    intro ω
    have h_div_nonneg : 0 ≤ S_N ω / (16 * D_raw) :=
      div_nonneg (h_S_nonneg ω) (by linarith)
    by_cases hG : P_good ω
    · have hR : P_reach ω := hG.1
      simp [hG, hR, h_div_nonneg]
    · by_cases hR : P_reach ω
      · simp only [hG, hR, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
        have h_gt : 16 * D_raw < S_N ω := by
          by_contra h_not_gt
          push_neg at h_not_gt
          exact hG (h_good_of_le ω hR h_not_gt)
        exact (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
      · simp [hG, hR, h_div_nonneg]
  have h_prob_diff :
      uniformProb h P_reach - uniformProb h P_good ≤ uniformExp h S_N / (16 * D_raw) := by
    dsimp [uniformProb, uniformExp]
    have h_sum_le :
        ∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, ((if P_reach ω then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if P_good ω then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ≤
          ∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, (S_N ω / (16 * D_raw)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_ind_le ω)
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_div] at h_sum_le
    have h_div_le := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sum_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ h)
    linarith [sub_div (∑ x : Fin h → Bool, if P_reach x then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      (∑ x : Fin h → Bool, if P_good x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ((2 : ℝ) ^ h),
      div_right_comm (∑ x : Fin h → Bool, S_N x) (16 * D_raw) ((2 : ℝ) ^ h)]
  have h_exp_div : uniformExp h S_N / (16 * D_raw) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    calc uniformExp h S_N / (16 * D_raw)
      _ ≤ (2 * D_raw) / (16 * D_raw) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_exp_S (by linarith)
      _ = 1 / 8 := by
          have hD_ne : D_raw ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD_raw
          field_simp [hD_ne]
          ring
  have h_reach' : uniformProb h P_reach ≥ 3 / 4 := h_reach
  change uniformProb h P_good ≥ 5 / 8
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))
  have hcont : Continuous ψ := continuousOn_univ.mp (hψ.continuousOn isOpen_univ)
  have hsub : ∀ x : E, ∃ g : E, ∀ w : E, inner ℝ g (w - x) ≤ ψ w - ψ x := by
    intro x
    let U : Set (E × ℝ) := {p | ψ p.1 < p.2}
    have hU_open : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt (hcont.comp continuous_fst) continuous_snd
    have hU_conv : Convex ℝ U := by
      intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ a b ha hb hab
      simp only [U, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd,
        smul_eq_mul] at hp₁ hp₂ ⊢
      have h_conv := hψ.2 (Set.mem_univ p₁.1) (Set.mem_univ p₂.1) ha hb hab
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h_conv
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
      · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
        subst hb1
        linarith
      · have h1 : a * ψ p₁.1 < a * p₁.2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp₁ ha_pos
        have h2 : b * ψ p₂.1 ≤ b * p₂.2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hp₂) hb
        linarith
    have hx_not_mem : (x, ψ x) ∉ U := by simp [U]
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_point_open hU_conv hU_open hx_not_mem
    have hf_decomp : ∀ (w : E) (t : ℝ), f (w, t) = f (w, 0) + t * f (0, 1) := by
      intro w t
      have h_eq : (w, t) = (w, (0 : ℝ)) + t • ((0 : E), (1 : ℝ)) := by ext <;> simp
      rw [h_eq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    let c : ℝ := f (0, 1)
    have hc_pos : 0 < c := by
      have h_mem : (x, ψ x + 1) ∈ U := by
        simp only [U, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        linarith
      have h_lt := hf (x, ψ x + 1) h_mem
      rw [hf_decomp x (ψ x), hf_decomp x (ψ x + 1)] at h_lt
      dsimp [c]
      linarith
    have h_ineq : ∀ w : E, -c⁻¹ * f (w - x, 0) ≤ ψ w - ψ x := by
      intro w
      have h_le : f (x, 0) + ψ x * c ≤ f (w, 0) + ψ w * c := by
        apply le_of_forall_pos_lt_add
        intro ε hε
        have h_mem : (w, ψ w + ε / c) ∈ U := by
          simp only [U, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
          have : 0 < ε / c := div_pos hε hc_pos
          linarith
        have h_lt := hf (w, ψ w + ε / c) h_mem
        rw [hf_decomp x (ψ x), hf_decomp w (ψ w + ε / c)] at h_lt
        change f (x, 0) + ψ x * c < f (w, 0) + (ψ w + ε / c) * c at h_lt
        have h_cancel : (ψ w + ε / c) * c = ψ w * c + ε := by
          have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc_pos
          field_simp
        linarith
      have h_sub : f (x - w, 0) = f (x, 0) - f (w, 0) := by
        have : (x - w, (0 : ℝ)) = (x, (0 : ℝ)) - (w, (0 : ℝ)) := by ext <;> simp
        rw [this, map_sub]
      have h_neg : f (w - x, 0) = -f (x - w, 0) := by
        have : (w - x, (0 : ℝ)) = -(x - w, (0 : ℝ)) := by ext <;> simp
        rw [this, map_neg]
      have h_bound : -f (w - x, 0) ≤ (ψ w - ψ x) * c := by linarith
      have h_div : -f (w - x, 0) / c ≤ ψ w - ψ x := (div_le_iff₀ hc_pos).mpr h_bound
      have h_lhs : -f (w - x, 0) / c = -c⁻¹ * f (w - x, 0) := by ring
      linarith
    let ℓ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := (-c⁻¹) • (f.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ))
    let g : E := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm ℓ
    refine ⟨g, fun w => ?_⟩
    have h_dual : inner ℝ g (w - x) = ℓ (w - x) :=
      InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    rw [h_dual]
    change (-c⁻¹) * f (w - x, 0) ≤ ψ w - ψ x
    exact h_ineq w
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := hsub 0
  have hg₀' : ∀ ξ : E, ψ 0 + inner ℝ g₀ ξ ≤ ψ ξ := by
    intro ξ
    have h := hg₀ ξ
    rw [sub_zero] at h
    linarith
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ := fun y ξ => ψ ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖ξ - y‖ ^ 2
  have hΦ_cont : ∀ y : E, Continuous (Φ y) := by
    intro y
    refine hcont.add ?_
    exact continuous_const.mul (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm).pow 2)
  have h_min_ex : ∀ y : E, ∃ z : E, ∀ w : E, Φ y z ≤ Φ y w := by
    intro y
    let y₀ : E := y - g₀
    let R : ℝ := 2 * ‖y₀‖ + 1
    have hR_nonneg : 0 ≤ R := by positivity
    have h_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R) := isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) R
    have h_ne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R).Nonempty := Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hR_nonneg
    obtain ⟨z, hz_mem, hz_min⟩ := h_comp.exists_isMinOn h_ne (hΦ_cont y).continuousOn
    rw [isMinOn_iff] at hz_min
    have h0_mem : (0 : E) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR_nonneg
    have hz_le_0 : Φ y z ≤ Φ y 0 := hz_min 0 h0_mem
    refine ⟨z, fun w => ?_⟩
    by_cases hw : w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R
    · exact hz_min w hw
    · have hw_gt : R < ‖w‖ := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hw
      have h_tri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖y₀‖ + ‖w - y₀‖ := norm_le_insert' w y₀
      have hw_y₀ : ‖y₀‖ + 1 < ‖w - y₀‖ := by
        dsimp [R] at hw_gt
        linarith
      have h_sq_gt : ‖y₀‖ ^ 2 < ‖w - y₀‖ ^ 2 := by
        have hy₀_nn : 0 ≤ ‖y₀‖ := norm_nonneg y₀
        nlinarith
      have h_id : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w - y‖ ^ 2 + inner ℝ g₀ w =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w - y₀‖ ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖y₀‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : ‖w - y‖ ^ 2 = ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ w y + ‖y‖ ^ 2 := norm_sub_sq_real w y
        have h2 : ‖w - y₀‖ ^ 2 = ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ w y₀ + ‖y₀‖ ^ 2 := norm_sub_sq_real w y₀
        have h3 : inner ℝ w y₀ = inner ℝ w y - inner ℝ g₀ w := by
          dsimp [y₀]
          rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_comm g₀ w]
        linarith
      have hΦ0 : Φ y 0 = ψ 0 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [Φ]
        rw [zero_sub, norm_neg]
      have hΦw : Φ y w = ψ w + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w - y‖ ^ 2 := rfl
      have hg₀_w := hg₀' w
      linarith
  choose J hJ_min using h_min_ex
  have hJ_var : ∀ y w : E, inner ℝ (y - J y) (w - J y) ≤ ψ w - ψ (J y) := by
    intro y w
    let z := J y
    change inner ℝ (y - z) (w - z) ≤ ψ w - ψ z
    apply le_of_forall_pos_lt_add
    intro ε hε
    let t : ℝ := min (1 / 2) (ε / (‖w - z‖ ^ 2 + 1))
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := by positivity
    have ht_le_half : t ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have ht_le_eps : t ≤ ε / (‖w - z‖ ^ 2 + 1) := min_le_right _ _
    have h1mt_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith
    have ht_nonneg : 0 ≤ t := le_of_lt ht_pos
    let ξ_t : E := (1 - t) • z + t • w
    have h_conv := hψ.2 (Set.mem_univ z) (Set.mem_univ w) h1mt_nonneg ht_nonneg (by ring)
    change ψ ξ_t ≤ (1 - t) * ψ z + t * ψ w at h_conv
    have hξ_sub : ξ_t - y = (z - y) + t • (w - z) := by
      dsimp [ξ_t]
      module
    have h_norm_sq : ‖ξ_t - y‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖z - y‖ ^ 2 - 2 * t * inner ℝ (y - z) (w - z) + t ^ 2 * ‖w - z‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hξ_sub, norm_add_sq_real, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos ht_pos, mul_pow]
      have h_in : inner ℝ (z - y) (w - z) = -inner ℝ (y - z) (w - z) := by
        rw [← neg_sub y z, inner_neg_left]
      rw [h_in]
      ring
    have h_min_t : Φ y z ≤ Φ y ξ_t := hJ_min y ξ_t
    dsimp [Φ] at h_min_t
    change ψ z + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖z - y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ψ ξ_t + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖ξ_t - y‖ ^ 2 at h_min_t
    rw [h_norm_sq] at h_min_t
    have h_t_ineq : t * inner ℝ (y - z) (w - z) ≤
        t * (ψ w - ψ z + (t / 2) * ‖w - z‖ ^ 2) := by
      linarith
    have h_div : inner ℝ (y - z) (w - z) ≤ ψ w - ψ z + (t / 2) * ‖w - z‖ ^ 2 :=
      le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_t_ineq ht_pos
    have h_err_lt : (t / 2) * ‖w - z‖ ^ 2 < ε := by
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_le_eps (by positivity : 0 ≤ ‖w - z‖ ^ 2 + 1)
      have h_eq : (‖w - z‖ ^ 2 + 1) * (ε / (‖w - z‖ ^ 2 + 1)) = ε :=
        mul_div_cancel₀ ε (by positivity)
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ t * ‖w - z‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hJ_lip : LipschitzWith 1 J := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro y₁ y₂
    rw [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have h1 := hJ_var y₁ (J y₂)
    have h2 := hJ_var y₂ (J y₁)
    have h_in : inner ℝ (J y₁ - J y₂) (J y₁ - J y₂) ≤ inner ℝ (y₁ - y₂) (J y₁ - J y₂) := by
      have ha : inner ℝ (y₁ - J y₁) (J y₂ - J y₁) =
          -inner ℝ (y₁ - J y₁) (J y₁ - J y₂) := by
        rw [← neg_sub (J y₁) (J y₂), inner_neg_right]
      have hb : inner ℝ ((y₁ - J y₁) - (y₂ - J y₂)) (J y₁ - J y₂) =
          inner ℝ (y₁ - J y₁) (J y₁ - J y₂) - inner ℝ (y₂ - J y₂) (J y₁ - J y₂) :=
        inner_sub_left _ _ _
      have hc : (y₁ - J y₁) - (y₂ - J y₂) = (y₁ - y₂) - (J y₁ - J y₂) := by abel
      rw [hc] at hb
      have hd : inner ℝ ((y₁ - y₂) - (J y₁ - J y₂)) (J y₁ - J y₂) =
          inner ℝ (y₁ - y₂) (J y₁ - J y₂) - inner ℝ (J y₁ - J y₂) (J y₁ - J y₂) :=
        inner_sub_left _ _ _
      linarith
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h_in
    have h_cs := real_inner_le_norm (y₁ - y₂) (J y₁ - J y₂)
    have h_sq_le : ‖J y₁ - J y₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖y₁ - y₂‖ * ‖J y₁ - J y₂‖ := le_trans h_in h_cs
    by_contra h_lt
    push_neg at h_lt
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (J y₁ - J y₂), norm_nonneg (y₁ - y₂)]
  have hJ_surj : ∀ x : E, ∃ y : E, J y = x := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hsub x
    let y : E := x + g
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    have h1 := hg (J y)
    have h2 := hJ_var y x
    have hy_sub : y - x = g := add_sub_cancel_left x g
    have h_norm_sq : ‖x - J y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
      have ha : inner ℝ g (J y - x) = -inner ℝ (y - x) (x - J y) := by
        rw [hy_sub, ← neg_sub x (J y), inner_neg_right]
      have hb : inner ℝ (y - J y) (x - J y) - inner ℝ (y - x) (x - J y) =
          inner ℝ ((y - J y) - (y - x)) (x - J y) :=
        (inner_sub_left _ _ _).symm
      have hc : (y - J y) - (y - x) = x - J y := by abel
      rw [hc, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hb
      linarith
    have h_zero : ‖x - J y‖ = 0 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (x - J y)]
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp h_zero)).symm
  let μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E := MeasureTheory.volume
  let S_bad : Set E := {y : E | ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ J y}
  let N : Set E := J '' S_bad
  have hS_null : μ S_bad = 0 := by
    have h_ae : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, DifferentiableAt ℝ J y := hJ_lip.ae_differentiableAt
    rwa [MeasureTheory.ae_iff] at h_ae
  have hN_null : μ N = 0 := by
    letI : SMul ℝ (Set E) := Set.smulSet
    let A : E →L[ℝ] E := 0
    let m : NNReal := ⟨|A.det| + 1, by positivity⟩
    have hm_coe : (m : ℝ) = |A.det| + 1 := rfl
    have hm_gt : ENNReal.ofReal |A.det| < (m : ENNReal) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, hm_coe]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
    have h_ev := MeasureTheory.addHaar_image_le_mul_of_det_lt μ A hm_gt
    have h_ev_pos : ∀ᶠ δ : NNReal in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0),
        (δ ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : NNReal)) ∧
        ∀ (s : Set E) (f : E → E), ApproximatesLinearOn f A s δ → μ (f '' s) ≤ m * μ s :=
      eventually_mem_nhdsWithin.and h_ev
    haveI : (nhdsWithin (0 : NNReal) (Set.Ioi 0)).NeBot := nhdsWithin_Ioi_neBot le_rfl
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_bound⟩ := h_ev_pos.exists
    let g_map : E → E := fun y => (δ : ℝ) • J y
    have h_approx : ApproximatesLinearOn g_map A S_bad δ := by
      rw [ApproximatesLinearOn.approximatesLinearOn_iff_lipschitzOnWith]
      apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro y₁ _ y₂ _
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, A, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, sub_zero, g_map]
      rw [dist_eq_norm, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg δ)]
      have h_lip_y := hJ_lip.dist_le_mul y₁ y₂
      rw [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm] at h_lip_y
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lip_y (NNReal.coe_nonneg δ)
    have hg_null : μ (g_map '' S_bad) = 0 := by
      have h_le := hδ_bound S_bad g_map h_approx
      rw [hS_null, mul_zero] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le zero_le
    have hg_img : g_map '' S_bad = (δ : ℝ) • N := by
      dsimp [g_map, N]
      rw [← Set.image_smul, Set.image_image]
    rw [hg_img, MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_smul] at hg_null
    have h_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < |(δ : ℝ) ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E)| := by
      have hδ_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (δ : ℝ) := hδ_pos
      positivity
    have h_ofReal_ne : ENNReal.ofReal |(δ : ℝ) ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E)| ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero]
      linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hg_null with h_abs | hN_zero
    · exact False.elim (h_ofReal_ne h_abs)
    · exact hN_zero
  refine ⟨J, N, ⟨hJ_lip, hJ_var, hJ_surj⟩, hN_null, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  by_contra h_ndiff
  exact hx ⟨y, h_ndiff, hy⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hJ : IsProximalMapFor (fun ξ => u ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) J)
    (ξ₀ q₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (M₀ δ₀ : ℝ)
    (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀)
    (hub : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ₀,
      u ξ ≤ u ξ₀ + inner ℝ q₀ (ξ - ξ₀) + M₀ * ‖ξ - ξ₀‖ ^ 2)
    (hdiff : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), J y = ξ₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ J y) :
    ∃ X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      (∀ v w, inner ℝ (X v) w = inner ℝ v (X w)) ∧
      ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ →
        ∃ δ_test : ℝ, 0 < δ_test ∧
          ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ_test,
            |u ξ - u ξ₀ - inner ℝ q₀ (ξ - ξ₀) -
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (ξ - ξ₀)) (ξ - ξ₀)| ≤ (κ / 2) * ‖ξ - ξ₀‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  let ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ := fun ξ => u ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2
  let g₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := q₀ + lam • ξ₀
  let M₁ : ℝ := M₀ + lam / 2
  have hM₁ : 0 < M₁ := by positivity
  have hψ_shift : ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ψ ξ - ψ ξ₀ - inner ℝ g₀ (ξ - ξ₀) =
        (u ξ - u ξ₀ - inner ℝ q₀ (ξ - ξ₀)) + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ - ξ₀‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro ξ
    have h_norm : ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖ξ₀‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ ξ₀ (ξ - ξ₀) + ‖ξ - ξ₀‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_eq : ξ = ξ₀ + (ξ - ξ₀) := by abel
      conv_lhs => rw [h_eq]
      exact norm_add_sq_real ξ₀ (ξ - ξ₀)
    have h_inner : inner ℝ g₀ (ξ - ξ₀) = inner ℝ q₀ (ξ - ξ₀) + lam * inner ℝ ξ₀ (ξ - ξ₀) := by
      dsimp [g₀]
      rw [inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real]
    dsimp [ψ]
    rw [h_norm, h_inner]
    ring
  have hψ_ub : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ₀,
      ψ ξ ≤ ψ ξ₀ + inner ℝ g₀ (ξ - ξ₀) + M₁ * ‖ξ - ξ₀‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hu := hub ξ hξ
    have h_sh := hψ_shift ξ
    dsimp [M₁]
    linarith
  have h_sub : ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), inner ℝ g₀ (ξ - ξ₀) ≤ ψ ξ - ψ ξ₀ := by
    intro ξ
    by_contra h_lt
    push_neg at h_lt
    let h := ξ - ξ₀
    let Δ := inner ℝ g₀ h - (ψ ξ - ψ ξ₀)
    have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ := by dsimp [Δ, h]; linarith
    have hh_ne : h ≠ 0 := by
      intro hh0
      have hξ_eq : ξ = ξ₀ := sub_eq_zero.mp hh0
      subst hξ_eq
      simp [h, Δ] at hΔ_pos
    have hh_pos : 0 < ‖h‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hh_ne
    let t : ℝ := min (δ₀ / (2 * ‖h‖)) (Δ / (2 * M₁ * ‖h‖ ^ 2))
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := by positivity
    have ht_le1 : t ≤ δ₀ / (2 * ‖h‖) := min_le_left _ _
    have ht_le2 : t ≤ Δ / (2 * M₁ * ‖h‖ ^ 2) := min_le_right _ _
    have ht_norm : t * ‖h‖ ≤ δ₀ / 2 := by
      have := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * ‖h‖)).mp ht_le1
      linarith
    have ht_Δ : t * (2 * M₁ * ‖h‖ ^ 2) ≤ Δ :=
      (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * M₁ * ‖h‖ ^ 2)).mp ht_le2
    let w := ξ₀ - t • h
    have hw_sub : w - ξ₀ = -(t • h) := by dsimp [w]; abel
    have hw_ball : w ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ₀ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hw_sub, norm_neg, norm_smul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht_pos]
      linarith
    have hψ_w := hψ_ub w hw_ball
    have h_inner_w : inner ℝ g₀ (w - ξ₀) = -t * inner ℝ g₀ h := by
      rw [hw_sub, inner_neg_right, inner_smul_right]
      ring
    have h_norm_w : ‖w - ξ₀‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hw_sub, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    rw [h_inner_w, h_norm_w] at hψ_w
    let a : ℝ := t / (1 + t)
    let b : ℝ := 1 / (1 + t)
    have h1t_pos : 0 < 1 + t := by linarith
    have ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a := by positivity
    have hb_nonneg : 0 ≤ b := by positivity
    have hab : a + b = 1 := by
      dsimp [a, b]
      rw [← add_div, add_comm t 1, div_self (ne_of_gt h1t_pos)]
    have h_comb : a • ξ + b • w = ξ₀ := by
      have hξ_eq : ξ = ξ₀ + h := by dsimp [h]; abel
      rw [hξ_eq]
      dsimp [w]
      have h_ab_t : a - b * t = 0 := by
        dsimp [a, b]
        ring
      calc a • (ξ₀ + h) + b • (ξ₀ - t • h)
        _ = (a + b) • ξ₀ + (a - b * t) • h := by module
        _ = (1 : ℝ) • ξ₀ + (0 : ℝ) • h := by rw [hab, h_ab_t]
        _ = ξ₀ := by simp
    have h_conv_ineq := hconv.2 (Set.mem_univ ξ) (Set.mem_univ w) ha_nonneg hb_nonneg hab
    rw [h_comb] at h_conv_ineq
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_conv_ineq (le_of_lt h1t_pos)
    have h_rhs : (1 + t) * (a • ψ ξ + b • ψ w) = t * ψ ξ + ψ w := by
      dsimp [a, b]
      change (1 + t) * (t / (1 + t) * ψ ξ + 1 / (1 + t) * ψ w) = t * ψ ξ + ψ w
      have h_ne : 1 + t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h1t_pos
      field_simp
    rw [h_rhs] at h_mul
    change (1 + t) * ψ ξ₀ ≤ t * ψ ξ + ψ w at h_mul
    have h_tΔ : t * Δ ≤ t * (M₁ * ‖h‖ ^ 2 * t) := by
      dsimp [Δ]
      nlinarith
    have h_Δ_le : Δ ≤ M₁ * ‖h‖ ^ 2 * t := le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_tΔ ht_pos
    nlinarith
  have hJ_y0 : J (ξ₀ + g₀) = ξ₀ := by
    let y₀ := ξ₀ + g₀
    let z₀ := J y₀
    have h1 : inner ℝ (y₀ - z₀) (ξ₀ - z₀) ≤ ψ ξ₀ - ψ z₀ := hJ.2.1 y₀ ξ₀
    have h2 : inner ℝ g₀ (z₀ - ξ₀) ≤ ψ z₀ - ψ ξ₀ := h_sub z₀
    have h_sum : inner ℝ (y₀ - z₀) (ξ₀ - z₀) + inner ℝ g₀ (z₀ - ξ₀) ≤ 0 := by linarith
    have h_alg : inner ℝ (y₀ - z₀) (ξ₀ - z₀) + inner ℝ g₀ (z₀ - ξ₀) = ‖ξ₀ - z₀‖ ^ 2 := by
      have hy₀ : y₀ - z₀ = (ξ₀ - z₀) + g₀ := by dsimp [y₀]; abel
      have hz₀ : z₀ - ξ₀ = -(ξ₀ - z₀) := by abel
      rw [hy₀, hz₀, inner_add_left, inner_neg_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      ring
    rw [h_alg] at h_sum
    have h_norm_zero : ‖ξ₀ - z₀‖ = 0 := by
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖ξ₀ - z₀‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h_sq_zero : ‖ξ₀ - z₀‖ ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm h_sum h_nonneg
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h_sq_zero
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp h_norm_zero)).symm
  have h_rev_lip : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      J y ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ (δ₀ / 2) →
      ‖y - (ξ₀ + g₀)‖ ≤ (1 + 4 * M₁) * ‖J y - ξ₀‖ := by
    intro y hy
    let z := J y
    let v := (y - z) - g₀
    have hz_lt : ‖z - ξ₀‖ < δ₀ / 2 := by simpa [z, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hy
    have hv_le : ‖v‖ ≤ 4 * M₁ * ‖z - ξ₀‖ := by
      by_contra h_gt
      push_neg at h_gt
      have hv_pos : 0 < ‖v‖ := by
        have : 0 ≤ 4 * M₁ * ‖z - ξ₀‖ := by positivity
        linarith
      let s : ℝ := min (δ₀ / 2) (‖v‖ / (4 * M₁))
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := by positivity
      have hs_le1 : s ≤ δ₀ / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      have hs_le2 : s ≤ ‖v‖ / (4 * M₁) := min_le_right _ _
      have hs_4M1 : 4 * M₁ * s ≤ ‖v‖ := by

      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (N : ℝ))]
      exact h_Hh_div
    have h_div_bounds := abs_le.mp h_abs_div
    rw [abs_le]
    dsimp [h] at h_sum_low h_sum_high h_div_bounds
    constructor <;> linarith
  let I_op : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
  let X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (H + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint H) - lam • I_op
  refine ⟨X, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v w
    dsimp [X, I_op]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,
      inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
      inner_add_left, inner_add_right, RCLike.conj_to_real]
    have h1 : inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint H v) w = inner ℝ v (H w) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left H w v
    have h2 : inner ℝ v (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint H w) = inner ℝ (H v) w :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right H v w
    linarith
  · intro κ hκ
    obtain ⟨δ_test, hδ_test_pos, hδ_test⟩ := h_taylor_ψ κ hκ
    refine ⟨δ_test, hδ_test_pos, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξ
    have h_t := hδ_test ξ hξ
    have h_sh := hψ_shift ξ
    have h_X_quad : ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X h) h =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (H h) h - (lam / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro h
      dsimp [X, I_op]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,
        inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, inner_add_left, RCLike.conj_to_real,
        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      have h_adj : inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint H h) h = inner ℝ (H h) h := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, real_inner_comm]
      linarith
    have h_X_ξ := h_X_quad (ξ - ξ₀)
    have h_eq : u ξ - u ξ₀ - inner ℝ q₀ (ξ - ξ₀) -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (ξ - ξ₀)) (ξ - ξ₀) =
        ψ ξ - ψ ξ₀ - inner ℝ g₀ (ξ - ξ₀) -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (H (ξ - ξ₀)) (ξ - ξ₀) := by
      linarith
    rwa [h_eq]

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (e_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (α' β' γ' K : ℝ)
    (hα' : 0 < α') (hβ' : 0 < β') (hγ' : 0 < γ') (hK : 0 < K) :
    let C_Q : ℝ := 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 + 2 * β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * γ' + K
    0 < C_Q ∧
    (∀ x₁ x₂ x₃ h₁ h₂ h₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K (x₁ + h₁) (x₂ + h₂) (x₃ + h₃) -
        threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ =
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₁ +
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₂ +
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₃ +
        threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K h₁ h₂ h₃) ∧
    (∀ h₁ h₂ h₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      |threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K h₁ h₂ h₃| ≤
        C_Q * (‖h₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₃‖ ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) ∧
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) ∧
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro C_Q
  have hC_Q_pos : 0 < C_Q := by
    dsimp [C_Q]
    positivity
  let P_perp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
    fun v => v - (inner ℝ e_hat v) • e_hat
  have hP_add : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      P_perp (u + v) = P_perp u + P_perp v := by
    intro u v
    dsimp [P_perp]
    rw [inner_add_right]
    module
  have hP_sub : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      P_perp (u - v) = P_perp u - P_perp v := by
    intro u v
    dsimp [P_perp]
    rw [inner_sub_right]
    module
  have hP_symm : ∀ w v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      inner ℝ w (P_perp v) = inner ℝ (P_perp w) v := by
    intro w v
    dsimp [P_perp]
    rw [inner_sub_right, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_comm w e_hat]
    ring
  have hP_sq : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ‖P_perp (u + v)‖ ^ 2 - ‖P_perp u‖ ^ 2 =
        2 * inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) v + ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro u v
    rw [hP_add u v, norm_add_sq_real (P_perp u) (P_perp v), hP_symm (P_perp u) v]
    ring
  have hP_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ‖P_perp v‖ ≤ (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) * ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    have h1 : ‖P_perp v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ + ‖(inner ℝ e_hat v) • e_hat‖ := norm_sub_le v _
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    have h2 : |inner ℝ e_hat v| * ‖e_hat‖ ≤ (‖e_hat‖ * ‖v‖) * ‖e_hat‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_real_inner_le_norm e_hat v) (norm_nonneg e_hat)
    have h3 : ‖v‖ + (‖e_hat‖ * ‖v‖) * ‖e_hat‖ = (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) * ‖v‖ := by ring
    linarith
  have hP_norm_sq : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    have h1 := hP_norm v
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖P_perp v‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h3 : ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) * ‖v‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h4 : ((1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) * ‖v‖) ^ 2 = (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    linarith
  have hP2_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ‖P_perp (P_perp v)‖ ≤ (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    have h1 := hP_norm (P_perp v)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hP_norm v) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2)
    have h3 : (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) * ((1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) * ‖v‖) = (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖v‖ := by ring
    linarith
  have h_taylor : ∀ x₁ x₂ x₃ h₁ h₂ h₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K (x₁ + h₁) (x₂ + h₂) (x₃ + h₃) -
        threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ =
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₁ +
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₂ +
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₃ +
        threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K h₁ h₂ h₃ := by
    intro x₁ x₂ x₃ h₁ h₂ h₃
    let u := x₁ - x₂
    let v := h₁ - h₂
    let m := x₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x₁ + x₂)
    let dm := h₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (h₁ + h₂)
    have huv : (x₁ + h₁) - (x₂ + h₂) = u + v := by
      dsimp [u, v]
      module
    have hmdm : (x₃ + h₃) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((x₁ + h₁) + (x₂ + h₂)) = m + dm := by
      dsimp [m, dm]
      module
    have h_dir : (inner ℝ e_hat (u + v)) ^ 2 - (inner ℝ e_hat u) ^ 2 =
        2 * inner ℝ e_hat u * inner ℝ e_hat h₁ -
        2 * inner ℝ e_hat u * inner ℝ e_hat h₂ +
        (inner ℝ e_hat v) ^ 2 := by
      have hv_in : inner ℝ e_hat v = inner ℝ e_hat h₁ - inner ℝ e_hat h₂ :=
        inner_sub_right e_hat h₁ h₂
      calc (inner ℝ e_hat (u + v)) ^ 2 - (inner ℝ e_hat u) ^ 2
        _ = (inner ℝ e_hat u + inner ℝ e_hat v) ^ 2 - (inner ℝ e_hat u) ^ 2 := by
            rw [inner_add_right]
        _ = 2 * inner ℝ e_hat u * inner ℝ e_hat v + (inner ℝ e_hat v) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 2 * inner ℝ e_hat u * (inner ℝ e_hat h₁ - inner ℝ e_hat h₂) + (inner ℝ e_hat v) ^ 2 := by
            rw [hv_in]
        _ = 2 * inner ℝ e_hat u * inner ℝ e_hat h₁ -
            2 * inner ℝ e_hat u * inner ℝ e_hat h₂ +
            (inner ℝ e_hat v) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_orth : ‖P_perp (u + v)‖ ^ 2 - ‖P_perp u‖ ^ 2 =
        2 * inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₁ -
        2 * inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₂ +
        ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 := by
      calc ‖P_perp (u + v)‖ ^ 2 - ‖P_perp u‖ ^ 2
        _ = 2 * inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) v + ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 := hP_sq u v
        _ = 2 * (inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₁ - inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₂) + ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [inner_sub_right (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₁ h₂]
        _ = 2 * inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₁ -
            2 * inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₂ +
            ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_mid : ‖m + dm‖ ^ 2 - ‖m‖ ^ 2 =
        -inner ℝ m h₁ - inner ℝ m h₂ + 2 * inner ℝ m h₃ + ‖dm‖ ^ 2 := by
      have hdm_in : inner ℝ m dm = inner ℝ m h₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (inner ℝ m h₁ + inner ℝ m h₂) := by
        dsimp [dm]
        rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right]
      calc ‖m + dm‖ ^ 2 - ‖m‖ ^ 2
        _ = 2 * inner ℝ m dm + ‖dm‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [norm_add_sq_real m dm]
            ring
        _ = 2 * (inner ℝ m h₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (inner ℝ m h₁ + inner ℝ m h₂)) + ‖dm‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [hdm_in]
        _ = -inner ℝ m h₁ - inner ℝ m h₂ + 2 * inner ℝ m h₃ + ‖dm‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_iso₁ : ‖x₁ + h₁‖ ^ 2 - ‖x₁‖ ^ 2 = 2 * inner ℝ x₁ h₁ + ‖h₁‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_add_sq_real x₁ h₁]; ring
    have h_iso₂ : ‖x₂ + h₂‖ ^ 2 - ‖x₂‖ ^ 2 = 2 * inner ℝ x₂ h₂ + ‖h₂‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_add_sq_real x₂ h₂]; ring
    have h_iso₃ : ‖x₃ + h₃‖ ^ 2 - ‖x₃‖ ^ 2 = 2 * inner ℝ x₃ h₃ + ‖h₃‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_add_sq_real x₃ h₃]; ring
    have hg₁ : inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₁ =
        -2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat u * inner ℝ e_hat h₁ +
        2 * β' * inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₁ -
        γ' * inner ℝ m h₁ +
        2 * K * inner ℝ x₁ h₁ := by
      dsimp [threePointQuadGrad₁, P_perp, u, m]
      simp only [inner_add_left, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left]
    have hg₂ : inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₂ =
        2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat u * inner ℝ e_hat h₂ -
        2 * β' * inner ℝ (P_perp (P_perp u)) h₂ -
        γ' * inner ℝ m h₂ +
        2 * K * inner ℝ x₂ h₂ := by
      dsimp [threePointQuadGrad₂, P_perp, u, m]
      simp only [inner_add_left, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left]
    have hg₃ : inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃) h₃ =
        2 * γ' * inner ℝ m h₃ +
        2 * K * inner ℝ x₃ h₃ := by
      dsimp [threePointQuadGrad₃, m]
      simp only [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
    have hQ_diff : threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K (x₁ + h₁) (x₂ + h₂) (x₃ + h₃) -
        threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ =
        -α' * ((inner ℝ e_hat (u + v)) ^ 2 - (inner ℝ e_hat u) ^ 2) +
        β' * (‖P_perp (u + v)‖ ^ 2 - ‖P_perp u‖ ^ 2) +
        γ' * (‖m + dm‖ ^ 2 - ‖m‖ ^ 2) +
        K * ((‖x₁ + h₁‖ ^ 2 - ‖x₁‖ ^ 2) + (‖x₂ + h₂‖ ^ 2 - ‖x₂‖ ^ 2) + (‖x₃ + h₃‖ ^ 2 - ‖x₃‖ ^ 2)) := by
      dsimp [threePointQuadForm, P_perp]
      rw [huv, hmdm]
      ring
    have hQ_h : threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K h₁ h₂ h₃ =
        -α' * (inner ℝ e_hat v) ^ 2 +
        β' * ‖P_perp v‖ ^ 2 +
        γ' * ‖dm‖ ^ 2 +
        K * (‖h₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₃‖ ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [threePointQuadForm, P_perp, v, dm]
    rw [hQ_diff, h_dir, h_orth, h_mid, h_iso₁, h_iso₂, h_iso₃, hg₁, hg₂, hg₃, hQ_h]
    ring
  have h_quad : ∀ h₁ h₂ h₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      |threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K h₁ h₂ h₃| ≤
        C_Q * (‖h₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₃‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro h₁ h₂ h₃
    let S : ℝ := ‖h₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₃‖ ^ 2
    have hS_nonneg : 0 ≤ S := by
      dsimp [S]
      positivity
    have h_para_sub : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        ‖a - b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro a b
      have h1 := norm_sub_sq_real a b
      have h2 := norm_add_sq_real a b
      have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖a + b‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
    have h_para_add : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
        ‖a + b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro a b
      have h1 := norm_sub_sq_real a b
      have h2 := norm_add_sq_real a b
      have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖a - b‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
    have h_diff_sq : ‖h₁ - h₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * S := by
      have h1 := h_para_sub h₁ h₂
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖h₃‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      dsimp [S]
      linarith
    have h_mid_sq : ‖h₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (h₁ + h₂)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * S := by
      have h1 := h_para_sub h₃ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (h₁ + h₂))
      have h2 : ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (h₁ + h₂)‖ ^ 2 = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖h₁ + h₂‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
        ring
      have h3 := h_para_add h₁ h₂
      have h4 : 0 ≤ ‖h₁‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h5 : 0 ≤ ‖h₂‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      dsimp [S]
      linarith
    have h_dir_sq : (inner ℝ e_hat (h₁ - h₂)) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * S := by
      have h_cs := abs_real_inner_le_norm e_hat (h₁ - h₂)
      have h_abs_nonneg : 0 ≤ |inner ℝ e_hat (h₁ - h₂)| := abs_nonneg _
      have h_sq1 : (inner ℝ e_hat (h₁ - h₂)) ^ 2 ≤ (‖e_hat‖ * ‖h₁ - h₂‖) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs (inner ℝ e_hat (h₁ - h₂))]
        nlinarith
      have h_sq2 : (‖e_hat‖ * ‖h₁ - h₂‖) ^ 2 = ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * ‖h₁ - h₂‖ ^ 2 := by ring
      have h_sq3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_sq (sq_nonneg ‖e_hat‖)
      linarith
    have h_orth_sq : ‖P_perp (h₁ - h₂)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * S := by
      have h1 := hP_norm_sq (h₁ - h₂)
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_sq (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2)
      linarith
    have h_term1_nonneg : 0 ≤ α' * (inner ℝ e_hat (h₁ - h₂)) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h_term1_le : α' * (inner ℝ e_hat (h₁ - h₂)) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * S := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_dir_sq (le_of_lt hα')
      linarith
    have h_term2_nonneg : 0 ≤ β' * ‖P_perp (h₁ - h₂)‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h_term2_le : β' * ‖P_perp (h₁ - h₂)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * S := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_orth_sq (le_of_lt hβ')
      linarith
    have h_term3_nonneg : 0 ≤ γ' * ‖h₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (h₁ + h₂)‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h_term3_le : γ' * ‖h₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (h₁ + h₂)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * γ' * S := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mid_sq (le_of_lt hγ')
      linarith
    have h_term4_nonneg : 0 ≤ K * S := by positivity
    have h_CQ_S : C_Q * S =
        2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * S + 2 * β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * S + 2 * γ' * S + K * S := by
      dsimp [C_Q]
      ring
    have h_nonneg_extra1 : 0 ≤ 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * S := by positivity
    have h_nonneg_extra2 : 0 ≤ 2 * β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * S := by positivity
    have h_nonneg_extra3 : 0 ≤ 2 * γ' * S := by positivity
    have hQ_eq : threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K h₁ h₂ h₃ =
        -(α' * (inner ℝ e_hat (h₁ - h₂)) ^ 2) +
        β' * ‖P_perp (h₁ - h₂)‖ ^ 2 +
        γ' * ‖h₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (h₁ + h₂)‖ ^ 2 +
        K * S := by
      dsimp [threePointQuadForm, P_perp, S]
      ring
    rw [abs_le]
    change -(C_Q * S) ≤ threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K h₁ h₂ h₃ ∧
      threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K h₁ h₂ h₃ ≤ C_Q * S
    rw [hQ_eq]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h_grad_norm : ∀ u₁ u₂ u₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      let D : ℝ := ‖u₁‖ + ‖u₂‖ + ‖u₃‖
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K u₁ u₂ u₃‖ ≤ 2 * C_Q * D ∧
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K u₁ u₂ u₃‖ ≤ 2 * C_Q * D ∧
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K u₁ u₂ u₃‖ ≤ 2 * C_Q * D := by
    intro u₁ u₂ u₃ D
    have hD_nonneg : 0 ≤ D := by
      dsimp [D]
      positivity
    have hu₁_le : ‖u₁‖ ≤ D := by
      dsimp [D]
      linarith [norm_nonneg u₂, norm_nonneg u₃]
    have hu₂_le : ‖u₂‖ ≤ D := by
      dsimp [D]
      linarith [norm_nonneg u₁, norm_nonneg u₃]
    have hu₃_le : ‖u₃‖ ≤ D := by
      dsimp [D]
      linarith [norm_nonneg u₁, norm_nonneg u₂]
    have h_diff_le : ‖u₁ - u₂‖ ≤ D := by
      have h1 := norm_sub_le u₁ u₂
      dsimp [D]
      linarith [norm_nonneg u₃]
    have h_mid_le : ‖u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)‖ ≤ D := by
      have h1 := norm_sub_le u₃ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂))
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)] at h1
      have h2 := norm_add_le u₁ u₂
      dsimp [D]
      linarith [norm_nonneg u₁, norm_nonneg u₂]
    have h_dir_le1 : ‖(-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat‖ ≤ 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * D := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        show (-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) = -(2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) by ring,
        abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * α')]
      have h_cs := abs_real_inner_le_norm e_hat (u₁ - u₂)
      have h1 : 2 * α' * |inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)| * ‖e_hat‖ ≤
          2 * α' * (‖e_hat‖ * ‖u₁ - u₂‖) * ‖e_hat‖ := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cs (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * α')
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this (norm_nonneg e_hat)
      have h2 : 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * ‖u₁ - u₂‖ ≤ 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * D :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_le (by positivity)
      linarith [ (by ring : 2 * α' * (‖e_hat‖ * ‖u₁ - u₂‖) * ‖e_hat‖ = 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * ‖u₁ - u₂‖) ]
    have h_dir_le2 : ‖(2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat‖ ≤ 2 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * D := by
      have h_eq : (2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat =
          -((-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat) := by module
      rw [h_eq, norm_neg]
      exact h_dir_le1
    have h_orth_le : ‖(2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂))‖ ≤
        2 * β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * D := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * β')]
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hP2_norm (u₁ - u₂)) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * β')
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_le (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2)
      linarith
    have h_mid_g12 : ‖γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂))‖ ≤ γ' * D := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hγ']
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mid_le (le_of_lt hγ')
    have h_mid_g3 : ‖(2 * γ') • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂))‖ ≤ 2 * γ' * D := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * γ')]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mid_le (by positivity)
    have h_iso_u1 : ‖(2 * K) • u₁‖ ≤ 2 * K * D := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * K)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu₁_le (by positivity)
    have h_iso_u2 : ‖(2 * K) • u₂‖ ≤ 2 * K * D := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * K)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu₂_le (by positivity)
    have h_iso_u3 : ‖(2 * K) • u₃‖ ≤ 2 * K * D := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * K)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu₃_le (by positivity)
    have h_2CQ_D : 2 * C_Q * D =
        4 * α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * D + 4 * β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * D + 4 * γ' * D + 2 * K * D := by
      dsimp [C_Q]
      ring
    have h_extra1 : 0 ≤ α' * ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2 * D := by positivity
    have h_extra2 : 0 ≤ β' * (1 + ‖e_hat‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * D := by positivity
    have h_extra3 : 0 ≤ γ' * D := by positivity
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change ‖((-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat +
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)) -
          γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)) +
          (2 * K) • u₁)‖ ≤ 2 * C_Q * D
      have h_tri1 := norm_add_le
        ((-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat +
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)) -
          γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)))
        ((2 * K) • u₁)
      have h_tri2 := norm_sub_le
        ((-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat +
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)))
        (γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)))
      have h_tri3 := norm_add_le
        ((-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat)
        ((2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)))
      linarith
    · change ‖((2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat -
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)) -
          γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)) +
          (2 * K) • u₂)‖ ≤ 2 * C_Q * D
      have h_tri1 := norm_add_le
        ((2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat -
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)) -
          γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)))
        ((2 * K) • u₂)
      have h_tri2 := norm_sub_le
        ((2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat -
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)))
        (γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)))
      have h_tri3 := norm_sub_le
        ((2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat)
        ((2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)))
      linarith
    · change ‖(2 * γ') • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)) + (2 * K) • u₃‖ ≤ 2 * C_Q * D
      have h_tri1 := norm_add_le
        ((2 * γ') • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)))
        ((2 * K) • u₃)
      linarith
  have h_lip : ∀ x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) ∧
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) ∧
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) := by
    intro x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃
    let u₁ := x₁ - y₁
    let u₂ := x₂ - y₂
    let u₃ := x₃ - y₃
    have h_diff_xy : (x₁ - x₂) - (y₁ - y₂) = u₁ - u₂ := by
      dsimp [u₁, u₂]
      module
    have h_P2_diff : P_perp (P_perp (x₁ - x₂)) - P_perp (P_perp (y₁ - y₂)) =
        P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)) := by
      rw [← hP_sub, ← hP_sub, h_diff_xy]
    have h_in_diff : inner ℝ e_hat (x₁ - x₂) - inner ℝ e_hat (y₁ - y₂) =
        inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂) := by
      rw [← inner_sub_right, h_diff_xy]
    have hg₁_sub : threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃ =
        threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' K u₁ u₂ u₃ := by
      change ((-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (x₁ - x₂)) • e_hat +
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (x₁ - x₂)) -
          γ' • (x₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x₁ + x₂)) +
          (2 * K) • x₁) -
        ((-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (y₁ - y₂)) • e_hat +
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (y₁ - y₂)) -
          γ' • (y₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (y₁ + y₂)) +
          (2 * K) • y₁) =
        (-2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat +
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)) -
          γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)) +
          (2 * K) • u₁
      rw [← h_P2_diff, ← h_in_diff]
      dsimp [u₁, u₂, u₃]
      module
    have hg₂_sub : threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃ =
        threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' K u₁ u₂ u₃ := by
      change ((2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (x₁ - x₂)) • e_hat -
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (x₁ - x₂)) -
          γ' • (x₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x₁ + x₂)) +
          (2 * K) • x₂) -
        ((2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (y₁ - y₂)) • e_hat -
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (y₁ - y₂)) -
          γ' • (y₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (y₁ + y₂)) +
          (2 * K) • y₂) =
        (2 * α' * inner ℝ e_hat (u₁ - u₂)) • e_hat -
          (2 * β') • P_perp (P_perp (u₁ - u₂)) -
          γ' • (u₃ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u₁ + u₂)) +
          (2 * K) • u₂
      rw [← h_P2_diff, ← h_in_diff]
      dsimp [u₁, u₂, u₃]
      module
    have hg₃_sub : threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K y₁ y₂ y₃ =
        threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' K u₁ u₂ u₃ := by
      dsimp [threePointQuadGrad₃, u₁, u₂, u₃]
      module
    rw [hg₁_sub, hg₂_sub, hg₃_sub]
    exact h_grad_norm u₁ u₂ u₃
  exact ⟨hC_Q_pos, h_taylor, h_quad, h_lip⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(d : ℕ)
    (lam r α' β' γ' K' η δ C_Q : ℝ)
    (e_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (u_hat₁ u_hat₂ u_hat₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (N₁ N₂ N₃ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hr : 0 < r) (hη : 0 < η) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ_lt : δ < r) (hC_Q : 0 < C_Q)
    (hu₁0 : u_hat₁ 0 = 0) (hu₂0 : u_hat₂ 0 = 0) (hu₃0 : u_hat₃ 0 = 0)
    (hconv₁ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₁ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hconv₂ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₂ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hconv₃ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun ξ => u_hat₃ ξ + (lam / 2) * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    (hsum : ∀ ξ₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
      ∀ ξ₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
        ∀ ξ₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
          u_hat₁ ξ₁ + u_hat₂ ξ₂ + u_hat₃ ξ₃ ≤
            threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' K' ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃)
    (h_taylor : ∀ x₁ x₂ x₃ h₁ h₂ h₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) (x₁ + h₁) (x₂ + h₂) (x₃ + h₃) -
        threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃ =
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃) h₁ +
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃) h₂ +
        inner ℝ (threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃) h₃ +
        threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) h₁ h₂ h₃)
    (h_quad : ∀ h₁ h₂ h₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      |threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) h₁ h₂ h₃| ≤
        C_Q * (‖h₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖h₃‖ ^ 2))
    (h_lip : ∀ x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) ∧
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖) ∧
      ‖threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) y₁ y₂ y₃‖ ≤
        2 * C_Q * (‖x₁ - y₁‖ + ‖x₂ - y₂‖ + ‖x₃ - y₃‖))
    (hN₁ : MeasureTheory.volume N₁ = 0)
    (hN₂ : MeasureTheory.volume N₂ = 0)
    (hN₃ : MeasureTheory.volume N₃ = 0) :
    ∃ (ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃ v₁ v₂ v₃ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      ξ_bar₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ ∧
      ξ_bar₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ ∧
      ξ_bar₃ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ ∧
      v₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (η * δ / 4) ∧
      v₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (η * δ / 4) ∧
      v₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (η * δ / 4) ∧
      ξ_bar₁ ∉ N₁ ∧ ξ_bar₂ ∉ N₂ ∧ ξ_bar₃ ∉ N₃ ∧
      ∀ ξ₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ,
        ∀ ξ₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ,
          ∀ ξ₃ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) δ,
            (u_hat₁ ξ₁ + inner ℝ v₁ ξ₁) +
              (u_hat₂ ξ₂ + inner ℝ v₂ ξ₂) +
              (u_hat₃ ξ₃ + inner ℝ v₃ ξ₃) -
              threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ ≤
            (u_hat₁ ξ_bar₁ + inner ℝ v₁ ξ_bar₁) +
              (u_hat₂ ξ_bar₂ + inner ℝ v₂ ξ_bar₂) +
              (u_hat₃ ξ_bar₃ + inner ℝ v₃ ξ_bar₃) -
              threePointQuadForm e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) ξ_bar₁ ξ_bar₂ ξ_bar₃

      rw [h_eq]
      have h_tri := norm_sub_le
        (threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) (F v 0) (F v 1) (F v 2) -
         threePointQuadGrad₁ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) (F v' 0) (F v' 1) (F v' 2))
        (q₀ v - q₀ v')
      have hq₀_pi : ‖q₀ v - q₀ v'‖ ≤ (64 * C_Q + 16 * lam) * ‖F v - F v'‖ :=
        le_trans hq₀_lip (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF0_le h_coeff_pos)
      dsimp [Λ]

    have hv₁_le : ‖(v - v') 1‖ ≤ Λ * ‖F v - F v'‖ := by
      have h_eq : (v - v') 1 =
          (threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) (F v 0) (F v 1) (F v 2) -
           threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) (F v' 0) (F v' 1) (F v' 2)) -
          (q₁ v - q₁ v') := by
        change v 1 - v' 1 = _

        abel
      rw [h_eq]
      have h_tri := norm_sub_le
        (threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) (F v 0) (F v 1) (F v 2) -
         threePointQuadGrad₂ e_hat α' β' γ' (K' + η) (F v' 0) (F v' 1) (F v' 2))
        (q₁ v - q₁ v')
      have hq₁_pi : ‖q₁ v - q₁ v'‖ ≤ (64 * C_Q + 16 * lam) * ‖F v - F v'‖ :=
        le_trans hq₁_lip (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF1_le h_coeff_pos)
      dsimp [Λ]

    have hv₂_le : ‖(v - v') 2‖ ≤ Λ * ‖F v - F v'‖ := by
      have h_eq : (v - v') 2 =

      have h_tri := norm_sub_le
        (threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) (F v 0) (F v 1) (F v 2) -
         threePointQuadGrad₃ γ' (K' + η) (F v' 0) (F v' 1) (F v' 2))
        (q₂ v - q₂ v')
      have hq₂_pi : ‖q₂ v - q₂ v'‖ ≤ (64 * C_Q + 16 * lam) * ‖F v - F v'‖ :=
        le_trans hq₂_lip (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF2_le h_coeff_pos)
      dsimp [Λ]
      linarith
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hv₀_le
    · exact hv₁_le
    · exact hv₂_le
  have h_vol_pos : MeasureTheory.volume (F '' S_v) ≠ 0 :=
    h_s3 r_v Λ hr_v_pos hΛ_pos F hF_rev_lip
  have h_exists_good : ∃ v ∈ S_v, ¬ (F v 0 ∈ N₁ ∨ F v 1 ∈ N₂ ∨ F v 2 ∈ N₃) := by
    by_contra h_all_bad
    push_neg at h_all_bad
    have h_sub_bad : F '' S_v ⊆ {ξ : E3 | ξ 0 ∈ N₁ ∨ ξ 1 ∈ N₂ ∨ ξ 2 ∈ N₃} := by
      rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact h_all_bad v hv

  have h78_lt : 7 * δ / 8 < δ := by linarith

  have h2_ball : F v 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) δ :=

  have hv_norm : ‖v‖ ≤ η * δ / 4 := by simpa [S_v, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hv

    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]

  have hv₁_cb : v 1 ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (η * δ / 4) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]

    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]

import Mathlib

/-!
# Uniform Interior $C^{1,\alpha}$ Estimates for Infinity-Harmonic Functions (Theorem 1.1)

Formal problem statement for **Theorem 1.1** (Uniform interior estimate) from:
OpenAI, *Uniform Interior $C^{1,\alpha}$ Estimates for Infinity-Harmonic Functions*,
October 4, 2026.
https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/Uniform-Interior-C1alpha-Estimates-for-Infinity-Harmonic-Functions-October-4-2026/interior-c1-infinity-harmonic.pdf
-/

/-- The unnormalized infinity Laplacian
`Δ_∞ ϕ(z) = ⟨D²ϕ(z) ∇ϕ(z), ∇ϕ(z)⟩ = ∑_{i,j=1}^d ϕ_i(z) ϕ_j(z) ϕ_{ij}(z)`
of a real-valued function `ϕ` on `ℝ^d` at `z`. -/
noncomputable def infinityLaplacian {d : ℕ}
    (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z (gradient ϕ z) (gradient ϕ z)

/-- A continuous function `u` on an open set `Ω ⊆ ℝ^d` is *infinity-harmonic* (in the viscosity
sense) if every local upper `C²` test `ϕ` touching `u` from above at `z ∈ Ω` satisfies
`Δ_∞ ϕ(z) ≥ 0`, and every local lower `C²` test `ϕ` touching `u` from below at `z ∈ Ω` satisfies
`Δ_∞ ϕ(z) ≤ 0` (including when `∇ϕ(z) = 0`). -/
def IsInfinityHarmonicOn {d : ℕ}
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (Ω : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) : Prop :=
  ContinuousOn u Ω ∧
  (∀ z ∈ Ω, ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
    ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      IsOpen V → z ∈ V → V ⊆ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
      ϕ z = u z → (∀ y ∈ V, u y ≤ ϕ y) → 0 ≤ infinityLaplacian ϕ z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ Ω, ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
    ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      IsOpen V → z ∈ V → V ⊆ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V →
      ϕ z = u z → (∀ y ∈ V, ϕ y ≤ u y) → infinityLaplacian ϕ z ≤ 0)

/-- The oscillation `osc_E u = sup_E u - inf_E u` of a real-valued function `u` on `E`. -/
noncomputable def oscOn {X : Type*} (u : X → ℝ) (E : Set X) : ℝ :=
  sSup (u '' E) - sInf (u '' E)

/-- The supremum norm `‖g‖_{L^∞(E)} = sup_{x ∈ E} ‖g(x)‖` on `E`. -/
noncomputable def supNormOn {X Y : Type*} [Norm Y] (g : X → Y) (E : Set X) : ℝ :=
  sSup ((fun x => ‖g x‖) '' E)

/-- The `α`-Hölder seminorm
`[g]_{C^{0,α}(E)} = sup_{x, y ∈ E, x ≠ y} (‖g(x) - g(y)‖ / ‖x - y‖^α)`. -/
noncomputable def holderSeminormOn {X Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y]
    (α : ℝ) (g : X → Y) (E : Set X) : ℝ :=
  sSup { q : ℝ | ∃ x ∈ E, ∃ y ∈ E, x ≠ y ∧ q = ‖g x - g y‖ / ‖x - y‖ ^ α }

/-- Membership `u ∈ C^{1,α}(E)` on an open subset `E ⊆ ℝ^d`: `u` is `C¹` on `E`, `u` is bounded on
`E`, and both `‖∇u‖` and the `α`-Hölder difference quotients of `∇u` are bounded above on `E`. -/
def MemC1HolderOn {d : ℕ} (α : ℝ) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u E ∧
  Bornology.IsBounded (u '' E) ∧
  BddAbove ((fun x => ‖gradient u x‖) '' E) ∧
  BddAbove { q : ℝ | ∃ x ∈ E, ∃ y ∈ E, x ≠ y ∧
    q = ‖gradient u x - gradient u y‖ / ‖x - y‖ ^ α }

/- **Theorem 1.1** (Uniform interior estimate):
For every integer `d ≥ 3` there are constants `α_d ∈ (0, 1/3]` and `C_d < ∞` such that every
bounded infinity-harmonic function `u ∈ C(B_1)`, where `B_1 ⊂ ℝ^d`, belongs to
`C^{1,α_d}(B_{1/2})` and satisfies
`‖∇u‖_{L^∞(B_{1/2})} + [∇u]_{C^{0,α_d}(B_{1/2})} ≤ C_d osc_{B_1} u`. -/
