noncomputable def projSpace {d : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).symm (fun i => z (Fin.castSucc i))

noncomputable def projTime {d : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  z (Fin.last d)

noncomputable def mkSpaceTime {d : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.snoc (fun i => x i) t)

noncomputable def liftFunc {d : ℕ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  u (projSpace z) + projTime z

def IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic (d : ℕ) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Bornology.IsBounded (u '' Metric.ball 0 1) ∧
  IsInfinityHarmonicOn u (Metric.ball 0 1) ∧
  u 0 = 0 ∧
  oscOn u (Metric.ball 0 1) ≤ 1

def IsCylinderGood {d : ℕ} (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r lam : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), P ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
      let N_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P‖⁻¹) • P
      |inner ℝ h N_P| ≤ r →
      ‖h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * r →
      |U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P h| ≤ lam * r

def HasUniformCylinderPowerDecay (d : ℕ) (B γ s₀ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < B ∧ 0 < γ ∧ γ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < s₀ ∧ s₀ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
  ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
    IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u →
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ s₀ * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) →
        ∀ lam : ℝ, B * (r / (3 / 4 - ‖z‖)) ^ γ < lam → lam < 1 →
          IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u) z r lam

noncomputable def limitingOperator {d : ℕ} (ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := mkSpaceTime (projSpace (gradient ϕ z)) 1
  fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ϕ) z ξ ξ

def InLimitingClassA (d : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Continuous v ∧
  (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
    ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z = v z → (∀ y ∈ V, v y ≤ ϕ y) →
      0 ≤ limitingOperator ϕ z) ∧
  (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ∀ ϕ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ,
    ∀ V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      IsOpen V → z ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ϕ V → ϕ z = v z → (∀ y ∈ V, ϕ y ≤ v y) →
      limitingOperator ϕ z ≤ 0) ∧
  (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ), 0 < R →
    ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
      ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ℓ : ℝ),
        |ℓ| ≤ R → ‖h - ℓ • p‖ ≤ R →
        |v (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) -
          inner ℝ p h - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ| ≤ C₀ * R)

def IsAffineSpaceTime (d : ℕ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (c : ℝ),
    ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), v z = inner ℝ P z + c

def IsFitAt (d : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ)
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ℓ : ℝ),
    |ℓ| ≤ R → ‖h - ℓ • p‖ ≤ R →
    |v (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v (mkSpaceTime x t) -
      inner ℝ p h - (a - ‖p‖ ^ 2 / 2) * ℓ| ≤ C₀ * R

def IsCenteredAt (d : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  v (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀) = 0 ∧ IsFitAt d C₀ v x₀ t₀ 1 0 0

noncomputable def quadEnvelopePlus (d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  sSup ((fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
    f (mkSpaceTime y (projTime z + ℓ)) - ‖y - projSpace z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ)

noncomputable def quadEnvelopeMinus (d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  sInf ((fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
    f (mkSpaceTime y (projTime z - ℓ)) + ‖y - projSpace z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ℓ)) '' Set.univ)

noncomputable def slopePlus (d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (quadEnvelopePlus d ℓ f z - f z) / ℓ

noncomputable def slopeMinus (d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (f z - quadEnvelopeMinus d ℓ f z) / ℓ

def HasCommonSlopeLimit (d : ℕ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => slopePlus d ℓ f z) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun ℓ => slopeMinus d ℓ f z) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds H)

def HasHorizontalJensenBound (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
    (∀ i, 0 < θ i) → (∑ i, θ i = 1) →
    let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := ∑ i, θ i • y i
    let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - x‖ ^ 2)
    (∑ i, θ i * f (mkSpaceTime (y i) t)) - f (mkSpaceTime x t) ≤ κ * r

noncomputable def barycentricEnvelope (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  sSup { val : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
    (∀ i, 0 < θ i) ∧ (∑ i, θ i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, θ i • y i = projSpace z) ∧
    val = (∑ i, θ i * f (mkSpaceTime (y i) (projTime z))) -
      (∑ i, θ i * ‖y i - projSpace z‖ ^ 2) / (2 * s) }

noncomputable def shiftedBarycentricEnvelope (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  barycentricEnvelope d (projTime z) f z - κ ^ 2 * projTime z / 2

def IsCylinderFitAt {d : ℕ} (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r lam : ℝ)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : Prop :=
  P ≠ 0 ∧
  ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    let N_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P‖⁻¹) • P
    |inner ℝ h N_P| ≤ r →
    ‖h - (inner ℝ h N_P) • N_P‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * r →
    |U (z + h) - U z - inner ℝ P h| ≤ lam * r

def HasUniformNormalizedLiftBounds (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
    IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u →
    let U := liftFunc u
    IsInfinityHarmonicOn U (Metric.ball 0 (15 / 16)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8), |U z| ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8),
      ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (7 / 8),
        |U z₁ - U z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) →
        ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam < 1 →
          ∀ P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
            IsCylinderFitAt U z r lam P →
            ‖P‖ ≤ L + Real.sqrt lam ∧ |projTime P - 1| ≤ Real.sqrt lam)

def HasUniformQualitativeFlatness (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ s₀ : ℝ, 0 < s₀ ∧ s₀ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
      ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ,
        IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u →
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4),
          ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ s₀ * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) →
            ∀ lam : ℝ, ε ≤ lam → lam < 1 →
              IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u) z r lam

def HasSelectedBlowupScales (d : ℕ)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : ℕ,
    IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d (u_seq i) ∧
    z_seq i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
    0 < r_seq i ∧
    r_seq i ≤ (1 / (i + 8 : ℝ)) * (3 / 4 - ‖z_seq i‖) ∧
    0 < lam_seq i ∧
    lam_seq i < 1 / 128 ∧
    ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (lam_seq i) ∧
    IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (32 * lam_seq i)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto lam_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  (∀ M : ℝ, 2 ≤ M →
    ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖z - z_seq i‖ ≤ M * r_seq i →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ M * r_seq i →
          z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
          r ≤ (1 / 8) * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) ∧
          IsCylinderGood (liftFunc (u_seq i)) z r (32 * lam_seq i))

noncomputable def anisotropicRescale {d : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r c lam : ℝ)
    (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let x := projSpace w
  let t := projTime w
  (U (z + r • O (mkSpaceTime (Real.sqrt lam • x) t)) - U z - r * c * t) / (r * c * lam)

def IsAnisotropicBlowupLimit (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  v 0 = 0 ∧
  ∃ (k : ℕ → ℕ) (P_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (O_seq : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))),
    StrictMono k ∧
    (∀ i : ℕ,
      let j := k i
      IsCylinderFitAt (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (z_seq j) (r_seq j) (32 * lam_seq j) (P_seq i) ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖P_seq i‖ ∧ ‖P_seq i‖ ≤ L + 1 ∧
      O_seq i (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = (‖P_seq i‖⁻¹) • P_seq i) ∧
    (∀ K ε : ℝ, 0 < K → 0 < ε →
      ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
        let j := k i
        ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖w‖ ≤ K →
          |anisotropicRescale (liftFunc (u_seq j)) (z_seq j) (r_seq j) ‖P_seq i‖ (lam_seq j) (O_seq i) w - v w| ≤ ε)

def badParamSet (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  { lam : ℝ | 0 < lam ∧ lam < 1 ∧
    ∃ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r : ℝ),
      IsNormalizedInfinityHarmonic d u ∧
      z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
      0 < r ∧ r ≤ s * (3 / 4 - ‖z‖) ∧
      ¬ IsCylinderGood (liftFunc u) z r lam }

noncomputable def familyBadness (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (insert 0 (badParamSet d s))

noncomputable def isotropicBlowup {d : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (R : ℝ)
    (X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (U (z + R • X) - U z) / R

def HasUniformLinearLimitOnBall {d : ℕ}
    (F_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : Prop :=
  ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
    ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
      ∀ X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) ρ,
        |F_seq i X - inner ℝ P X| ≤ δ

def HasUniformMidpointFlatnessOnQuarterBall {d : ℕ}
    (F_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
    ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
      ∀ X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (1 / 4),
        ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (1 / 4),
          |F_seq i X + F_seq i Y - 2 * F_seq i ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + Y))| ≤ η * ‖X - Y‖

def IsSlowScaleExtraction (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (k₁ : ℕ → ℕ) (R_seq : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsInfinityHarmonicOn U₀ (Metric.ball 0 (27 / 32)) ∧
  (∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
    ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (27 / 32),
      |U₀ z₁ - U₀ z₂| ≤ L * ‖z₁ - z₂‖) ∧
  z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (3 / 4) ∧
  StrictMono k₁ ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ,
    let j := k₁ i
    let U_hat := isotropicBlowup (liftFunc (u_seq j)) z_star (R_seq i)
    0 < R_seq i ∧ R_seq i ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
    IsInfinityHarmonicOn U_hat (Metric.ball 0 1) ∧
    (∀ X₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |U_hat X₁ - U_hat X₂| ≤ L * ‖X₁ - X₂‖)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto R_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun i => r_seq (k₁ i) / R_seq i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ‖z_seq (k₁ i) - z_star‖ / R_seq i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
    ∃ i₀ : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
      let j := k₁ i
      ∀ X ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) 1,
        |isotropicBlowup (liftFunc (u_seq j)) z_star (R_seq i) X -
          isotropicBlowup U₀ z_star (R_seq i) X| ≤ δ)

noncomputable def fittedFrameTransform (d : ℕ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (r : ℝ)
    (p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₀ : ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let y := projSpace z
  let s := projTime z
  (v (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + r • (y + (s - 1) • p₀)) (r * s)) - v (mkSpaceTime x₀ r)) / r -
    inner ℝ p₀ y - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s - 1)

def HasUniformSubquadraticGrowth (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    ∃ (M : ℝ), 0 < M ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
          |t| ≤ T → M ≤ ‖x‖ → |w (mkSpaceTime x t)| ≤ ε * ‖x‖ ^ 2

def ConvergesLocUnif (d : ℕ)
    (w_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (v_inf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    ∃ (N : ℕ), ∀ (m : ℕ), N ≤ m →
      ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
        ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ R → |projTime z| ≤ R → |w_seq m z - v_inf z| ≤ ε

noncomputable def driftFunctional (d : ℕ) (κ ε : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (quadEnvelopePlus d ε (shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v) z -
    quadEnvelopeMinus d ε v z) / (2 * ε)

def IsOptimizingStepTriple (d : ℕ) (κ ε : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : Prop :=
  let W := shiftedBarycentricEnvelope d κ v
  W (mkSpaceTime (x + ε • Q_zero) (t + ε)) - (ε / 2) * ‖Q_zero‖ ^ 2 =
    quadEnvelopePlus d ε W (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
  W (mkSpaceTime (x + (2 * ε) • Q_plus) (t + 2 * ε)) - ε * ‖Q_plus‖ ^ 2 =
    quadEnvelopePlus d (2 * ε) W (mkSpaceTime x t) ∧
  v (mkSpaceTime (x - (2 * ε) • Q_minus) (t - 2 * ε)) + ε * ‖Q_minus‖ ^ 2 =
    quadEnvelopeMinus d (2 * ε) v (mkSpaceTime x t)

def HasPrelimitWalkContacts (d : ℕ) (C₁ κ : ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (R K L₀ D₀ : ℝ) (M_blk N_seq : ℕ → ℕ) (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x_term : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (x_mk p_mk : ℕ → ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (a_mk : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ R ∧ 0 < K ∧ 0 < D₀ ∧ StrictMono N_seq ∧
  (∀ h : ℕ, h ≤ M_blk h) ∧
  ∀ m : ℕ,
    let τ_m : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (N_seq m)
    0 < ε_seq m ∧ ε_seq m ≤ τ_m / 4 ∧
    ‖x_term m‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
    L₀ ≤ driftFunctional d κ (ε_seq m) v (mkSpaceTime (x_term m) τ_m) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N_seq m →
      let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
      ‖x_mk m j‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
      IsFitAt d C₁ v (x_mk m j) δ_j δ_j (p_mk m j) (a_mk m j) ∧
      L₀ - D₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤
        driftFunctional d κ (ε_seq m) v (mkSpaceTime (x_mk m j) δ_j)) ∧
    (∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ m →
      ∃ j : ℕ, h ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M_blk h ∧ j ≤ N_seq m ∧
        ‖x_term m - x_mk m j - (τ_m - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) • p_mk m j‖ ≤
          K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j)

def IsBaseSlopeAndFrameSeq (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (u_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (z_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (r_seq lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (P_base : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
    (O_base : ℕ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : ℕ,
    IsCylinderFitAt (liftFunc (u_seq i)) (z_seq i) (r_seq i) (32 * lam_seq i) (P_base i) ∧
    1 / 2 ≤ ‖P_base i‖ ∧ ‖P_base i‖ ≤ L + 1 ∧
    O_base i (mkSpaceTime 0 1) = (‖P_base i‖⁻¹) • P_base i

def HasCylinderFitComparisonBounds (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C_comp : ℝ, 0 < C_comp ∧
    ∀ (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
      (z z' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (H H' θ : ℝ)
      (P P' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      0 < θ → θ < 1 / 2 →
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖P‖ → ‖P‖ ≤ L + 1 →
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖P'‖ → ‖P'‖ ≤ L + 1 →
      let n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P‖⁻¹) • P
      let n' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P'‖⁻¹) • P'
      ((z' = z ∧ 0 < H ∧ H ≤ H' ∧ H' ≤ 2 * H ∧
        IsCylinderFitAt U z H (θ ^ 2) P ∧ IsCylinderFitAt U z H' (θ ^ 2) P') ∨
       (H' = H ∧ 0 < H ∧ |inner ℝ (z' - z) n| ≤ H / 4 ∧
        ‖(z' - z) - (inner ℝ (z' - z) n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H / 4 ∧
        IsCylinderFitAt U z H (θ ^ 2) P ∧ IsCylinderFitAt U z' H (θ ^ 2) P')) →
      ‖P - P'‖ ≤ C_comp * θ ∧
      ‖n - n'‖ ≤ C_comp * θ ∧
      |‖P‖ - ‖P'‖| ≤ C_comp * θ ^ 2

def HasUniformRescaledShearedBoxFits (d : ℕ)
    (lam_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (v_seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ K S : ℝ, 0 < K → 0 < S →
    ∃ (C_KS : ℝ) (i₀ : ℕ), 0 ≤ C_KS ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, i₀ ≤ i →
        ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
          ‖mkSpaceTime x t‖ ≤ K →
          ∃ (p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (q' : ℝ),
            ‖p'‖ + |q'| ≤ C_KS ∧
            1 / 2 ≤ 1 + lam_seq i * q' ∧
            ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ℓ : ℝ),
              |ℓ| ≤ S / 2 →
              ‖h - ((1 + lam_seq i * q')⁻¹ * ℓ) • p'‖ ≤ S →
              |v_seq i (mkSpaceTime (x + h) (t + ℓ)) - v_seq i (mkSpaceTime x t) -
                inner ℝ p' h - q' * ℓ| ≤ 64 * S

def HasSphericalConeComparison {d : ℕ}
    (U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r M : ℝ),
    0 < r → ‖z‖ + r < 27 / 32 → 0 ≤ M →
    ((∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall z r, U₀ Z - U₀ z ≤ M * r) →
      ∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall z r, U₀ Z - U₀ z ≤ M * ‖Z - z‖) ∧
    ((∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall z r, U₀ z - U₀ Z ≤ M * r) →
      ∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall z r, U₀ z - U₀ Z ≤ M * ‖Z - z‖)

def HasCommonInfinitesimalSlope {d : ℕ}
    (U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (L_star : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ L_star ∧
  (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 16 →
    (∃ h_plus ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
      L_star * r ≤ U₀ (z_star + h_plus) - U₀ z_star) ∧
    (∃ h_minus ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
      L_star * r ≤ U₀ z_star - U₀ (z_star + h_minus))) ∧
  (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧
      ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), ‖h‖ ≤ ρ₀ →
        |U₀ (z_star + h) - U₀ z_star| ≤ (L_star + ε) * ‖h‖)

def HasCenteredClassABounds (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    ∃ (M : ℝ), 0 < M ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
          M ≤ ‖y‖ → |w (mkSpaceTime y 1)| ≤ ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t R : ℝ), 0 < R →
    ∃ (B_fit : ℝ), 0 ≤ B_fit ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
          ‖p‖ ≤ B_fit ∧ |a| ≤ B_fit ∧ IsFitAt d C₁ w x t R p a) ∧
  (∀ (K : ℝ), 0 < K →
    (∃ (U : ℝ), 0 ≤ U ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ K → |projTime z| ≤ K → |w z| ≤ U) ∧
    (∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
          InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
          ∀ (z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
            ‖projSpace z₁‖ ≤ K → |projTime z₁| ≤ K →
            ‖projSpace z₂‖ ≤ K → |projTime z₂| ≤ K →
            ‖z₁ - z₂‖ ≤ δ → |w z₁ - w z₂| ≤ ε))

noncomputable def parabolicTestFunc (d : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  c₀ + c₁ * (projTime z - τ₀) + (c₂ / 2) * (projTime z - τ₀) ^ 2 +
    ‖projSpace z - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (projTime z - t))

noncomputable def concaveSepPenalty (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  r - (1 / 8 : ℝ) * (r * Real.sqrt r)

noncomputable def threePointCutoff {d : ℕ} (L δ : ℝ)
    (c₀ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let C : ℝ := 2 * L
  let B_out : ℝ := (5 / 4 : ℝ) * (C + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * C ^ 2 + 1)
  δ / 2 + 16 * B_out * ‖c - c₀‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def threePointPenaltyPsi {d : ℕ} (L δ : ℝ)
    (P_star c₀ x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)
  let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := z - c
  let r : ℝ := ‖x - y‖
  inner ℝ P_star (x + y - (2 : ℝ) • z) +
    threePointCutoff L δ c₀ c * concaveSepPenalty r +
    ‖h‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2

noncomputable def threePointQuadForm {d : ℕ}
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  -α * (inner ℝ e (x - y)) ^ 2 +
    β * ‖(x - y) - (inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e‖ ^ 2 +
    γ * ‖z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)‖ ^ 2 +
    K * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 + ‖z‖ ^ 2)

def HasQuadraticSubsolutionTest {d : ℕ}
    (u_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) r,
    ∀ (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)))
      (X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
      (∀ v w, inner ℝ (X v) w = inner ℝ v (X w)) →
      (∃ δ_test > 0, ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball ξ₀ δ_test,
        u_hat ξ ≤ u_hat ξ₀ + inner ℝ q (ξ - ξ₀) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (X (ξ - ξ₀)) (ξ - ξ₀)) →
      0 ≤ inner ℝ (X (P + q)) (P + q)

def HasUniformBoxAndFitBounds (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M →
    ∃ (U_M : ℝ), 0 ≤ U_M ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ M → |projTime z| ≤ M → |w z| ≤ U_M) ∧
  (∀ (M R : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → 0 < R →
    ∃ (B_MR : ℝ), 0 ≤ B_MR ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ)
          (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a : ℝ),
          ‖x‖ ≤ M → |t| ≤ M → IsFitAt d C₁ w x t R p a →

def HasUniformBoxEquicontinuity (d : ℕ) (C₁ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : ℝ), 0 < M → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    ∃ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ),
        InLimitingClassA d C₁ w → IsCenteredAt d C₁ w 0 1 →
        ∀ (z z' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
          ‖projSpace z‖ ≤ M → |projTime z| ≤ M →
          ‖projSpace z' - projSpace z‖ ≤ δ → |projTime z' - projTime z| ≤ δ →
          |w z' - w z| ≤ ε

def IsCylinderComparisonConstant (d : ℕ) (L C_comp : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < C_comp ∧
  ∀ (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z z' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (H H' θ : ℝ)
    (P P' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))),
    0 < θ → θ < 1 / 2 →
    1 / 2 ≤ ‖P‖ → ‖P‖ ≤ L + 1 →
    1 / 2 ≤ ‖P'‖ → ‖P'‖ ≤ L + 1 →
    let n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P‖⁻¹) • P
    let n' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (‖P'‖⁻¹) • P'
    ((z' = z ∧ 0 < H ∧ H ≤ H' ∧ H' ≤ 2 * H ∧
      IsCylinderFitAt U z H (θ ^ 2) P ∧ IsCylinderFitAt U z H' (θ ^ 2) P') ∨
     (H' = H ∧ 0 < H ∧ |inner ℝ (z' - z) n| ≤ H / 4 ∧
      ‖(z' - z) - (inner ℝ (z' - z) n) • n‖ ≤ θ * H / 4 ∧
      IsCylinderFitAt U z H (θ ^ 2) P ∧ IsCylinderFitAt U z' H (θ ^ 2) P')) →
    ‖P - P'‖ ≤ C_comp * θ ∧
    ‖n - n'‖ ≤ C_comp * θ ∧
    |‖P‖ - ‖P'‖| ≤ C_comp * θ ^ 2

def IsBoundedCylinderFitAt (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (r lam : ℝ)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : Prop :=
  IsCylinderFitAt U z r lam P ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ ‖P‖ ∧ ‖P‖ ≤ L + 1

noncomputable def shearedFrameTransform (d : ℕ)
    (w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t₀ R : ℝ)
    (p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (a₀ : ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  let y := projSpace z
  let s := projTime z
  (w₀ (mkSpaceTime (x₀ + R • (y + (s - 1) • p₀)) (t₀ + R * (s - 1))) -
    w₀ (mkSpaceTime x₀ t₀)) / R -
    inner ℝ p₀ y - (a₀ + ‖p₀‖ ^ 2 / 2) * (s - 1)

noncomputable def psiPotential (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * s ^ 2 * (Real.log s) ^ 2 - 6 * s ^ 2 * Real.log s + 8 * s ^ 2

def HasPsiPotentialBounds : Prop :=
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ psiPotential s) ∧
  (∀ s T : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ T → psiPotential s ≤ psiPotential T) ∧
  (∀ s ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → 4 * ε ≤ s →
    ε ^ 2 * ((Real.log s) ^ 2 + 1 / 2) ≤
      (psiPotential (s + ε) + psiPotential (s - ε)) / 2 - psiPotential s)

noncomputable def uniformExp (h : ℕ) (f : (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ ω : Fin h → Bool, f ω) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h

noncomputable def uniformProb (h : ℕ) (P : (Fin h → Bool) → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact uniformExp h (fun ω => if P ω then 1 else 0)

def flipBit (h n : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) (i : Fin h) : Bool :=
  if i.1 = n then !ω i else ω i

def walkStepBit (h : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) (n : ℕ) : Bool :=
  if hn : n < h then ω ⟨n, hn⟩ else true

noncomputable def isWalkActive (d : ℕ) (δ R : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact decide (δ < z.2 ∧ z.2 < 16 ∧ ‖z.1‖ < R)

noncomputable def stoppedWalk (d : ℕ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (ε δ R : ℝ) (h : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ
  | 0 => (0, 1)
  | n + 1 =>
    let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ R h ω n
    if isWalkActive d δ R z then
      if walkStepBit h ω n then
        (z.1 + ε • Q_plus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 + ε)
      else
        (z.1 - ε • Q_minus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 - ε)
    else z

def isGoodReachedWalk (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R L₀ D₀ : ℝ) (ε_walk : ℕ → ℝ) (h_walk : ℕ → ℕ)
    (N : ℕ) (ω : Fin (h_walk N) → Bool) : Prop :=
  let ε := ε_walk N
  let h := h_walk N
  let δ_N := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N
  let z_term := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_N R h ω h
  z_term.2 = δ_N ∧
  ‖z_term.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
  L₀ ≤ driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime z_term.1 δ_N) ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N →
    let δ_j := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
    let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω h
    z_mk.2 = δ_j ∧
    ‖z_mk.1‖ ≤ R + 1 ∧
    L₀ - D₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ driftFunctional d κ ε v (mkSpaceTime z_mk.1 δ_j)

def HasPredictableTravelBound (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : ℕ) (ε' S_max M_vel C_vel B₀ : ℝ)
    (y : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (s : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → ℝ)
    (act : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → Bool)
    (q_plus q_minus q_zero : ℕ → (Fin h → Bool) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
    0 < ε' → 2 ≤ S_max → 0 ≤ M_vel → 0 ≤ C_vel → 0 ≤ B₀ →
    (∀ ω, y 0 ω = 0 ∧ s 0 ω = 1) →
    (∀ k n, k ≤ n → n < h → ∀ ω,
      y k (flipBit h n ω) = y k ω ∧
      s k (flipBit h n ω) = s k ω ∧
      act k (flipBit h n ω) = act k ω ∧
      q_zero k (flipBit h n ω) = q_zero k ω) →
    (∀ n < h, ∀ ω,
      (act n ω = true →
        y (n + 1) ω = (if walkStepBit h ω n then y n ω + ε' • q_plus n ω else y n ω - ε' • q_minus n ω) ∧
        s (n + 1) ω = (if walkStepBit h ω n then s n ω + ε' else s n ω - ε') ∧
        4 * ε' ≤ s n ω ∧
        ‖q_zero n ω‖ ≤ M_vel + C_vel * |Real.log (s n ω)|) ∧
      (act n ω = false → y (n + 1) ω = y n ω ∧ s (n + 1) ω = s n ω)) →
    (∀ ω, 0 < s h ω ∧ s h ω ≤ S_max) →
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (‖q_plus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2 + ‖q_minus n ω - q_zero n ω‖ ^ 2) else 0) ≤ B₀ →
    uniformExp h (fun ω => s h ω) = 1 ∧
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range h,
      if act n ω then (ε') ^ 2 else 0) ≤ 2 * psiPotential S_max ∧
    uniformExp h (fun ω => ‖y h ω‖) ≤
      Real.sqrt (psiPotential S_max) * (2 * (M_vel + C_vel) + Real.sqrt (2 * B₀))

def HasOriginalWalkBounds (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus Q_zero : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R L₀ D₀ B₀ : ℝ) (m_walk h_walk : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  let ε_walk : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m_walk N)
  16 ≤ R ∧ 0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < B₀ ∧
  ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
    N + 2 ≤ m_walk N ∧
    0 < ε_walk N ∧ ε_walk N ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) / 4 ∧
    (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (t : ℝ),
      ‖x‖ ≤ R → ε_walk N < t → t ≤ 16 →
      ‖(ε_walk N) • Q_plus x t (ε_walk N)‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      ‖(ε_walk N) • Q_minus x t (ε_walk N)‖ ≤ 1) ∧
    uniformProb (h_walk N)
      (isGoodReachedWalk d κ v Q_plus Q_minus R L₀ D₀ ε_walk h_walk N) ≥ 5 / 8 ∧
    uniformExp (h_walk N) (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (h_walk N),
      let z := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus (ε_walk N) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R (h_walk N) ω n
      if isWalkActive d ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) R z then
        (‖Q_plus z.1 z.2 (ε_walk N) - Q_zero z.1 z.2 (ε_walk N)‖ ^ 2 +
         ‖Q_minus z.1 z.2 (ε_walk N) - Q_zero z.1 z.2 (ε_walk N)‖ ^ 2)
      else 0) ≤ B₀

noncomputable def sliceQuadTest (d : ℕ) (p₀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (s₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ α : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  inner ℝ p₀ (projSpace z) + c₀ + c₁ * (projTime z - s₀) +
    (c₂ / 2) * (projTime z - s₀) ^ 2 + (α / 2) * ‖projSpace z - x‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def movingParabolicTestFunc (d : ℕ) (x q_path : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (t τ₀ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : ℝ :=
  c₀ + c₁ * (projTime z - τ₀) + (c₂ / 2) * (projTime z - τ₀) ^ 2 -
    ‖q_path‖ ^ 2 * ((projTime z - t) * Real.log (projTime z - t)) +
    ‖projSpace z - (x + (projTime z - t) • q_path)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (projTime z - t))

noncomputable def threePointQuadGrad₁ {d : ℕ}
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  let w_perp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (x - y) - (inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e
  let w_perp2 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := w_perp - (inner ℝ e w_perp) • e
  (-2 * α * inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e +
    (2 * β) • w_perp2 -
    γ • (z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) +
    (2 * K) • x

noncomputable def threePointQuadGrad₂ {d : ℕ}
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (α β γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  let w_perp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := (x - y) - (inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e
  let w_perp2 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) := w_perp - (inner ℝ e w_perp) • e
  (2 * α * inner ℝ e (x - y)) • e -
    (2 * β) • w_perp2 -
    γ • (z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) +
    (2 * K) • y

noncomputable def threePointQuadGrad₃ {d : ℕ}
    (γ K : ℝ)
    (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) :=
  (2 * γ) • (z - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) +
    (2 * K) • z

def IsProximalMapFor {d : ℕ}
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ)
    (J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) : Prop :=
  LipschitzWith 1 J ∧
  (∀ y w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    inner ℝ (y - J y) (w - J y) ≤ ψ w - ψ (J y)) ∧
  (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)),
    ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)), J y = x)

open Classical in
noncomputable def isMarkReached (d : ℕ) (δ_j R : ℝ) (z_mk : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : Bool :=
  decide (isWalkActive d δ_j R z_mk = false ∧ z_mk.2 = δ_j)

noncomputable def fittedRelPos (d : ℕ)
    (p_sel : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (j : ℕ) (z_mk z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
  let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
  δ_j⁻¹ • (z.1 - z_mk.1 - (z.2 - z_mk.2) • p_sel j z_mk.1)

noncomputable def fittedRelTime (d : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (j : ℕ)
    (z_mk z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
  if isMarkReached d δ_j R z_mk then δ_j⁻¹ * z.2 else 1

open Classical in
noncomputable def isPostMarkActive (d : ℕ)
    (p_sel : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (δ_N R : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (z_mk z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ) : Bool :=
  let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
  decide (isMarkReached d δ_j R z_mk = true ∧
    isWalkActive d δ_N R z = true ∧ z.2 < 8 * δ_j ∧
    ‖fittedRelPos d p_sel j z_mk z‖ < K)

noncomputable def postMarkWalk (d : ℕ)
    (Q_plus Q_minus : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (p_sel : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (ε δ_N R : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (h : ℕ) (ω : Fin h → Bool) :
    ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) × ℝ
  | 0 => (0, 1)
  | n + 1 =>
    let δ_j : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j
    let z_mk := stoppedWalk d Q_plus Q_minus ε δ_j R h ω n
    let z := postMarkWalk d Q_plus Q_minus p_sel ε δ_N R j K h ω n
    if (isWalkActive d δ_j R z_mk || isPostMarkActive d p_sel δ_N R j K z_mk z) then
      if walkStepBit h ω n then
        (z.1 + ε • Q_plus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 + ε)
      else
        (z.1 - ε • Q_minus z.1 z.2 ε, z.2 - ε)
    else z
